metas.description: In a bold 28-day experiment, comedian Mo Gilligan tours the UK and US on a fried chicken diet to uncover the impact of the craving — and industry behind it.

metas.name: Poster Boy: Becoming Zyzz
metas.description: Explores the rise, impact, and enduring mythology of Aziz Shavershian – “Zyzz” – the unlikely internet icon whose transformation from anonymous teenager to global symbol of fitness culture reshaped how a generation defines influencers, identity, and self-invention.

metas.name: The Time Machine: A UTS Revue
metas.description: Aspiring directors, Cam and Felicity, pitch a revue that gets rejected immediately. In order to put on the show they've always dreamt about, they hatch a plan. But what happens when that plan goes wrong?

metas.name: Scuz
metas.description: 'Scuz' tells the story of County Cricketer Graham 'Scuzzer' Kersey, who’s life was cut short in a car accident in Australia on Christmas Eve, 1996. With a host of archive clips, unearthed photographs and new interviews with cricketing greats, 'Scuz' explores the memories and wild anecdotes of his career, from his beginnings at Bexley, through to his wicketkeeping years at Kent and Surrey, in a life cut short, but always lived to the full.

metas.name: Ice Twister
metas.description: A family in a mountain cabin faces a deadly ice tornado that blocks escape routes. As the storm tears apart their shelter and tensions rise, they must choose between braving the elements or staying put to face the natural disaster from hell.

metas.name: Gargantuan
metas.description: Five washed-up heroes reunite to pilot their giant robot and save the world.

metas.name: Perspective
metas.description: A college student, after provoked, recounts a time with his old friend. But his vision is a little hazy, and sometimes he cannot tell what's real from what's not

metas.name: The Doorman
metas.description: A freshman pledge guarding the biggest dorm party of the year faces a test of his commitment to the fraternity.

metas.name: Bullseye
metas.description: An argument between a couple escalates

metas.name: slushynoobzcanadatour2026thedocumentary
metas.description: This documentary showcases the creative thought process, back-of-the-van planning, and absolute chaos behind the cross-country journey of creators Hamzah Al-Emad and Martin Andrijasevic (Slushy Noobz). Spanning eight dates from June 23 to July 18, 2026, the film tracks their live streaming route across Canada—from Quebec City to Toronto—captured entirely by videographer Liam Bursey.

metas.name: Girl Downstairs Top Upstairs
metas.description: The official music video for Girl Downstairs Top Upstairs by Hot House. Also known as GDTU. Special thanks to Annie Wren and Emily Louise for helping to make all the objects fly!

metas.name: Something Good Going On
metas.description: A Chinese-Indonesian teen confronts a stolen restaurant paycheck, a strained father-son bond, and the cost of his Ivy League future.

metas.name: a spring glow
metas.description: A young woman is taken along to celebrate the arrival of spring.

metas.name: Oh Boy - A Will To Change
metas.description: Bas invites his friend Flor on a boys’ weekend in the French Ardennes to explore vulnerability. To facilitate this experiment, they adopt ‘Cowboy’ alter egos, in the hope that this role-play will help them get closer to themselves and to each other.

metas.name: Gwen Everest
metas.description: “The song’s title is an obscure reference to a character in a short story by Frank Herbert. It was written from the perspective of someone watching a loved one set out on a path that was not recommended to them, able only to watch passively as events unfold.” – Panchiko

metas.name: Our Town
metas.description: Grover's Corners is a quiet little town, full of ordinary folk, living everyday lives. They work, they laugh, they sing, they fall in love and raise their children and grow old. But within those moments of ordinary, everyday life, there are truths that reach out to us all. And a passionate demand to cherish every moment, right now, while we still can. (A joint Welsh National Theatre and Rose Theatre production, filmed at the Rose Theatre in Kingston, London on 19 March 2026.)

metas.name: Trigger Happy
metas.description: A neon action-thriller about influencers fighting to the death at a live-streamed, lethal laser-tag match, exploring competition, revenge, and weaponized performance.

metas.name: Before Never
metas.description: When Wendy Darling escapes an attempted abduction, her family employs James and Smee to identify the attacker with the help of the only eyewitness: Peter Pan.

metas.name: The Cover Story
metas.description: Inside an ordinary home, a plastic cover speaks not as waste, but as a ruler. From the smallest household corner, it declares its dominance.

metas.name: Sky to Soil
metas.description: A young couple with conflicting desires for intimacy attempt to celebrate their one-year anniversary.

metas.name: Angel Dark
metas.description: Two best friends, Lilith and Miley, head to a carnival for a nostalgic night of fun, laughter, and memories. Amid the bright lights and lively music, an old flame from Lilith’s past unexpectedly appears, hoping to reconnect and rekindle what they once had.

metas.name: Turtle Rock
metas.description: A teenage girl named Turtle must overcome her stage fright to fight against dangerous musical monsters with the power of rock ‘n’ roll.

metas.name: Ohio King: A Gooner Sigma Story
metas.description: After the death of his Master Sigma, a gooner named Gian seeks vengeance on the ancient villain, the Ohio King.  On his journey Gian will discover truth, friends, and where he lies in the mind of his fallen Master.

metas.name: The Merlodyssey
metas.description: A gripping true story about about student life at the village, as one (two?) young man goes on an alcohol deprived odyssey to find his bottle of merlot.

metas.name: May 1st
metas.description: A short following a man as he struggles with his mental health, and showing how life keeps moving no matter what.

metas.name: Birthday Party
metas.description: Stop-motion animation of setting up a birthday party

metas.name: Storm on Sesame Street
metas.description: In the Storm on Sesame Street special, Elmo and his friends work together to get ready for a big storm, learning how to be prepared, have courage, and calm their bodies and minds when things feel scary. After the storm passes, Sesame Street looks different, and everyone pitches in to help their neighbors rebuild their homes. With the help of the neighborhood, including celebrity guests Post Malone and Michelle Buteau, Elmo and Abby set out to make a difference, and discover that small acts of kindness, and support from friends, can make the biggest difference of all.

metas.name: The Bottom of the Can
metas.description: Following Freya as she suffers from a severe lack of spark in the theme park... could it be a case of the frightful "theme park ennui"?

metas.name: Bad Ramen
metas.description: A ramen date goes south when the girl suddenly falls ill at dinner and begins exhibiting sinister behavior.

metas.name: Shards
metas.description: A WWII pilots journey flying through treacherous air hoping to evade enemy aircraft and not be captured while struggling with reminders of home.

metas.name: How To Be Happy
metas.description: When Max goes through a messy breakup he has to figure out how to get over his sad patch.

metas.name: Sea of Stars
metas.description: Driving through a sea of stars. The universe is infinite.

metas.name: Blood Mandate
metas.description: A visceral action-thriller where a lone fighter is forced into a relentless pursuit by a grim ancestral decree. To satisfy a blood mandate that haunts his family's legacy, he must cut through a web of enemies and shifting alliances. As the hunt intensifies, the line between justice and revenge blurs in a raw struggle for survival.

metas.name: Décima
metas.description: In 1980s Puerto Rico, a grieving man is torn between escaping with his pregnant wife or joining his radicalized younger brother in a dangerous fight for justice, as the death of their brother threatens to tear their family and community apart.

metas.name: Oceanic Feeling
metas.description: On a summer vacation, David must stomach his mother's continued disappointment as he asks for her help after being laid off.

metas.name: Kylie Vincent's Last Day on Earth
metas.description: Last year (2025), Kylie Vincent's Instagram was deleted by Meta, with no option to appeal. Meta is silencing SA survivors and is one of the biggest perpetrators of censorship in America.

metas.name: Ankaha
metas.description: When Priya chooses to hang out with a new intern instead of attending a wedding with her boyfriend Ishaan, he is forced to confront what he really wants out of his future.

metas.name: Swordfish: The Legend of Johnny Fin
metas.description: They killed Johnny Fin's fish... now Johnny must show them the price they must pay.

metas.name: 24 Hour Sanctuary
metas.description: In the heart of Los Angeles, a century-old deli that was once the symbol of Jewish heritage has survived the changing landscapes of a postmodern society by becoming a 24-hour sanctuary of community resilience for all people.

metas.name: Blessings
metas.description: Ray and Tyler go on a fishing trip. Ray has a proposal; hilarity ensues.

metas.name: Heista La Vista
metas.description: Raymond, an unprepared hacker, must navigate his crew in a heist for The Benefactor, an expensive artwork rumoured to contain a map.

metas.name: WWE SummerSlam 2026: Sunday
metas.description: The 2026 SummerSlam, also promoted as SummerSlam: Minnesota, is a professional wrestling pay-per-view (PPV) and livestreaming event produced by WWE. It is the 39th annual SummerSlam and took place as a two-night event on August 1st and 2nd at U.S. Bank Stadium in Minneapolis, Minnesota.

metas.name: Oscar's Date
metas.description: When their roommate starts dating someone from their past, three friends race to warn him before things spiral out of control.

metas.name: The Little Girl Who Didn't Exist
metas.description: When Mel tries to meet the parents of her daughter's new playmate Sara, she finds that everyone claims the child doesn't exist. But as evidence mounts that Sara is real, Mel becomes convinced that someone is hiding the girl to conceal a dark secret.

metas.name: Ciggie
metas.description: Tells the story of 11 year old Joseph and his 12 year old best friend Joyce. We follow them as they sneak off into the bush behind their house to smoke a cigarette for the first time. As the story unfolds we realise that Joseph's rich and powerful friendship with Joyce serves as a beacon of hope and positivity in contrast to the not so ideal life he must endure at home.

metas.name: The Whole Thing
metas.description: Two strangers meeting at a crematorium while picking up their loved ones' remains. They decide to spend the day together, killing time and watching the world go by.

metas.name: The Kete Informs You
metas.description: The Kete Informs You follows Paitai as he weaves a kete (handwoven basket or a bag) while reflecting on this rangaranga journey, the inspiration behind his work, and the role weaving continues to play in identity and contemporary culture. - Cook Islands News

metas.name: Lady Shaka : Sonic Sands
metas.description: A poetic film following internationally recognised multi-Indigenous DJ Lady Shaka as she transforms club spaces into sites of resistance, connection, and cultural reclamation. Through music, movement, and community, she celebrates Pacific identity and turns the dance floor into a living expression of resilience and belonging.

metas.name: Tall Hours
metas.description: After his daughter dies in a racing accident, a father must decide the fate of the horse that killed her. An intimate and emotional exploration of grief set against the backdrop of rural Aotearoa.

metas.name: Arrival
metas.description: After arriving in Aotearoa as refugees, a mother and daughter find their roles upended in the face of a new and unfamiliar world.

metas.name: Yes David
metas.description: In the near-future where "wokeness" is outlawed, seven strangers attend a workshop led by a disembodied leader but as his absurd lessons turn violent, they must choose between obedience and humanity.

metas.name: Wet Proofs of the Flesh
metas.description: Mistress Maggie Peach moves in latex and leather through the fruit and flesh of your five-part wet dream.

metas.name: SHITTING A PENIS
metas.description: Found footage of a Montreal girl’s trip turns sinister as the textures and unnatural rhythms of VHS are haunted by half-remembered nightmares from the past. With SHITTING A PENIS, Sam Morgan transforms a found object into a dark and uncomfortable exploration of memory and identity. In an era of image overabundance, what happens to what has been recorded? Are there people trapped forever on tapes, hard drives, and phones, enshrouded mirrors of selves, caught on repeat?

metas.name: Even, For Tonight
metas.description: Two people decide to call it even, for tonight.

metas.name: Be Merry
metas.description: Raised in 1980s Russell by Merry, an artist whose life became local folklore, filmmaker Gwen Isaac returns to her Far North hometown to untangle fact from family legend and confront the inheritance she carries into her own motherhood.

metas.name: Letter To Celestial
metas.description: Letter to Celestial is a re-animation and re-imagination of archival documents found in the search for Asian sex workers in Montréal's Chinatown and historic Red Light District.

metas.name: The Lift
metas.description: The world's first film shot entirely inside an elevator, from the brilliant mind of Sexocracy author Luca Redavid. Bologna, August 2, 1980. A terrifying roar shakes the central station, while six strangers remain trapped in a cabin just steps from hell. Isolated from the world in a claustrophobic space of just a few square meters, tensions rise to the limit as air runs out and help fails to arrive...

metas.name: Triesverse: Cataclysm
metas.description: Part one of a two-part finale. Daniel Chapman is back, and this time he's brought company. With his rebooted mission to bring the Last Reality to fruition in progress, Izz Fury's newly-formed Reality Warriors must band together to put an end to his deluded antics. The stakes have never been higher - the Triesverse ends here.

metas.name: Constructs
metas.description: This experimental found-footage film uses state and corporate propaganda to explore the relationship between extractive industry infrastructure and audiovisual materials in Canada's colonial project.

metas.name: Everything On Land With Bones Is A Fish
metas.description: A man appears to be falling from a building, but it's the building behind him that rises, leaving a crater in the ground. Strange structures emerge from the hole and then ascend. When he tries his keys to get back inside, his real fall begins.

metas.name: The Glitter Fades
metas.description: After an impulsive decision to steal a watch, Matthew, a young man stuck working at a dry cleaner, is pulled into a chain of encounters that force him to confront who he is and who he wants to become.

metas.name: Spectronizer
metas.description: Superhero team Spectronizer, has to defend the town from a threat that is closer to home than they may think....

metas.name: Little Miss Fortune
metas.description: A young journalist must find a story in Belfast before midnight or lose his job.

metas.name: Freaks Part II
metas.description: Several years after a traumatic escape, we meet Mary and her daughter Chloe as they live on the road, hiding their powers and identities. They are hunted by the Abnormal Defense Force, paramilitary police that specialize in ruthlessly exterminating ‘freaks‘ like them. Mary is fueled by revenge, determined to find the ADF officer who killed her first child.

metas.name: The Messenger
metas.description: In 1800s Fiji, Kaliti must battle both man & nature to save her village from impending doom.

metas.name: In Conversation with Jack Maurer
metas.description: When American tech billionaire Jack Maurer pays for an elite prediction service for global threats, he receives a warning that takes him to Queenstown, New Zealand.

metas.name: Kurī
metas.description: Kurī hasn't been back home to Te Urewera since she was bitten on the face by a dog as a child. She must return home and face the uncertainty of grief - whether she's ready to or not.

metas.name: East Did Meet West
metas.description: Inspired by the 1930s court case Roldan vs. Los Angeles County, Filipino Salvador  Roldan and English Marjorie Rogers must find a way to convince an attorney to fight  for their marriage despite the anti-miscegenation laws of the time.

metas.name: WWE SummerSlam 2026: Sunday - Countdown
metas.description: Get the latest breaking news, rivalry analysis from a panel of experts, and much more before The Biggest Party of the Summer concludes on Sunday night!

metas.name: Handle With Care
metas.description: Handle With Care, a short documentary filmed in Niseko, Hokkaido, Japan. It shows the lifestyle and the changes that are taking place in the small town through natural scenery, classical music, and stories from the mouth of a local. It is soothing, though with a scent of senti

metas.name: The Inbetween
metas.description: Eric Williams, a renowned food critic is invited to a fine establishment run by a strange, utopian cult.

metas.name: I Kill Gods
metas.description: After spending years entrapped by the gods, Calypso has finally escaped and is coming back with a vengeance.

metas.name: Establishing Shots (and how music affects them)
metas.description: Establishing Shots (and how music affects them), a short film.

metas.name: Hawkins Power & Light
metas.description: HAWKINS POWER and LIGHT is set in 1983 and tells the story of three high school graduates who happen upon X-03, an escaped experiment from Hawkins Lab. Before they know it, they're thrust into a dark government conspiracy.

metas.name: Cornerstone: The Lenny Wilkens Story
metas.description: Built around Lenny’s final interview and the voices of those who knew him best, this short documentary celebrates the life of one of Seattle’s most beloved figures and reflects on a lifetime of leadership, humility, and service.

metas.name: Always Been You
metas.description: Two friends grow apart as one friend's relationship gets in the way of the two.

metas.name: Tracers
metas.description: Tracers follows a group of young American soldiers from basic training through their combat experiences in Vietnam and, for those who survive, their difficult return to civilian life. The film explores the legacy of the original stage production, which was created by Vietnam veterans and became one of the most influential artistic works about the war. Perniciaro's film combines documentary storytelling with staged performance to tell both the story of the play and the experiences that inspired it.

metas.name: Echoes
metas.description: A girl enters an old attic that seems to be frozen in time. Between forgotten objects, an old radio and the warm light coming through the windows, she discovers a small hidden world: an old circus tent from another time. As she explores the room, something begins to come back. Distant children's voices, forgotten laughter and strange feelings appear, as if the attic is holding memories from the past.  The room is not empty. It still keeps the echoes of the people and moments that once lived there.

metas.name: The Story Behind The City
metas.description: An experimental video that was shot, edited, and finalized in 24 hours as a class project. "The Story Behind The City" combines some remarks by a 75-year-old Shanghainese man with shots from Huangpu District, while using Charli XCX's "Camera" as the soundtrack.

metas.name: Calvin Harris: Live from Scotland
metas.description: Scottish DJ, producer and global superstar Calvin Harris returns home for a hugely anticipated show, live from Glasgow’s legendary Hampden Park. Celebrating an extraordinary 20-year career, the prolific hitmaker has amassed over 56 billion streams, won multiple awards and boasts 11 UK number one singles, making him the dance act with the most chart-topping records in history.  Just 20 years after playing his first ever gig to around 300 people at Glasgow's King Tut's Wah Wah Hut, the Dumfries-born artist transforms the country's national stadium into a giant open-air club. He performs a career-spanning set packed with era-defining anthems, spectacular production and euphoric moments for more than 50,000 fans, his biggest Scottish crowd to date.

metas.name: Eclipse Across Europe
metas.description: On Wednesday, August 12, 2026, Europe will look to the skies for a once-in-a-lifetime event: a total solar eclipse. For the first time in 27 years, the moon’s shadow will sweep dramatically across Greenland, Iceland, and Spain, captivating an estimated 980 million viewers.  Traveling at an astonishing 1,500 mph and stretching 190 miles wide, this cosmic marvel promises to be the most talked-about natural event of the decade.  Our one-hour special delivers the ultimate front-row seat to this breathtaking phenomenon, packed with expert insights, cutting-edge visuals, and a countdown to the moment the world stands still.

metas.name: Hitler’s Games: Berlin 1936 in Colour
metas.description: In 1931, Germany was awarded the Olympic Games in the hope this would draw them into the international community and world peace would be promoted through sport.  For two weeks in August 1936 cameras captured the world’s greatest sporting spectacle, including the Gold Medal triumphs of record-breaking sprinter Jesse Owens. The Berlin Olympics were groundbreaking – many innovations introduced in 1936 such as television coverage and the torch relay became part of every subsequent Games.  Hitler’s Games in Colour tells the story of the remarkable amateurs who excelled, but also how Hitler used the Games as propaganda for his brutal regime, to show the Nazis as benign and their military ambitions as modest. Using black and white archive, transformed by cutting-edge restoration and colourisation, this is the story of 16 days that fooled the world…

metas.name: Killer Clown
metas.description: Decades after witnessing her mother’s brutal murder at the hands of the “Killer Clown,” Elizabeth Helmer (Sara Paxton) remains haunted by the crime that shattered her childhood. When she begins investigating the long-unsolved cold case, Elizabeth becomes the target of a terrifying copycat stalker, forcing her to confront painful memories she has spent a lifetime trying to escape. As she searches for answers alongside her father Reed (David Cubitt) and husband Dan (Hamza Haq), Elizabeth uncovers a tangled web of family betrayal and long-buried secrets.  As she closes in on the truth, Elizabeth must separate fact from manipulation and fight to survive before history repeats itself.

metas.name: Passing By

Bound by invisible burdens, they confront loss, identity, and the fragile hope of becoming more than the lives they almost lived. Through a poetic reinterpretation of limbo, the film explores the silent rebellion of simply continuing to exist.

metas.name: Interlinked

Pushing his body to its limits and navigating the pressures of city life, he begins to find unexpected peace in Layla a connection that offers warmth, intimacy, and the possibility of healing.  But as memories begin to blur with the present, the fragile stability JJ has built starts to fracture. Moments repeat, emotions spiral, and the line between past and reality grows increasingly uncertain. Through a fragmented journey of rage, vulnerability, and longing, JJ is forced to confront the parts of himself he has spent years trying to bury.  As the story unfolds, the truth behind JJ’s experience slowly emerges revealing a devastating portrait of trauma, perception, and the fragile ways the mind protects itself when pain goes unheard.

metas.name: Blind Road

In 2026, it made its official broadcast debut on television and was released online for global audiences.  Driven by Dhaka's relentless traffic, a reckless motorcyclist dangerously rode onto a sidewalk, terrifying pedestrians and aggressively confronting a visually impaired man who was using the guided path. As an outraged crowd gathered to confront the illegal rider for his blatant disregard for safety and decency, the blind man remarkably stepped in to shield his aggressor. Ultimately, his unexpected act of grace transformed a moment of hostility into a powerful lesson in compassion.

metas.name: A Way Out
metas.description: One call for help ignites a nationwide fight to end human trafficking.  A Way Out follows Safe House Project as they confront the reality of human trafficking in the United States and build a clear path to safety for survivors. The documentary centers on a simple turning point: a survivor makes a call for help. From there, the film tracks what happens behind the scenes as Safe House Project coordinates a rapid response, connects with survivor advocates, and works alongside law enforcement and trusted partners to move someone from immediate danger toward safety and justice. As the story unfolds, viewers see how a single call can set a nationwide network in motion, and how clarity, coordination, and courage can change the outcome for someone who feels trapped. The film balances the gravity of the issue with a strong sense of hope, showing ordinary people stepping into an extraordinary mission to make a way out.  —Clay Vaughan

metas.name: Wild Inside

What follows when Flaco, who had lived his entire life in captivity, was released in New York City is a surprising story revealing the delight, concern, and fascination of millions in the city and beyond.

metas.description: A surrealist/experimental internet short film about grief.

metas.name: Chasing Home
metas.description: A 30-year-old British-Mexican comic creator visits her parents to secure a deposit for her first flat, only to find help won’t come because her mother, 51, is pregnant.

metas.name: Daybreak
metas.description: Two unicorns, representing ex-WWE superstars Kofi Kingston & Xavier Woods, breaking out of the circus.

metas.name: windowfilm
metas.description: A journey between Astoria and Herald Square through the windows of the train.

metas.name: Sisters of the Shattered Moon
metas.description: When a teenage girl discovers the corruption of her futuristic suburban idyll in the clouds, she is expelled to a vast underworld of endless night.

metas.name: Ultimate Shark Dive
metas.description: In a world first, a cliff diver Molly Carlson attempts a 50-foot dive off a helicopter into a floating cage surrounded by a shark feeding frenzy.

metas.name: How to Train a Great White
metas.description: Experts attempt to train great white sharks using cues and challenges to test learning, memory, and decision-making in the wild.

metas.name: What Shark Attacked?
metas.description: Experts analyze shark encounters caught on camera, using forensics to review bite marks and behavior patterns as they wonder: What shark attacked?

metas.name: The Making Of
metas.description: A documentary about making a film, shot over a week.

metas.name: Hierophany
metas.description: An extraterrestrial-obsessed man is troubled by nightly visitations from a mysterious presence.

metas.name: Familiar Strangers
metas.description: A short drama exploring how different people deal with grief.

metas.name: The Light
metas.description: An animated short made as part of a 24-hour film challenge.

metas.name: Afterliving
metas.description: A woman arrives at The Bureau, a mysterious in-between, where her life is put to a test before her fate can be decided.

metas.name: Carpe Noctem
metas.description: Thomas's life is changed after he watches Dead Poets Society for the first time. It makes him realize he must carpe diem, or seize the day, and make the most of Summer... but it's night, so he puts his own spin on the classic phrase. With the help of a newfound friend and a video camera, Thomas has the best Summer of his life.

metas.name: Soulless
metas.description: A struggling writer is confronted by temptation to make his life a little easier.

metas.name: Man With News
metas.description: Harry has one line on a TV show and he's going to give it all he's got.

metas.name: John Shearer: American Moments
metas.description: A documentary short on the life and work of the late artist John Shearer, one of the greatest American photographers of the 20th century.

metas.name: AMUCK
metas.description: A man who laments "not even feeling like the main character of his own story" suddenly finds himself aware of the camera that's watching him, eliciting a mind-bending journey of self discovery.

metas.name: The Two Year Rule
metas.description: On the way to a cottage weekend with friends, a couple’s drive takes an unexpected turn when a passing cemetery stirs unresolved tensions.

metas.name: Mickey's Country Farm
metas.description: Mickey and friends use their new farm vehicles to build the Fairest Farm Fair ever — hoping Daisy’s cowgirl idol, Lasso Lucy, will stop by for a visit.

metas.name: Tiny Rejections
metas.description: Taylor and her friend try to climb a fence at night but something looms in the shadows.

metas.name: Addicted to Change
metas.description: In a near future Britain, at a biotech lab on the brink of collapse, three interns invent a cognitive enhancing drug. They begin full scale manufacture, only to become targets of government forces who view their breakthrough as a threat.

metas.name: Snoopy Presents: There's No Place Like Home, Snoopy
metas.description: When Snoopy's beloved doghouse goes missing, he tries to track it down, and learns what makes a house feel like home.

metas.name: Morning Afternoon Night
metas.description: They say you can start over, but if the music in your head is different, and the smells aren’t the same... then what? Where is that start?  In a single day, Marta, a young Russian migrant in Perth faces the end of her visa and the question of who she really is when home is nowhere to be found.

metas.name: Play Room
metas.description: In this surreal queer rom-com, macho bouncer Alexei secretly attends a cruising hotspot, where his sexual experiences are played out as rounds of board games. After multiple unfulfilling encounters, he finds himself connecting with Josh, which forces him to finally confront the way he keeps these worlds apart.

metas.name: Death Note - The Musical
metas.description: If you had the power over life and death, what would you do?  Now, boldly reimagined for the London stage in close collaboration with the original Japanese producers, HoriPro, this new musical features an electrifying score by Tony, Grammy and Emmy nominee Frank Wildhorn, lyrics by Jack Murphy and a book by Ivan Menchell. Death Note: The Musical is set to be the theatrical event of the summer.  When brilliant student Light Yagami discovers a notebook with the power to determine who lives and who dies, his mission to reshape society quickly spirals out of control and attracts the attention of the elusive and ruthless detective L. What begins as justice descends into obsession and forces both Light and L to confront the limits of morality itself.

metas.name: Naked Pool Party
metas.description: A comedy that follows three gay friends as they step out of their comfort zones to attend their first naked pool party.

metas.name: A Prince in Paradise: A Royal Wedding
metas.description: When the fairytale royal wedding of Olivia Perkins and Prince Alexander is derailed by an archaic law, the couple must confront an uncertain future and fight for their right to be together.

metas.name: Ashes
metas.description: One night. One gun. Two estranged brothers reunited by the man who killed their parents and a choice that will either damn them both or lead one to grace.

metas.name: Interstate
metas.description: Set in 2009, a group of lost high school graduates embark on a road trip to find themselves before they enter the next chapter of their lives. However, their plans take a twist when both old and new drama emerges, threatening to break their fragile group bond.

metas.name: Kim Novak's Vertigo
metas.description: Explores Kim Novak's life, highlighting her role in Alfred Hitchcock's Vertigo, and her journey from stardom to a reclusive life as an artist in Oregon, using rare archival footage and Novak's own reflections.

metas.name: A Comfortable Relationship
metas.description: A quiet portrait of love, comfort, and the subtle ways two people can lose themselves in one another.

metas.name: The Lion
metas.description: After accruing some serious debt, Charlie and Elias have spent the last six months doing some not-so-legal jobs for IRA Lieutenant Collin. When Collin approaches them to do their first hired hit, they are forced to reckon with the consequences of their actions, and question how far they are willing to go in this criminal life.

metas.name: LAVOLA Live at The Shack North
metas.description: LAVOLA Live at The Shack North concert film includes performances from LAVOLA's album "Did You Have a Good Day."

metas.name: Lover of a Ghost
metas.description: A girl abandoned by her lover is ostracized by the people of a small town, refusing to believe he ran from a murder. In search of clues she returns to the scene of the crime, only to be met by the silent gaze of a ghost.

metas.name: Jared Leto: Hollywood's Dark Secret
metas.description: An investigative documentary exploring long-standing and newly detailed allegations of sexual misconduct, grooming, and criminal sexual conduct against Oscar-winning actor and Thirty Seconds to Mars frontman Jared Leto.

metas.name: Don’t explode
metas.description: DON’T EXPLODE!

metas.name: Cool Drink
metas.description: Sixteen best friends from across the planet meet for the first time and experience loss, love, and grief through the power of live music. Can they find their way back home?

metas.name: Expedition X: Atomic Sharks
metas.description: The team investigates disturbing reports of aggressive mutant sharks in the Marshall Islands, exploring whether the region's atomic past is to blame.

metas.name: Expedition Unknown: Shark Secrets
metas.description: Josh Gates explores Scotland's Stronsay Beast, the earliest known shark attack and how the USS Indianapolis led to history's deadliest attack.

metas.name: Alien Sharks: Untamed America
metas.description: Forrest Galante explores America's strangest alien sharks in celebration of the nation's 250th anniversary.

metas.name: After the Line
metas.description: Documentary profile of cyclist Logan Maclean.

metas.name: The Bothy
metas.description: A short documentary looking at the world of the bothy.

metas.name: Tale of the Kelpie
metas.description: An animated story from the world of Scottish myth and legend.

metas.name: Madness
metas.description: A profile of a modern day monk on the Scottish island of Iona.

metas.name: Cattle
metas.description: A quiet farmer is pushed to the breaking point by a group of teenagers.

metas.name: Izmaylovo 1
metas.description: What is that up in the sky? Is it a bird? Is it an  aeroplane?  No, it's the cinematic eye decieving you. It's a study of circular motion, polyphony in image, light, shape and form. It's a liquid painting in white on the blue canvas of the sky. It's an experimental short, short in Izmaylovo

metas.name: Sime-la li bien-bien long
metas.description: A couple that does not love each other anymore goes on a roadtrip. What could go wrong?

metas.name: God Hunter
metas.description: In a world where beings from myth and folklore have entered our realm, an undercover cop infiltrates a trafficking ring that smuggles and sells these beings to find his son.

metas.name: Love/Bug
metas.description: A couple, affectionately naming each other Love and Bug, test the limits of their love living with each other for fifteen months.

metas.name: Filíocht Na Corcaí
metas.description: An intimate documentary showcasing the vibrant poetry scene of Cork City and the talented community of artists involved in these incredible nights.

metas.name: In Memory Of Tommy Tiger
metas.description: Washed-up cereal spokesman Tommy Tiger wastes his hours with a cocktail of whippets, whiskey, and cheap beer. A memory of his father hurdles him into a crushing downward spiral.

metas.name: The Gentleman Thief
metas.description: A retired master thief must protect his impulsive brother from disaster when a 100 million dollar yacht heist spirals into a dangerous web of deception. Old foes emerge as the stakes rise, forcing him to use every trick he knows to stay alive.

metas.name: Out Of Line
metas.description: Through quiet images and symbolic moments, the film explores the feeling of being different and the search for identity. It is a story about loneliness, acceptance, and learning to embrace the things that make us unique.

metas.name: Jess Elgene: Less of a Man
metas.description: Jess Elgene's debut special, LESS OF A MAN, was recorded live at Caveat in New York City on March 6, 2024 and features the original songs "Katarina," "Food Court," "Body // Feelings," "The Devil," "Small Talk," and "Undeniably." The special covers a range of topics including gender identity, body image, and acceptance. Elgene is "totally charismatic and engrossing," and LESS OF A MAN boasts "some of the very best of storytelling-comedy at the Fringe this year." -- Binge Fringe Magazine

metas.name: The Chorus of Tongues
metas.description: An ecologist, tasked with recording frogsong and surveying species presence, comes face to face with local extinction when the voices of the bog go quiet one by one.

metas.name: The Curse of the Rosetta Stone
metas.description: Three best friends go on a quest to find the Rosetta Stone!

metas.name: Chum Island: Catching a Killer
metas.description: In this Shark Week whodunnit, a rare surge of highly aggressive shark attacks hit a tight-knit community off Australia’s southern coast, prompting marine biologist Riley Elliott to find and tag the oceanic suspects. But when he discovers this could be a new, elusive population of sharks, he builds the world's first "chum island" to lure them in and uncover if they are the ones responsible for the attacks.

metas.name: Jaws vs. Orca
metas.description: This special investigates the chilling phenomenon of great white sharks washing ashore with their livers extracted with surgical precision. To decode the orca's "kill sequence," the team travels to the Strait of Gibraltar, where orcas have developed a highly organized tactic of ramming sailboats, crippling rudders, and even sinking vessels.

metas.name: Jurassic Sharks
metas.description: The special takes viewers deep into prehistoric waters to explore the ancient ancestors of today's sharks. Using animation, the episode highlights some of the most feared prehistoric ocean creatures, including the Dunkleosteus, the buzzsaw shark (Helicoprion), and the scissor-toothed shark (Edestus).

metas.name: Winky's Speakeasy
metas.description: Booze, banter and boings. Welcome to the saloon for washed-up cartoons.

metas.name: RESET
metas.description: In a world where citizens are reset to six at age 65, a young woman must care for her newly-reset mother and find her estranged father before the state intervenes— only to discover that healing her family means reparenting the child her mother never got to be.

metas.name: Longwood Dr.
metas.description: Introverted high schooler Devon begins to question her sanity when ominous messages start to appear around her as she tries to navigate her crumbling relationships.

metas.name: THE COLLECTOR
metas.description: A quiet, deadpan craftsman treats his ordinary collection of stones with the serene precision of a master artist, turning a mysterious, dark trade into a highly disciplined science.

metas.name: Mary Beth Barone: Galaxy Brain
metas.description: Is an ex-best friend the worst ex? Can dating apps save democracy? What's with NYPD merch? Mary Beth Barone has all the answers in this witty special.

metas.name: Wham! 10 Days in China
metas.description: In 1985, WHAM! made history as the first Western pop act to perform in communist China. George Michael and Andrew Ridgeley’s concerts in Beijing and Guangzhou were a cultural milestone – East meets West, music meets politics. Now, newly restored footage reveals the untold story of the iconic tour that helped launch WHAM! to global superstardom.

metas.name: The Country They Call Life
metas.description: A spirit must choose between life and death with only the help of a suicidal man.

metas.name: The Galactic Ghoul
metas.description: Space-conquering, saucer-aircraft explorer Captain Oscar Bravo, and his sly subordinate Lieutenant Foxtrot, are made prisoners of Queen Xaltalusia XXIII (Isabelle), after discovering a mysterious stone on their journey and being engulfed by her permanent and outlandish jail, Planet of the Toum, from where the cosmic crusaders must escape while fending off her heavy-duty military, and their own brotherly conflict, to restore love and peace in the Galaxy.

metas.name: Spider-Man: Brand New Day
metas.description: Fighting crime full-time as Spider-Man in a world that doesn't remember him—and the pressure of seeing his old friends move on without him—sparks a change in Peter Parker he may not have the power to control. But that transformation might also be the only thing that can stop a shocking new threat to the city and those he loves - a powerful villain no one can even see.

metas.name: Gustloff: The Forgotten Tragedy
metas.description: A documentary-style recounting of the horrific fate of the MV Wilhelm Gustloff.

metas.name: The Art Of Noticing
metas.description: The world is full of details that are often ignored. By focusing on ordinary places, objects, and moments, the film invites the audience to slow down and discover the beauty hidden in everyday life. A reflection on how paying attention can change the way we see the world.

metas.name: The Last Fifteen Minutes
metas.description: While a giant monster attacks their city, the queer inhabitants of a small residential building (portrayed by hand-carved puppets) try to make their peace with imminent death — through music, sex, and lasagna.

metas.name: Pink Ounces
metas.description: A young black lesbian woman must battle the voices in her head and a charismatic artist to seal a kiss with the girl of her dreams.

metas.name: Tib Tub, We Need You!
metas.description: Three kids and their best friend Tib Tub, a 30-foot-tall robot boy, have one day left to complete the Perfect Summer Checklist. All they have left to do is go for a swim…without accidentally destroying the whole town!

metas.name: House of Sharks
metas.description: In New Zealand's waters, great white "houses" battle for dominance. Experts risk it all to reveal the bloodlines that determine their allegiances.

metas.name: Biggest Mako on Earth
metas.description: A new report of a 15-foot mako shark off the coast of Mexico shatters conventional wisdom on how large these sharks can grow. A team of experts heads to the Pacific Ocean to track down this mega shark and find the biggest mako in the world.

metas.name: Bull Shark Dinner Bell
metas.description: Shark attack survivor Paul de Gelder and predator specialist Rosie Moore head to Jupiter, Florida to uncover what's fueling a surge in bull shark aggression. Testing weather, prey and human behavior, they build toward one explosive final demonstration.

metas.name: Call Grandma
metas.description: On a bitterly cold winter day, a young couple Lennie and Luke are on a drive to New York City to visit Lennie’s neurotic, seemingly aggressive but sweet-natured father. [Overview courtesy of filmmaker]

metas.name: Old Fantasy
metas.description: A woman wants to be like her grandma. [Overview courtesy of filmmaker]

metas.name: The Bowdoin Library Experiment 1972
metas.description: Recently unearthed footage from the controversial Bowdoin Library Experiment (1972) in which a simulation of a library goes awry. [Overview courtesy of filmmaker]

metas.name: Power Lines
metas.description: A man tries to explain why he likes looking at power lines. [Overview courtesy of filmmaker]

metas.name: Pro Se
metas.description: Berthe, a young painter travels hills and valleys with the help of her assistant and a herd of models in search of a form of contentment unknown to us. [Overview courtesy of filmmakers]

metas.name: GEMINI
metas.description: GEMINI is a darkly comedic and intimate portrait of love, loss, and secrecy.

metas.name: Scherwitz
metas.description: Scherwitz just lost custody of his son.

metas.name: Revelation
metas.description: Three people are brought to a chapel under the impression that they will have a fortune bestowed upon them, leading to a... Revelation.

metas.name: Novel Affairs
metas.description: Stuck in the monotony of day to day life, Quinn goes on a journey through novels from her local bookstore to achieve and harbor self-acceptance.

metas.name: You Set My Skin On Fire, My Heart Ice Cold
metas.description: A young couple walks back home discussing a brutal neighbourhood murder.

metas.name: Emily Catalano: The Introvert
metas.description: Comedian Emily Catalano explores her personality (or lack thereof) in her stand-up special The Introvert, filmed live at The Belly Up in San Diego.

metas.name: la mar A marla
metas.description: Eduardo and Marla share a teenage romance that is interrupted when Marla's father moves her to South Korea. A cinematic correspondence emerges between the two from afar. Years later, Marla returns, only to vanish on a trip through the north of Peru - forcing Eduardo to embark on a pilgrimage to find her.

metas.name: Home Movies: Inside the Making of Amélie
metas.description: Documentary on the making of Amélie

metas.name: Train of Thought
metas.description: A new work from emerging filmmaker and prolific train-goer Katie Edwards.

metas.name: The Ultimate Linemarker
metas.description: We follow Borus, a road line marker who treats asphalt like a sacred canvas, as he passionately explains the emotional and deep importance of straight lines, proper spacing, and precision. His world is thrown into chaos when a reckless young teammate commits the ultimate workplace sin: unauthorized road doodling.

metas.name: Amerigo: The Search for the American Dream
metas.description: As the United States celebrates its 250th anniversary on July 4, 2026, AMERIGO: THE SEARCH FOR THE AMERICAN DREAM asks one urgent, unifying question – what happened to the American Dream – and explores if it is still attainable for many today. Filmed across all 50 states over two years, the program features unscripted interviews with everyday Americans, from blue-collar workers, veterans and immigrants to students, entrepreneurs and community leaders. Told in thematic chapters examining work, housing, healthcare, technology, art and more, AMERIGO captures a raw, panoramic and unexpectedly hopeful portrait of a country at a crossroads.

metas.name: Whispers of the North
metas.description: A resilient young woman navigates the silent solitude of her world and confronts the turbulent echoes of family addiction and buried secrets, all while forging a path toward redemption.

metas.name: George Michael: The Trojan Souls
metas.description: The conversation that never finished.  In 1993, Andros Georgiou — lifelong best friend and brother to George Michael — began assembling the greatest collaborative album ever conceived. Eight of the most iconic artists in history all said yes. The album was never made. Until now, the footage has never been seen. This is Trojan Souls — the film that tells the story of what almost was.

metas.name: The Busy Nursing Director
metas.description: A young nurse is distressed about a fallen patient when she seeks help from her boss — an irritable director of nursing.

metas.name: Air Jaws: Red, White and Breach
metas.description: Reports of great white sharks breaching off the California coast sparks an investigation to document the new phenomena.

metas.name: Invasion of the Mega Sharks
metas.description: Off Nova Scotia's coast is rumored to be the elusive Big Rose, a female great white shark believed to be one of largest predators in the North Atlantic. Using innovative tagging technology and daring field ops, a team attempts to find this ocean giant.

metas.name: Aitch: Don't Be Afraid​
metas.description: Rapper Aitch climbs Mount Kilimanjaro to raise money and awareness for people with Down syndrome, inspired by his sister and his campaign for greater inclusion

metas.name: AEW Redemption 2026: The Buy In
metas.description: Redemption 2026 was the inaugural edition of All Elite Wrestling's annual Redemption pay-per-view, held on July 26, 2026, at the Bell Centre in Montreal, Quebec, Canada. The event was co-headlined by Kenny Omega (c) vs. Kevin Knight for the AEW World Championship and Thekla (c) vs. Willow Nightingale for the AEW Women's World Championship. This is the pre-show event that aired free before the pay-per-view.

metas.name: Cinematic Nothingness
metas.description: A filmmaker embarks on an ambitious experiment: creating a feature film entirely through improvisation. As fiction and reality begin to blur, the process becomes as unpredictable as the story itself.

metas.name: K-Pop Shark Heroes
metas.description: Follows Ken Jeong and Rei Ami as they launch a public awareness campaign to reshape the perception of sharks across East Asia using K-Pop after shark encounters off the Korean Peninsula.

metas.name: Terror in the Skies: Stopping the Liquid Bomb Plot
metas.description: The untold story of the 2006 liquid bomb plot and the frantic race to stop it through one of the biggest covert operations ever mounted.

metas.name: On Time
metas.description: A Man is almost late for the biggest moment of his life

metas.name: Dancheong, Let's play
metas.description: Deconstructing everyday life by exploring similarities and differences through the repeated filming of dancheong at Segeomjeong-teo.

metas.name: Dalseong
metas.description: Once an ancient earthen fortress, Dalseong is now home to a zoo and public park. By 2027, the animals will be relocated to Daegu Grand Park, and by 2034, the fortress walls are scheduled to be restored. Over time, the site has served as an earthen fortress, a provincial governor's office, and a Shinto shrine. Wandering through present-day Dalseong, the film reflects on the traces and memories embedded within the site's layered history.

metas.name: Wavelength
metas.description: In a room someone wanders. A voice is heard.

metas.name: Shadow Shadows
metas.description: Memories of an old man have been fallen loosely as a shadow. A quarter century old house builds a dream in bright shade through subdued darkness.

metas.name: Instadocs: The Prediction Games
metas.description: Prediction markets let anyone bet on anything, from the World Cup to alien invasions. "Instadocs" investigates the explosive rise of global betting.

metas.name: Something Worth Capturing - - A Senior Year Documentary
metas.description: Aidan Wirtz spent his final semester of college carrying a camcorder almost everywhere he went. What started as a short video became something more: an attempt to hold onto a chapter he wasn’t ready to leave. Something Worth Capturing is a documentary about friendship, growing up, and the ordinary moments that become unforgettable. A thank you to the people, places, and memories that made Iowa home.

metas.name: The Journey of a Star
metas.description: Andy, a young adult, is housed by his mother and friends in a small town. After a traumatic experience with his church, he is forced to undergo one of the hardest years of his life, and uncover his own individuality while unbeknownst to him, he is being followed by a mysterious figure known only as The Phantom.

metas.name: Four Films about Music (Silent Jazz / Orchestra / Pause / Interior Music)
metas.description: Many of my films evolve from a single shot, and quite often that shot is an immediate response to a situation unfolding in front of me. This is about the closest I get to improvising, a musical form I sometimes aspire to, but is difficult to attain as a filmmaker. That was how I shot the majority of films in this programme, using the convenience of the mobile phone in my pocket. I often sense immediately that something might be made from the situation I find myself in, but only after studying the shots on my computer do I discover the direction they might take. The third film Pause clearly involved some planning, but again, after the initial recording, I had to work with the fragments of sound and image to see where they might lead, in a lengthy process of trial and error. In Interior Music I am using the camera in direct response to music emanating from the Trinity Conservatoire in Greenwich. (EXiS — Experimental Film and Video Festival in Seoul, 2026)

metas.name: Animal Studies (Egret / Seagull Reflection / Midges / Spider / Swans in a Line)
metas.description: Animal Studies relates to and overlaps the Short Film Series, which I began in 1975. The beauty of working in a series is its flexibility; films can be added to or dropped, the order and manner of projection can be varied. Each film is like a brick, insignificant in itself, but can be combined into all kinds of structures. My filmic interest in animals is that they are unselfconscious, authentic, and can’t act. (EXiS — Experimental Film and Video Festival in Seoul, 2026)

metas.name: Sidetracked
metas.description: A hopeful party goer tries to get to the function, but is inundated with various requests and errands of increasing absurdity.

metas.name: What She Didn't Tell Me
metas.description: When a disturbing overdose rocks her new town, a determined but grieving pharmacist must unravel the link between a growing teen drug crisis and a mysterious grief website before her own daughter becomes the next target.

metas.name: Captain Canada
metas.description: Captain Canada must face his greatest threat yet to protect the country he loves.

metas.name: The Unmaking
metas.description: Esteemed genius and award-winning arthouse filmmaker Josef Balée's attempt at crafting the most ambitious and pretentious film of his career.

metas.name: I'm in Love with a Stripper
metas.description: Alone on Christmas Eve, Michael makes a last-ditch effort to win back his ex-girlfriend. Although repelled by his sudden reappearance, the promise of $1000 buys ten minutes of Honey’s time as she reluctantly sits through his declaration of love. Michael’s dreams of a heartfelt reunion are shattered when he is promptly rejected by a stripper who refuses to participate in his fantasy, challenging toxic romantic comedy tropes normalized through contemporary media. Based on her semi-autobiographical stage play, Never Walk Alone, Julie Phan offers a desensationalized interpretation of sex work through an intimate representation of the person underneath the projection.

metas.name: Emoji
metas.description: A dejected man gets his morning latte stolen. With the help of a stranger, he embarks on an absurd journey to find the perpetrator.

metas.name: Crying Over Dead Cats
metas.description: A person talking.

metas.name: Taxi
metas.description: A man in his mid 50s becomes a Taxi driver to help pay for something, will he manage to?

metas.name: Welcome to Tool Shed
metas.description: At the long-standing Palm Springs gay bar Tool Shed—a desert oasis for leather-loving, sex-positive seniors—a generation who once faced the HIV/AIDS epidemic and decades of oppression find themselves trailblazers again as the first openly LGBTQ+ seniors.

metas.name: Replika
metas.description: After surviving a horrific car crash and losing his arm, an unstable family man develops a bizarre fascination for augmenting his body with bionic prosthetics.

metas.name: KING
metas.description: King, a champion of the fighting organization, lives, trains, and fights under one roof with his roommate Sam. They compete weekly in grueling matches that leave them bruised and battered. Their landlord and promoter promises to get them away from this lifestyle for bigger and better opportunities on the condition that they continue to push themselves for another fight. The roommates face their toughest battles during recovery while pushing each other to continue training for their next bouts.

metas.name: RISE
metas.description: The year is 2099. With the evolution of AI bringing machines to a superior to human intelligence they have lived peacefully and in harmony together. Until now…

metas.name: Tethered
metas.description: Ayden, a man grappling with a fractured conscience, finds himself at the mercy of a methodical psychiatrist who pushes his unorthodox tactics to the extreme.

metas.name: Clogged Up
metas.description: After being mysteriously kidnapped, a man must search into his past and clog for his freedom.

metas.name: Jason
metas.description: A young boy in Miami carries on with his days while the voice of his mother, recently deported, travels through the phone to try to reach him. JASON is about what happens after deportation, the felt absence, the connection that struggles to survive it and the power of a mother’s love.

metas.name: Time With You
metas.description: In a small town in Italy, Jack has found he can freeze time to escape from the world, but he can't freeze her.

metas.name: The Briefcase Problem
metas.description: Two henchmen argue over a briefcase.

metas.name: Love Under the Mistletoe
metas.description: Interior designer Grace (Lilley) runs a business with her best friend and her brother in the quaint town of Ivy Glen but is too busy for a real relationship. Ryan (Bateman), a successful New York City financial advisor and Grace's former high school crush, returns home planning to sell his grandmother's historic St. Nicholas House. The mayor convinces him to revive the beloved Ribbons and Bows charity fundraiser and brings Grace on board to help. Working side by side to pull the event together, the former couple reminisces and feelings they once shared slowly resurface. But will this yuletide reunion lead to love under the mistletoe?

metas.name: Swapped!
metas.description: When TTRPGS go... wrong? An Elf in our world, a modern human in theirs. What could possiblly go wrong?

metas.name: How To Fund A Feature Film (As A Broke College Kid)
metas.description: Desperate to fund her dream film, Ava, a broke college student, devises a risky plan to pawn school equipment and flip party drugs over the holiday break. Dragging her best friend, Liam along for the ride.  Inspired by a true story, How To Fund A Feature Film (As A Broke College Kid) is an original crime/comedy short film written and directed by Evan Moore.  It is an independent narrative short film blending crime, comedy, and drama.  It showcases the ambition and questionable decision-making of young filmmakers chasing impossible dreams, the film explores friendship, desperation, and the unintended consequences of trying to shortcut success.

metas.name: bobcats.mp4
metas.description: College students attempt to make a documentary in the Florida wilderness, but encounter something sinister. This is the footage that they left behind.

metas.name: Chug, Charlie Chug!
metas.description: When a down on his luck tequila salesman means a former champion in a bar, their lives change forever.

metas.name: Oliver Tree - Celebration of Life
metas.description: The live show and recording of Oliver Tree's Celebration of Life ceramony following the passing of the singer in June 2026

metas.name: Volver
metas.description: A group of young people from Italy, France, Slovakia and Spain meet in the small Spanish village of Tubilla Del Lago for an Erasmus  exchange project called Youth Wave. The camera follows them during the last day of the exchange, as they exchange their memories and live moments of fun and unity before heading  back home.

metas.name: RevPro: Womens's Grand Prix
metas.description: RevPro presents the womens grand prix in Wolverhampton

metas.name: Terrifying Gargoyle Porn
metas.description: Wholesome buddy comedy set in Madison, Alabama

metas.name: Who the hell am I?
metas.description: A young man narrates his thoughts while he sets out in his hometown of Rabat to find an answer to the question of his identity...

metas.name: Princess Sparkles
metas.description: A sparkly pig teaches a reluctant adult how to grow up—just barely.

metas.name: hi mom
metas.description: A young woman struggles to find the right words to come out to her mom.

metas.name: All the Worlds I Could Lift
metas.description: As they redefine strength and female masculinity as acts of resistance, a group of queer women use weightlifting to reclaim bodies and spaces that have long excluded them.

metas.name: The Oak Park Post
metas.description: Two journalists investigate the acquisition of their newspaper and its ties to the murder of their friend and colleague.

metas.name: One of the Girls
metas.description: A short documentary following Mary, a Japanese American immigrant, single mother, and electrologist whose gender-affirming care has made her a trusted figure in the lives of transgender women.

metas.name: Ferris Wheel in the air
metas.description: As a Ferris wheel ascends from the ground to its peak, passengers experience a shifting array of perspectives. This film, captured on 35mm photographic film and processed through generative AI, represents a hybrid fusion of human and machine vision. Through the deliberate act of editing, the work transcends the conventional vantage points of a Ferris wheel, ultimately unveiling an entirely new dimension of sight.

metas.name: Podcast Pete
metas.description: Podcast Pete tries to start a podcast with a manosphere influencer so he can form new ideas to save his alien race.

metas.name: Nominal
metas.description: 2046. Corporations are using repressed memories to secure sensitive data against hacking.  K lives in isolation inside a sterile memory compound, subjected to daily interrogations designed to excavate and erase a single buried memory. As fragments resurface through recurring dreams of fire, panic, and a lost child, he struggles to separate genuine recollection from manufactured reconstruction.  Guided deeper by a calm, invasive corporate system, K is forced to confront a tragedy tied to his sister and the guilt he has carried ever since. But as the sessions intensify, a darker truth emerges: his trauma is not being treated. It is being weaponised. His unresolved grief is a living encryption key, and the corporation is using his subconscious to breach a protected mental firewall.  Nominal is a psychological sci-fi noir about memory, grief, and the commodification of consciousness, in a world where even trauma is bought and sold.

metas.name: The Perception of Perfection
metas.description: A pregnant woman who prides herself in her perfect life recruits her young friend to help her deal with her philandering fiancé.

metas.name: O How Happy the Bride
metas.description: 17th-century nun composer Rosa Giacinta Badalla is our guide through the tumultuous life of medieval saint Radegund as she is traded as a pawn among murderous kings, escapes queen-hood for the convent, performs miracles, and prays for a happier second marriage... to Jesus.

metas.name: Tears Fall Underwater
metas.description: While masking her grief at a laundromat, a woman discovers a washing machine that opens a gateway to her deepest joy and sorrow.

metas.name: Girl in the Coffin
metas.description: After the death of her mother, Jasmine is struggling to move forward when she finds comfort in Bill, the compassionate funeral director. But beneath Bill's kindness lies a dangerous obsession as he believes they are destined to be together.

metas.name: Cimes
metas.description: An impressionistic exploration of the canopy, captured frame by frame.

metas.name: Bro
metas.description: Summer 2024 was an unforgettable time when many found the dream to become famous—including Lukas, whose cousin decided it was the perfect moment to make a move. But as they plunge into the world of ambition and pop culture, they face the ultimate question: at what cost?

metas.name: Only Good Feelings
metas.description: Benny is haunted by guilt after his fiance dies in a car accident. In his spiral, he reconnects with Kam, a troubled childhood friend who pulls him into robbery and fraud, a desperate plan to flee to Mexico and leave their lives behind.

metas.name: Light Through The Dust
metas.description: When the 2011 Christchurch earthquake struck, tattoo apprentice Bonnie Singh was inside Southern Ink, the studio where she had finally begun chasing her dream. The tattoo studio collapsed and Bonnie, trapped in the rubble, suffered a broken back, a shattered neck, and a brain injury that would affect her for life.  With the help of fellow tattooist Jak Law, Bonnie is determined to push through physical and neurological limitations to master the craft of tattooing that once seemed out of reach. A story of resilience, reinvention, and the invisible scars we carry, this is not just a film about tattoos but instead is about what it means to rebuild a life and the importance of having a dream when everything has fallen away.

metas.name: The X Time I Saw Her
metas.description: Two women drift through the same spaces: hallways, smoking areas, balconies, cafés... They never speak, but through repeated encounters, they reach an almost self-knowledge, an almost relationship.

metas.name: Arabic Disco Funk
metas.description: Heartbroken, Shams revisits the moment they first met Ana, hoping that -maybe this time- they'll understand why it all fell apart.

metas.name: Coconut Valley
metas.description: A washed-up video game developer reunites with his estranged brother in Thailand in order to chase their late father's dream of uncovering a long-lost treasure.

metas.name: Congé
metas.description: On a rare day off, a mother and her son make the most of their time together, until an unexpected call turns everything upside down.

metas.name: Meadowhawk
metas.description: When washed-up actor David Eastman participates in a comic convention in order to earn money for his granddaughter, he encounters his former co-star and rival Rick Majors for the first time in 40 years.

metas.name: no one has seen me naked in a long time
metas.description: A reflection on the intimacy of being seen and our perception of time.

metas.name: sabukaru Black Kray Documentary
metas.description: Flying to his hometown of Ashland, Virginia, sabukaru got to sit down with one of the most pivotal experimental artists of all time: Black Kray.  His dark, emo swag; his heavenly cloud rap; his chant-like flows; all these elements created the foundation for modern rap. Getting to meet his mother and other family members, this is the most extensive and personal interview on Black Kray to date.

metas.name: Geo-Storm
metas.description: Earth's gravity weakens, causing devastating earthquakes and electric anomalies that magnetize objects to catastrophic effect. As the planet is ripped apart, a team of expert scientists must figure out the cause and save the world.

metas.name: Are You There?
metas.description: Are You There? follows a troubled teen after the events of a car crash.

metas.name: Butter
metas.description: A lazy man prepares a simple breakfast, butter on toast. Unknowingly until the arrival of others, this meal could cause the end of the world…

metas.name: The Toys We Left Behind
metas.description: Old toys become a connection to the past and to the moments we leave behind while growing up. Through simple images, the film explores nostalgia, imagination, and the emotional value of the objects that were once part of our childhood.

metas.name: Business Hours
metas.description: Julio has always dreamed of becoming a mobster. As he works under the city's most respected crime boss, Oscar, what begins as another routine collection quickly spirals out of control. While Oscar closes legitimate business deals across the city, Julio and Nico are left to clean up the consequences, revealing that for people in their world there is no separation between work and life. As day fades into night, Business Hours explores loyalty, respect, and the cost of living a life where the job never truly ends.

metas.name: The Old House
metas.description: An old abandoned house is full of forgotten objects, empty rooms, and signs of the past. Every corner tells a quiet story without using words. Through simple images, the film explores memory, nostalgia, and the feeling that some places can still hold the moments that happened inside them.

metas.name: Paths Of Silence
metas.description: A young Englishman walked into a church and, in an instant, decided to convert to Orthodoxy.  A Ukrainian man grew up in a place where religion was strictly forbidden. A man from Crete followed the guidance of the saints.  What draws people to Mount Athos, the holiest place for the Orthodox Church?

metas.name: Moms Guardian
metas.description: When the mom who abandoned her passes away, Victoria must confront her feelings about the situation when someone unexpected shows up. Her mom's guardian.

metas.name: Pura Vida
metas.description: 8 delegates set off for an all-expenses-paid Eco convention, in one of the worlds most exotic locations. But fantasies of sun, sea and salsa come crashing down when dreams turn to nightmares full of crocodiles and murder.

metas.name: Personalities
metas.description: A troubled college student struggles with the will to live and the power of addiction

metas.name: Nowhere Left to Hide
metas.description: A desperate woman starts over again in a small seaside town after faking her own death to escape from her abusive husband. But when he tracks her down, he starts to threaten the lives of those around her until she agrees to be with him forever.

metas.name: Xavi Simons - Back Home
metas.description: Xavi Simons returns to his home town, reflecting on his upbringing and discussing his recovery from the ACL injury he suffered in April

metas.name: Nostos
metas.description: Original images of nature are accompanied by the director's personal reflections, presented through subtitles, forming a quiet and contemplative cinematic experience

metas.name: The Ballad of Akabusi
metas.description: He goes by many names: The Landlord, The Big Cheese, The Swiss Cheese, Brie Larsson, Henrik Larsson, Lars Ricken, but most people know him as Busi - and he runs this city.

metas.name: I Know Where You Live
metas.description: Sarah thinks she's found "the one" until his flaws emerge....

metas.name: Bowling For Soup
metas.description: Wee Billy Cunningham is a man on the run. With a soup debt and money on his head, he lays low in a pub to hide from his French demons. Little does he know that his past is about to catch up with him...

metas.name: The Terrible Power of Fiction
metas.description: María Finojosa, wife of Spanish settler Juan de Cervantes, tunes into the fragile memory of the exact moment when her husband became obsessed with founding a town that would perpetuate his family name. In the middle of the 19th century, in the mountains of Costa Rica, María's memory of her husband's Quixote-like delusions, unravels like the reel of an old film, projected onto the persistent rain and the constant lurking of the cracks of fiction.

metas.name: I'm Sick of Pizza
metas.description: A pizza delivery driver crosses paths with a bank robber.

metas.name: Road Head
metas.description: A young man tries to get his driver's license to fulfill his lifelong dream.

metas.name: Pinche Nerdo
metas.description: An aspiring comic book artist from Tijuana crosses the border and suits up in cosplay to promote his work in the chaotic crowds of Comic-Con, where an unexpected encounter with an influential attendee forces him to make a choice about his dream.

metas.name: The Summer Heat
metas.description: A dual snapshot of Irish summer; the favourable and the unavoidable.

metas.name: Santino The Person The Movie
metas.description: Metal-loving teenager Santino Calpo celebrates his 18th birthday around the city with his friends in this absolutely unhinged guerrilla documentary.

metas.name: Triple Decker
metas.description: Over the course of one bizarre day, a couple with a dangerous plan and a stranger with her own agenda find their lives colliding in the most unexpected ways. As secrets simmer beneath the surface, everything quickly spirals into a wild mix of chaos, dark humor, and perfectly timed misfortune—where every move only makes things worse.

metas.name: The Proposal Project
metas.description: A special story where Abby gets engaged, and the whole process surrounding it.

metas.name: Routine
metas.description: Benedicte constantly tries to escape her monotonous life by daydreaming about a warmer, kinder world. On yet another predictable day at work, she is confronted by a client for making a bad sandwich. After being reprimanded by her boss, she remakes the sandwich while checking for the time left to go home, sleep, and dream about tying both her manager and the client to a tree as she roams freely. The next morning, she wakes up to her alarm ringing... realizing that she had overslept and was late for work this time.

metas.name: Euphoria: A Look Back
metas.description: The cast and crew of HBO's Euphoria take an exclusive look back at the critically acclaimed series' origins, evolution, and influences.

metas.name: Last Night
metas.description: Strangers Arun and Tam meet on a rooftop the night they both intend to end their lives. When Arun suggests they spend the night together instead, just until sunrise, they embark on an unexpected journey through the city.

metas.name: Heartstopper: Ending on a Hi
metas.description: After the ending of the hit Netflix series “Heartstopper”, this special combines never-before-seen behind-the-scenes footage, cast and crew interviews, larger cultural commentary, and fan input.

metas.name: A Good Place To Die
metas.description: During wartime, a young Israeli woman living in Jerusalem embarks on a surreal journey in which she is forced to confront violence, responsibility, denial, and her own complicity within a violent reality she is part of. Paper cutouts, oil pastel paintings and street photography are woven together in a surreal mixed-media animated film, walking a line between dream and waking, reflecting the distorted reality of a never-ending cycle of war and death.

metas.name: Odyssey on a Loop
metas.description: When Marie considers handing over the spare key to her boyfriend, her mind spirals into a vertiginous labyrinth where doubt takes on unfathomable depths. An absurd and psychedelic odyssey, unfolding entirely within the confines of her own consciousness.

metas.name: Asesino Perfecto
metas.description: A peaceful town is gripped by fear when a series of mysterious murders leaves investigators with no witnesses, no evidence, and no clear suspect. As each new victim is discovered, Captain Rocio Cortes and Detective Soto race to stop a killer who always seems one step ahead. Their investigation uncovers hidden secrets, broken family ties, and painful events from the past that connect several lives in unexpected ways. As suspicion shifts from one person to another, two brothers, Leo and Elias, find themselves at the center of a mystery that will test their loyalty and force them to confront the truth. With fear spreading throughout the community and trust quickly fading, the search for justice becomes a dangerous race against time in this suspenseful Mexican crime thriller filled with mystery, psychological tension, and unexpected twists.

metas.name: Outback Dale
metas.description: After a social media meltdown, a middle aged man embarks on a wild journey to restore his reputation.

metas.name: שלושה ארגזים כחולים; חלל וגעגוע
metas.description: A child leaves home and returns in three IDF boxes, that became my biggest secret. My brother is dead. What if these objects are the only proof he was here? I look for him in a 60liter plastic box, objectifying my brother, humanizing the box.

metas.name: Perception
metas.description: Students in an art class are asked to draw the same nude model, but each interprets the subject in their own way. As their works reveal contrasting perspectives, the session becomes an exploration of perception, art, and the ways individuals project meaning onto what they observe.

metas.name: Insectasy
metas.description: Sadie struggles to find balance as she juggles work, her social life and her erotic fascination with insects.

metas.name: Faithless
metas.description: After a personal loss, Savannah’s grief begins to distort her perception of reality. As she tries to understand what she is experiencing, her sense of faith, memory, and truth begins to break down.

metas.name: Tenants of Lenapehocking in the Age of Magnets
metas.description: Tenants of Lenapehocking in the Age of Magnets is a collection of stories about the inhabitants of a land, specifically the Black community of North Philadelphia in the 20th century, an epicenter of African American social, cultural and political life both locally and nationally. The place of the documentary is a portion of the original homeland of the Lenape between the Delaware and Schuylkill rivers and the stories told cover an age of industry shaped by developing electromagnetic technology.  Featured oral history narrators include Chief Robert Redhawk Ruth, Dr. Rae Alexander-Minter, Rev. Joseph Williams, Cecily Moore Banks, Elaine Brown, David Litofsky, Dr. John Churchville, Rev. Frank Tyson, Jamaaladeen Tacuma and Karen Warrington. Their life stories are animated by photos from the archive of photographer John W. Mosely.

metas.name: Justice
metas.description: The online child safety taskforce, "Predator Puncherz", document their latest and most infamous sting operation.

metas.name: Chasing Dragonflies
metas.description: After running his grocery store for over 40 years, Chuck reflects on his childhood in South Korea and his lifelong commitment to serving the unique needs of Philadelphia’s Caribbean community. Now at 72 years old, his observations and pursuit of peace have brought him full circle.

metas.name: Rising Embers
metas.description: Two thousand years. One truth. Carried by ordinary people who refused to let their faith be silenced.

metas.name: SORTIE
metas.description: A private detective investigating a missing person case becomes trapped in a hypnotic noir labyrinth, where he discovers that every exit leads back inside.

metas.name: The Taro Donatella Story
metas.description: From Underdog to legend - From silence to legend. The Taro Donatella Story is the true rise of a man who built an empire alone. A journey of ambition, obsession, and belief in the impossible. - "Mark Zuckerberg & Taro Donatella. One code. One invention. Who actually created the real-time algorithm? The truth behind the biggest lie in social media history - Coming Summer 2026."

metas.name: Chum
