metas.description: Randy and Filthy are two lowlife roadies who land a new gig and hit the streets on foot, crossing paths with a bizarre cast of characters. Along the way, they're gifted a strange, powerful fish-while being relentlessly stalked by their old rival, Texas.

metas.name: The Cowboy Killer
metas.description: When a delusional killer in a cowboy costume starts treating a small town like his personal shooting range, two bumbling detectives must track him down and free his captive bride before he kills again.

metas.name: Estate
metas.description: Assaf wasn’t brought up by his father, and when he dies, he meets his family for the first time, and as the only son, he’s revealed as the sole successor. When Assaf falls in love with Miriam, a homeless woman who stays in his backyard, a Pandora’s box is unleashed.

metas.name: On the Sea
metas.description: Jack has been married to Maggie for over half his life. He works as a Hand Raker on the mussel beds in North Wales alongside his younger brother, Dyfan, and Dyfan’s three sons. Jack has always assumed that his own boy, Tom, will join the family business on leaving school but Tom’s resistance to follow in his footsteps creates familial tension. Tensions are further inflamed by the arrival of an itinerant deckhand, Daniel, who makes known his feelings for Jack. In this remote, rural community where life revolves around Church and fishery, Jack is faced with an impossible dilemma. On The Sea is a beautiful, sensual and at times, tragic exploration of masculinity, place and desire.

metas.name: Avatar Aang: The Last Airbender
metas.description: Avatar Aang, the world's last Airbender, learns of an ancient power that could save his culture from extinction. With the help of his friends, he embarks on a global quest to find it before it falls into the wrong hands and threatens to upend the peace they sacrificed everything to achieve.

metas.name: Motor City
metas.description: In 1970s Detroit, John Miller falls for a local gangster's girl and lands in prison for a crime he didn't commit. With his life ruined, Miller plots revenge against the man who took his girl away.
Four college students get into a car crash on the way to their graduation ceremony and the aftermath forces them to finally be honest with each other about what comes next.

metas.name: XXXXX Livestream
metas.description: A 2hr album film shot over multiple sets; shooting on drones, infrared, cctv, steadicam, camcorders... with moving sets, lighting rigs, on-the-fly vision-mixing; a raw, instinctual, live performance. Shot without a full rehearsal, with the most incredible, creatively ambitious crew.

metas.name: Passing Portrait
metas.description: A grieving artist gives everything she has into a memorial piece for her grandmother, alienating her friends and destroying a delicate new romance as she struggles to capture the light of a loved one she hasn't properly mourned.

metas.name: N!PS
metas.description: A journey of a woman who braves public scrutiny to finally set her nipples free.

metas.name: Floored
metas.description: An aging actress and a motley crew of Lorazapammed women summon a Westside pelvic floor guru to uncover the source of their pain. Enlightenment leads to a very bold decision.

metas.name: SURPRISE
metas.description: A bathroom mishap at a surprise party sets off a chain of disastrous events that spiral wildly out of control.

metas.name: Wait!
metas.description: Inspired by a true-ish story, this tale dives into the quietly epic, absurdly mundane test of human patience: waiting at a crosswalk.

metas.name: Upstairs
metas.description: After a marathon of alien films in his basement, Tom notices some strange sounds and lights coming from upstairs.

metas.name: On The Line
metas.description: Allie, a young teenage girl finally gets her own landline. She decides to call random numbers and ends up meeting a lot of different interesting people! But she decides to meet up with one, which was a huge mistake.

metas.name: Etheric Realms of the Night (The Complete Album Film)
metas.description: Etheric Realms of the Night is a feature-length album film that follows a woman slipping between the waking world and a surreal dream dimension. As she journeys deeper into this liminal space, she is pursued by Hypnos, the Greek god of sleep, blurring the boundary between reality and illusion. Structured as a modern Greek tragedy, the film unfolds as a descent into the subconscious, exploring themes of somniphobia, astral projection, and the fragile nature of consciousness, with the band IATT serving as a haunting chorus guiding the narrative.

metas.name: Talking Tom Hero’s on the Big Screen
metas.description: Talking Tom Heroes are coming to the big screen! An hour-long show featuring your very favourite episodes of the hit series and never-seen-before surprises!

metas.name: In Transit: Part II
metas.description: The Strokes continue their behind-the-scenes journey, capturing the collaborative process of refining musical ideas and experimenting with new sounds in a remote studio setting. The band navigates creative challenges and evaluates various song structures as they work toward crafting their next record.

metas.name: Dr. Jekyll and Mr. Hyde
metas.description: In this new pseudo-vintage silent short film, a scientist discovers the horrible consequences when he allows his dark side complete control. This is directed by Gary Hill, and the novella "Strange Case of Dr. Jekyll and Mr. Hyde" by Robert Louis Stevenson.

metas.name: The List.
metas.description: A boy discovers a diary he wrote as a child, filled with dreams he once believed he would achieve. As he reflects on how far he is from that life, he breaks the fourth wall to share his regrets, hopes, and one simple truth: he's still trying.

metas.name: The Darkness
metas.description: When the sun dies out, the world goes quiet. Humanity begins to fall apart.

metas.name: Secondhand Embarrassment
metas.description: When two young shoppers spot a vintage sweater at a thrift store a high stakes battle ensues.

metas.name: Fuga
metas.description: Life has not been fulfilling to Mari.

metas.name: Come to Brasil
metas.description: Look in the comment section of any celebrity and you'll see one comment more than any other: “Come to Brasil.” In the west, the phrase is brushed off as a meme, but for Brazilian fans, it's a rallying cry, a plea that unites fandoms in a country that even the biggest stars pass over on their so-called "world" tours. Through the eyes of four Rio de Janeiro pop music superfans, the most popular comment on the internet is explored as a vessel to highlight the uniting forces of music and the resilience of music lovers.

metas.name: That We May See
metas.description: An intimate documentary on the lives and artistic journeys of Renato Habulan, Egai Fernandez, Pablo Baens-Santos, Jess Abrera, and Antipas Delotavo - pioneers of the Philippine Social Realist movement. Centered on the founding of KAISAHAN in 1976, the film examines how the realities of Martial Law under the Marcos dictatorship shaped a generation of artists committed to social engagement through their work. It also highlights the crucial role of CAYA (Center for the Advancement of Young Artists) in nurturing the movement's early development. Through personal reflections and historical and contemporary perspectives, the documentary traces the artists' shared ideals and divergent paths, revealing the challenges, convictions, and creative resilience that affirm their enduring vision of art as a force that shapes Filipino identity—as witness, critic, and visionary. Created in part through a grant of the National Commission on Culture and the Arts.

metas.name: Leave No One Behind
metas.description: Suwardi (Suwardi Becak Lawu), a police officer with the rank of Assistant Commissioner, is transferred from Jakarta to his hometown in Garut to carry out a mission for the government’s Task Force on Human Trafficking (Satgas TPPO) to combat kidnapping and human trafficking. The joy of his return home turns into a nightmare when his own niece, Lilis (Cinta Kharisma), is kidnapped by a human trafficking ringleader. Overcome by deep guilt and in conflict with Asep (Iyang Darmawan), Lilis’s father, Suwardi forms a special task force to dismantle the largest human trafficking network in West Java, led by Rando (Macho Hungan). One ambush after another drags Suwardi into an escalating vortex of fistfights and shootouts until a shocking truth about Rando’s true identity is revealed.

metas.name: Pillars of Power: The Hidden Secret Behind Achieving Greatness
metas.description: Seven legendary co-stars of The Secret, alongside thought leaders Ken Honda, Sharon Lechter, and other visionaries, expose five hidden pillars of true greatness: Money, Relationships, Health, Mental Wellness, and Spirituality. Uniting leadership, science, and spirituality, Pillars of Power redefines success for a modern audience, revealing that greatness is built on inner harmony and purpose as much as outward achievement, inspiring a new generation of leaders and changemakers.

metas.name: The Sex Worker's Guide to Parenting
metas.description: The Sex Worker’s Guide to Parenting is a feature documentary rooted in the Los Angeles sex worker community. The film centers six parents working in the sex industry, including filmmaker Kimberly Ye, as they reflect on the overlapping demands of erotic labor, caregiving, secrecy, survival, and mutual support. Through intimate interviews, small group conversations, observational material, and animated reenactments, the project examines how parents in stigmatized and criminalized lines of work create family life on their own terms.

metas.name: Compliment Sandwich
metas.description: A couple, over the hump of the honeymoon period, moves into a more serious state of communication in their sexual relationship.

metas.name: What Was She Thinking
metas.description: Four close friends, all proudly childfree women, take on every question the world throws at them with honesty, humor, and zero apologies.

metas.name: Mystery Inc. II: Curse of the 13th Spirit
metas.description: With Mystery Inc. breaking up, Shaggy sets out to create a new team but when the gang uncovers an ancient chest that once opened, will unleash an ancient evil upon the world, they will need the help of a new mysterious friend who can send this creature back to where he came from, before the world is plunged into eternal darkness.

metas.name: Small Triumph
metas.description: A painter struggles with the toughest model she's ever had: her daughter.

metas.name: Free Wifi
metas.description: Davi, an online motorcycle taxi driver, fakes a wealthy image on social media to attract Grace's attention. Their relationship is opposed by Grace's ex-fiancé, who hires a detective to uncover Davi's true identity. The revelation of the truth triggers a series of misunderstandings, conflicts, and chaos involving both families.

metas.name: Sia: Nostalgic for the Present
metas.description: A bold experience that challenges the genre that trades pop poetry for pure art. Impressive voices, impressive choreography and iconic performances, captured cinematically and sounded by an unparalleled catalog of hits.

metas.name: Rubberhead: The Life & Monsters of Steve Johnson
metas.description: Known for his intense work ethic, perfectionism, and obsession with breaking new ground, Steve Johnson has created iconic creatures and effects for some of the most beloved genre films in cinema history, working with everyone from John Carpenter, David Cronenberg, and Sam Raimi to James Cameron, Steven Spielberg, and Guillermo del Toro. His drive and ambition also led to heartbreaking acts of self-sabotage, divorce, and a serious drug addiction.

metas.name: THE OATH
metas.description: From the beautiful team at Filler Arc comes a loud -  raw - short-form documentary - look into hardcore music scene and what it means to be apart of it.

metas.name: Fake Hundreds
metas.description: After a cancer diagnosis, a man tries to confront God.

metas.name: Mosquito Halo
metas.description: Police investigate Dream Harvester, a political faction opposing the digitization of consciousness.

metas.name: Mones
metas.description: Cici, a trans woman, confronts her gender dysphoria at her younger brother Teddy’s fraternity during a historic Pride party/drag show she put together with her best friends. As the drag performers, frat boys, and queers mingle, Cici has a romantic encounter with a familiar young man that leads to her overcoming her mental hurdles around being a woman. Ultimately, she learns the universal truth of womanhood… sometimes your titties just hurt! A high energy comedy that explores questions of identity.

metas.name: Shifting Baselines
metas.description: Boca Chica, Texas. Hemmed in by the Gulf of Mexico and the Rio Grande, the village is defined by the rhythmic sound of the waves. But this wild country is in the midst of irreversible change. For the swamps have been drained, the beaches closed and the homes bought out: the shadow looming over the beach is that of a 50-story rocket, being readied for launch into space.

metas.name: The Dink
metas.description: Desperate to save a struggling country club and earn his father's respect, a washed-up tennis pro is compelled to break a sacred vow and do the unthinkable: play pickleball.

metas.name: To my sisters
metas.description: Four women are on an existential journey in Morocco, connecting with local women from all walks of life bonding in sisterhood, and share their common quest for empowerment.

metas.name: The Origin Of Bootleg Bill
metas.description: John (Jacob's cousin) has planned a meet up with hero Speedy The Speedster but when they meet up a argument rises but john gets taken and then he starts changing for the worse and john is no longer john

metas.name: The Session
metas.description: Haunted by a recurring nightmare, a woman battling insomnia must undergo a cryptic therapy session to uncover a dark, suppressed memory before the guilt she buried consumes her.

metas.name: The World We Lost (or With Him, Without Him)
metas.description: A visual journal of a queer relationship in New York City at the onset of the pandemic.

metas.name: Amish Ammayi
metas.description: A young Indian American animator, exhausted by rejection in the modern world, attempts a "reverse Rumspringa" after falling for an Amish man and his way of life, and must survive a visit from her achievement-minded immigrant parents or risk her chance to finally thrive.

metas.name: Wild Blackberries
metas.description: An insight into living in London, United Kingdom in 2026

metas.name: The Bet
metas.description: The Bet follows a man trying to win a wager with a friend by pretending to be stood up on a blind date in order to get a free dinner. His plot quickly gets foiled when the woman of his dreams mistakes him for her blind date.

metas.name: Eltareeq
metas.description: Sound and moving image made in support of Mohammad Tayyeb's residency at the Institute of Contemporary Art, Los Angeles with contributions from Hana Elrakhawi and Batool Elhenawy.

metas.name: Elder Brother
metas.description: A man's search to document encounters with Sasquatch turns into a journey across Texas, Unfolding the time and space of memories that spawn mythologies past and present

metas.name: Many Happy Returns
metas.description: A letter made up of excerpts, fragments, and details from cinema and its predecessors. Images and sounds—collected over the years. I thought that these images might reorient my life, change its course, move its solitude towards travel and association.

metas.name: Sculptures
metas.description: A study of our temporal relationship with natural spaces and the memories they hold; questioning if humanity and nature resides in the same superorganism.

metas.name: Miles and MILES!
metas.description: After declaring I'd given up on love, I spent the fall traveling alone—going on a 2 week road trip, navigating work travel, and dancing in between.

metas.name: Sinking Road
metas.description: Dotty Duette gets pushed into the waters to drown by an unknown assailant, where she is then stuck on a magical golden road which drags her down to the underwater "Sinking Road Village". Once there, she meets the embodiments of the Buddhist precepts, some welcoming her and making her feel right at home until the road comes back down for her, and some, like the infamous 1st precept, being out for her blood.

metas.name: Within
metas.description: man love girlfriend  man hit head  man hate girlfriend

metas.name: Rewrite
metas.description: As Daniel and Alli begin writing and editing their final college film project together, a romcom, they realize they may have more in common with the characters they play (Walter and Chelsea) in their film than they thought.

metas.name: My Grandfather Charles Manson
metas.description: Sophia was always the good girl growing up and her father's rock, but her quest to identify her unknown grandfather results in a shocking discovery: He is Charles Manson, history's most notorious criminal; and he bears striking physical similarities to her beloved father. Sophia's discovery propels her into an underworld of Manson family members and unreliable narrators as she traces her grandfather's life. Along the way, her genetics unlock never-before-released records and audio recordings that illuminate Manson's pathology in startling ways. But the more Sophia uncovers, the more her relationship with her father is strained. For Sophia, there's no turning back. What has she inherited, and how will she reckon with her family legacy?

metas.name: A Toxic Love Story
metas.description: A string of threatening emails escalates into a revenge plot involving a newly married US marshal and his ex-girlfriend.

metas.name: Role Models
metas.description: Role Models follows Sophie, Erin and Fletch as they spend the day recovering from a part from the night before. Erin who ruined the party by letting it slip that the birthday girl cheated on her boyfriend. Spends the day on the couch thinking about what she’s done, out of pity fletch offers to go to the shops for her which is. Decision he would soon regret. On the flip side of all of this Sophie spends the day setting up to do a dj set at what she presumes is a night club as she arrives it soon becomes clear she’s made a mistake

metas.name: The Fire We Choose
metas.description: Brian, a newly married outsider in a religious extremist family, is torn between faith and morality when the Wards kidnap a lesbian couple, Kennedy and Mia, determined to save them at any cost.

metas.name: Everything I Own
metas.description: As his parents prepare to divorce and sell the home he grew up in, filmmaker Andrew Garbus turns the camera on his family and himself, unearthing long buried trauma, unresolved guilt, and the elusive hope of healing over one agonizing, revelatory week.

metas.name: The Disconnection
metas.description: Luke is pressured by a pair of stereotypical bullies to get a new phone, so he enlists the help of his unpredictable, dumb friend Liam, but their mission quickly spirals into chaos when a pair of rich, phone-obsessed twins enter the classroom, turning a simple task into a ridiculous, absurd adventure.

metas.name: Days that Shocked the World: Concorde
metas.description: Concorde was an icon of the skies. But after Air France Flight 4590 crashed with the loss of all on board, investigators discovered a shockingly simple explanation for the catastrophe.

metas.name: Bad Counselors
metas.description: After committing a crime on campus, two frat-stars pretend to be Christian camp counselors in order to fulfill court ordered community service.

metas.name: I, Object
metas.description: 10-year-old Tom, grieving the loss of his father and unable to relate to the people in his life, takes refuge in the everyday objects around him. Pop can lids, suitcases and untold numbers of everyday objects reveal their true faces and speak to him, helping him on his healing journey.

metas.name: Beautiful Birds
metas.description: When a widowed birdwatcher reluctantly teams up with her granddaughter for a local birdwatching competition on an island in Scotland, their search for rare species becomes a heartfelt journey through grief, love, and letting go.

metas.name: Becoming Hines Ward
metas.description: From Super Bowl MVP to a man searching for peace, this is the untold story of Hines Ward—whose journey is defined not by touchdowns, but by identity. The son of a Korean mother and an American soldier, Ward grew up caught between worlds, never fully accepted by either. Football made him a legend, but couldn’t quiet the questions: Who am I? Where do I belong?  Decades later, Ward returns to South Korea with his family to confront the culture he once resented and the sacrifices his mother made. What begins as a personal pilgrimage becomes a reckoning with history and a mission to change the lives of children who now walk the path he once did.

metas.name: Desires
metas.description: A 75-year-old retiree gains the power to turn anything he touches into gold. After a tragic mistake, he must confront his desires and discover the true meaning of selfless giving.

metas.name: Finding A Way: Revitalizing Nature in America's Heartland
metas.description: The Midwest has a rich natural heritage. Beautiful forests, sprawling prairies and clear and clean lakes and rivers. The vast human footprint across America's heartland has clashed with the natural heritage for several decades. Restoration of our most sensitive habitats is how humans can find a way to help biodiversity to persist within this working landscape.

metas.name: Love Song
metas.description: Two lovers separate, but eventually reunite atop a mountain. Adapted from a poem by Friedrich Hölderlin.

metas.name: I want you tenderness
metas.description: Experimental dance movie of the play "Je te veux de la tendresse" by Bastian A. Miranda

metas.name: Commander Clep Hoggins VS The Aliens
metas.description: The Reporter follows Commander Clep Hoggins and his Private as they attempt to survive an alien invasion

metas.name: Valley of the Horntak
metas.description: During their search in the woods for a missing boy, an estranged father and son encounter a sinister cult who worship mind and flesh altering creatures.

metas.name: Rabani
metas.description: “Rabani” – is a film about Ukrainian refugee with Sudanese roots, who is caught between memory and a relentless media stream that constructs a parallel life inside his mind. As he moves through Berlin, this mediated reality begins to distort his perception, until he can no longer distinguish which emotions are his own and which are imposed.

metas.name: Tangential Live at King St Crawl
metas.description: Junior reporter Mia makes a pitiful attempt to earn her stripes covering the 2026 King St Crawl.

metas.name: Mozart: The Magic Flute @  Aix-en-Provence Festival 2026
metas.description: For years, *The Magic Flute* has been one of the most frequently performed operas at the Aix-en-Provence Festival. After an eight-year absence, Mozart’s work is now back on the programme. Clément Cogitore interprets the plot as a modern coming-of-age story: Tamino and Pamina leave the world of childhood behind and enter a reality in which beauty is fragile and truth is uncertain.

metas.name: People Magazine Investigates: The Cult of the Soulful Journey
metas.description: Details how self-help guru Soulaire Allerai manipulated followers into financial and mental dependency through isolation and forced communal living. Former members describe the organization's promises of enlightenment masking a reality of strict control and abuse.

metas.name: The End of The End
metas.description: Courageous throughout her life, a woman is no less defiant when it concludes. In the underworld, Death manifests before her in myriad forms, each with a bargain to strike. Death may have met its match, though.

metas.name: The Last DIY Show
metas.description: When a zombie apocalypse breaks out at a punk show, young show photographer Dahlia, her friends, and ex-boyfriend must band together to make it out alive.

metas.name: Ends Meat
metas.description: A woman is confronted with the realization that she's misunderstood the meaning of a common phrase.

metas.name: Permanent Damage
metas.description: Prison escapee Tommy Gods spirals into deeper trouble when he falls for Joe Plísek and is forced to work for her crooked uncle. Together, the couple plots to steal his "golden goose."

metas.name: El Draa
metas.description: Beneath Chioggia's modern port, memories of the last sea dragon vibrate the lagoon. Above, a summer of work and silence unfolds, on an increasingly weary sea.

metas.name: Someone's Daughter
metas.description: A criminal defence lawyer, Sam, (Pascale Bussières, Ma Vie en cinémascope, When Night is Falling), finds herself kidnapped and abandoned on a remote island along with former client Paul (François Arnaud, Heated Rivalry, Fucktoys, The Borgias), who she previously cleared of sexual assault charges. As they make their way through the unrelenting Canadian wilderness, Paul’s behaviour forces Sam to question the man she once defended. As doubt gives way to fear, she finds herself facing a choice no lawyer should ever have to make.

metas.name: Thank You for Sharing
metas.description: In what sounds like a dystopia but is in fact all too real, our human suffering is flattened and repackaged as a “mental health crisis” by naive professionals and buzzword-shilling experts. By unraveling the heretofore ignored history of our mental health culture, two Canadian filmmakers reveal the darker side of our humanitarian impulses, and dare to ask whether they could actually be fuelling the mental health crisis machine.

metas.name: Mnemosyne
metas.description: What is a landscape?  Is it an idea of desire?  I sit on the edge of a precipice, looking at the mountains before me.  The desire for possession  presses my finger against the shutter of the camera...  No! It is not enough.  I reach my hand into the landscape.  It is blood that begins to pour  from the mountains and the valleys.  I ask:  Is this a criminal illusion?  What is a landscape?  Is it a specter of memory and the imaginary?  I ask:  What did the landscape whisper into the ear of your eye?  How far does the extent of its reality reach?  To which one of these does it belong?  To the living space and time,  or to a lost space and time in the past,  or even in the future?

metas.name: The Time of Our Lives: A Concert Movie
metas.description: Following their 2-leg “Time of Your Life Tour”, New York City collective “LAUNDRY DAY” show the ups, downs, and in-betweens of what it really is like to go on tour with your friends turned bandmates. Across 20+ cities, with bumps in the road, flat tires, screaming fans, and pure happiness from LAUNDRY DAY- Jude, Sawyer, Henry, & Henry really encapsulate what it means to have the Time Of Your Life.

metas.name: Everything Passes
metas.description: A married man in a struggling relationship constantly dreams of another woman whom he has never met, or has no recollection of ever knowing. In a desperate attempt to remove her from his mind and to stop his thoughts of being a disloyal husband, he lucid dreams out of the reality of him dreaming of the mystery girl. However, he lucid dreams to the point of no return - he can no longer decipher whether he is real or not anymore.

metas.name: Glorious Disaster
metas.description: Documentary on Laurel & Hardy by David Cairns and Fiona Watson

metas.name: IP
metas.description: Due to overpopulation, the internet is collapsing under the weight of IP addresses belonging to deceased people. As a result, a system is introduced to purge and delete their accounts based on official death records. However, one account linked to a registered death shows recent activity, prompting the protagonist to reach out to its owner.

metas.name: Before the Coffee
metas.description: Naw Paw visits her boyfriend, Ko Phone for what should be a joyful week together. But as unspoken frustrations, conflicting dreams, and the fear of separation surface, their relationship is tested in ways neither of them expects.

metas.name: Morton Meet the Eye
metas.description: An amateur sleuth named Morton attempts to uncover the identity of a legendary detective known as “The Eye” during a chaotic and deadly Hollywood luncheon

metas.name: Kinsky in Prague
metas.description: Follows Toni Kinsky in his home city of Prague, learning about the goalkeeper's first steps in football and his journey to Spurs

metas.name: Nothing Really Matters
metas.description: a short film about the sophomore album from Michigander

metas.name: Please God
metas.description: Noah a devoted Christian struggles to come to terms with his sexuality and faith. In a desperate attempt to rid himself of these thoughts he undergoes a procedure to erase all the memories of the person he desires the most.

metas.name: Men Behind Bars
metas.description: Inmate Rex is transferred to a new prison after allegations of abuse against the prison service. Waiting down in the solitary confinement unit is the governor's human weapon, Darrell, now in his daddy era—what will Rex do to survive?

metas.name: A Hero Story
metas.description: A schoolboy learns to muster up the courage to defeat two bullies by imagining himself in a cowboy movie.

metas.name: I Stared The Devil In The Eye
metas.description: Three seemingly unconnected lives become intertwined through a series of  unexpected events, forcing each person to confront the consequences of their choices. As the truth begins to surface, everything changes in ways they never saw coming.

metas.name: Amy Winehouse: The Tragic Downfall
metas.description: A documentary that delves into the life, career, and struggles of iconic British singer and songwriter Amy Winehouse. Through the archival footage, interviews with those who knew her and expert analysis, the film explores Amy's quick rise to fame, her battles with addiction and mental health issues, and the pressure of celebrity culture. It offers a poignant reflection on the music industry's impact on artists and devastating consequences of unchecked fame.

metas.name: 72 HOURS
metas.description: To save his career, a 40-year-old ad exec joins a crew of twentysomethings for a wild Miami bachelor party after they mistakenly add him to a group chat.

metas.name: Mirror Marked
metas.description: Fully enveloped in the figures of a body I created. Smooth, soft edges. Reclusive, mechanical redesigns. I am stuck here, with that screen hovering over my head. I dive inside.

metas.name: Tropical Parasite
metas.description: A daring treasure hunter must survive the curse of an evil sea gypsy and lovespell of a haunting water nymph, while exploring the Andaman Sea.

metas.name: Nature of the Soul
metas.description: This is the tale of a girl whose soul was split between her body and a pendant she wore. When it slips off her neck one day, a fear awakens that a part of her could be lost…

metas.name: Worst Behavior
metas.description: An LGBTQ+ coming-of-age drama about the emotional isolation and recklessness of Gen Z.The story follows Julie, a young woman trapped in the chaos of modern "situationships." While trying to rekindle a complex romance with her former flame, Noa, her friends pressure her to move on and ask another woman, Erin, out on a date. Lost between peer advice and group dynamics, Julie spirals into poor communication and impulsive choices.Filmed in Bar Harbor, Maine, the short film captures the raw contradictions of a youth that is hyper-connected by technology but deeply isolated in its feelings.

metas.name: HappyDeal
metas.description: In the near future, a struggling single mother living out of her car with her young daughter sees a life-changing opportunity when a global online retail giant launches a hiring initiative for people in need. After an unexpected setback threatens her chances, she's offered an experimental alternative that could secure her future, but at a cost she never anticipated.

metas.name: He'll Never Find Me
metas.description: After fleeing an abusive marriage and faking her own death, a woman builds a new life on a farm in a quiet Midwestern town—until a viral video exposes her identity.

metas.name: Anaganaga O Sukravaram
metas.description: After the loss of her father, Meghana buries herself in work while her overprotective mother, Lakshmi, tries to control every aspect of her life. But when a mysterious twist swaps their bodies for a day, the mother-daughter duo are forced to live each other's struggles, secrets, and emotions. As chaos turns into understanding, one question remains: what caused the swap in the first place?

metas.name: Cámaras
metas.description: Memo is obsessed with his neighbor, Renata, when she accidentally breaks one of the cameras he has hidden in her place, Memo sneaks in to fix it, not knowing what this may cause.

metas.name: The Art of Quitting Gracefully
metas.description: When 41-year-old NYC teacher Joan Cantrell quits her job to finally write the novel she's been avoiding, she's haunted by more than her deadline: her mother also tried to become a writer, and killed herself when she failed.

metas.name: hey, pumpkin.
metas.description: After her recent marriage proposal, Dani’s night spirals into spilled coffee, unwanted advice, and relentless advertisements that seem to know her greatest fears. While picking up her sister from a party gone wrong, both women confront love, adulthood, and the possibility that none of this is as spontaneous as it feels.  This film is not sponsored, endorsed, or associated with the Starbucks Coffee Company.

metas.name: To Whom It May Concern
metas.description: In the quiet stillness of a dying summer, Soren cares for his sister as a terminal illness slowly destroys her body from within. Love and mercy begin to intertwine with something far darker.

metas.name: Sky Full of Stars for a Roof
metas.description: A gunfighter, concerned with being a legend, must come to terms with his life hunting bounties.

metas.name: Twilight: reimagined
metas.description: A short satirical movie, based on the widely known 'Twilight' (2008).

metas.name: Singer
metas.description: While recording vocal takes alone in a deserted carpark, an anxious singer confronts the shadows outside and the fear within.

metas.name: Auditoria
metas.description: In an audition room, Zephyr and June reunite with their past flickering behind. Exchanging dozens of faces and double the glances, they seek to find something to grip within each other. Something that will help to convince, to persuade, to plead. One's truth over the other's.

metas.name: D-Punk
metas.description: D-Punk is a loud, unruly collision of punk and disability – two cultures built on defiance. Through raw interviews and first-hand stories, it uncovers a hidden history of resistance, creativity and refusal. This isn’t about inspiration – it’s about anger, identity and taking up space. Urgent, political and unapologetic, D-Punk reclaims punk as a force for difference.

metas.name: CRASHCAT
metas.description: During her final exam, hot-headed space cadet Crashcat must rein in her fiery temper—or risk losing more than just her diploma.

metas.name: The Fox and the Grapes
metas.description: A fox attempts to eat some delicious grapes, an Aesops Fables

metas.name: algorithm
metas.description: Even after her breakup, Evie isn’t alone. Evie has algorithm, like almost everyone. Algorithm understands you, knows your desires, even before you do. Smart home, personal assistant and social media manager all in one perfect companion.  When her ex-girlfriend wants to restart their relationship, Evie is overwhelmed. Luckily algorithm has her back, but is it’s advice trustworthy? After all, algorithm loves nothing more than a postable love story.

metas.name: Echoes In Time
metas.description: When computer engineer Luke Molan inadvertently discovers a way to travel through time, he uses the technology to go back and warn his wife, Peta, of an impending cancer diagnosis.

metas.name: Fix
metas.description: When Victoria, a pharmaceutical executive, discovers her long-lost brother Damian is homeless and struggling with addiction, she takes a bold step-secretly administering an experimental drug to help him get back on his feet. All seems to be going well until the drug runs out.

metas.name: The Darkest Light
metas.description: What do you do when someone you love does terrible things?  That question haunts Neshama, daughter of Rabbi Shlomo Carlebach, the legendary musician whose songs lay the spiritual foundation for Judaism worldwide. THE DARKEST LIGHT follows Neshama’s wrenching attempt to reconcile the father she adored and the serial abuser he turned out to be.  Through unflinching firsthand testimony, survivors recount the harm they suffered at the hands of the spiritual leader they trusted, revealing the painful contradictions within a man revered by many and a community long steeped in silence, denial and complicity.

metas.name: Prompt: Make a Documentary
metas.description: Prompt: Make a Documentary investigates the growing influence of artificial intelligence on the film industry.  The documentary places the rise of AI within the broader historical context of cinema’s evolution, drawing parallels with earlier technological shifts such as the introduction of sound, colour, and digital visual effects. By revisiting landmark moments in film history, the film demonstrates that disruption has always been part of cinema’s DNA, while questioning whether AI represents a fundamentally different kind of change.  Featuring insights from directors, academics, and practitioners, Prompt: Make a Documentary explores the tension between innovation and integrity, the democratisation of creative tools, and the ethical implications of automation in the arts. The film ultimately asks whether artificial intelligence will empower the next generation of storytellers or redefine creativity itself.

metas.name: Pulling Teeth
metas.description: A young man realizes that he and his brother are growing up and life moves pretty fast, he begins to realize he cannot prevent it and must embrace it.

metas.name: The Melting Man
metas.description: Mr. Fazio is an ordinary man, but what seems like an ordinary science fair, one very special project sticks out.

metas.name: Bride
metas.description: Victor Frankenstein has been running from the consequences of his actions for years but tonight she's caught up to him.

metas.name: Cowboys & Angels
metas.description: A man ventures through the city streets at night as something else calls to him...

metas.name: Your Name is Neighbor
metas.description: Fed up with rising rents and toxic living conditions, two tenants in Harlem and Washington Heights organize a rent strike against their private equity landlord. YOUR NAME IS NEIGHBOR is an intimate portrait of their struggle for home in for-profit housing.

metas.name: Footbinding: A History
metas.description: A thorough recollection of footbinding spanning a thousand years of Chinese history.

metas.name: You Answered...?
metas.description: A young girl decides to call the people who once loved her just to search for that love again.

metas.name: Call Me Cupid
metas.description: A film student who's never been on a date before becomes a dating coach.

metas.name: Zeus | The Chug With the Mind of a Bug
metas.description: In the final chapter of his life, 14-year-old Zeus - a blind, deaf, diabetic Chihuahua-Pug living with dementia, experiences a world that has slowly faded around him. Told entirely through his perspective, this intimate documentary invites viewers into the often-overlooked reality of growing old as a dog, revealing a side of companionship that many pet owners never truly see. A meditation on aging, memory, and the quiet bond between humans and their oldest friends.

metas.name: Crowning at the Prom
metas.description: On the brink of prom queen glory and a coveted athletic scholarship, obsessive overachiever Kat Walker is determined to maintain the flawless image she's built for herself and for her devoted single mother, Abigail.

metas.name: Case in Color
metas.description: A detective faced with stagnation in his career is suddenly thrusted into a new case that brings both romance and purpose in his life.

metas.name: Methodical
metas.description: A man devoted to his flawless daily routine begins to unravel when an unexpected disruption threatens the world he's built.

metas.name: Somewhere After
metas.description: In 2020, seven Australians shared their hopes, dreams and fears and chose a landscape to reflect their experience of isolation. Three years later, they listen back with vulnerability and humour, confronting the universal question: can we use difficult times to become who we hope to be?

metas.name: The Bench
metas.description: When the Mayor of a small town makes the very controversial decision to move the beloved park bench a whole 5 meters in the opposite direction, the locals erupt with anger and disappointment, leading to a dramatic protest and much more. The story is told through interviews, dramatic re-enactments and heartfelt moments with the locals.

metas.name: Clay Life
metas.description: A struggling actor builds a clay figurine of himself that comes to life and quickly achieves everything he has always dreamed of.

metas.name: Saturday Night's Main Event XLV
metas.description: Undisputed WWE Champion CM Punk joins forces with Cody Rhodes against Gunther and Sami Zayn, Danhausen competes in his first match at Madison Square Garden as he takes on JD McDonagh in a No Disqualification Match, and WWE Women's Tag Team Champions Paige and Brie Bella defend their title against Lainey Reid and Fallon Henley of Fatal Influence.

metas.name: What Krishna Saw
metas.description: A documentary exploring the relationship between devotion, dairy, and modern Hindu practice through the lens of Krishna consciousness in contemporary India.  In the excuse of God, we have institutionalized a contradiction. "What Krishna Saw" investigates the profound disconnect between the ancient, revered sanctity of the cow in Hindu tradition and the stark realities of the modern, industrial dairy complex that fuels today's rituals.

metas.name: The Lonely Child
metas.description: Eighty years after the Holocaust, the daughter of the writer of a haunting Yiddish lullaby traces the song's origin and impact over generations.

metas.name: Beacon of Flesh
metas.description: A doomed transgender creature becomes psychically entangled with a medieval nun in this Super 8 rock opera.

metas.name: HER SECOND ACT
metas.description: Sandra, a middle-aged mother, has long devoted herself to her family, quietly setting aside parts of herself that once felt alive. When she inherits her late brother's bicycle, an impulsive ride leads to an unexpected victory. This sudden recognition begins to unsettle the stillness of her carefully ordered life. As attention grows, the delicate balance within her marriage begins to shift. Long-suppressed dreams, disappointments, and silences between Sandra and her husband rise to the surface, unsettling the roles they have long taken for granted. Caught between the family and the pull of desire, Sandra is drawn into a disorienting second act, where change arrives uninvited, bringing both possibility and consequence for both husband, wife and family.

metas.name: Firefly
metas.description: Confined in her room, she finds in her brother's girlfriend, a special connection.

metas.name: Yellow
metas.description: Far from home for the first time, a young Jeffrey is swallowed by an ache of loneliness from a campus that doesn't yet feel like home. Easton, an upperclassman, decides he's worth looking after. Slowly, Jeffrey begins the hard work of grappling with what's been weighing on him, one step at a time.

metas.name: Downeast Hardcore: Stories From The Kave
metas.description: In rural Maine, Kathy Findlay’s underground venue became a refuge for isolated teenagers, where a local scene supported by bands like Agnostic Front, Terror, 100 Demons, and Slapshot offered a sense of belonging.

metas.name: In The Middle Of Something
metas.description: During the worst gig of his life, a piano player wrestling with failure, fatherhood, and marriage has a surreal encounter that suggests he's been playing the wrong song all along.

metas.name: Sheldina
metas.description: Sheldina follows a group of 6 friends living in Emeryville, California in the 1960s and their job is to make movies, and they move up to Burbank so they can get better work.

metas.name: A Long Ride Home
metas.description: Mick learns about the death of his father through a phone call. Now he needs to return to a home he hasn't been to in 25 years to face his Demons.  Director J. Robert Bellamy originally wanted this story to be told in film format, but would only get funding to make it as a series for Bell Fibe. This version is his definitive vision.

metas.name: I Don't Know What I'm Doing Here
metas.description: Mima, an American college student, embarks on a road trip to the rural Romanian village where her grandmother, Esther, was born. Her friend Jacob, a recent film-school dropout, joins her in the old country, along with an 18-year-old translator whom she found on Facebook. Decades after Esther’s death, Mima relies on her grandmother’s unmarked photos of the village and recorded oral history to orient herself in the remote area. As the trio scale walls and trek through fields searching for any evidence of Esther’s life in Romania, the deeper unknowns animating Mima's journey begin to reveal themselves.

metas.name: EZ Driver
metas.description: Miguel Matias, a laid-back EZ driver coasting through life, hits an unexpected breaking point when he picks up Ruby Valentine, a suspicious passenger with secrets that attract the wrong kind of attention. What begins as a routine ride escalates into a dangerous chain reaction that pulls Miguel into her trouble, forcing him to navigate rising threats, split-second choices, and a night that pushes him far beyond his comfort zone.

metas.name: Batter Up, Queen!
metas.description: Drag queen Frannie P. Bodied takes on the most mortifying gig of her career: babysitting a bubbly child baseball player.

metas.name: Snowbound for the Holidays
metas.description: Hotel manager Cassidy Evergreen evaluates a cozy ski lodge, but Christmas magic—and its charming owner, Trey Sanderson—turn a simple assignment into a heartfelt choice between duty and love.

metas.name: Charli's on the Run
metas.description: Charli, a runaway from a highly limiting family, must discover her true identity after meeting Emma, a dancer.

metas.name: Devils in the Bush
metas.description: In a summer’s sweltering heat, 20-something Fei begins to suspect her boyfriend is cheating. As doubt takes root for Fei, she searches for connection elsewhere.

metas.name: Cupid
metas.description: After an encounter with a mysterious stranger, three friends—Kelvin, Pranshu, and Adam—find themselves in possession of a powerful new drug known only as CUPID. What begins as an opportunity to make quick money soon turns into a dangerous journey as the face the consequences of a drug dealing lifestyle.

metas.name: Sand
metas.description: Elisha wakes to a crumbling reality. The wind never stops blowing, the sand keeps accumulating, burying everything. Medea arrives, his long-lost love, elegant and alive, trying to reach through. But In a world where everything falls apart, could anything last?

metas.name: The First Steps to Salvation is Forgiveness
metas.description: Centered on the theme that the first step to salvation is forgiveness, this Saint Patrick's College student film follows a young Marist student enduring relentlessly bullied during school hours.  Pushed to his limits, he takes action and calls upon school authorities. When the bullies are confronted with the true values of respect and pride, both must choose between being trapped in conflict, or the difficult path towards reconciliation.

metas.name: My Love
metas.description: "My Love" follows the story of a couple named Tom and Lucy who plan to go out to dinner for a date night, but when Tom is murdered, Lcy most cope with the loss of her lover.

metas.name: Laniakea the creature (in super 8 Ektachrome)
metas.description: the zany and lovable Laniakea doesnt know what type of creature she is, or if she is even real. She finds help from Glaucous the creature, Joy the creature, and Miss Mousey Mouse Church Mouse the Mouse.  featuring the wondrous nature of ohio, the luminous spectrum of kodak ektachrome super 8 film stock, and a brainwave swirling synthesizer based soundtrack  DESTROY ALL LEAFBLOWERS

metas.name: Jesy Nelson: Life Changing

metas.name: Kaploof

Together, they explore the cynical nature of their reality while finding comfort underneath its gloom.

metas.name: Lola Goes to Bicol!

metas.name: Vietnam: Kill Zone
metas.description: During the Tet Offensive, a battle-weary combat photographer joins a battered U.S. platoon on a deadly jungle mission where survival becomes secondary to the political agenda behind their orders.

metas.name: Tit for Tat 2
metas.description: A woman rebuilds her life after serving time, but a manipulative boyfriend, a haunting past, and buried secrets spark a deadly fight for survival.

metas.description: When Lori learns her daughter, Mia, has entered a throuple, her concern turns to fear when one member of the relationship is found dead and Mia becomes the prime suspect.

metas.name: "OG"

metas.name: Perfection
metas.description: An unsuccessful man becomes obsessed with his brothers looks.

metas.description: after the boss of the mafia family changes, the new bosses brother pays a gangster to take him out so he can be the new boss. after the assasin meets the boss things get philosopical.

metas.name: Velvet
metas.description: After being threatened with termination at her monotonous office job, a creatively stifled Plain Girl is transported into the pages of a mysterious magazine, where each surreal spread forces her to confront, and reclaim, the parts of herself previously dulled.

metas.name: Cuatro condenados a vivir se han escapado
metas.description: On Saturday night, four civilians were arrested for committing various minor crimes. Blitz Nova was arrested for assaulting a minor with a toy laser gun outside a high school. Desmond Benjamin was arrested for interfering with a police operation during a robbery because of "The Portuguese Homeland." John DeLuque was arrested for illegally selling the highly anticipated anime film "Pascual Does Not Dream About Foxy Girl Senpai" before its official release. Pau Cobos was arrested for illegally selling vapes.  Despite their different offenses, they all shared the same sentence: three days in the local police station's holding cells. But waiting was never an option for them. Together, they took the initiative to escape the facility.  The rest is history.

metas.name: Lady Moonlight, Come Back
metas.description: After falling in love while in a dream, a girl has to make the decision on whether to stay and carry out a fake life, or live in reality without her lover.

metas.name: Summertime Sadness

metas.name: The Chittering
metas.description: In an independent movie theater, a small documentary production investigates a conspiracy involving rodents. However, the crew becomes entangled in a web of mystery and darkness as they push the theater staff a little too far.

metas.name: The Odyssemen
metas.description: After undergoing the split of Meiosis, meiosisters Orchis and Semes awaken as sperm in the ethereal land of Test, where the annual Testy Festy welcomes them to what seems like heaven. Things take a turn when Seed, a strange sperm donning a condom mask, claims that their paradise is a lie and calls for the start of the Great Jac, a taboo event prophesied to lead either to the Promised Unknown or to death. A sperm civil war breaks out as rebels and loyalists fight over whether their world is truly heaven or merely the prelude to something far greater...

metas.name: Borderline
metas.description: Convinced they are our secret saviors, rogue U.S. operatives abduct Mexican gang members and seed them across major American cities, unleashing criminal chaos, swaying voters by playing on nativist prejudices, and forcing law enforcement into a race to expose the plot as the escalating carnage threatens democracy itself.

metas.name: Troma’s ODYSSEY
metas.description: Trodysseus makes his journey home to his Kingdom and his Queen Penelope following the Troma War, encountering the brute Cyclops, voluptuous Calypso, and seductive Siren along the way.

metas.name: Low Tide
metas.description: On a secluded beach, Dylan and Malachi find a temporary escape from a world that refuses to understand them. But as the tide shifts, a raw confrontation about love, identity, and family rejection threatens to change everything between them forever.

metas.name: A Different Palate
metas.description: A young sommelier starts to panic when he realizes he enjoys low quality wine.

metas.name: Grace
metas.description: When Grace wakes up on an unknown world with no memory of how she got there, she finds herself racing against the clock to find her way back to base-camp before her oxygen runs out. With only her dad's voice in her ear to guide her, she begins to wonder whether she's really heading to the right place at all.

metas.name: Dead Parents Club
metas.description: Dead Parents Club is a hybrid documentary blending observational footage, experimental performance, and cultural analysis to challenge the pervasive "orphan trope" in popular culture.  While children's media like The Lion King, Frozen, and Finding Nemo frequently use parental loss as a narrative tool to spark a character's independence, the lived reality of grief is vastly more complex.  The film follows real individuals who have lost parents as they collaborate on a unique theatre production. By stepping into the roles of iconic fictional orphans like Simba and Frodo, the cast members weave their personal stories of trauma into the scripted scenes. The resulting performance offers a poignant, absurd, and unexpectedly funny exploration of identity and healing.  Moving between fantasy and lived experience, this documentary examines how we navigate profound loss, build deep connections, and ultimately learn to parent ourselves.

metas.name: Heartstopper Forever
metas.description: It's a new school year for the Truham-Higgs gang. As Nick and Charlie's relationship deepens, their thoughts turn to life after the last bell rings.

metas.name: Iran School Bombing: The Search For Truth
metas.description: On the first day of the war in Iran, a primary school in the remote town of Minab was bombed. 156 people died, including 120 pupils and 26 of their teachers.  Ever since people have demanded answers. Who was behind it? Was it a terrible mistake? If so, how could such a horrific accident have been allowed to happen?  Many have pointed the finger at the United States. But in June President Trump told Sky News "I don't think it was  who might be responsible. Sky News has spent the four and a half months since the attack investigating what happened, how it happened and Sky's Dominic Waghorn reports from the town - the first journalist from a major western news organisation to go there - where he speaks to survivors, bereaved parents and emergency workers.

metas.name: Jschlatt: Just This Once
metas.description: The comedy live recorded show at the NYC Town Hall with Jschlatt.

metas.name: Sugar in the Water
metas.description: Each year, about a million international students come to the U.S. to study, and roughly half try to stay after graduation. It often involves a lengthy and uncertain process.  Sugar in the Water explores the universal human experience of waiting through the lens of an independent filmmaker. Collaborating with twelve close friends and family members, the film unfolds in carefully chosen locations—indoors, outdoors, and within a studio setting—where their spontaneous actions reflect the subtle rhythms of anticipation and stillness. The result is an intimate meditation on time, presence, and the shared existential realities that arise when we simply wait.

metas.name: John Deer

metas.name: OLD SOUL
metas.description: An old-fashioned young man meets a modern girl in a theatre class, and their connection slowly unravels, leading him through unrequited love, faith, and a quiet spiritual reconciliation.

metas.name: SAILBOAT

metas.name: The Clean Up

metas.name: Diamond Made Man
metas.description: Diamond Made Man" spans epochs and galaxies, marking a cinematic milestone as potentially the first Hollywood production to feature an epic confrontation between prehistoric dinosaurs and advanced robotics.Scenes include intense battles in modern city streets where Dr.E.Sreehari, inside a colossal golden robot, clashes with a life-sized T-Rex using groundbreaking practical effects, animatronics, and motion capture technology.The story delves into ancient times around 4700 BC, where humanity's early struggles intertwine with futuristic elements, such as discovering billions in gold aboard a ship in the sea or confronting demonic forces reminiscent of mythological.  ​"A cinematic masterclass in immersion, this film redefines the future of storytelling by seamlessly integrating groundbreaking performance capture, hyper-realistic physics simulations, and native future-proofed VFX ecosystem."

metas.name: Taboo Cocoon

When Maddox captures the Queen of Hearts, Red and Chloe must work alongside Red’s new sister Pink, Luisa Madrigal’s son Luis, and Maddox’s son Max to save her and Wonderland.

Through candid anecdotes, they reflect on past life experiences while attempting to embrace a more relaxed approach to performance and vulnerability on stage.

metas.name: Hunting The Spycammers
metas.description: Jess Davies investigates spy cams and discovers a bigger, darker world than she ever expected. She uncovers an online network where secretly filmed footage of people in their most intimate moments, is shared for views, likes and trades. Who’s doing this and how are they getting away with it?

metas.name: Golgotha Object: The Making of Angel (iii)
metas.description: An intimate piece documenting the collaboration of Amilyn Alma Jones & Audrey Jaye in the making of Jones' film, Angel (iii).

metas.name: Generations: The Evolution of Spider-Man
metas.description: Swing through twenty years of Spider-Man history—from Tobey Maguire and Andrew Garfield to Tom Holland. Explore the evolution of the iconic suits and stunts, follow Tom's journey into the mask, and get an exclusive look at Peter Parker's next chapter with Spider-Man: Brand New Day director Destin Daniel Cretton.

However what the warrior isn't aware of is the manipulation of another slippery sorceress. An ancient evil from beyond the Dreamlands is tightening it's coils around his desires.

metas.name: Glowing

As poets, musicians, and performers reveal deeply personal truths, their stories collide and intertwine, forming a powerful, living dialogue with the audience. What unfolds is not simply storytelling, but an invitation: to feel, to witness, to connect.

metas.name: National Theatre at Home: London Road
metas.description: Autumn, 2006. The everyday life of the Suffolk town of Ipswich is shattered by the discovery of the bodies of five women. The occupant of No. 79 London Road is arrested, charged and finally convicted of the murders. Caught in the headlines and the invasion of their quiet road, the community grapples with what it means to be at the epicentre of the tragedy. Using their own words set to an innovative musical score, London Road is a moving story of ordinary people coming together during an extraordinary time. Director Rufus Norris, writer Alecky Blythe, and composer Adam Cork reunite for this highly anticipated return of the remarkable, award-winning verbatim musical.

metas.name: The Light of Bulgaria
metas.description: Filmed during Great Lent, Great and Holy Week, and the joyous celebration of Pascha in 2025, “The Light of Bulgaria” combines historical research, firsthand interviews, and footage from across Bulgaria to tell a story largely unknown outside that country.  Although the Old Calendar Orthodox Church of Bulgaria finally obtained legal registration after many years of efforts, recent legislative changes supported by the Patriarchate of Bulgaria have once again placed its future in jeopardy. As renewed legal efforts seek to dissolve the Church, this documentary offers an opportunity to understand both the history that led to this moment and the Faithful who continue to endure opposition.

metas.name: The Odyssey: The Making of an Epic
metas.description: Go behind the scenes of Christopher Nolan's mythic action epic, The Odyssey. This special documentary explores the monumental undertaking of adapting Homer’s foundational saga for the big screen, charting a grueling 91-day principal photography schedule across six countries. From the revolutionary use of brand-new IMAX film technology to the massive coordination of over 5,300 custom-designed costumes, discover how a star-studded cast led by Matt Damon, Tom Holland, and Anne Hathaway brought the dangerous, timeless world of ancient Greek gods and monsters to life.
