metas.description: A random Wednesday. A routine office Zoom call. A life forced to start over.

metas.name: Razaa
metas.description: Razaa and her mother Sabeen spend a tense afternoon in a gynecologist's clinic, awaiting an abortion. As they argue over the morality of their decision, Razaa's father suddenly calls they must ensure he never finds out about the pregnancy.

metas.name: Deadly Sign-In
metas.description: When recorded audio from a murder starts playing on the speakers from an unknown device, Kate doesn’t know if it’s real or a prank.

metas.name: Bótharín
metas.description: With his beloved older sister in the throws of Alzheimer's and on her deathbed, an elderly man pieces together an uncertain truth which tosses their whole relationship into question.

metas.name: Minland Empire
metas.description: Ex-cons Bob and Kevin navigate the challenges of modern life when an old nemesis unexpectedly returns and threatens their retirement.

metas.name: The Badger of Ballybog
metas.description: The Badger of Ballybog is a comedy mockumentary following the contestants of Ireland’s premier men’s beauty pageant, including five-time reigning champ Little Johnny, legacy entrant Mícheál Milk, competition bad boy Big Daddy, the young and eager Declan Dweeb, international man of mystery Nakamura Ozu, English pariah Paddy Maguire and American folk singer Duke Davis. It’s like the Rose of Tralee, but for lads.

metas.name: Shot 4 Shot 2026: Cowboy Christ
metas.description: Poet Punch's submission to the Shot4Shot film festival in 2026

metas.name: “NOISE”
metas.description: A soldier’s memory of his first kill unravels into noise, static, and silence - until he’s forced to ask you the same question war asked him.

metas.name: The Last Closet
metas.description: Why the AFL was the last major sports league without an openly queer male player; explores inclusion in Australian football culture.

metas.name: Queering Sydney
metas.description: Poetic doc on young queer people of colour navigating identity, freedom, and nighttime sanctuary in Sydney.

metas.name: Let Sleeping Cats Lie
metas.description: Unlike a cat you only get one life so sometimes it's better to let sleeping cats lie.

metas.name: Autosave
metas.description: Bintang, who had lost his father, embarks on a new in-game adventure alongside his father after he gathers the courage to play it again. It’s their favourite console game that they haven’t finished yet.

metas.name: Glass Saints
metas.description: A group of young men ranging from the ages of 18 to 24 live their bizarre eccentric lives in a world that doesn't understand them. They navigate life's course one day at a time.

metas.name: Keizo Murase: The Last Monster Maker
metas.description: Artist. Innovator. Teacher. Inspiration.  From his humble beginnings as a modeling assistant in 1958 to his acclaimed directorial debut, Brush of the God in 2024, the legendary Keizo Murase spent his career dedicated to the art of monster making, bringing life to many of Japan’s most iconic and beloved kaiju characters. But behind every rampaging monster and transforming superhero were the hands of a dedicated artist, whose contributions to the Japanese film industry might have been forgotten, if not for a dedicated group of close friends, longtime admirers, and fans from every corner of the globe. For the first time in the English-speaking world, the life and career of this singular creative visionary is revealed and celebrated in a feature-length tribute that sheds detailed light on the accomplishments of Japan’s last great monster maker, and preserves the stories of those who knew and loved him best.

metas.name: Richard the Dream Cowboy
metas.description: Richard goes on a cycling trip filled with freedom, fantasy and love.

metas.name: The Salisbury Poisonings: A Spy Next Door
metas.description: The story begins in March 2018, when former Russian intelligence officer Sergei Skripal and his daughter Yulia collapse on a park bench in Salisbury, England – a quaint, historic city where nothing normally happens. But what starts as a local incident explodes into a geopolitical crisis, which exposes the covert espionage war being raged between Russia and the West. A cinematic portrait of loyalty and betrayal and a story that resonates amid ongoing tensions with Russia, the documentary explores the collision of two men: Sergei Skripal and Vladimir Putin, the dictator determined to settle an old score by sending assassins to Salisbury armed with the deadly nerve agent Novichok.

metas.name: Splash City
metas.description: Two brothers on diverging paths struggle to survive amidst the pressures of their community.

metas.name: STUCK
metas.description: Ambitious journalist Simon is drawn into a bitter rural feud involving one dead dog, two angry men, and three slain sheep. Against his editor's advice, he attempts mediation. However, brokering a peace will be no easy task.

metas.name: Finding Solace
metas.description: When two adopted siblings lose their mother, they struggle to come to terms with their own grief while keeping the family together.

metas.name: Left ın the Dark
metas.description: On a dark night, Uncle Sabi, an elderly motorcyclist, offers a ride to a young woman he encounters by chance. When she disappears at the end of the journey, leaving behind an abandoned baby, the situation blurs the boundaries between compassion and responsibility. And leads to an unexpected confrontation.

metas.name: Lewis Capaldi: Live at American Express Presents BST Hyde Park
metas.description: Watch night one of my biggest ever headline shows live in London this coming Saturday!

metas.name: Christmas Uncorked
metas.description: A sophisticated sommelier returns to her small hometown for Christmas and must work with the local tavern chef to put on the best holiday feast the town has ever seen.

metas.name: Chunks
metas.description: An anthology film of six unique comedy shorts threaded together with your host, faded Hollywood starlet Ruby, and taking inspiration from the glamourous by-gone era of late nite public access weirdness.  With live action shorts featuring originals from Podcast About List, Sandy Honig, Nate Fisher & Will Senett, and two animated segments from Episode 1 & Jim Soper, and Nick Mullen & Saul Crinier.

metas.name: Why do you Cry, Perceval?
metas.description: A sad movie about love and dying.

metas.name: Birdboy
metas.description: Set against the neon-lit streets of Kuala Lumpur, Birdboy follows Calvin, the youngest son in a traditional Chinese family, as he struggles to conceal his sexuality while searching for connection in a city suspended between religious conservatism and modern desire. There, he meets Jerry, a Vietnamese massage boy working illegally, and together the pair drift through the city’s shadows dreaming of futures that always feel just out of reach.

metas.name: Displacement and Replacement: A Remixed Narrative of Western Australia
metas.description: In this accumulating remix of 12 films (commissioned by the state of Western Australia in the 1960s and 70s) in 12 chapters phrases from the film’s original narration have been pulled on to highlight the ideological and material violence of the colonial project — unfolding through the banality of things like roads, railways, mines, agriculture, farming and the weaponisation of things we commonly hold dear, like “community” and “home”.

metas.name: J.
metas.description: David keeps seeing his ex in other people's faces.

metas.name: Board
metas.description: A teenage boy decides to pick up skateboarding as a means of making friends.

metas.name: Dante: 500 Miles on Psychedelics
metas.description: A man embarks on a grueling 500 mile run through the desert using psychedelics to push his physical and mental limits. While he battles his inner demons and the harsh terrain, he seeks redemption, aiming to prove that human potential is limitless and to challenge the stigma surrounding unconventional healing.

metas.name: Acropolis Cats and Other Wondrous Creatures
metas.description: Exploring the lives of stray cats in Athens and beyond, ACROPOLIS CATS AND OTHER WONDROUS CREATURES examines the tenderness and tragedies in human-animal relationships. It reflects on love, cruelty, compassion, and what we can learn about freedom in a rapidly changing world.

metas.name: Wedding Flowers
metas.description: A begrudgingly adept, family outcast and her overbearing mother struggle to find connection as their Vietnamese American family reunites for a wedding celebration.

metas.name: There'll Likely be Michael Jackson Vigils Throughout the Night
metas.description: Through nearly a thousand found footage videos from the early internet, filmmaker Marcus Batto recreates the day of Michael Jackson's passing, assembling a vast, fragmented portrait of the cultural earthquake. Equal parts elegy, musical, and excavation into the death of the King of Pop from the lens of strangers, critics and bystanders.

metas.name: Wildman
metas.description: An aloof young man escapes to the wilds of Yosemite in the throes of a depressive episode. His only companion is a camera.

metas.name: The Train to Nowhere
metas.description: Following the success of Dude, Where's My Bus? (2024), Gio Petti's new documentary The Train to Nowhere shifts focus from buses to rail, centring on the Line 2 expansion of Ottawa’s Light Rail Transit (LRT), a project that many commuters hoped would mark a turning point for transit in the city. The documentary follows Petti as he documents the circumstances surrounding the expansion, the project's transition to a hot-button political issue, and the broader impact on riders who depend on the various systems every day. It also explores themes of retaining optimism and taking charge for change in the transit system in the face of cynicism.

metas.name: O Little Christmas Market
metas.description: An artist's fights to saves her town's beloved Christmas market from a developer but a budding romance with the architect tied to the deal may help bring about a Christmas miracle.

metas.name: DETAIL THE HUMAN OPERA
metas.description: Ramiel is on the subway with his girlfriend when he sees someone from his past on an adjacent running train. He decides to get some closure.

metas.name: Rosebush Pruning
metas.description: In a Spanish villa, American siblings Jack, Ed, Anna and Robert wallow in isolation and their inherited fortune. When Jack wants to move in with his girlfriend and Ed uncovers the truth about their mother’s death, the fabric of the family begins to unravel.

metas.name: The Heart of Nachu
metas.description: In the quiet village of Nachu, a small dispensary is transforming lives by bringing essential healthcare closer to the community, proving that even the smallest facilities can make a lasting impact.

metas.name: The Return of Omotara Johnson
metas.description: Haunted by her criminal past, Omotara Johnson has built a quiet life around her son. But when he's accused of murder, old enemies resurface and hidden betrayals explode. From a lover's double life to a best friend's deadly secret.

metas.name: Accelerator
metas.description: Accelerator digitally reconstructs the first linear particle accelerator built in colonial Taiwan by physicist Bunsaku Arakatsu and later dismantled by the United States after World War II. Through unstable 3D models, the work traces Taiwan’s scientific infrastructure, secret weapons research, and Cold War nuclear development, linking computational imaging to the lingering specter of the island’s unfinished nuclear history.

metas.name: Slow Rain
metas.description: A slow rain drips on a small railway station while the rhythms of everyday life progress unchanged.

metas.name: Deadbeat
metas.description: When a soon-to-be father has a crisis of confidence, thinking of running from his family, his own deadbeat dad appears.

metas.name: Shit Happens
metas.description: Desperate for a lover, Billy starts seeing Carrie who hides a bizarre secret.

metas.name: Forever
metas.description: A girl recounts a fleeting summer love in a poetic memory.

metas.name: Cecilia Is Only Eight Years Old
metas.description: Cecilia is about to turn 68 and has never been creative in her life. Spurred on by her curmudgeonly and competitive best friend, she enters a talent competition.

metas.name: A Dream Like a Dream
metas.description: A man finds his soul lingering in the remnants of daily life. Unaware of his own death, he feels no particular concern for his destination. An unexpected phone call forges a brief connection to the living world—a bond as fleeting as his mortal existence, where genuine engagement always eluded him.

metas.name: God's work
metas.description: Set on the streets of Durban, where absurdity and hope walk hand-in-hand, God's Work is a surreal journey into the lives of four homeless friends who face a daily struggle to exist, live, and survive on the margin of society.

metas.name: A Remedy for a Dying Friend
metas.description: Jo’s friend is dying, she must find a remedy to save her.

metas.name: Lucky Liam
metas.description: Taken to a forest to be killed, Lucky Liam sees a chance to survive when a rookie hitman awkwardly interrupts the execution.

metas.name: SOCAPA THE CAMP THE FILM THE MOVIE
metas.description: Two Camp Counselors prove they can make a movie!

metas.name: Protozoa
metas.description: Protozoa, a lonely fluke of nature, faces Earth's evolutionary winner, the mussels, to stop their evil plot of devolving all other life on Earth into complete extinction.

metas.name: Critical Path
metas.description: Critical Path offers an exclusive, behind-the-scenes look at the engineering marvel that is the SpaceX Starship program. The documentary details the iterative design philosophy, the high-stakes testing, and the relentless drive to build the largest and most powerful rocket ever flown. From the first conceptual sketches to the atmospheric re-entry and landing attempts, this film chronicles the single, complex path of innovation required to make life multi-planetary.

metas.name: NOXIOUS
metas.description: Created as his HKU graduation project, Kay Hilman’s animated short film, NOXIOUS, is a haunting exploration of a world reclaimed by nature. Created in Blender with a hand-drawn illustrative style, it imagines a impressive but terrifying new lifeform that has decided to claim our planet for itself. The music and sound design by Mikael Umarov helps set the mood.

metas.name: The One Next Door
metas.description: When a mysterious stranger moves in next door to Robert and Tabitha, boundaries are tested, loyalty is questioned, and danger comes for all.

metas.name: पाखंड [The Facade]
metas.description: "Who made the humans?  AMBITION ..."  An experimental short film by ShubHankar.

metas.name: The Sunken Sahara: ERI-TV
metas.description: Found on forgotten cassette tapes and long-lost duplicate VHS recordings, ERi-TV The Sunken Sahara airs once, on a late December night in 1998. An objective relic of the Eritrea-Ethiopia war, some call it a propaganda piece, some call it protest art, some say something deeper.  Allegedly "brainwashed" witnesses described what they saw as "magic".  The original writers and those associated with the broadcast are unknown and their words are misremembered and misheard.

metas.name: All For You
metas.description: A short film inspired by the albums Preacher’s Daughter and Willoughby Tucker, I’ll Always Love You by Ethel Cain.

metas.name: Help Wanted!
metas.description: An unclear job listing and loads of miscommunication make for a comedic interview between these three characters.

metas.name: i wear the cross free movie
metas.description: movie collage about rape, from the perspective of a bipolar woman in her 20s made in half a day, using media found on the internet and art made by anjimiki this past year

metas.name: Brace for Oblivion
metas.description: BRACE FOR OBLIVION is a vérité portrayal of 7 male and female Ukrainian citizens-turned-soldiers, exploring the horrors and normalization of open-ended combat. Filmed over 3 years, the film portrays what resistance does to ones soul.

metas.name: Love Monster
metas.description: "Love Monster", the opening chapter of FENDI Couture Fall/Winter 2026-2027, a sensuous journey from Villa Borghese through Galleria Nazionale d’Arte Moderna e Contemporanea, extending the collection’s exploration of sensuality, freedom, and pleasure.

metas.name: Tesztpálya
metas.description: Short film directed by Lydia Cornett.

metas.name: Dread
metas.description: Terror takes many forms. In five chilling tales, the mundane becomes monstrous and no one gets out clean.

metas.name: The Night Everything Changed
metas.description: When Tina's teenage daughter doesn't return home from a sleepover with her closest friends, she goes on a frantic hunt to find her before it's too late. In the process, she unravels dark secrets of a forbidden romance and a tryst among BFFs.

metas.name: Jonás
metas.description: Jonás, a teenager about to become a father, has secretly decided to escape.

metas.name: Intrusive Thought
metas.description: two friends are walking when they see a button and argue if they should press it

metas.name: Utopia Air
metas.description: Welcome aboard Utopia Air! Please pay close attention to the following safety instructions.

metas.name: Sartorial
metas.description: After swimming in the lake, a woman begins to clothe herself in a most peculiar manner.  Sartorial is a film about how fashion can define us, how clothes can liberate or restrict our physical expression. We are an all female, international crew, hoping for the chance to tell our story.

metas.name: Storm
metas.description: A drifting beach ball must avoid an incoming storm.

metas.name: Flowery Voices
metas.description: After a fight, a young man calls up a friend.

metas.name: Shipwrecked: Nightmare at Sea
metas.description: Never-before-seen footage and survivor accounts trace the 2012 shipwreck of a luxury cruise and the disaster that ensued, in this immersive documentary.

metas.name: Mudharkanal
metas.description: A brilliant teenager destined for greatness loses everything to drug addiction after one wrong friendship. When he gets a final chance to rebuild his life, he must confront the consequences of his past before they consume his future.

metas.name: Hen Don't
metas.description: A late night hen party spirals out of control when the bride's older sister and the maid of honour have conflicting ideas of how the bride should celebrate her last night of freedom.

metas.name: Still Water
metas.description: In 2008, as China basks in Olympic glory, Xi, a domestic worker, remains haunted by the loss of her sister in a devastating earthquake. When she learns of her sister’s reincarnation, she becomes drawn to her employer’s unborn child, convinced it is her sister.

metas.name: Never Had a Chance
metas.description: When Ravi meets Sukhi, he wants to settle down and have a 'normal' life. But his best mate Jay has other plans and soon he's dragged back to the reality of the streets.

metas.name: Dove
metas.description: Paloma struggles to connect with her Mum after her parents separate. After she plans a secret meet-up with her Dad, tensions between Paloma and her mother grow, and Paloma is forced to make a realisation.

metas.name: Long Live Bernie
metas.description: After a hacker gains Bernie's personal interests on the internet, he demands £2,000 from Bernie during his venture back to his home town.

metas.name: No Sun on Salvation
metas.description: In 1897, Penelope comes to terms with the death of her father with the help of Alabama, a hermit whose daughter is dying from the same illness.

metas.name: 4 Minutes Before Forever
metas.description: What starts as harmless fun with a voice assistant becomes a countdown to destruction when the AI begins predicting a couple's relationship's demise with terrifying precision.

metas.name: Life Support
metas.description: Since October 2023, Gaza has been sealed from the world-except for one group. International doctors breach the blockade, what they find is not just a humanitarian crisis, but a calculated dismantling of life itself.

metas.name: You'll Never Believe Who's Dead
metas.description: As the Cosgrove family gather for a traditional Irish Christmas, and their financial problems come to the fore, a solution presents itself in the form of a robbery of local reclusive farmer Charlie Bann. But the Cosgrove’s have bitten off more than they can chew, as Charlie Bann is not who he seems to be…

metas.name: Rabbit on a Highway
metas.description: A neurotic, alcoholic trans man struggles through navigating his social and love life.

metas.name: If You Can Make It Here
metas.description: Kingsley, Kevin, and Hailey are three ambitious eighth graders preparing for a single exam that could determine their futures. They’re competing for admission to New York City’s Specialized High Schools, elite public institutions that have produced Nobel Prize laureates, astronauts, judges, artists, and national leaders. But as the kids await their test results, a citywide battle is raging over who should attend these schools—the kids who score highest on the entrance exam or the kids who improve diversity. Featuring interviews with kids, parents, and education leaders, If You Can Make It Here places young students at the center of a high-stakes cultural conflict over the future of equity and excellence in public education.

metas.name: NAXOS
metas.description: On a research trip to Greece, Adam slips into a parallel life without marriage, children, or responsibility. With Nysa, a local, he drifts through enchanted freedom while haunted by the life he once took for granted.

metas.name: Lads Being Lads
metas.description: The series follows four close friends who live in the all too depressing yet fictional village of Greyville, Ireland. The kind of place you would expect barely anything to happen. But for Eoin McGintley, Patrick Quinn, James Dames, and Marky Mac, the four of whom are just trying to find some adventure and a few laughs, it becomes the epicentre for their many outright whacky and foolish shenanigans as the lads try to just have fun with what little youth they have left now that adulthood lies closer around the corner for this group of immature teens.

metas.name: All the Queens Houses
metas.description: A photographic exploration of Queens’ unconventional architecture reveals the borough’s beauty through the eyes of an architect while uncovering the deeper history behind its strange and spectacular designs.

metas.name: Laundry day lovers
metas.description: In conversation over dirty clothes, Paul and Ed air out their true feelings for one another.

metas.name: The Isolate Thief
metas.description: A young woman struggles to conceal the gold she stole from a group of violent outlaws who have seized control of her remote outpost.

metas.name: Down the Long River
metas.description: In the aftermath of the Civil War, a former Army surgeon, a notorious gang, and a duplicitous Pinkerton agent cross paths in a tiny river town. When revenge and a fortune in gold are at stake, the town is caught in the crossfire.

metas.name: The Outer Threat
metas.description: After making a groundbreaking extraterrestrial discovery, astrophysicists Daniel and Michelle are forced to flee from home with their family — pursued through the countryside by a relentless and anonymous assailant. As their flight unfolds, the line between cosmic revelation and human paranoia blurs, leading to a tense and emotional confrontation that challenges the boundaries of understanding, science, and survival.

metas.name: The Misadventures of Girth Brooks
metas.description: Prequel short film to “BUM” (2025)

metas.name: BINIchella Week One
metas.description: The Nation's Girl Group, BINI, represents the Philippines as they take over the Mojave Stage for two weeks, becoming the first Filipino act to perform in Coachella in a high energy 45-minute set of their hit songs.

metas.name: Code for the People
metas.description: Short documentary by the makers of WordPress about the fight for the open web. Who built it, who’s trying to close it, and what you can do about it.

metas.name: Queen Lizzy
metas.description: This raw and honest documentary portrays the life of Elizabeth Connors, a queer Traveller woman and spoken word poet, and her relationship with her family who have yet to come to terms with her sexuality.

metas.name: IBS
metas.description: Andie experiences chronic digestive issues but hides it from her roommate. When she is prescribed a stool sample kit for the first time, she has to learn to take care of her health and deal with her own shit (literally and figuratively).

metas.name: Macha
metas.description: Dismissed after surgery for endometriosis and left without answers,Ana draws on the strength of Macha to reclaim her voice and confront the system ignoring her pain, while her father grapples with the helplessness of loving someone he cannot heal.

metas.name: Lone Rocks
metas.description: "Lone Rocks" explores the lesser-known outdoor bouldering possibilities across the Baltic States (Latvia, Estonia, and Lithuania). While indoor climbing gyms have seen explosive popularity in the region, the massive glacial erratic boulders scattered across the natural Baltic landscapes have remained mostly solitary and undocumented. The film interviews local pioneers—including looking back at the 2013/2014 footage of the Lithuanian "The Big Ones" project—and documents attempts to establish lines on unique formations like Latvia’s tallest boulder (Capsadis/Džūkste) and Estonia's giant coastal erratics.

metas.name: Bump
metas.description: An expectant mother's world fractures as she obsesses over what her child's future might cost the planet - and what the planet might cost her child.

metas.name: Bobby Josh: Shadow Of Darkness
metas.description: When a string of mysterious disappearances shakes the city, seven friends uncover a terrifying truth—the mastermind behind the chaos is Bobby Josh, a brilliant but ruthless figure who thrives in the shadows. As Tanner Pridemore, Ian B, Lucas Galloway, Ian Stevenson, Garylee Michael Smith III, Brandon Lopez, and Gavin Latourette race to stop his deadly plan, every clue pulls them deeper into a web of deception, betrayal, and fear. With time running out and darkness closing in, they'll have to risk everything to face the man who always seems one step ahead. In the end, the greatest threat isn't what's hiding in the dark—it's who controls it.

metas.name: The Echo of You Leaving
metas.description: Every goodbye is the start of something new.

metas.name: Sludge
metas.description: Sinead Murphy’s debut film, Sludge, follows a young homeless woman living on the fringes of Irish society and deeply in love with her best friend. Haunted by fractured traumatic memories and visions of a dark-hooded figure, she struggles to hold onto reality as her friend is drawn into the orbit of a dangerous underworld. As her world unravels, she must confront the terrifying truth behind the figure that stalks her, and face the darkness within.

metas.name: Tender and Cruel
metas.description: Set during the days when all communication is cut off, the film follows a lover stranded in silence, aching for any sign of the woman he loves. With no news and no certainty, his longing stretches across distance and time. Wandering through the quiet, storied streets of Cambridge, he reflects on memory, absence, and the fragile threads that bind him and his beloved. As old streets and gentle rivers surround him, he reads a letter addressed to her, words that become both confession and prayer.

metas.name: Rage Against the Dying of the Light
metas.description: Often described as ‘avant-garde punk’, Dublin musician Meryl Streek is dark and dangerous – a cocktail of rage and despair. Onstage he’s a prowler – menacing, apoplectic, and snarling like a young Joe Strummer. Rage Against the Dying of the Light is not only a portrait of an artist, but a snapshot of a challenging time in Irish culture amid a massive housing crisis and a fear of artistic homogenisation – highlighting the importance of dissenting, unique and rousing voices.

metas.name: Note From a Gutter Boy
metas.description: After a young man is murdered in a violent street brawl in Melbourne's western suburbs, his best friend Tommy recounts the circumstances that led to his demise during a court-ordered group therapy session.

metas.name: Nocaretown
metas.description: In the surreal town of Nocaretown, a group of bizarre characters become entangled in a dangerous, absurd quest centered on a mysterious wooden box.

metas.name: Peace, Peace!
metas.description: An hour before their mother's funeral, three siblings are forced to reckon with the horrifying reality of their childhood.

metas.name: The Roast of Caveh Zahedi
metas.description: A documentary record of the live event hosted by Video Store(age) on February 27 at Life World in New York City. The roasters included the following luminaries, trouble makers, and last-minute substitutions: Yung Chomsky, Lily Lady, Christian Lorentzen, Sharon Mashihi, Peter Rinaldi, Joe Swanberg, Onur Tukel, Pacho Velez, and Joshua Z. Weinstein.

metas.name: An Mháthair
metas.description: When confronted with the young man who took her son away from her, a grieving mother must stop him before he strikes again.

metas.name: Qadira
metas.description: Sukant returns from a work trip and finds out that his partner, Tara, has ended their relationship and left. The heartbreak, combined with his failing startup, builds up to a point where he tries to end his life. But then he receives an unexpected phone call.

metas.name: Babesmilk
metas.description: After an ice cream outburst gets her arrested, an entitled woman grapples with the wreckage of her own behavior.

metas.name: DUMPED
metas.description: As Glenn sits by himself in a park after having his relationship come to an end, his mate Chris appears and takes him on a day out to help get his mind off the whole ordeal.

metas.name: Dissection
metas.description: Director Ewan Dunn showcases the making of two surrealist films that almost caused his departure from filmmaking.

metas.name: Almost with You
metas.description: Still devastated by the recent death of his brother, an Irish singer-songwriter on a solo tour of Australia finds himself in a remote West Australian town with 5 days off before the final show of the tour.

metas.name: You Dreamt You Saw Yourself But Couldn’t See Your Face
metas.description: A quiet whistling returned from childhood; the calm of a sky and a river dissolving into one another, from which emerges the image of a loved one. For the duration of a reflection, the water reveals memories and offers the delicacy of a glimpse into the course of a life.

metas.name: Mother, You Have Not Died Yet. But You Will. And When You Do, You Will Finally Be Alive Again.
metas.description: In the Indian township of Durban, where post-apartheid violence still simmers, Lishana cares for her dying mother. Through her photographic practice, she reflects on life and death, past and present, navigating between the tangible and the mystical.

metas.name: Uma Princesa
metas.description: Ten years in the life of Helena Verkoff, according to some of her biographers.

metas.name: Doppelgänger
metas.description: Two people with the same face live completely different lives. When a horrible incident happens, one of the two finds herself stepping into shoes that aren't hers.

metas.name: Urchins
metas.description: Follows a college freshman as they embark on a road trip with new friends, finding a renewed life purpose.

metas.name: Untitled
metas.description: Short for Portuguese television channel Canal180's "Jogo Cruzado" series.

metas.name: Shush, Now
metas.description: A seven year old girl discovers her mum is having an affair.

metas.name: Faraway Home
metas.description: Two young Jewish children are sent by their parents away from Nazi occupied Austria during WWII, on the Kindertransport, where they end up at a refugee farm in Northern Ireland.

metas.name: Red Thunder VS The Intrusive Thoughts
metas.description: A supervillain's plot to take over the world using a helmet that can read minds runs awry after an encounter with a man with some anxious thoughts and a secret identity.

metas.name: Neon Banana
metas.description: A seemingly innocent online interaction quickly turns precarious.

metas.name: Love and the End of Romance in Czechoslovakia
metas.description: After the birth of Czechoslovakia in 1918, a new architectural style flourished in cities such as Brno and Bratislava. The fate of the famous Tugendhat Villa, designed by Mies van der Rohe, mirrors the turbulent history of this short-lived nation-state.

metas.name: The Office: Ricky's Top 25 Brent Moments
metas.description: To celebrate the 25th anniversary of The Office, Ricky Gervais counts down his 25 favourite David Brent moments. Blending classic clips from the acclaimed BBC sitcom with newly filmed commentary, Gervais reflects on the inspiration behind the character, shares behind-the-scenes stories, and revisits the cringe, comedy and awkward brilliance that made David Brent one of British television's most memorable creations.

metas.name: OK MR BRUCE
metas.description: OK MR BRUCE is a visual album directed by Tom Oliver. Blending live action, performance, line animation and frame-by-frame painting, the film charts Mr Bruce’s surreal journey through personal and collective grief. Across five chapters, he navigates rituals of loss, memory, anxiety, empathy and acceptance, as he moves through a series of strange, vivid worlds that oscillate between the absurd and the profound.

metas.name: American England
metas.description: A sweeping montage of the English countryside, framed as an American western. The film explores the distortion of American idealism through the lens of western iconography: both a love letter and a critique of the country.

metas.name: The Mastodon in the Room

metas.name: The Art of Feeling

metas.name: Street of Dreams
metas.description: After her life is disrupted, Calle is seen holding on to soccer as a source of purpose and possibility. As she navigates uncertainty and self-doubt, she is guided by Sir David Beckham who appears as a personification of her inner voice, a guardian only she can see. He’s a powerful symbol of belief and opportunity, standing with her and showing up when it matters.

metas.name: Dots Dots Dots
metas.description: Mapping and spotting the complicit machinery of Germany. A graphical approach to make transparent the entangled networks between factories, supply chains, politicians, and military, in enabling the genocide of Palestinian people.

metas.name: I DON'T WANT TO HURT THINGS

metas.name: Bigfoot Lover

metas.name: Death Drinks Green Tea
metas.description: When Death herself knocks on his front door, Rami, self-condemned romantic and aspiring actor marked by failure, is forced to confront everything he has neglected in his life, within the depths of his psyche, in Limbo.

metas.name: Love in the Cloud
metas.description: Hidden behind a horse mask, a young lonely woman ventures into the world of adult content creation. She must face her fear of being truly seen when a connection with a client springs unexpected feelings of love.

metas.name: Project Hellgate

metas.name: Bean

metas.name: Barçawash

metas.name: How to Get Filthy Rich with Gary Stevenson
metas.description: In this provocative state-of-the-nation film, Stevenson travels across the country meeting those most affected by the widening wealth gap, alongside multi-millionaires and billionaires who sit at the other end of the economic spectrum.  Having made millions during his career in finance, Stevenson now campaigns against the expanding divide between rich and poor, and examines what he believes is driving inequality in Britain today.  The documentary sees him engage with economists, financiers, public sector workers and individuals from across society, going head-to-head with critics of his views while also hearing from those who support his proposed solutions.  At the heart of the film is Stevenson’s belief that meaningful change requires a wealth tax, with the super-rich contributing more to address what he sees as a broken system.

metas.name: Cat's Blood (Proof of Concept)
metas.description: Through the eyes of William Maves, the personal driver of Nico Marchesi, we follow a deadly clash between two rival families in South Africa, where blackmail, betrayal, and revenge turn love, loyalty, and blood into weapons—and one misstep can be fatal.

metas.name: Pure Reason

metas.name: I Couldn’t Draw You A Map
metas.description: In the divided city of Mitrovica, Kosovo, fragments of a diary, everyday gestures and sounds gathered from the city compose an exploration of separation on multiple levels: political, territorial and emotional.

metas.name: A Requiem in Bishkek
metas.description: An Indian refugee living in the capital of Kyrgyzstan, witness to the political instability surrounding him, drifts into a melancholic and elegiac meditation on his condition as a foreigner. Film stock is his last refuge.

metas.name: Permanent Trespass
metas.description: Two “professional mourners” meet within the ominous setting of an Art Nouveau villa. Who — or what — is being mourned? From Beirut to Sarajevo, what first appeared to be an intimate encounter gradually transforms into a singular confrontation with History.

metas.name: To Become Ghosts

metas.name: My Little Nothing

metas.name: Murphy vs. Christmas
metas.description: Murphy Vs Christmas is a darkly satirical yet heartfelt drama set in contemporary Dublin, which concerns the plight of failed Irish artist and father, Eoin Murphy as he battles for truth in a world distracted by commercialism, myths and lies.

metas.name: What Am I Looking At? Is It Someone’s Navel?

metas.name: Moana

metas.description: A couple on the edge of a breakup discover a supernatural force that's keeping them together

metas.name: Where the Horses Heal the Soul
metas.description: Children, adults, and veterans discover hope and healing through the powerful human-horse connection at ROCK Ride On Center for Kids, a Texas nonprofit providing equine-assisted services. In the arena, uncertainty gives way to confidence, walls begin to come down, and participants living with physical, cognitive, and emotional challenges find courage, purpose, and possibility.  Through the rhythm of riding and the quiet presence of horses, breakthroughs unfold one session, one connection, and one transformed life at a time. Where the Horses Heal the Soul is a moving documentary about the extraordinary power of the human-horse bond to open a path forward and reveal the potential within each person.

metas.name: Tamsyn Kelly: Hot Titty Bungalow
metas.description: Tamsyn Kelly brings sharp wit and wonderfully awkward storytelling to the stage in this hilarious stand-up performance about big life choices, messy relationships, and starting over in a new city. After impulsively moving from Cornwall to Glasgow for love, she quickly discovers that major decisions don’t always come with major planning.  Blending self-deprecating humor with clever observations, Tamsyn dives into long-distance dating, family dynamics, modern friendships, and the strange realities of adapting to a completely different culture. From awkward encounters with exes to bizarre local experiences and questionable attempts at self-discovery, every story is packed with relatable chaos and unexpected punchlines.  Warm, quirky, and brutally honest, this set showcases Tamsyn Kelly’s unique comedic voice as she turns life’s uncertainties into laugh-out-loud comedy.

metas.name: Before America
metas.description: Before America is a cinematic documentary uncovering the Indigenous histories of Michigan long before the United States existed. From the 1763 uprising at Fort Michilimackinac to Odawa trail trees and the overlooked women of Fort Detroit, the film reveals how Anishinaabe nations shaped Great Lakes history and helped spark the chain of events that ultimately pushed the American colonies.

With the pressure of the future and the state of the world weighing heavily on him, how will Cassian confront everything he's trying to run from?

metas.name: The War Game at Cinecity
metas.description: When Peter Watkins’ banned nuclear war masterpiece "The War Game" reached Toronto in 1967, it found an unlikely home at Cinecity, a new cinema determined to challenge audiences. Drawing on archival research and eyewitness accounts, this documentary explores the film’s enduring impact and the role Cinecity played in shaping Canadian film culture.

metas.name: Attack of the Samurai Sharks
metas.description: A 3,000-year-old cold case could be the earliest known victim of a shark attack. The skeleton, found in Japan, is covered in unusually deep cut marks. It looks like the victim of a frenzied samurai sword attack, but could his wounds have been caused by a shark? If so, which species of shark is the prime suspect? Shark experts Alyssa White, Gavin Naylor, Kirin Sekito and Masato Nakatsukasa investigate.

metas.name: The Odyssey with Dan Snow
metas.description: Dan Snow sets sail across the Mediterranean in the wake of Homer's The Odyssey. This epic was written down almost 3,000 years ago, and it has been loved by generations of filmmakers, artists, authors and historians since. Now Dan re-tells the story visiting the harbours, mysterious islands and incredible ancient locations across Greece that inspired The Odyssey.

metas.name: The poem: Masochist
metas.description: I think I'm a masochist  I crave intimacy more than any other feeling  To have someone look at me and put all their emotions onto my body and mind  The idea of being hit excites my mind more than any feeling of bodily pleasure  The outburst of another inflicted on my skin, as their fist connect with my flesh and the blood vessels explode within like tiny orgasms  To feel the ache graze over my skin and soothe into a warm and tingling sensation  The idea of purple and red flowers blooming on my body in an act of true emotions  I never got bruises from the hits  They were never sexual or romantic  I don't like to be hit in my face.

metas.name: Rain Catcher
metas.description: In rainy, nocturnal London, photographer Miles obsessively captures unforgiving, morbid portraits of oblivious strangers. When not selling them, he shares them online as 'Rain Catcher'. But soon he notices something unsettling: a mysterious woman watching him and photographing him—turning the lens back on Miles. As her gaze closes in, his world fractures—his work is sabotaged, his name defamed, his loved ones endangered. Consumed by paranoia, he spirals into a dark, delirious obsession to uncover the truth behind her motives. Based on the 2018 short film of the same name.

metas.name: Hammerhead Sharks Up Close with Bertie Gregory
metas.description: In Mexico’s Pacific waters, Bertie Gregory goes in search of one of the ocean’s most iconic predators: the hammerhead shark. Once abundant in these seas, hammerhead numbers have plummeted, making sightings increasingly rare. Bertie investigates what’s driving the hammerhead decline, and how protected waters offer hope for the future. His journey culminates in a rare and unforgettable encounter that shines a light on the future of one of the world’s most famous sharks.

metas.name: The SU
metas.description: For decades the Students’ Union at the University of Galway has produced some of Ireland’s leading political figures, including former President Michael D. Higgins. Over the years these young activists not only defended students’ rights, but found themselves on the front lines of battles stretching well beyond campus – from contraception to abortion, from the Troubles in Northern Ireland to war in the Middle East. Some issues have changed over time, though the overall mission remains the same. This documentary follows along as the current union executives organise protests and other events on and off campus, growing into their roles as leaders. Shot over two years, the film celebrates their passion and vitality, as well as the laughter, friendship and exuberance of youth, giving an inspiring insight into the reality of student life and the growth of strong, socially conscious leaders in whose hands the future lies.

metas.name: This is George and Monty
metas.description: This outrageous marketing parody film guides viewers through the rise and fall of George and Monty, who manage to captivate audiences in all the wrong ways.  An unpredictable internet and commercial sensation, George and Monty lack any discernable talent or intelligence, and nothing about them makes any sense.  In this absurd "documentary," they carelessly wield the power of the camera with catastrophic results in their absurd workplace training videos, alternative advertising campaigns, dating websites, connections to North Korea, multiple branding fails, re-editing of major motion pictures, and seemingly ruining the lives of everyone they touch (well no, not like that).  In a world where appearance supersedes reality, you won’t know what’s real or fake.  The story of George and Monty needed to be told but nobody is sure why – they still don’t make any sense – none of this makes any sense!

metas.name: The Mana of Culinary
metas.description: Food. Who doesn't love food?  Northcote College and many schools across the globe offer amazing learning opportunities under the hospitality industry, but it is seen as 'a bummy subject' due to the reduced knowledge required in the field. In this documentary, experienced Northcote College hospitality students express their views against the major backlash and testimonials about their experience in the new and improved K-block kitchens.  Students at Northcote College clearly love the hospitality classes. Although it isn’t as academically demanding as other subjects, it's open to everyone and can still lead you to a successful career. These classes bring friends together to collaborate on making a fancy dish, something other classes fail to do, and that's what makes it so successful and unique.  This documentary will make you rethink hospitality as a 'drop-out' subject into an accepting and empowering subject.

metas.name: Emily's Last Game
metas.description: After the Football Association’s decision to ban transgender women from women’s football in England, we returned to speak with Emily, Lucy Clark and the TRUK United community about what the decision means for them, their future in the game, and why football matters so deeply.  For Emily, football has been a place of belonging through some of the hardest moments of her life. For Lucy, it’s about fighting to ensure future generations can continue to find that same community.  This isn’t just a film about football. It’s a conversation about identity, resilience, belonging and the human impact behind the headlines.

metas.name: Learning to Drive in Birmingham
metas.description: Laisul, a Bangladeshi immigrant now living in the UK, attempts to navigate Birmingham through driving lessons, conversations in cars, and phone calls from home.  Filmed inside vehicles and among construction sites, blocked roads, and sprawling South Asian neighbourhoods on the city’s outskirts, the work reflects on mobility, belonging, and displacement, while offering a glimpse into the lives of Bangladeshi communities who have made Birmingham their home.  As the artist learns to drive in a city seemingly built around cars, encounters with friends, driving instructors, and archival traces of Bangladeshi political figures reveal Birmingham’s deep connections to Bangladesh and its diaspora.  Moving between intimate conversations and urban observation, the film unfolds as a portrait of a city in transition, where personal experiences intersect with migration, infrastructure, and histories that continue to travel between Birmingham and Bangladesh.

metas.name: a house not ours//pilgrims
metas.description: Casa d’altri // Fujenti was conceived as a diptych, two variations on the same religious theme, the paradoxical meaning of prayer and devotion. If, as Sergio Quinzio suggests, prayer is a negative moment marked by God’s constant lack of response, the first part, freely inspired by Silvio D’Arzo’s  Casa d’altri, explores this question through a single figure. A wanderer moves among saints, churches and books, posing a scandalous question to theology. The second part shifts the same question from the individual to the multitude. Through archival materials connected to rites, processions and popular pilgrimages, the film observes bodies that pray, walk, wait, and offer fatigue, voice, tears and presence. Following Quinzio’s intuition, the praying figures do not appear as pacified images of devotion, but as needy creatures, beggars before the invisible, bodies asking for the fulfilment of a concrete lack.
