It’s wrestling that celebrates the talent, curated for fans who know ball, and those who’d like to learn—or learn to love it.  For this edition, PRODUCE features SUPERFIGHT, a headlining match between Jonathan Gresham and Fuminori Abe, plus appearances by Joey Janela, Effy, LaBron Kozone, Mance Warner, Steph de Lander, Man Like Dereiss, AEW Women’s Pure Champion Deonna Purrazzo, “Hot Sauce” Tracy Williams, Mad Dog Connelly, and many more.  PRODUCE is presented by Orange Crush, and co-produced by Jonathan Gresham.

metas.name: REVIVER
metas.description: REVIVER is an independent experimental short film that blends psychological drama with surreal storytelling to explore identity, redemption, and the consequences of our choices.

metas.name: Punch's Journey
metas.description: Inspired by the viral true story of Panchi-kun, an infant macaque rejected by his mother at Ichikawa City Zoo, Japan. In this fictionalized short, Punch finds fleeting comfort with Uma, an abandoned Persian kitten, endures cruel rejection from Garo, a bullying troop member, and discovers protective love from the gentle guardian Go-chan.

metas.name: True British Horror
metas.description: A dark dive behind the genteel curtains of Great Britain, revealing some of the most horrific crimes ever committed. From Jack The Ripper to Dr Harold Shipman, no grim detail is spared in this look at Britain's most notorious killers.

metas.name: Sucess
metas.description: Noé tells his partner, Camille, how he set out to sell a valuable item but ultimately returned empty-handed. Through a series of absurd encounters, and driven by an impeccable logic, he traded his possessions for others of lesser value, until he was left with nothing at all.

metas.name: I'm At Home
metas.description: She sleeps,  she leaves,  she cries, she uses her cellphone.

metas.name: Beneath the Mask
metas.description: A teenage streamer's dialy life conflicts with the masked version of himself.

metas.name: The Final Bliss
metas.description: a man is preparing to get revenge on the people who have wronged him throughout his life but along the way he comes to a realization that changes everything.

metas.name: DERANGED
metas.description: After Harry kills a boy with his dad's car, he spirals into a murderous state and bludgeons all of his friends.

metas.name: The Journey With The Wish Fish
The uncertainty
metas.description: A documentary film shows the conversation about the reality of background actor and technicians

metas.name: Eli Manning Presents: The Undercovers - Sabrina Ionescu
metas.description: Eli Manning recruits WNBA superstar Sabrina Ionescu to go undercover at her alma mater, the University of Oregon. Sabrina transforms into Jennifer Scone, an enthusiastic Ducks fan who's attending her first basketball game. She fools coaches, mingles with fans, and shocks the crowd at halftime.

metas.name: coffee bean and nothingness
metas.description: Sensual portrayal of a man making his morning cup of coffee

metas.name: Disney Celebrates America: The Pursuit of Happiness
metas.description: A coast-to-coast event exploring Disney Parks and attractions as a portal through which America's greatest stories, triumphs and traditions are celebrated.

metas.name: Wuertz' Pub
metas.description: An influencer walks into a bar.

metas.name: Austen's Least Romantic
metas.description: Convinced that Jane Austen wrote a love story for every scenario, a Darcy-obsessed woman must do everything in her power to prove her theory wrong when she finds out her story might be Northanger Abbey—Austen's least romantic novel.

metas.name: Declarations: Black Americans and the Revolutionary War
metas.description: When the Declaration of Independence was signed 250 years ago, the Founders – many of whom were slaveholders – declared: “all men are created equal.” As their aspirational words and ideals of freedom were signed into existence and spread throughout the colonies, Black people recognized that these ideas included them. DECLARATIONS: BLACK AMERICANS AND THE REVOLUTIONARY WAR examines how they fought for these tenets of democracy for themselves, their families, and their communities. The film features insights from historians and scholars including Leslie Alexander, Danielle Allen, Edward Ayers, Christopher L. Brown, Woody Holton, and others.

metas.name: The Harder They Fall
metas.description: A casual game of Jenga between Rigsy and Dearden becomes the battleground for a simmering argument neither of them can keep stacked.

metas.name: The Odyssey: The Real Story
metas.description: After the fall of Troy, warrior-king Odysseus begins a perilous voyage home, only to be thrown into a decade of wandering across a world ruled by gods and monsters. He outwits cyclopes, resists enchantresses, and descends into the realm of the dead, while his family fights to survive in his absence.

metas.name: Corps Man
metas.description: The untold true story of Mexican-American combat corpsman Dave Lara, and his band of brothers known as The Group, who kept the biggest secret of the Vietnam War. For the first time on film, Dave Lara tells his story of how he and The Group navigated a hostile society and military as gay men at a time when it was criminal to be themselves.

metas.name: Schrödinger's Man
metas.description: In the midst of an existential crisis, Y. ostracizes himself to live the rest of his days in  solitude - locked in an underground bunker, with a system designed to euthanize him at a  random time.  Both dead and alive, his fragile peace is shattered by a series of apparitions.

metas.name: The Hunter and The Hunted
metas.description: Two boys rustle the feathers of a ruthless hunter and find themselves in an intense chase that will test their teamwork and will to survive.

metas.name: Orevwa
metas.description: In Orevwa — Haitian Creole for “goodbye” or “until we meet again”  EJ, a young gay Haitian American barista from South L.A., is doing everything he can to care for his ailing grandmother while keeping his own dreams alive. Searching for stability, he enrolls in a CNA program, where he meets Jordan, his confident and irresistibly charming instructor. As sparks fly between them, EJ must navigate the pull between love, duty, and self-discovery.  Orevwa is a heartfelt, romantic dramedy about saying goodbye to who we were and daring to embrace who we’re becoming

metas.name: Guided by Horses
metas.description: In the stunning beauty of the Kimberley, this feature length documentary is a cinematic story of hope, rising from the quiet, unexpectedly powerful bond between a cast of young people and horses, who are participating in a uniquely special sanctuary created by Aboriginal researcher Professor Juli Coffin.

metas.name: Tiny Doll House
metas.description: The film explores the unique NYC-store Tiny Doll House, and follows its owner Leslie Edelman on a summer day at the shop.

metas.name: لا انا لست بانسان
metas.description: No, I'm Not a Human

metas.name: Dance Gavin Dance: The Pantheon Live from Anaheim
metas.description: Watch Dance Gavin Dance perform at their sold out show live from the House of Blues Anaheim on The Pantheon Tour.

metas.name: The Lost Mirror
metas.description: As his grandfather's memories fade, 10-year-old Jin journeys into the magical World of Mirrors to retrieve his Grandpa's lost mirror, discovering that some reflections hold more than memories, they reveal who we're meant to become.  Adapted from a Korean children's book of the same title, the film is shot entirely on a virtual production stage.

metas.name: Trapped With Two Monsters
metas.description: Locked inside with no way out, two sisters must face a terrifying presence stalking their home while their father is away at work. As the night grows darker and longer, the line between reality and nightmare blurs. Secret stalkers are hiding in the darkness, but the true identity of the "monsters" is far more terrifying than they ever imagined.

metas.name: The Man From Bristol: Ralph Bates Remembered
metas.description: Documentary on the career of actor Ralph Bates.

metas.name: Joan Collins: Queen Of The Horror Films
metas.description: Documentary on Joan Collins and her career in horror films.

metas.name: Hammer and Beyond: The Jimmy Sangster Legacy
metas.description: Documentary from Hammer Historian Marcus Hearn tracking the career of director Jimmy Sangster.

metas.name: Evel: America's Daredevil
metas.description: Mike O'Hara takes a high-octane trip down memory lane, honoring what was once the greatest event on television: Evel Knievel.

metas.name: The Devil
metas.description: A pair of thieves, a homeless disciple of the Devil, and an empty jar collide in a darkly comic tale.they discover the Devil was never interested in buried treasure, only in exposing the hypocrisy and hidden sins of those who blame her for their own evil.

metas.name: &TEAM VR CONCERT: BOUNDLESS
metas.description: The cinematic VR concert <&TEAM VR CONCERT : BOUNDLESS> follows the boys as they escape a mysterious, secret laboratory. After breaking out, they reunite with their fandom, LUNÉ, in the shadows of the city on a journey to rediscover who they are.

metas.name: Estados Unidos: 250 Un País de Inmigrantes
metas.description: The history of the United States cannot be told without Latinos. From independence to the present day, they have helped build, defend, and transform this nation. This Special from Noticias Telemundo highlights the legacy of a community that has left an indelible mark on the country's history.

metas.name: Management is Killing Me
metas.description: The debut short film from Trifecta Studios

metas.name: The Hermit
metas.description: Well respected investigative journalist Danny Inter-View meets Clermonstre, a friendly monster who's life story hopes to inspire many.

metas.name: Seed
metas.description: Jasim has Infertility. thus, he tries to hide it out of fear of the stigma while seeking a way out in a middle eastern gulf society.

metas.name: Prophet of Ecstasy
metas.description: THE PROPHET OF ECSTASY explores themes of art, politics and consciousness through the improbable life of Michael Clegg, the former Catholic priest who introduced MDMA to the world - a drug he would later dub ‘Ecstasy’. The documentary will take viewers on a wild ride, from Clegg’s life as an MDMA drug kingpin, to his present-day transformation as an enlightened yogi. It also examines how the destinies of Michael Clegg, chemist Carina Leveriza, and psychedelics advocate Rick Doblin, are inexorably bound with that of the socio-cultural explosion of MDMA through its epic journey of discovery, criminalization, and re-emergence from the shadows.

metas.name: Hindsight Services
metas.description: A young couple try to save their marriage after being delivered a file from the future detailing their impending divorce.

metas.name: CONTRAST
metas.description: Born with black-and-white skin, a lonely student is excluded by his classmates. When the bullying escalates, only one girl refuses to judge him.

metas.name: Fadengang
metas.description: A story about how social media takes over your life.

metas.name: Where Are You Hailey?
metas.description: A man struggling with alcohol, cigarette, and Fortnite addiction waits for his fiance to come home. But what day will she be back?

metas.name: Taylor: A Story of Love
metas.description: As Taylor Swift prepares to tie the knot, this documentary traces how the love life of the world’s biggest pop star has influenced her music and her irrepressibly successful career

metas.name: Wilma, Wu, and a Stripper Named Lorraine
metas.description: When a beloved desert cantina is threatened with closure, a washed-up burlesque dancer rallies an outrageous crew of misfits, church ladies, hustlers, and dreamers for one last talent show to save their town. As chaos turns to community, a feuding mother and daughter must decide whether to hold on or finally let go. ​

metas.name: wiśniowy
metas.description: A surreal attempt at cherry growing

metas.name: Wimbledon 2025 Review
metas.description: A look back at last year's tournament, which saw Carlos Alcaraz and Barbora Krejcíková enter as the reigning men's and ladies' singles champions

metas.name: no tears left
metas.description: Simone is a teenager struggling with his mental health, Alyssa is his best friend but she doesn't know to help him.

metas.name: AEW x NJPW x CMLL x Stardom Present Forbidden Door 2026: Buy-In
metas.description: The Buy-In served as the pre-show for All Elite Wrestling's 2026 Forbidden Door event.

metas.name: The Heir
metas.description: A grieving granddaughter inherits her grandmother’s home in a gentrifying D.C. neighborhood, where family tensions and generational scars force her to choose between preserving tradition or redefining legacy.

metas.name: Phrenia
metas.description: Prakash, a painter returns to his studio after 200 days of sobriety. Haunted by a blank canvas that seems to follow him everywhere, he confronts fear, doubt, and the thin line between reality and imagination.

metas.name: Tattoo Medicine
metas.description: Tattoo Medicine explores Pili's path as a brown indigenous Colombian person from the Muisca & Pijao people, highlighting the intersection of ancestral spirituality and healing in his tattoo practice. From his childhood struggles in Miami to being a resident artist at Fruit Camp, the most prominent queer-tattoo shop in Baltimore, the documentary delves into the challenges and triumphs of forging a unique, culturally rooted career in the world of tattooing.

metas.name: Kil and the Kids
metas.description: In Southeast D.C., a mentor named Kil supports youth through Horton’s Kids while coping with the loss of one to gun violence. When another teen is robbed at gunpoint, Kil helps him process the trauma through art and expression, revealing how showing up can transform pain into resilience.

metas.name: One Two Three
metas.description: A little girl is alone at home with her bird, suddenly they see something and call the social emergency and report the child being hurt....

metas.name: remain in light
metas.description: a love letter to the susquehanna and the passage of time

metas.name: Striking Out the Boys
metas.description: A feature documentary about Jaida Lee, the first female to compete in men's baseball at the Canada SummerGames.

metas.name: A Thrift Story
metas.description: It’s Amy’s last day at the no-name thrift store where she works, but she’s got one last difficult customer to deal with.

metas.name: What Never Was
metas.description: A figure devoid of identity stands in a field of flowers.

metas.name: NXT The Great American Bash 2026
metas.description: The 2026 NXT The Great American Bash, also promoted as NXT The Great American Bash: Orlando, is a professional wrestling livestreaming event produced by WWE. It is the 14th Great American Bash under the WWE banner, the seventh annual produced specifically for its developmental brand NXT, and the 28th Great American Bash event overall.

metas.name: The Three Graces
metas.description: In 1860s London, three Greek female artists attend a gallery opening, seeking to impress the Pre-Raphaelite Brotherhood.

metas.name: 50 Years of Punk
metas.description: This new documentary traces the explosion of punk on London’s Kings Road and is the most authentic insider account of punk’s evolution and legacy, by the artists and people who lived it. Fifty years on, punk’s core values of individuality, creativity, authenticity and freedom, are more relevant than ever. Punk was never about the music - it is a way of life. Features interviews and footage with Hugh Cornwell, Dave Vanian, Vivienne Westwood, Rat Scabies, Gaye Advert, Richard Jobson, Glen Mattlock, Jan Wobble, Terry Chimes, Tony James, Viv Albertine and many more.

metas.name: TNA Slammiversary 2026
metas.description: The 2026 Slammiversary is an upcoming professional wrestling pay-per-view (PPV) event produced by Total Nonstop Action Wrestling (TNA). It will take place on June 28, 2026, at the Agganis Arena in Boston, Massachusetts. It will be the 22nd event under the Slammiversary chronology, and will celebrate the promotion's 24th anniversary.

metas.name: No Shit, Sherlock!
metas.description: A murder has been committed and a detective is on the case... one of them, at least.

metas.name: Deserto Branco
metas.description: Today is Saturday, all my friends are dead: The film follows Digitaria on tour through South America.

metas.name: Dummy
metas.description: Set in 2004, when pop-punk dominated the music charts, Dummy follows Divya, a strait-laced young Indian girl trying to find her place among pale-faced punks of this subculture.

metas.name: AEW x NJPW x CMLL x Stardom Present Forbidden Door 2026
metas.description: The 2026 Forbidden Door was a professional wrestling pay-per-view (PPV) event and supershow co-produced by the American promotion All Elite Wrestling (AEW), Mexican promotion Consejo Mundial de Lucha Libre (CMLL) and the Japanese promotions New Japan Pro-Wrestling (NJPW) and World Wonder Ring Stardom (Stardom). It was the fifth annual Forbidden Door event and took place on June 28, 2026 at SAP Center at San Jose in San Jose, California, USA.

metas.name: Matchmaker
metas.description: A woman desperately searching for love goes on a date with her AI device.

metas.name: Hell
metas.description: A place where dreams are real, wishes come true, and everything is always awful for everyone.

metas.name: The Worm Charmers
metas.description: In a rural English village, a group of enthusiasts take part in the annual worm-charming championships in a desperate attempt for local immortality.

metas.name: Riff Raff!
metas.description: A grimly fiendish Sunday league manager engages in an argument over the worth of winning and losing with the league's weary referee, all whilst the manager's squad of droogs set out to sabotage that morning's match.

metas.name: Souvenir
metas.description: A chance encounter between old friends Kevin and Dani leads to an unexpected day-long adventure through New York City as they attempt to return a stranger’s lost wallet, forcing them to confront unresolved feelings and life-changing decisions.

metas.name: The Burger Joint
metas.description: The Burger Joint is a mockumentary, sitcom, comedy that follows a television network that sends a crew down to Stephenville Newfoundland to capture footage of a local restaurant chain called Benji's Burgers, the burger joint that sells everything but actual burgers.

metas.name: Dyslexia
metas.description: Maggie March is a 10-year-old girl who is being forced to move to a new place and start a new school by her mother. At Maggie's last school she was harshly bullied for her struggles with reading and writing. She feels that things will never get better and the new school will be even worse than her last one. As Maggie starts her new school, her greatest fear comes true. She continues to struggle with reading and writing, and the other children make fun of her, proving to her that nothing will ever get better. The school's guidance counsellor requests to meet with her. He discusses her past with bullying and her struggles and acknowledges her talent with art and encourages her to pursue her passions. The counsellor conducts some tests with Maggie to help understand why she struggles.

metas.name: Pallbearers
metas.description: An experimental personal documentary that follows the literal and emotional journey of the director and their best friend Phoebe Ferguson as they travel to see her mother’s grave for the first time in her life. Traveling by plane, car, and train from Portland, Oregon to Dublin, Texas, the film follows their ten day journey to reunite mother and daughter.

metas.name: Finding Honk
metas.description: When a local singing legend is diagnosed with a terminal illness, his son must find an estranged family member so they can make peace before time runs out.

metas.name: Eine Reise durch Atlantic City
metas.description: 16mm, silent.

metas.name: Reclaim It.
metas.description: A prominent weather presenter's career and personal life is suddenly threatened by a malicious workplace smear campaign during the month of Ramadan.

metas.name: Hunter's Moon
metas.description: Mountaineers Christina Lusti and Gee Pierrel are the first to summit and ski Mt. Cook, NZ in which they called their run, "Hunter's Moon."

metas.name: How Do You Remember The Matrix?
metas.description: In the year 2073, where all copies of films have been lost in a sea of AI-generated replicas, two detectives seek out the original copy of 'The Matrix'.

metas.name: QUACK
metas.description: This short film tells an absurd story: an anteater actually works as a "teapot doctor". Relying on its superficial and limited knowledge, it "treats" all kinds of teapots that come to it for help.Eventually consumed by one's own greed.

metas.name: Bambi Meets Godzilla: A New Legacy
metas.description: A 2026 2D animated homage to Marv Newland’s iconic 1969 cult classic. This modern take faithfully reimagines the beloved, absurd crossover while delivering an unexpected, modernized twist at the end

metas.name: Unseen
metas.description: George, a withdrawn young artist who expresses his emotions through his art, struggles to connect with his blind mother until a sudden medical crisis forces him to confront the love and grief he's kept hidden for years.

metas.name: I'm the Main Character
metas.description: When everyone thinks they're the main character, is anyone? It depends who you ask, and how compelling their theme song is.

metas.name: Unbreakable Me - The Gabrielle Daleman Story
metas.description: This inspiring documentary follows Gabrielle Daleman, two-time Canadian champion and 2018 Olympic gold medalist, as she battles injuries, illness, bullying, and mental health struggles. Beyond the medals and spotlight, she faces adversity with courage and grit, rising again and again to prove that her greatest strength isn't just on the ice - it's in her unbreakable spirit.

metas.name: conscious
metas.description: After a near fatal car accident, a teenage boy is given an experimental medicine which forces him to say the things he's afraid to say.

metas.name: Phenomena
metas.description: In a world that welcomes mysterious lights in their skies with caution and awe, two friends navigate their changing relationship.

metas.name: Eternity and a Day
metas.description: Kherson — a city scarred by occupation and liberation — continues to live under daily attacks, just a river away from the front lines. Eternity and a Day is an intimate portrait of artists who choose to stay and keep their theater alive. When filming began in the summer of 2023, the theater's windows were still intact. By the end, missile attacks had destroyed them all. The stage, however, remained lit.

metas.name: Croatia, Wonderful
metas.description: A girl and her mother made a short film about their trip to Croatia, Bosnia and Herzegovina.

metas.name: Classic 100 Concert 2026
metas.description: Hosted by Megan Burslem and Jeremy Fernandez, the ABC Classic 100 Concert 2026 will see Melbourne Symphony Orchestra perform with Principal Guest Conductor Benjamin Northey in a spectacular celebration of Australia's favourite classical music, as voted by audiences in the ABC Classic 100: Greatest Of All Time.

metas.name: The Gods (الالهة)
metas.description: Following their father’s death, Adel and Moïse are coming to terms with their grief, but their obsession with their loss is putting their bond at risk.

metas.name: Natural Selection
metas.description: A father, his son and a billionaire find themselves face to face with the relentless fury of nature.

metas.name: Vacation
metas.description: Whilst their parents are going through a divorce, two sisters discover a reality quite different from what they had imagined.

metas.name: Evil Way Out
metas.description: A recently freed man comes to deciding choices regarding doing evil or nothing.

metas.name: Single Black Tenant
metas.description: Esme finally believes her luck has turned after landing an affordable apartment in a quiet neighborhood. But her relief quickly gives way to fear when she begins to suspect she's living with a killer who is trying to frame her for murder.

metas.name: Threading The American Dream
metas.description: A Nepali immigrant entrepreneur's fight to change Mississippi State Law.

metas.name: Perfectly Seasoned
metas.description: Bikram, a longtime chef and confirmed bachelor, runs his restaurant with heart and discipline. But when his niece and two meddling Aunties host a speed-dating night there, his world is thrown into comedic chaos— blending family pressure, unexpected romance, and the perfect dash of second chances.

metas.name: Have A Good One
metas.description: Misha lives up to the expectations of her parents in India while hiding the challenging reality of her life as an immigrant.

metas.name: The Passage
metas.description: In a world suspended between dream and death, a girl wanders aimlessly as reality slowly fades away.

metas.name: For the Cure
metas.description: On the day of his father’s funeral, a man loses the ability to speak. His mother tries to help him recover.

metas.name: Una, who are you?
metas.description: Back at the River Una, a woman confronts her childhood memories and questions her place between nature and memory.

metas.name: I did not say a word.
metas.description: Following an incident of racism, a film director discusses his beliefs with his brother, exploring themes of memory, identity and hope.

metas.name: New Trees
metas.description: An exploration of commercial trees.

metas.name: WWE Night of Champions 2026
metas.description: The 2026 Night of Champions, also promoted as Night of Champions: Riyadh, was a professional wrestling premium live event produced by World Wrestling Entertainment (WWE) that took place on June 27, 2026, at Kingdom Arena in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The event featured the finals of the 2026 King and Queen of the Ring tournaments, along with championship matches for the WWE United States Championship and WWE Women's United States Championship. It was headlined by an Undisputed WWE Championship Triple Threat match between champion Cody Rhodes, Sami Zayn, and Gunther.

metas.name: Crystal Blue
metas.description: An assassin becomes entangled with a relaxed crime boss and a paranoid drug runner.

metas.name: The Impossible Dream
metas.description: The Impossible Dream follows the stories of American citizens from around the nation, approaching the 250th anniversary of America. They explore what it means to be American while overcoming their unique challenges, acting out of the responsibility that they can - and must - follow the American Dream to build a future for coming generations. From ranchers to coffee shop owners, they show that the hope and beliefs that built this nation are still alive today. In this land of opportunity, through hard work and God's help, nothing is impossible.

metas.name: In Their Hands
metas.description: Unable to return to Colombia, Francisco Godoy searches for belonging in the Netherlands. Alongside fellow newcomers Liu and Aleksandr, he rebuilds his life through friendship and the puppet theatre he once left behind.

metas.name: A Decent Citizen
metas.description: A secret agent working for the regime faces a test that calls her convictions and loyalty into question.

metas.name: Deuce Purgatory
metas.description: When the players of a mixed doubles tennis match get stuck at 40-40 for seemingly an eternity, underdog Shelly Shlop realizes that to win the match, she must find her self-worth.

metas.name: Ganibarra
metas.description: What happens when we lose a species that is family? Ganibarra is a deeply personal journey into the cultural connection between first nations people and dingoes.

metas.name: Jia
metas.description: In the haze of a California summer, two best friends must reckon with their feelings for one another.

metas.name: Beneath the Blue Ice
metas.description: Tasha, a college student, finds herself caught between Layson, a devoted hockey player who loves her, and Aaron, who is only using her. As loyalties are tested on and off the ice, she has to decide who truly has her heart.

metas.name: I Am a DVD Player
metas.description: A love story between a fisherman and a DVD player.

metas.name: Served Cold
metas.description: When the sacred code between two hitmen best friends is broken, revenge is the only option. Clyde tracks down his former colleague Mal – but his assassination attempt will be harder to execute than he first thought.

metas.name: Secondhand Spells
metas.description: After successfully casting a spell from a thrift-store grimoire, Alex and Riley realise they may have gotten more than they bargained for.

metas.name: With Sympathy
metas.description: A grieving woman is bombarded with well-meaning advice she never asked for.

metas.name: The Velvet Viscera
metas.description: A Magician performs for her freaks in the circus when she looses control and finds something is living inside her. At an attempt to keep this creature away she comes face to face with her child only to end up in another womb.

metas.name: WILF - Hope & Hardship
metas.description: In WW1 Germany, Australian citizens are pronounced 'Enemy Aliens', and their lives and whereabouts are controlled by the authorities. Wilf is taken from his University and placed on a rural farm, and then later imprisoned along with other foreigners as the war rages on across Europe.

metas.name: Spring Child
metas.description: In 1912 Australia, two girls hide a forbidden bond from their nature-worshipping cult, but when their secret is exposed, the fearsome Shepherd blames them for the land’s failing harvest.

metas.name: Transience
metas.description: Two homeless companions discover a magical hourglass with the power to rewind time… but only for ten seconds. They soon realise that this could be an opportunity to drastically change their situation. However, their plan requires two people, and neither one fully trusts the other.

metas.name: Naked
metas.description: “Naked” is a raw, intimate split-screen drama set inside a grand hotel. On a weekend away, young couple Nora and Simon are caught in the intoxicating rush of a new relationship. But when Simon accuses Nora of saying the wrong name in bed, a brief but crucial window opens: a chance for both of them to be honest. Physically close yet emotionally miles apart, each side of the screen follows their inner narrative as a quiet countdown begins.

metas.name: Blue Sands
metas.description: In a neon-drenched dystopia where lifespans are traded like currency, a dying man drags himself through the night in search of a second chance he may not deserve.

metas.name: Poachers
metas.description: A story of a babysitter, trying to bang a smoke show cougar. JUST LIKE ALL OF US. He gets deep into detective work to find the cougars missing baby.

metas.name: Vertical Remains
metas.description: Time ascends as history sinks. Thirty-two upward-tilting shots, across British Columbia’s Lower Mainland, excavate histories of Indigenous presence, colonial violence, and ecological transformation. As image fades from colour to monochrome and sound descends against the camera’s rise, chronology collapses. Archival images, composite landscapes, and a descending sonic register unsettle linear narration, reframing the present as accumulated residue, and the land emerges as an unresolved stratigraphic archive, where history persists vertically beneath contemporary space.

metas.name: The Kalgan Horse
metas.description: In the borderlands of farming and herding in northern China, a Mongolian horse awaits the fate of castration, while a 10-year-old boy, determined to protect it, must confront violence and cruelty beyond his understanding.

metas.name: The Price of Mari Anne
metas.description: When a college student suddenly drops dead on a walk home from the bar, three young men must decide between reporting the body or fleeing the scene. Their choices quickly unravel undesirable consequences.

metas.name: The Rhino
metas.description: The day before their wedding, she told him she didn’t want children and may never will. The Rhino follows their marriage 11 years later, exploring how this conflict shapes their relationship. Through reenacted memories and lived moments, the film observes how love, grief, and tenderness coexist alongside an irreconcilable difference.

metas.name: The Goose That Laid the Golden Egg
metas.description: When a psychiatrist discovers that a medication for the treatment of acne is causing teenagers to kill themselves, the pharmaceutical company sets out on a campaign to destroy the source of the threat to their billion-dollar-a-year drug.

metas.name: A Castle of Our Own
metas.description: When an overworked architect takes an unexpected summer trip, a sandcastle contest and a contractor help her reconnect with her daughter, rediscover joy, and find love she never saw coming.

metas.name: Mither
metas.description: During the evacuation of her island home, Rebecca McKay refuses to leave due to her belief that her missing son may still be alive. Despite the insistence of her husband Calum, to abandon hope, Rebecca goes to extremes to find an answer.

metas.name: Hamilton House
metas.description: A home of struggling actors will stop at nothing to create a haunted house to catch the eye of their new neighbor, a legendary horror filmmaker.

metas.name: Laws Of Desire
metas.description: Angel is a young woman on the brink of a nervous breakdown. Feeling as if she has no control left in her life, she commits wholeheartedly to a series of spontaneous and erratic decisions. The result is an emotional metamorphosis with large scale consequences.

metas.name: Lysistrata
metas.description: Lysistrata and the women of Athens and Sparta take a radical decision to bring an end to the war between their cities, as they go on a sex strike.

metas.name: Hold It Together
metas.description: On her weekly trips to the swimming pool, Neema, a young immigrant to Iceland, stads out so much that she melts into a puddle. As she strives to stay solid, she realises that she is not the only one struggling with loneliness and grief.

metas.name: Spiritual Enrichment and Relaxation Tape Part II
metas.description: A tape tries to communicate a calming message.

metas.name: Beneath the Ashes: The Past Reimagined
metas.description: For generations, Altadena stood as a beacon of hope. While neighboring Pasadena enforced redlining policies that kept Black families from owning homes, Altadena welcomed them with open arms. Here, African American families could finally put down roots, build equity, and pass something meaningful to the next generation. That legacy-decades in the making-now hangs in the balance. Beneath the Ashes shares the voices of those who lived it: homeowners who lost everything, renters searching for stability, business owners rebuilding from scratch, and community leaders fighting to preserve what took generations to create. Through intimate conversations and powerful storytelling, the film reveals both the pain of loss and an inspiring vision for what comes next.

metas.name: The Bus To Bagbazar
metas.description: A man's ideals are tested when he falls in love with a woman out of his league.

metas.name: American Flake
metas.description: A small-town drug dealer avoids grieving the death of his mom by searching for a lost bag of his favorite potato chips.

metas.name: Fox & the Tiny Demon
metas.description: Qaqsoss naka Wahantuhsis is an animated allegory about Qaqsoss, a fox who is haunted by Wahantuhsis, a tiny demon. Set in an enchanted forest, the film explores themes of mental illness, trauma, and generational pain through Qaqsoss' struggles with both her inner demons and the mischievous demon that follows her. As Qaqsoss faces her fears, she discovers resilience and growth. Ultimately, the story intertwines Indigenous culture and personal experience, showcasing the importance of self-healing and the understanding of others. The film, told in Wolastoqey, is a poignant exploration of survival and connection.

metas.name: Have You Seen My Gods?
metas.description: Amitabh sets out to locate the stolen gods of Kathmandu fulfilling his grandmother’s final wish.

metas.name: Mind Games
metas.description: An unsettled therapist individually counsels both members of a troubled couple, becoming dangerously entangled in their relationship, to the point of her complete family uprooting.

metas.name: Stan Lee: The Final Chapter
metas.description: An insider look at Stan Lee's tumultuous final years, revealing how mistreatment and conflict threatened his life and legacy.

metas.name: SYNC
metas.description: In the near future, a grieving man turns to groundbreaking technology to reunite with an AI generated version of his deceased fiancé, but as he delves deeper into their virtual encounters, he notices something is off with her programming.

metas.name: mud ritual
metas.description: In the summer of 2024, filmmaker and artist Janne Elens retreats to rural Sweden, where she stays on a permaculture farm that, years prior, had served as a sanctuary after she had escaped a dangerous situation. After years of trauma processing, she now decides to close this chapter of humiliation and suffering, on the land that had carried her so dearly while the residue of this traumatic event lingered on her body. This mud ritual arose from a spontaneous urge to give herself deep cleansing, and in doing so, return all the filth and the dirt inflicted upon her back to the Earth.

metas.name: Girl From Nepal
metas.description: A girl from Nepal, Hema, comes to Kyrgyzstan and finds Kairat to give him a letter from her mother Uma. From the letter we learn that they met 40 years ago when Kairat mistook Uma for the Indian actress Hema Malini.

metas.name: The Woman with Three Husbands
metas.description: Concerned her impressionable brother has joined an isolated polyamorous family, Natalie investigates her new 'in-laws'. The strange death of one of Marcus's fellow 'brother husbands' leads Natalie to realize her brother is living with a killer

metas.name: Train Window Visions
metas.description: A daily commute on the Chicago Brown Line transformed into a dissociative stream of flickering, ephemeral images.

metas.name: O Block: The Movie
metas.description: An action packed and dramatic film covering the tragedy of O block and the deadly corruption ruled by Lil' Curtis

metas.name: Dreams of a Coward Man
metas.description: Sidney, a student, and Nelly, a prostitute, meet at her apartment outside the context of her work. Both are insecure about what is to ensue, as it is Sidney's first time being with a woman, and Nelly's first time in years with a non-client. Their attempts to hide their insecurity fail as the evening moves forward. Will they manage to save the mess?

metas.name: Going Out for a Cigarette
metas.description: A man goes out for a cigarette

metas.name: Space Coast Confidential
metas.description: A veteran detective is paired with a transplant detective from Massachusetts to investigate strange occurrences in Cocoa Beach.

metas.name: Portal
metas.description: Two friends loaded their bikes with camping gear, some cameras and a portable music set-up, and headed up into the wild Highlands of Scotland for 10 days in search of some of the most remote locations in the UK to compose music - up mountains, into caves, past crystal blue lochs and into make shift studio spaces in remote 'bothies'

metas.name: Choosing Violence: The Skin Graph & Gnarl Weekend Tour
metas.description: Skin Graph is a powerviolence band currently split between Tupelo and Starkville while Gnarl is a project from Starkville that can only be described as a violent form of drone metal, and in January of 2026, two bands set out on a short weekend tour through the scenes of deepest of the deep south.

metas.name: A Little R&R
metas.description: Five career criminals with cryptic pasts are forced into a deadly game of Russian roulette where only one will survive, and nothing is as it seems.

metas.name: Nina Eba @ Europavox Sessions 2026
metas.description: Up-and-coming Ukrainian artist Nina Eba creates a unique sound at the crossroads of pop art and electronic music. Blending bass music, hyperpop and club influences, her solo project reflects a creative journey shaped by DJing and experimental sound exploration.

metas.name: Jason Isbell and the 400 Unit: Live at Radio City Music Hall
metas.description: Relive Jason Isbell and the 400 Unit’s February 2026 performance at the iconic Radio City Music Hall in NYC.

metas.name: Cinnamon Girl
metas.description: Two friends film an audition tape for the new season of Love Island.

metas.name: Marillion - Thank God for the Internet
A Broken Man
metas.description: A man vents about his unraveling life to his best friend, unaware that the truth of their conversation extends far beyond his own perspective.

metas.name: A Case Full Of Dreams
metas.description: This Multi international award winning film is about a young man trapped in the routine of working life begins to question the path laid out in front of him. As reality starts to blur with dreamlike visions of freedom, he is forced to confront the dreams he left behind and the person he used to be. A surreal short film about routine, lost ambition, and the search for meaning.

metas.name: Gaslit 2: How Factory Farming Broke the Chicken
metas.description: A look at the conditions of chicken in megafarms in the United Kingdom.

metas.name: Sideweighs and Backwords
metas.description: Using a monoprint printmaking technique to recreate archival footage, Sideweighs and Backwords forefronts the imperfect action of memory. In opposition to the immaculate reproduction of traditional print and digital media, human memory is exposed as a verb – a constant recreation of a sequence of events, a story we tell ourselves. The story told here is a movement between homeland and a new home, a constant traversing of terrain and terms.

metas.name: Outer Heavens
metas.description: In a secluded part of Ireland, untouched by time, a group of older neighbours live quietly in the past. When a young woman arrives asking for their help, she disrupts their world and forces them to face what they have long avoided.

metas.name: A Suited Man
metas.description: Short film about a man who is wearing a suit.

metas.name: Hot Girl Summer
metas.description: Four besties graduating high school and heading into the perfect summer discover that growing up means life doesn’t always go according to plan.

metas.name: Worry Bird
metas.description: A friend comes over after a breakup, but things are not as they seem.

metas.name: I'm Just Like You (And It Sucks)
metas.description: In Edy Modica’s debut comedy special, she discusses her longing for human connection and all of the ways she’s contorted herself in search of it.

metas.name: Living Waters
metas.description: On a drifting sheet of Arctic ice, a woman comes face to face with the loneliness and uncertainty of a world that is slowly melting away.

metas.name: Mama
metas.description: Lulú, a 7-year-old girl, encourages her mother, who has recently had breast surgery, to regain the confidence to go out again.

metas.name: Pipo
metas.description: Lucas, a 7 year old boy, embarks on a final treasure hunting adventure with his imaginary friend, a journey that leads him to reaffirm his calling.

metas.name: Visitors of the Unknown
metas.description: When an experimental NASA probe crash-lands in their backyard, two siblings find themselves at the center of an extraordinary encounter with the unknown.

metas.name: How to Live on Earth
metas.description: A visionary feature documentary that explores our vital connection to nature and its role in our future. Presented by Benedict Cumberbatch, this ultimate 'how-to guide' features inspirational, cutting-edge stories and powerful cinematography from around the world to reveal how humans are learning to team up with nature to solve our biggest challenges.

metas.name: Memory
metas.description: A memory seen through opening fingers up close to an eye.

metas.name: The Diner
metas.description: After taking her supposed last customer, two men in suits come into the diner. All they ask for is one burger; however, for some reason, Samantha feels uneasy around these two men. But why?

metas.name: There's a Dark Corner in My Room
metas.description: A young woman deals with a traumatic event and a sinister corner in her bedroom.

metas.name: MACARONS
metas.description: Crime-Comedy Short Film

metas.name: FunBoy
metas.description: A teen with a guilty conscience films his family vacation, but after finding a hidden gun during a game of hide-and-seek, paranoia begins to take hold.

metas.name: The Myth of Sissypants
metas.description: An updated version of the Greek story of Sisyphus told through narrative video with live score by the artist himself.

metas.name: The Inevitable Destruction of the World by Natural Occurrence
metas.description: An experimental narrative video about a naive wayfarer encountering different paranormal phenomena embedded in the natural landscape, all while a meteor descends fatally closer to the surface of the Earth.

metas.name: Pickles
metas.description: A man struggles to open a pickle jar

metas.name: Peppa the Great
metas.description: A hustling entertainer puts her past behind her and will do anything to make it in New York City.

metas.name: The Reality Experiment
metas.description: Eight strangers gather for an unknown experiment at the University for a quick payday. However, things rapidly get out of control as reality itself begins to turn on them.

metas.name: Brian; or, Brain
metas.description: Brian has learned something very interesting about the world.

metas.name: The Letter
metas.description: A young postwoman tries to rebuild her relationship with her father, coming to terms with the pain of abandonment, the weight of the past and new bonds.

metas.name: Paul Simon: The Quiet Celebration Concert
metas.description: Follows Paul Simon performing his GRAMMY-nominated "Seven Psalms" live for the first time, featuring new arrangements of classics and deep cuts. Recorded at McCaw Hall in Seattle.

metas.name: Loose ends
metas.description: Danny and Mike, two gang members sent to kill a rat, find their mission thrown into disarray when Danny gets second thoughts moments before the hit.

metas.name: Wendy
metas.description: What if Neverland was all in Wendy's imagination? She gazes at the birds flying and wishes she could too. She meets and makes fast friends with a mysterious boy who shares her affinity for adventure. A stick becomes a sword, a sheet becomes a sail, and a cynical old farmer with a hooked cane becomes a pirate.

metas.name: Eyes I
metas.description: A set of eyes of several women.

metas.name: High Voltage
metas.description: Over the course of a single night in the Far Rockaways, two teenage girls drift toward an intimacy that neither can fully name, blurring the line between friendship and desire.

metas.name: Fennel
metas.description: During a tense lunch, a father and son struggle to connect. Fennel is a quiet, intimate look at the emotional distance between parent and child and the words left unsaid.

metas.name: The Saturn Code
metas.description: When a kid is assigned a conspiracy theory project, he goes in too deep to a conspiracy about Saturn, forever changing his life.

metas.name: Madonna + Graham
metas.description: Graham Norton sits down with the 'Queen of Pop', singer-songwriter, record producer, actress, entrepreneur, charity founder and LGBT rights and gender equality activist Madonna. The pair discuss her lengthy career in which she has achieved 18 multi-platinum albums globally, seven Grammy Awards, two Golden Globe Awards, twenty MTV Video Music Awards and an induction to the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame.

metas.name: Four Paintings by Edward Povey: Edward's Look
metas.description: One shot as Edward Povey takes in the exhibition and reflects on what's come up and where he is, right then, in his creative journey

metas.name: GENDER NEUTRAL BATHROOM
metas.description: After getting harassed in the public toilets, two trans friends fight back.  Or: a short film about pissing on transphobes.

metas.name: Dave vs. Hollywood
metas.description: Dave is an actor who moves to Los Angeles, completely devoid of connections and contacts. The humiliations and indignities soon pile up. After a fruitless struggle, Dave decides to make his mark by taking a non-traditional, unorthodox, 'anything goes' approach — he joins AA for connections; joins Scientology to network; considers donating a kidney to an aging movie star in exchange for a role in said aging star’s film; leaves his headshot and reel on the windshields of vehicles outside the Brentwood church where a funeral for a studio executive is taking place, etc.

metas.name: The Chair
metas.description: A short animated film exploring the complex relationship between a little girl, Piku, and her grandfather’s old vintage armchair.

metas.name: A Stab At Heaven
metas.description: A true story of an 18-year-old Ema McKie who, after receiving news that her fiancé has committed suicide, drives across the country to join him in death, losing her mind to find her truth and journey home.

metas.name: S·G·N·A·L
metas.description: A young PlayView channel owner, dedicated to preserving and digitizing archived television footage across the United States, discovers a mysterious DVD containing recordings of a signal hijacking incident from 2007. The broadcast, once belonging to a Mexican television channel that aired in California, reveals a disruption that was never officially explained.

metas.name: Aimless Monologue Before The Credits...
metas.description: A young man reflects on the past moments of his life just before everything changes forever.

metas.name: Eclogues
metas.description: Landscapes are permeable, impermanent. They are hallucinations of literature, manifestations of human manipulation. Like the pixel, they are degraded, rearranged, forgotten. “Eclogues” is an expression of landscape in the purest principles of digital image-making: duration, practicality, limitation. Shot in 2020 in Strafford, Vermont.

metas.name: Watched
metas.description: After her boyfriend Logan begins acting suspicious, Rachel becomes aware that her reality is hiding something a little more sinister.

metas.name: My Bed is a Prison
metas.description: "My bed is a prison" is an autobiographical documentary about my agoraphobia and mental illness, seen through the lens of a CCTV camera that constantly filmed my bed between October and December 2024.

metas.name: Rod Quantock Comedy Warrior
metas.description: This feature documentary charts Rod Quantock’s five-decade career and his tireless efforts to communicate the perils of neoliberalism and the urgency of climate change through humour. His journey illustrates the building of the thriving comedy landscape we take for granted today, showcasing a man who has remained steadfast in his pursuit of truth in an hilarious fashion.

metas.name: The Perfect Shot
metas.description: A hit man and photographer meet in a bar and discover they're both in town to shoot the president.

metas.name: Before I Do
metas.description: A lakeside bachelor party weekend devolves into chaos when the groom and his best man’s past romantic feelings reignite, entangling the wedding party in the pre-wedding drama.

metas.name: Satisfaction Guaranteed
metas.description: Marcus, a customer service agent whose job is to help anyone with anything with the aid of Assist-O, a hyper-efficient AI assistant. When the tasks become increasingly bizarre and Assist-O starts taking things too far, Marcus struggles to maintain control, revealing the chaos and absurdity lurking behind the promise of perfect service.

metas.name: Landship
metas.description: The Battle of Passchendaele, 1917. For three years the great war has been waging, and the two armies find themselves entrenched along the four-hundred-mile Western Front. At the start of a pivotal allied offensive to break the stalemate, the nine-man crew of a British MKIV Tank set out to destroy a series of heavily defended German bunkers.

metas.name: Lucky Strike
metas.description: A wounded American soldier fights to survive behind enemy lines during WWII's Battle of the Bulge against the Germans, relying on his instinct, spy craft and a hand-radio to evade capture and find his way back to his unit.

metas.name: Simply Red: Holding Back The Years: 40 Years Of Simply Red, Live In Santiago
metas.description: Live album and concert film by British pop and soul band Simply Red. Released on June 26, 2026, it captures the band's five sold-out performances at the Movistar Arena in Santiago, Chile, where they played to over 75,000 fans.

metas.name: Red Flag
metas.description: A newly-single woman, just out of a dysfunctional relationship, is introduced to the concept of red flags, but takes it a bit too literally as she heads back into dating.

metas.name: Cherry B
metas.description: It’s 1969, a housewives soiree, drinking cocktails whilst summoning up an old dead friend. When a spiritual message prompts adolescent Lilith to respond, it alerts us to the demon that lies within.

metas.name: Not Even the Sun
metas.description: Not Even The Sun is an intimate portrait of a young woman experiencing the end of a relationship in a foreign land. Told from the perspective of the female protagonist (Deragh Campbell), the precarious living situation of a young Canadian woman and the growing tension between her and her boyfriend (Santiago Blanco Choya) finally reach a breaking point in rural Spain.

metas.name: Wounded Light
metas.description: Claire is in an emotional and creative pause, until she finds her old projector and, with it, a way to reconnect with her childhood self.

metas.name: RokuGatsu
metas.description: 晴れた日を待ち望む中で、  若い女性は雨の多い春の美しさに気づく。  While longing for a sunny day, a woman learns to appreciate the beauty of a rainy spring.

metas.name: The Get Out
metas.description: A nightclub owner is on the verge of leaving his dangerous past behind for retirement with his girlfriend. When masked gunmen rob him and he finds himself squeezed by ruthless cartels, a mysterious newcomer arrives with an interest in buying the business. With danger closing in from all sides, he must navigate a deadly web of deception, power, and survival  -  where escape may no longer be an option.

metas.name: Soliga Hälsningar
metas.description: A documentary following Lena Emmertz, a retired woman living in Malmö, Sweden.

metas.name: Between Calls
metas.description: Lio, a young man in his twenties, lives a hectic life in the business world In a quiet moment, Lio lets go of his urgency and discovers that sometimes a simple pause can hold more value than the next urgent call.

metas.name: IMPACT x Nightline: The Girl in the Trunk
metas.description: A 14-year-old girl and the rising music star D4vd are involved in a mysterious disappearance turned gruesome murder. David Anthony Burke, known as D4vd, got his start as a gamer and was on the verge of stardom. New details have emerged from text messages, photos and DNA that authorities say destroyed two lives.

metas.name: X-MEN but better and more accurate
metas.description: Aunty Donna have beaten Marvel and Disney to the punch by adapting the entire X-Men Dark Phoenix Saga in only one day and with only a sliver of the budget. Hollywood has nothing on these boys.

metas.name: Umuganda
metas.description: Communities in Rwanda have come together every last Saturday of month since the 11th century to build, clean, and plant.

metas.name: Yθyo only sleêps when riφe, But ηoT Alwayz
metas.description: A collision of bizarre characters, senseless situations and countless styles (like eight) that is bound to leave you speechless. Join our lucky audience, giving praises in the likes of "I don't get it.", "This should win the grand prize!" and "Huh?".

metas.name: The Perfect Family
metas.description: The Perfect Family follows 12-year-old Margot as she navigates life in a damaged household. Her parents, Mia and Jack, mask their failing marriage with moments of forced normalcy, but Margot is constantly affected by the arguments and resentment between her parents.

metas.name: SEED 0
metas.description: In an era when physical space has been thoroughly explored, virtual spaces harken back to the romance of the colonial frontier  -Jules Skotnes-Brown, Video Games and the Global South

metas.name: For Your Future Wife
metas.description: After leaving an aggressive voicemail post-breakup, a young man moves on to find the beauty in a new relationship while his ex-girlfriend struggles to find a new path after his abuse.

metas.name: The puppet effect
metas.description: Rosenberg is a shy man who speaks only through a hand puppet. But when he tries to fulfill a childhood dream in a cynical theater, he discovers his true voice.

metas.name: Silent Retreat
metas.description: Two men arrive at a silent Buddhist meditation retreat expecting stillness. In the quiet, they begin to reveal who they really are.

metas.name: When I Was Older
metas.description: Haunted by a drawing she made as a child, a young mother is pulled back toward the sea — and the self she left behind.

metas.name: FarEye
metas.description: Fleeing the chaos of home, a young Jamaican boy finds refuge within a community guided by music, spirit and faith, awakening something deep within that will change the course of his life forever.

metas.name: Alaska
metas.description: Seraphim journeys to Alaska, the most beautiful place in this child's mind's eye.

metas.name: White Italian Truffles in Brine
metas.description: When her old friend Leslie comes to Los Angeles on a work trip, Camille attempts to reconnect with her by making her a home-cooked meal.

metas.name: Sore Loser
metas.description: Two men face off in a neverending rock-paper-scissors competition, with one side failing to take his constant losses well. Fortunately, he has the perfect comeback plan.

metas.name: Voices
metas.description: Three mothers share harrowing experiences of coercive control, exposing warning signs, abusers' tactics, and harsh reality that leaving didn't end the abuse.

metas.name: Tom Cashman: The Formula for Happiness
metas.description: Tom Cashman's third stand up special, which may or may not include the formula for happiness. Toured in 2025 as '2 Truths, 1 Lie and 17 Slight Exaggerations' and filmed at the Brisbane Powerhouse on 31 October 2025.

metas.name: Rik Mayall's Sketches: Rare And Unseen
metas.description: A selection of rarely seen comic moments from the actor and comedian, who rose to fame as Kevin Turvey and as Rick in The Young Ones, a show he helped create. Rik Mayall later achieved more widespread fame in Bottom, and The New Statesman.

metas.name: Rik Mayall: Magnificent B'Stard
metas.description: From early sketches to standout performances, Mayall's fearless comedy bursts with energy and intent, capturing a pivotal moment in British comedy while delivering pure entertainment.

metas.name: Remembering Jimbuli Gording: The Mission for Intercourse: An Introspective: A Review
metas.description: In 2023 AD, visionary director Nye Buckland created the film Jimbuli Gording: The Mission for Intercourse. Three years AD later, the cast and crew of the film have participated in a documentary exposing the truth about the film, shedding light on the tragedies that occurred as well as offering their own thoughts on the cultural impact of the film.

metas.name: Euro Dome Simulator
metas.description: While Virtual Reality promises a whole world, in fact it offers only a view within the strictly defined boundaries of a sphere. Is this also the case for the strictly defined boundaries of the European Union? When crossing the borders of the European Union, one is not allowed to film. This also applies to Google and their Street View cars, resulting in gaps in the available Street View coverage within the area of EU border control posts. The Euro dome is increasingly made more visible and intimidating from the outside: high fences with barbed wire stand tall along the border and armed border patrols pass by on a regular basis. While from inside the dome, one can only see a virtual glimpse of its borders. A faint reflection or a delayed feedback version.

metas.name: Understand?
metas.description: After finding himself in debt, Baxter has been told that if he manages to get a confession for a crime out of someone his debt will be forgiven, however he's shocked to find the person he needs to gain the confession from is his old friend

metas.name: Hippie Hollow
metas.description: Construction worker Uriel’s private escape to a nude beach takes an unexpected turn when he encounters his son Jorge there with his boyfriend.

metas.name: The King of Black Goo
metas.description: A bitter, lonely man undergoes a personality-altering medical procedure in the hope that it will make him worthy of love.

metas.name: Enter
metas.description: Set against the backdrop of school memories and first love, ENTER explores the emotions we carry long after moments have passed. Through silence, longing and nostalgia, a young boy confronts the feelings he never expressed and discovers the courage to begin.

metas.name: Phylum
metas.description: A wordless 16mm experimental short film exploring the human relationship to nature, labor, and the evolution of machinery.

metas.name: The Life and Lens of Colin H. Law
metas.description: Colin Law just wants to be a great artist, so what if his photos aren't any good? Armed with theory, delusion, two eyeballs, and a camera, Colin sets out to prove that "good art" is all about perspective.

metas.name: The Blistering Blundering West
metas.description: A bumbling, lovestruck cowboy stumbles through the western frontier, overcoming a series of comical obstacles in the hopes of making it on time for a date with the potential love of his life.

metas.name: Rescue
metas.description: As the full-scale war in Ukraine forces millions to flee, rescuers move in the opposite direction - toward destroyed villages, active shelling, and mined roads - to save animals left behind when humans are forced to escape.

metas.name: TAEMONG
metas.description: During a pregnancy photoshoot, a woman sells her taemong - a baby conception dream - which contains a dark desire triggered by her past.

metas.name: Corn
metas.description: After getting a promotion, Dennis gets invited to his boss's house for dinner, which turns into a living nightmare when Dennis eats corn the "wrong" way.

metas.name: Million Dollar Man
metas.description: A timid man does something by himself for once.

metas.name: Good Vibes Only
metas.description: A woman desperately wants to cry following a painful breakup. But her AI companion won't let her.

metas.name: Pauline
metas.description: In a bar, Pauline writes to a man she does not know. Between desire, art, and projection, reality eventually begins to crack the story she has invented for herself.

metas.name: Soldier's Bones
metas.description: In 1971 reporter Alec Shimkin discovers a secret US-led military campaign: Operation Speedy Express. This discovery may reveal war crimes on an immense scale. Yet nobody knows about Alec’s scoop, who went missing-in-action in Vietnam himself. In Alec’s footsteps, Soldier’s Bones searches for Speedy’s deadly echo in the Mekong Delta.

metas.name: If You had Stayed
metas.description: After a tragic choice leads him to the brink, a disillusioned artist named Michael awakens on a mysterious beach. a liminal space where lost souls come to confront their pasts. Guided by Bob, a charismatic yet enigmatic caretaker, Michael embarks on a surreal journey through the pivotal moments of his life: love, heartbreak, and devastating loss. As he confronts hidden truths and unspoken regrets, Michael is faced with one profound question: Was it worth it, and what would life be like if he had stayed?

metas.name: Return to Your Dreams
metas.description: Waking up from a dream he can’t seem to forget, Faizan struggles to maintain the newly structured life he’s built for himself, dazed and lost in thought. And as more memories from his past continue to resurface, he soon learns that the nightmarish ones still refuse to let him go.

metas.name: Truly Mine
metas.description: Leila, an 18-year-old girl who is on the brink of adulthood. As the pressure of her family's expectations grows, Leila has to choose between a life laid out for her or freedom, risking everything she loves for a life that's truly hers.

metas.name: Meeting the Buddha
metas.description: Meeting the Buddha presents the life and legacy of the 16th Karmapa, Rangjung Rigpe Dorje—the head of the Karma Kagyu lineage, one of four main schools of Tibetan Buddhism. The film captures the remarkable presence of this spiritual teacher, known as a Living Buddha and the King of the Yogis.  We meet Ole Nydahl, a wild young hippy from Denmark who, as a small child, had declared his wish to become the "Danish champion of mind." His life is radically transformed by a chance encounter with the Karmapa in Nepal in 1969.  Ole and his wife, Hannah, become key figures in bringing Tibetan Buddhism to the West, founding hundreds of meditation centres—from Mexico City to Vladivostok—and carrying forward their teacher's vision with unshakable dedication.

metas.name: Rescued
metas.description: A homeless man finds the motivation to turn his life around after a stray dog saves his life and refuses to leave his side.

metas.name: Death on the Brandywine
metas.description: An aging politician is found dead at his home. The police declare it suicide, but amateur sleuth Professor Millie Park is not convinced. In her investigation, she lays bare a family consumed by sibling rivalry and unchecked ambition.

metas.name: Azart Come Make Art
metas.description: The documentary tells the colourful and cheerful history of Amsterdam's narrator ship Azart, or The Ship of Fools, which sailed around the world for over 30 years bringing music and theatre. At the helm the creator of this sailing work of art: captain and actor August Dirks, who lived and worked on the Azart for over 30 years. Amsterdam's Azartplein is named after the ship.

metas.name: Meet Me at the Club: The Castro Country Club Story
metas.description: On April 1, 1983 at the frightening start of the AIDS epidemic, gay businessman and restaurateur Steve Harris opened the doors to the Castro Country Club as a refuge where folks could gather and find community outside of the bars and clubs in the Castro. For 40 years, the CCC has saved thousands of lives from the grips of addiction and alcoholism from its humble perch on 18th Street, one block from Castro Street. Meet Me at the Club captures the history of early trans experiences, the role that the AIDS epidemic played in addiction and alcoholism, and the miraculous recoveries from hopeless states of mind and body in San Francisco. When 295 people die every day from overdoses, the story of how this beautiful community came together to survive and thrive, there's no more important time than now to tell this story.

metas.name: Eureka Day
metas.description: Eureka Day is a private California elementary school with a Board of Directors that values inclusion above all else—that is, until an outbreak of the mumps forces everyone in the community to reconsider the school’s liberal vaccine policy. As cases rise, the board realizes with horror that they’ve got to do what they swore they never would: make a choice that won’t please absolutely everybody.

metas.description: A complete lore and analysis video about the award-winning game Clair Obscur: Expedition 33.

Royce is a young, successful director trying to come up with a new idea, putting unnecessary pressure on his shoulders to stay in the spotlight and not let His fans, agents, and studio execs down. He falls into his mind, getting lost, and wrestles with his conscience, but still has a hard time coming up with an idea. As his girlfriend is on the rise and taking the spotlight from him, as tonight is her huge movie premiere, he learns that his agent invited the studio execs to the premiere. At the last second, he gets a new idea, but is distracted and ultimately blows up their relationship.

metas.name: Tales from the Crypto

metas.name: A Quiet Bloom
metas.description: Marketing specialist Iris returns to Cebu, dreading confrontations with her overly traditional mother who constantly pressures her about marriage. After a heated argument, she escapes on her motorcycle to the only place still open—a flower café where owner Hyacinth offers her warm tea and unexpected kindness. Iris returns nightly, needing the café's Wi-Fi for work. Hyacinth, whose struggling business could use marketing help, welcomes the arrangement. What begins as mutual convenience transforms into something deeper. Through late-night conversations, motorcycle rides, and shared dreams, they fall in love. But their relationship reveals painful differences. Hyacinth proudly introduces Iris as her girlfriend to her small café family. At Iris' home, Hyacinth is merely a "friend." When Iris' mother arranges a date with a churchmate's son, Iris says nothing-paralyzed by fear and guilt. This makes Hyacinth question whether their level of commitment is the same.

metas.name: Drones
metas.description: When a tech enthusiast subscribes to a groundbreaking Drone Butler service, he’s enamored by the technology’s intuition and uncanny attentiveness to his needs—until it begins to cross disturbing lines. DRONES is a sci-fi thriller that looks at our trust and dependence on tech, and how the ease of convenience can quickly devolve into something more sinister.  ​

metas.name: Camp Oleander

metas.name: Angela Allen: The Woman Who Saw Everything
metas.description: What do such classic films as The Third Man, The African Queen, The Misfits and Labyrinth have in common? Present during the filming of all of them was Angela Allen, acting as “continuity” – noting every shot and memorising all the details before her, working closely with the director, crew and actors to achieve a consistent and convincing world in front of the camera. She is one of the last witnesses to a truly golden age of cinema. Angela – who celebrated her 97th birthday in February 2026 – began her career as a 19-year-old on several British films, and then in 1948 was assigned to the second unit in Vienna for Carol Reed’s The Third Man. She subsequently became a regular aide to three great directors in particular, John Huston (with whom she made 14 films), John Frankenheimer and Franco Zeffirelli, as well as working with such diverse filmmakers as Tony Richardson, Ken Russell, Roman Polanski and Sidney Lumet.

This work aims to consider the true essence of cinema rebuilding our perception of what is really the World and to discover its relation to the Self.

metas.name: The Hole
metas.description: Despite living mere feet from one another, downstairs neighbor SYBIL and upstairs neighbor HUGO have never met. But worlds collide when a hole is cut open between their units to address a plumbing leak. Yearning for connection, Sybil can't resist climbing through the hole to spy on Hugo -- an act that will ultimately lead to broken bones and an unlikely friendship.

metas.name: Palm

metas.name: An Encounter

metas.description: Unsatisfied with her prospects following graduation, struggling artist Eleanor "Nell" Ross reflects on her life with her boyfriend over a game of dominoes.

metas.name: Body of Work
metas.description: The life story of Eric Anfinson, who became a prolific painter in Key West, Florida after a high school football injury in Austin, Minnesota changed the trajectory of his life.

metas.name: Destination Detroit
metas.description: No city tells the 20th-century American story like Detroit. Drawn by the promise of opportunity, families arrived from the South, Appalachia, and across the world to build new lives. Destination Detroit explores this powerful migration story—through community voices, history, and culture—connecting Detroit’s past and present to the larger American journey as the nation approaches America 250.

metas.name: Signed, Sealed & Delivered: Inside the Billion-Dollar World of Sports Collectibles
metas.description: What was once considered a childhood hobby has evolved into a billion-dollar global marketplace. Signed, Sealed & Delivered takes audiences inside the high-stakes world of sports collectibles, where rare trading cards, signed jerseys, and historic memorabilia have become status symbols, emotional investments, and financial assets. Through exclusive access, interviews, and behind-the-scenes footage, the documentary explores the personalities and businesses driving the hobby's modern explosion. Featuring appearances and commentary tied to sports and business icons including Lionel Messi, Kevin O'Leary, and Gary Vaynerchuk, the film uncovers the culture, psychology, risks, and financial opportunities behind the booming collectibles industry — while asking what people are truly chasing when they spend fortunes trying to own a piece of sports history.

metas.name: Choked

Yet she can't get her devoted and loving boyfriend Eddie to meet her needs, so she goes to where all good decisions are made: a hookup app. Just as it seems like Shakona is finally letting go, she has the chance to take power into her own hands.

metas.name: American Boy

After overcoming his anxiety with their encouragement, he finally finds the courage to speak to the person he loves. But on what should be the best night of his life, he is suddenly detained by ICE.

metas.name: In Case You Forget

metas.name: burn, scar
metas.description: Prescribed fire– the practice of setting small burns to clear ecosystems of overgrowth– is a critical tool for climate resiliency and forest restoration. But in 2022, a burn set by the U.S. Forest Service in the mountains of northern New Mexico escaped its firelines and spiraled out of control to become the largest wildfire in the state’s history.

metas.name: Please
metas.description: A dark comedy about humankind’s desire to love and to be loved. Centred around neediness, intimacy and romance.  Told through a series of loosely connected, tender and absurd scenes, the film follows people who are searching for closeness and acceptance. In a world that preaches self-control, the film explores the sides we try to hide, such as feeling needy and pathetic.  The stories overlap and reappear, gradually forming a portrait of collective longing.

metas.name: Scaredy Cat
metas.description: The short follows the adventure of two 11-year-olds, Scaredy Cat, a cute-scared-Vietnamese-cat-monster and his best friend, Ghost Girl, an outgoing-fearless-princess-demon as they attempt find a cooler pair of shoes.

metas.name: THE CAGE WITHIN
metas.description: A true fight isn’t fought in the ring, but inside the mind.  The Cage Within follows Jake, a young fighter struggling with anger, trauma and the weight of expectations, as he tries to break the cycle of violence that shaped him. Between training, silence and fractured relationships, the film observes a man who chooses not to become what hurt him — even when that choice hurts more.  An intimate, restrained drama about masculinity, control and the quiet cost of change.

metas.name: Bloodlust

metas.name: ZsaZsa Zaturnnah vs The Amazonistas of Planet X
metas.description: Ada is a shy gay man living in a small town in the Philippines. After many heartbreaks over many years, he has committed himself to a simple and single life. But when a magical stone from outer space transforms him into a flamboyant female superhero, Ada is forced to face fantastic challenges. From fighting zombies to stopping invading Amazonistas from Planet X, to the even more difficult task of risking his heart to love again.

metas.name: Rogue Trooper
metas.description: Rogue is a "Genetic Infantryman", a genetically-engineered, blue-skinned, manufactured super soldier who, alongside his three comrades, is searching for the Traitor General. His comrades are with him in the form of biochips—onto which a G.I.'s entire personality is downloaded at the time of death for later retrieval—and are named Gunnar (mounted on Rogue's rifle), Bagman (on his backpack) and Helm (on his helmet). Rogue is designed to be immune to almost all known toxins, can submerge in strong acid unaffected, and is able to withstand a vacuum on his bare skin.

metas.name: Nanni Balestrini. Poetry Boy
metas.description: Poetry Boy is a documentary portrait of Nanni Balestrini, poet, novelist, visual artist, and one of the most radical voices in postwar Italian culture. Following his death in 2019, director Nina Di Majo travelled across Italy retracing the people, places, and memories that shaped his life and work, assembling a portrait as layered and uncompromising as Balestrini himself.  Through archival footage, recordings, photographs, and interviews filmed across Rome, Milan, Paris, and Berlin, the film explores the enduring impact of Balestrini’s artistic and political vision, from Gruppo 63 to the social movements of 1969 and 1977, and the way his work continuously challenged the boundaries between literature, art, and activism.  Featuring contributions by Andrea Barzini, Giancarlo De Cataldo, Angelo Guglielmi, Peppe Morra, Gigi Roggero, and Girolamo De Simone.

metas.name: Ravel: Piano Concerto for the Left Hand Anna Vinnitskaya in Strasbourg
metas.description: The Strasbourg Philharmonic Orchestra, conducted by Aziz Shokhakimov invites Anna Vinnitskaya, who won first prize at the Queen Elisabeth Competition in 2007, to perform Maurice Ravel’s Piano Concerto for the Left Hand. Ravel composed this virtuoso jazz-influenced work for pianist Paul Wittgenstein, who had lost his right arm in the First World War. Part of europiano, ARTE's special day celebrating the piano concerto across Europe

metas.name: Rachmaninoff: Piano Concerto No. 2 Hayato Sumino in Wiesbaden
metas.description: Hayato Sumino performs Sergei Rachmaninoff’s Piano Concerto No. 2 in C minor at the Wiesbaden Kurhaus in Germany with the Frankfurt Radio Symphony Orchestra conducted by Alain Altinoglu as part of Europiano.

metas.name: Day of the Everlasting Sun
metas.description: A filmmaker roams around to film the lives of people during the longest day of the year.

metas.name: Mohenjo-daro: Unsealing an Ancient Indus City
metas.description: A documentary exploring the Indus Valley Civilization, which once flourished along the banks of the Indus in what is now Pakistan and India.

metas.name: The Comb
metas.description: England, 1002AD. Mere moments after massacring a host of Vikings, a Saxon tries to justify his blood lust, with chilling consequences.

metas.name: TRNSMT 2026: Skye Newman
metas.description: Skye Newman headlines King Tuts with sass and confidence in her TRNSMT debut.

metas.name: TRNSMT 2026: Perrie
metas.description: Perrie brings her girl power and pop magic to her first solo set at TRNSMT.

metas.name: TRNSMT 2026: CMAT
metas.description: CMAT brings big TRNSMT energy to the main stage on the festival’s final day.

metas.name: TRNSMT 2026: Lewis Capaldi
