metas.description: Lewis Capaldi delivers a powerful emotional headliner set to close this year’s TRNSMT.

metas.name: Heaven is a Witness
metas.description: Abandoned by his wife and facing imminent eviction, a struggling father must navigate the streets with his child, holding onto the hope that their desperate endurance is seen by heaven.  Inspired by Saksi Ng Langit Music Video by December Avenue.

metas.name: Nature of Attraction
metas.description: After a messy house party, two dysfunctional exes attempt to cover up a crime they don't remember. Falling back into old habits, the pair are faced with a long-repressed desire that interrupts their rational thinking when they need it most.

metas.name: BREAKFAST BASTARD
metas.description: Breakfast Bastard's self-titled debut album is an audio-visual concept album that combines original music, original / bootlegged video, and visual iconography to explore themes of cultural identity, generational trauma, civic frustration, and nostalgia. The breakfast roll functions as the project's central visual motif: a symbol of indulgence, convenience, and contemporary Irish identity.  Musically, the album draws from post-punk, lo-fi pop, techno, and instrumental hip-hop. Some of its tracks include a techno composition featuring Michael D. Higgins thanking artists, an ode to the teenage years framed as a love song to piracy, and a look at the present through fictional romances with inanimate objects, bots, and AI companions.

metas.name: The Fall Of (Wo)Man
metas.description: Having/Inhabiting a body makes us prone to the forces of gravity. This film explores the hidden poetry of the fall. No film crew has ever explored this scientific territory. Calling it a documentary itself make film critics fall.

metas.name: Ali Siddiq: My Father
metas.description: Ali Siddiq: My Father delivers a deeply personal, hilarious, and unforgettable comedy experience centered around one of the most iconic characters in his life. Fans of Ali’s storytelling know his real-life stories are raw, vivid, emotional, and laugh-out-loud funny. This time, he dedicates an entire special to the man who helped shape his journey & perspective. Blending masterful storytelling, sharp humor, and heartfelt truth, My Father showcases Ali Siddiq at his most authentic and entertaining. This isn’t just another stand-up special; it’s a cinematic comedy experience filled with family memories, life lessons, and the kind of laughter that stays with you long after the show ends.

metas.name: Jenaka
metas.description: Andra has to carry out his mother's request to take care of his half sister, Jenaka, despite the circumstances that force him to live in his car. However, he faces an internal conflict as Jenaka's innocence slowly breaks down the barriers he built.

metas.name: The Monkey bar
metas.description: Three childhood friends return to their favorite college bar a night before a wedding ,only to discover that the bar remembers them. The stools they sit on unlock personal truths they've buried for years. Guided by the spirits of Gandhi’s three monkeys, they see, hear, and speak the uncomfortable realities they’ve long avoided ,and leave the night changed forever.

metas.name: Celebrity Crime Scene: Marilyn Monroe
metas.description: Marilyn Monroe's death wasn't a suicide ... at least according to investigator Paul Holes, who believes powerful people may have played a role in shaping what really happened to the Hollywood icon.

metas.name: Sacred To The Memory Of
metas.description: Super 8mm portrait of the Flaybrick Hill Cemetery in Birkenhead, England, where some of my ancestors were buried.  Part tribute to those I could never know and part intimate survey of the grounds in which they rest.

metas.name: Housepainter
metas.description: A paroled house painter in Venice Beach's life brutally falls apart over the course of a few bad days.

metas.name: Married Alive
metas.description: Single dad Mack & his soon-to-be-married son Tony may not survive their off-road camping trip when their Jeep overturns, trapping Tony underneath. With a storm coming, Mack has to find help to save his son from drowning.

metas.name: Take Five
metas.description: In a world where time travel has been commercialized, a woman connects with a man from the future who will do anything but give her the answers she’s in search of.

metas.name: Luna
metas.description: With the moon hurtling toward Earth and the world unraveling, one woman's quiet descent into solitude mirrors the chaos above.  As doomsday approaches, Selene-adrift in grief and silence-finds an unexpected connection in the sky's slow collapse. A haunting, poetic journey through memory and meaning, The Award winning Luna is a meditative tale of endings, and the peace we find when we stop running from them.

metas.name: Paradise Lost
metas.description: Three journeys from Belfast to Glasgow uncover how a football club’s disappearance reshaped a community. Through intimate character portraits, the film examines identity, memory, and belonging in the shadow of conflict.

metas.name: Europiano (2/2)  - The finest piano concertos from across Europe
metas.description: In the second part of this magnificent concert celebrating music from across Europe, Lukas Sternath, Martha Argerich, Bruce Liu and Hayato Sumino perform the finest piano concertos by Beethoven, Schumann, Tchaikovsky and Rachmaninoff.

metas.name: Europiano (1/2) - The finest piano concertos from across Europe
metas.description: To mark Music Day, ten European orchestras will perform some of the finest piano concertos alongside prestigious soloists and under the baton of renowned conductors from various cities across the continent. The programme for this exceptional concert features works by Brahms, Grieg, Chopin, Beethoven, Ravel and Mozart.

metas.name: AIRPLANE MODE
metas.description: Katie flies to Paris but gets caught up in her anxieties of air travel - what movie to watch? How is that girl still on TikTok? What if the plane blows up? Sacré bleu!

metas.name: THE LIVE IS ON, BUT NOBODY’S HOME
metas.description: The absurd ways in which we are forced to find comfort in our increasingly alienating and online world are brought to the fore in this essay film on homesickness and livestreams.

metas.name: The Smile Everyone Loved
metas.description: Sometimes it's hard to be someone who everyone loves.

metas.name: Acting Like Women
metas.description: A documentary that explores the explosive rise of feminist performance art in 1970s Los Angeles, where artists connected to the Woman’s Building challenged sexism and redefined art through bold explorations of body, gender, and identity. Directed by artist and filmmaker Cheri Gaulke, who was part of the movement herself, the documentary combines archival footage and artist interviews to capture the creativity, activism, and community that shaped this groundbreaking era. Executive produced by Lily Tomlin alongside her longtime partner Jane Wagner, the film traces the origins and lasting influence of feminist performance art.

metas.name: Lady Macbeth Was Never a Girl
metas.description: A school term, a pair of forgotten joggers, a line from Macbeth - in the ordinary spaces of uniformed days, one student starts to notice a quiet disconnect between who they are and who they're expected to be.

metas.name: Is There Life On Mars?
metas.description: March, 2028. A TV host who rebels against his superiors returns to the village where he spent his childhood with his brother, only to find even greater evil there.

metas.name: Wife Wife
metas.description: After two femme presenting queer women get married on the beach, a group of three cishet men tell them “congratulations.” As the couple thanks the group, the men propose that they have a drink together and that the couple should “go grab their husbands.” Via this stereotypical heteronormative assumption, the wives are transported to a hyper queer affirming world containing queer couples dressed in their wedding best, but before they can join these empowering beautiful humans the wives must defeat their own inner colonial heteronormative insecurities.

metas.name: Woody Guthrie and the Ghost of Tom Joad Today
metas.description: Narrated by Rosanne Cash and featuring music from Bruce Springsteen, this timely film connects the paths of two American icons—songwriter Woody Guthrie (who penned "This Land is Your Land") and novelist John Steinbeck (who wrote "The Grapes of Wrath")—as they forged a bond in a campaign to ease the suffering of migrants in California, and their legacy today.

metas.name: The Waddles
metas.description: A photo plunges Joy into despair. Max convinces her to join him in getting a cosmetic procedure and then hiding away in Palm Springs over the holidays to convalesce. But their friendship changes.

metas.name: Forever Home
metas.description: Benson the three-legged mastiff spends his days content to watch the world pass by until one day a mysterious dog shows up at his doorstep, followed by many more. A story of friendship, loyalty and unconditional love.

metas.name: The Last Light
metas.description: In a world bound by prophecy, the rise of the Dark Lord threatens to plunge everything into eternal darkness. As supernatural forces awaken, three unlikely heroes—Black Hawk, a reluctant warrior tied to a powerful spirit, Kookoo Monkey, a chaotic fighter, and the coward Vesante Elevante—are drawn together as the last hope against an unstoppable fate. But the prophecy is clear: they are destined to fail. Hunted by deadly enemies and facing powers beyond their control, they must fight to survive a war that may already be lost. Blending action, horror, and chaotic humor, The Last Light begins a story where destiny itself is the greatest enemy.

metas.name: SKIN
metas.description: A simple tattoo session becomes a quiet reckoning as a man learns to stop running, embrace his history, and love the person he’s becoming.

metas.name: The Horizon from the Tip of the Nose
metas.description: Diagnosed as completely nearsighted at age 6, I have spent my life in a blur. A journey through the not always clear twists and turns of ophthalmology.

metas.name: Ball Face
metas.description: Life throws curveballs, how you react decides if you make it through. We follow an elementary schoolgirl terrified of sports who survives a chaotic ball game by bouncing a ball off her face. By the end of the game, she’s completely transformed.

metas.name: Carceral Jigs
metas.description: How do recycled architectures of containment complicate and unsettle ideas of contemporary Irish nationalism? Carceral Jigs laces footage of anti-migration protests and talking-head interviews with children’s television tropes, 3D puppetry, and linguistic tongue twisters to consider how control is choreographed through culture, policy, media, and the built environment – and how the spectacle of belonging is maintained and malformed by its systematic denial.

metas.name: Breathe, Brother, Breathe
metas.description: An asthmatic Iranian-American high schooler learns the trumpet to keep a precious friendship intact, reconnect with his emotionally distant family, and take control of his fragmented life.

metas.name: Oma
metas.description: A reworking of Little Red Riding Hood through the lens of love and loss.

metas.name: Tales of Railway's Past
metas.description: The West Clare Railway is one of many lines in Ireland that were shut down in the 20th Century. If you walk along the line today, you will see little indication of what once was, but listening to the locals, a colourful world starts to unfold before you. A time long gone, a time remembered: the time of the railway.

metas.name: The Sunrise File
metas.description: The Sunrise File is a geopolitical thriller in which a Mossad agent seeks to determine the fate of former Nazi executioners.  The film takes us on a breathtaking tale of espionage from the end of the Second World War to the trial of Klaus Barbie, between Paris, Berlin, La Paz and Tel Aviv.

metas.name: The Orbit of Minor Satellites
metas.description: A dark story about love in a time of darkness that follows a psychiatric patient, the doctor who treats her, and the imagined inhabitants of a forgotten Cold War space station on a moon of Saturn.

metas.name: ALLEN & AI
metas.description: June 3, 1990. New York City. On his 64th birthday, Allen Ginsberg gathers a handful of friends in his downtown apartment. Among them, a young, unknown Chinese artist documents the day. His name is Ai Weiwei. The tape survives. Nothing “historic” happens and yet, everything is there.

metas.name: The Fool
metas.description: Charlie, a talented student who dreams of performing, is forced to abandon the lead role in his school play when his father prioritizes academic success over his passion.

metas.name: Prejudice & Pride
metas.description: During Pride weekend, struggling author Jessie Jones joins her partner at their boss' home for a poker game, leading to a night of intolerable cruelty and shocking discoveries. Made for the 48 Hour Film Project in New Orleans.

metas.name: DUMMY: the saddest story never told
metas.description: Serving as the visual companion to TUV's third record and concept album, DUMMY, this film tells a emotional story about a crash test dummy coming to life.

metas.name: I'm not alone
metas.description: The university was far more than just a place for classes. It was a community, a sanctuary, and a bastion of resistance. This short documentary captures the experiences of students at the Academy of Arts in Novi Sad, reflecting their relationships, fears, solidarity, and their shared need to stay present in a moment that changes everything. Created as a first-year exam project, the film offers an intimate glimpse into a generation navigating a time of uncertainty and togetherness.

metas.name: TRNSMT 2026: The last dinner party
metas.description: The Last Dinner Party make a welcome return to TRNSMT with their theatrical glamour.

metas.name: TRNSMT 2026: Sonny Fodera
metas.description: Superstar DJ Sonny Fodera brings euphoric house music energy to his TRNSMT debut.

metas.name: Future Islands "The Moon is Blue"
metas.description: In 18th-century rural France, a huntress tracks down her former lover—a vampire living in plain sight disguised as a nun. Driven by rage, the huntress seeks to put an end to this toxic romance in a breathtaking fight scene.

metas.name: Godpower
metas.description: A surf instructor in Tarkwa Bay Nigeria battles to keep his family afloat as life pushes him toward an unthinkable choice.

metas.name: Psalms and Lamentations
metas.description: Psalms and Lamentations is a short film depicting the depth of pain and grief that we so often find in life caused by the struggle of sin, along with, how that relates to our walk with God. Much of the script is derived from the books, Psalms, lamentations, Job, Johna and other books of the Bible. It is unlike most films in that it exist to relate to the pain and not to the joy in our lives. This provides a very unique viewing experience. Some people find this film extremely deep and moving while others can see the depth but don't feel it as much. Much of how deep it is for someone is hevaly determined by what someone's self talk sounds like.  Film available on YouTube

metas.name: Canoe Carry Me Home
metas.description: Indigenous filmmaker Derek Sands discovers his great-great-grandfather’s lost canoe, and returns home to Walpole Island, where rebuilding it sparks a reconnection to culture, land, and community.

metas.name: Kairo
metas.description: A Stop-Motion with a divided perspective

metas.name: Don't Trust the Girls Upstairs
metas.description: In the wake of her estranged sister's death, Ashley finds herself caring for her niece, who she's never met before. As they grapple with their shared loss, Ashley must uncover the truth that lurks beneath her own roof, before it's too late

metas.name: I GAVE MY BABY POWERADE
metas.description: When his wife leaves for lunch for the first time since giving birth, a new dad has the impossible task of watching his baby by himself. Everything that can go wrong, does.

metas.name: Jon Snow: A Last Big Story
metas.description: Faced with an Alzheimer’s diagnosis, Jon Snow rediscovers his purpose in doing what he's always done, exposing injustice as he fights for a Zambian community whose homes have been destroyed by a mine.

metas.name: What Remains of You
metas.description: A young woman revisits memories from the past and faces the emotions attached to them, discovering what truly remains when everything else changes.

metas.name: Mimi The Mime
metas.description: A homeless mime and a struggling clown fight over the attention of a crowd on a NYC sidewalk.  When their fight draws more attention and money than their performances ever could, they  realize they struck gold. Broke, desperate and out of options, the pair transform their slapstick  routines into an underground bare-knuckle sensation called ‘Mime vs Clown’.

metas.name: Take That live from Etihad Stadium
metas.description: Experience Take That live from their spectacular Circus tour – a dazzling stadium spectacle of gold-plated hits, breathtaking circus performers, and pure nostalgia.

metas.name: Fleddy Melculy - Live at Graspop 2026
metas.description: New music from Fleddy Melculy? Check! The South Stage opened on Saturday with plenty of surprises—even a masked female singer...

metas.name: Loneliness and the Sheep
metas.description: We follow the trip of a heartbroken man. Long after his break up, he cannot let it leave his mind continuously searching for meaning in every mundane thing, only to ultimately find peace in the carelessly afraid sheep at the footsteps of Mont Saint-Michel.

metas.name: Ouroboros
metas.description: Ouroboros delicately captures Highgate Cemetery’s gothic architecture, ivy-draped tombs, and nature-reclaimed landscapes, drawing on staff perspectives to reconsider ideas of death, remembrance and everyday work there.

metas.name: Katy Perry: Live at Rock in Rio Lisboa 2026
Take That - The Circus Live - Manchester 2026
metas.description: Experience Take That live from their spectacular Circus tour – a dazzling stadium spectacle of gold-plated hits, breathtaking circus performers, and pure nostalgia. From the soaring anthems of Greatest Day and Back for Good to the jaw-dropping theatrics of fire-breathers, trapeze artists, and a 30ft mechanical elephant, this is the greatest show in town.

metas.name: Keo: Live at TRNSMT 2026
metas.description: Keo bring a blend of grunge and indie rock to their TRNSMT debut.

metas.name: The Vertigo of Chance
metas.description: Two guys are having a perfectly normal day at their usual teahouse. The conversation shifts to a serious issue.

metas.name: Detective McMan in the LABYRINTH OF LIES
metas.description: When movie director Howard Morrison is murdered, polar opposite detectives Geoffrey McMan and Drake Blake must solve the case. Can they find who murdered Howard Morrison before more people die, or will they themselves die trying?

metas.name: Sirens
metas.description: A man protects two women from the deadly sound of the sirens, but they insist on hearing them, even if it means risking their lives.

metas.name: Music is God Speaking – Brian Wilson
metas.description: Wishing Brian a happy and heavenly birthday. We invite you to view this video celebrating Brian’s life, created by directors Brent Wilson and George Dougherty, with graphics by David Calcano. They created this film for Brian's family and closest friends as they gathered to honor his remarkable life at his memorial last year. Now, this wonderful tribute is available for the world to see. Love and Mercy.  From the outset, they understood they had been given an impossible task: to capture the beautiful soul of a man whose music helped shape our lives.  The longtime Brian collaborators poured through a treasure trove of photographs, filmed performances, and memories, hoping to capture just a sliver of his kindness, his humor, his vulnerability, and the remarkable gift he shared with the world through his music.

metas.name: The Belladonna
metas.description: Haunted by visions of her late mother, a burlesque dancer’s paranoia deepens when she becomes convinced a fellow performer is plotting to steal her crown as Queen of the Belladonna Club.

metas.name: Mama?
metas.description: The caged bird sings with a fearful trill of things unknown but longed for still and his tune is heard on the distant hill for the caged bird sings of freedom

metas.name: The New Dawn of Tennis
metas.description: The film places a heavy focus on the 2025 Roland-Garros (French Open) tournament, where Alcaraz and Sinner met in an epic, highly intense final. It details their contrasting playing styles—juxtaposing Alcaraz's raw passion and dramatic fifth-set clutch performances with Sinner’s methodical, almost mathematical "engineering" approach to perfecting his game.

metas.name: Not All Dogs Go To Heaven
metas.description: A fragmented recalling of a ghost’s past lives, cursed to wander alone.

metas.name: Let Us Be
metas.description: An intimate portrait of Intersex individuals born with sex anatomy not typically male or female, across India, Brazil, and the USA. Through personal stories, the film exposes the ongoing human rights struggle against non-consensual surgeries performed on intersex children, while confronting the rigid binaries that shape our understanding of sex and gender. "Let Us Be" invites audiences to reconsider the norms imposed on bodies and identities, offering a reflection on autonomy, dignity, and the beauty of human diversity.

metas.name: P$RN STAR University
metas.description: What happens when one of OnlyFans’ biggest stars decides to open a university? Andy Lee is breaking taboos and building a business, one straight guy at a time. With fifteen years in the adult industry behind him, he’s now doing something nobody else has attempted: launching a real-life school for aspiring male performers, coaching, coaxing and filming straight-identifying men as they step into gay adult content for the first time. His new intake arrives with different motivations, quick cash, curiosity, ambition, or all three. What none of them expect is quite how much they’re about to learn, about performance, yes, but also about boundaries, identity and the surprisingly emotional experience of being truly seen.

metas.name: The Troll
metas.description: A TikTok megastar spirals after one cruel comment, stalking her troll in a descent that blurs fame, obsession, and revenge.

metas.name: The Cage
metas.description: A covert operative goes undercover as a henchman in a warehouse hiding a major drug operation. Out for revenge, he fights his way through the criminals inside, determined to take down the ruthless Baron responsible for his daughter’s life.

metas.name: Three Wishes
metas.description: While cleaning out his grandmother's living room, a young man discovers a mysterious lamp and accidentally frees the spirit of an eccentric genie,

metas.name: The Intimacy Coordinator
metas.description: A heartbroken man mistakes an intimacy coordinator job posting as a sexual opportunity and is hired by two unhinged theater directors who believe they’ve found the perfect guy for the job.

metas.name: Afterblue
metas.description: A boy wakes up confused in an enchanting forest, when a butterfly calms him and guides him through the woods to an ethereal garden, where he encounters a mysterious carp that takes him on an astral journey of liberation.

metas.name: The Hockey Player
metas.description: A documentary that follows Canadian-born defenseman Luke Prokop as he decides to become the first — and still only — professional athlete playing under contract to an NHL team to come out as gay. Growing up in Edmonton steeped in Canada’s tough, often homophobic hockey culture, and playing without gay role models throughout professional sports, Luke’s path to coming out of the closet has been neither easy nor obvious. The film charts Prokop’s personal journey against the backdrop of a professional hockey industry that has had, at best, an ambivalent relationship to diversity. As the film sensitively reveals, being publicly out certainly came as an earthquake to his family, especially his father Al, who as Luke’s mentor and sometime coach represents the most complex and moving relationship in the film.

metas.name: BREAKFAST AT BERGHAIN
metas.description: A small-town girl takes a pilgrimage to the famed German nightclub Berghain and ends up spending years of her life in the hallowed den of drum and bass.

metas.name: The Love Heist
metas.description: Celebrity stylist Kayli must team up with hotel security chief Mills to track down an iconic piece of fashion history after it goes missing on her watch before the Chicago Costume Gala.

metas.name: Infinity Mirror
metas.description: During a tense encounter in a bar bathroom, Bash gets trapped in a time loop with his ex-best friend—and his only hope of escape is to confront what tore them apart.

metas.name: Safe In My Skin
metas.description: Mikey Liu, a young Chinese American man living in New York City, travels to his hometown for the funeral of his childhood friend, Shaun. As the trip pulls him back into his past, long-buried memories begin to surface, revealing the quiet weight of a complicated friendship.

metas.name: The Faggots & Their Friends Between Revolutions
metas.description: A poetic cinematic envisioning of the legendary queer 1970s manifesto, The F--gots & Their Friends Between Revolutions, this visual meditation contrasts nature’s quiet strength with the rigid architecture of power. In a world where the f--gots and their friends are made of flowers, trees and softness, will they survive against the men of concrete and steel? A story of otherness not as weakness, but as enduring, blooming power.

metas.name: So Be It
metas.description: Five senior LGBTQIA+ couples share their resilient love stories, reflecting on identity, aging, and love while offering younger generations inspiring role models.

metas.name: Free Food Race
metas.description: A starving, broke student finds a discount coupon for the bakery across the street. But her moment of joy is brief. To use it, she’ll have to race against the clock and the city’s vermin.

metas.name: Oliver West
metas.description: West Knight secretly helps Oliver, a ghost only she can see, cross over to the afterlife before his spiritual essence deteriorates completely. While her step sibling Jaime navigates a new romance with coworker Quinn, West discovers that Oliver's unfinished business isn't about supernatural rituals—it's about experiencing human connection and love.

metas.name: Genieology
metas.description: When a man happens upon a magical genie lamp, its up to his crackshot lawyer to make sure he isnt tricked at the hands of the genie.

metas.name: Crossroads
metas.description: A forensics professional returns to her childhood home for a weekend of soul-searching only to find mobsters waiting for her with a tempting offer.

metas.name: Breaking Al
metas.description: Come back and revisit Anchor Bay's Better Call Al and Breaking Broadcast in one full experience. This is an abridged/parody PG version of Better Call Saul and Breaking Bad.

metas.name: UAP
metas.description: When a group of friends, on their annual 4th of July trip, finds a UAP (Unidentified Anomalous Phenomena) that lands behind their lake house, they must decide if they want to use it for selfish gain, or save the world from destruction.

metas.name: Voicemails for Isabelle
metas.description: A young woman's hilariously confessional voicemails to her late sister are unknowingly redirected to a stranger, who begins to fall in love from afar.

metas.name: Fortnite The Movie 2: Mario Kart
metas.description: When a rogue opposition goes on a journey to revive some old familiar faces, a curious penguin stowaway finds himself right in the middle of a kart race derby. Unknowingly, this penguin might actually be the key to stopping an evil master plan that has been in motion for many, many years.

metas.name: Who Killed My Husband's Mistress?
metas.description: Megan's attempt to break free from her troubled marriage takes a deadly turn when she witnesses her husband's murder just days after his mistress was killed. As ominous threats start to close in, she soon realizes she could be the next target.

metas.name: Rotting Christ - Hellfest 2026
metas.description: Rotting Christ take to the stage to deliver an hours set live at Hellfest Open Air 2026

metas.name: Where's the Respect?
metas.description: "Where’s the Respect?" is a track written, composed, and produced by Ali Boubacar Bonkano, featuring vocals by Bima Bama. Delivered as a raw, personal narrative from Bama’s perspective, the lyrics confront the persistent jealousy and scrutiny Bonkano faces within the fashion industry. By centering the recurring question, "Where's the respect?", the track critiques a competitive environment while asserting Bonkano’s dominance and refusal to be derailed. Ultimately, the song serves as a defiant declaration of focus, confirming that he will continue to advance his craft and legacy, indifferent to the negative opinions and insecurities of those waiting for his downfall.

metas.name: Saving Spring Creek Valley
metas.description: Saving Spring Creek Valley is a compelling story of grassroots resistance and environmental justice. When development threatens a fragile ecosystem, a determined community rises to defend it. This documentary captures their courage, unity, and hope as they fight to protect threatened species and preserve the valley from irreversible destruction.

metas.name: Jaap van Zweden dirige Mozart, Stravinsky et Betsy Jolas
metas.description: To mark his return to the Radio France Philharmonic Orchestra, Jaap van Zweden will conduct works by Mozart, Stravinsky and Betsy Jolas. With *The Rite of Spring* as the highlight, the concert spans music from more than two centuries.

metas.name: With You
metas.description: No matter what comes next, I'm with you.

metas.name: TRNSMT 2026: Wold Alice
metas.description: Wolf Alice make a welcome return to the TRNSMT main stage.

metas.name: Copyright infringement
metas.description: A group of teens are trying to make a horror short film for a summer class but they cant get it right.

metas.name: Seducing My Hockey Rival
metas.description: Connor loses everything when his curling team disbands. His girlfriend, Ivy, dumps him. She leaves him for Hunter Strand. Hunter is a billionaire hockey captain. Connor blames Hunter for his ruin. He devises a revenge scheme. He joins Hunter's hockey world. Connor plans to seduce Hunter. This will sabotage the engagement. Connor insists he is straight. His clumsy seduction attempts create intense tension. Soon, fake attraction becomes real love. Ivy discovers the original plot. She successfully breaks them apart. Connor makes a dramatic confession. Hunter forgives him. They reconcile and choose love over societal expectations.

metas.name: Static
metas.description: A rising 2000’s Rock band’s breakout night unravels while fractured memories expose the truth.

metas.name: The Hug of Emptiness
metas.description: In 2003, Chandrashekhar's world was turned upside down. He had pledged his property to the Sullia cooperative bank for a loan, but when he couldn't repay, the bank took it away, despite RBI norms saying otherwise. What followed is over two decades of struggle. He has taken the bank to court, but the case drags on.

metas.name: Deadbeat
metas.description: Journey into the lives of Father's fighting to be with their children. As they face an uphill battle against a biased system pushing a Fatherless agenda. Wrongfully Accused, False Accusations, Child Support and Meritless Restraining Orders

metas.name: Aspiring Tourists
metas.description: Two siblings prepare for a vacation with their cousin when a self made problem arises.

metas.name: NEXT
metas.description: A young filmmaker finds himself caught between his passion for cinema and the choices that shapes his future.

metas.name: Dear Mothers!
metas.description: As three generations of Colombian women prepare for their daughter's quinceañera in London, the daughter faces the unexpected reality of her pregnancy and whether to reveal it on the day meant to honour her, risking a celebration that would forever change.

metas.name: Jane
metas.description: Twenty-five-year-old nanny and aspiring writer Sophie can’t believe her luck when she lands a gig babysitting for the daughter of her favorite author. But not everything in this house is as it seems.

metas.name: Branches of a Fig Tree
metas.description: In a peaceful world recovering from catastrophe, a spirited runaway meets a magnetic community leader. As they fall in love, they discover truths about connection, the world, and their pasts- and realise they might be more connected than they thought.

metas.name: Hope Comes Home: Inside the Obama Presidential Center
metas.description: A rare sit-down interview with former President Barack Obama, an exclusive conversation with former First Lady Michelle Obama, and a walk-and-talk tour of the center with Obama Foundation CEO Valerie Jarrett, offering viewers an unprecedented look inside the historic institution.

metas.name: Zara Larsson: Pinkpop Festival 2026
metas.description: Recorded live at Pinkpop Festival 2026 in Landgraaf, the Netherlands, Zara Larsson brings the radiant energy of her Midnight Sun era to one of Europe’s most iconic festival stages. Backed by dazzling visuals, powerful vocals, and a dynamic live production, Larsson leads the crowd through a set that celebrates her artistic reinvention. Standout performances of “Midnight Sun,” “Blue Moon,” “Pretty Ugly,” and “Stateside” showcase the heart of her latest chapter, blending euphoric pop, fearless self-expression, and emotional storytelling. Alongside beloved hits such as “Lush Life,” “Never Forget You,” and “Symphony,” this electrifying performance captures Zara Larsson at her most confident, ambitious, and unforgettable.

metas.name: Bonnaroo 2026: The Moovie
metas.description: A love letter to friends and a pseudo-documentary of the events that transpired during the 2026 Bonnaroo Music and Arts Festival

metas.name: The Clash of Nations: Joe Louis vs. Max Schmeling
metas.description: Follows the parallel lives and careers of American Joe Louis and German Max Schmeling as they overcome social and political obstacles while hurtling on a collision course to two historic matchups in the ring, and a pivotal place in history.

metas.name: Then You Said It
metas.description: Two best friends realise they both have feelings for each other. But will they confess? And what will happen if they do?

metas.name: Return of the Clowns
metas.description: In a new ESPN E60 special debuting on the Juneteenth holiday, a vibrant, deeply human, and joyfully cinematic documentary chronicles the extraordinary journey of the Indianapolis Clowns – once icons of Negro League baseball, now reborn for a new generation through the electric world of Banana Ball.

metas.name: La maldición del sauce
metas.description: A documentary about the city of Quilmes.

metas.name: 7 Piano Sketches
metas.description: A piano tuner wanders through the streets of New York after dark, seeking artistic inspiration. Sketchbook in hand, he observes the city’s lovers, mourners, and giant ants from afar. But when a twist of fate brings him face-to-face with a kindred spirit, he finds what he was looking for all along.

metas.name: Here, Queer, and On TV
metas.description: Before YouTube, Lavender Lounge lit up public access TV with a ’90s queer and trans dance party and groundbreaking show, capturing San Francisco’s first Dyke March and the first official Pride video. Thirty years later, creator Mark Kliem brings rare footage to light, reuniting the original crew with younger generations when queer history is again under attack.

metas.name: CONTRAST
metas.description: In the span of a single day an ethnic narrator takes us through different people's lives in Honolulu while picking apart life itself in black and white 35mm.

metas.name: Midnight City
metas.description: Dutch Lazarus is a detective who specializes in strange cases. When a new client walks into his office and stymies him at every turn, we begin to wonder what her game is, and if Dutch already knows a lot more more than she's telling.

metas.name: Salt
metas.description: “What do we say anymore to conjure the salt of our earth?”  400 meters under the surface in coastal Antrim, machinery and poetry echo out from the depths of Ireland's only active salt mine. Featuring and inspired by Seamus Heaney’s “The Singers House”, this short documentary takes a poetic view of the salt mine as both an artificial space and a natural environment, finding a sense of humanity in its alien sounds and structures.

metas.name: Land of Wolves
metas.description: When a covert rescue mission goes wrong, four former Navy SEALs are captured and thrown into an underground death match. Watched by depraved billionaires, they are forced to fight in a brutal tournament. With no weapons and no way out, the team must rely on their training and unbreakable bond to survive the bloody arena, dismantle the entire operation and reclaim their freedom.

metas.name: Stuck
metas.description: Kamila has an epiphany about time spent at a place that makes her feel stuck.

metas.name: Method Cowboy
metas.description: When a struggling actor feigns being gay to land the role of a lifetime in an Oscar-bait Cowboy Western, he decides to transform himself for the role, blurring the lines between reality and performance.

metas.name: Loves Company
metas.description: Washed-up TV guest star Blake de Troy is rescued after a car crash by his devoted fan, Antoinette Funk, who lives in the Florida Everglades. Believing he's been kidnapped, Blake initially tries to escape, but after the death of his life partner and manager, Jimmy, he realizes he has nowhere else to go and begins exploiting the situation as a potential publicity stunt. Their increasingly dysfunctional arrangement spirals into a dark comedy about celebrity, loneliness, obsession, and fandom.

metas.name: Peace Corps
metas.description: Drifting directionlessly around her hometown after unexpectedly being dismissed early from a stint in the Peace Corps, a 30-year-old Asian American woman butts heads with her mother, goes on an ill-advised date with a figure from her past, and ruminates on the meaning of her life.

metas.name: The Pink Funeral
metas.description: A transgender Chinese girl on the brink of crossing over to the afterlife embarks on a comedic struggle back on Earth to ensure the proper burial of her body, ultimately leading to a profound reconciliation with her mother and acceptance of her true identity.

metas.name: Love in Old York
metas.description: A bored student, trapped in a black and white world finds unexpected colour, when he meets his true love.

metas.name: The Bait
metas.description: Rosie and Annie’s love has always felt unshakable, but old tensions resurface with the disappearance of their cat Ripley. When Rosie is visited by a divine presence, she is compelled to undergo the ultimate test.

metas.name: Node
metas.description: A poignant exploration of childhood illness, resilience, and family.

metas.name: Goodbye to All That
metas.description: In a dusty apartment, Gabo mourns the end of a difficult relationship. Soon, reality gives way to a dreamlike delirium…

metas.name: Stepfather
metas.description: After years of eradicating any family that falls short of perfection, Darnell believes his new wife Asia and her daughters might finally be the real deal. That is, until tensions rise and they uncover his deadly pattern. Now, getting rid of them won’t be as easy as he planned.

metas.name: Synthetic Sincerity
metas.description: Marc Isaacs makes a deal with The Synthetic Sincerity Lab, an AI research project affiliated with the University of Southern England. There, researchers are investigating the possibility of teaching AI characters authenticity, using characters from Isaacs’ documentaries to do so. In return, they allow Isaacs to film the process.

metas.name: Love & Other Crimes
metas.description: Noah Thomas's life takes a dangerous turn when a chance reunion with an old high school friend entangles him in a ruthless crime ring. As he falls deeper into the syndicate's violent world, his budding romance with Shaye Matthews offers a fragile glimmer of hope. Torn between love and survival, Noah must navigate betrayals, escalating stakes, and deadly choices that threaten to destroy everything he values.

metas.name: Gainesville Takes to the Streets
metas.description: A docu short film captured at the "No Kings" protests in Gainesville, GA.

metas.name: Shoot the People
metas.description: A documentary capturing photographer and activist Misan Harriman’s journey documenting global protest movements that drive social change. Follow Harriman as he highlights the resilience of grassroots activists fighting for equality, civil rights, and social justice, the film showcases the intersectionality of these movements and their collective power. With historical context, interviews with activists, and explorations of digital activism, the documentary reveals how Harriman's lens brings the world's activism to light, inspiring viewers to recognize their own power in shaping a more just society.

metas.name: Pickleball
metas.description: When foreclosure threatens their community center, Father Joseph rallies his late friend’s sons into an underdog pickleball team for a $100,000 tournament—against a cocky tennis legend determined to seize the courts and steal the spotlight.

metas.name: Black Men in Uniform
metas.description: Pata Seca  (1828), a man whose back bore the whip marks of his enslavers , whose eyes held the haunted memory of being forced to breed over 200 slave children in order to sustain his master’s plantation.  Men broken but unbowed, transformed from field hands into soldiers from the civil war to Vietnam.  This documentary weaves together authentic narratives from the 1800s, accompanied by original images and footage, highlighting the significant influence that Black men in uniform had in Hollywood and addressing ongoing relevant issues to date.

metas.name: Citizen Vigilante
metas.description: A man takes justice into his own hands, hunting down criminals. His vigilante crusade makes him a social media star but puts him at odds with the local police chief.

metas.name: Virginia Woolf's Night & Day
metas.description: In 1910 London, independent-minded Katharine Hilbery defies her family's expectations of marriage to pursue a career in astronomy. But when her father pressures her into an unwanted engagement, her resolve is tested. Through new friendships—including a bold suffragette and a thoughtful editor—Katharine begins to question the limits placed on her by society, love, and tradition, ultimately searching for a path that is truly her own.

metas.name: Sizzler '77
metas.description: In the summer of 1977, a group of working girls are being coerced by a mysterious and sinister pimp Bossy Jim and his young partner Chaka, to become involved in a profit-share scheme.

metas.name: Crossed Wires
metas.description: Alone on a battlefield far from home, a young soldier is close to death - until he gets a mysterious phone call...

metas.name: Amala Dianor and Les Arts Florissants: Gesualdo Passione @ Nuits de Fourvière 2026
metas.description: With their performance of “Gesualdo Passione” at the Nuits de Fourvière, choreographer Amala Dianor and Les Arts Florissants, conducted by Paul Agnew, strike up a dialogue between hip-hop dance and Baroque music that is as unexpected as it is captivating.

metas.name: Gassed Up
metas.description: A day in the life of rap superstar, Clarence.

metas.name: If You See the Buddha in the Road
metas.description: Meditative diary film invoking reflection through low resolution

metas.name: B.I.G - A World First
metas.description: On September 20, 2023, Jakob Schubert was able to climb “B.I.G.” (formerly known as “Project Big”) in Flatanger, Norway—one of the most demanding sport climbing routes in the world.  Originally bolted by Adam Ondra, the route remained a project for over a decade. After working on it together in 2022, Jakob returned the following year with a new idea: attempting the climb while livestreaming my tries.  “B.I.G. – A World First” documents this journey—capturing not only the ascent itself, but also the mental side of pushing Jakob’s limits on a route that once felt impossible.

metas.name: Southern Fuel
metas.description: Across the American South, gas stations are more than pit stops. They are places to eat, gather, and share stories. Photographer Kate Medley explores how these everyday spaces sustain rural communities in North Carolina.

metas.name: Termn and Conditions
metas.description: In an isolated cabin, a mask sculptor struggles with their own identity. When a strange figure appears at the door, offering answers and comfort, their world begins to spiral into dissociation and madness.

metas.name: SHADOW TOWN: IS AIT AN MAC AN SAOL
metas.description: A rural town in Ireland swells to a population of half a million for one week during the world’s largest annual celebration of Irish music, transforming it into a major metropolis of culture, diversity and decadence.

metas.name: Gem
metas.description: A short film by Lily Sarosi.

metas.name: The Light We Carry
metas.description: A young woman is offered the gift of light by her grandmother. The gift has been in her family for generations. But can she accept it?

metas.name: Geraldine Hickey: Of Course We've Got Horses
metas.description: In her hit 2023 show Of Course We’ve Got Horses, Geraldine Hickey reflects on new‑found privileges like getting married, owning horses and buying a very nice camera for bird photography. (Okay, technically the horses belong to her wife Cath… and one of them is a pony. But as they say, what’s mine is yours.)

metas.name: Huí Jiā
metas.description: An aging restaurant owner reflects on an old letter she once sent to her father in her homeland.

metas.name: From Hope to Home: The Obama Presidential Center
metas.description: The Obama Presidential Center's star-studded grand opening ceremony brings a slew of celebrities and dignitaries to Chicago for the big event.  The festivities feature what organizers said would be "legendary performances by global icons and powerful remarks from today's most prominent voices."  Bruce Springsteen, Stevie Wonder, Christina Aguilera, John Legend and Bono are just some of the many big names slated to perform.

metas.name: Rusty Bearclaw and The Rucket List
metas.description: An LDS teenager receives his call to serve a mission for his church. Realizing he doesn't have long before he leaves for two years, he creates a "pre-mission bucket list" to complete alongside his two idiotic best friends.

metas.name: Confined
metas.description: The story of a gang put together by a crime boss in order to pull off a heist. It all seems to be going well, until it’s not. The crew gets broken up after the heist due to external circumstances, and upon reuniting, there is undeniable tension between the men. They are confined to a hideout in a remote location, waiting to hear from the boss. But the question is - how long will they be able to trust each other?

metas.name: Original Night
metas.description: Told in two semi-fictional acts, this 16mm film serves as an elegy for Europe’s last wallabies — a marsupial animal from Australia, introduced in Scotland in the 1940s. Reflecting on humanity’s enduring urge to record animals, from prehistoric cave art to early cinema, Alasdair Asmussen Doyle links the extinction of species with the evolution of image-making.

metas.name: X-Ray Katx
metas.description: Bradley Eros companion piece to X-Ray Eros.

metas.name: Back To Black
metas.description: A young woman, unable to move on from a failed relationship, spirals into depression, drugs, and alcohol.  Haunted by memories of the man she once loved, she struggles to escape the past that continues to consume her.  Desperate for answers, she seeks him out, only to uncover a devastating truth he has been hiding from her all along.  But once she learns the truth, she makes a choice that can never be undone

metas.name: The Sun Comes Up
metas.description: Amidst the suffocating isolation of a prolonged COVID lockdown as a single mother, Caitlin struggles to find hope.

metas.name: Dan Mintz: Well Rounded Entertainer
metas.description: Best known as the voice of Tina Belcher on Bob's Burgers, Dan Mintz began his career doing standup comedy, and is now releasing his first full-length special only 27 years later. Recorded live at Dynasty Typewriter in Los Angeles, Dan Mintz: Well Rounded Entertainer was then animated by the team behind Bob's Burgers, bringing to life Dan's deadpan one-liners with vivid colors and surreal animated bits.

metas.name: Everyone Gets Bored of Everything
metas.description: A young girl loses her job, prompting a day of mundane and surprisingly deep conversations.

metas.name: We're Close
metas.description: A simple phone call between two friends.

metas.name: Les Dreamables
metas.description: A film about a guy struggling with Les Dreamables.

metas.name: Panda & Peanut
metas.description: It's Thursday morning, and siblings Hubie and Valentina must get through their shared birthday while navigating money problems, purpose, and their ever-changing relationship as Val enters the next stage of her life.

metas.name: Free Lyric
metas.description: Set against the rise of social media, Free Lyric revisits one of rap culture’s earliest viral moments: the public shaming of a 17-year-old female rapper after a sexual confession spreads online. Through Niki’s story, the film explores gender, consent, and the early roots of online call-out culture.

metas.name: Wills Home Movies
metas.description: Home movies are immortal through moments frozen in time but also forever changing as our life evolves and our perspectives shift. The further you look back the harder it becomes to find what you once were, but home movies can act as a reminder of the pieces of your life that have made you what you are. This film is an honest snapshot of my life, but its core is rooted in universal life experiences that anyone can find glimpses of themselves in.

metas.name: Big Break
metas.description: When three Los Angeles transplants discover that the MiniDV tape containing their drunken shenanigans is missing, they revisit their sins from the night prior in order to recover the secrets they’ve recorded.

metas.name: Sergio e Mirta: Storia di un matrimonio in 8mm
metas.description: A classic found-footage film, revealing a story that would otherwise have been lost: the love between Sergio Corbucci and Mirta Guarnaschelli.

metas.name: Each Other
metas.description: Enemies at school. friends at home. Two brothers navigate childhood with and without each other.

metas.name: Saat Aku Bersuara
metas.description: Nadia, a bright young lawyer, finds her life shattered when her wedding is canceled at the last second. But that bitterness did not make him submit. She rose up and dedicated herself to defending women's rights. Together with her two friends, Andien and Riana, and Adrian, a Public Prosecutor who is an important part of her journey, Nadia struggles to rebuild her life, including her broken relationship with her father. As the wounds of the past slowly find their way, Nadia becomes increasingly convinced that as long as she dares to speak out and doesn't give up, hope will never be extinguished.

metas.name: You Can't Fly
metas.description: Follows Matt Lewis, aka Silverback Tarzan, as he comes to terms with being grounded following a near fatal hang-gliding accident. For someone with as much energy and “seize the day” drive as Tarzan, this isn’t easy, but, with the support of his loving partner Tara, Tarzan’s almost aggressive positivity wins through.

metas.name: JACKPOT!
metas.description: When a young man hides the truth about his lottery ticket winnings from his friend, conflict erupts.

metas.name: Tracing Paper
metas.description: Follow the preservation of vintage paper through past, present, and future.

metas.name: ترايثليت
metas.description: A triathlete living and training in Al-Naseem district, exploring how the sport becomes more than just competition, but a way of life built on discipline, endurance, and commitment. Through his daily routine and personal journey, the film highlights the challenges of pursuing an intense sport while balancing everyday life, offering a closer look at ambition and perseverance within an unexpected environment.

metas.name: Meet Me in the Margins
metas.description: A book editor secretly pens her own romance manuscript, only to find unexpected editorial notes from a mysterious critic in the margins. The film is a witty, heartwarming story about finding love between the lines.

metas.name: Finding Joy
metas.description: Roni Gingrich is a PTSD survivor and aspiring artist whose buried childhood trauma manifests in the form of sleep paralysis and recurring dreams as she unravels the truth of her past.

metas.name: Night After Night
metas.description: A reclusive night guard at a private university investigates the circumstances surrounding a coworker’s disappearance and a secret room in which an ever changing entity reappears night after night.

metas.name: Canto da Gente: Um Filme Sobre os Tápes
metas.description: Documentary about Brazilian folk music group Os Tápes.

metas.name: Street Smart
metas.description: A look into the lives of a lively group of unhoused young adults in the iconic beach town, who come together with humor and a bit of Robin Hood-style larceny, forging unbreakable bonds and redefining what it means to be a family.

metas.name: Little Brother
metas.description: A tightly wound realtor's picture-perfect life gets an extreme makeover when his lovably chaotic "little brother" suddenly reappears.

metas.name: Spades
metas.description: As a begrudged detective investigates a recent string of murders, he soon discovers his prime suspect is a mysterious vigilante out to bring down a ruthless up-and-coming crime syndicate.

metas.name: Jackass: Best and Last
metas.description: The fifth and final installment to Jackass franchise where the crew go on one last insane crusade.

metas.name: Amor Post Mortem
metas.description: Juan, devastated by his wife's death, decides to use a biotechnological cloning seed to bring her back to life.

metas.name: The Orion Call
metas.description: After receiving a cryptic online call about a mysterious, otherworldly box hidden in Las Vegas, a young woman from Arizona sets out to find it. But as strange forces begin to close in, she realizes the box isn't just powerful-it's calling to her, and she may already be too late to escape its pull.

metas.name: We're Already Living in an Alien Invasion Movie
metas.description: An analysis of the artificial intelligence and data center issue through the lens of alien invasion movies.

metas.name: The Neighbourhood
metas.description: This is a short experimental drama meant to evoke a sense of unease in an everyday neighbourhood and observing the surroundings we all see everyday as the sun sets, but we might not all look close enough...

metas.name: Hung Up On You
metas.description: Over the course of a tense phone call, two girls who were once best friends slowly untangle the web of misunderstandings that led to the end of their budding romance earlier that summer.

metas.name: No One There
metas.description: In a dystopian future, ruled by a artificially puppeteered and totalitarian regime where nothing is disclosed. A young adult (Matthew) is abducted and put on trial for a crime he cannot remember committing.  THEY WATCH. THEY RECORD. THEY CONTROL

metas.name: Let’s Chat
metas.description: One night while isolated and alone a boy rediscovers the importance of human connection through an AI platform called ‘Let’s Chat’.

metas.name: Dave the Diver: In the Jungle
metas.description: A live-action short film to accompany the DLC of the video game of the same name.

metas.name: Extreme Makeover: Homer Edition
metas.description: Homer and Marge's fun couples' date night goes off the rails when Marge learns Homer left the kids unsupervised with only the doorbell camera as a babysitter. Frustrated with her imperfect husband, a tipsy Marge stirs up a trilogy of fantasies of a different Homer.

metas.name: The Best 40 Minutes of a Bad day
metas.description: Instead of going to his college end of year show, Swedish Llama made another film. This is that film. A 40 minute uncut take on a static tripod in a park. The camera pans around and zooms in, finding as many completely different colours, textures and shot compositions while staying in a fixed position.

metas.name: ALL AFRAID
metas.description: I guess we’re just all afraid

metas.name: Skies
metas.description: Short film by Pat O'Neill.

metas.name: The Margins
metas.description: A nighttime journey into the abyss, where medieval marginalia perform an everlasting bureaucratic ritual in which the ticket becomes a fragile sacrifice.

metas.name: the guy that lives on my front yard
metas.description: Grey wakes to find a stranger living in a tent on his front lawn. Unable to physically remove him, he is forced to allow the man to steadily encroach on every aspect of his life. When confronted about the man by someone close to him, Grey is compelled to seek a more vulnerable method: coexisting with this presence he cannot escape.

metas.name: THAT GUY: An MKT Story
metas.description: One of the world's most infamous criminals treats a potential new hire to a dinner at his home.

metas.name: Entering the Fly-Space
metas.description: Finding it impossible to sleep, young Zarwell ventures into the mysterious 'Fly Space’ to secure his rest.

metas.name: Let’s Chat
metas.description: One night while isolated and alone a boy rediscovers the importance of human connection through an AI platform called ‘Let’s Chat’.

metas.name: The Exhibitor
metas.description: As murders begin to surface around hotels and expos, suspicion around Vi begins to close in. With her past resurfacing and her behavior growing harder to read, one question lingers: What is she really hiding?

metas.name: The Butcher and The Crabs
metas.description: As a war threatens mankind, a pair of roommates tries to outlive a few crabs that they had purchased for a party.

metas.name: in:CUBE
metas.description: Consumed by self-imposed isolation and total apathy, a young man’s mind begins to violently turn against him, trapping him in a psychological puzzle box of his own making where he must fight his own fractured identities to survive.

metas.name: Wish You Were Here
metas.description: Gray recalls a memory of him and his ex, Sybil, arguing. Only to be dragged back to the cold empty present.

metas.name: Four Paintings by Edward Povey: The Discomfort in a Ball of Hairy Twine
metas.description: Another installment in the interview series with Edward Povey, in this film Povey discusses the meaning of the paintings title, the link to iranian women and how we read paintings

metas.name: If Only
metas.description: A story about being in many realities at once. Sometimes one at a time, sometimes all at once.

metas.name: The Third Child
metas.description: In a century where humanity has lost its way and boundaries no longer exist, a mother transforms her grief into a final act of hope and resistance.

metas.name: Moon Song
metas.description: After the loss of her grandad, Ash gets stuck in a cycle of loneliness, grief and pain. As she struggles to get her life together, she rewatches the same old video for comfort.

metas.name: Exiled for Existing
metas.description: In 'Exiled for Existing’, more than 40 lesbian, gay, bisexual, trans and queer refugees and asylum-seekers in Glasgow explore the impact of having to flee a place to be yourself.

metas.name: To Face the Sea
metas.description: A small voyage shared amongst friends that leads to nothing, what a pity.

metas.name: Babymetal Live at Intuit Dome
metas.description: Celebrating their 15th anniversary, and as part of their 2025/2026 world tour, BABYMETAL made history as the first Japanese group to hold a one-man live show and sell out said show at the Intuit Dome in Los Angeles!

metas.name: Your Fault: London
metas.description: Nick and Noah are both embarking on life-changing adventures that are threatening to pull them apart—Nick in business with his father and Noah starting a fresh chapter at Oxford University. Now living separate lives, and meeting new people, they find themselves entangled in temptations, rivalries, and betrayals and their bond is tested like never before. As secrets unravel and temptation rises, they must fight to hold onto each other—or risk losing everything.

metas.name: 10s Across the Borders
metas.description: If the world doesn’t accept you and your kind, trailblaze a world that does. Inspired by the Black and Latinx underground Ballroom culture of New York, Sun, Teddy, and Xyza create Ballroom communities in Southeast Asia as safe havens from homophobia, transphobia, color discrimination and HIV stigma.

metas.name: Born To Die Scared
metas.description: After joining the military, a teen’s friends set up a going away party for him. Things quickly turn sour when it becomes apparent that the teen’s best friend has devised a plan to get him to not leave for the military, and he’s forced to choose between staying home with his friends, or risking his life overseas.

metas.name: Beethoven: Piano Concerto No. 3 Eric Lu in Stockholm
metas.description: American pianist Eric Lu is one of the rising stars of his generation. As part of europiano, ARTE's special day celebrating the piano concerto across Europe, Lu plays for the first time with the Royal Stockholm Philharmonic Orchestra, conducted by its principal conductor Ryan Bancroft. On the programme: Beethoven's Piano Concerto No. 3.

metas.name: UNDER THE SUN
metas.description: An expository documentary exploring how rising temperatures affect the lives and livelihoods of people who work under the sun.

metas.name: Bad Photography
metas.description: There are beautiful things that wont last 'till morning .

metas.name: Yet Again Another Great Chase
metas.description: The Chase Continues, but is this it?

metas.name: Creative Differences
metas.description: A rock band are sent to a countryside retreat to write their next album.

metas.name: White Rabbits Only
metas.description: A young woman is denied entry by a doorman wearing a rabbit mask. What first seems like an elitist act slowly reveals itself to be something more cruel. The film explores how prejudice often hides behind rules, hypocrisy , and absurdity.

metas.name: Ohio Fatty
metas.description: Fat man wants to ride the highway.

metas.name: Emmy Blotnick: What's Her Secret?
metas.description: In the follow-up to her critically acclaimed album PARTY NIGHTS, Emmy Blotnick returns to the stage of Brooklyn’s Union Hall with absurd yet relatable takes on marriage, dogs, and getting lost in Sephora. Crack open a fresh jar of Jennifer Lopez-brand butt cream and enjoy Emmy Blotnick’s latest special WHAT’S HER SECRET?

metas.name: The Vinyl Countdown
metas.description: This student film follows the charismatic and charming presenter Sammy as he sets out to discover why generation z lead the charts for vinyl sales.

metas.name: A Spark Into A Flame: Hamilton & Hip Hop
metas.description: Lin-Manuel Miranda and others set hip-hop and Broadway on fire in The Hamilton Mixtape.

metas.name: My Husband
metas.description: Otto bemoans the strife of loving (and loathing) his handsome spouse.

metas.name: The Loop Of Psyche
metas.description: A depressed twin finds himself in an unknown location with a mysterious stranger. As the encounter unfolds, it resolves his inner turmoil but reveals a shocking twist that changes everything for his brother.

metas.name: Yellow Guitar
metas.description: A dog with yellow clothes encounters a yellow guitar.

metas.name: Saul Goodman America’s 250th
metas.description: Saul Goodman reminds you of your constitutional rights in the celebration of America's 250th anniversary

metas.name: Lunacy
metas.description: Someone who has been engulfed by mental illness attempts to overthrow his twisted mind.

metas.name: B'Twixt Mourn & Æterna - Canto II: Leaving Your Mark
metas.description: Canto II out of XIII

metas.name: One for the Road
metas.description: Two regulars celebrate their last pint before their beloved pub closes.

metas.name: Nobody’s Fault
metas.description: A magical break-up sponsor helps a heartbroken man mourn the end of a recent relationship.

metas.name: Paggunita Ni Aion
metas.description: A heartfelt coming-of-age drama about a young man who unexpectedly encounters his 12-year-old self, leading him to reflect on his childhood frustrations and rediscover the immeasurable love, sacrifices, and memories left behind by his late mother.

metas.name: From The Breakwater
metas.description: A young Chinese man retreats into the countryside of North Wales.

metas.name: Perfect Love
metas.description: At the brink of giving up on all human connection, a painfully inhibited young woman meets a self-loving stranger at New York's Coney Island, inspiring her to ride a rollercoaster–for real and in her own bedroom...

metas.name: Butterfly
metas.description: Set against the backdrop of New York City, Butterfly follows Jericha a teenage girl navigating the quiet chaos of adolescence. At home, her mother faces mounting challenges as they struggle to stay afloat. At school, Jericha endures ridicule. And within her inner circle, cracks are beginning to form, with her closest friends making dangerous choices. Through it all, dance becomes her sanctuary. It's where she finds control, freedom, and release. But as her environment grows increasingly unstable, Jericha must face the growing tension around her, and within her, to decide if she'll retreat into silence, or find the strength to push forward.

metas.name: Hello Solace
metas.description: Haunted by her partner's death, a grieving girl retreats into isolation with an advanced empathy AI, but a fatal system glitch transforms her digital sanctuary into an infinite, nightmarish loop.

metas.name: RiseGoji
metas.description: The 10th anniversary of “Rise Goji” brings us the 5th feature film by acclaimed director Luis Duran.

metas.name: Breaking Cover
metas.description: A seemingly ordinary back-office worker whose father-daughter hunting trip turns into a relentless fight for survival, and the father's past as a covert operative is unearthed.

metas.name: 40 Dates and 40 Nights
metas.description: Burned out on dating and ready to quit, Leah accepts her grandma's outrageous challenge: 40 dates in 40 nights for a full year of rent. From awkward dinners to unexpected sparks, she discovers the biggest obstacle to love might just be herself.

metas.name: Darkroom
metas.description: Photographer and social recluse Louis and his cool-girl co-worker Eloise are unlikely friends at their New York photo lab. But when Eloise leaves on a date, Louis has to confront his priorities when he gets stuck overnight in the darkroom door.

metas.name: Blank Space
metas.description: A disheartened young pianist retreats into the woods, only to discover a strange patch of land that seemingly disappears objects into a mysterious void beyond reality. INTO FILM AWARD 2026 OFFICIAL SELECTION

metas.name: Chicks
metas.description: Chicks follows a group of teenage girls as they navigate the complexities of friendship, identity and growing up in contemporary London. Blending moments of humour, vulnerability and emotional honesty, the film explores the pressures placed on young women and the search for authenticity within a world of expectations. A heartfelt coming-of-age story about connection, change and finding your own voice.

metas.name: Half Past One
metas.description: Between every drunken confession or dazed quarrel, parties create the sparkling backdrop to many heated conversations. HALF PAST ONE follows Leah and Aggie and their relationship's journey. Told in non-linear fragments, Aggie navigates her need to belong while Leah spirals out of control. That is, until Aggie stumbles across nonchalant Jo, forcing her to reconsider what she really wants.

metas.name: Cause Of All Suffering
metas.description: Just cannot do it. Walks through the life by mostly sitting and staring into the known unknown.

metas.name: Tie Dealer
metas.description: A lucrative peddler of ties transacts with a boastful countryman.

metas.name: this place is not a place of honour
metas.description: Plagued by prophetic visions, an acolyte journeys into the abyss to confront the deity she worships. A paint on glass animation exploring a woman's journey inwards.

metas.name: Becoming American: Philadelphia's Story
metas.description: Becoming American: Philadelphia's Story restores to the historical record the enormous role Black people played in the shaping of our country's fundamental institutions both at its founding and in its crucial early decades.  It is a compelling exploration of the role of race in our country's founding, and the black men and women who were Founders as well, and will be welcomed in the classroom as we attempt to tell the full story of America's founding 250 years ago.

metas.name: He Won’t Stop Building a Map to an Imaginary Place
metas.description: The remarkable story of Jerry Gretzinger and the map he's dedicated his life to making.

metas.name: No Country for Mothers
metas.description: No Country for Mothers explores the culture wars surrounding American motherhood and why both the “girl boss” and “trad wife” labels ultimately distract us from the real issue: the lack of support for American families.  Following activist Reshma Saujani, the film charts a growing national movement to reunite moms across divisions and win the kind of historic support families actually need.

metas.name: The rain swept away my father
metas.description: A firstborn daughter loses her father because of a flash flood on the day of the 2025 local elections. After his death, she is forced to unpack their distant relationship with the help of her mother, only to realize how complex grief can become.

metas.name: Dolly: The World's Most Famous Sheep
metas.description: In 1996, a ragtag team of Scottish scientists changed history by creating Dolly the sheep - the first ever mammal clone. From global fame to moral uproar, this is Dolly’s story.

metas.name: Business As Usual
metas.description: After a producer fires him from his big break film, a director enters a rapid downward spiral as he sets out to enact the ultimate revenge.

metas.name: Senior Options: The Movie
metas.description: A documentary showcasing the individuals of the Edgemont High School Class of 2026 through the lens of Senior Options, a unique student-focused program.

metas.name: Bad: The Song That Saved My Life
metas.description: Bad: The Song That Saved My Life is a powerful new feature documentary exploring the remarkable life of Andy “Guck” Rowen, the Dublin man whose struggles with trauma and heroin addiction inspired three U2 songs, including the classic anthem ‘Bad’.

metas.name: The Outskirts
metas.description: The Outskirts of a place somewhere.

metas.name: The Magician's Elephant
metas.description: In the war-scarred town of Baltese, a lonely orphan's search for hope is transformed when a magician conjures an elephant from the sky, setting off a chain of impossible events that changes the lives of everyone around him.

metas.name: Mythologie moderne
metas.description: A strange noise occurs in the middle of the night, waking the narrator.

metas.name: You're Alive, Act Like It
metas.description: A nihilistic individual who lives a mundane life wants to end it all. She transcends into another dimension and must face the consequences of her wishes.

metas.name: Blue Light
metas.description: Marcus, all long time friend of The Man checks up on him after semmingly going silent for days on his phone. What has happened to him?

metas.name: On the coincidences of being filmed falling in love
metas.description: A filmmaker uncovers footage of a party where, buried in the background, two people appear to be falling in love, and wonders how many moments like this exist, unnoticed, in tapes nobody has a reason to revisit.

metas.name: The Magic of Movies: Jessie Saves the Day
metas.description: When a young child faces a hospital visit, Jessie, Woody, Buzz and the Toy Story gang set out on a mission to help her feel brave, turning a moment of worry into one of comfort, courage and Disney magic.

metas.name: Genshin Impact: The Final Gift
metas.description: Here lies Alain Guillotin, Founding Director of the Research Institute of Kinetic Energy Engineering, White Cavalier of Protection, Lord-Artificer.  May the waters protect his soul. May he be troubled by suffering no more. May the waters guide his soul safely across to the other shore.  "Regrettably, there's nothing more to say."

metas.name: View from a Window
metas.description: Filmed over a year. This short documentary depicts the changes of the view from a window.  In dedication to the filmmakers cats, Tom and Bowser, who enjoyed watching out of the window.

metas.name: OnlyFans: Inside the Machine
metas.description: Amber Haque reveals how OnlyFans models suffer widespread exploitation and coercion at the hands of their managers.

metas.name: The Dream Seer
metas.description: A young girl becomes the last guardian of dreams in a surreal world where her existence—and the fate of her three sisters—depends on preserving imagination itself.
A universal hotline serves as a channel for the unspoken, where callers send heartfelt messages to the people they long to reach.

metas.name: Sports Illustrated Swimsuit Runway Show
metas.description: The 2026 Sports Illustrated Swimsuit Runway Show brought models, athletes, influencers and celebrities to the catwalk. From pop star Lizzo to social media sensation Alix Earle, the show featured a diverse lineup of familiar faces showing off the latest swimwear trends. See all the runway looks in the gallery below.

metas.name: Checkmate
metas.description: A young man in debt, encounters a psychotic serial killer hell bent on eliminating the weak from today’s society.

metas.name: Breakfast for Dinner, Too
metas.description: Detective Albert Sneeval is tasked with finding the rare sapphire that has been stolen from the new museum that just opened up in town. Through cigarettes, cocaine, and stupidity, the gang of characters join together to find the culprit.

metas.name: Four Paintings by Edward Povey: Unfinished Tea
metas.description: The third interview short in the Four Paintings series with painter Edward Povey. In this short he explores his painting Accomodation, considering how, in many ways, it shouldn't work but somehow does

metas.name: Less Unhappy
metas.description: A gay man and a lesbian who are kicked out of the queer community for their toxicity and decide to try living as a straight couple, on the theory that straight people are dumb and therefore less miserable than smarter gay people.

metas.name: .WAVIEE
metas.description: Raves are the pinnacle of creating safe spaces; houses creative expression through music, fashion, and icons that promote community building. We follow D Waviee, a DJ and a trans icon in the Filipino rave scene, while we get a glimpse of the local rave scene—as she closes the night of queer joy, with her music.

metas.name: Pig in a Wig
metas.description: After being dumped, a dishonest pig gets a wig to help him find a new girlfriend, but the wig turns out to be an alien from outer space that grows bigger each time he tells a lie.

metas.name: cockroach
metas.description: A working student bustles through scorching Manila, pushed to a cycle of exhaustion as the disparities of a distant world of capitalist excess kindle a common tenderness.

metas.name: Veronica's Secret
metas.description: A girl's disappearance spirals into unraveling a dark past and its secrets.

metas.name: Tarfu Bravo Zulu
metas.description: At a lonely outpost on the coast of nowhere, two soldiers of sorts stand guard against civilization.  Or for it — sorry, yeah, for it?

metas.name: CLOUDS
metas.description: A short story about clouds and the child-like wonder

metas.name: Star Spangled Adventures - The Movie!
metas.description: When Liberty the Eagle attempts to chronicle independence in America, she is quickly confronted by Tyrannus, a Crow determined to create oppression in the New Land. Will this fledgling nation fall into tyranny, or achieve freedom for all?

metas.name: It's Nice to Finally Meet You
metas.description: It's Nice to Finally Meet You follows Hannah, a woman who is feeling anxious about meeting the parents. She feels like a failure in every aspect of her life, but she desperately wants to be accepted by this new family. It takes every ounce of courage for her to get to the front door. When she finally does, a surprise is in store for everyone involved. This film is a story about resilience and the power of gifts.

metas.name: TAKEOUT
metas.description: Two friends deal with grief after the death of their other friend.

metas.name: Quantum Entangled
metas.description: When two strangers find themselves connected in bizarre and unusual ways, they learn their souls are entangled at the quantum level.

metas.name: 16 Pages
metas.description: A not so good in his mind director tries to get funding for his new film

metas.name: Separate Roads
metas.description: When former high school sweethearts Daniel and Tyler meet again years after a painful breakup, they're forced to confront the scars of their past - including Tyler's attempt to 'cure' his love through conversion therapy. They try to bury the hatchet and find closure, but old wounds may be too deep to heal.

metas.name: Pet Shop
metas.description: Pet Shop works as an experiment on regret and suffering.  A juxtaposition of a dog in a pet shop and a window. Narrated from the perspective of God, or the Devil, the text recounts discussions a person has had with Him. The person accuses Him of destroying his life. This could be for a sin, a murder, or for falling in love with a person of the same sex.

metas.name: The Tidekeepers
metas.description: Following a group of seaweed harvesters along the Cornish coastline, navigating the changing relationship between coastal communities, food traditions, marine ecosystems, and environmental stewardship.

metas.name: As The Train Passes
metas.description: Tracing the heritage of Indian railways, this documentary explores the evolution of train travel and its lasting impact on people, culture, memory and cinema. A personal documentary short film made entirely on a smartphone.

metas.name: Red Rock Ranch
metas.description: Cyrus Briggs wakes up in a different reality one day and soon discovers the truth behind this "perfect" world.

metas.name: Superfan No. 1
