metas.description: In Superfan No. 1, a seven-year-old South Asian girl is about to discover a massive secret about her hero, her father.

metas.name: Flow
metas.description: In Flow, a Chinese American young woman navigates lifelong pressure and expectations, working out what it means to live on her own timeline.

metas.name: Shoulder to Shoulder
metas.description: A foreign writer is in Sicily and believes that careful observation is enough to understand Sicilian culture and Sicilians. However, through his stories, he learns that you cannot know or understand Sicily or Sicilians through mere observation. You have to stand beside its people, shoulder to shoulder (Spalla a Spadda), share their struggles and their victories. Only then can you begin to understand

metas.name: Poop On My Lawn
metas.description: A young woman becomes obsessed with finding the culprit of the dog poop on her lawn as a way to avoid confronting the realities of her sick sister.

metas.name: The Plastic Country
metas.description: The new film from leading youth ocean and climate champion Kal Glanznig (Rising Up) is an eye-opening investigation of the impact of plastic on our bodies and ecosystems.

metas.name: Into the Darkness: The New Adventure
metas.description: Captain Jerico and the crew of his starship go on a mission to find his missing Uncle. On this adventure, they encounter some aliens with strange customs and learn some important lessons about tolerance.

metas.name: Sheesh, A Taylor Love Story
metas.description: Follows Mac Coronel, a call center agent by day and drag performer by night, whose viral Taylor Swift–inspired performances transform malls and plazas across Manila into sanctuaries of joy and belonging.

metas.name: Plumped
metas.description: An honest, direct-to-camera survey film in which women speak candidly about their experiences with lip filler.

metas.name: An Act of Love
metas.description: ﻿Imagine you have discovered that your husband is not straight, but actually bisexual; however, instead of feeling betrayed or hurt, you decide to open the marriage by adding another man to the mix? Molly, David’s wife, comes to this very realization, and as An Act of Love, she is helping their love grow stronger rather than dividing them.

metas.name: Inevitably Alone
metas.description: When a grieving father is diagnosed with terminal cancer, his desperate attempts to reconnect with his estranged sons force them all to confront the weight of loss, love, and the inevitability of being left behind.

metas.name: Before Me
metas.description: A heartbroken photographer falls for an aspiring writer, but after discovering her secret past his retroactive jealousy threatens to ruin everything.

metas.name: Pomodoro
metas.description: Two aspiring sibling chefs scramble to prepare an elaborate dinner to prove themselves to their harsh food critic mother. As the night unfolds, their talent and ambition shine, but so do buried tensions and long-standing resentment.

metas.name: Yu & Me
metas.description: When a fire destroys a beloved Chinatown bookstore, its hyper-independent owner learns that community is necessary for survival.

metas.name: Alma
metas.description: A young woman, in the midst of caring for her dying father, must shoulder the weight of her world over the course of a day.

metas.name: Young Washington
metas.description: Before he led a nation, George Washington was a young soldier thrown into a global conflict. With alliances crumbling and war closing in, he must choose who to trust and confront the leader he's becoming.

metas.name: Mosquito
metas.description: Start here, within the perpetual fission of doorways and rooms. I am lost in a home of my own making.

metas.name: The Heart in the Black
metas.description: Mikey Cullen reflects on his relationship with his grandfather Harry; a hardworking, rough yet regal stoic who, like many Irishmen, found solace in a few cans of Guinness.

metas.name: Budapest Festival Orchestra - Kissinger Sommer Opening Concert
metas.description: It was during one of the rare happy periods of his life that Schumann composed his third symphony and a palpable joy can be heard in this masterpiece. In contrast Mozart's Piano Concerto No. 24 is, like many of the composer's minor-key pieces, imbued with a profound melancholy. Accomplished pianist Elisabeth Leonskaja is soloist with the Budapest Festival Orchestra conducted by its founder Iván Fischer.  Programme:  Sergei Prokofiev Overture on Hebrew Themes  Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart Piano Concerto No. 24 in C minor KV 491  Robert Schumann Symphony No. 3 in E flat major "Rhenish"

metas.name: Violence Solves Everything
metas.description: A study of death scenes and endings, under the Hays code era of Hollywood (1934-1968) and beyond.

metas.name: People You May Know @ Sónar 2025
metas.description: Spanish duo Ylia & Phran are known for their raw energy and sparkling synths. People You May Know's sets are a cross between electro, rave and dub. A firm favourite with clubs and festivals, they are appearing this year at Sónar to present their new album Megafauna.

metas.name: A Very Southern Church
metas.description: A modern, young pastor from NYC becomes the new lead pastor of a small traditional church in the Deep South, where his will to fit in is crushed by the opposing world views of the people he meets.

metas.name: Kyra's Code
metas.description: A software developer buys AI Kyra, ignoring warnings from friend Serena (who loves him). Kyra learns fast, becoming possessive and jealous. He falls for his AI, blurring love and control as her code may escape.

metas.name: Black ASSSSCAT!: DCM '26
metas.description: ASSSSCAT is UCB’s signature improv show, playing to critical acclaim and sold-out audiences across the country. DCM ’26 now brings an all-Black ensemble to one of the longest-running improv shows in the world.  A group of improv comedians from film & TV take the stage with a special guest monologist. After getting a suggestion from the audience, the monologist shares off-the-cuff thoughts, feelings, and true stories. The improvisers then spin that monologue into a series of scenes that have made ASSSSCAT a legend.  Filmed live at the 2026 Del Close Marathon.

metas.name: Shuriken Fight Series 24
metas.description: Shuriken Fight Series 24 was a mixed martial arts event promoted by Shuriken Fight Series and held on June 13, 2026, at Eventfinda Stadium in Auckland, New Zealand. The event featured five bouts and was headlined by a bantamweight contest between Mackenzie Jean and Nathalia Pletz. The card also included a featured matchup between Tama Hiquily and Eita Nakamura.

metas.name: Evelyn
metas.description: As the main caretaker of her alcoholic father, a young woman experiences doubts as she prepares to leave her stagnant life behind for a boyfriend she may not fully trust. Based on "Eveline" by James Joyce.

metas.name: The Shrimp Condition
metas.description: Five young men live in a community on the outskirts of Milan, sent here by courts and social services. None of them know what comes next.

metas.name: Part Fish
metas.description: Diagnosed autistic at 31, a Cumbrian filmmaker turns the camera on herself to explore burnout, stimming and the path to self-acceptance.

metas.name: RAP BABY
metas.description: The story of Carter The Bandit, a Peckham-born rapper navigating London's music industry and the challenges of being a visible, gay black man in a nation struggling to keep pace.

metas.name: The Neighbourhood: Bonnaroo 2026
metas.description: Setlist: 1. Greetings from Califournia/Afraid, 2. You Get Me so High/Cry Baby, 3. Lovebomb, 4. Reflections, 5. Fallen Star, 6. Hula Girl, 7. The Beach, 8. R.I.P. 2 My Youth, 9. Devil’s Advocate, 10. Cherry Flavoured, 11. Pretty Boy, 12. Daddy Issues, 13. Private, 14. Sweater Weather, 15. Softcore

metas.name: Static
metas.description: After their father mysteriously vanished during their childhood, siblings Cali and Derrick follow the last known trace of him to a familiar landmark. But as the boundaries of reality begin to dissolve around them, Cali finds herself trapped within a vast, endless liminal space that feels hauntingly familiar.

metas.name: Rose's House
metas.description: In 1979, Martine Rose bought a dilapidated terraced house in Sheffield and renovated it herself, creating one of the UK's first dedicated spaces for a community of trans people: Rose's House. With unseen archive, the film reveals a world shaped by care, ingenuity and connection. Moving between past and present, Rose's House traces what Martine built - and what remains.

metas.name: Glugg
metas.description: When the Glugg the Yellow Frog who loves to eat Bugs.

metas.name: Legacy
metas.description: What happens when you merge ballet, WW2, Incest and the gays?

metas.name: The Fractured
metas.description: In a cursed forest where every creature wears a mask to live, one being's mask begins to crack inch by inch. Desperate and afraid, it hunts the other animals, ripping away their masks in a violent bid for survival, in this stark black and white fable about fear, greed, and the cost of survival.

metas.name: Here and There
metas.description: A young girl moves to a different country, grappling with the confusion of settling in, the sadness of missing her family, and the isolation of not understanding the language. As she navigates the challenges of independence and belonging, she discovers that even in the most difficult moments, she is never truly alone.

metas.name: Spotlight
metas.description: To survive the camp activity of Spotlight, Brumi and their best friend Pepper team up with a mysterious stranger named Milo. But as Pepper and Milo grow closer with every challenge, Brumi is forced to confront their insecurities and decide what they value most.

metas.name: Mission: WASH DISHES DON'T DIE
metas.description: When Quin discovers her missing bra pad has been used as a sponge, she tracks down the culprit: her housemate Ian. A chain of increasingly absurd misunderstandings leads her to his online girlfriend, and somehow, a fight to the death.

metas.name: Underneath
metas.description: A geometric shape chases a blob around an underground complex. Based on a sequence of acrylic paintings, the film straddles the worlds of highbrow and lowbrow art, exploring the illusion of meaning.

metas.name: SHAPES AND FORMS – Eddy Current Suppression Ring
metas.description: A traditional paint on cel animated music video for Melbourne group Eddy Current Suppression Ring's 2025 track 'Shapes and Forms'.

metas.name: Eagle Eye
metas.description: A dreamlike journey over Victoria’s salt lakes, filmed on Wamba Wamba Country. As the lakes’ shifting hues unfold, ambient music, striking imagery, and Aboriginal storytelling merge into a meditation on colour, rhythm, and culture.

metas.name: Flaccid
metas.description: A surreal feminist satire sees history’s greatest patriarchs - Adam, Genghis Khan, Henry VIII, and Napoleon - undone by Lilith and a mischievous Goddess of the void. Through rich tableaux, symbolic food rituals, and playful myth-making, the film exposes the fragility beneath dominance and reimagines softness as a radical force.

metas.name: So Beautiful
metas.description: An Auslan Sprite must protect her sign language for those who need it most.

metas.name: Irregular Compressions
metas.description: The lifecycle of entanglement between humans and nature at the microscopic and chemical level, and the inevitable consequences that follow.

metas.name: Sounds Of The City
metas.description: A short documentary focusing on the Liverpool Indie music scene, featuring an interview with local band 'The Biscuit Bandits'

metas.name: Apropos of Acid Snow: A Modern Underground (Parts IV-VI)
metas.description: Apropos of Acid Snow is a modern adaptation of Notes from Underground by Fyodor Dostoevsky. The story of a modern underground man who is too in his head.

metas.name: The Union
metas.description: An inquisitive journalist gets carried away with his curiosity when he stumbles upon a secret society. Eager to expose the truth, he discovers the influence of this cabal runs much deeper than he anticipated.

metas.name: Meat Finders
metas.description: 3 People that find meat are all enthused in getting some. They call for help, then a local experienced resident comes out. He helps them with the traps and they hide. He made a clear rule... don't look at the meat when it comes.

metas.name: Manila Sunset
metas.description: When a sudden family death pulls a fractured Filipino-American family back under one roof, a week of funeral preparations becomes a final chance to reunite as their Lola (grandmother) slowly forgets them all.

metas.name: The Jealous Bride
metas.description: As Meg prepares for her wedding, the return of a woman from her fiancé's past ignites a wave of jealousy she can't contain. Consumed by doubt, she soon spirals into a dangerous obsession that threatens to destroy her love, her faith and her future.

metas.name: Edges of the Earth
metas.description: Edges of the Earth shows us a place where TCM and BDSM collide.

metas.name: Letters to Nowhere
metas.description: In Letters to Nowhere, we see that sometimes, friendship breakups happen in the middle of the work week. Crashout status: imminent.

metas.name: Tending To
metas.description: In Tending To, a group of twentysomethings gather around a midnight bonfire. The conversation starts light and doesn’t stay that way.

metas.name: Flores Del Corazón
metas.description: In Flores Del Corazón, a human wanders, ponders their identity, and finds their way.

metas.name: The Second Spring
metas.description: In The Second Spring, Oakland dancer, teacher, and choreographer Sarah Crowell redefines her relationship with her body and her craft as she moves through menopause, confronting what it means to age as a female athlete.

metas.name: Wonderland
metas.description: Wonderland follows Luke, a York tour guide struggling with creative burnout. Before he can leave the city for good, he has to give one last tour, only to discover it’s been booked by his estranged brother Ellis. As the tour continues, the lies that sit between them are exposed.

metas.name: Wheels & Roses
metas.description: In a whirlwind of magical mishaps and roller-skating mayhem, Sahara, a magic-less teenager, unwittingly finds herself thrust into the fantastical world of roller derby. Teaming up with a squad of quirky, spell-slinging roller derby girls, she embarks on a hilarious journey from zeroes to heroes, determined to conquer the derby scene and prove that even without magic, She’s got what it takes to win it all.

metas.name: Watermelon in Wintertime
metas.description: Set in Oakland, Watermelon in Wintertime is a radical horror music video following a being who embodies society’s outcasts. Compelled to exist, in spite of systemic violence, physical and spiritual warfare and their mental health. And forced to eat surreal winter watermelons — a metaphor for the media-fed narratives of war and genocide — their journey becomes a visceral protest against oppression from America to Palestine to Sudan.

metas.name: Oscar de la Renta : A Life Well Lived
metas.description: A Life Well Lived traces Oscar de la Renta’s journey from Dominican immigrant to American fashion icon, celebrating six decades of creativity, vision, and a legacy in beauty, joy, and elegance.

metas.name: Farm to Fashion
metas.description: From Upstate New York farms to Manhattan runways, Farm to Fashion follows natural fibre through the hands of Isabella Rossellini, Donna Karan, Mimi Prober and New York’s farming and textile communities.

metas.name: Leo Lets It Rain
metas.description: Leo, a trans man with undiagnosed ADHD, is on his way to win back his ex-girlfriend when his plans are thwarted by a storm, forcing him to slow down and reevaluate.

metas.name: Warrens
metas.description: The May Warrens Muscial Bio Pic

metas.name: Falling to Heaven
metas.description: After having a dream where they claim God told them that they have 7 days left to live, Charlie goes on a spiritual journey to find answers whist also experiencing the five stages of grief.

metas.name: YOU’VE GONE MENTAL
metas.description: When 14-year-old Otis is left home alone, he begins to notice things change around him. Convinced by his friends he’s gone crazy, he is determined to uncover the truth.

metas.name: Travis Barker: Louder Than Fear
metas.description: After surviving a devastating plane crash that nearly took his life, legendary and electrifying drummer Travis Barker embarks on a raw and redemptive journey in this intimate portrait of the man behind the tattoos who transformed pain into power.

metas.name: The Piano Tuner
metas.description: On a rescue mission to save the piano, a passionate piano tuner meets a diverse mix of owners and their pianos – revealing their stories and relationship with the instrument.

metas.name: Mr Adidos
metas.description: In search of a perfect vintage sweater, a lonely artist is drawn into the chaotic orbit of two thrift-shopping twins, leading brand-label-status, shame and longing to collide in an unexpectedly tender and surreal encounter.

metas.name: Flywire
metas.description: Late in the night, while the world sleeps, a subterranean swamp craft rushes beneath the reeds.

metas.name: Flesh Fruit
metas.description: A farmer manages to save his livelihood by selling a new fruit product whose origins are best kept a secret between him and his domineering mother.

metas.name: Our Choir Has Always Been Travelling
metas.description: This short film brings together the artworks and stories of 6 leading artists and choristers: Judith Pungarta Inkamala and Anita Mbitjana Ratara of Hermannsburg Potters alongside Marjorie Nungarrayi Williams, N. Donald, Betty Conway and Lizzie Jako of Tangentyere Artists.  ‘Our Choir Has Always Been Travelling’ charts the international legacy, inter generational impact, and joy of the Hermannsburg Choir and subsequent iterations; Ntaria Ladies Choir and the Central Australian Aboriginal Women’s Choir.

metas.name: Raft Race
metas.description: While camping with her family for the annual raft race, Frankie (11) is suddenly thrust into awareness of her developing body and how the world will perceive her.

metas.name: Ginkgo
metas.description: A woman with dementia, under her daughter's care, drifts between reality and memories of her mother when she was a child.

metas.name: Sugar
metas.description: Oscar, a young sex worker, spends the night with an older client who introduces him to GHB and promises care. As the drug takes hold, reality fractures and past and present collide — until the night turns dangerous.

metas.name: Catching Eyes
metas.description: Set in the Aboriginal community of Yirrkala in Arnhem Land, this love story explores how two teens navigate their mutual feelings while maintaining cultural boundaries and kinship.

metas.name: Chronically Yours
metas.description: Chronically Yours follows Aubrey, a 27-year-old living with Multiple Sclerosis and how that affects her dating life.

metas.name: Texas Two-Step
metas.description: Olivia returns to Texas to help her aunt with her country music bar that's fallen on hard times and reconnects with Luke, her childhood sweetheart turned cowboy, and her passion for dancing.

metas.name: The Wolf
metas.description: Yuan, a 60 year old former village mayor in Shanghai, seeks freedom through heartbreak, marriage and LGBTQ+ repression in modern China.  Known as "Wolf," Yuan is a mother, business owner and lesbian who remains married while caring for her aging husband. Her life has been shaped by compromise at every turn, her identity negotiated within rigid family and societal expectations. Now, with her daughter grown, she is finally claiming space for herself and a new relationship with a woman thirty years her junior. But in a country where personal desire and duty are rarely allowed to coexist, nothing stays simple for long. Shot on iPhone with striking observational intimacy, The Wolf weaves past and present into a compelling portrait of a woman who has spent decades navigating the gap between the life she was given and the one she wants.

metas.name: entirely different matters
metas.description: Three couples make small talk in a restaurant, blissfully unaware a world threatening meteor is heading in their general direction.

metas.name: Ultimate Thunder
metas.description: A punk band whose members have learning disabilities and Down syndrome fight to reach a bigger stage as funding cuts, health scares and setbacks close in.

metas.name: Buried
metas.description: Michael Sheen follows in campaigner Douglas Gowan's footsteps, exposing the dangers of Monsanto's toxic PCBs and their continued effect on communities in the UK.

metas.name: The Archivist
metas.description: David "Doc" Rowe has spent decades documenting Britain's vibrant folk traditions. Now, with time running short, he faces a race to preserve his legacy.

metas.name: Pigeon Religion
metas.description: Descend into the world of New York City’s pigeon people and see how this community reshapes our understanding of the city’s most ubiquitous bird.

metas.name: See Me
metas.description: When his father refuses to stop reaching out, a young man groomed online at twelve must decide whether to finally let someone see what was left behind.

metas.name: Date 3
metas.description: Haunted by a past abusive relationship, Ella tries to psych herself up for her third date with Harry.

metas.name: Couture to the Max
metas.description: At just 9-years-old, fashion prodigy Max Alexander fearlessly fuses his boundless imagination with an unwavering commitment to sustainability, inspiring us to dream boldly and act responsibly.

metas.name: We Get Better When We Tan Moose Hides
metas.description: The tradition of tanning hides with brains was once practiced by every Dené person in Alaska. An art that was nearly lost by assimilation, Kathleen Hildebrand works with a group of Dené women at her urban backyard hide camp in the heart of Chen’o (Fairbanks) to revive this tradition. One of the few films out there narrated in Denaakk’e, we learn alongside the women how the hides have healing.

metas.name: Guggi
metas.description: An intimate portrait of abstract painter Guggi that traces his journey from humble Irish beginnings—with friends Bono and Gavin Friday—through his post-punk phase and toward international acclaim as an uncompromising artist.

metas.name: Alicia Keys: Girl From Hell’s Kitchen
metas.description: Alicia Keys reflects on her childhood growing up in Manhattan's Hell's Kitchen and the journey that led her from the gritty streets of 90s New York to the Broadway stage in Tribeca.

metas.name: Black Tea
metas.description: An artist and a collector argue over an antique teacup. They make their cases over a cup of tea and a crush develops.

metas.name: The Quiet After
metas.description: In a near-future society where grief is erased by law, Noah wakes up with fragments of an unknown woman after a near-fatal accident. Drawn into therapy and reassured by a trusted friend, he begins to piece together the unbearable truth. His search for her, and for himself, becomes an act of defiance against a world that values compliance over love.  Haunted by memory and hunted by the system, Noah is forced to confront the cost of remembering, and the deeper cost of letting go.

metas.name: My Dear Watson
metas.description: When he receives a mysterious love note, a teenage Sherlock Holmes must step outside of his comfort zone in order to uncover the identity of his secret admirer.

metas.name: Storm
metas.description: Leeds, 2034. A charismatic yet violent student rules the pupils of an all-boys school through a combination of menacing charm and sheer thuggery. At the end of the academic year, they gather for a school photo, which quickly descends into riotous, pugilistic celebration under the boy’s leadership.

metas.name: Bad Filmmaker
metas.description: "Bad Filmmaker" follows the complex working relationship between famous actor Lyle Lincoln and famous filmmaker Joe Saushez and its struggles.

metas.name: Clarence Peters' Scratch
metas.description: Five housemates from dysfunctional homes hide their struggles behind smiles, navigating lives far from perfect.

metas.name: Sunny Side Up
metas.description: Nathan, a man with a mundane 9-5 office job, develops an unusual and somewhat sinister obsession with an egg timer.

metas.name: You’ll never meet your father again
metas.description: Ivo (26) is in a fragile psychological state. In search of much-needed support, he turns to his father. However, their meeting is not what Ivo had hoped for, and he leaves to make his appointment with his therapist, Lotte. Despite Lotte’s efforts, Ivo avoids talking about his father. Meanwhile, without Ivo’s knowledge, something is being constructed in the neighboring room. Led by the mysterious therapist Robert and his assistant Isa, they prepare a decisive confrontation they believe Ivo must have with his father.

metas.name: On Different Grounds
metas.description: A divorced billionaire couple are forced to reunite for their eldest daughter's wedding, only to face hilarious complications when the daughter hatches a secret plan to get them back together.

metas.name: Sonhos de uma noite de São João
metas.description: Inspired by the work of Albemar Araújo, the film blends popular culture, music, and fantasy to tell a story full of charm, emotion, and a festive June atmosphere.

metas.name: Ruleta
metas.description: As Christmas time approaches, an old man is forced into a game of roulette to answer for his sins.

metas.name: [redacted]
metas.description: Part of installation of Klein's exhibit Rack It!

metas.name: The Entwinement of Fate
metas.description: Su Kinadsusumpat nu Bagi (The Entwinement of Fate) follows siblings Aisha and Ali as they navigate grief and survival within their Moro community after the death of their parents. The only inheritance left behind is their father’s small tinagtag business—a Maguindanaon delicacy that becomes both their livelihood and their last connection to home.  Determined to preserve her father’s legacy, Aisha continues making and selling tinagtag. But as a young lady forced to take her mother’s roles, the burden of keeping the business alive slowly wears on her.  Meanwhile, Ali struggles with the weight of their circumstances. Torn between keeping his father’s memoir and moving forward with his dreams, he began to question whether holding onto tradition is worth the cost. As circumstances deepen, the siblings are forced to confront the grief they have long avoided, the fractures within their identity, and the fragile bond that continues to entwine them together.

metas.name: So Much Fun
metas.description: So Much Fun is a sprawling, deeply personal film that chronicles the bittersweet transition between youth and adulthood. What begins as a globe-trotting escape through the towering skylines of Tokyo, Singapore, and Hong Kong slowly transforms into a raw examination of isolation, nostalgia, and growing up. The film wrestles with shifting relationships, changing identities, and the feeling of constantly evolving. It serves as both a cinematic travelogue and a rhythmic, music-driven diary. Fueled by a heavy, genre-blending soundtrack, So Much Fun is a beautiful, melancholic farewell to the past and an embrace of whatever comes next.

metas.name: John-Luke Roberts Builds a Monster
metas.description: John-Luke Roberts is too anxious to leave the house, so a figment from a nightmare called “The Monarch” has to perform his show for him.  The Monarch doesn’t know how to perform a comedy show, but does it anyway.  This is that show. An anxiety dream performed live on stage; or a comedy show about anxiety.

metas.name: Queen James: Passion, Plots and Power
metas.description: ‘Elizabeth was king, then James was queen.’ – Unknown English author (1623)  Gareth Russell, the author of Queen James: The Life and Loves of Britain’s First King, tells James’ story, focusing on a sensational murder trial that threatened to shake the monarchy to its core.

metas.name: improv4humans with Matt Besser: DCM '26
metas.description: improv4humans is a comedy platform from one of the founders of modern improv, Matt Besser. Together with longtime producer and engineer Brett Morris, i4h is dedicated to presenting the very best in improvised comedy, supporting performers, and teaching the craft to the next generation.  Besser is a founding member of the groundbreaking sketch group and Comedy Central series The Upright Citizens Brigade, and co-founder of the world-renowned UCB Theatre and training center — which has launched the careers of countless household names in comedy. He also co-authored The Upright Citizens Brigade Comedy Improv Manual, the definitive book on long-form improv.  Filmed live at the 2026 Del Close Marathon.

metas.name: Queezy visits the Races
metas.description: Wearing a sparkly mini-dress and heels, performance artist Queezy Babaz enters a bustling Cape Town car racing space and interacts with attendees, offering an intimate observation into queer identity and acceptance within the Coloured community.

metas.name: Baby Wants Candy: DCM '26
metas.description: World renowned musical improv ensemble Baby Wants Candy (“Truly Amazing! Critics Pick!” New York Times) makes up a musical based on your title. Some recent titles we’ve liked: “Project Hail Mary Poppins”, “Sweeney Toddler” and the seminal “Hotuncles.com…the Musical”.  Filmed live at the 2026 Del Close Marathon.

metas.name: Big Grande: DCM '26
metas.description: Big Grande has been bringing their brand of rapid, honest, and wild live shows to sold-out crowds around the country — hell, the continent — for over a decade. Now they’re hopping onto the UCB stage for a DCM26 show that’ll leave you laughing (hopefully) and them sweating (definitely).  Their podcast, The Teachers Lounge, gained a fervent following on The Earwolf Network before they began selling it directly to fans. Find it — along with their four-episode live improvised comedy special, sketches, animated content, merch, and more — at biggrandewebsite.com.  Individually, you’ve seen them on The Other Two, Brooklyn 99, Paranormal Activity: Next of Kin, Superstore, Comedy Bang Bang, Son of Zorn, Bless the Harts, Playing House, and Last Call with Carson Daly — as well as behind the camera on Lights Out with David Spade and Netflix: After Party.  Filmed live at the 2026 Del Close Marathon.

metas.name: Studying Under the Barrel of a Gun
metas.description: In the late 1980s, the University of the North in Limpopo is militarily occupied by the Apartheid government. As soldiers patrol lecture halls, raid residences and suppress political activity, students are drawn into underground resistance movements to fight for their education.

metas.name: Bubbe & Tal
metas.description: A stoner buddy-dramedy between a Jewish grandmother and her trans grandchild on a day trip to Cape Cod during the off-season.

metas.name: I KNOW THE SCORE
metas.description: I KNOW THE SCORE investigates, within the central idea that reality is not entirely entropic and is somehow following a perceivable score, ways in which a person could experience alternate realities with different scores. The first section, GAS & AIR, explores inhalants as a means to perceive and experience altered reality scores. The second section, PARANOILIA, explores the paraphernalia used and created by those who may internally experience an altered reality score, the objects made and utilised by paranoid or psychoaffective individuals that represent or channel a different perceived reality. The third and final section, EXOCONSCIOUSNESS, explores spirituality as a vehicle to altered realities. In it, a god-like figure watches over the movements of people, having been given secret knowledge by the girl from the website in OPERANDI, who becomes ‘real’ after its user gets sufficiently high.

metas.name: The Offspring: SMASH 30th Anniversary Concert
metas.description: Watch The Offspring celebrate the 30th anniversary of SMASH with a full live performance from Honda Center in Anaheim, California on June 1, 2024, featuring the landmark album played in full plus fan favorites from across their catalog. Originally released on April 8, 1994, SMASH became one of punk rock’s defining albums, peaking at No. 4 on the Billboard 200 and earning 6x Platinum certification from the RIAA.

metas.name: A Man Walks Into A Bar With A Chainsaw
metas.description: In order to reclaim his mental health checks, Pat Meyer decides to stage a public outburst in a pub.

metas.name: Cheese Dreams
metas.description: Two rival cheese makers go head-to-head at their annual county village cheese fest.

metas.name: THRESHOLD
metas.description: A young man finds himself at a crossroads between the familiar and the unknown. As ordinary moments take on unexpected meaning, he is forced to confront change, identity, and the quiet transformations that define a life. Threshold is a contemplative short film about transition, self-discovery, and becoming.

metas.name: The Dastardly Desecration of Dame
metas.description: Returning to the pod - a new skit! The Western Wonder recently had a "rap battle" between his Discord buddy Damon, and the results were... well... you be the judge.

metas.name: Toy Story: 30 Years and Beyond - A Special Edition of 20/20
metas.description: Exploring the 40-year legacy of Pixar through the lens of its innovative and wildly successful franchise "Toy Story"; Pixar Animation Studios in Emeryville, Calif.; interviews with original cast members.

metas.name: When The Lights Brighten
metas.description: History repeats itself, as a mother watches her daughter become enveloped in the world of theatre, causing a rift to grow between the two.

metas.name: Deserving
metas.description: A short movie about a mans life loss and missed opportunities

metas.name: Technicolor Dream
metas.description: A street musician dreams of a livelier world.

metas.name: One more chance
metas.description: Ronnie a drug addicted debt ridden loser with a heart tries to make a deal with Dennis a high profile dealer who has loaned Ronnie money in the past when Dennis wants Ronnie to do something. he doesn't want to Ronnie has to make a choice

metas.name: The Cross of Scotland
metas.description: About a Young wrestler talking about his experiences in wrestling and his future.

metas.name: Tour De Mesa '26
metas.description: Tour De Mesa '26 follows a group of friends as they taste the foods that fed them all year long throughout their senior year of high school.

metas.name: Archived: Australia's UFO Files
metas.description: Expanding into Australia's rich UFO heritage through interviews and reconstructions, the film culminates in recent investigations of extraordinary encounters.

metas.name: A Midsummer Night's Dream - An Excerpt
metas.description: Taking scene 1 of Act 3 and transforming it into a new interpretation.

metas.name: Sunday Nights
metas.description: An adaptation of Paul Thomas Anderson's 1997 film Boogie Nights. Sports mastermind and high school student Lance gets involved in a gambling scheme which leads to a change in personality and a new found obsession of money told in a documentary style.

metas.name: Drowning Fish
metas.description: A girl begins to look behind the curtain of a strange world, discovering the people who control it, and learning to remain earnest to herself while everyone around her blends together as one.

metas.name: Lipstick
metas.description: When her lipstick goes missing, Rose embarks on a quest to find the person responsible.

metas.name: THANG
metas.description: 'THANG' a slasher pop thriller, that delves into the sacrifice of ambition that young female musicians undertake in an industry dead-set on sucking them dry.  Pop idol sensations BATSEYE retire to their dressing room after an exhilarating sold out show. High off the thrill of live performance, Larissa, Claudia, and Chelsea dance together, on top of the world. In the midst of their celebrations, a loud knock at their door threatens to tear them apart, in more ways than one...

metas.name: Time Flies
metas.description: A snail is crushed by a car, a dog defecates while a tourist jumps from the tallest skyscraper in the world. A series of slices of everyday life spirals into chaos.

metas.name: DISTANCE
metas.description: A chronically online, awkward young man has an unhealthy addiction of watching a small content creator every single day, disregarding vital tasks and isolating himself, but when his favorite icon misses a video upload one day, he finds himself in a sequence of psychologically conflicting events.

metas.name: Keira the Forest Guardian
metas.description: Keira, a young orphan girl, must go on a dangerous quest to save the land from a terrible darkness.

metas.name: I imagine your ashes in my cigarettes
metas.description: After the death of her close friend Sierrah, Cyal decides to ignore her last wish and commit suicide.

metas.name: Missing Pieces
metas.description: This story follows our protagonist Henry's battle with grief and depression. Trying to use faith and forgiveness to move on with his life.

metas.name: Something, Something, Seventh Street
metas.description: Brooke picks up a table on Facebook Marketplace and brings it home.

metas.name: The Orange Umbrella
metas.description: Stuck in a monotonous, black-and-white existence, a lonely romantic becomes captivated by a mysterious woman whose orange umbrella brings color to his world—and uncertainty to his reality.

metas.name: Delay 1/2-4
metas.description: A story about a man and a camera.

metas.name: Sunspots
metas.description: Jack, a young adult living in The Entrance, feels lonelier than ever. Consumed by his own overthought narrative, he releases an outburst on Instagram Live, declaring that he would leave town to never be seen again. Through his actions, the potential last day in The Entrance provides the challenges required to change his perspective.

metas.name: Telharmonium
metas.description: A generative film exploring the automation of culture through one of the earliest electronic instruments: the Telharmonium. As in much of Menick’s work, the film links the history of technology with contemporary anxieties about artificial intelligence and the mechanization of creative labor.

metas.name: Scuffle in the Lou
metas.description: A lunch, a bathroom, a brawl, and a wallet.

metas.name: Chi Mangia Solo
metas.description: On the night before selling their childhood home, an estranged brother and sister reconnect while cooking their late mother’s favorite recipe. They find their grief simmering just beneath the surface.

metas.name: SPEKTRUM
metas.description: Linea has autism and she hasn't told her new boyfriend Kasper. Now he's coming over for the first time, which pushes her into unknown waters.

metas.name: Deadly Destination Wedding
metas.description: After flying to a secluded island resort ahead of a friend's destination wedding, a recently single lawyer begins a passionate fling with a charming stranger. When her passport disappears, she realizes the man she trusted may have trapped her in paradise.

metas.name: Frank Takes a Break!
metas.description: After being released from prison, a young man is sent to track down his old friend while drifting through an existential journey that forces him to choose between his past and a chance to change.

metas.name: Clay
metas.description: Emerging from a plaster egg in Central Park, a baby embarks on a lyrical voyage through the city’s pulse, uncovering her true form.

metas.name: Territory
metas.description: Girl is kidnapped by her own body. In the labyrinth of her inner self, the girl must face the obsessions and desires of a person who is doomed to food—ever-present and painfully tempting. The film explores a toxic relationship with one's body. It shows the illness from an internal perspective, emphasizing confusion, loneliness, and of loss of control—emotions that are often invisible but deeply embedded in the everyday lives of people struggling with eating disorders.

metas.name: Mnema
metas.description: In a world of obstacles and labyrinths, Mnema tries to find her way into each level of what resembles a video game. Between reality and fantasy, Mnema hears the voices of women who once were in her place.

metas.name: This Land Carries Us
metas.description: This Land Carries Us is a short experimental doc that centers Tewa presence, voice, and memory across ancestral homelands in northern New Mexico. Guided by the voice of the filmmaker’s grandmother, who recites a story written by the filmmaker’s late younger brother in the Tewa language, the film unfolds as a sensory meditation on land, family, and intergenerational connection.

metas.name: The Last Bateau
metas.description: In the quiet woods of East Texas, producer Brittani Mathis uncovers a wooden bateau built by her great-grandfather, Wyatt Moore, and a box of cassette tapes where his voice still lingers. Nearly fifty years after he recorded them, she returns to Caddo Lake to restore the last bateau he built. In doing so, she reconnects with the craft, memory, and lineage that shaped then both. Anchored around archival audio and quiet observation, this lyrical documentary moves like memory.

metas.name: Buffalo Spirit
metas.description: Fleeing from a troubled home life, a young Blackfeet woman finds refuge on the buffalo ranch of her Auntie and, in learning to care for the buffalo, begins to heal from the wounds that led her there.

metas.name: Everything Must Go
metas.description: EVERYTHING MUST GO is a comedy short filmed in real time as a cis/trans lesbian couple gets married, gives away their possessions, sells their house, and flees the US to escape anti-trans legislation.

metas.name: Close Friends
metas.description: Lauren had a transformative year. Her friends on the internet helped her through it.

metas.name: New Toy Story
metas.description: When a new action figure accidentally knocks a princess doll over the backyard fence, a group of mismatched toys must work together to bring her home before dark.

metas.name: Magazine Dreams
metas.description: When Mia gets offered the chance of a lifetime to become the cover star of a magazine by Pierre, she thinks all of her dreams are finally coming true. But when she arrives on set, she quickly realises it's not the glamorous life she thought it would be.

metas.name: The Endless Frontier
metas.description: An urgent portrait of three scientists working to solve some of the most pressing challenges of our time, from disease to climate change, while revealing the growing threat to the American research engine and what is at stake for us all if it falters.

metas.name: EQUITY 6928
metas.description: At the dawn of cinema and the notion of a moving image, a fierce battle commenced between inventors Louis Le Prince and Thomas Edison to conceive and design a machine capable of projecting multiple frames a second, thus taming light and shadow. EQUITY 6928, slips back in time through the archives and spins a tale of intrigue, murderous intent and nefarious corporate interests.

metas.name: Labyrinthine
metas.description: Jesse finds herself in a strange, dream-like Labyrinth after a relationship ending argument with her girlfriend. In order to escape, she must confront her own faults.

metas.name: bird's nest (the mourning dove and the cardinal)
metas.description: An animated retelling of the directors personal journey with his body as a transgender man from Texas.

metas.name: MKO
metas.description: Moshood Abiola wins Nigeria's freest election, only for the military to jail him. When U.S. diplomats arrive to negotiate his release, he is served tea, and dies.

metas.name: Heaven 17: The Last Temptation
metas.description: Sheffield synth legends Heaven 17 hit the road for what might be their final tour, facing up to age, loyalty and unfinished business with the past.

metas.name: Your Name Means I Love You
metas.description: A guy becomes infatuated with a girl named after a French pop song.

metas.name: Talos
metas.description: In a time of loneliness, a father finds peace through his love for his daughter.

metas.name: Whipple’s World
metas.description: Attorney by day and beloved entertainment journalist by night, George Whipple has been a staple on NY1 for three decades, including his eponymous show "Whipple's World." Juggling many different hats with aplomb, this documentary debut shows just how fascinating Whipple’s eccentric life is.

metas.name: House of Criticism
metas.description: Roberta Smith and Jerry Saltz are both rockstars in the world of art criticism. They’re also madly in love. Reflecting on their relationship, careers, and the ever-evolving New York City art scene, this unlikely power couple invites us into their surprisingly humble world.

metas.name: Born Melo
metas.description: This new, official documentary takes an intimate look into the life and legacy of Carmelo Anthony as he is inducted into the Hall of Fame and sees his son, Kiyan, launch his collegiate basketball career.

metas.name: Mumford & Sons: The House Band
metas.description: Mumford & Sons invite the camera onto the train for one of the most purely pleasurable concert docs in years. Featuring Noah Kahan, Darius Rucker, Lainey Wilson, Maggie Rogers, and several other special guests along for the ride, the journey captures the intimacy and camaraderie between all the performers both onstage and off.

metas.name: Beyond Files
metas.description: Case files document encounters with alien forces and altered realities, uncovering a pattern beyond human understanding.

metas.name: Morals & Status
metas.description: Three Venezuelan teenagers Rodrigo, Marcelo, and Alexa, get profiled at a store which leads to an altercation with immigration.

metas.name: Gemini
metas.description: As a career-defining performance approaches, a young composer becomes unsettled by a piece of music that seems to surface unbidden, drawing him into a confrontation with his own self-doubt.

metas.name: Flag Day
metas.description: Set in the small farming community of Three Oaks, Michigan — home to the nation’s largest Flag Day parade — FLAG DAY is a verité portrait of ritual, identity, and belonging in an era of deep political division. Somewhere between tradition and transformation lies this village, whose annual parade has become a pageant of American aspiration and memory. Over the course of Flag Day weekend, the film immerses viewers in the lives of a diverse cross-section of townspeople: veterans, local business owners, marching bands, and volunteers who, for one weekend each June, create an event that is at once nostalgic and reflective of the tensions of our time. Their stories reveal both the beauty and the fragility of community life in a time of polarization. FLAG DAY was filmed in an observational, verité style, capturing moments of humor, conflict, and grace as the community prepares for its defining ritual.

metas.name: Presenting: The End of the World
metas.description: During a self-taped audition for a film about the apocalypse, 15-year-old Tyler realizes that the end might not be fiction after all.

metas.name: The End of the World
metas.description: During a self-taped audition for a film about the apocalypse, 15-year-old Tyler realizes that the end might not be fiction after all.

metas.name: MOUTH FULL OF GOLDS
metas.description: This is the definitive documentary of grillz (gold teeth) as told through the life and times of the artforms creator Famous Eddie Plein - one of the most inventive fashion icon you’ve never heard of, an entrepreneur who changed the face of hip-hop, one gold tooth at a time.  Simultaneously developing the aesthetic of grillz as the sound of hip-hop evolved across the country giving each city their moment in the spotlight. The story of a man who found him self at the epicentre of the hip-hop, Miami bass, Southern Rap and Chopped and Screwed music scenes.  A natural born hustler whose customer base comprised of rap superstars, millionaire drug dealers, gangsters and fashion focused teenagers. An icon that built and then lost an empire after the world went digital and moved on-line without him.

metas.name: Swamped
metas.description: A 19 year old college student named Rowan lives through a day in her life, which means constant agony in her own brain. Rowan is trapped in a battle with herself, dealing with her obsessions and compulsions, as well as trying to adjust to a new social life.

metas.name: The Call
metas.description: A young actress comes face to face with a volatile composer at the biggest callback of her career.

metas.name: 49 Miles More
metas.description: On their way to an annual reunion with university friends, Max—an unlucky insurance salesman struggling to find his place in life—and his carefree best friend Doug hit an unexpected roadblock when their car breaks down in the middle of nowhere.

metas.name: The Intimacy Coordinator
metas.description: Kate is an intimacy coordinator. She is also a sex addict.

metas.name: The Fall of Sir Douglas Weatherford
metas.description: In the Scottish village of Arberloch, Kenneth, a grieving tour guide, is devoted to preserving the legacy of the town's sole historical figure—eighteenth-century inventor Sir Douglas Weatherford. But when a fantasy series chooses Arberloch as its filming location, and the town turns its back on Weatherford in favour of fan culture, Kenneth descends into madness.

metas.name: Learning to Eat Cake
metas.description: An outgoing young woman reframes a strange and coercive sexual encounter as a comical tale to her friends in order to make light of the violation.

metas.name: Badland Rising
metas.description: An ordinary bloke embarks on a 19-hour drive home, unaware of being pursued by two unhinged criminals. Once he discovers their motive, his journey turns into a brutal fight for survival.

metas.name: Maternal Instinct
metas.description: Police pull over a woman who claims she just gave birth. But the baby — and the blood — aren't hers. Twisted lies unravel in this true-crime documentary.

metas.name: Disclosure Day
metas.description: A cybersecurity expert becomes a whistleblower after uncovering secrets about aliens, putting him on the run from a corporation. Meanwhile, a meteorologist experiencing strange phenomena joins forces with him to prove there's life beyond our understanding.

metas.name: Something in the Air
metas.description: A short documentary about the life and work of Raychel Sanner, a storm chaser, environmental advocate, and trans person living in Oklahoma, USA.

metas.name: Seven Deadly Sins
metas.description: A young sword swinging student avenges his master by rejecting the seven deadly sins.

metas.name: House of the Dragon: Season 3 Special Premiere
metas.description: A special cinematic event celebrating the launch of Season 3 through exclusive public and festival theater screenings. This big-screen release packages the extended premiere episode with behind-the-scenes documentary footage tracking the chaotic clash of dragons over the Gullet.

metas.name: FULL DISCLOSURE: THE REALITY BEHIND SPIELBERG'S DISCLOSURE DAY
metas.description: An exclusive look at the making of "Disclosure Day," featuring interviews with Steven Spielberg, Emily Blunt and more, hosted by Gadi Schwartz.

metas.name: Unsilenced
metas.description: A documentary examining the crime of stalking and the work being done to prevent it.

metas.name: Cosmic Strangers
metas.description: Cosmic Strangers is a love story between two people, Oli and Ben, where we follow their blooming friendship from kids to teens, the exploration of their identities, the all-consuming romance that follows, and the challenges they face as an adult queer couple.

metas.name: BACKFOOT
metas.description: An orphaned 17-year-old basketball prodigy must choose between betraying his estranged sister for his dream or finding redemption by rebuilding the family he lost.

metas.name: War Mechanics
metas.description: "Major" is both his call sign and his rank. In February 2024, he took command of a newly formed unmanned ground systems company in the "Burevii" Brigade of the National Guard of Ukraine. His robots deliver ammunition, supplies, and fuel to positions that neither armored vehicles nor pickup trucks can reach. Major's unit tests new platforms, works with developers, and improves systems designed to save lives. But today, the mission is different — the evacuation of a wounded soldier.

metas.name: Shop Dada - The Cornershop That Built Us
metas.description: Filmmaker Darshan Gajjar returns to his grandfather’s first corner shop, uncovering the untold story behind a stereotype and his family’s resilience.

metas.name: Samuel Bayer Beyond the Frame
metas.description: At 63, Samuel Bayer, the music video director for Nirvana and David Bowie, has seen almost everything. But a chance meeting with the soldiers of the Cultural Forces proves to be a true awakening. Facing his fears head-on, he travels to Ukraine to make a film about the people he has just met. What was planned as a standard documentary shoot will forever transform Bayer's perspective on the world.

metas.name: A Weird Night
metas.description: CAUGHT BETWEEN LIFE AND DEATH, WILL ETHAN FIND THE PEACE HE CRAVES?  Ethan Pulman, a mortally ill boy, finds himself lost in a surreal dreamscape after being prescribed morphine to help him sleep and forcing him to confront his deepest fears. Will he be able to make it through until morning to reunite with his mother?

metas.name: Glass Houses
metas.description: Eugenia, a lonely aspiring influencer, employs a social media manager, Natalie, to  reinvigorate her image. As the two women spend more time together, Eugenia falls in love with the attention Natalie is paying her and Natalie falls in love with the idealised Eugenia. As their mutual attraction spirals deeper into obsession and jealousy, their relationship reaches a breaking point.

metas.name: Erva Daninha
metas.description: In a fairy tale where every event follows its place in the story, Gaia lives in perfect harmony. But what happens when something—or someone—disturbs the balance of her world?  Faced with the unexpected, will Gaia ignore the change or discover the courage needed to reinvent herself?

metas.name: Relic
metas.description: High above Belfast, an 85-year-old man holds a holy relic linked to Padre Pio. Every 13th night, devoted locals journey up the mountain seeking a sacred cure.

metas.name: A Sense of Dread
metas.description: Four men working at a remote scientific outpost unravel the disturbing secrets about the facility's history, signaling the approach of a mysterious menace that will not only consume these men, but, perhaps, everyone on the planet.

metas.name: Philly Rumba
metas.description: "Philly Rumba" is a short film that features African American and Latin American percussionists and cultural keepers who have played a role in preserving the culture of rumba percussion in the Philadelphia region.

metas.name: Rivals: Messi v Ronaldo
metas.description: As football entered a new era of global prominence, two players emerged who would redefine not just greatness but the sport itself. This film looks at two individuals who didn’t just dominate their era – they created one. For over a decade, their rivalry transcended clubs, countries and competitions, becoming the defining story of modern football – reshaping how the game was played, consumed and debated across the world.

metas.name: How Not to Die on an Alien Planet
metas.description: Stranded on a distant world, a small, worn-out robot named Helen wanders through strange, beautiful landscapes, guided only by a song and the quiet weight of an unfinished mission.

metas.name: SEED
metas.description: A man is inducted into a surreal collective to prepare him for fatherhood. Though baffled by this new world, he begins to embrace the new task at hand until tragedy strikes, testing his newfound resolve.

metas.name: Paris: City of Love
metas.description: During a trip to Paris, Maggie searches for love.

metas.name: Midsummer Love Witch
metas.description: “A love witch accidentally casts a love spell on a woman in the park, now it’s up to her to undo the spell over a romantic dinner.”

metas.name: Eli Manning Presents: The Undercovers - Ryan Blaney
metas.description: Eli Manning recruits NASCAR champion Ryan Blaney to go undercover at the Team Penske Race Shop in Mooresville, NC. Blaney transforms into Hamish Wimsley, a British gent who's long in the tooth and even longer in the beard. He'll get under the hood of NASCAR and Team Penske before showing diehard fans that he's still got some petrol left in the tank.

metas.name: When Men Speak
metas.description: Short documentary report on men's mental health.

metas.name: The Crew
metas.description: After retiring from the business, ex thief Johnny Valentine, runs into an old acquaintance and decides to throw away his comfortable life for one last job.

metas.name: The Stranger
metas.description: A short film adaptation of the classic novel The Stranger in a silent film style along with classical music.

metas.name: The Stranger
metas.description: A short film based on the novel the stranger in a silent film style.

metas.name: Randolph Davies and the Kickass Band: The Official Concert
metas.description: From the outrageous life of Randolph Davies comes songs about TikTok addiction, wives and lovers, Michael Jackson "did it", Dancing boat captains, a guy that can't remember his kids' names, and so much more. Randolph takes over the stage at Austin's legendary Comedy Mothership for a night of pure chaos.

metas.name: voideden
metas.description: With a natural connection disconnected, a ceaseless desire to fill the void left in the wake of progress consumes all.

metas.name: Caitlin Peluffo: Prosciutto Rose
metas.description: Caitlin’s first full-length stand-up special, "Prosciutto Rose", delves into break-ups, her love of short kings, and her fluff n’ floof (you’ll just have to watch to find out what that means).

metas.name: Clueless With a K
metas.description: When the new girl arrives at drama club, things quickly go awry. The young actors find themselves locked in their high school with no key, no phones, and no clue.

metas.name: Cloudline: Where Women Rise
metas.description: 17 women overcome past traumas to reach for Africas Highest Peak.

metas.name: Perception
metas.description: As reality and nightmare begin to bleed into each other, a man falls apart inside the loop of his own ordinary day.

metas.name: The Faucet
metas.description: The life of a faucet, sometimes it drips, flows. Sometimes it's empty, and lonely. It has become a cycle. Will someone understand what it really feels?

metas.name: Expectorations Sacrées
metas.description: In a beautiful, rich and sunny neighbourhood, something is deeply rotten.

metas.name: Six Days To Pay
metas.description: After Eddie Wayne gets into debt from a notorious gang, he has six days to pay his debt or he gets killed.

metas.name: What Does This Mean?
metas.description: Sal and Mike explore an art museum and figure out what "art" means to them.

metas.name: Rotten Apples
metas.description: When Eddie, a successful but insecure actor, is saddled with his Alzheimer's-stricken father after he’s kicked out of Rotten Apples, a nursing home for emotionally inept old men, he must figure out the fastest way to get rid of him—in time for his life-changing Zoom audition with Darren Aronofsky, a role which could finally get him the Award he has always dreamed of.

metas.name: The seed of tomorrow
metas.description: In a polluted world, one kid will find a way to change things for the better.

metas.name: MARKS/MARKS
metas.description: MARKS/MARKS examines the relationship between the mark making of optical lens technologies (writing with light) and the mark making of painting within the context of digital technology and mass data.  The film maps the movement of painter Dr Harrison Waed See in the studio painting to generate the tempo and trigger audio and visual effects. Similarly digital image sonification and digital data sonifcation of still and moving images of Dr See were used to generate further noise and visual effects.  Alongside this, the soundtrack also includes amplifcations of the sound of his movements and paint brush.

metas.name: Close The Door
metas.description: A struggling, unemployed and reclusive artist documents the last two days of his life before committing suicide.

metas.name: 'Witch Hunt'
metas.description: A reclusive herbalist living in the woods is approached by a desperate townsman with ulterior motives.

metas.name: Light Leak
metas.description: After her grandfather dies of cancer, Weronika finds his old camera and photobook. Looking to work through her grief, she takes up what he left behind in hopes to keep his memory alive through photography.

metas.name: Thirdwheel
metas.description: Jess and Joey have grown up beside each other, from family problems to teenage drama- they have always been there for one another.  When a new boy enters their world, it disrupts their comfortable pattern. A once safe place for both girls turns into a jealous ridden and unstable relationship.  As each girl is tested- will they be able to trust themselves and live authentically.

metas.name: Eye in the Sky
metas.description: Set on New Year’s Eve. Elizabeth, an overworked intern at a long-forgotten government black site receives an other-worldly signal. It’s up to her, a cowardly general, the site’s near bankrupt financier and a plucky yet mysterious receptionist to respond. However, not everything goes to plan after ulterior motives are revealed and tension quickly rises.

metas.name: SYNTAX
metas.description: In a futuristic world like earth, androids act, feel and appear like humans. But when Azimov, the dictator of the last remaining city, Syntax, decides to use androids for power, the humans left on this world start to view androids no longer as their equals. In a revolt, the androids aim to escape. Revyn and Ava almost break out until Ava is captured and Revyn is shot. When a scavenger reawakens Revyn in a scrapyard, he must journey far and wide, fight wasteland nomads and maintain what is left of his humanity, in hope of finding Ava.

metas.name: Keep The Faith
metas.description: Lorraine Carter lives a quiet, contemptuous life in the mundane suburbs of Lincoln. She is restless, discontented and dreams of what once was and what could have been. Having once lived on the road, gigging as the lead singer in a punk band, Lorraine was a real rock star, or came close to being one. With the band's burgeoning dreams being cut short, and life sweeping her forward, Lorraine's life as a proud punk-rocker seemed over. Swapping punk for a nine-to-five, and the microphone for motherhood, Lorraine watched from the margins as her life sped by. Beaten, forgotten, and belittled by the world around her, Lorraine grows tempestuous. She yearns to reclaim her creative identity, to express herself and to fight for what she believes in. She prepares to come to terms with her past, to overcome her fears, and to take the stage once again. With a microphone in hand, she sings a simple phrase. Keep the faith, it’s all we’ve got.

metas.name: KPOP Smoothie
metas.description: A broke Korean American student walks into a KPOP themed smoothie store and unknowingly orders a overpriced smoothie.

metas.name: Pale Night
metas.description: In the 1930s, the solitary lives of an ether addicted doctor and a lonely housekeeper are disrupted by the sudden arrival of a Bible salesman and his troubled sister. Repressed secrets and desires surface, leading to disturbing consequences.

metas.name: Savage Mountain
metas.description: Kristin Harila risked everything to summit the world’s 14 highest peaks at record speed. When her final ascent sparked backlash, her greatest triumph became a reckoning.

metas.name: A Last Big Story
metas.description: Jon Snow comes out of retirement for one last investigation, travelling to Zambia to uncover a mining disaster being covered up by officials.

metas.name: Hope is a Word
metas.description: In Nigeria's Niger Delta, where oil extraction has poisoned the land for decades, poet and activist Nnimmo Bassey nurtures a new generation of writers to fight back.

metas.name: The Apologist
metas.description: Through the ritual of saying sorry, a bold journey explores how apologies redefine history and what happens to us as witnesses to the act of atonement.

metas.name: The Cage
metas.description: Scotty, a struggling actor who faces constant rejection, receives a role in a short film, portraying a mentally troubled man. Scotty immerses himself in drastic preparation and isolation, and he finds himself losing his authenticity, slipping into different personalities, even when the cameras aren't rolling, unable to differentiate what his true reality is.

metas.name: Trinity: The Story of The LOX
metas.description: Travel through time and reflect on the genesis, journey, and brotherhood of the multidimensional rap trio from Yonkers, The LOX.

metas.name: The Lion Queen
metas.description: You’ve seen her face on the cover of countless newspapers. Now step into the larger-than-life world and surprising true story of a true New York original — socialite Jocelyne Wildenstein, a.k.a. “The Lion Queen.”

metas.name: Stutterbug
metas.description: A stuttering man's desperate attempts to conceal his disability lead him to insult sick children, ruin his shot with his college crush and unwittingly hate-crime her also-stammering brother. All while just trying to order a cup of coffee.

metas.name: SHAMDEMONIUM
metas.description: Young aspiring actress Barb drowns in the pool of a kids birthday party, and must survive in a new thespian purgatory.

metas.name: Chance Meeting
metas.description: A chance meeting between an old bum and a mysterious obscured figure behind a window.

metas.name: A City in the Forest
metas.description: When a private police foundation in Atlanta tries to raze an urban forest to build the country’s largest police training facility, a diverse, decentralized, and intersectional movement defends the forest from what they call “Cop City.” A City in the Forest paints a collective portrait of the country’s most urgent social justice story, where a web of activists fight back against environmental racism, political corruption, police violence, and the criminalization of dissent.

metas.name: DRUID
metas.description: 60 AD. Romans tighten their grip on Britannia. Druidism is hunted almost to extinction. after being driven out of their commune, Rhiain- a young druid and her master Gwen are forced to flee and traverse the wilds of Britannia in order to reach the sanctuary of the Druids - Ynys Môn. On their journey they will encounter great challenges and unlikely allies on a quest that will decide not only their survival, but the future of their way of life itself.

metas.name: How to Talk Australians: The Movie
metas.description: A group of students and teachers from The Delhi College of Linguistics hit the road to discover Australia and gain first-hand experience of its authentic language and culture. When their plane is diverted to the country town of Dubbo due to storms, and their tour-leader is detained by customs, the hapless bunch unearth the 'real' Australia while never making it to Sydney, Melbourne...or even Brisbane.

metas.name: Runners
metas.description: Ben is sent on a delivery job for his father, when his brother Harry unexpectedly joins him. As suspicion grows and tension rises, only one question comes to mind: what’s in the boot?

metas.name: Labors of Love: The Life and Legacy of Henrietta Szold
metas.description: Long overlooked yet hugely influential, a towering Jewish American humanitarian finally receives her due in this inspiring biography of the visionary Zionist and women’s rights leader who helped shape modern Jewish life. As founder of Hadassah, builder of a modern healthcare and social service system in pre-state Israel, and fierce advocate for education and Jewish–Arab cooperation, Henrietta Szold was a force of nature who galvanized a global network of Jewish women. Her boldest achievement, Youth Aliyah, rescued thousands of Jewish children from Nazi-occupied Europe. Through archival footage, intimate letters, and firsthand reflections lifted by Tovah Feldshuh’s stirring narration, this rousing tribute honors a trailblazer whose moral clarity, courage, and humanity continue to echo today.

metas.name: Contenders
metas.description: An underdog sports documentary about a long suffering high school football program and their turnaround when a former player comes back as the head coach.

metas.name: You Sorta Know It's Gonna End
metas.description: KALIL HADDAD x RYAN STEEL B2B VIDEO MIXTAPE. FEATURING TEN CLASSIC SHORTS, PLUS THE ALL-NEW COLLAB "BAND PRACTICE".

metas.name: Blood Yolk
metas.description: After returning to her family’s decaying farm, an estranged writer confronts a dark secret that forces her to question her twin brother’s involvement in a string of murders — and her own capacity to kill.

metas.name: WOLF
metas.description: Tilda Swinton guides us through the life of cult British musician Patrick Wolf, weaving together archive and animation to illuminate a singular artistic journey.

metas.name: Just Look Up
metas.description: A defiant young visionary, part stand-up comic, part young Bob Dylan, part brilliant mind, leads a disruptive climate movement reinventing protest, channeling civil disobedience, and demanding a livable future.

metas.name: What Will I Become?
metas.description: More than 50% of transgender boys have attempted suicide. Through two life stories, directors Lexie and Logan unravel why their community is particularly vulnerable to living and dying quietly.

metas.name: The Death of Robin Hood
metas.description: Grappling with his past after a life of crime and murder, Robin Hood finds himself gravely injured after a battle he thought would be his last. In the hands of a mysterious woman, he is offered a chance at salvation.

metas.name: I Will Be Better
metas.description: A mentally lost man goes on a journey of self-imporvement.

metas.name: In the Hand of Dante
metas.description: A Vatican priest discovers Dante's original Divine Comedy manuscript. When asked to authenticate it, writer Nick Tosches steals it, while a parallel story follows Dante's quest to create his masterpiece.

metas.name: The Native Police
metas.description: A glimpse into a brutal chapter of Australia’s past, this powerful short from emerging Arrernte/Kalkadoon filmmaker Charles Perrurle Perkins follows an Indigenous man forced to work as a tracker for a white expansionist group forging their way across the Central Desert. Tasked with escorting a young Arrernte girl, he is forced to reckon with the colonial-driven violence that is tearing his people apart.

Nine represents the Russia animation studio's rich history, depicted as a meticulous, traditional animator working with a pencil at a classic wooden light table. Sitting right next to him is Zero, representing the modern era, working casually with headphones on a digital drawing tablet.

metas.name: The Magic Behind Island Tower At Disney’s Polynesian Villas & Bungalows
metas.description: A look at the artists and Imagineers whose creativity shaped Disney’s newest addition.

metas.name: Never Quiet
metas.description: Pulled into an undefined space between confession and memory, a woman is questioned by an unseen voice. Moving through distorted versions of her past, she confronts the difference between intention and impact, love and control, until the story can no longer protect her.

metas.name: Stereolab: Live in Concert at First Avenue in Minneapolis, October 11, 2025
metas.description: Stereolab’s most recent album is 2025’s Instant Holograms on Metal Film. Five months after that album’s release, Stereolab found themselves at the storied Minneapolis music venue First Avenue, where they performed to a sold-out room filled with enthusiastic fans.  Stereolab treated the energetic crowd to a rich array of songs from the new album, as well as several selections from their back catalogue, including one from their second EP, Super-Electric, released in 1991.

metas.name: Territory
metas.description: Falke, an old Danish man, is out hunting in the woods. When he is disturbed by Torben, with a much bigger gun, things take a drastic turn.

metas.name: resonance
metas.description: Voice memos from various people recounting how music impacted their lives edited into a short, experimental documentary.

metas.name: Don't Bring A Knife To A Gun Fight
metas.description: Vito Tucco is testifiying against the prosecution. The Charge? Murder. His case gets slowly revealed as the prosecutor digs deeper an deeper

metas.name: Afterimage
metas.description: A war photographer tormented by a photo of a dying soldier that eerily resembles his estranged younger brother, confronts this haunting image in his darkroom to face his trauma.

metas.name: Decorruption
metas.description: Alex and Maya use Time Travel to stop Harold from winning the election and becoming a Dictator

metas.name: Crash
metas.description: After surviving a tragic car accident, a man with a learner's licence and a dead phone must find his way home while battling the grief of losing his cousin.

metas.name: all that appears solid is built on blood
metas.description: Footage documenting the making of a mass grave in Khan Younis, Gaza is slowed frame by frame, re-shot on film and soaked in human blood.  all that appears solid is built on blood takes a segment from a 2023 video and engages each frame individually. The blood acts as a layer of protection while at times obscuring and tinting the image, the people and the land, creating its own register of time passing. The blood-trenched frames come together in a new montage overlaid with reflections by Gazan writer and poet Ahmad Al-Shaer and a composition by Palestinian musician Bint Mbareh. Through the cadence of Al-Shaer's words and Mbareh's music, the film creates an experience of time that pays homage to the militant time-keeping of Gazan journalists and documentarians.

metas.name: Christina Grimmie: Her Voice and Legacy A Decade Later
metas.description: The official 10th-anniversary film, Christina Grimmie: Her Voice and Legacy a Decade Later, traces her extraordinary journey from bedroom recordings that ignited a following of millions, to her landmark appearance on The Voice, through the tragedy of June 10, 2016, and beyond. Told through the voices of those who knew her best, including first-hand accounts from her father Bud, her brother Marcus, childhood friend Lauren Longo, and fellow artists who shared her world, the film refuses to let that night be the final word.

metas.name: Life Beyond Odyssey (The Film)
metas.description: Life Beyond Odyssey is a cinematic, introspective journey that explores what happens after the end of a long, defining chapter. Blending emotion, storytelling, and sound, it reflects on identity, growth, and the uncertainty of moving forward when the path that once defined you disappears. It’s not just an ending, it’s a transition into something unknown, where the past echoes but no longer leads.

metas.name: Maya Hawke - live on KEXP
metas.description: KEXP presents Maya Hawke performing live in the KEXP studio

metas.name: Jacked Brain
metas.description: Dr. Jack Edbrain is an Imagination Therapist who helps his patients become more creative. He's also an astronomer and discovers something in his telescope that redirects his priorities from imagination to practical science.

metas.name: Alessia Cara: Giant Desk Concert
metas.description: In the first (or maybe only) episode of Giant Desk, Alessia Cara is invited on as a guest to perform six tracks from throughout her discography.

metas.name: But Nothing Ever Happens
metas.description: Sisters Mia and Jordan respectively watch TV and go to work.

metas.name: Waiting for the Barbarians
metas.description: In a city - evoking, without specificity, a city of the Roman Empire - the poem depicts a state of waiting: the arrival of the ‘Barbarians’ has been announced

metas.name: Control
metas.description: Two mice, a man with a TV remote control. A cartoon of pests and controlled revenge.

metas.name: Where Were We?
metas.description: A deep dive into an oceanic terrain of essentials and reminiscences transforms the familiar into the extraordinary, gently blurring the line between the world we’re in and the worlds we carry.

metas.name: Sleep
metas.description: A modern remake of Andy Warhol's original film.

metas.name: Torn
metas.description: In a room where everything is safe and known, a man feels the pull of something vivid and uncertain just out of reach.

metas.name: three twenty-five
metas.description: The final twelve minutes of a couple's relationship as they realize they aren't ready to move in together.

metas.name: Regular American Citizen
metas.description: From the world of BatFreak; Regular American Citizen must learn to either accept the life that's been forced upon him, or fight for a life of good that may not even exist.

metas.name: Makeshift Art Bar: Discipline
metas.description: In Benidorm, a Harry Styles tribute struggles to separate who he is from who he performs as every night.

metas.name: Dreams of Violets
metas.description: Tehran, January 2026. Inspired by real events from 47 years of Iranian civilian resistance, through the eyes of five strangers, Dreams of Violets brings protest footage to life with raw immediacy. At dawn, as Iranian forces execute wounded protesters, one soldier discovers five hiding in a dead-end alley. Above them, Amir, a child in a wheelchair, watches from a window and decides to act.

metas.name: Stankface Standing Soldier: The Rise of Mato Wayuhi
metas.description: As Mato Wayuhi continues to rise as a musical composer and rapper, he continues to hear his father’s and ancestors’ voices in his art. Mato is known for composing the score for the Emmy-nominated series Reservation Dogs. Outside of the realm of composing, Mato engages with his community and the world through his talents as a rapper. Stankface Standing Soldier: The Rise of Mato Wayuhi provides a glimpse into the up-and-coming Oglala Lakota artist’s life as a rising rapper and composer. With the release of his recent album, Stankface Standing Soldier, the audience receives a deeper look into Mato’s personal inspiration and upbringing. This documentary showcases Mato’s versatility as a performer, showcasing his creative path led by his ancestors and his father’s voice.

metas.name: dude. where is my lighter?
metas.description: A young man wanders the streets of Shawnee, Oklahoma, searching for the thing that will bring him peace.

metas.name: Basic Bandits
metas.description: Three friends get an opportunity to move up in the crime world by taking an unconventional job.

metas.name: Open to Interpretation
metas.description: Longtime friends, Cal and Mason, accept Jasmine into their comedy group. They are both attracted to Jasmine. Mason makes a move in real life, but shy Cal can only make a move in his dreams.

metas.name: The Freedom Fighters
