metas.description: Michelle is floating through life until a surprising connection with a high schooler challenges her friendship with her overbearing best friend, in this bitingly astute and exceptionally hilarious satire.

metas.name: Don't They Know It's the End of the World?
metas.description: Two people on a date realize their circumstances prevent them from ever having a serious relationship. They create a fantasy that they're married, leading to existential consequences.

metas.name: Banbury vs. Daventry - A Historic Rivalry
metas.description: Banbury vs Daventry is an extremely educational documentary about the two towns' historic rivalry. The two representatives, Reece and Seb, will be talking about everything from wars to cakes.

metas.name: A Girl Is A Gun*
metas.description: In a secluded safe house, a seasoned politician meets the enigmatic Agent 011 to hand over a briefcase containing secrets powerful enough to shape the future of a nation. But as tensions rise and hidden motives surface, the exchange turns violent when a mysterious figure emerges.

metas.name: Variety’s Power of Women London
metas.description: Variety’s Power of Women held its inaugural U.K. edition on June 3, 2026, at the Chancery Rosewood in London. Presented in partnership with Lifetime, the event celebrated five high-profile honorees who were each featured on individual covers of a special accompanying issue.

metas.name: Sorry for the Genocide
metas.description: Over a century has passed since the genocide of the Ovaherero and Nama people, yet Germany and Namibia continue to grapple with memory and accountability, as the legacy of colonialism shapes the present. While the governments negotiate a diplomatic agreement, the voices of descendants are often ignored. By hearing directly from the affected communities, the film places these voices at the forefront, exposing the tensions behind political processes and asking what genuine justice and reconciliation could look like.

metas.name: I Duok om I Bohuntung - The Owl and the Rainbow
metas.description: When depression pulls her daughter into darkness, a mother must transform to restore hope and bring colour back to their lives.

metas.name: Ace and Cody vs. The Fry
metas.description: In the spirit of Scott Pilgrim vs. the World, Ace and Cody vs. The Fry is a high-energy, hyper-stylized short film that turns the most trivial moment—the last fry in the bucket—into the most important battle of two best friends’ lives. The second that lone fry is spotted, Ace makes the first move, setting off a breathless chase through a sprawling park that transforms the fields into a full-blown war zone. As the pursuit escalates like a video game fight, Ace and Cody are pushed to increasingly ridiculous heights in a showdown where everything seems to hinge on a single french fry.

metas.name: Jalen Brunson: The Man Who Saved the New York Knicks
metas.description: Jalen Brunson was never supposed to be the face of the New York Knicks.  He was the son of an NBA player. An accomplished guard at Villanova. A national champion.  Yet despite his resume of accolades, found himself as a second-round pick entering his NBA journey. He was a player many believed was too small or too limited to become a true NBA superstar.  From his early life around the game, to his ascention as the face of the New York Knicks, Brunson’s journey was built on patience and an almost unshakable belief in who he was.  In this original documentary, we look back at the complete rise of Jalen Brunson — from his childhood and college career, to his NBA breakthrough, as well as a deep look into how an underrated guard from New Jersey became the player to lead the Knicks back to their first NBA Finals since 1999.  This is the story of how Jalen Brunson became the captain of New York basketball, and brought basketball's Mecca back to life.

metas.name: A Storied Landscape
metas.description: Told through Hawaiian oral tradition, this story follows two sisters migrating across Hawaiʻi Island, where love, rivalry, and ancestral legacy intertwine with memory and landscape.

metas.name: Raised by The Canoe
metas.description: The Terry Lee Canoe Club of Sts’ailes First Nation began as a family crew and now thrives in resurgence, guided by Cathrine and Devin Paul, uniting generations through carving, training, and cultural continuity.

metas.name: Sukkaillutit Uqaruk (Say It Slowly)
metas.description: A moving parallel between language loss and climate change, highlighting personal and communal resilience.

metas.name: Béal
metas.description: Béal is a 16 mm film that explores the intertwined histories, communities, and daily lives of Toronto’s Cabbagetown and Regent Park. Extending to the Don Valley and Don River—lands and waterways long used by Indigenous peoples as gathering, fishing, and travel routes—the film situates these neighbourhoods within a deeper landscape of history and movement. Later shaped by Irish immigration during the 1847 famine, the area evolved through poverty, working-class settlement, and the creation of Regent Park as Canada’s first large-scale social housing project. Today, cycles of redevelopment and gentrification continue to transform the neighbourhoods, bringing new tensions and challenges. Through intimate collaborations with residents and community workers, Béal reflects on resilience, displacement, and the enduring connections between past and present in the city’s changing urban fabric.

metas.name: EACHOTHER 互
metas.description: EACHOTHER 互, is a live simulation of one million autonomous beings

metas.name: Màquina
metas.description: When a father consumed by alcoholism agrees to join his son on a journey through psychedelic-assisted addiction treatment in Colorado, their road trip across the American West in an aging Winnebago becomes an unflinching exploration of codependency, memory, and hope.

metas.name: Holz
metas.description: Those were tough times.

metas.name: Axt niemals entfernen
metas.description: You should always pay attention to warning signs.

metas.name: Quintesson’s Garden
metas.description: An astral gardener has an asbestos problem

metas.name: THE HUM
metas.description: During his class, Leo, who struggles with ADHD, fights to write a single word while the sensory overload of the room pushes him to his breaking point.

metas.name: The Hot Seat
metas.description: World Cup winners from France 1998 and France 2018, plus a crew of comedians, face off in a no-holds-barred comedy roast hosted by Paul de Saint Sernin.

metas.name: Agora
metas.description: A chance encounter with an online dating match turns awkward when an unexpected presence reveals their true colours. A comedy on moral masking.

metas.name: Unwelcome
metas.description: A YouTube Short Film about two burglars who enter a home. They are met with a terrifying owner.

metas.name: Game Face
metas.description: Time is running out, and dude bro Jake needs to print his final essay in order to go to The Game. But, the only way to do that is to use the printer in the Dorothy Center, his campus’s queer safe space. To do so, he goes through a transformation.

metas.name: Água Salgada
metas.description: With her partner lost at sea, a young woman begins to question her perception of reality and identity.

metas.name: Dogwood
metas.description: A grad student, home for the week and bouncing back from depression, reencounters an old "friend".

metas.name: Cocotte
metas.description: Charlotte, a trans girl, gets in a feud with her grandmother Mamie over her hormone injection.

metas.name: Will Time Ever Let Me Forget You
metas.description: Years after losing Emma, Aaron wanders familiar places where memories of their time together resurface. A letter she left forces him to confront loss, love, and the way she continues to live within him.

metas.name: SOARING
metas.description: SOARING follows athletes on their climb to the 2026 Special Olympics USA Games. Chasing their goals and overcoming challenges, they aren’t trying to prove anything to anyone. But in the process, their pursuit uplifts everyone.

metas.name: Rabbit Gnaw
metas.description: After a brief encounter with an enigmatic woman, a voyeuristic illustrator finds himself lost in an endless rabbit hole of uncanny coincidences and forgotten memories, unable to shake the strange feeling that she strikingly resembles a missing woman from his hometown.

metas.name: The Hadron Collider: In Search of the Peace Particle
metas.description: In the aftermath of Hiroshima, a group of scientists vowed never to turn knowledge into weapons again, and from that promise, CERN was born.  Deep underground, researchers from nations in conflict have worked side by side for decades, driven by curiosity and shared wonder. For 70 years, CERN has stood as an act of hope, a place where collaboration transcends borders, even as the world above grows more divided.  Blending poetry, music and rare archival footage of Oppenheimer with remarkable access to the Large Hadron Collider, the film explores how science, politics and culture collide.

metas.name: Part Of The Job
metas.description: During a slow shift at a bar, a bartender is told by their manager to be friendlier with male customers to increase sales, forcing her to confront how often women are expected to trade boundaries for financial security.

metas.name: Oz Troikas
metas.description: Australian animals. In threes. Mostly.

metas.name: Eins Zwei Drei ‒ The Triplets Trio
metas.description: Three triplet brothers sing and dance into old age. Is it wise?

metas.name: A Triple Encounter Of The Third Kind
metas.description: A three-trailer footage experiment. The idea: Only every third frame from the trailers for Three Days of the Condor, Close Encounters of the Third Kind and North by Northwest was reassembled in a new order. The three soundtracks are mixed together.

metas.name: <3 [Less Than Three]
metas.description: A film about striving for belonging against all odds.

metas.name: My Aunt With A Poodle
metas.description: Things happen when you go for a sunday walk with your aunt and her poodle.
A narrative voice, at first speechless, finds itself in an extraordinary film screening and is confronted with a flood of mysterious images that raise at least three question marks.

metas.name: 3 People Filming 3 Minutes On Trix 3 Times Brussels Sprouts
metas.description: Brussels sprouts on Dixie, on a sign, in water birds.

metas.name: Three Stars
metas.description: Three star reviews are tricky. Some people think they're good and some think they're bad. So they really can go either way.

metas.name: 3 Girls
metas.description: The story of three sisters based on Grimm's fairy tale »Three Brothers«.

metas.name: Commissioned Confession
metas.description: An artist born in Jerusalem is commissioned by a German institution to create a work of art about another artist – a sculptor celebrated by the Nazis. He approaches the task with a silent film. How does one describe something that is, by the very nature of its commission, steeped in violence?

metas.name: Birth
metas.description: A ritual, words from a long-forgotten language. In 2018, an Egyptian mother fights in court for the fundamental rights of her daughter who was born out of wedlock. The film is inspired by this event. With great tenderness and sensitivity, Birth interweaves the story of this struggle with images of an archaic birth ritual.

metas.name: What The Night Hides
metas.description: In the dead of night, a woman wakes to find her mother speaking with an unexpected guest.

metas.name: The Void
metas.description: After leaving her abusive boyfriend, Rose tries to seek shelter with her estranged sister. However, when her car stalls, she finds herself stuck near a mysterious phone booth, and the voice on the other end is calling for her.

metas.name: The Bargain
metas.description: A young girl summons the Devil to get justice from her abusive foster father. The Devil is willing to make a deal but in Ruth’s desire for revenge exceeds her nerve. A chilling tale of revenge, religion and desperation in our lowest moments.

metas.name: The All-Star Massacre
metas.description: A trio of softball players run afoul of a baseball-themed slasher.

metas.name: Sweetheart
metas.description: A young woman’s attempt to exorcise her mother unravels into something far more personal.

metas.name: Paralysis
metas.description: During a terrifying episode of sleep paralysis, Natasha finds herself trapped in a world where time stops, her body betrays her, and a grotesque entity crawls closer, turning her struggle to wake into a desperate fight for spiritual survival.

metas.name: Nurture
metas.description: On a remote Oregon farm, a couple grieving from a miscarriage finds hope in a mysterious flower. But as it heals her, the flower takes root in him. Nurture is a dialogue-free folk-horror fable about love, grief, and the consequences of taking too much from nature.

metas.name: I Don’t Know Her
metas.description: A séance opens a door to the unfamiliar.

metas.name: Chum
metas.description: Five twenty-somethings face the wrath of a killer lobsterman while vacationing off the coast of Maine.

metas.name: Cat and Mouse
metas.description: Michelle is caught in a killer’s sadistic and carefully orchestrated game. With danger closing in at every turn, Michelle must outwit and outlast her relentless pursuer. As the night goes on, unsettling clues reveal that all may not be what it seems.

metas.name: Behold And Hear
metas.description: Four friends embark on a fated road trip that changes their lives forever.

metas.name: Beach Goers
metas.description: A day at the beach takes a turn for the worst for a small friend group when one of them disappears mysteriously. It’s a mad dash to try and find her as quickly as possible whilst also preparing for the worst.

metas.name: James: Getting Away with It
metas.description: The first-ever authorised tell-all documentary about iconic British band James.

metas.name: Test
metas.description: The unforgettable, striking, and emotionally raw story of Eddie, a young bodybuilder struggling to define himself in a community with limited opportunity. Eddie lives under the intense influence of his deeply codependent mother while grappling with gay sexual desires that clash with the rigid religious beliefs that shape his world. Convince that his only path forward is through perfecting the body God gave him, Eddie pursues bodybuilding with an obsessive devotion that ultimately forces him to questions of identity, masculinity, and faith.

metas.name: Impasto
metas.description: An illustrator in Paris is stuck in his routine and stuck for ideas, until he follows the music he hears from his window into the night...

metas.name: First to Fifty
metas.description: Guided by a legendary figure of the Finnish wood throwing game, a group of mates form Australia’s first ever team to compete at the Mölkky World Championships.

metas.name: A Thing of the Past
metas.description: A pharmaceutical trial promises Aya her lost memories, but as they return, her body begins to manifest them in disturbing ways.

metas.name: Welcome To The Cyber Rodeo
metas.description: A portrait of a young mechanical bull rider known as the Cyber Cowboy

metas.name: Off The Clock
metas.description: After a late night at his boring office job, Peter can’t seem to find his way home. After being trapped in the city and encountering some strange people, he realizes the truth he's been avoiding this whole time.

metas.name: Iikaiksimatsa’pao’p: Grateful To Be On The Land
metas.description: Iikaiksimatsa’pao’p (Grateful to Be on the Land) follows Cassie Ayoungman, founder of Soul of Miistaki and member of the Siksika nation, on her journey to bring the healing power of the mountains to those within her community. Breaking down barriers to climbing, and integrating Indigenous teachings and land-based learning, she raises questions about representation, builds community, and redefines what it means to be on the land.

metas.name: Earth, Wind & Fire (To Be Celestial vs. That's the Weight of the World)
metas.description: Examines the legacy, cultural impact, and body of work of American R&B/funk/jazz/soul/disco band Earth, Wind & Fire, and will feature exclusive access to the band’s archives of visual, audio, and written material, as well as the support of the estate of Maurice White and the band.

metas.name: Taming the Beast
metas.description: The world strongest man learns how to embrace his mental health challenges by confronting his inner demons and dealing with his biggest failure to date which ultimately changes his life.

metas.name: Broken Rhythm: Bruce Lee's Game of Death
metas.description: Delving into Bruce Lee's unfinished film, Game of Death, while also exploring the legendary martial arts icon as a real, complex, flesh-and-blood human being.

metas.name: Fragments
metas.description: An individual in a strange land reflects on their metamorphosis through a poem.

metas.name: One Man's Trash
metas.description: Two Southern buddies embark on a journey for buried treasure, but it may be nothing more than one man's trash.

metas.name: Houston Hostage Crisis
metas.description: A man has barricaded himself in his apartment and taken his own family hostage. We see the results of these actions.

metas.name: Screeny Meanie
metas.description: A funny morality play about the dangers of technology addiction

metas.name: Shrooms
metas.description: Darren barrels through work at a below average pizza shop, dreaming of being the poster boy of culinary leadership. He’s got the cooking skills, and the looks, but is completely incapable of standing up for himself.

metas.name: Devil's Bargain: The Making of Hell Spa
metas.description: Documentary discussing the making of HELL SPA.

metas.name: Tautoko the Panthers
metas.description: In 2024 Leki Jackson-Bourke and Black Grace encouraged us to create a new work about our support of a Dawn Raids Apology called for by the Polynesian Panther Party Legacy Trust. This support from Black Grace gave us an opportunity to acknowledge and share the words of people who joined with us to write letters and emails to the Government to #TautokoThePanthers. Thank you to every writer. This is for you.

metas.name: Planet Playground
metas.description: Another ordinary day in the digital circus...

metas.name: One for the Road
metas.description: Following their father’s passing, two half-siblings raised worlds apart meet to mourn him, only to realize that understanding his life means confronting their own unfinished stories.

metas.name: One Man's Trash
metas.description: Two Southern buddies embark on a journey for buried treasure, but it may be nothing more than one man's trash.

metas.name: Howl
metas.description: Misfit Molly lives in a tent in her suburban backyard—but when she spots a wolf and no one believes her, she becomes obsessed with proving it's real.

metas.name: Crossed Animals
metas.description: Cindy didn't come to this island to make friends. She's here to get filthy rich — no matter the cost.

metas.name: Detective Alan and Toddson in ”The Mysterious Mystery!”
metas.description: There's no other detective on the scene (and no other stupid enough) to take on a most mysterious of mysteries. Detective Alan and Toddson, two partners in crime, and possibly more, help a poor transvestite figure out who killed her lover.

metas.name: Expert Marksmanship: A Path to Olympic Gold Medal
metas.description: This 1962 unclassified documentary short features footage of Captain W. W. McMillan's marksmanship skills, and his "Path to Olympic Gold Medal" at the 1960 Olympics.  While depicting Marines caring for rifles and practicing marksmanship at large shooting ranges, the majority of the film focuses on an interview of McMillan, where he provides marksmanship instruction and demonstrates each step, focusing on fundamentals like grip, stance, stability, sighting alignment and trigger control for rapid fire shooting with pistols and revolvers.  The film also features footage of McMillan at the Olympics and multiple creative "trick shots" by McMillan: teacups, poker chips, playing cards, upside down pistol shots and slight aligning with mirrors.

metas.name: B'Twixt Mourn & Æterna - Canto IX: When You Are Not...
metas.description: Canto IX out of XIII

metas.name: PULSE
metas.description: A man isolated from society appears to have nothing to show for his life, yet in his solitude, he has quietly taught himself to see and hear the world with a depth and beauty that most people are too distracted to ever find.

metas.name: Slow & Stupendous
metas.description: Two friends go on an adventure to find a missing film in the Slow & Stupendous series.

metas.name: Learning, Studying… Always Perfecting: The Making of One Battle After Another
metas.description: A behind-the-scenes documentary filmed during the production of Paul Thomas Anderson’s One Battle After Another, featuring candid moments from the cast and crew.

metas.name: Wheel of Sensation
metas.description: David and Rosa are two content creators known for their romantic content. To regain their popularity, they created a kissing video that went viral. However, beneath the surface, there were feelings they never fully acknowledged until it was too late.

metas.name: High Noon
metas.description: A lone outlaw finds shelter in a seemingly empty saloon.

metas.name: Mitch Match #28
metas.description: A character finds an egg and tries to save it.

metas.name: If Not Now, When?
metas.description: Framed as the next best thing, a young author struggles to finish his long-awaited sophomore novel. Overwhelmed by mounting pressure from his publisher, he impulsively escapes to the beach in search of distance from his failing work. However, a series of trampled sandcastles forces him to realise he isn’t so alone after all, as he is taught an unconventional lesson by an unconventional stranger.

metas.name: Procrastination Yoga
metas.description: The morning begins with a scream - the day ahead promises a barrage of chores, and the pressure to make money leaves no room for relaxation.

metas.name: The Campaign
metas.description: The Campaign dives into how this is not just a war of rockets and gunfire, but one of narratives: a global effort to shape public perception around Gaza, Israel, the West, and the Jewish people. It’s a war fought through propaganda, disinformation, and emotional manipulation, amplified by both mainstream and social media.

metas.name: Loud Gun
metas.description: A Guy Randomly FInds A Gun In Front Of His House, What Will Happen Next?

metas.name: Carla and Her Legs
metas.description: Carla, who has no legs, is reduced by people around her to a curiosity rather than an artist. She lives for acrobatics, but works as an assistant in a variety show, invisible to the world of stage. When the theater begins to decline, the director offers her the chance to perform.

metas.name: Cornellskop: Freedom From Fear
metas.description: At a South African sanctuary, Luke Cornell provides a second chance for wildlife, confronting the harsh realities of poaching while revealing the deep emotional bond between the animals and those dedicated to their care.

metas.name: Mantle of Dusk
metas.description: From the mouth of the mad river.

metas.name: Wet Paper Bag
metas.description: A former investigative journalist goes undercover at a psychedelic wellness center to find her missing sister. What she uncovers is far more unsettling than she expected.  Wet Paper Bag is a psychological drama that explores identity, control, and the quiet tension beneath carefully constructed lives.

metas.name: Double Kill
metas.description: Twin assassins take on a night of violent contracts until betrayal turns their mission into a fight for survival, forcing sister against sister in a relentless clash of blood, loyalty, and revenge.

metas.name: The Late Stage
metas.description: Actors Joshua & Phoebe visit a dying director to rehearse a new play - his life’s work which they’ve convinced him has been greenlit.

metas.name: The Experiencers: Full Disclosure
metas.description: An astonishing award-winning documentary that goes beyond asking whether extraterrestrial contact is real - and into the more unsettling question of why, drawing on firsthand accounts and evidence for what intelligent life beyond our world may be.

metas.name: WallDale
metas.description: At first glance, WallDale appears to be an ordinary town, quiet streets, familiar faces, and a reassuring sense of routine. Life moves steadily, shaped by repetition and tradition, where nothing ever truly changes. But beneath the calm exterior lies a fragile balance dependent on everyone playing their part.  When a new arrival disrupts the rhythm of daily life and a violent death shatters the illusion of safety, suspicion spreads quickly. As neighbours turn on one another and secrets surface, it becomes clear that the events unfolding are not random.  The town is part of a far darker experiment, controlled by hidden forces manipulating lives with cold precision. What begins as a search for a killer evolves into a fight for identity, free will, and survival as the terrifying truth behind WallDale is revealed.

metas.name: UPDAWG
metas.description: A man must fill in the shoes of a former superhero after his tragic passing.

metas.name: OTW
metas.description: As night falls, JOKO, an online motorcycle ride-hailing driver, struggles to get orders after receiving a poor rating earlier that day. His wife, KIRANA, calls to ask where he is. Joko shares his frustration with the pressure of difficult customers, platform fees, paid service programs, and the lack of support for online drivers. Kirana then tells him that a debt collector has come to their home because they are still Rp100,000 short on a payment. Determined to earn enough before returning home, Joko continues waiting for an order. He eventually receives a request to deliver an urgent package to another city. Although he initially hesitates because of the long distance, he accepts after learning how important the package is to the customer. After collecting it from the post office, Joko sets off on a 38-kilometer journey that pushes his endurance, determination, and hope to their limits.

metas.name: Blood in the Comments
metas.description: A rising content creator becomes entangled in a deadly online murder plot after relationship advice sparks a dangerous chain of events.

metas.name: BAD NEWS
metas.description: A Mysterious delivery man and his shady business of death, with a tasteful twist.

metas.name: Sock Opera
metas.description: Milo is a 20 year old theatre student who is making a puppet named Jimbo for a play. After acting out a scene with Jimbo, the puppet becomes attached to Milo’s arm overnight, gaining its own consciousness. Thinking he’s seeing things, Milo goes about his day with Jimbo on his arm. However, Jimbo wreaks havoc on Milo’s day, causing him more trouble than he anticipated. Milo struggles to regain control of his life, leading to a surreal showdown between creator and creation.

metas.name: Jeff Foxworthy: The Joke's On Me
metas.description: A stand-up special that goes beyond the main stage. Following Jeff Foxworthy, while interweaving his set at the Gas South Theater with club performances reveals how he perfects his material.

metas.name: Pittsburgh is Freezing
metas.description: Pittsburgh is Freezing is a short film made by Pittsburgh filmmaker Gabby Valdivieso, documenting a night with Joemygosh, Snoozy Q, and the House of Medical Malpractice.

metas.name: Homage
metas.description: A reformed street figure risks everything when he tries to help an old friend fresh out of prison, only to discover that some debts don't disappear; they come back to collect.

metas.name: HOA Heist
metas.description: Neighbors take on a secret HOA mission.

metas.name: The Donut Hole
metas.description: At a donut shop, a sharp-tongued young Latina turns a petty feud into a sweet-and-dirty power play, serving her novela-loving grandma as the unexpected real winner.

metas.name: What's That Sound?
metas.description: When a girl discovers music in a new way she embarks on a mental journey.

metas.name: Blind
metas.description: After forming a strong bond through online chats, a young man and woman decide to meet in person. But when the woman sees him for the first time, her reaction changes as he does not match the image she had imagined.

metas.name: Autumn Leaves
metas.description: On the edge of herself, Ellie retreats into memory, not to escape, but to find a reason to stay. A quiet, unflinching portrait of a young woman fighting to remember who she was before the world got loud.

metas.name: Wolf Puppy
metas.description: A lonely man who thinks of himself as a tough guy begins experiencing strange visions as he’s forced to confront who he is and who he wants to be.

metas.name: The Touch
metas.description: A man sees a doctor about his hand, which is on fire.

metas.name: Lesbian Cleaning Service
metas.description: Between meticulous flower arrangements and sanitising sex toys, they must face the inevitable questions and washes of pain that come with falling in and out of love.

metas.name: Surviving Biafra
metas.description: Some of the last survivors from Nigeria’s Civil War, also known as the Biafran War, share their memories from the frontline.

metas.name: TUESDAY
metas.description: Ronnie Henslee wakes up late to work on Tuesday. He is also the goat but that is another matter

metas.name: She Measures the Earth
metas.description: Four women scientists in Canada, Alison Criscitiello, Jocelyn Hirose, Isobel Phoebus, and Chimira Andres reshape who belongs to science.

metas.name: Dating Among the Ashes
metas.description: Two femmes dish over their dating lives as they split a pack of cigarettes

metas.name: The March to War: Iran, Israel and the USA
metas.description: As the first American and Israeli missiles hit Iran on February 28, 2026, U.S. government officials argued that this was not the start of war. Instead, it was just the next stage in a conflict that started with the 1979 Islamic Revolution that toppled the American and Israeli-backed regime of the Shah, and made the U.S. and Israel sworn enemies of the new Islamic state.  THE MARCH TO WAR is a unique three-part series that looks at the deep roots of the “infinite roller-coaster” of conflict that has ensnared Israel and Iran and drawn in the United States. Was open war inevitable, the series asks? And could the escalation have been stopped?  The series tells the story through the voices of those that shaped it: politicians (including former U.S. Secretary of Defense Leon Panetta and Israeli prime minister Benjamin Netanyahu), military commanders, intelligence chiefs and ambassadors, from all sides, along with political scientists and historians.

metas.name: The Fitzroy's Fastest Bowler
metas.description: Fitzroy bowlers Jack, Brad and Oskar face a very serious issue, one that only a true hero can face.

metas.name: Escape!
metas.description: Four friends wake up and find themselves trapped in an unfamiliar room, disoriented and without their phones. As confusion gives way to tension, they search for answers, grappling with rising paranoia, fractured memories, and the tickling pressure of a mysterious countdown. With no clear idea of how they go there and no way out, they are forced to confront not only their circumstances but also each other.

metas.name: Banana Plant
metas.description: A Puerto Rican family living in Rochester, New York, takes great care of the banana trees in their garden. When winter arrives, they dig up the plants and bring them indoors to protect them from the cold. With the arrival of spring, the trees return to the earth, creating a cyclic ritual that repeats itself year after year. Through this caring activity, Migdalia and Fernando maintain a living link with their roots, and their work becomes both an act of resilience and a way of dealing with their diasporic identity.

metas.name: The NOAH Flood
metas.description: The Noah Flood investigates the biblical story of Noah through dramatic reenactments, geological evidence, and historical analysis. From massive rock formations to fossil mysteries, the film asks a bold question, could the global flood described in Genesis be real history written in the earth itself?

metas.name: Made With Love
metas.description: Director Max O'Connor Hurni crafts an intimate portrait of his family, tracing its history, exploring how it shaped his identity, and reflecting on his experience growing up with same-sex parents.

metas.name: Emma Barnett: Fighting Endometriosis
metas.description: Emma Barnett shares her life-long struggle with endometriosis – a disease affecting one in ten women of reproductive age, which causes excruciating, often debilitating, pain.  Inside Emma’s body, rogue cells similar to the lining of the womb mysteriously appear on other organs, creating lesions which bleed, scar and cause inflammation. There is no cure. Endometriosis is as common as diabetes but receives a fraction of the research funding.  Emma travels across the UK to meet a few of the millions of women who, like her, are suffering. Through candid conversations, they reveal the extent to which endometriosis is devastating the lives of women – affecting fertility, work and loved ones.

metas.name: Redhorn
metas.description: At a remote summer sleep-away camp, a lonely newcomer named Mateo tries to win over a group of boys who quickly turn against him. After his attempts to gain their acceptance backfire and tensions boil over, Mateo is pushed to the edge, clinging to one final, dangerous idea.

metas.name: Góðufellarnir
metas.description: In a world where gangster rule, we follow Henry Hill through his rise and fall...

metas.name: Daddy?
metas.description: In 'Daddy?', time and persona are fluid as we explore a homeless young dancer's night. Following the break up with his boyfriend and an assault on his way to the club where he works, events cause him to question who he is, where he’s going and what he has lost. A fever dream of violence and sex, bringing his buried fears to life.  Is the man he wants to love someone he can trust? Will he ever have someone, feel safe and be whole?

metas.name: The Light That Remains
metas.description: An astronaut, Julian, grieving the recent loss of his wife, is selected by Auron Astronautics for the Aether I mission to test the atmosphere after a devastating coronal mass ejection.

metas.name: Lavender
metas.description: When lesbian writer Audrey runs into her ex-boyfriend, Julian, she must confront her bisexual panic or risk losing her sense of identity.

metas.name: The Understudy
metas.description: A shy high school student, Sienna, tends to keep to herself and doesn't let anyone in. When she decides to audition for her school play she learns being on her own isn't always a good thing.

metas.name: A Broken Child the Esha Riley Story
metas.description: A young girl endures the harsh realities of the foster care system, facing pain, loss, and instability. But what was meant to break her instead builds her into a powerful voice for the unheard-turning trauma into strength, and survival into purpose.

metas.name: Sorry
metas.description: A portrait of three young women: Luna Alyaan, a young Gaza violinist, killed by an Elbit drone; Eden Golan, a Zionist singer who represented Israel at 2024’s Eurovision in Malmo; and Greta Thunberg, who lead protests at Eurovision that year. A dark satire of Israel’s weaponization of song for hasbara (propaganda) purposes, Sorry uses humour and pop culture to create a mash-up agit-prop in support of the ongoing Eurovision boycott and the Dump Elbit campaign. (Inspired by Toronto Palestine Film Festival’s Gaza Lives tribute to artists lost in the genocide).

metas.name: When The House Went Silent
metas.description: Alex, an angry 17 year old, struggles to care for his sister’s worsening illness as the two struggle financially. Refusing help from others, he must hold everything together on his own. As time begins to run out before CPS takes him away, Alex is forced to confront his anger and accept he needs help from others.

metas.name: The Imperfect Film
metas.description: Adam, a perfectionist film director, finally secures funding for his first movie but soon becomes consumed by making every detail perfect. As production spirals out of control, his producer struggles to keep the project together and help Adam realize that perfection isn’t possible.

metas.name: Welcome to Borovia
metas.description: Harry Enfield heads a brilliant cast in this quirky political comedy where plots, counterplots and seduction flourish in faraway Borovia.

metas.name: THS 2026 Senior Movie
metas.description: A recap of the 2026 school year that got a small release in the city of Washington PA

metas.name: Maxim Commodity Ballet
metas.description: A kaleidoscopic exploration of found objects that express deeper human emotion.

metas.name: The Art of Trying
metas.description: Antonio chose to leave a life of crime behind him after 25 years. He is now homeless and wandering around the same crime-ridden streets trying to make an honest living as a painter.

metas.name: When Cells Turn
metas.description: When Cells Turn is a Documentary that dives deep into two powerful journeys, Belinda's battle with breast cancer and Eliza's life shaped by loss. This raw, emotional story shatters myths and reveals the urgent truth about a disease that can touch anyone, at any time.

metas.name: Stake Bake
metas.description: Jamie Stevens makes a stake.

metas.name: The Bill in My Name
metas.description: Ten years ago, a "cleaner" named Timothy murdered twenty people to earn a way out of a criminal underworld controlled by the sadistic Orson Knox. Faced with a rigged game of Blackjack, Timothy chose to gamble his son Daniel's physical safety for a new identity, resulting in a permanent scar on the boy's face and a new life under the name "Nelson". 20 years later, the debt comes due when Orson resurfaces, lured by the "merchandise" he marked years ago. When Daniel is forced into the same chair his father once occupied, the truth of the "Nelson" name is revealed, forcing a violent confrontation that proves some debts can only be settled in blood.

metas.name: Driftwood Returned
metas.description: A drifter wanders through the city, a piece of wood in hand.

metas.name: The Milky Way
metas.description: An amateur milkman accidentally brings a group of unsuspecting Londoners together through his good intentions.

metas.name: Sunset Rhythms
metas.description: Dawn, a young woman with an inescapable desire for connection, yearns for acceptance and appreciation from her peers who feel a world away. As she gears herself up for a once in a lifetime party, Dawn is confronted with her own fears of isolation and rejection that threaten to overwhelm her. However, her night is transformed as she is exposed to an unforgettable world of friendship, passion, and belonging through the language of dance.

metas.name: Supplies
metas.description: Some time after the outbreak of a global pandemic that turned humans into mindless, terrifying monsters, two young survivors bound together by a necessary need for survival flee their homes in search of safety.

metas.name: Kick Ons
metas.description: When every attempt to leave a looping backyard party fails, two twenty-somethings must confront the fact that their lives- and friendship- are moving on.

metas.name: The Black Pier
metas.description: A woman carrying a mysterious black bag containing valuables is shot and killed by an assassin. Yet a stolen doll proves to hold more significance than anticipated.

metas.name: Love or Limerence?
metas.description: It begins with a notification, a follow, a view, a possibility. What seems small quickly becomes consuming, as a young woman finds her world quietly reshaped by someone who barely knows she exists. Curiosity turns into fixation, and feeling starts to feel like fate.

metas.name: Four Paintings by Edward Povey: Stories we are made of
metas.description: The first of five interview short films with renowned painter Edward Povey during the install of a collection of four paintings at 2 Blackburne Terrace. In the first interview we see the install and dive into our first painting.

metas.name: The Shamrock Keys
metas.description: A raw and lively look at a seven piece Irish band keeping tradition alive through spirited drinking songs, fast paced reels, and timeless jigs.

metas.name: It Was Just A Nightmare
metas.description: An unexpected visit from an old friend

metas.name: Verge
metas.description: Elena arrives home to discover a body neatly laid out on her living room floor. After her dog, Nanaya, begins speaking to her, the two discuss the strange occurrence and the mysterious pattern it ties into.

metas.name: Cart Pushers
metas.description: A maladjusted cart pusher at a dying grocery store falls for an underage cashier during a heat wave in the New Jersey suburbs.

metas.name: The Yellow One
metas.description: After an event known as the great invasion, wipes out most of the human population, James is forced to become bait for a particularly type of alien. However, things don't go as planned as he finds out the most dangerous variant of these aliens comes to visit him. .

metas.name: Blowfish
metas.description: A drifting young high school dropout gets himself employed at a suburban fish store, where he decides to steal a rare and valuable pufferfish that will help him start his life afresh. In his efforts to sell the precious item to a wealthy collector, the scheme begins to deteriorate into paranoia, dangerous situations, and unhealthy relationships. When faced with the results of his dishonesty, he must confront himself and understand the true consequences of his actions.

metas.name: Plague
metas.description: A poetic journey through an oppressed liminal space.

metas.name: Final Orders
metas.description: Set in France in 1916, three British soldier's are facing the firing squad for cowardness. As they await their fate they have to overcome their own differences and class as in the eyes of death all men are equal.

metas.name: A Message
metas.description: A Message is a short-form documentary draft capturing the raw, unmediated protests and performances of queer Palestinian artist Mama Ganuush while facing pink washing propaganda. Created by trans Palestinian artist Mama Ganuush, this film rejects the flattening narrative of tragedy. Instead, it posits Palestinian Futurism - a framework where those in exile are not merely survivors, but the architects of a liberated cultural and political future.

metas.name: Out of Options
metas.description: Lee Elbaz, a 36-year-old Israeli, was arrested by the FBI, exposing a global fraud industry. While serving 22 years in prison, she maintains her innocence as the industry’s leaders evade punishment.

metas.name: Dreams Deferred
metas.description: Dreams Deferred follows Mary, a young aspiring actress as she grapples with the ever-present tension between artistic passion and the harsh realities of the film industry. In a career where success and external validation can often feel like a reflection of personal value, Mary shares her personal experience as an actress; her passion, love for character work and struggles with feedback and self image. The documentary captures the intensity of the actor’s journey through re-enactments of auditions, stylized interviews, and dreamlike sequences inspired by classic Hollywood.

metas.name: Summer Windows
metas.description: When an ambitious teenager has different plans for her future then originally planned with her friend, she sets up a backyard concert in an attempt to get everyone together for one last time. She must decide if she will allow personal and technical issues get in the way of creating a memorable night

metas.name: Operation Red Leppard
metas.description: Canadian military organization, M.U.D., enlists their most skilled operative for a highly dangerous mission.

metas.name: We Will Haunt Your Archive
metas.description: December 2, 2023. A queer protest erupts in San Francisco in solidarity with Palestine. The film situates this action within the longer history of ACT UP’s activism during the AIDS crisis. It explores glitch as a radical feminist tactic for resisting contemporary regimes of surveillance and silencing.

metas.name: Accidental Truth: Next - Beyond UFO Disclosure
metas.description: An amazing cast takes you on a journey beyond UFO Disclosure. It starts within the cement walls of Washington DC, and then guides you beyond your imagination. Prepare for an awesome adventure that will leave you questioning EVERYTHING.

metas.name: The Space of the Dream
metas.description: In a post-human world where dreams have vanished, a solitary woman wanders through silent cities, carrying with her memories of love and humanity that endure despite the desolation.

metas.name: Grey
metas.description: A grey man can see the colors on others. Obsessed with their beauty, he tries to please people to connect with them. Repeated failures cause him to lose himself, leaving him an exhausted, hollow shell.

metas.name: Off The Menu
metas.description: Four animals who happen to be on a lot of menus: Angel, the fish, Sowley, the pig, Bullock, the bovine and Peck, the chicken have off-beat conversations about the world of food.

metas.name: World Beyond: Ground Zero
metas.description: In a harsh, lawless world where trust is rare and survival comes at a cost.

metas.name: Blue Zone
metas.description: A team of soldiers are sent to investigate a strange anomaly near enemy lines, only to discover that their mission holds far more dangers than they initially bargained for.

metas.name: The Land Demands Blood: Hammer Horror and the Legacy of Cornish Gothic
metas.description: Water, woods, rock, and drifted stream. Storms overhead, fields of salt water, wicked moor. Lightning strokes and standing stones, ground hard as iron and oak, granite swallowing tin and slate. This documentary special feature examines Hammer Films use of Cornwall as a setting and location for its films, exploring the "new weird Britain" of contemporary Cornish folk horror with filmmakers, playwrights, and historians, and drawing on creative work from the region.

metas.name: Roll the Clip!
metas.description: Upcoming mockumentary short film from Andrew Reid.

metas.name: SOMEHOW.
metas.description: When a relationship goes awry, a couple must figure out how to communicate and cope.

metas.name: PARANOIA
metas.description: In a series of recent home invasions, a teenage girl must fight her delusive suspicions when she is left home alone.

metas.name: The Barrel
metas.description: A young prankster wakes trapped in a metal barrel in an abandoned workshop. He must find a way out and learn how and why he got there. Estranged from his devout father, he can only rely on him, shackled to a pole nearby, for guidance.

metas.name: The Creative Dilemma
metas.description: Australian artists share valuable insight about pursuing a full-time creative career despite the stigma and challenges surrounding the creative industry.

metas.name: The Alice Paradox
metas.description: Alice travels through a wormhole, and is transported into an alternate version of the recent past where she encounters different versions of herself and her friend and lab partner, Bob. Trapped in a world that has diverged from ours during the Cold War, and which prizes collectivism over individuality, Alice is forced to confront her life choices, grappling with profound questions about identity, fate, and the search for meaning.

metas.name: The World Is Our Dance Floor
metas.description: Exactly one year after a tragedy, a young writer carries on through the night as though it were any other. What first appears ordinary gradually reveals itself as something far more fragile.

metas.name: Hope
metas.description: On the last day of college, three lives quietly collide with memories, choices, and unspoken feelings. Hope is a poetic reflection on timing, love, and the moments that could have changed everything.  Hope follows three hearts bound by silence, longing, and what remains unsaid. A gentle story about love, timing, and the fragile beauty of unanswered emotions.

metas.name: Untitled Banditos! Sequel
metas.description: Thomas Kitt returns, this time a fully fledged MI6 agent.

metas.name: The Mix
metas.description: An audio engineer must stop her own podcast host's live stream before the violence his words ignite reaches their door in this hyper-stylized, razor-sharp takedown of our modern information age.

metas.name: To Wander the Earth
metas.description: Across three pivotal moments in his life, a masochistic ex-Catholic desperately chases penitential fire, struggling to survive his loss of faith.

metas.name: Feast or Famine: The Quest for the Michelin Star
metas.description: A documentary following the London restaurant Angelina, its chefs and owners, over the span of three months, as they strive to achieve their ultimate goal of winning their first Michelin star.

metas.name: DRUNK
metas.description: Haruna (25), who shows signs of alcohol dependency, spends her days drinking and having fun every night. But she repeatedly causes trouble for her friends and ends up apologizing to them again and again.  One day, Haruna loses her job and even starts bragging about it to her friends.  Gradually, her friends begin to distance themselves from her…

metas.name: Idle
metas.description: Over the course of a day and a half, we explore the life of Dani going about her life, living out of a car, and her spiral when that car breaks down on a secluded road. How far will Dani go to get her car going again?

metas.name: You Who Sees
metas.description: In a village with no government and ruled by a cult leader, Luman, a blind boy turns against the faith he once followed after his sister is killed in a brutal ritual.

metas.name: Venice
metas.description: "A video collage inspired by traversing the canals of Venice, Italy." —Bruce Wood

metas.name: Voices from Ukraine
metas.description: For Out of Frame’s 27th film talk, we took the opportunity to shine a light on the ongoing, unrightful and terrible war in Ukraine while showcasing the work of four amazing filmmakers and artists from Ukraine, who now make their voices heard in Ireland. This was the first Out of Frame session to be recorded. With the war entering its forth year, we decided to turn 'Voices of Ukraine' into a feature length documentary. The audio recorded from our Out of Frame session is featured alongside footage from the rally in support of Ukraine that took place in Cork city, on the Eve of the four year anniversary of the Russian full scale invasion, The Greater Chornobyl Cause annual Chornobyl commemorative service held in Bishop Lucey Park and new interviews from local Ukranian artists / activists.

metas.name: God May Not Exist but Angels Do
metas.description: A handmade matte holds six pairs of wings, twelve wings in total. One wing is exposed at a time, each for one minute, at the matching angel-number times: 06:06, 07:07, 08:08, 09:09, 10:10, 11:11, 12:12, 13:13, 14:14, 15:15, 16:16, and 17:17. Over this, a chorus of voices, children, adults, and the weary, speak their wishes.

metas.name: Consider the Mort
metas.description: Examining the Literal and Figurative Underbellies of the Fish-pain Debate - Essay by Vladic Ravich

metas.name: Boop
metas.description: What happens when a curious clay alien crash-lands in a world of LEGO® bricks?

metas.name: The Schmusical!
metas.description: The Schmus, a group of three friends, hangs out over the summer.

metas.name: The Dreamer
metas.description: It was supposed to be easy to get rid of The Dreamer, but when a tourist arrives a day early, it throws the whole plan off.

metas.name: The Leo
metas.description: Will this be a culmination of the past 50 years or the beginning of the next? This question looms over the town of Prescott, Ontario as the community of just over four thousand people prepare for the 50th edition of the Super Bowl of minor league hockey, "The Leo Boivin Showcase".

metas.name: Mount Airy Hole Nine
metas.description: Four golfers’ tee shot on hole nine at Mount Airy

metas.name: Reverie in Reverse
metas.description: Time flows backward through the last moments of a man’s life, where gestures precede their meanings and emotions echo before they are felt. As the world rewinds around him, fragments of presence dissolve into silence, revealing a final truth hidden at the beginning of it all.

metas.name: THE FAN
metas.description: Following a student suicide, demands to remove ceiling fans reveal a deeper failure within the education system and society itself.

metas.name: For Love
metas.description: Flustered with his static life in love and career, a mid 30s man takes a chance at romance with an affable beau from Mexico City after putting himself aside for nearly a decade.

metas.name: Road Runner
metas.description: Shot on 35mm and 16mm, Road Runner is an experimental meditation on moving incognegro through the world as a Black person of Trans experience—a portrait of what it means to honor ourselves now, in motion, before the world catches up.

metas.name: By Dawn's Early Light
metas.description: Explores faith, liberty, and the American spirit, featuring cultural commentary and historical reflections on the challenges facing people of faith.

metas.name: I den kalla snön
metas.description: It has been a couple of months since he arrived, trying to outrun something far away. Expecting things to be different, but remaining the same, stuck in a cycle of isolation that he can't break out of. He does his best to get through the day but this time he decides to continue his escape, to a place he might not return from.

metas.name: Shruthi & Matty
metas.description: Two queer women in their twenties who connect at a mutual friend's birthday party in Hyderabad.

metas.name: Public Transit
metas.description: A traveler meets a fellow traveler who prompts him to take a look back at himself.

metas.name: Seafarers
metas.description: Amorous sailors bite off more than they can chew when they stop into a seaside pub.

metas.name: Freits
metas.description: Two witches upon their arrival in Scotland run into a series of mishaps, slowly leading to a reveal of deep family history and magical prowess

metas.name: Back to the Zooture
metas.description: Doctor Retro thinks he can rewind time to before it all went bad, and he's taking his roommate/landlord/best friend, Joshua with him.

metas.name: China Girl
metas.description: In an experimental deconstruction of filmic history, a fictional ‘china girl’ confronts the medium and industry that produced her orientalist name. Contrary to the term’s racial connotations, these anonymous models, used for the calibration of exposure and colour in film since the 1920s, were largely white. Drawing from this phenomena, ‘China Girl’ transforms one of cinema’s most invisible yet essential figures through a speculative manifesto on race, visibility, and narrative.

metas.name: The Oldest Munro Bagger
metas.description: A moving, authentic story of enduring love and growth, told against the breathtaking backdrop of the Scottish Highlands.

metas.name: Samuel Volery: The Slackline Legend
metas.description: A portrayal of slacklining legend Samuel Volery's journey as he pushes the different disciplines of jumplining, highlining and freestyle highlining.

metas.name: BAV
metas.description: BAV is a vibrant snapshot of college life capturing the chaos, raw immaturity, childlike energy, and unfiltered fun shared between students across three unforgettable years of their degree.

metas.name: Will - Short Film
metas.description: After going through the dull motions of a non eventful day, a downhearted elderly man (William Harrold) finds joy in what matters most.

metas.name: Man Inflating a Woopie Cushion
metas.description: Actuality of a man inflating a woopie cushion in his home.

metas.name: Precipice
metas.description: A reckless group of teens on the run from the ever approaching future engage in a downward spiral of drug abuse, violence, and existentialism.

metas.name: Eventually
metas.description: A struggling but capable teenager works through his increasingly odd responsibilities on a family farm.

metas.name: First Death
metas.description: Dead and down-bad, Margot makes one last play for eternal love with the avoidant woman she loved on earth.

metas.name: I want a president
metas.description: 1992. United States of America. Bush and Clinton are presidential candidates, as is Myles, a candidate who at the time identifies as a woman, working-class, and openly lesbian. The issue inspires a poem to Zoe Leonard. 2024. The poem was augmented with new demands and translated into Acadam, a post-binary language, by the Bye Bye Binary collective.

metas.name: Why Can't I Belong?
metas.description: A student becomes increasingly dependent with using AI to do his coursework for him, until the technology he relies on begins taking control, forcing him and the people around him to face the unsettling consequences of an over-automated world.

metas.name: AFI Life Achievement Award: A Tribute to Eddie Murphy
metas.description: Comedy trailblazer Eddie Murphy celebrates his legendary film career in this star-studded tribute filmed live in Los Angeles.

metas.name: Um Gosto Assim
metas.description: A Taste - short film

metas.name: REX SPIDER
metas.description: One shot 70s drama about glam rockstar Ricky Jones who refuses to perform as his persona Rex Spider for his last show of the tour

metas.name: Haunters
metas.description: A woman returns to her childhood home after a death in the family. Amidst a surreal drive down winding midwestern roads, she attempts to reconcile where she came from with who she's become.

metas.name: Revolutionary America
metas.description: The story of the American Founding, the greatest political achievement in history. The American colonists had developed a unique way of life as they practiced self-government for 150 years. In the struggles between the colonies and the mother country that followed the French and Indian War, Britain declared that Americans had no right to rule themselves. This went against everything the Americans knew. In response, our ancestors risked their “lives, fortunes, and sacred honor” to fight the War for Independence. Against all odds, they won, and in victory formed a stable, lasting republic.

metas.name: Chasing the Summit
metas.description: Documentary short on Kane Fetterplace and Red Tractor Foods

metas.name: Countershot
metas.description: Since 2022 the german police uses 106 surveillance cameras located in 7 zones of cologne, germany to surveil its people. I surveilled them back over the course of one month. „Countershot“ is a performative film study attempting to symbolically target governmental surveillance in public spaces through individual artistic practice. One super 8 cassette exposed exclusively with single frames; the act of shooting back.

metas.name: Junkmail
metas.description: A boxing drama

metas.name: The Wrong Side of Town
metas.description: A miniseries

metas.name: Hate Cake
metas.description: Plot unknown

metas.name: dykeotomy
metas.description: A teen boy is visited by a silent, future version of himself that is a woman.

metas.name: WITH LOVE, MAE
metas.description: “With Love, Mae” is an animated thesis film directed by Hazelmapel in 2024. The film centers around Mae, an eccentric and impulsive girl, who loves to stir up trouble. She is willing to do anything for her best friend, Lola- even if it means getting rid of said best friend’s boyfriend, Joey.

metas.name: Ishpite
metas.description: “Ishpite” is a pungent drink—its sharpness burns some in the throat, and others in the pocket.

metas.name: CHA CHAI
metas.description: Tea has been used since ancient times to help keep away the unpleasant odor of a dead body—but how much tea would be needed for each corpse? Just the right amount.

metas.name: SOLE MATE
metas.description: I have seen a leader’s joys and sorrows, what matters and what doesn’t, the shades of black and white—yet I lose my place, just because I am considered old. Perhaps loyalty doesn’t always have a price.

metas.name: HOMONCULUS
metas.description: If suddenly, from one day to the next, we could no longer see our reflections—never again seeing our own eyes, nose, face, or ourselves—what would it be like?

metas.name: L’etere
metas.description: An experimental short film on the tension between untouched landscapes and sprawling metropolitan cities

metas.name: MISSED TRAIN
metas.description: After a man misses a train, he is faced with two men that are convinced he is god.

metas.name: Mishpucha
metas.description: A queer stripper has to face the Jewish family that shunned her in order to fulfill her beloved Bubbie's dying wishes.

metas.name: Francesca Hennessy vs. Aurora De Persio
metas.description: Hennessy will be aiming to defend her WBC Silver bantamweight title against Italian De Persio to set up a fight against undisputed bantamweight champion Cherneka Johnson later this year.  "This is another important test for me," said 21-year-old Hennessy. "I've always wanted to challenge myself against good opponents because that's what will prepare me for world title fights."

metas.name: STATIC
metas.description: A cultural sciences professor named Sam has spent nearly two months buried in archival research on Remi Silva — a Lagos philanthropist of Afro-Brazilian descent whose life, on paper, reads as entirely ordinary. But the deeper Sam digs, the more the man refuses to stay ordinary.  A cassette tape in Yoruba. A cryptic sealed letter. A symbol that keeps appearing where it shouldn't.  When a young bookkeeper steps in for the absent librarian, what begins as small talk about belief and mythology starts to quietly destabilize everything Sam thinks he knows.  *Static* is a slow-burn mystery about the limits of skepticism — and what happens when a man of reason comes face to face with what he cannot explain.

metas.name: Waywa
metas.description: After escaping a dangerous confrontation one woman must negotiate with a mysterious survivor to recover what matters most: her missing friend. But not everything in the galaxy is what it seems.

metas.name: Election Day - The Day Thailand Dug Its Own Grave
metas.description: Surrounded by major controversy, a general election that was supposed to bring a fresh start for the year 2026, resulted in once again a disappointment for many of the Thai people.

metas.name: مهندس الذوق العام
metas.description: A comedy Kuwaiti play about a husband yearning to be a father who finally get the good news of his wife being pregnant. But he doesn’t want his child to live in this world of misery chaos and twisted morality. So he try to make the world a better place for his future child hoping his kid would continue this journey after him.

metas.name: Bug Me
metas.description: The film had to be made—independently of the fear of including the family into any creative process, depending exclusively on the use of photographs. In the absence of motion, new fears come to light. They are conquered bit by bit, at 24 frames per second.

metas.name: Exquisite Tension
metas.description: Triple-projection 16mm film by Erica Sheu

metas.name: About the Same Age
metas.description: Expanded cinema work by Erica Sheu featuring 16mm footage and two 35mm slide projections

metas.name: Edgewater Rituals
metas.description: Filmed in celebration of our upcoming wedding and as we moved into our new home on March 28 & 29, 2026. With Nicole, Ben & Carl along the Chicago Lakefront at Hollywood Beach.

metas.name: The Revenge On Adore: One Final Battle
Life and Taxes
metas.description: Sebastian (b. Milton Miron), a 90-year-old accountant and tax preparer in Los Angeles, reflects on his pursuit of a creative life as an underground filmmaker and impresario during San Francisco's counter-cultural heyday.

metas.description: Two close friends meet late at night to talk

metas.name: Leave a Comment
metas.description: Michael Burns lets a hater ruin his week.
