metas.name: Toast to Milan
metas.description: Team USA’s figure skating stars reunite to reflect on the top stories and moments from the 2026 Winter Olympics in Milan Cortina, hosted by Adam Rippon.

metas.name: If Only You Knew
metas.description: After losing someone dear to her, fem finds the courage to confront her Jamaican father about his absences. A conversation that leads to an unspoken truth.

metas.name: To Busk or Not to Busk
metas.description: Two contrasting buskers present the value of their profession along with the sacrifices they made to pursue what they do, as seen both through the eyes of the public and their own.

metas.name: Mario Kart:La Pelicula
metas.description: Mario drives his kart through the real world until he accidentally crashes into a pipe. Now, Mario must compete against the King of the Koopas, Bowser, to decide the fate of the Mushroom Kingdom.

metas.name: Instadocs: Alex Murdaugh, Unconvicted
metas.description: Why was Alex Murdaugh's conviction overturned? The debut of "Instadocs" digs into stunning allegations of jury interference in his double murder trial.

metas.name: Radio Silent
metas.description: A short film starring the band DELCO that follows a guitarist and his band's journey of bringing back music to a quiet nation.

metas.name: peach
metas.description: A reunion between two ex-friends unravels the delicate space between friendship and Queer desire.

metas.name: My Life, Hers
metas.description: An expectant mother sees her life through different womens' perpsectives.

metas.name: AAA Noche de Los Grandes 2026 - Week 1
metas.description: Noche de Los Grandes (Spanish for "Night of the Greats") was a professional wrestling event produced by the Mexican professional wrestling promotion Lucha Libre AAA Worldwide (AAA), in partnership with its parent company WWE. The event took place on Saturday, May 30, 2026, at Arena Monterrey in Monterrey, Nuevo León, Mexico.

metas.name: Roots
metas.description: A man battling cancer chooses between strength and rest, help and independence.

metas.name: Rationale
metas.description: Torn on coming out to his parents, a teenage boy turns to his friend for a second opinion.

metas.name: Basement People
metas.description: Seven-year-old Tina is left in the care of her extended family after a traumatic event exposes the fault lines of a volatile household.

metas.name: Howard’s Way: The Hot Dog Howard Story
metas.description: A washed up competitive eater details his fall from grace.

metas.name: Nine Counties
metas.description: The Winter Solstice as seen through the lens of a Super 8 road movie; a vignette painted through impressions of the land, the sights, the sounds and the local radio stations.

metas.name: l à m       m ề m
metas.description: A Vietnamese-American girl reflects on a childhood memory of her grandmother while ill.

metas.name: The -Core: A Core Page Documentary
metas.description: A documentary that takes a look at the Core Page subculture that's existed on Facebook for over a decade now. A showcase of the influence Cores have had on Facebook, the broader internet, and the lives of the admins running these pages.

metas.name: Cat in the Rain
metas.description: Classmates Samantha and Melissa get carried away while finishing a project for their high school English class.

metas.name: Something Still
metas.description: A heartbroken man returns to the home he shared with his ex-boyfriend, where visceral memories force him to confront the fissures that led to their parting: when the 'casual threesome' they planned evolved into something more.

metas.name: The Love Situation
metas.description: A teen in love overthinks an unlikely situation only to see it unfold in front of his eyes. Abby cheated on Logan for Bentley, Brynlee cheated on Bentley for Logan, Logan cheated on Abby for Brynlee, and Bentley cheated on Brynlee for Abby.

metas.name: Girl Dad
metas.description: A tough, queer teenager leaves Brooklyn for the first time to spend the summer with her estranged, struggling composer father in Los Angeles. The two are forced to reconnect over a used refrigerator, that nearly upends and further strains their father-daughter relationship in the process.

metas.name: The Long Con
metas.description: A little desert motel. A runaway bride. A grifter lover. A suitcase full of trouble.

metas.name: The Edge of Eternity
metas.description: Part three of a trilogy of personal growth and discovery

metas.name: A Wish
metas.description: A quiet celebration triggers a painful past. In confronting it, she finds closure.

metas.name: Boys Night
metas.description: Todd and Skinny go to Prince Edward Island for a party. Tommy and Liz stay home.

metas.name: Admission Possible
metas.description: Admission Possible follows high-achieving, first-generation college applicants from a single NYC public high school as they strive to secure a future once unimaginable for their immigrant families.

metas.name: Ryzyup
metas.description: Ryzyup (pronounced rih-zee-up) presents a series of unstable, shifting images that resist clear recognition. Shapes appear briefly before dissolving back into motion and texture. The film invites a mode of attention where perception softens and the viewer begins to drift inward.

metas.name: Haunted Harmony Mysteries: Key to the Castle
metas.description: When a ghost hunter show comes to town, it's up to Gethsemane and Eamon to solve the unexpected murder of the host, allowing the brand-new spirit to cross-over.

metas.name: Work Friends
metas.description: A small time criminal is tasked with killing a rat…whom he just so happens to share a past with.

metas.name: A Butler's Job
metas.description: A devoted butler tries to save his detective master from a mysterious vampiric kidnapping.

metas.name: Who Knew?
metas.description: Late at night on an isolated bush road, two strangers cross paths — each carrying a secret the other has no business knowing. What follows is a tense game of cat-and-mouse as both try to manipulate the other, each convinced they're in control.

metas.name: STOP THE WORLD I WANT TO GET OFF
metas.description: The complex relationship between parent and child from childhood to adulthood has affected Florence's life in unthinkable ways.  She must now navigate whether to sever ties for good...or whether to give her father another chance.

metas.name: Spirits Talk
metas.description: A grieving woman’s reality and memories begin to blur as her adoptive mother, Mother Nikki, reaches out to her from the spirit realm. She must speak to her mother one last time—or risk losing the ability to love herself and others.

metas.name: Dinamita
metas.description: After a harsh breakup, a soul-crushing job, and the pain of watching her ex move on with someone new, Cristina reaches a breaking point. What starts as a fleeting intrusive thought turns into a wild, reckless plan to erase him from her life — a choice that will send her down a path with no way back.

metas.name: Same Time Next Year?
metas.description: Expecting another uneventful Jummah, Safa finds herself trapped with her overbearing family and an angry ex.

metas.name: Sucker-Punch
metas.description: Set somewhen around Valentines day, Sucker-Punch is a noir-comedy starring candy-themed private eye Pez Incognito. Hired by Sophia Mafia, a mob boss' daughter, to investigate the murder of her situationship. Incognito faces the sweet and sour of romance in a world of eccentric criminals, gangsters, and murder.

metas.name: Good Daze
metas.description: A coming-of-age stoner comedy that explores the power of friendship and shows that the most extraordinary journeys often happen in the most unexpected places. Jas (they/them), a sharp-witted two-spirit punk, and Ari (she/her), their shy but loyal best friend, are about to take the ride of their lives. When Jas’s wild cousin Coco delivers a slick, retro dream car, their world is flipped upside down.

metas.name: Mata Hari
metas.description: In 1975, television star David Carradine came up with a novel way to forge a relationship with his estranged daughter Calista: he would make a movie with her. "Mata Hari" tells the story of David and Calista's relationship through the lens of their unfinished, years-long film project, an epic telling of the life of the Dutch courtesan and spy, Mata Hari.

metas.name: Where the Heart Lands
metas.description: A Kentucky horse trainer's world is upended when a handsome LA lawyer inherits her stable. To stop him from selling, she and the locals drag him into the excitement of horse racing, finding love along the way.

metas.name: The Boy and The Other
metas.description: The Boy is stuck in a mental battle with himself. Though desperate for solitude, a curious Other insists on friendship.

metas.name: Looking for Alan
metas.description: Lilian is worried about whether she can still look after herself and Tom. While she helps him look for something that he can't remember (but it has something to do with football pundits), she has a decision to make about their future.

metas.name: (Untitled)2025
metas.description: (Untitled)2025 is an incantation to our Indigenous ancestors from the Global Majority who experienced enforced binary genders, colonialism and the theft of land and resources. Campbell X explores these themes through a lyrical script, innovative camera techniques which explore the human form in close detail, a haunting soundscape and visuals from lush and devastating extraction from both countries and bodies.

metas.name: No Place for Football
metas.description: A football club from Nuuk is forced to overcome a series of obstacles as they travel north for the world’s shortest football season, in pursuit of a dream of becoming Greenland’s national champions.

metas.name: On The Line
metas.description: Robert a young solitary student, must navigate an unpredictable night to save his brother.

metas.name: The Tide Turns
metas.description: A mute young woman, Nora, awakens into a surreal domestic prison, a seemingly idyllic beachside cottage under the suffocating control of a charismatic but sinister Fisherman and his increasingly unstable partner.

metas.name: Mariana
metas.description: In 2022, Mariana (36) is imprisoned for drug trafficking—a desperate act committed to support her child amid economic instability and a crumbling family life.  Behind bars, she finds time to confront her past and seek redemption. The arrival of the 2025 Jubilee Year offers her a glimmer of hope for a fresh start. Upon her parole in December 2025, Mariana reaches a profound realization: her true duty as a mother is not measured by the money she provides through crime, but by the love and presence she offers her child.

metas.name: Cherry
metas.description: While their best friend loses their virginity in an adjoining motel room, high school sophomores Charlie and Emmett bond over the sexual insecurity of adolescence.

metas.name: Chaser and the Cars
metas.description: Chaser and his dad take out a bunch of cars and drive them.

metas.name: Waking a Brutal Beast
metas.description: A feature-length documentary on the making of Tobe Hooper's THE MANGLER.

metas.name: In Ten Pictures: Britney
metas.description: Britney Spears was one of the biggest pop stars of her generation. This is the story of how, defined by imagery, she fought for control over her music, her life and her image.

metas.name: C++: The Documentary
metas.description: C++: The Documentary  tells the story of one of the most influential programming languages ever created. From its beginnings at Bell Labs in 1979 to its role powering modern computing infrastructure, the film traces how C++ evolved and why it continues to matter today.  Through interviews with language creators, standards contributors, and engineers across industries, the documentary explores the design philosophy behind C++, the challenges of maintaining a language used by millions of developers, and the systems it enables—from game engines and particle physics to financial infrastructure.

metas.name: Belly Hop
metas.description: A young couple trying to shoot rabbits in the desert. And of course… stuff gets very, very weird.

metas.name: DRUMMER
metas.description: A hardcore drummer meets a dancer.

metas.name: The Bar Between Roads
metas.description: On the anniversary of her death, a young man and his late lover spend one final night together in a bar between life and the afterlife.

metas.name: One Bottle After Another
metas.description: When one guy's water bottle gets stolen, he attempts to take it back.

metas.name: Tinseltown
metas.description: A young struggling Actor meets a brief and unlikely mentor in attempting an impossible project.

metas.name: Cost of a Second
metas.description: Late to pitch her revolutionary time machine, inventor Olivia is interrupted by her future self, forcing her to choose between fortune and fame, or destroying her invention to save the world.

metas.name: SWISH
metas.description: Swish is a short film that captures the everyday life of Filipino student-athletes who share a deep passion for basketball. The film highlights the energy, struggles, and joy found in Filipino basketball culture.

metas.name: Boygirl
metas.description: Segments from childhood diaries intertwine with poetry to tell the story of Boygirl:a genderqueer child who is traversing the complexity of their inner world.

metas.name: 2:00AM Senses
metas.description: Music Video for DOAH NEITCH's EARTHECCO

metas.name: Calicut Paragon Menu
metas.description: At the Calicut Paragon Restaurant in Karama, a 15-minute visual journey unfolded across glowing screens — a cinematic slideshow of signature dishes, rich flavors, and vibrant culinary creations playing silently in the background while dining.

metas.name: BURNED
metas.description: A THIEF DID SOMETHING IN HIS PAST BUT IT IS SLOWLY CATCHING UP TO HIM & HE DOESN'T KNOW WHAT TO DO NEXT...

metas.name: Dilanglawin
metas.description: Following a five member friend group (Akiro, Samuel, Mara, Eirene, and Malia) as they navigate the sharp turns of early adulthood, the gravity of their emotions, and the loss of something that cannot be left forgotten six feet below the grass.

metas.name: Who Killed Penelope?
metas.description: August lost her best friend, Penelope, and went out of her way to find her.

metas.name: Still Here
metas.description: a modern world where love feels like something everyone is searching for, Lia finds herself torn between two very different kinds of love. Adrian offers passion that is intense and consuming, while Mateo brings a quiet sense of comfort and stability. Believing that choosing between them will finally fill the emptiness she feels, Lia makes a decision that seems perfect at first. But when the excitement fades, she realizes that the answer she was looking for cannot be found in another person. Forced to confront herself and what she truly wants, Lia discovers that love is not meant to complete someone, but to grow alongside them as they become the person they are meant to be.

metas.name: puppies
metas.description: experimental collage short film by Elsie Fisher

metas.name: Joan of Arc
metas.description: A vague light flickers in the distance.

metas.name: Tomorrow's Dreams  Short Demo
metas.description: Short Demo  ...  private request only

metas.name: UTKA! or: The Assassination of Trotsky, Abridged
metas.description: A concise and extremely historically-accurate retelling of the events surrounding Leon Trotsky's assassination.

metas.name: A Moment in Time
metas.description: Sometimes the love along the way is the thing we truly miss  A Moment in Time - a moving short film about love, memory, and the fragile seconds that define us

metas.name: Elevator Killings
metas.description: An unsuspecting student takes a deadly elevator ride with a classmate.

metas.name: Hooperella
metas.description: A modern fairy-tale satire set in the cutthroat world of academic research that follows Gabriela Quiroz, an overworked PhD student preparing for a crucial Research Funding mixer where major grants are awarded. Her entitled lab partner Andrew routinely coasts on her work while taking credit. Their advisor, Dr. Thatcher reinforces the imbalance. Gabriela is expected to remain invisible but indispensable. Will she find the courage to defy her advisor and lab partner in a bid to secure funding for her research?

metas.name: The History of Harriton
metas.description: Tucked away in the corner of Lower Merion is Harriton High School, a public school known for its competitive culture, distinguished extracurriculars and stellar educational quality. This documentary explores the deep, convoluted history of the school, tracing not only its 68 years of operation but also the origins of its name and land dating back to the mid-17th century. Created by a student at the school, this film includes interviews from past and present teachers, administrators, and students.

metas.name: THEY NEVER STOP DANCING
metas.description: Inside a confined cube, chaotic shadow dancers move without rhythm or order. A mysterious figure, seen only through fragments of a face, begins reshaping their world — pulling curtains, rebuilding space, and restoring structure to the movement. As the environment transforms, the dancers emerge from confinement into floating bubbles beyond the cube, where dance continues freely. A surreal meditation on dance as one of humanity’s oldest universal expressions of joy, emotion, and existence

metas.name: Cloudy, with a chance of Sunburn
metas.description: John Cabot University

metas.name: Etched Flowers
metas.description: When their stems looses integrity, three blossoms face one another in a poignant discourse.

metas.name: The Cat Lands on All Fours
metas.description: The existential crises of our present moment in conversation with the unlikely magic of motion picture technology.

metas.name: Robbo: My Liverpool
metas.description: Look back on Robbo's incredible journey with the Reds. Robbo: My Liverpool premieres on All Red Video on Thursday 28th of May

metas.name: A Thousand Words
metas.description: Two filmmakers set out for Nepal to find the exact spot from where legendary mountaineer and photographer Vittorio Sella captured the first images of Mount Everest 125 years ago.

metas.name: The Thin Air Between
metas.description: A former pro cyclist embarks on a heart-pounding, visually breathtaking journey into the thin air between success and failure.

metas.name: Khumbu: Whispers of an Ancient Glacier
metas.description: In a poetic and intimate monologue, an ancient glacier speaks to us, sharing its story.

metas.name: This Call May Be Recorded
metas.description: Will, a broke college graduate, accepts a job at a sketchy telemarketing agency with his roommate, but after realizing what the job entails, Will begins to question his morals as he grapples with choosing money over the well-being of others.

metas.name: The Queen
metas.description: When an anxious teen who lives under the shadow of her prom queen sister starts suspecting she's alien royalty after experiencing strange, out-of-this-world visions, she must confront whether she is destined for power or losing her grip on reality.

metas.name: PULSE
metas.description: In the world of ego, money, and fashion, a creative on the fringes of the music scene is torn between family and his ambition, leaving him to decide whether to betray his brother to achieve success.

metas.name: Ajosepo 2: The Gathering
metas.description: Two families reunite for a lavish Yoruba wedding after a past scandal nearly tore them apart. As Mary and Jide prepare to marry, unresolved tensions, family pressure, and reputation fears threaten their union. Meanwhile, new parents Dapo and Tani battle constant clashes between their feuding mothers. Amid tradition, church politics, and romantic distractions, both couples must choose honesty and commitment before the celebration unravels.

metas.name: Train 39
metas.description: Train 39 follows a boy named Rowan as he sets out to buy groceries for his grandmother's 73rd birthday. After missing his train, he's left waiting on the platform, until a strange man directs him to board "Train 39," a train that seemingly appears out of nowhere behind him. Once aboard, Rowan loses consciousness and awakens in a pastel pink house within a dreamlike world where everything feels eerily perfect.

metas.name: Queen's Land
metas.description: Queen’s Land tells the oft forgotten history of drag, repression and resistance in Queensland’s queer scene during the Joh Bjelke-Petersen dictatorship. With glitter and glamour Destiny Rogers describes the ups and downs of life under Australia’s most conservative police state through the 60s to 80s. Petrified jelly, bribery, and gay bikies. Despite living in “pig city” a community was able to persist. To complement, Sel Dowd provides a history of the activist struggles of the era which inform our ongoing struggles today.

metas.name: Are You Being Thanked Endlessly?
metas.description: Filmmaker Gulzar and their two best friends spend a tired afternoon together. What begins as a playful conversation about hair, turns into an intimate reflection on gender, identity and belonging.

metas.name: Pentacide
metas.description: In 1999, a series of grisly, religiously inspired killings struck the country repeating every five years, now in the present day (2024) the story follows two detectives who are trying to solve the biggest serial killer case the UK has ever seen!

metas.name: Jhimmiki
metas.description: A young woman struggles against harassment and judgment in a society that refuses to hear her.

metas.name: Director's Notes
metas.description: Director’s Notes is a modular playlist exploring the ideas behind Carnets d’Amérique, a fictional film about an African writer visiting New York on a book tour, leading to adventures and encounters with collaborators, authorities, institutions, and libraries.

metas.name: Iku Aka
metas.description: In a film written, directed, filmed, and produced by a crew of all Black women including three of Nigerian-American descent, Chinelo approaches what should be one of the happiest days of her life: her wedding. Her soon-to-be fiance must complete Iku Aka, the first stage of cultural marriage in Igbo land, by asking her mother for her hand in marriage. Out of respect for tradition, Chinelo’s mother appoints her uncle, Festus, to speak on the family’s behalf as the eldest and most successful man—but he also is a man who sexually assaulted Chinelo when she was young. The confrontation forces her down a rabbit hole of memories, compelling her to face the deficiencies of tradition.

metas.name: Rookie Run-Thru
metas.description: A new conductor must navigate her inner thoughts and fears while preparing to lead a marching band for the very first time.

metas.name: White Agbada
metas.description: Ibironke, a Nigerian-American woman whose life is stagnant, engages in self-destructive behaviors to cope. Her concerned sister calls her one day to propose a family trip to Nigeria for spiritual assistance. Ibironke is totally against this and continues to engage in her bad habits—including a casual relationship with an engaged prospective business partner who has a baby on the way. When their post-sex discussion accelerates into a fight, an ancestor who has dropped Easter eggs throughout her day appears in her mirror, terrifying her. She immediately knows this climactic sighting is a radical call for change.

metas.name: Hope
metas.description: After doom-scrolling on social media, a young poet named Salome Agbaroji is thrust into a fantastic journey through a magical animated realm, where she encounters a majestic Black Crowned Crane.

metas.name: Learning How to Feel
metas.description: Only a week into married life, Anna learns she will lose her sight in six months time. Her husband Drew discovers the hardest part isn’t the diagnosis, but navigating their opposing ways on how to prepare before this new chapter of their life begins.

metas.name: Leavers
metas.description: Faced with moving on to the next chapter of their lives, four young men must confront the close-knit bonds of their friendships when two of them realise their feelings for each other.

metas.name: Troll Story
metas.description: An internet troll outlines his own rules of engagement and comments on how cutting-edge technology is threatening a post-truth world.

metas.name: What on Earth
metas.description: A fearful alien is sent to Earth to retrieve a fugitive from his own kind, but things get complicated as he has befriended a little girl who teaches them about love and human emotions.

metas.name: I'm Gonna Kill You
metas.description: In the distant future, inside an ‘all gay colony’, Cal and Spector, two paired lovers, fighting an internal battle – where remaining colony members ultimately pay the price of their twisted games.

metas.name: National Theatre Live: The Playboy of the Western World
metas.description: Pegeen Flaherty’s life is turned upside down when a young man walks into her pub claiming that he’s killed his father. Instead of being shunned, the killer becomes a local hero and begins to win hearts, that is until a second man unexpectedly arrives on the scene...

metas.name: Return
metas.description: The film tells the story of antelope Hardy, who embarks on a difficult journey of self-cultivation in order to fight against the wolves that threaten the group after the death of his father.

metas.name: The Boys of Dungeon Lane: In Conversation with Paul McCartney and Paul Mescal
metas.description: Premiering exclusively on Amazon Live and Amazon Music, this short film features an intimate conversation between Paul McCartney and Paul Mescal, exploring the memories, relationships, events and stories that inform McCartney’s forthcoming album of the same name.

metas.name: Emi Martínez: The Kid Who Stops Time
metas.description: Mixing animation and interviews, this film follows Emi Martínez's journey to becoming a legendary goalkeeper, from small-town Argentina to world glory.

metas.name: Strung
metas.description: A talented violinist's prestigious new role as a music tutor for an enigmatic, elite family spirals into a psychological battle for her safety and sanity.

metas.name: Teeth to the Wind
metas.description: Before Michael Gardner's death in Nepal in 2024, he and his climbing partner Sam Hennessey had started a film project about their friendship. Remarkable alpinists, but reluctant filmmakers, Teeth to the Wind realizes Gardner and Hennessey's original vision: a joyful and unassuming glimpse at what they referred to as “the spirit.”

metas.name: Sewer Pigs Declare War on London
metas.description: Ayo, a punk-rock teen and first-generation Brit, is full of fighting spirit for the betterment of those around her, but feels isolated and rejected with no one to fight by her side. When the sewer pig army invades London to take the city for themselves, Ayo must fight to defend her community in spite of her doubts.

metas.name: The Memory Clocksmith
metas.description: Victor is a Clock smith that works towards restoring his customers memories trapped inside. One day someone leaves him a broken pocket-watch, and he sets to fixing it immediately. Things start to get a little funky when the broken watch suddenly sucks Victor into a string of his own forgotten memories. This new journey will send Victor on a path of rediscovering himself and what’s been lost.

metas.name: Kreachur Kichin
metas.description: When creative doldrums drive him late into the night, monstrous gourmands create late-night chaos in the kitchen of a promising young chef.

metas.name: Graveyard Gremlins
metas.description: Two morally questionable graverobbers accidentally start the zombie apocalypse by stealing from their grandmother’s grave. When their grandmother rises from the dead, they must set aside their selfish pride and take responsibility for the mess they’ve created.

metas.name: Perfume ZO/Z5th Anniversary "Nebula Romance" -Complete Edition-
metas.description: In addition to the final performance (April 20) of the nationwide arena tour "Perfume 10th Tour ZOZ5 "Nebula Romance" Episode 1" held to celebrate the 25th anniversary of the formation and the 20th anniversary of their major label debut, the "Perfume ZO/Z5 Anniversary "Nebula Romance" Episode TOKYO DOME" (September 23), two performances that symbolize Perfume's milestones, are packaged as a complete version.  In addition, approximately 147 minutes of bonus footage is included, including the MC at each location, highlights from "P.T.A. 's Corner," selected performance footage from the arena tour, and the MC from the first day of the Dome performance. The content allows viewers to relive the tour from multiple angles.

metas.name: The Baby Clause
metas.description: A career driven woman fixated on become a single mom finds herself with more family and loves than she ever thought possible when a precocious preteen plays matchmaker with her jaded single dad.

metas.name: Sandsailors
metas.description: Sandsailors is a high-speed film packed with mayhem and action, inspired by science fiction comics and anime. Despite its harsh aesthetics, the story is defined by a soft emotional core. In the face of a bloodthirsty crowd, Emery and Alison’s love for each other motivates them to think beyond the “one survivor” rule. In a world that seems overwhelmingly violent, our connections to one another become our hope. The sailors’ relationship represents that hope, even as the cruel forces that surround the arena threaten to doom them.

metas.name: Charlatan
metas.description: Faced with a tough choice between financial survival and integrity, a con man parading as a psychic meets his latest mark: a ghost who doesn't take kindly to frauds. Trapped in a world where his own tricks come to life, he must outrun his lies to make it home.

metas.name: arable.
metas.description: When a celebrated architect discovers an obsessive solace in designing a residential home on a plot of farmland, he must first address the matters in his own house.

metas.name: Two Apes Beat Each Other to Death
metas.description: Two apes fight for the last seat on Noah's Ark

metas.name: Moticos
metas.description: In rural Texas, a driver embarks on a solitary road trip where she is overcome with  memories of her past relationship, each one represented in various degrees of  reality. These flashbacks eventually bleed into her present as she is forced to  confront her ex.

metas.name: Newspeak
metas.description: A man finds himself in a place he can't recognize, accused of a crime he can't remember, and when he's punished, he is sent to "the room" a mysterious place that takes away his  agency and makes him the face of this malicious place.

metas.name: YŪGEN
metas.description: An ambient vision of the Oregon coast.

metas.name: Any Minute Now
metas.description: In a quiet university accommodation, a group of flatmates spiral into anxious chaos as the clock strikes ten.

metas.name: Baignade Interdite
metas.description: Stop bullying

metas.name: Thiefish
metas.description: A thief and a fisherman work together to steal a fish spirit being used as an energy source in order to return it to the ocean.

metas.name: Sold to Death
metas.description: When a realtor's celebrity clients start turning up dead, she becomes the suspect in a string of murders that trace back to a buried family secret.

metas.name: The Big Dill
metas.description: After a struggling actor finally lands a leading role as the monster in a movie called "Attack of the 80-Foot Pickle," his willpower is tested when he and the director start to butt heads.

metas.name: Richard Madeley: Inside the World's Mega Prison
metas.description: Broadcaster Richard Madeley gains access inside one of the most controversial prisons in the world, El Salvador's Centro de Confinamiento del Terrorismo.

metas.name: Only ONE Person Can Leave This Room...
metas.description: I did it! I made an escape room that only one player out of everyone would be able to beat. And I did it all in vanilla Minecraft without commands as well. There's a lot of cool tech in this video that was mainly discovered by me so shout out me. Also shout out Big Dxs  This video is like 20% escape room and 80% improve 😭 I mean I did say I'm not an escape room creator...

metas.name: The Pioneers
metas.description: Drinking his way through a tragedy, Miles messages an old friend, hoping it'll heal old wounds, but little does he know, what starts as a friendly reunion, slowly turns sinister

metas.name: Broken
metas.description: After a domestic violence incident, Shelly accidentally kills her abuser in self defence, leading to a strong feeling of guilt and loss.

metas.name: Hound Dog’s Release
metas.description: A compelling mystery about an old song and it’s impacts on the generation growing up hearing it.

metas.name: IBIU
metas.description: A short private film created by 3 high-school students depicting the average teenage-girl experience. Shot in a grass field over 2 minutes.

metas.name: Foam-Born
metas.description: The birth of Aphrodite

metas.name: Billions Club Live with Olivia Rodrigo: A Concert Film
metas.description: Live from Barcelona, Olivia Rodrigo takes her top fans on an emotional ride through her biggest songs during a one-night-only Billions Club Live concert. From her Billions Club hits to her new single "drop dead," along with a few fan favorites, it all unravels in one unforgettable live performance.

metas.name: The Moon Stole My Stripes
metas.description: A tiger tries getting her stripes back after they've been stolen by the rabbit on the moon.

metas.name: Tukuy
metas.description: Sacha, the mother tree and guardian of the Yungas collapses when her beloved Lapacho tree dies and takes all color from her life. Lost in grief, she meets Diablito, a good carnival devil who briefly reminds her of joy and pushes her to question her purpose.

metas.name: Dream Stall
metas.description: When her father (Mark Lee) decides to shut down You & Me Bak Kut Teh, their family bak kut teh hawker business, top-scoring university graduate Enya (Annette Lee) takes it upon herself to save it.  She successfully persuades her childhood friends Tammy (Xixi Lim) and Ahji (Jaspers Lai) to quit their jobs and join her in reopening business, but their endeavour gets off to a bad start when famous local actress Estella Tsai (Ya Hui), with the help of her manager Doreen (Cassandra See), open a restaurant next to them, selling the exact same dish.  Determined not to lose to her newfound rivals, Enya feigns interest in a food documentary YouTuber, Preston (Xander Pang) — who has a reputation of saving local F&B businesses with his videos but only does so pro-bono. Will she succeed in keeping the shop alive?

metas.name: Back to Bones
metas.description: An evil Necromancer plots to invade a distant castle. Surrounded by bones and debris he casts a spell, raising the dead to assemble an army and march across the dry landscape. Meanwhile, a Knight and his Squire are resurrected from the magic. Not wanting to get involved, and honestly just tired, the Knight tries to go back to sleep. He tries new, and increasingly extreme, methods of self-destruction only to find that the Necromancer’s magic keeps bringing him back to life.

metas.name: Passage
metas.description: Saddled with the grief of missing her late mother’s last phone call, Anna must choose what to do with the pregnancy that sparked their final argument.

metas.name: Blueberries
metas.description: Two tired men argue over the stupidest stuff

metas.name: The Original Sin
metas.description: A ridiculously wealthy father gifts his son Adam a girlfriend in an attempt to inspire his manhood.

metas.name: JOHN
metas.description: After mistreatment at her law firm, a black female lawyer disguises herself as a white man.

metas.name: Matches
metas.description: After matching with a famous actor on a dating app, Ryan is invited to a party at his mansion and is unexpectedly thrown into a cutthroat competition for the actor’s heart.

metas.name: All the Seasons Pass Me Over Too
metas.description: Monica, a young college student must come face to face with her relationship with Ben.

metas.name: 93 'Til
metas.description: A struggling artist painter on the brink of eviction and a vintage curator haunted by inherited dreams skip the corporate future they're supposed to want and spend one day discovering whether love is worth the risk.

metas.name: Hold Your Horses
metas.description: An anxious man transforms into a pony during a full moon... while on his date!

metas.name: Penny in the Sky
metas.description: When a man contemplating his life decides to put his fate into a coin toss, he's interrupted by the sudden appearance of a woman there to end her life as well. Now they both find themselves at a crossroads, life and death decided by heads or tails.

metas.name: Cold War in Philly
metas.description: In 1976 with the Cold War raging, the Philadelphia Flyers took to the ice to play the unbeaten Russian Red Army team. What happened that day went down in sports history.

metas.name: Youth Fighting
metas.description: A new classmate, Lonia, joins the 7th grade of elementary school. Romek and Damian compete for her attention, which turns into a series of wild adventures. Lonia discovers life in the housing estates of Zabrze, an industrial city in Silesia. The story takes place in 1990s Poland, during the post-Soviet transformation. Everything is seen and told through the eyes of the main character. The story is based on the memories of the film’s director and screenwriter.

metas.name: A Life in Colour
metas.description: Lucy, an aspiring artist escapes into dreamlike visions through mysterious vials. As fantasy consumes her, she must choose which world to live in.

metas.name: What's the Story, Wishbone?
metas.description: A behind-the-scenes journey into the creation and lasting legacy of Wishbone, the Emmy-winning PBS series that introduced a generation to classic literature through the adventures of a small dog with a big imagination.

metas.name: Kylie - Tension Tour Live
metas.description: It's time to hit the dancefloor as pop superstar Kylie Minogue shares a vibrant, exclusive behind-the-scenes look at her smash 2025 Tension World Tour.

metas.name: Red Herring
metas.description: When a murder mystery party reveals a dark secret, an innocent young woman finds herself in a game of cat and mouse with the rest of the players.

metas.name: To the Tooth
metas.description: Artie is a young Italian chef who runs a bistro that used to be owned by her father. When the dead body of an ex-mafioso appears in the restaurant, Artie must re-evaluate her relationship with both L'Atessa and the people in it.

metas.name: Long Ago
metas.description: A story of long, long ago. When the world was just beginning.

metas.name: Something to Entertain You
metas.description: Meet the artists you will never forget. A documentary about Karen & Tony Barone — two desert artists who turned a highway into a gallery, and their whole life into art.

metas.name: Peace before Disasterpiece
metas.description: A man obsessed with a lover who is now distant from him commits suicide.

metas.name: The Little Mermaid vs. Mega Jaws
metas.description: In a world where the ocean's deepest secrets come to life, the fabled mermaid faces her greatest nemesis yet: Mega Jaws, nature's deadliest killer. When a terrifying, mutated great white shark emerges from the abyss, it's up to the fearless mermaid to defend her kingdom-both under the sea and on land. With jaw-dropping underwater battles, explosive land chases, and heart-pounding action, this is the guilty pleasure you've been waiting for.

metas.name: Selfish
metas.description: Jean makes a new friend in college, Andy. Since she cannot date Andy who is homosexual, she sets him up with her cousin, Titus. What started as friends in class quickly spiral into obsession and selfish desires, and secrets uncovered.

metas.name: We're Being Held Hostage in a Technology Bubble
metas.description: A documentary about the disappearance, subversion and suppression of different technologies.

metas.name: The Knowing
metas.description: After a mysterious event leaves a young woman deeply shaken, she finds herself caught in a series of increasingly disturbing encounters that force her to confront fear, fate, and her own survival.

metas.name: Deadline
metas.description: When writer’s block threatens his career, Tómas, a screenwriter searches for a shortcut before time runs out.

metas.name: I Dreamt of Cowboys, Cottonfields, and Clouds – Bernard Williams
metas.description: An excavator of American history, painter and sculptor Bernard Williams draws inspiration from seminal, but under-appreciated figures such as Black cowboys, farmers, and a unique female aviator. Taking us on a journey from Chicago to Indiana to Alabama, the film follows Williams as he debuts a public art installation and visits a 90-year-old family friend who informs his work.  Part of "4x4: Contemporary Art in Chicago" - Season 1

metas.name: Beneath the Surface of the Everyday
metas.description: An observer of quotidian strangeness, Deb Sokolow creates semi-fictitious drawings and books commenting on architecture, politics, and pop culture. Shot on 16mm and adopting the style of 70s paranoid thrillers, the film traces the evolution of Sokolow’s speculative ethos, detailing a shadowy encounter at McDonald’s and her fixation with Rocky Balboa.  Part of "4x4: Contemporary Art in Chicago" - Season 1

metas.name: Errol Ortiz: Headspace
metas.description: Despite producing hundreds of paintings over the span of seventy-plus years, Chicago Imagist Errol Ortiz has received too little attention from the wider art world. This observational documentary surveys Ortiz as he works on a new painting from start to finish, while musing on his art school days, the influence of the cityscape, and the challenges of working as an aging artist.  Part of "4x4: Contemporary Art in Chicago" - Season 1

metas.name: we are two.
metas.description: An intimate portrait of artist Jenn Freeman | Po’Chop, whose practice merges the worlds of dance, storytelling, drag, and striptease, as they perform at queer burlesque clubs, stage THICK: a crumbling freak show, and maintain House of the Lorde, a Black feminist studio & gathering space.  Part of "4x4: Contemporary Art in Chicago" - Season 1

metas.name: Play or Get Played
metas.description: Ava Cooper is caught in a web of love, betrayal, and hidden secrets as a dangerous affair forces her to question everyone around her.

metas.name: Nameless Flower
metas.description: A protagonist journeys through physical labor and isolation, constructing a space to bury her past and former identity. Through exhaustion, confrontation with memory, and inner struggle, she attempts to empty herself of what once defined her. As the old self collapses, a transformation begins - leading to the birth of a new existence.

metas.name: The Hunter Becomes The Hunted
metas.description: Hunter Gieger is a guy stuck in a rut that mooches off of his friend instead of taking responsibility. After being kicked out of an apartment that he was sharing with his buddy, he now has to decide whether he wants to grow up or be a bum on the streets.

metas.name: nutshell
metas.description: After receiving the news that she needs to bring on a new writer, filmmaker Gwen returns to her hometown to come face to face with an estranged old friend.

metas.name: Punch and Judy
metas.description: Stay-at-Home-Wife Amanda's dinner is interrupted when her husband's sock-puppet-persona drags her into a suburban nightmare, leaving her to fight for her freedom as she tries to escape, taking extreme measures to flee.

metas.name: GNAW!
metas.description: A surrealist short following the 'timeless' hunter on his eternal prowl.

metas.name: mother daughter
metas.description: After the death of her mother years earlier, Emily returns to her family’s farm in the south of  Sweden to face the long avoided task of digging through her mother’s belongings. When her  childhood friend arrives from the States for moral support, Emily stumbles through the murky  terrain of trauma and grief, straining their relationship and forcing her subconscious fears to  bubble to the surface.

metas.name: Dreams
metas.description: A boy's experience with dreams, narrated over a series of tableaus and animated characters.

metas.name: May 2026
metas.description: the greatest piece of cinema known to mankind

metas.name: 3 DAYS
metas.description: Talking through your thoughts in your final days.

metas.name: MACRO: The Economy
metas.description: This is the greatest AP macroeconomic project of all time. A group of high school students from the slums of Leesville, share the truth about the current state of the economy.

metas.name: B.L.I.N.K! Reloaded
metas.description: Don't B.L.I.N.K! twice! It's high noon when a showdown takes place between Black and White, two western friends turned foes. This is an upgraded version of the original B.L.I.N.K!.

metas.name: Letters
metas.description: A man helps his friend leave the world behind.

metas.name: Banana Phone
metas.description: A man receives a ridiculous call from a banana phone.

metas.name: summer walk
metas.description: a person takes a nice walk on a summer day

metas.name: Dromen is voor 's Nachts
metas.description: Exhausted, a man wakes up in a field and exchanges flowers with an old friend.

metas.name: Spectraitor
metas.description: A young man goes about his day.

metas.name: After the Curtain Falls
metas.description: After joining a school theatre production to cope with a shaky home life, Cole is forced to deal with his trauma directly after a tragic event blurs the lines between art and reality.

metas.name: The Bald Short
metas.description: A silent man lives a colorless life—until a brief, mysterious encounter begins to change everything.  The Bald Short is a visual story about routine, transformation, and the unseen moments that shape who we become.  Written, directed, and performed by Anivesh Soni.

metas.name: Tethersnipe
metas.description: A jaded entomologist starts to question reality at his dying arcade after committing academic fraud. An interactive film.

metas.name: The War Cabinet
metas.description: Rubio. Vance. Wiles. Gabbard. Hegseth. Miller.  These are some of the key players behind President Donald Trump's expansive use of the U.S. military.  FRONTLINE examines the inner circle of advisors and officials trying to project U.S. power, from clashes with allies, to taking out foreign leaders, to waging war in the Middle East. • "The War Cabinet"

metas.name: Hi, I'm Kayla the Nanny
metas.description: Kayla is a nanny in Brooklyn, and today is her first day taking care of married couple Tim and Sarah's young son Woodrow. Sounds pretty straight forward, right? What could go wrong?

metas.name: i think about you all the time
metas.description: An unofficial music video for the song 'i think about you all the time' by Deftones.  After a rough patch in an already strained relationship, Cian uses a surreal outlet in an attempt to remedy the connection with his partner.

metas.name: Uploading Gemini
metas.description: Two life long friends new to their well paying jobs discover a hidden secret.

metas.name: Beograd bez kompromisa
metas.description: Two friends travel to Belgrade to explore a music scene that exists outside state funding and institutional support. Moving through trap, hardcore, and alternative rock collectives, they meet artists who create their own creative spaces under difficult conditions. The talent, ambition, and hospitality of Serbia’s musicians leave them deeply impressed.

metas.name: I Come Home
metas.description: Christine attends her sister’s wedding with her two partners, Alex and Stephane. As the trio adjusts to their newly formed polyamorous relationship, Christine learns she is unexpectedly pregnant. The news sparks conflicting reactions and exposes tensions about commitment and the future. Surrounded by judgmental relatives and controlling parents, the wedding becomes a pressure cooker where private doubts and fragile dynamics surface. Over the course of the celebration, the three must confront what love, family, and responsibility mean for them.

metas.name: Like Strangers
metas.description: An emotionally guarded bartender must confront a complicated past when a young woman comes to town in search of a long-lost relative.

metas.name: Untold UK: Vinnie Jones
metas.description: This is the story of Vinnie Jones's rise, fall, and comeback against odds – and red cards – from one of football's most notorious hard men to FA cup winner.

metas.name: No One Carbs Alone
metas.description: A young man who fears vulnerability in sharing details about his experience in living with Type 1 Diabetes tries to form a connection with one of his friends who also shares in the disability.

metas.name: No Miracles
metas.description: Emma and Jay take three months off of work after getting £20,000. They use the time to relax and unwind together, but their relationship begins to struggle as issues of belonging in the modern world become all too apparent.

metas.name: Out of the Blue
metas.description: A film shoot is thrown into disarray when six-year-old Emily becomes distressed during an emotionally charged scene. As tensions rise between cast and crew, her mother reveals a buried childhood trauma that has been unintentionally triggered. Confronted with the weight of this revelation, the director must make difficult decisions to protect Emily’s sense of safety and agency while keeping the production on track. In doing so, the set becomes more than a workplace, it becomes a space where trust is rebuilt, boundaries are respected, and a painful memory is gently transformed.

metas.name: USER
metas.description: In the not too distant future, a man without hope attempts to save the life he was hired to end with HELPER, a world changing technology that allows anyone to trade control of their physical body for money.

metas.name: Something Something Takes
metas.description: An isolated and impulsive skater, Rager is forced to abstain from fighting, all while being constantly provoked by a paranormal box of censorship.

metas.name: Voidance
metas.description: To join the elite ATIC Guard, Alana Toro must pass one final test: enter a simulation, prevent a terrorist attack, and prove her loyalty. Every mistake resets the clock. Every death disappears - except in her memory, where the weight keeps building. The more Alana learns, the more she begins to question the organisation she fought so hard to join.

metas.name: Rogue One: The Andor Cut
metas.description: 'Rogue One: The Andor Cut' sets out to re-envision 'Rogue One: A Star Wars Story' as the final finale and epilogue of the Andor series, as if it had been made afterwards. Musical pieces and leitmotifs from the show appear, pertinent flashbacks are inserted, and the tone and pacing are brought more in line with what audiences had grown accustomed to over the course of the two incredible seasons.

metas.name: The Woods Run Red – The Making of “Hunter’s Blood”
metas.description: Feature-length documentary on the making of the 1986 horror film HUNTER'S BLOOD.

metas.name: Spirit of the Valley
metas.description: “Spirit of the Valley” is a medium-length film composed entirely of fragments from an anonymous Super8 collection shot in the '80s. No new footage has been added.  The protagonists of this bio-photochemical impromptu jam session are the faces and places captured by the filmmaker’s lens during those years: scattered fragments that I selected and altered through various interventions on the emulsion, alongside the assistance of time.  Images shot almost half a century ago survive in an eroded state, resurfacing at times untouched in this ghost home movie, an elegy to 8mm film, an ode to Moviechrome, and a requiem for Kodachrome.

metas.name: Elsewhere
metas.description: Guided by an omniscient narrator, a time-traveller from the future travels back to the present in search of ghosts from the past.

metas.name: Horatio Gould: Space Cowboy
metas.description: Horatio's sophomore comedy show. Recorded at the Hoxton Hall, East London 29/11/25.

metas.name: Strawberry Shortcake
metas.description: Dahlia, a college student, is ready to end her life on the campus bridge on her birthday, until she unexpectedly meets Tisha, a classmate she barely knows. What begins as a brief encounter slowly unfolds into a night of quiet conversations, leading her to question everything she had planned.

metas.name: Tumar
metas.description: Recorded from May 6th to May 16th in Shymkent, where my grandfather was recently hospitalized, and West Lafayette, where my brother was graduating from college.

metas.name: Come On In
metas.description: A student documentary on Glasgow's publishing scene.

metas.name: Pastoral
metas.description: experimental animated movie

metas.name: Mami Moto
metas.description: A production thesis by Aimeery De Castro.

metas.name: Picasso
metas.description: A boxer attempts to bounce back after taking a hard hit.

metas.name: Inbetween days
metas.description: After a suicide attempt a troubled actress wakes up in purgatory with three other people killed during her attempt

metas.name: Confessions of a Serial Killer: Levi Bellfield
metas.description: A gripping true crime series exploring one of Britain’s most disturbing killers and the confessions that continue to haunt the justice system. Ex-DCI Colin Sutton  (Manhunt/The Real Manhunter) and his team re-examine the claims of serial killer Levi Bellfield, whose repeated and conflicting confessions to the 1996 murders of Lin and Megan Russell have reignited one of the country’s most controversial cases. With another man still serving life sentences for the crime, this series unravels a complex web of evidence, doubt and deception, asking whether Bellfield is manipulating the system from behind bars.

metas.name: Dressing Up Together
metas.description: Elly travels from Berlin to Michigan to visit her grandfather Dixie. Their long-standing email correspondence, begun after their respective queer coming-outs in 2015, finally takes shape in person, revealing mismatched expectations: Dixie associates queerness with physical connection, while Elly does not.

metas.name: Colin Pinzel and Jackson Tower's VEX Bot Time Machine
metas.description: Two high school students attempt to create a time machine for their tech class, after receiving an F they embark on a mission to raise their grade.

metas.name: Merry Christmas Bill
metas.description: Two men try to scam a vulnerable old lady. But will their usual con go to plan?

metas.name: What Remains at Dawn
metas.description: In Singapore, executions take place at dawn. Years after her brother’s death sentencing for drug trafficking, a sister duo continues their early-morning journeys, carrying the quiet aftermath of a punishment the city no longer sees.

metas.name: Timothy’s Delusions
metas.description: Timothy, an introverted 17-year-old-boy grasps with anxiety and depression while being tormented by his friends about the girl of his dreams.

metas.name: Weeyagale
metas.description: A magical-realist drama follows a young British-Ugandan girl whose classroom show-and-tell unlocks a dreamlike journey into her heritage.

metas.name: Mouthwash Madness
metas.description: A hilarious animated short about Marie, who accidentally swallows her mouthwash and thinks she has poisoned herself. Her sisters then have to deal with the dramatic consequences.

metas.name: Forever
metas.description: Ashton and Julie are about to go down two very different roads. As they take one last ride through their hometown, they reflect on the past, present, future, and forever

metas.name: Achilles Returns
metas.description: After many years, with help of Thetis and negotiations between Zeus and Hades, the Greek hero Achilles is released from the Underworld into the modern world.

metas.name: Pressure
metas.description: In the tense 72 hours before D-Day, and the fate of the free world hanging in the balance, General Dwight D. Eisenhower and Captain James Stagg face an impossible choice—launch the largest and most dangerous seaborne invasion in history or risk losing the war altogether.

metas.name: Out Of Reach
metas.description: Seventeen-year-old Adam, a driven student fixated on getting into Princeton, isolates himself from his friends and pushes them aside in his quest for academic success, in hopes to resolve the unraveling of his parents' marriage and discovers that true achievement lies in reconnecting with those he loves.

metas.name: Humo - A Flamenco Ballet by Rafaela Carrasco
metas.description: Filmed at Seville’s Teatro de la Maestranza in Seville, Humo, (smoke) combines dance and song in a tribute to the 19th century cigar makers who also inspired the character of Carmen from the famous opera. Choreographer Rafaela Carrasco creates portraits that reveal diverse lives that often contradict clichés of the past and present.

metas.name: Holly Humberstone: Radio 1’s Big Weekend
metas.description: Hot off releasing her acclaimed LP Cruel World, the beloved pop star takes to the stage.

metas.name: Olivia Dean: Radio 1's Big Weekend
metas.description: Having already achieved the chart double in 2025, star of the moment Olivia Dean has enjoyed an incredible start to the year. She swept the Brit Awards with four wins, including Artist of the Year and Album of the Year, alongside a Grammy win and a number one single with Sam Fender. And if that wasn’t enough, the record-breaking artist is now set to tick off another major milestone at Radio 1’s Big Weekend as she headlines the festival for the very first time. Closing the weekend at Sunderland’s Herrington Country Park, Olivia takes to the Main Stage with her soulful storytelling and summer-ready sound for an unforgettable finale packed with fan favourites, warmth and joy.

metas.name: CMAT: Radio 1's Big Weekend 2026
metas.description: Feel-good, poignant pop from the Mercury-nominated Irish sensation.

metas.name: I Know a Spot
metas.description: An interactive documentary web platform that explores the city of Ereymentau through archives, interviews, visual observation, and personal reflection by revealing it as a living space shaped by memory, nature, history and shifting perspectives.

metas.name: change in paradise
metas.description: group of teens loses disneyland tickets before if begins

metas.name: Maisie Peters: BBC Big Weekend
metas.description: The weekend of her album release “Florescence”, Maisie Peters hits the Big Weekend stage performing hits such as ‘Questions’, ‘Lost The Breakup’, ‘My Regards’ and more.

metas.name: Zits
metas.description: A girl in high school has no clue what she wants to do after graduation. However, during a math test her imagination shows her lots of ideas.

metas.name: Island Nation
metas.description: Grímsey is an island 40km north of Iceland, the northernmost inhabited area of the country measuring 2.5 km in length. It has been populated for over 800 years, but now their future is uncertain. This film is a elegy and celebration to a fading way of life.

metas.name: Plomb Culture
metas.description: Framed as a vintage sex-ed film, a cruise ship penetrates a fjord, recasting mass tourism as an intimate act of intrusion, attraction, and environmental violation.

metas.name: Torn And Careless Offerings
metas.description: A Series Of Interlocking Segments Utilizing & Distorting The Physical Form To Express Trauma, Pain & The Lasting Effects Of The Past On The Present. Taking A Directly Physical Approach In Expressing These Struggles. Freeing The Images From Their Ghosts In The Process.

metas.name: Hands Off
metas.description: During what should have been a simple job, two members of a trio of looters have yet to return to the getaway vehicle. The third member, Reed, tired of waiting, exits his vehicle and walks into the abandoned building to find his accomplices. However, once inside the dilapidated building, Reed soon learns that this evacuation mission may be harder than he initially thought.

metas.name: Feel the Beat
metas.description: A two-hour special featuring videos and interviews with some of today’s biggest stars in music. From solo acts to pop groups, broadway, and rock ‘n roll, Feel the Beat is both a front row seat and back stage pass to some of music’s hottest superstars.

metas.name: Busan
metas.description: A bear goes for a walk after a rough day.

metas.name: Stargazers
metas.description: Best friends Jack and Benji race to uncover the mystery of the strange signals transmitting from their town. Could it be proof of Aliens living on Earth? They have three days to find out or risk being split up forever.

metas.name: Test footage filmed on the set of Francis Ford Coppola’s One from the Heart
metas.description: Test footage filmed on the set of Francis Ford Coppola’s One from the Heart

Along the way he explores Britain's busiest, newest and oldest service stations, travels to the Lake District to find out what the farm shop fuss is all about, and races against the clock to see if it's possible to grab a coffee and head to the loo in under five minutes.

metas.name: AEW Double or Nothing 2026
metas.description: The 2026 Double or Nothing was a professional wrestling pay-per-view produced by All Elite Wrestling (AEW) that took place on May 24, 2026, at Louis Armstrong Stadium in New York City, New York, USA. It featured the first quarter-final matches of the 2026 Owen Hart Foundation Tournaments for both the men and women, as well as the long-anticipated AEW International Championship match between Don Callis Family members Kazuchika Okada (c) and Konosuke Takeshita. The show was headlined by Darby Allin (c) vs. MJF in a Title vs. Hair match for the AEW World Championship, where MJF would have to shave his head bald if he lost.

metas.name: Ink Between the Lines
metas.description: After the devastating suicide of her best friend Coli, 15 year old Natalie turns to journaling to cope with her overwhelming grief. Struggling with guilt and isolation, she pours her emotions onto the page and joins a support group for teens. A deep conversation with Ezra, a friend who understands silent pain, inspires her to transform her journal entries into a novel. As Natalie writes, she begins to confront hidden truths about her friendship with Coli, unspoken struggles, and the weight of what was left unsaid. Through storytelling, she finds healing, connection, and the courage to speak the truth—not just for herself, but for others who need to hear it.

metas.name: Bare Roots
metas.description: AMY reluctantly returns home to the windy clifftop in North Cornwall where she grew up, after a break-up with her partner Jess has left her homeless. She hopes her mum, SUE, will be pleasantly surprised at the chance for them to reconnect. But Sue isn't good with surprises, and has other things on her mind. She is preparing to plant a bare root hedge, her final act of resistance against the second home development that will surround her home, concreting over her memories and erasing her past. They start early: digging in the hedge is backbreaking work. When Amy finally manages to tell Sue about her loss, Sue is lost for words. They doggedly continue planting, gradually finding a rhythm together in the silence. As night falls, and exhaustion sets in, Sue returns to the house, and Amy is left in the field, digging the last trench for the remaining plants. Alone, they each find a way to reach out across the silence, the years of separation, and their losses, towards each other.

metas.description: Bringing her anthemic sound to Sunderland is Sweden’s pop phenomenon Zara Larsson, who is fast becoming a Radio 1’s Big Weekend mainstay as she prepares to make her fourth appearance at the festival. Since making her debut in 2017, the then-teenage sensation has grown into a global force and takes to the Main Stage to top the bill for the very first time.  Fresh from releasing her latest album, Midnight Sun, Zara is set to light up Herrington Country Park with huge singalong hits and powerhouse vocals that have made her a festival favourite. metas.name: The Katabasis of...

It follows 40 interviews discussing funeral plans, flashbacks before death, and identities shaped by memories, among other things. What will be lost when they are gone? What fragments remain? This film serves as a memorial to each person's memories and hopes. The actual runtime is 23 hours and 17 minutes.

metas.name: Boat Movie
metas.description: A group of friends go on a boat outing to witness an unprecedented natural phenomenon.  Maggie joins a new group of friends (Steph, Steven, Anna, and James) for a boat day. After they are left on an isolated beach, Maggie learns that today is the day that the sun is predicted change color. Maggies tries to hide her nerves about this unprecedented solar event while also managing her social anxiety around a new group. When the sun is about to change color, Steven reveals that there is a 10% chance of mortality. Maggie has a panic attack and faints; the rest of the group goes haywire. Suddenly, a beautiful pink hue is cast upon the group. Everything is fine. Maggie wakes up to find her new friends dead. She freaks out, then realizes it's just an awful prank. What a perfect day!

metas.name: I Wanna be Your Lobster…

As Snow becomes the lead vocalist of Wira’s band, long-buried feelings gradually resurface. At the same time, she meets Thi Ha, an artistically minded businessman who offers her the opportunity to perform in Bangkok and opens the door to a different future. Torn between the innocence of first love and the desire to pursue her own dreams, Snow must choose the path she truly wants. Led by a cast of trained musicians with live recorded music performances, the film captures the emotional uncertainty of youth, where love and music become memories that linger long after they fade.

Kicking off the festival as Friday night’s Main Stage headliner is the ultimate party starter, Fatboy Slim. The man who helped take dance music from club floors to festival main stages worldwide is set to bring his legendary show to the north east for a high-energy, hands-in-the-air frenzy. With what promises to be a blockbuster set, expect crowd favourites and his trademark barefoot style - this is the ultimate Friday night Dance Party.

metas.name: Butcher: Invisible Wounds
metas.description: A major feature-length ITV documentary about footballer Terry Butcher will chart his career as well as the devastating personal tragedy of the loss of his Army veteran son.  Butcher is one of England's most celebrated players, with 77 caps, seven times as captain. Photos and footage of him playing on with a bandage around a head injury during a vital World Cup qualifier provide one of the iconic images of the national team's history. Butcher's achievements in the club game include trophy-winning stints at Ipswich Town and Glasgow Rangers.  But Butcher: Invisible Wounds also tells the story of the personal loss he endured following the death of his son Chris, a British Army veteran who passed away after suffering severe PTSD.

metas.name: annually

However, the questions they ask are out of the ordinary, and secrets are spilled and confessions are made. Why are the cops asking about relationships? Why do they want to know? Full of messy relationships, secrets, and inevitably finding out the truth, the story sheds light on the reality of high school relationships and how people will go to extreme lengths to get their way.

metas.name: American Deadbeats
metas.description: A group of small-town filmmakers chase their dream of making a movie despite having no budget, no connections, and no idea what they’re doing.

metas.name: Voyage of The Lost
metas.description: After a cosmic storm wiped out nearly the entire universe, Vera Moon must fight to survive as she steals a map that leads to the one place she thought she'd never see again - Earth.

metas.name: The Pirate Queen: No Safe Waters
metas.description: The Pirate Queen: No Safe Waters (2026)  Legendary Pirate Queen Cheng Shih tells her story of her rise to power as the woman who commanded the largest pirate fleet in history in this cinematic immersive experience premiering in competition at Cannes Film Festival.

metas.name: Beyond The Weeping Tent
metas.description: A young man fleeing from war finds comfort within the estranged world hidden from most: Crempton Circus. With a lone Clown by his side, the two unravel history and hide for survival.

metas.name: Hiatus
metas.description: Lukas embarks a journey of acceptance and reprisal of art after Marianne leaves.

metas.name: Free Speech Zone
metas.description: Two years following an abuse of power, students and faculty at SUNY Purchase College must grapple with a changed campus community - and the lasting cost of speaking up.

metas.name: How'd It Go?
metas.description: A rising stand-up comedian deals with bombing during his big break.

metas.name: Sisters' Swim
metas.description: Every year, Rose and Lina, two sisters who aren’t particularly close, have to make the trip to Ostend in Belgium for the traditional New Year’s Day swim imposed by their mother. Problem: she is no longer there... she’s dead.

metas.name: Sisters' Swim
metas.description: Film selected for the Cannes Film Festival Short Films Competition lineup.

metas.name: Fresh Cut
metas.description: Film selected for the Cannes Film Festival Short Films Competition lineup.

metas.name: Forever Outcast
metas.description: In a world of witch hunting, a late 50s cult believes two teenagers are internal demons haunting others. With nowhere to go, both teens are overwhelmed with grief as the Pastor delivers his speech before clock strikes 12:00am, when the two teens are planned to be killed, all in one 5 minute take.

metas.name: Matador Bolero
metas.description: New York nightclub, The Matador, becomes the site of a high-profile murder that attracts the attention of an obsessive detective, a TV news reporter, and an elusive being living outside the realms of time and space. Their stories converge with that of a new-age cult operating at the command of an ultra-intelligent supercomputer named Bolero.

metas.name: Justiciar
metas.description: A reclusive man is forced to reckon with the Ghosts of his past

metas.name: All My Heroes Had Magic Fingers
metas.description: A person's suicide attempt is interrupted by a strange magician.

metas.name: I Remember Every Death
metas.description: Trapped in a brutal time loop where he remembers every death, a man must uncover the identity and rules of a sadistic architect who turned his life into a game, before the loop erases what’s left of his sanity.

metas.name: Sleeppers
metas.description: One day in the life of Angelos and Ioanna, each dealing with last night's fight.

metas.name: O Mother, Where Art Thou?
metas.description: A short comedy about a socially awkward 20-something who attends a speed-dating event to find a 'replacement' mother, only to realise that she might be better off without one

metas.name: Life in pink like in the movies
metas.description: 19 Super 8 film reels, bought in a second hand store, make a young filmmaker take a plunge into the past of an unknown family. He decides to give back this holy shrine, full of memories, to their legitimate owner. When confronted with reality, the image of a perfect family vanishes. This movie is both an ethical gesture and an interesting essay on the relationship between movie pictures and memory.

metas.name: Pickleball Pete
metas.description: A washed-up tennis player enters a Palm Beach pickleball tournament in order to save his hometown courts from being torn down for a corporate office complex.

metas.name: Missoula
metas.description: Montana 1998. The lives of a wide kaleidoscope of characters intertwine in a dramatic fashion as the romance between Clara-Belle and Rebecca tightens.

metas.name: Vengeance Rising
metas.description: Andrew Vengeance is determined to stop the MIC from attacking their city and knows they need a strong team to counter the CIA's threat.

metas.name: Dreamlink
metas.description: Jesse, a troubled teenager seeks solace in DreamLink, a revolutionary app merging dreams and reality that promises to connect them with the person they need the most.

metas.name: The Balloonists
metas.description: Follows the improbable team of Bertrand Piccard and Brian Jones, who, in 1999, competed against the world's finest pilots and extremely wealthy adventurers to become the first individuals to fly a hot air balloon around the globe nonstop.

metas.name: The Violin Case
metas.description: A painter has the worst night of his life after leaving his violin artwork in the back of a taxi in Macao.

metas.name: Holy Joe
metas.description: When two altar boys stumble across their priest secretive misdeeds, they plot out an intricate plan to save their parish.

metas.name: The Portal
metas.description: An assistant of a CEO goes on a dangerous journey to save the multiverse after his company fails to showcase a prototype of their revolutionary invention - the Portal.

metas.name: Ladies First
metas.description: An arrogant but charismatic ladies' man finds his life of money, power and casual flings upended when he wakes up in a parallel world dominated by women.

metas.name: Yaxlont
metas.description: When a teenage boy has a girl over for the first time, the overly attached monster under his bed has a meltdown.

metas.name: letter to a person who no longer exists
metas.description: An allusion to Justin Kaminuma's previous short film, "I Still Exist," which deals with missed opportunities and opportunities that still exist in life. A profound insight into the flawed existence of every individual.

metas.name: Cuando El Agua Calla
metas.description: The documentary "Cuando el agua Calla" examines major challenges and urgent issues: the overexploitation of groundwater, declining reservoir levels, the lack of universal access to potable water, pollution, and many other problems that compromise the sustainability and well-being of communities.

metas.name: My Bubble
metas.description: A girl who loves art, but has a lot of pressure from her supportive father as he wants her to be successful, teaching her the ”right kind of art”.

metas.name: Mu
metas.description: A newly born bird is excited to explore the world. On its adventure, it finds others on its way, but doesn't understand a word of what is asked of it. As they explain, both the bird as well as the viewer begin to understand more of the language and by the end have learned a few words of Toki Pona.

metas.name: Prisma
metas.description: Two childhood friends with a dream to one day run away together, but when the opportunity arises it’s not quite what they imagined… One sees the end of the world, the other a chance for life anew. What happens when Rue refuses to let go, and Safarin denies any ties to their past?

metas.name: Will o' Wisp
metas.description: Isolated and longing for a friend, Young Anneka meets a floating light that takes her to a wide endless wheatfield to play but time flies by and she stays longer than she thought.

metas.name: Candlerina
metas.description: The overly confident Candle Girl loves to dance for her ever loving audience to fuel her growing flame, but when suddenly a new dancer comes on stage Candle Girl feels deeply jealous and starts to lose the audience that fuels her fire.

metas.name: Bets Off
metas.description: A seemingly amateur poker player competes against a expert… but neither character is as they seem.

metas.name: A very cheesy love story
metas.description: Chloe’s just moved from Wisconsin to California. How will she juggle adjusting to her new life and dealing with the stuck up Cali kids when there’s a cute guy in her class offering her a cheese curd? Oh, and she has a boyfriend she’s not crazy about.

metas.name: Outset
metas.description: Nine months into a zombie apocalypse, a suicidal survivor is forced back toward life after a brutal encounter and an unexpected connection.

metas.name: Closing Time
metas.description: After an injury on service, a high-strung chef must work with his estranged drug-addled brother to finish a signature dish for a critic

metas.name: The Human Library
metas.description: As Al drains colour from the modern world, a young woman and a Human Library "book" find themselves written into each other's margins, risking memory, policy, and erasure to hold onto something real.

metas.name: A Girl Called Flower
metas.description: An unfulfilled woman rediscovers herself through her passion for fashion design after her lonely 50th birthday party.

metas.name: Home Helper
metas.description: As we are introduced to this world of a new development (Home Helper) through an advert, Harry and his mistress, Brooke are sitting on the sofa. Brooke notices a wedding ring on Harry's finger and suddenly leaves in a hurry. As Brooke leaves, Harry immediately rushes to get rid of the kiss marks still left on his cheeks, only be to surprised when his wife, Liz comes back from work early. Liz instantly notices Home Helper in the living room and is alarmed, by telling her husband to get rid of it . In a state of fear Home Helper quickly reacts and tells the wife that Harry has been cheating and shows video evidence on the TV. Liz then drops her ring and leaves Harry as he then starts to take his anger out on Home Helper.  As Harry starts to reflect on his actions, he hears a knock at the door, he is shocked when he looks down at the floor to see a newly packaged Home Helper device which then states that Harry will never be able to get rid of it.

metas.name: Marine Realness
metas.description: A non-binary drag artist must put on a showstopping performance to stop the construction of a toxic oil rig.

metas.name: Robbery for Beginners
metas.description: Mikkel stages a fake robbery at the café he works at, hoping to impress his coworker by playing the hero.

metas.name: FUNNY ISN'T IT
metas.description: A comedian works a three night stint at a night club while his mother is dying.

metas.name: Schwag
metas.description: After smoking weed one time, a woman believes that remaining stoned will be the answer to all of her problems. “Schwag,” directed by Danny Hurwitz, stars a hilarious Sara Hennessey in a meandering tale of indecisiveness and pot smoking. At first she declines to hit a joint with a friend, played by a nonchalant Whitley Watson, explaining that she used to be a huge pothead in high school which resulted in not having any “teen-mem’s” (teenage memories). Seconds pass, and the woman decides she’s actually down to take a drag. A second later, she hesitates again, proceeding to tell a spiraling story of her most recent session with weed. It unfolds in flashback form; we learn about an evening two years ago where a party, apartment deep clean, next-level sex, and kitchen experiments all took place. When she tries to replicate the experience, it goes horribly wrong

metas.name: The McKenna Project
metas.description: A feature-length documentary following the NHL's next potential superstar, Gavin McKenna, from the Yukon, through recruiting visits, and into his scrutinized draft year.

metas.name: City Mark: A Rochester Icon
