metas.description: A documentary film exploring the origin, evolution, and lasting impact of one of Rochester, NY's most recognizable symbols. From its creation in the 1970s to its place in today’s culture, the City Mark’s simple design became a powerful expression of identity, pride, and belonging. Through archival footage, local voices, and new interviews, the documentary traces the mark’s journey — from a government design initiative to a symbol embraced by the community. It’s a design story, but more importantly, it’s a story about people.

metas.name: Bloom
metas.description: A lovable underdog goes against a charming high school hero to win the heart of a girl, finding out along the way that all it takes is to notice the little things.

metas.name: My oh My !
metas.description: A woman takes drugs in a Los Angeles hotel, and has much to say.

metas.name: Cronies & Patsies
metas.description: A prequel to Desolation Row.

metas.name: How to make money fast
metas.description: Three friends argue on how to make money.

metas.name: ARROGATION (Original Short Film)
metas.description: ’ARROGATION’ is a haunting, mind-breaking window into the life of a man working his hardest for a woman to get back into a society that controls and shunned her away for knowing the truth…

metas.name: My Fellow Heroes
metas.description: My Fellow Heroes

metas.name: Hourglass on Side
metas.description: Images of flowers, churches, and leaves

metas.name: American Psycho
metas.description: Behind-the-scenes footage from a recreation of American Psycho. From Swedish Llama’s Dream Journal.

metas.name: Happy Birthday, America!
metas.description: On Independence Day, America's birthday, I was thinking about an immigrant friend of mine who had to self-deport because Trump's ICE stormtroopers had become a living nightmare.

metas.name: High Spirits
metas.description: What do you get when you cross two unemployed blokes and a camera crew?  Sam and Dan are on a mission to find peoples ghosts. What could possibly go wrong?

metas.name: Si’r det bar’
metas.description: Series on Ultra about a young girl that starts at a new school and tells a lie that ends up getting her in trouble.

metas.name: Containment Error
metas.description: A young, well-established scientist is kidnapped and brought to an unknown laboratory. He is then tricked into releasing an untested secret virus across the entire globe, and he must race against the clock to reverse the sequence before it's too late...

metas.name: Visions from the Victorian era
metas.description: Flashes of nature

metas.name: Masquerade
metas.description: Glenville is riddled with crime, and one man takes it upon himself to change this. Follow Masquerade as he experiences the town's many personalities; some need saving more than others...

metas.name: Cupán Tae
metas.description: While tending bar, Ciarán is approached by Sean, confused by Sean's Irish, Ciarán realises he has fallen out of touch with his language. When he finds his father's old Irish notes, he takes this a sign to teach himself again, with his Irish improved, he finds himself a new job and feels more in touch with his culture and family than before

metas.name: ElectroAcoustic Infatuation
metas.description: Set in a world where everyone is an instrument and electric and acoustic instruments are not allowed to be in love.

metas.name: The Laureate
metas.description: A stylish and artsy 18-year-old, Ruby Hayes (Camryn Anderson), who is a master of observation, must shed her polished reputation and embrace her true self to win a prestigious scholarship and expose her charming rival, Blair Sterling (Lea Wassom), all while navigating that waters of self-discovery.

metas.name: Monument
metas.description: On America’s 250th anniversary, with attacks on libraries, archives, universities, and commemorative landmarks, the story of a nation’s history hangs in the balance. MONUMENT asks how looking and listening to one’s personal environment can help us understand our foundations. MONUMENT is centered on the history of Rhode Island, weaving statues, plaques, and place names together with the routine movements of everyday life.

metas.name: Level Nine
metas.description: Three friends wandering through the city over one afternoon. When Graham reveals he’s been going to therapy, their conversations shift, forcing them to confront friendship, vulnerability, and growing up.

metas.name: The Fall of the Nighthawk
metas.description: In the late 1940s, a weary assassin known as the Nighthawk sits alone in a late-night diner, awaiting his inevitable end. Three distinct figures from his criminal world converge on him, each with their own agendas. Caught between their compelling offers and threats, the Nighthawk must decide how - and whether - he wants to face his fate. But in this city, the Establishment always collects its debts.

metas.name: Vigil
metas.description: Wayne, a rough and ragged detective, tries to solve a case that has eluded him for years. Will he find what he’s looking for, or will there be more questions than answers?

metas.name: Dua Lipa: Live from Mexico
metas.description: Live from Mexico, a brand new concert film capturing the high-octane finale of the global Radical Optimism Tour at Mexico City's Estadio GNP Seguros

metas.name: National Theatre Live: Man and Boy
metas.description: Jazz, Broadway and the Great Depression. In 1930s New York City, international financier Gregor Antonescu's luck has finally run out. As news of a catastrophic business deal ripples across the world, he flees to the apartment of his estranged son Basil. Truths are uncovered and relationships are tested as Gregor gets down to business, to save his reputation and keep his empire from collapse. In his National Theatre debut, director Anthony Lau (The Crucible) brings a sharp, contemporary edge to Terence Rattigan's tale of paternity and corruption, with Ben Daniels (The Normal Heart) and Laurie Kynaston (Long Day's Journey into Night) playing father and son.

metas.name: It's More Than Flesh, Sharpen the Knife
metas.description: Mikey's only known isolation. He's become familiar with the shape of loneliness, knows all it's nooks and crannies. that all changes with the arrival of Cameron. Unfortunately, their friendship is doomed as Cameron takes a leave from the realm of the living. Mikey, reeling from the grief of Cameron's death, comes back home in search of comfort. Only to find Cameron there, once again. Haunting him.

metas.name: Kyle Larson vs. The Double
metas.description: Two-time NASCAR champion Kyle Larson attempts the notorious "Double," racing the Indianapolis 500 and the Coca-Cola 600 on the same day. With weather, exhaustion, and risk closing in, 1,100 miles offers a rare inside look at one of the toughest challenges in motorsports-and the man daring enough to take it on.

metas.name: Selection
metas.description: Dean works for a company where he must always make a SELECTION. But who are we to decide?

metas.name: OUT
metas.description: After learning an online friend is considering suicide, Makoto, a young non-binary hikikomori, must try to save her while remaining trapped at home due to fear of the outside world.

metas.name: No Greater Evil
metas.description: Hours after walking out of jail, an impulsive criminal drags his cousin into a simple convenience store robbery. When the heist goes wrong, a routine getaway turns their reunion into a brutal, claustrophobic nightmare with no clean escape in sight.

metas.name: Home Again
metas.description: Home Again centers around MARA, a young woman caregiving for her sick uncle under mysterious circumstances. Mara meets DOMINIC, a delivery driver, and they spark a connection. But is there enough time?

metas.name: Landscape Psychosis
metas.description: Short film by Kim Westfall. Shot on Super 8.

metas.name: Our Secrets
metas.description: Film selected for the Cannes Film Festival La Cinéf competition lineup.

metas.name: The Joyless Economy
metas.description: Short film selected for the Cannes Film Festival Directors’ Fortnight Lineup. A documentary that explores how a woman's movie collection triggers her infidelity. Created for one viewer—the woman whose confessions are revealed through hypnotic second-person narration. All events and artifacts are presented at a steady, soothing pace.

metas.name: Free Eliza (Notes on an Anatomical Imperfection)
metas.description: Eliza works at a hotel resort, moving through a cycle of roles designed to always keep the guests satisfied. Behind the polished surface of the hotel, she struggles to balance an unseen private life, all while carrying a rare anatomical condition: she is physically unable to smile.

metas.name: Inferno
metas.description: A man descends through phases of texture, life, degradation and colour.

metas.name: Pickled
metas.description: All Eddie has ever known is her Granny’s world, where they pickle everything around them, preserving their family history forever. But when Granny joins their ancestors, Edie has to decide if she’ll continue their tradition, or live for herself.

metas.name: Spartamerika
metas.description: An essay film exploring the thirteen United States Presidents that have led the country through war and conflict from 1950 to 2025.

metas.name: Betting Zoo
metas.description: In a gambling-oriented society, Orla battles with her crumbling relationship and having to leave her life up to pure chance or returning to the Betting Zoo; a gameshow where masked racers are imprisoned until they win.

metas.name: C'est Pas la Vie en Rose
metas.description: Gentrification, fame, pop culture, no culture, the new Lisbon and digital dystopia, what do all these things have in common? Charles and Nicole.

metas.name: The End of It
metas.description: In a near-future world where ageing can be cured and death is now optional, Claire, a former provocative artist approaching her 250th birthday, decides she’s had enough, she wants to die.

metas.name: Q&A
metas.description: Acclaimed actor Timothy Markus McGraw returns to his youth theatre for a masterclass.

metas.name: From All Sides
metas.description: A multiracial bisexual married couple and their teenage children find themselves beset from all sides as they navigate work, school, sex, friendships, romances, and their colorful neighbors in the outer suburbs of Sydney.

metas.name: Piscina
metas.description: Embarrassed by her underarm hair at the swimming pool, a young woman resorts to increasingly desperate attempts to shave it off.

metas.name: American Madness
metas.description: "American Madness" is a deep-dive documentary into the history of Conspiracy Theories and an overview of the conspiracy culture that can take over people's lives and drive them to commit violent acts. Richard McCaslin was a comic artist, a filmmaker, but also a deeply broken person obsessed with conspiracy theories that inspired him to take dangerous action in spite of the consequences, when he donned the costume of his "super hero persona" The Phantom Patriot, infiltrated the secretive Bohemian Grove, and set it on fire. Based upon the book "American Madness" by Tea Krulos, this documentary takes a journey from the Border Wall in Texas across America in a cautionary tale for the present time, where the internet spreads false stories so fast that our population no longer lives in a shared reality with one another.

metas.name: Left For Dead
metas.description: In the aftermath of a physical confrontation gone too far, humanity reacts to a high schooler who is left for dead.

metas.name: A Lost Love Upon The Stars
metas.description: A desperate convict who's venturing the galaxy for his lost lover seeks help from a good friend who believes that love is void from the galaxy.

metas.name: Fred n Chris For Hire
metas.description: Set a year after their high school graduation, best friends Fred n Chris tried out the workforce and are both out of a job. They soon realize that staying employed might not be as easy as it seems.

metas.name: Chalk City
metas.description: Before going their separate ways, two childhood friends reminisce on an old chalk drawing while wondering whether what they built together will fade with time or remain a part of them forever.

metas.name: Untether
metas.description: During a chance encounter with an old friend at a rave, Antonio is forced to confront the lingering trauma of sexual abuse, facing the ghosts of his past as he learns to accept human connection again.

metas.name: Read The Room
metas.description: A telepathic bartender who uses her ability to help patrons feel seen, until one night she hears something she can't ignore.

metas.name: Cornbread
metas.description: A minor league baseball player named Levi "Cornbread" Callahan has a strange encounter with a blimp.

metas.name: The Body of Stars
metas.description: A being from the stars becomes trapped in a human body.

metas.name: The Act Of Quizzing
metas.description: A peppy documentary exploring the Cork pub quiz scene and its many characters.

metas.name: Under Suspicion: Kate McCann
metas.description: How Madeleine McCann's mother Kate came under suspicion to face police interrogation.

metas.name: Team Rudy
metas.description: In this warm, intimate, and often disarmingly funny documentary, director Nic Balthazar follows actor-writer Rudy Morren, who surrounds himself with a close-knit group of friends after being diagnosed with Parkinson's disease. As he undergoes major brain surgery, his “Team” grows into a powerful network of solidarity and hope. For creator Nic Balthazar, the project is also personal: his father also lives with Parkinson's disease.

metas.name: Bob's Dinner
metas.description: A short comedy drama about bob, a clueless father about to discover his daughters a lesbian.

metas.name: Finn & Sally
metas.description: Finn, a naive bet strong-willed woman explores the dark forests where she discovers her love for the mysterious monster, Sally.

metas.name: KUPAL
metas.description: After an exhausting day at school, starving college student Sam orders food delivery to his dorm and quickly spirals into obsession as the wait drags on. Bombarding the driver with frantic messages, desperate calls, and dramatic complaints about his hunger, Sam becomes increasingly unhinged when the driver responds with nothing more than a passive-aggressive thumbs-up emoji. What begins as a late-night craving soon turns into a tense and comedic clash between an impatient customer and a delivery driver pushed to his absolute limit.

metas.name: Fall in Love with Her
metas.description: Fall in Love with Her follows Lola, a musician deeply in love and on the brink of a creative breakthrough, as she begins to question whether the life she's building truly belongs to her. When love and ambition start pulling in different directions, Lola must confront what it means to choose herself and what it might cost. An intimate, emotionally resonant drama about timing, identity, and the quiet decisions that shape a life.

metas.name: The Soul Of Sallins
metas.description: Two local Irish daredevils dare to discover the real soul of a small town - and the dark history around it.

metas.name: You Will Die
metas.description: After Lenny meets with his daughter Ava for a grim discussion about his health, his afternoon takes a strange turn.

metas.name: Berlin theater of the streets
metas.description: A walk through Berlin; eyes open, camera ready.  Countless vignettes unfold around me, and I imagine storylines for each set piece.

metas.name: Hurricane Season
metas.description: Hurricane anxiety takes a visceral form as the image searches for an escape route. Inspired by true events. Created on 16mm film and developed with comfrey, mint, yerba mate and willow leaves.

metas.name: (another) Perfect Film
metas.description: "A lot of film is perfect left alone, perfectly revealing in its un- or semi-conscious form. I wish more stuff was available in its raw state, as primary source material for anyone to consider, and to leave for others in just that way, the evidence uncontaminated by compulsive proprietary misapplied artistry, 'editing', the purposeful 'pointing things out' that cuts a road straight and narrow through the cine-jungle; we barrel through thinking we're going somewhere and miss it all. Better to just be pointed to the territory, to put in time exploring, roughing it, on our own.” - Ken Jacobs

metas.name: Sunburnt Snapshots
metas.description: A chronicle of a lonely summer. Filmed on a phone throughout January 2026 in Wellington, New Zealand.

metas.name: solar wave
metas.description: sun light, sun set, sun rise, sun ray. a hand processed in camera roll shot on Kodak 3383 color print stock.

metas.name: there's no static on television anymore
metas.description: A city symphony.

metas.name: Exhumation (Dirt: Part Four)
metas.description: Exhumation is an extended poetic meditation on our relation to the soil, and the energies buried within it. Centuries of history, of conquering and re-conquering, lie beneath our feet, and the return of the vanquished is inevitable. There has also always been an alternative possibility, within the American landscape, of a more peaceful relationship with the soil, the resting place of our ancestors.

metas.name: Melencolia 2: Destitution Signs
metas.description: A nostalgic retread through the 4th plateau of New York City followed by a short polemic against ethnography and hipsters. Shot between 2006 and 2025

metas.name: STALL
metas.description: Lindsay McIntyre is a film artist from Edmonton of Inuk/European descent.

metas.name: Adam Disturbed a Bird
metas.description: A band, a bus, some friends, a few birds and a bunch of kids dance and wiggle to a song from the album "In the Ferns" by The Peel in this cut-out animated music video.

metas.name: ThePitch
metas.description: A group of filmmakers have to come up with a pitch for their newest project in doing so chaos ensues

metas.name: Lachlan's Locked In
metas.description: When Lachlan Room gets locked in a room, his best friend Alan Keye is tasked with finding the key. Paired with Fred "Bolt" Locke, they meet an estranged ensemble of characters on their adventure.

metas.name: CRASH!
metas.description: After colliding with a pedestrian, two friends attempt to reach an agreement in addressing a critical situation.

metas.name: Life is so much more than good!
metas.description: A woman takes her son on a trip across the world to connect with each other and to reflect on her life. Life is beautiful, life is complicated, life is so much more than good.

metas.name: Bound to Die Trying
metas.description: A folk music duo drifts apart.

metas.name: By The Horns
metas.description: When a jaded paralegal reunites with his volatile ex-friends, old desires and rivalries ignite into a dangerous game of seduction, power and betrayal.

metas.name: Background Action
metas.description: On a tense set of a film noir, two background actors quietly form a connection take after take

metas.name: The End Of The Rainbow
metas.description: An unlikely meeting with a mysterious man - Chris -  leads Rai to obsessive ends.

metas.name: The Gold Stares Back
metas.description: With his retirement match suddenly cancelled, a disillusioned wrestler must come to terms with his past, the future and losing what he loves
When Kevin wakes up in the basement of a serial killer, he soon learns that his only chance of survival is by playing the hand he's been dealt.

metas.name: Céad Míle Fáilte
metas.description: A documentary that asks young people how they feel about Irelands culture when it comes to welcoming diversity. We narrow in on Sarah Sida, a model and college student born in South Sudan who shares with us what it was like growing up in Ireland as a black woman.

metas.name: Undressing Them
metas.description: Tori, anxious about a house party, spirals into a gender crisis. A mysterious figure, Boy, forces her to confront her identity, leading to a journey from despair to self-acceptance.

metas.name: Man on Paper
metas.description: An artist begins an unconventional relationship with a figure drawing model.

metas.name: B.E.W.B
metas.description: Three fierce spies who specialize in eliminating the worst men alive go head-to-head with their former teammate (and former lover) when she breaks back into the Bureau — only to discover the deadliest battle may be the one between their past.

metas.name: Change of the Crooks
metas.description: Two women meet in prison and plan an escape, with any means necessary.

metas.name: Dernsie: The Amazing Life of Bruce Dern
metas.description: DERNSIE is an intimate portrait of Bruce Dern—tireless, uncompromising, and one of the last living legends of his generation—whose endurance has shaped both a turbulent life and one of Hollywood’s most enduring careers. A relentless runner on and off screen, Dern has outlasted the very industry that defined him.

metas.name: Rendezvous at the Abandoned Zoo
metas.description: Feelings from the past are uncaged when exes run into each other at their old spot, new dates in arm.

metas.name: Am I…?
metas.description: Daisy feels distant from the world and everyone in it. So, when a party is sprung upon her by her childhood friend in the effort to help her 'meet new people', she begins to realise that she is more complicated than she had thought.

metas.name: Growing Stones, Flying Papers
metas.description: Under a rising dictatorship, a writer hides in his apartment, documenting the truth in quiet resistance. His neighbor chooses a different path, taking to the streets at night. When she's caught, he is the only witness - and must choose between silence and action.

metas.name: Sunday’s Children
metas.description: Desperate to become a father, a man spends a weekend falling for a woman who believes God has warned her never to have children.

metas.name: Wanted, Wasted And Washed.
metas.description: Three Criminals. Missing Friend. One Angry Boss. A Neo Nazi Old Man. Two Hitmen. All in one movie.

metas.name: Twig
metas.description: Over the course of a summer day at the skate park, a determined 10-year-old boy struggles to land the simplest trick. As he attempts to drop into the pool, he uncovers a group of skaters, their troubled pasts, and something deeper within himself.

metas.name: InvaZion!
metas.description: Denaé, Fousey, and Remy plan to hit what they believe is an empty house, but when the homeowner unexpectedly returns, Fousey makes a split-second decision and one simple impulsive action changes the lives of everyone. Remy, known for her brilliant strategies, becomes tangled into a brawl with Fousey. Tensions boil over as Denaé finally witnesses the same treatment that was done unto her. When Fousey threatens Remy’s life, Denaé is finally forced to pick a side.

metas.name: Gambit
metas.description: A rising private detective is investigating the theft of a priceless painting, only to fall into a dangerous game with the very woman he's meant to catch. Caught between ambition & desire, he must choose what to sacrifice to win.

metas.name: GALICIA NON ARDE
metas.description: “GALICIA NON ARDE” is a short film that expresses the pain behind each provoked fire in Galicia during the summer of 2025.  A young man goes to his town in Lugo after learning from the media that it is on fire, evoking a strong feeling inside him.  Through photography, color, and sound, it seeks to create a sensory space where viewers can immerse themselves in a complete experience.

metas.name: Harry Hill: New Bits & Greatest Hits
metas.description: Harry Hill celebrated 60 years of fun, laughter and low-level disruption with a critically acclaimed tour.

metas.name: eye see you
metas.description: During a classroom writing activity, a new classmate, Gela, tells hard-of-hearing Odesa, “I see you,” but she mishears it as “ICU”, sending her on a quiet journey to decode its true meaning.

metas.name: God of Mischief
metas.description: When a cheeky 10-year-old boy sets his sights on playing Loki in the school play, his over-the-top confidence costs him the role, but he hatches a mischievous plan to prove he's the real god of mischief after all.

metas.name: Trial by Fire: A Ryan Drake Story
metas.description: Keira Frost, a former Army tech specialist newly recruited into the CIA, joins Ryan Drake’s Shepard team on a high-stakes mission. ​ As she navigates a hostile environment and skeptical teammates, Frost faces a challenge that tests both her loyalty and resilience to their limits.

metas.name: Cabinet
metas.description: Cabinet (2026)  Genre: Mystery, Thriller, Science Fiction  In a shadowy, bureaucratic organization known only as The Workplace, recruits are subjected to a ritual of initiation involving a mysterious cabinet—an anomaly that assigns them a partner whose identity is inexplicably implanted into their minds. The process, shrouded in secrecy, is designed to minimize accidents in the field. But when one recruit lingers inside for an unprecedented 48 seconds, seasoned agent Alice begins to question everything she thought she understood about her job.  As Alice and her new recruit navigate a world of hidden threats, underground dealings, and inexplicable phenomena, a desperate search leads Alice to confront the limits of knowledge, safety, and certainty.  Blending existential horror with a noir-infused investigative thriller, Cabinet is a chilling descent into the boundaries of reality and the cost of uncovering hidden truths.

metas.name: Tom Clancy's Jack Ryan: Ghost War
metas.description: Jack Ryan is reluctantly pulled back into espionage when an international covert mission unravels a deadly conspiracy. Racing against time, he joins CIA allies Mike November & James Greer and sharp MI6 officer Emma Marlowe to battle a rogue black-ops unit in a high-stakes, deeply personal fight.

metas.name: The Mimic
metas.description: A mage explores a seemingly abandoned house.

metas.name: Cannon Ball/Cannibal
metas.description: A pirate looking for a place to fit in accidentally joins a club of cannibals.

metas.name: StreetLight
metas.description: Late one night, seventeen-year-old Seb returns to a neglected basketball court beneath the city streets. As memories of a painful chapter in his adolescence begin to surface, he finds himself confronting emotions he has spent years avoiding. Through the rhythm of the game and the spaces that shaped him, He embarks on a quiet journey toward acceptance, healing, and self-discovery.

metas.name: One Of Us - Becoming Andy Robertson
metas.description: Documentary about Liverpool left-back Andy Robertson.

metas.name: The Last Election
metas.description: A look back at the "Last Election" moment of 2024 in America through several generations grappling with and attempting to reflect upon it.

metas.name: The Room
metas.description: In The Room, Franco-Egyptian visual artist Youssef Nabil delivers a poetic, meditative short film that plays like a vintage piece of Golden Age Egyptian celluloid. Melding moving image with his signature hand-colored, highly theatrical aesthetic, Nabil crafts a comforting fable about mortality and transition.  The film follows Nabil as a soul contemplating the end of his earthly existence. He is met at the threshold by performance art icon Marina Abramović, who embodies a serene, angelic guide. Rather than leading him into darkness, Abramović awakens him from the "dream" of life and ushers him through a symbolic doorway into a radiant, hyper-saturated paradise. Materializing as a traditional Farah (an Arabic wedding celebration meaning "Joy"), this afterlife becomes a festive, music-filled homecoming—framing the end of life not as a tragedy, but as a beautiful transition into eternal celebration.

metas.name: Youthie
metas.description: On a northern English estate, a teenager quietly overwhelmed by responsibility at home begins to find hope through the support of a local youth worker.

metas.name: Satellites II
metas.description: An AI-generated teaser film to promote the Prada Mode event, which the fashion brand will hold at the iconic Chelsea Hotel during the Tribeca Film Festival. Directed by and co-starring Nicolas Winding Refn and Hideo Kojima.

metas.name: Killer Curve
metas.description: After her brother is murdered, Jade Carter uncovers a secret list linking powerful elites to a deadly conspiracy. As corrupt forces close in, she must outsmart both criminals and law enforcement to expose the truth - and survive long enough to get revenge.

metas.name: World War Bigfoot
metas.description: When his platoon is ambushed during WWII, an American medic escapes into the nearby forest, relentlessly pursued by the enemy. While evading capture, he encounters an unbelievable creature, not knowing if it's friend or foe. It will take everything he has to survive as new alliances will be formed and loyalties will be tested.

metas.name: Sampai Tujuan
metas.description: Mega spends her days working as an online motorcycle taxi driver, navigating the harsh streets while caring for her sick child. An unexpected event gradually brings to light a secret she has kept hidden all this time. In the end, it is revealed that everything she has done was simply to fulfill her child’s one final request.

metas.name: Camp Taywiyuska
metas.description: Two summer camp counselors face their fears when they are woken to a strange noise in the night.

metas.name: Me And You
metas.description: Damien is a young man who has spent several years in the bustling city.He decides to attend a therapy session to talk about his challenges and share his experiences with a past relationship with someone he holds close to his heart.During this session, he learns to cope with his mental health struggles and discovers how to release the attachment to this person he once considered his everything.

metas.name: The Fishsitter
metas.description: A pessimist agrees to babysit his friend's cherished pet goldfish while he's away for the weekend, but is he up to the task?

metas.name: Josh's Deli
metas.description: A deli owner contends with his ham-fisted staff. Would it kill 'em to show gratitude every so often?

metas.name: Prosthetic Heart
metas.description: Jessie is a lonely person and is taken advantage of by mystery sales man Leo Stall. He sells Jessie his product promising him a better life although things turn sideways as the product ruins Jessies life. A David Lynch inspired short.

metas.name: Clowning Around
metas.description: Living alone, a sad clown with social anxiety attempts to overcome his issues and meet people like him.

metas.name: The Baker's Dozen
metas.description: A storied music venue called "TOAD" suddenly closes, interrupting 15 years of performance by The Baker Thomas Band. A year later, the musicians reunite amid uncertain times at the city's remaining musical sanctuary.

metas.name: Forever Young: A Grammy Salute to Rod Stewart Live
metas.description: This electrifying once-in-a-lifetime television event honors Sir Rod Stewart, the Grammy Award-winning two-time Rock & Roll Hall of Fame inductee and one of the best-selling artists in music history. This two-hour celebration brings viewers on stage and behind the scenes for an all-access concert experience.

metas.name: A Pretty Boy's Guide to Getting a Girlfriend
metas.description: In order to keep up a lie, romantic loser Tyler uses a remote that controls time to help his gullible best friend Ezekiel disastrously ask out a girl.

metas.name: Prince of Pigeons vs the Midnight Squid
metas.description: A dark comedy about the evolving relationship between two people who are completely different save for one thing; they both want to die.

metas.name: Chill Pill
metas.description: After their friend passes away, a group of friends deals with the loss in an... unconventional way. The group are forced to reckon with the question of whether they were good friends and finally let their friend go.

metas.name: Magpie
metas.description: Following the death of her mother, a young and talented pianist must find her way through monumental loss while preparing for an important audition. As grief and ambition begin to clash, Liz attempts to maintain a sense of normalcy while navigating the expectations from both herself and others. However, as she spirals through the stages of denial, anger, and devastation; she must come face-to-face with her loss and confront her grief through music.

metas.name: Mimicry
metas.description: A daughter attempts to mimic the divine, blurring the lines between grief and duty.

metas.name: Goodnight Lamby
metas.description: Three-year-old Zia searches for her missing stuffed Lamby through her father’s surreal sculpture-a vast world of oceans, caves, and outer space. Her quest becomes a journey of courage, wonder, and self-discovery.

metas.name: Andy's Cowboys
metas.description: A cowboy recalls a dance he shared at a now closed club.

metas.name: Untold UK: Liverpool's Miracle of Istanbul
metas.description: At half-time in the 2005 champion league final Liverpool were 3-0 down. What happened next made football history -​ as players recall in this documentary.

metas.name: Expendable
metas.description: A janitor for a Mining company finds himself in a turn where his life changes.

metas.name: I Don't Feel Funny
metas.description: Sam Dothro, an up-and-coming comedian in his mid-20s, is preparing for his very first comedy special when tragedy strikes. His best friend, Adam Beckman, passes away suddenly, and the grief causes Sam to lose what makes him funny. Now, on the eve of the big special show, Sam must reconcile with the memory of Adam to move forward and become funny once again.

metas.name: That They May Be One
metas.description: Uncovers a remarkable story of God’s providence unfolding for more than a century. From the urgent prayers of St. Elena Guerra, which inspired Pope Leo XIII to consecrate the twentieth century to the Holy Spirit, to the dramatic outpouring of the Spirit in Topeka, the historic revival at Azusa Street, and the surprising awakening among Catholics at Duquesne University in 1967, a powerful thread emerges.

metas.name: Wanda Sykes: Legacy
metas.description: Wanda Sykes returns to her alma mater with a fearlessly funny takedown of everything from the state of the world to the cultural clash over washcloths.

metas.name: Florescence
metas.description: A young married couple retreat to an English country house in an attempt to salvage Lucy's worsening mental health. John's strict instructions and their self-imposed isolation pushes their relationship to breaking point and Lucy begins to experience strange phenomena in the house.

metas.name: Mouse and His Mates
metas.description: After getting fired from his job, an ambitious loser attempts to rally his two friends together to get revenge on the man who fired him.

metas.name: Left Behind, Still Standing
metas.description: When the steel factory she’s working to dismantle comes back to life one night, immigrant Morana must face the fragility of her own existence - and how much she truly has in common with the laid-off workers.

metas.name: When the Hallways Go Quiet
metas.description: On the night before graduation at Portage Northern High School, four friends Carmen, Vig, Ace, and Aanya walk through the quiet halls of their school one last time. When they stop outside their classroom, they decide to sit together and talk about their memories from the past four years, remembering the moments that made their high school life special. As they reflect, scenes from the lives of other seniors appear in montages, showing the many experiences shared by the Class of 2026. When they finally leave the classroom, Vig pauses and sees a group of younger students running in, ready to begin their own journey. In that moment, he realizes that while their time at the school is ending, a new chapter is just beginning for others.

metas.name: W.E.B. Du Bois: Rebel With a Cause
metas.description: Explore the life and legacy of notable Black scholar and civil rights pioneer W.E.B. Du Bois. From his birth, just five years after the Emancipation Proclamation; to his death, on the eve of the March on Washington in 1963, his legacy as an activist continues to resonate today.

metas.name: Silent Voices
metas.description: In New York, a Korean immigrant family of four leads separate lives, each facing moments of defeat in their daily existence. As they navigate complexities of survival and disconnection, they each hide their wounds from one another

metas.name: Diamond
metas.description: Joe Diamond is out of time with a traumatic past and an uncanny ability to solve crimes, using wit and observation to peel back hidden truths.

metas.name: Six Months in a Pink and Blue Building
metas.description: Mexico City, early 90s. The day Bruno turns 11, his growing feelings for his best friend Vladimir clash with the sudden announcement that his father has HIV. Like in salsa songs, his family tries to sing and dance their pain away. Thirty years later, Bruno films and reimagine the memory of what he could not quite perceive as a child.

metas.name: Small Hours
metas.description: Struggling with alcohol addiction and mental illness, an artist reaches out to an old friend.

metas.name: Stop! That! Train!
metas.description: Best friends and train stewardesses Tess and DeeDee trade their dreary shifts on the Stank Rail for the glitzy Glamazonian Express. However, when a catastrophic Stormaganza threatens to crash the high-speed train into Celebration, Florida, the duo in coach must join forces with the snobby first-class attendants, a hot but dimwitted co-conductor, and fabulous US President Judy Gagwell to save the day.

metas.name: Masters of the Universe
metas.description: After being separated for 15 years, the Sword of Power leads Prince Adam back to Eternia, where he discovers his home shattered under the fiendish rule of Skeletor. To save his family and his world, Adam must join forces with his closest allies, Teela and Duncan/Man-At-Arms, and embrace his true destiny as He-Man — the most powerful man in the universe.

metas.name: The Seminal Works of Dr. Tiffany Belle
metas.description: Tiffany, a charismatic but unconventional sperm donation technician, navigates the absurdities of her profession and her personal life in a quest for validation. Her eccentric colleagues, her complicated love life, and the existential questions of a job involving the origins of human life all pull at her. Told as an interactive film in which characters call the viewer directly mid-scene, the story runs across four branches to twenty-eight endings.

metas.name: Bound for Glory: The General as Keaton's Cinematic Manifesto
metas.description: Video essay detailing Buster Keaton's motivation and construction of his 1927 film, The General. Made up almost entirely of silent scenes from the film.

metas.name: Destiny
metas.description: Two girls, Jennifer and Kimmi, accidentally get their frisbee stuck in the backyard of Troy Falcon, the cutest boy on the block. They devise a plan to retrieve the frisbee without getting caught, but right at the end, Troy catches them.

metas.name: Algorithm Party
metas.description: Algorithm Party is an authentic, forthright glimpse into working class life, told with a blunt honesty with humour and compassion. Roy’s deft, articulate and startlingly observed musings veer from the comic to the calamitous in a breath, cutting to the quick of the broad swathe of people and personalities that comprise his native city of Liverpool - from struggling parents to small-time criminals, pent-up white-collar workers to drinkers long lost to the ale.

metas.name: A New Leash on Life
metas.description: Desperate for a job and a sense of purpose, Alex stumbles into dog walking - despite being wildly allergic. In the chaos that follows, he begins to discover confidence in the most unexpected place. And sometimes you may find a new life, starts with a leash.

metas.name: Think Again! I'm the Hidden Boss Mom
metas.description: PTA moms target and frame a "nobody" mom's son. She's humiliated and cast aside as a bigger secret emerges—until they learn she's the secret billionaire behind the school. Now she decides their fate.

metas.name: Tradfluencer - The Sharon Shannon Story
metas.description: An access all areas look at the life and career of renowned accordion virtuoso Sharon Shannon, featuring esteemed collaborators & exclusive behind-the-scenes moments from her gigs.

metas.name: Bcoming
metas.description: Our most ambitious production yet. Bcoming follows the journey of Bocconi students through their most defining moments — friendships built, challenges faced, and a university unlike any other.

metas.name: Probably not, but it could be
metas.description: A singular instant within the life of someone who cannot recall their past, trapped within the tactille universe. A traversable miracle of chemistry, a pathway of a memory that has long since been forgotten.

metas.name: Bad Funeral
metas.description: Two friends plan a funeral for their recently deceased muslim friend in this hidden camera guerrilla comedy.

metas.name: Fara Sense Filmul
metas.description: Fără Sense is a Romanian vertical-first mockumentary series set inside a chaotic modern company where nobody truly knows what they are doing, but everyone pretends they do.  Blending workplace comedy, internet culture and social satire, the series explores burnout, pointless meetings, corporate ego clashes, social media obsession and the absurd realities of modern work life through a fast paced and highly relatable format built specifically for the mobile generation.  At the center of the story is Andrei Severin, the real life CEO of the company behind the project, playing a fictionalized version of himself in a self aware portrayal of leadership inside a collapsing corporate ecosystem.  Combining actors, creators and internet personalities, Fără Sense turns modern work culture into cinematic chaos.

metas.name: The Making of "Am I Funny Yet?"
metas.description: A look into Lleyton Senne's short film "Am I Funny Yet?"

metas.name: Bell Labs - Home
metas.description: An exploration of what really makes something "home." Is it the place, or is it the people?

metas.name: Preparation
metas.description: A duel to the death set in Edo period Japan.

metas.name: In Pieces: The Musical (A Staged Concert)
metas.description: Be the first to experience Joey Contreras' hit new musical In Pieces, filmed LIVE during its sold-out run at The Other Palace in London.  Written and composed by Fred Ebb Award and Jonathan Larson Grant Finalist, Joey Contreras, In Pieces is a bold, contemporary new musical featuring a pop-driven score that dives into echoes of love, loss, and self-discovery by weaving the romantic journeys of six characters across three chapters of life. As friends, family, and former lovers confront old wounds and unresolved feelings, will they learn to coexist with the joy and pain of the past?  In Pieces has become a global sensation with a massive social media fanbase, tens of millions of streams, and licensed productions internationally. NOW, you can experience the staged concert from home for a limited time only.

metas.name: willow weep for me
metas.description: A low resolution glimpse of a young couple's day through Girona's flower exhibition.

metas.name: The Dark Side of Married at First Sight - Panorama
metas.description: Panorama investigates allegations that raise serious concerns that welfare procedures on Married at First Sight UK have failed contributors, leaving them at risk of harm.

metas.name: How I See The World
metas.description: 4 minutes of shots and visuals taken within Auckland City

metas.name: The Gold Stares Back
metas.description: With his retirement match suddenly cancelled, a disillusioned wrestler must come to terms with his past, the future and losing what he loves.

metas.name: Youth
metas.description: An archival footage compilation exploring the nature of youth, and the passage of time.

metas.name: A Brave Engineer: Buster Keaton's Last Ride
metas.description: From 1920 to 1965, the great Buster Keaton made spectacular use of locomotives in his films. This video essay charts the course of his iconic cinematic career across the many tracks he rode along on screen: as a young man in the surge of his silent movie ascent in Our Hospitality, while making his masterpiece The General, and traversing the width of Canada on a railway speeder car as an old man in The Railrodder.

metas.name: The Creeps - Behind the Scenes
metas.description: An in-depth documentary revealing all the secrets behind Marko Mäkilaakso's film THE CREEPS.

metas.name: Nostalgia for the Future
metas.description: Guided by the evocative narration of Charlotte Rampling, Nostalgia for the Future is a descent into the labyrinthine world of Chris Marker, the “best-known author of unknown films,” who spent a lifetime concealing himself behind a veil of pseudonyms and images of cats.  Moving through a constellation of personal documents and film fragments, an archivist attempts to decode the man through the material traces he left behind. By repurposing and recontextualizing Marker’s own body of work, the film treats his images as “time machines,” transforming the archive into a landscape of living memory. Nostalgia for the Future is a meditation on memory, identity, and the power our past images hold over the futures we imagine.

metas.name: Dead Man Memory
metas.description: David, a French police officer, travels to Thailand to meet Ravi – a young boy who claims to have been a criminal named Floyd in his previous life. Alongside his colleague Joanna, David enlists the young child and utilises his expertise to track down the dangerous criminal enterprise Floyd once had ties to.

metas.name: Class Photo
metas.description: While revisiting his now-abandoned school, Ignas runs into a former classmate. As they wander through corridors filled with conflicting memories, they try to capture what will soon be gone.

metas.name: Tin Castle
metas.description: Along a long-forgotten road, the O’Reillys live in a rundown trailer stranded in the middle of the fields. Pa’, Lisa, and their ten children weather the seasons in their tin castle, heirs to a way of life on borrowed time. Under threat of eviction, their tenuous balance falters, yet – steadfast in their tradition – they resist. The children laugh, the dogs bark, the trailer holds on – but for how long?

metas.name: Maude Macher & Dom Duck
metas.description: Maude is a talented guitarist struggling to find her place in the world of music. That all changes when she meets a special duck named Dom.

metas.name: My House, My Father
metas.description: Filmmaker Dylan Coty returns to his family home to explore the life and death of the man who built it, his late father. Through conversations with those who still live there, the house becomes a lens through which his family's past and present are brought into focus.

metas.name: Drip Drop
metas.description: A wealthy woman offers her best friend and husband $200,000 for a swingers weekend, unleashing chaos that threatens everyone's lives.

metas.name: Drag Kings: Question Time
metas.description: After 10 years on the stage, PECS Drag Kings Collective gathers for a one-day festival in London to celebrate their anniversary with the queer community.  Critical thinker and Drag King fan Diana G. penetrates Shoreditch Town Hall to ask the audience a crucial question. Have Drag Kings and Things changed the landscape of Gender and Sexuality?

metas.name: Daughter in a Box
metas.description: A seemingly independent woman moves her ailing parents into her home and finds herself back in the emotional constraints of her childhood.

metas.name: The Least Generous Donor
metas.description: Gia and Polly embark on an emotional roadtrip to confront a man who wronged them.

metas.name: How To Fix A Drawer
metas.description: Brock follows twelve simple steps to fix his busted kitchen drawer.

metas.name: Internet Famous
metas.description: Frank, a middle-aged family man, is convinced internet fame is his last shot at making his life mean something. When he promises his wife he'll go viral in a year, Frank's 365 days spent recklessly pursuing views and likes results in injuries, hospital bills, and chaos within the family. For Frank, success is only one viral video away — no matter the cost.

metas.name: Isn't It Pretty to Think So
metas.description: Isn't It Pretty To Think So is a parody short film adaptation of the ending of The Sun Also Rises by Ernest Hemingway. The film reimagines the classic literary source material with a humorous, modern tone.

metas.name: Zugzwang!
metas.description: In the shadow of war, a disgraced soldier is discharged back to his home town. In the search for his girlfriend, he is drawn into a game he does not want to play.

metas.name: Pith
metas.description: After two boys go missing years prior, an amateur journalist team sets out to uncover what really happened to them.

metas.name: By Storm - 5.17.26
metas.description: shot with Sony DCR-TRV460

metas.name: One Night At Star
metas.description: One Night At Star is a mini-documentary showcasing performances by the bands OGRE, Zookraught, and Happy Death Men at Star Theater in Portland, Oregon in April 2026.

metas.name: Jônetsu Tairiku : Iyo Sky
metas.description: WWE, the world's largest professional wrestling organization, is said to be watched by over 1 billion people in more than 150 countries through television and streaming. The annual "WrestleMania" event attracts nearly 60,000 spectators, creating an excitement comparable to the American football "Super Bowl. "Only top wrestlers from around the world step into the ring. In 2018, a Japanese woman professional wrestler joined WWE. A former gymnast, she captivated audiences with her acrobatic moves, utilizing her flexibility and agility. And last year, she rose to become the WWE Women's World Champion. That's Iyo Sky. When Iyo appears in front of the venue, a huge cheer erupts. "IYO! IYO!". Autographs, high-fives, hugs, two-shot photos... Her popularity is soaring across America.

metas.name: Revisit 4 (9 10 11)
metas.description: "Almost every shot in my films is only a portion of the original take, and it is extremely unlikely that I would choose the exact same portion twice — and if so such an instance would be so rare that it would not pose a redunancy problem." - Fred Camper

metas.name: Revisit 3 (6 7 8)
metas.description: "Most Interactions to date juxtapose related imagery, almost always from the same or nearby locations, and one attraction of intercutting these works was that I could make edits that crossed space, such as the way Revisits 3 [6 7 8] intercuts Amsterdam, Antwerp, and London." - Fred Camper

metas.name: Revisit 2 (3 4 5)
metas.description: "It is not necessary to view a Revisit together with it sources, but the page for each Intreractions does contain information on the locations and dates of the original shooting."- Fred Camper

metas.name: Revisit 1 (0 1 2)
metas.description: As will likely be evident, the bracketed numbers in the title are the numbers of the Interactions that the work is drawn from. Interactions 0 was originally intended to be the first, but when the editing of it was completed I found the footage I had, of Chicago in winter, inadequate, and thought that I could learn from it without releasing it. Now I am glad to reveal some of it here in Revisit 1.

metas.name: Interactions 35: Trinity Churchyard
metas.description: Filmed in Filmed in New York, New York, May 7-9 2025.

metas.name: Interactions 34: Vehicle Lights
metas.description: Filmed in Bayonne, New Jersey, May 7-9, 2025.

metas.name: Interactions 33: Delphi
metas.description: Filmed in Delphi, Greece, July 2-3, 2024.

metas.name: Interactions 32: To the Temenos
metas.description: Filmed in Greece, on a bus trip from Athens to the area where the Temenos was held; in Olympia; in and near Loutra Ireas; at and near the Temenos event near Lyssaraia, June 26-30, 2024.

metas.name: Interactions 31: Near the Acropolis
metas.description: Filmed in Athens, Greece, June 25, 2024.

metas.name: Interactions 30: Archaeological Museum
metas.description: Filmed in Athens, Greece, June 22-24,2024.

metas.name: Interactions 29: Views 2, Athens
metas.description: Filmed in Athens, Greece, June 21-22, 2024.

metas.name: Rookie: The Night the Goalposts Came Down
metas.description: A multi-media performance of Brewster Durbin's debut album, "Rookie," in which a fictional UL Lafayette football player - the titular Rookie - disappears immediately following the biggest moment in his career and becomes a mythical hero in south Louisiana.

metas.name: First Rehearsal
metas.description: When Ritwik called his friends to rehearse for a play, he expected some friction. He did not anticipate a war.

metas.name: Promenade and Green
metas.description: Camera roll screen recordings.

metas.name: Arthur Jackson
metas.description: A young boy named Arthur is an energetic student who is a fan of Michael Jackson, but he is unaware with the truth about Michael Jackson’s passing

metas.name: Ver, Veracruz
metas.description: Ver, Veracruz explores the oldest city in America, seeking to uncover what truly defines it beyond its beaches, food, and music, revealing a deeper identity of culture and history shaped by its people, memory, and lived experience.

metas.name: Sucks to Suck
metas.description: After a workplace incident, a newly promoted boss becomes the target of his office’s robot vacuum.

metas.name: siropoynportiseben
metas.description: zeropointfortyseven

metas.name: Friends Until the End
metas.description: When a luxurious weekend brunch turns deadly after their host is found mysteriously murdered, a group of longtime friends must unravel buried secrets and survive a series of chilling attacks.

metas.name: The Agent Game
metas.description: Unreleased, Plot TBA

metas.name: Horizon
metas.description: Horizon, set in the coastal town of Bristol, Rhode Island, follows Mike, a boy growing up in the shadow of the sea. When family struggles and personal loss weigh heavily on him, the water becomes both a refuge and a challenge. Through resilience and self-discovery, he learns that the horizon is not just a place in the distance, but a path forward.

metas.name: Better Future
metas.description: A weasel in a war-torn world of woodland animals uses his art to restore hope and strength in his village.

metas.name: I
metas.description: A cycle of a young Christian, who struggles with addiction, wrestling with himself.

metas.name: Мараг ялсан нь
metas.description: Siddhartha defeats Mara and becomes the Buddha.

metas.name: Glabah
metas.description: The city is not a city; the figures are not quite human. Though these shapes with hands turned into weapons seem artificial, they were once men. These are inverted, deceptive silhouettes—beings whose eyes and ears have long been shuttered, drifting away from humanity, deceived by the gears and iron of that cold Glabah.

metas.name: introverted.
metas.description: A shy musician named Luka Hill, slowly breaks his way out of his shell, accompanied by his puppet best friend. Though the more he does so, the more the puppet disappears, thus leaving him to decide between himself or the made up friendship in his head.

metas.name: Tranquil
metas.description: When a U.S. senator mysteriously disappears, a team of intelligence specialists defy government orders to search for him.  In a race against time, they must navigate a high-stakes game of surveillance, cover-ups and digital breadcrumbs.

metas.name: DON'T
metas.description: Based on a true story, this short animated film illustrating the difficulties faced by a person suffering from mental illness. This black and white film, inspired by the classic style of sequencing, is animated using rotoscoping to convey realistic emotions and movements.

metas.name: The Anniversary
metas.description: Salim, a young Palestinian musician returns home to celebrate his parent’s wedding anniversary. Upon his arrival, he and his family’s true priorities are put into question when his mother requests that he drop out of college in order to help their struggling family business. Now with his future on the line, Salim must choose between his personal ambitions and his responsibilities to the family that raised him.

metas.name: Can This Be Reel?
metas.description: The reel and the real face off in the reality of this reel of reels that represent various realities. Really.

metas.name: Ape Shit
metas.description: Two monkeys embark on a mission from an unlivable earth. They are the last hope, and as their shuttle lifts off it’s not even clear they’ll make it. They set their sights on a lush green planet galaxies away. The last hope for monkey-kind. A rocky landing, everything up in smoke. The monkeys were not sure who would be living here, and they certainly didn’t expect dodo birds. One question remains, can apes and birds live in harmony?

metas.name: Our Backyard Hist'ry
metas.description: A Conductor of Ann Arbor's Underground Railroad Tour and a sole survivor of the greatest generation that ever lived, Scott F. McFadden's graphic description of history tells it like it was, and still is. A voice, so clear and with such passion, it speaks for an era without bitterness or self-pity among the dying and already dead. take a tour with us as we share Our Backyard Hist'ry.

metas.name: CYANOTYPE
metas.description: Photographer Pauly V. navigates life with chronic illness through Eco-experimental film photography.

metas.name: The Window Was Open on an April Afternoon
metas.description: Pablo, a pet bird, lives a long, monotonous, and consistent ten years. After his death, his owner reevaluates the pair’s connection, as she experiences true grief for the first time.

metas.name: The Gooners Fight Club
metas.description: In an underground fighting ring, two fighters, (gooners) are connected by a former love. After an affair they try to get revenge on each other. Engaging in a brutal fight lasting 3 rounds.

metas.name: Aptitude
metas.description: In a near-future society where a high-stakes virtual exam dictates one’s future, a disadvantaged student must decide whether to risk everything by cheating or accept a system designed for her to fail. This film was made as part of the American Film Institute’s 2025 Directing Workshop for Women Program.

metas.name: Avedon
metas.description: Richard Avedon’s photographs didn’t just reflect culture, they shaped it, and continue to do so. The feature documentary AVEDON traces the life and legacy of an artist who used fashion, portraiture, and commercial photography to explore identity, power, fear and beauty. With unprecedented access to Avedon’s archive, including never before seen photos, behind the scenes recordings, and interviews with those who knew him best, AVEDON is a visually stunning examination of the mind of an artist who shaped our collective image of the 20th century.

metas.name: Go Down Easy
metas.description: A student's life is disrupted when the  incident occurs.

metas.name: CALL
metas.description: The Boy chooses between comfort or growth.

metas.name: The Bridge
metas.description: ‘The Bridge’ follows a young woman who hears a mysterious phone ringing in the forest and follows it into a surreal world, where inspiration resides but cannot manifest. It is a meditation on the creative act as a passage between fantasy and reality; a concept I was very much in touch with throughout the process of manifesting this film.

metas.name: Flying Bee
metas.description: “Abeja Voladora” follows Ramona, a woman who begins working as a reporter at a major newspaper. After being sexually assaulted by her boss, she sets out to seek revenge, committing crimes that start drawing the attention of detective Benjamín Flores. As Benjamín investigates the cases, he unexpectedly begins to fall in love with Ramona, unaware that she is the one behind the violent acts.

metas.name: One More Day
metas.description: Ed is blessed with the gift of time travel, able to reset the day at will. He uses this gift to correct his mistakes, giving him what he thinks is the perfect mistake free life. However, after a painstaking attempt to create the perfect date, he discovers that this is the day his grandad dies. Unable to come to terms with his grandad's passing. Ed uses his powers to reset the day over and over continuously torturing himself transforming his gift of time travel into a never-ending curse.

metas.name: INTERCHANGE
metas.description: At Westfield Marion, there is an interchange. At Westfield Tea Tree Plaza, there is an interchange. Between these shopping centres, a number of events occur, and several spectres appear.

metas.name: Holding Water
metas.description: Over the course of an afternoon in late spring, two longtime friends reunite under a mulberry tree to confront the ways their time apart has changed them.

metas.name: These Hands Aren’t Mine
metas.description: As their own hands become strange and distant, a filmmaker reconstructs their identity through MRI scans and 35mm film.

metas.name: Scum '87
metas.description: Whatever happened to Valerie Solanas?

metas.name: Anesthesia
metas.description: A business executive meets his childhood mother in an anesthesia app, but is she there to help him?

metas.name: The Fishermen
metas.description: A day in the mundane for two lonesome moviegoers. One an old veteran, the other a young devotee, both live in the ghosts of days gone by, observing small rituals of comfort against Adelaide's uncaring sprawl. They eventually converge on an aged cinema, in search of that certain feeling.

metas.name: Passing Signals
metas.description: When a lonely man discovers a mysterious TV broadcast featuring a woman who can see and hear him, they form a deep virtual connection, but as the signal falters, he must confront the fragility of their bond and the true cost of technology-enabled intimacy.

metas.name: Maverick: The Epic Adventures of David Lean
metas.description: Profiles the double Oscar winner, who helmed some of the most well-respected movies of all time, via never-before-seen archive and contributions from leading film directors. Haunted by the shadow of his dismissive father and his puritan upbringing, Lean was married six times, and he created layered and complex narratives in his work while struggling to find connection and meaning in his personal life.

metas.name: North
metas.description: I found a decaying print of Nanook of the North buried in the archive at Northwest Film Forum. Vinegar-soaked. Warped. Unstable. I let it keep rotting. Then I pushed it further: through photochemical abrasion, through touch, through light.

metas.name: Leaked
metas.description: Young underground artist Kristi finds themselves having to track and chase down clout chasers who have stolen a USB drive with their music on it

metas.name: Those Sage Days
metas.description: When her childhood best friend returns after years of silence, Charlotte is drawn back into a past shaped by shared rituals and fragmented memories. As the boundary between memory and reality begins to blur, Charlotte must face the unspoken feelings she has carried for years, and learn how to live with a bond too fragile to hold, yet too precious to let go.

metas.name: The Crown
metas.description: Bound by a marriage dictated by duty rather than love, Princess Selma and the peasant Narsou flee after the fall of the kingdom and find refuge in an old house on the edge of the forest. Narsou is willing to sacrifice everything for her love, while Selma clings to the ghost of lost power and refuses to accept her new reality. When Narsou decides to turn to magic, Selma must let go of the past and make a choice that will determine her fate.

metas.name: Dead Man's Hand
metas.description: Who? What? Where? Why? Upon returning from a routine delivery, a driver finds his coworker lying on the street, lifeless. As he attempts to address what happened to his colleagues, the evening takes an unexpected turn for the worse.

metas.name: Red Flagged 2
metas.description: As Megan reaches a stagnant point in her dating life, she is roped into a date unlike any she has ever gone on.

metas.name: Too Sense
metas.description: Jenny is two cents short of buying a drink, so she embarks on a journey in the night in hopes that one of her friends can spot her.

metas.name: Barber
metas.description: In a world where men are quietly seeking connection but struggling to find it, the barbershop poses as a space for them to build relationships. The star of this film, Tristan Cramer, explores connection and love in two very different but connected spaces. As a barber, he serves and pours life into his customers, but who pours into him? Tristan invites us to think about connection in our lives through the frames of his life. Barber asks the question: how do you love those around you?

metas.name: I was bored, so I made a music album
metas.description: jdot was bored, so he created a music album.

metas.name: Honey, Our Son is a Rat
metas.description: Hana and Osman attempt to deal with the transformation of their son on the day of his birthday.

metas.name: Precious Thing
metas.description: A daughter discusses the overlapping issues with her current life and her mother's previous and current experiences through phone calls over the course of many months while away at college. Life events cause conversations to get more serious and pressing, beginning to affect both women's lives as they cling to each other for comfort and consistency.

metas.name: Off-screen
metas.description: Rita's phone has been taken away, angry, she decides to run away from home and accomplish a list she created when she was 13 : Things to do before I turn 18. But she's gonna realize her whole world is more superficial than she thought.

metas.name: Half the Results
metas.description: In the medium-sized midwest town of Columbia, Missouri, Shane Stander is a committed skateshop owner who is coming up on five years of opening a new skateshop; coincidentally down the street from the one he used to co-run. As the filmmaker attempts to ask questions and poke around, this film explores the passion, peculiarity and community of the mid-Missouri skateboarding scene.

metas.name: Moment of Parting
metas.description: When an elaborate surprise starts to unravel, a dynamic friend group must reconvene to problem solve.

metas.name: Last Resort
metas.description: A strained sibling road trip spirals into chaos after a motel stop in the middle of nowhere reveals that some places are more dangerous than they seem.

metas.name: Doug
metas.description: No movement.No sound.No life.Just....Doug  When the world collapses into silence, one man is left searching for a purpose he never found to begin with. A surreal film about loneliness, darkness, and the strange things that fill the void when everything disappears.

metas.name: For A Day Like Today
metas.description: Following the death of her husband, Dan, in November of 2010, Suzanne Frisse Lathrop converts her Facebook into a public diary, housing her grief in magical and unexpected ways. A ritual throughout her week, Suzanne photographs the sky and shares photos containing strange spherical aberrations which she calls "orbs." For A Day Like Today confronts American attitudes surrounding grief all the while inviting audiences to reflect on how and where they see those they have lost.

metas.name: Trans Panic
metas.description: Trans Panic! is a mockumentary about a trans girl/christian fundamentalist/hyperpop rapper who tries to blow up a liberal arts college with the help of an incel filmmaker who's in love with her. They succeed, but at a terrible cost.

metas.name: Heir to the Rift: The Final Choice
metas.description: As Morague continues in his pursuit, Sammy joins an old acquaintance to try anything to stop his father from destroying time itself. Meanwhile the government persist in covering up the secrets of the past. In this thrilling finale to The Choice Saga, Sammy is forced to make one final choice which will determine his entire fate, and fulfil his destiny.

metas.name: Apropos of Acid Snow: A Modern Underground (Parts I-III)
metas.description: Apropos of Acid Snow is a modern adaptation of Notes from Underground by Fyodor Dostoevsky. The story of a modern underground man who is too in his head.

metas.name: if i could do anything
metas.description: if only i could

metas.name: I Probably Am a Lonely One
metas.description: A wife tries to find some kind of connection with her husband, Edward, to no avail.

metas.name: Traces of Tracking
metas.description: One who trying to escape his past is being pursued by the god within him. Though the barriers of memory barely protect him, they cannot prevent the truth from seeping to the surface.

metas.name: Aphiemi
metas.description: 3 friends are worried about having accidentally started an extinction event, until a bigger problem comes their way

metas.name: Love You, Brother
metas.description: After being divided by the rodeo industry, two brothers are forced to confront what it means to say goodbye.

metas.name: Desire/Sleep
metas.description: A cat lounges on a chair, while the sound of birdsong and traffic echoes through a window.

metas.name: Commit to Memory
metas.description: Commit to Memory is a Sci-Fi Thriller short exploring a girl's ability to remember.  A girl with severe memory loss relies on nightly videos to remind herself of her day each morning. But when a stranger claims they met the day before, and her own video says otherwise, everything goes south.

metas.name: The White Ibis
metas.description: At an illustrious restaurant, a disrespected new employee must deliver a prized sandwich on foot to keep their job and test their mettle.

metas.name: Faith & Forgiveness: A Duck Dynasty Love Story
metas.description: Lisa and Al Robertson, known from Duck Dynasty, fell hard and fast believing they had found a once-in-a-lifetime love. But betrayal and unspoken pain slowly fracture what they built together. When the truth comes to light, both must confront everything they thought they knew about love and loyalty — and decide if their marriage and faith are worth fighting for.

metas.name: Reality Games
metas.description: A video game thriller about two best friends fighting for control of the narrative online. An updated cut of Michael Morgenstern's film Dared My Best Friend to Ruin My Life.

metas.name: John and Hark Get Rich
metas.description: Two dysfunctional neighbors must learn to tolerate one another once they become burdened with a suitcase that reads "Free Money" on the side of it.

metas.name: Afterparty
metas.description: Caught between the conservative values of his homeland and the liberal freedoms of his new American life, Aziz, an immigrant from a homophobic country, struggles to navigate his identity in a world that demands he choose between two conflicting cultures.

metas.name: 14 Seconds of Indifference (By A Cosmic Deity Watching Me)
metas.description: Against the backdrop of a dying Tacloban, an underqualified teenager struggles to secure employment in a ruthless city that has no place for him. Worse still, he discovers that a rising artificial intelligence program threatens to steal all the work reserved for man. In his search for meaning for himself and for the city he calls home, he finds out a cosmic entity has been quietly watching him.

metas.name: Cadence of a Prayer
metas.description: Inspired by horror films and videos displayed on screens in shops, Cadence of a Prayer considers the abstraction of the queer, human, tropical body. Representations of flesh, body, and skin are coagulated into corporeal messes, as the body becomes ‘inhumanised’ through a combination of stretches, melts, and sweat.

metas.name: Boulders
metas.description: Shot entirely on Super8 camera, this film is a part of Montien’s ‘The Gay Asian Cowboy’ series. Inspired by his late father’s obsession with vintage Western movies, Montien travelled to the location where early classics in that genre were made, and shot his own queer version of the cowboy’s fantasy.

metas.name: A Cocktail Based on a Dreamer's Dream
metas.description: Artist Doreen Chan assumes the role of facilitator and mixologist, chatting with participants about their dream associations as they consume cocktails or mocktails she has created. These visceral blends evoke places, smells, and tastes connected to their dreams. Across the three documentary videos, these exchanges unfold as moments of reflection and remembrance.

metas.name: No Time to Think: Bob Dylan as Filmmaker
metas.description: A freewheeling video essay about Bob Dylan's underexamined work as a filmmaker, based on the book by Michael Glover Smith

metas.name: We Act Like Children
metas.description: Two children, or perhaps elders, a brother and a sister, have built a home on an island beyond time itself. Their days consist of fishing, foraging, making art and finding new medicines, though imminent climate collapse and the lives they’ve left behind weigh heavily on them both. Through conflict and collaboration, they come to an understanding within the teachings of the Anishinaabe adzookaanag, prophecies and legends, that led them to the island in the first place. The siblings must learn to make peace with their fear of annihilation and choose to live in a good way — to honor the prophecy that, as long as there are Anishinaabe, the world will not end.

metas.name: Children & Animals
metas.description: A 12-year-old farmer begins to come to terms with the fact that his beloved show goat, Grace, will die one day.

metas.name: The Three Shadows
metas.description: A Nightclub owner ventures home, not knowing of the two men waiting to kill him. They attempt to work out a negotiation, whilst also trying to stay unknown to their target.

metas.name: Chocolate or Vanilla
metas.description: A woman enjoys ice cream.

metas.name: Best Served Cold: A Hannah Swensen Mystery
metas.description: When a suspect in a forgery case is murdered and the prosecutor goes missing, Hannah and Chad must uncover how the two cases are connected and solve them in time for the trial.

metas.name: The Algorithm of Loss
metas.description: After a failed blind date, Kazuyo is inspired to upgrade the AI programme of her late partner, Adam. But his sensory limitations force Kazuyo to confront the reality of grief, memory, loneliness and mortality.

metas.name: I LOVE TO RUN
metas.description: When a wannabe running influencer's career is interrupted by an insidious call to something greater, he loses himself to curiosity and ambition.

metas.name: STRAIGHT EDGE
metas.description: Desperate to escape his dead-end life, Matt (Chris Lovejoy) recruits his derelict friends to rob the neighborhood mob's card game. With his crew's reputation on the line, Denicio (Joe Graziano) is tasked with hunting down the trio and finding the money. Matt is forced to choose between his past or a life with the woman he loves.

metas.name: The Long Way to Tipperary
metas.description: A man returns home.

metas.name: GREED
metas.description: A group of young students resort to a grand heist to pay off their student debts, will they be successful or succumb to greed?

metas.name: Plants
metas.description: After a ecological collapse a scientist narrates over footage of the plants humanity lost in hopes of warning any future civilization that may be lucky enough to exist in a world with plants.

metas.name: No One Can Hear You
metas.description: Fermi wakes aboard a derelict spacecraft, rescued by a lone castaway. But as they strive to repair the ship and return to Earth, a troubling truth emerges...

metas.name: FATAL ERROR - Do You Want to Still Take This Train?
metas.description: At the dawn of the 19th century, Scotsman John Turpin-Monroy, the last member of the famous aristocratic and conspiratorial Tupin Atigeinst dynasty, after filling the entire world with railroads bearing his name, sets out, alongside a group of brave hustlers, dispossessed people, and thieves, to find Himaya-Suzu, the promised land, once and for all.

metas.name: Full Phil
metas.description: Wealthy American industrialist Philip Doom attempts to reconnect with his daughter Madeleine during a luxurious trip to Paris. Unfortunately, French cuisine, a 1950s horror film, and an intrusive hotel employee disrupt their stay.

metas.name: The Time Travel Immigration Bureau
metas.description: A new hire at the Bureau accidentally admits passage to a time terrorist and must find a way to set the timeline straight before her boss finds out.

metas.name: The Kismet Test
metas.description: In a twisted corporate experiment, two strangers are locked in a room together for 23 days. At the end, they must vote on who they think is an android. For the human, a fortune hangs in the balance, for the machine, it's life or death.

metas.name: Doble Línea
metas.description: A frustrated writer working as a night guard struggles with writer’s block when interference on the security radio starts repeating lines from his own novel.

metas.name: KEROSENE
metas.description: Light of God dimming weak.

metas.name: The Story of Documentary Film: 1970s
metas.description: From Mark Cousins, creator of the groundbreaking The Story of Film: A New Generation & Women Make Film, comes the definitive history of documentary. Tracing the evolution of documentary film across time, encompassing landmark works and hidden treasures, while revealing how the form has helped us see and make sense of our world.

metas.name: Top Hat - The Musical
metas.description: Based on the classic 1935 RKO movie starring Fred Astaire and Ginger Rogers, Top Hat is a sparkling romantic cocktail laced with witty comedy, stunning choreography and tap-dancing brilliance, brought to life on stage with lavish sets and gorgeous costumes. Irving Berlin’s irresistible score includes some of Hollywood’s greatest songs, including the immortal Cheek to Cheek, Let’s Face the Music and Dance, Top Hat White Tie and Tails and Puttin’ on the Ritz.  When Broadway star Jerry Travers arrives in London to open a new show, he crosses paths with model Dale Tremont whose beauty sleep is rudely interrupted by Jerry tap dancing in the hotel suite above hers. Instantly smitten, Jerry vows to abandon his bachelor life to win her – but the path of true love never does run smooth.  Put on your top hat, brush off your tails and let this joyous romantic musical comedy sweep you off your feet!

metas.name: Irving Berlin's Top Hat
metas.description: Inspired by the iconic 1935 movie musical starring Fred Astaire and Ginger Rogers, this acclaimed Chichester Festival Theatre revival recorded from the West End in January 2026 is directed and choreographed by three-time Tony winner Kathleen Marshall.

metas.name: The scream painting
metas.description: A documentary about the true nature of humans

metas.name: GENESIS
metas.description: A widowed father unravels his conviction after being plagued with recurring nightmares of sacrificing his beloved daughter.

metas.name: Two Drops of Blue
metas.description: The complexity of friendship through a platonic bond that runs deep enough to blur love, dependence, and identity.
