metas.name: SME III
metas.description: Experimental short film

metas.name: A Fistful of Hours
metas.description: Cowboy hat-wearin' high school juvenile known as The Kid must fulfill his missing community service hours in order to graduate. The twist? Kill school-wide outlaws in exchange for hours. Will our protagonist be able to restore all his hours before it's too late? Will a notorious wrongdoer not caught for ages stand in his way?

metas.name: Where is Charlotte?
metas.description: A meditation on insomnia and lucid dreaming, following one sleepless night where memory, dream, and waking life become impossible to tell apart.

metas.name: Everlasting
metas.description: Everyone wants to leave something behind. For sculptor Cornelius Pepsi Lyon, this is the driving force behind his creativity. Over the past four decades, he built the largest sculpture garden in America made by an individual artist, with over 800 pieces of his work scattered around his 40 acre property. Everlasting is an examination of Cornelius’ life’s work and the very nature of what inspires us to create.

metas.name: The Fool Always Wins
metas.description: On Christmas Eve, a man in crisis is invited to his neighbour’s apartment for dinner.

metas.name: Gilded Rage
metas.description: In the wake of being deferred from her Ivy League dream school, a spoiled Manhattan teenager throws a murder mystery party for all of her friends.

metas.name: Between the Islands
metas.description: At summer’s end, a father and his two sons share a day under the influence of San Pedro, where fleeting moments of connection give way to the realization that their time together is running out.

metas.name: Bloodline
metas.description: While seeking refuge with her estranged brother's family after a horrifying incident, a vampire comes face-to-face with the cycles of violence that shaped her childhood.

metas.name: Lacuna
metas.description: A young woman revisits an underground party in Athens in hopes of reconnecting with her elusive ex. What she finds out there, however, is a fever dream of her erasure.

metas.name: What Happened to Janet
metas.description: Locked in their apartment during a global pandemic, two roommates descend into madness among a fantasy world, but as they are constantly interrupted by the increasingly distressing abuse of their elderly neighbor, they decide they must avenge her.

metas.name: Poachers
metas.description: In the wake of her mother’s death, 12-year-old Maura struggles against her repressed family and domineering godmother to rescue the sanctity of her mother’s memory.

metas.name: skimmer
metas.description: When Mila, a 20-something charismatic shopaholic, buys stolen credit card information on the dark web for a blowout shopping spree with her boyfriend, Theo, she gets more than she bargained for. The consequences of her addict consumerism will change her and Theo forever.

metas.name: Beyond the South
metas.description: In a mist-covered mountain village, a young woman's life begins to shift with the arrival of two wandering musicians, as their fleeting melodies awaken her to the invisible ties between the living, the land, and the spirit.

metas.name: WINDBURN
metas.description: A farming couple in rural Indiana struggles to make it through the holidays on the one-year anniversary of their son’s suicide.

metas.name: Raghs (Dance)
metas.description: A single diaspora Iranian man seeks connection and belonging at a lively family & friends party.

metas.name: Astor
metas.description: A tense game of control spirals into violence when a boy’s rebellion against his domineering stepfather leads to a devastating accident.

metas.name: Thieving Days
metas.description: A lonely, hungry and ill-equipped French cowboy is travelling through an unknown land and find himself without food nor company, save for his beloved horse Fidéle. On a quest to find both, he passes a village where no one speaks his language. Meanwhile a pair of musicians sing of his endeavours.

metas.name: Howl
metas.description: In an overgrown abandoned factory, an overlooked 11-year-old mimics his older brother’s cruelty to finally be seen– until his first taste of power goes too far.

metas.name: Two Sides, One Coin
metas.description: When a high school senior, Ava, visits her older sister before graduation, their close relationship is tested as they unravel the unseen ways their parents shaped them.

metas.name: L'Improv
metas.description: The leader of a struggling improv group convinces them to perform a sketch that he wrote and pretend it’s improvised in a desperate attempt to save them from eviction.

metas.name: Woksape: Wisdom
metas.description: On Pine Ridge Reservation, a Lakota boy opens a portal to 1876 and witnesses his ancestors fighting to protect their songs, discovering that memory itself is a form of resistance.

metas.name: Glance
metas.description: A struggling photographer's fragile bond with his visiting mother fractures during her brief stay in New York.

metas.name: Bronx Girl
metas.description: A sheltered young adult in Yonkers escapes her strict, religious mother to have a wild night with a friend.

metas.name: There is No Wind
metas.description: A mysterious sonic boom rumbles above Taipei, prompting Ssu-Ning, an orchestra conductor, to reflect on the meaning of music. Simultaneously, her concert faces cancellation due to an impending typhoon.

metas.name: Hot Girl
metas.description: A plus-size woman wears a bikini to the beach for the first time, where a chance encounter with a young stranger forces her to face how she sees herself.

metas.name: The Void
metas.description: Dom lives in a bleak reality. After the government mistakenly declares his grandmother dead, he struggles to restore her Medicare insurance before it’s too late.

metas.name: Hannah at the Table
metas.description: Hannah goes to her widowed father’s apartment to meet his new girlfriend. When he makes a surprising announcement, she must decide whether to stay or go.

metas.name: Self-Tape
metas.description: A Hungarian filmmaker sets up a pop-up portrait studio on the streets of New York, where eager pedestrians step in like it’s a public audition. The quick encounter escalates into confessions and a collective reflection on self-image.

metas.name: Didukh
metas.description: A Ukrainian chef pours everything into one Christmas dinner to win over investors and save her restaurant dream — but as the night unravels, she finds that the only person who truly sees her is the stranger who delivers her flowers.

metas.name: Girl Egg Rocket
metas.description: A young girl in a small town finds a fragment fallen from the sky and carries it through the night, trying to return it to where it belongs.

metas.name: Teen Spirit!
metas.description: An intimate peek into a pregnant teenager’s life on the reservation as she considers moving away from her chosen and biological family as her looming due date encroaches.

metas.name: Second
metas.description: A teenage air-rifle athlete tampers with his rival’s rifle to secure a place in the provincial trials—only to discover that the real distance between them cannot be measured in points.

metas.name: Mississippi Sunrise
metas.description: In rural Mississippi, Mike and Lucky - uncle and nephew - must confront the memory that’s divided them when Lucky returns home to dig for the treasure he buried with his late cousin years ago.

metas.name: Crawling Hour
metas.description: Over the course of 24 hours, an immigrant's quiet struggle for dignity collapses into violence, testing how far he'll go to provide for his family.

metas.name: Beyond Blue Sky: The Untold Story of the First Private Astronauts
metas.description: A supersonic physics experiment that would either end in a funeral or aerospace immortality for the desert-dwelling, corner-cutting geniuses, who wanted to prove it was possible to have a low-cost, privately-financed, manned space program.

metas.name: Blood Orange
metas.description: Four days before the sun dies, a milk delivery man falls for another man's wife.

metas.name: Big Dogs
metas.description: Desperate to earn the respect of a new group of friends, middle schooler Carl submits to a series of escalating humiliations, pushing him to confront how far he’s willing to go for a place to belong.

metas.name: The 8th Actor
metas.description: An unknown young actor cast only as a corpse seizes his chance to shine when he single-handedly performs all seven roles in a hit play, sparking both acclaim and deadly envy among his fellow cast members.

metas.name: Rewired: Identity in the Age of Mass Distraction
metas.description: In an age where everyone is connected, our identities start to become shaped by a second life online. Our story follows the patterns of thinking and shared experiences brought upon by a digital world. Many generations are following unwritten rules and guidelines on how to act online, which affect their interactions.  Childhood is not the same as it once was, due to an all-consuming digital landscape. The lack of accountability and empathy that exists with the world's future generations has led to an uptick in mental health crises and people feeling more isolated than ever. If we are so connected, then why is there silence?

metas.name: Homogenized
metas.description: The process of homogenization of milk shown through various vignettes.

metas.name: Anjelah Johnson-Reyes: Ugly Baby
metas.description: Anjelah Johnson-Reyes shines in her 7th comedy special, exploring the adventures of family dynamics, embracing her current stage of life, and becoming a first-time mom in her later years.

metas.name: My Name Is Roscoe
metas.description: Roscoe, a man who displays a lack of empathy and excitement for the world around him, takes us through the final days of his life. A bartender by trade, Roscoe doubles as an information broker to pay the bills. After sleeping with the wife of a criminal kingpin, he ends up selling the exact info that would lead to his murder throughout an absurdist series of events.

metas.name: Jason Byrne - Head in the Clouds
metas.description: Jason Byrne's "Head in the Clouds" is a live stand-up comedy tour spanning 2025–2026, featuring his trademark high-energy, chaotic, and observational comedy,

metas.name: Uncovering Amy Hennig's Uncharted 4
metas.description: Reconstruction of the original vision for Uncharted 4 through extensive research into developer files, cut content, and internal concepts from before the project was extensively reworked in 2014.

metas.name: Freya
metas.description: A week before his wedding, Nick Foster's dreams are haunted by a woman in white.

metas.name: Do You Love Me?
metas.description: Katie's mind spirals into alternate scenarios, each shaped by a different answer to the same impossible question.

metas.name: Chuck & Charlie Got Into A Scrap
metas.description: Two friends, Chuck and Charlie, are brought back together by a third friend, Chip, begging them to reconcile after the two had an outlandish fight regarding Charlie's favorite show.

metas.name: Mon Papy
metas.description: A young boy is in the wait room of the hopital, because his granda fall

metas.name: Abracamazing!
metas.description: A stage magician is terrified of his own powers.

metas.name: Taxi Drivers
metas.description: A short documentary about fake cabs in Toronto and those who have been scammed by them.

metas.name: Last Walk In Shabla
metas.description: An assassin and his partner go on a mission in the Center of Shabla. One of them admits they want this to be their last mission, after which planing to purposely get caught by the police to escape this way of living. Things go terribly wrong as the two spiral into a confusing line of events.

metas.name: Wall Wizards
metas.description: Wall Wizards follows a young couple, Jamie and Brooke, as they move into their first home together. They’re expecting a fresh start, not a magical infestation. When their belongings begin to mysteriously disappear, they uncover a hidden world of tiny, mischievous wizards living inside their walls. What starts as a cozy move-in day quickly turns into curiosity, chaos, and unexpected magic.

metas.name: Poppy Tears
metas.description: In 1920s New York, a female Jazz Singer desperate for the spotlight strikes a deal with a speakeasy owner but soon runs the risk of getting to deep into a dangerous, hallucinogenic world.

metas.name: Egg Yolk Custard Bun
metas.description: At a dim sum table where food meets kink, three friends push playfulness and intimacy to its sticky, steamy edges—until a sudden interruption.

metas.name: The Making of A Man in Isolation
metas.description: In December of 2025, A Man in Isolation began its development process. It took roughly eight days to complete the entire film from start to finish. The final product came out to 25 minutes, including the credit sequence. Throughout the week, there were scenes and clips that never made the final edit, with some scenes not making it due to them not fitting the vibe.  Four months on, and those clips will be seen in this documentary-like film about the creation and the process of A Man in Isolation.

metas.name: The Soul of Africa
metas.description: Set against the Festival of Black Divinities in Togo, this captivating documentary explores the origins, resilience, and contemporary relevance of African spiritual traditions before and beyond Christianity and Islam.

metas.name: Caleb
metas.description: A grandson attempts to connect with his Nigerian grandmother as the woman he once knew quietly begins to fade.

metas.name: The Roast of Kevin Hart
metas.description: Kevin Hart is in the hot seat and ready for all the smoke as roastmaster Shane Gillis and a dais of A-listers unleash a raw and ruthless night of laughs.

metas.name: We Corrupted Few
metas.description: A BroHo documentary that tells the story of 4 schmucks, and how they sought to change the Overton Window by creating bizarre videos and pushing a philosophy of loving the corrupted.

metas.name: Stories About My Body
metas.description: In a tiny theatre in Aotearoa, New Zealand, four teenage stagehands work tirelessly to help Morgana tell the stories that shaped her - from her own teenagehood in 1998, to working foot-fetish parties in New York City, to falling in love and later birthing her babies in a Melbourne living room.  By turns vulnerable and riotously funny, she moves from lamenting her chins to marvelling at her cellular functions, using her body as the living template for every tale she tells.  Created and performed by Morgana O'Reilly (The White Lotus) and co-directed with her husband and real-life birth partner, 2025 BAFTA nominee Peter Salmon (After The Party), Stories About My Body blends nudity, heart-swelling honesty and real birth footage into a stand-up comedy special like no other - intimate, fearless and unexpectedly profound.

metas.name: Blooky: The Book Who Wanted To Be Read
metas.description: A brand-new little book gets lost in the vast maze of a grand library and journeys through every section in search of where he belongs, only to realize that the most meaningful place to be isn't always where you fit in best.

metas.name: Cat-Tasrophe
metas.description: While searching for his missing cat, Conrad meets an unlikely friend.

metas.name: Whispers Next Door
metas.description: Suzanne hides her daughter’s shocking secret to protect their family, but when their charismatic Pastor takes a disturbing interest in the baby, their lies ignite a chilling battle between faith, control, and truth.

metas.name: Hussaini
metas.description: Follows Hussaini, an okada (commercial motorcycle) rider trying to make ends meet and protect his pregnant wife, Amina, as life's pressures quietly mount.

metas.name: The Ryan Rooms: Pilot
metas.description: Follow a group of friends that find themselves exploring the creepy newly abandoned basement, before quickly finding that they are trapped inside with a savage cannibalistic monster. Will they escape, or will they be picked off one by one by a killer, and have their story end in Ryan’s Rooms?

metas.name: The Dao of Thao
metas.description: Performer Thao P. Nguyen prepares for her next comedy show while struggling to remain true to herself as a queer Asian American mother in the face of constraining social, cultural, and familial expectations.

metas.name: New Life: The Movie
metas.description: New Life is a raw and authentic faith-based coming-of-age story about a college student navigating his relationship with Christ and all the bumps and struggles that come with it. The story follows Peter, an African American college freshman who is struggling to believe in Christianity. After experiencing a traumatic breakup, Peter begins to question his life, purpose, and identity. He blames his Christian upbringing and decides to walk away from his faith during college. At freshman orientation, we are introduced to Melissa, a college sophomore and enthusiastic follower of Christ. She is a student leader at a Christian fellowship group on campus called New Life. When Melissa meets Peter, she invites him to join the fellowship. After hearing his doubts, she compassionately challenges his unbelief.

Follows Afropop artist Llona through a first-of-its-kind 25-city tour across Nigeria with his deeply moving, storied debut album, Homeless. A feat that superstars such as Wizkid, Davido and Burna Boy are yet to achieve. This documentary answers how Llona pulled this off with his debut album.

metas.name: BIG MEAT
metas.description: A pair of siblings try to take down a mega-corporation by making an exposé documentary in the middle of the night!

metas.name: Cultural Capital: African Art, Restitution, and Repatriation
metas.description: Exploring the repatriation of African Art and how it stolen loot was reframed ar African art by art dealers

metas.name: Night Moves
metas.description: Blending cinematography with choreography and powerful sound design, a film that explores dance as a language and a conduit for people to find connection through shared physical expression. Originally inspired by the proliferation of extraordinary choreographies by non-professional and professional dancers, performed to camera and distributed online, created specifically for social media.

metas.name: Un Niñx De Dos Mexicos
metas.description: In my first time returning to Mexico, I revisit old memories of childhood, exploring my journey as a Chicano. Understanding ever further what was sacrificed to give me & my siblings better opportunities. Un vida mejor, and return no longer wondering; "What if I was born in Mexico?"

metas.name: Banana
metas.description: A monkey keeps his precious new banana safe.

metas.name: Interlocked
metas.description: An inventor tries to parent her wall-powered robot son. When he tries to discover a world beyond the boundaries she designed for him, she has to choose between keeping him safe and letting him live on his own.

metas.name: Come Clean
metas.description: A man finds himself in a sticky situation.

metas.name: Young Man
metas.description: A young man fulfills his teenage goals before he becomes an old man (20)

metas.name: The Making of Night Bloom
metas.description: The Making of Night Bloom is an award-winning documentary about the creation of an immersive artwork led by Deaf artists from China and the UK. Winner of Best Documentary at Toronto’s Unify Film Festival, the film weaves creative process with powerful personal stories. It features Deaf Chinese elders who find connection through a vibrant Deaf club gathering beneath the trees of a city park, alongside young Deaf dancers carving out careers in a challenging mainstream world. Through Chinese Sign Language, movement and digital projection, the documentary reveals resilience, intergenerational exchange and the transformative power of Deaf-led collaboration across cultures.

metas.name: RHYTHMS
metas.description: Through trials and tribulations, four unacquainted girls prove to be more connected than expected, as they slowly become united through the power of dance.

metas.name: Piano Hands
metas.description: An experimental retelling of the tortured artist, structured around four elements: water, people, landscape, and night. While the narrative is fictional, the film originated from a story my father told me about encountering a dead body in the woods as a child.

metas.name: Miss Matched
metas.description: After a messy divorce, an architect who believes his rare skin condition makes him undateable hires a quirky matchmaker—sparking a partnership that forces them both to rewrite their own rules on love.

metas.name: On The Road
metas.description: In the early 1970s, young hippie Julie James embarks on a solo road trip to pursue her dream of being a singer, but quickly realizes she is in way over her head.

metas.name: Altar Boys After Mass
metas.description: Two deviant altar boys in masks of Saint Peter and Saint Paul investigate a hidden memoir written by a group of former altar boys.

metas.name: Seat at the Table
metas.description: In immersive vérité style, Seat at the Table follows several prominent South Asian political candidates during the 2024 election cycle, alongside a community galvanized by the groundbreaking campaign of the first South Asian presidential candidate. Within a hundred years, South Asians in America have gone from being disenfranchised, to seeing the first South Asian presidential candidate on a major party’s ticket.  With unprecedented access to congressional and state-level campaigns, as well as grassroots organizing efforts, the film captures a historic year for the South Asian diaspora as more candidates than ever run for office, providing us a rare front-row seat to an immigrant community awakening to its power in America.

metas.name: Procedures
metas.description: Simon Liu, 2026

metas.name: Bookwyrms
metas.description: In an old library, Astrid, a young author, struggles with her manuscript. When she writes down an idea, her ink comes to life and forms a small dragon-like creature – a Bookwyrm. It leads her deep into the shelves, into a world full of inspiration. On her journey through various literary genres, her idea evolves in unexpected ways. To move forward, Astrid must learn to let it go.

metas.name: Karolinka
metas.description: A short film about the South London based Polish song and dance company Karolinka.

metas.name: Who Smoked The Bones of Saint Jerome?
metas.description: When an ambitious priest is passed over for a coveted parish, his jealousy drives him to sabotage an innocent deacon, triggering unintended and miraculous consequences.

metas.name: Palos Verdes Landslide Complex
metas.description: At disparate points during the landslide of Palos Verdes, a man's generator loses power and a woman hikes down a cliffside.

metas.name: Dreams
metas.description: After a night of sleepwalking, a teenage girl is troubled with weird dreams. She slowly spirals as she thinks her dreams are seeping into her reality.

metas.name: An Investigation Into The Noseless Saint
metas.description: A look into the medieval mania around nose loss and other bodily fears, narrated by historian John Chatham who has been researching pilgrimage and power in the 14th Century. Shot and hand developed with Lomokino 35mm.

metas.name: The Exchange Rate
metas.description: After a bank heist, two criminals try to escape the law, sparking a chain of emotional, financial, and romantic fallouts that forces three different stories to collide in unexpected ways.

metas.name: ONE HOUR PARTY
metas.description: Landon and Sky try to host a party...

metas.name: pennies
metas.description: A journal-paper doll is visited by his friend.

metas.name: Beast Mode
metas.description: All Mark wanted to be was a superhero but he became a monster instead.

metas.name: Marc Ribot Quartet @ Jazz sous les Pommiers 2026
metas.description: Marc Ribot rarely performs in Europe. His appearance at Jazz sous les Pommiers is therefore a real treat, especially since the guitarist is performing here with his quartet to introduce us to the album *Hurry Red Telephone*.

metas.name: Albin de la Simone, Jozef Dumoulin & Fabrice Moreau @ Jazz sous les Pommiers 2026
metas.description: A leading figure in French music, Albin de la Simone revisits his repertoire alongside Jozef Dumoulin and Fabrice Moreau. These songs are waiting to be rediscovered through the lens of jazz at Jazz sous les Pommiers.

metas.name: Spring Cleaning
metas.description: Compulsive hoarder Jannette dies in her home, and her estranged daughter Beth must come back and deal with the mess.

metas.name: SCF – The Premiere: 12 Hangry Men
metas.description: 12 jurors get increasingly hangry as catering refuses their ever desperate requests for a meal. Also gets a bit lynchian towards the end.  Third night. Even better night. Best night, love this night.

metas.name: Hoop Like This
metas.description: Explores the emotional and physical demands placed on the world’s first professional Indian basketball team as they pursue history. India does not allow dual citizenship, meaning generations of elite athletes of Indian heritage have been ineligible to represent the national team across all sports.

metas.name: dEATH
metas.description: In a rain-soaked city, a cynical private eye hunts a serial murderer who's mutilating privileged men, only to confront his own jealousy and insecurities.

metas.name: Homecoming
metas.description: A small town's annual ceremony is put in jeopardy after a reluctant high school senior is selected as the winner. As expectations mount, he must decide whether to continue his town's violent tradition or break free from it.

metas.name: Under a Million Stars
metas.description: Experts and homeless neighbors alike bust myths about Seattle’s homelessness crisis in a deeply reported, humanistic dispatch from the front lines. Homelessness was declared a civil state of emergency in Seattle in 2015. Since then, the number of people sleeping outside has actually risen by more than 67 percent. Chezik Tsunoda's documentary Under a Million Stars, which received the Satterberg Foundation's Courageous Documentary Filmmaking Grant, is a deeply reported yet humanistic dispatch from the front lines of this crisis. Armed with facts and empathy, the film busts pernicious and all-too-common myths about homelessness.

metas.name: short stop
metas.description: Short Stop is a short film about a kid with cystic fibrosis trying to join his college baseball team but can't due to his condition and needs to find a new meaning for his life other then baseball

metas.name: Ice Women
metas.description: Three extraordinary stories of women, risking life, health, and money to explore the Arctic deserts – but in our days forgotten. We also aim to highlight contemporary women’s involvement in Arctic research, such as those aboard an icebreaker in Greenland or preserving Inuit culture and language in Alaska and Greenland.

metas.name: All's Fair in Love and Mahjong
metas.description: Ronni is living a full life as a school nurse and mom, hosting a longtime mahjong game with her best friends Shelley, Carly, and Melissa. But when her daughter leaves for college, everything shifts at once. Her hours get cut. Her ex is pushing to sell the home she loves. And suddenly she's staring down an empty nest wondering what comes next.

metas.name: One Last Detour
metas.description: After agreeing to drive him to a job interview, Dean reconnects with his old friend Travis.

metas.name: Love, Again
metas.description: Caroline and Henry's 30-year marriage faces upheaval when he's diagnosed with early-onset Alzheimer's. As Henry's memory deteriorates, Caroline finds comfort in friendship with Leo while coping with losing her partner.

metas.name: dawn
metas.description: Torn between the girl he loves and the future he’s always dreamed of, a boy must make the difficult decision of whether he should leave or stay.

metas.name: Dog with a Movie Camera
metas.description: A group of middle-aged men dressed as the Nazi high command gather in London to attempt a crucial experiment: making the first film entirely shot by a dog.

metas.name: In Her Care
metas.description: A poetic exploration of the Black healthcare industry through the personal history of Philadelphia nurse Patricia Curtis.

metas.name: A Form of Consciousness
metas.description: A young man struggling with uncertainty about his life finds himself on a surreal inner journey when a strange job interview blurs the line between reality and imagination

metas.name: The Good Assassin
metas.description: A naive contract killer becomes the roommate of his apathetic target, who he must find the strength to dispose of by the end of the week or face the wrath of the highest authorities of the criminal underworld.

metas.name: Touché
metas.description: A young British South Asian Sikh woman decides to turn her life around by entering the world of fencing.

metas.name: Mabuhay
metas.description: An artistically inclined college sophomore struggles to balance the traditional expectations of her Filipino mother with finding a fulfilling vocation. Along the way, an unexpected reunion with her estranged cousin allows her to test the boundaries of her burgeoning adulthood.

metas.name: The Male Experience
metas.description: Remy tries to hop on the game, but life gets in the way.

metas.name: The Giggle Minute: The Pilot
metas.description: The year is 2026, and the world has fallen into a dystopian hellscape. In this state of chaos, two geniuses, Professor Doctor and Doctor Professor, finally crack the code to time travel and go back to find ancient philosophers in the hope of saving the world together.

metas.name: My Blue Heaven
metas.description: "My Blue Heaven" follows a man living outside of Las Vegas, searching to escape life's monotony. Trapped in a cycle that he struggles to break out of, he inadvertently accepts his fate.

metas.name: In the Mood for Ghosting
metas.description: Adoration turns to delusion for Jonathan when Maggie suddenly stops responding, hurling him into pastiche and melancholy.

metas.name: The Secret Life of Fox Cubs
metas.description: What happens at a fox den when no one is watching? To authentically capture the first steps of young foxes outside their den, wildlife explorer David Cebulla spends days and weeks waiting for hours on end in his blind. This dedication provides an unusually deep insight into the life of a wild fox family.  However, while David becomes one with his surroundings in a ghillie suit, the project is constantly at risk of failing due to the unpredictable rhythm of nature. Diseases among the cubs and sudden changes in weather threaten the small family.

metas.name: Heartstone
metas.description: A grieving widow reflects on the last gift she received from her late husband.

metas.name: Surrender
metas.description: A police detective is getting ready for his last day before retirement, when a murderer hands himself in at the department, and tells the detective his son is buried in a secret location, but first, he has to delve into his own past and solve three murders, each time revealing clues to the next. Starring Josh Duhamel and Dylan Sprouse.

metas.name: Kings County
metas.description: After decoding a ritualistic clue found on a dead MMA fighter, a young, untamed detective infiltrates Brooklyn's underground fight world to unravel a string of murders.

metas.name: Moto Nineties: Rub Some Dirt on It
metas.description: Go behind the scenes of the wildest era in motocross

metas.name: subhuman
metas.description: A man orders food from a delivery app.

metas.name: Still Looking for Sitting Bull
metas.description: Ernie LaPointe, Native American of the Lakota tribe, Vietnam veteran, and great-grandson of the famous Chief Sitting Bull: this is the man I meet.  It all started with a strange vision from my mother. A road trip begins in South Dakota, where, between a Trumpist casino town and sacred sites of Native American spirituality, Ernie shares thoughts, memories, and values from his ancestors.

metas.name: The Trail (La Trace)
metas.description: A woman decides to go camping with her friend to help overcome her lingering anxiety. It only intensifies when she meets a passerby on the street.

metas.name: The Prankening 2
metas.description: One year after the tragic prank war Dave and Alex find that a new prankster with that same jacket has come to terrorize them once again

metas.name: Sentimental Value
metas.description: Dr. Rick Nelson, a victim of the Oklahoma City bombings, learns what it feels like to live in an alternate reality.

metas.name: Outcast
metas.description: A boy is jealous of another child's attention when he gets a cast for a broken bone

metas.name: 1 vs 1
metas.description: Suthershun after losing in the semi finals of a chess tournament in 2025 prepares to win the 2026 chess tournament. Will he persevere?

metas.name: Limelight
metas.description: Following an encounter with the Irish Mob, an Actor (Theo Creager) copes with his new life inside the Witness Protection Program.

metas.name: Swim for Me
metas.description: Seventeen-year-old Darcie believes she is responsible for the drowning of her younger sister, Stella. As she begins seeing visions of Stella that blur the line between memory and reality, she must confront the truth about what really happened, before her guilt consumes her.

metas.name: Turn Around
metas.description: The 45-minute performance moved through three phases. An opening of contained, whispered self-consciousness as students navigated the after-dark building. A middle section in which genuine exchanges and unplanned moments surfaced. A final integration in which the edit, score, cue delivery, and student presence arrived at something unrehearsed and unrepeatable.

metas.name: The Librarian Stops the Drug Problem
metas.description: A 90 year old Librarian and her intern must team up when they find out that someone has been stashing drugs in their library.

metas.name: everything i saw before i returned to your side
metas.description: A dying mind starts dreaming for the last time before their death. As the dream continues and the mind simultaneously decays, the dream starts to lose its shape.

metas.name: Knights of the Old Republic: Escape from Taris
metas.description: An engineer and war veteran must save a Jedi Knight from a blockaded world.

metas.name: Vampire Variety Hour
metas.description: Vampire Variety Hour presented by FirstName Watkins brings you a variety of exciting story segments that go exactly as planned.

metas.name: Flamingo's Cousin
metas.description: The artist's interpretation of a longtime institutional feud within the School of the Art Institute's film program.

metas.name: War on Science
metas.description: From the Laetrile craze to the COVID-19 infodemic, the film explores how decades of institutional deception and corporate greed birthed a fatal era of science denial and fringe conspiracies.

metas.name: Think of Me Once in Awhile
metas.description: After an serious argument with her best friend, Ellie Jones looks to wipe her memories of all the moments they had together, the good ones, bad ones.. but does joy even exist without sadness? This is an exploration of the human mind and emotions, exploring what makes the happy moments with our loved ones truly special.

metas.name: The Silence of the Inner Circle
metas.description: A troubled group commits a heist.

metas.name: First Day
metas.description: A student makes his way to his first lecture at university, but there might be another story hiding somewhere else.

metas.name: SUMMER TOUR '25
metas.description: A documentary about the EveryHeart tour, with a specific focus on the impact and heart behind our 2025 outreach.

metas.name: I'm so tired of being me
metas.description: It's hard to be the same person doing the same things over and over again every single day. Sometimes you need something to pull you out...

metas.name: England's Next Top Prince Consort
metas.description: England’s Next Top Prince Consort turns Elizabethan politics into a chaotic reality competition as Queen Elizabeth I momentarily abandons statecraft to evaluate a lineup of suitors—Philip II of Spain, the Duke of Anjou, Charles II of Austria, and the ever-intrusive Robert Dudley—under the dubious guidance of judges Walsingham, Cecil, Dudley, and a confused Shakespeare. Confessionals function as court intrigue, alliances form and implode, and a cryptic lady-in-waiting named Balthazar quietly tracks every secret. Assassination rumors, theatrical entrances, and relentless scheming pile up as each contender fights for the queen’s hand and the power attached to it.

metas.name: Bobby Rahal: True American Racer
metas.description: Fox Sports documentary celebrating the life, legacy and 1986 Indy 500 victory of the legendary driver and team owner, chronicling his journey from fighting for opportunities to becoming a three-time CART champion and influential IndyCar team co-founder.

metas.name: Inebriated
metas.description: One crazy party goes totally wrong when a masked killer is on the loose.

metas.name: Remarkably Bright Creatures
metas.description: Through unlikely bonds formed during night shifts at a local aquarium, Tova, an elderly widow, learns of a life-changing discovery that may bring her joy and wonder once again.

metas.name: Billie Eilish - Hit Me Hard and Soft: The Tour (Live in 3D)
metas.description: Captured during Billie Eilish's sold-out world tour, a concert experience from one of the most celebrated and successful artists of her generation, presented in immersive 3D.

metas.name: The Doghouse
metas.description: Brothers Steve and Stu scramble to put on a last-minute birthday show for Steve’s daughter - because if they fail, Steve’s in the doghouse and Stu might end up… dead.

metas.name: Lost Down Mexico Way
metas.description: In Thatcher's grim Black Country of 1986, Gary (AKA Adder) and five pals bolt for the Mexico World Cup, plunging into a riotous, beer-soaked adventure among England's misfit supporters. From stadium chaos sparked by Maradona's "Hand of God" to a wild, thousand-mile journey across Mexico and beyond, what begins as a reckless escape spirals into something far bigger - a legendary summer that rewires their lives and forges bonds that last a lifetime.

metas.name: Camp Salvation
metas.description: What happens when such blasphemous work is discovered at a Christian summer camp??

metas.name: Restoration
metas.description: Penelope undergoes an unconventional operation to improve her mental health. She will need to change how she sees herself and the world.

metas.name: The Unitrix Saga Movie
metas.description: Kyo and Ryzen's journey nears its end as they transcend time and space to stop Unitrix at all costs.

metas.name: Mr. Eclectic
metas.description: A performative male goes to a library to show off, but things don't go as planned...

metas.name: Shivering Echo
metas.description: Rencor, a young violinist, overcomes performance anxiety by journeying into the forest of her soul and reconnecting with the fragments of her Self.

metas.name: Orange Chicken Night
metas.description: With only three chances to accept an incoming job offer, student worker Jud Beckett is forced to juggle a tyrannical manager and the chaos of dinner rush when the call he's been waiting for arrives at the worst possible time.

metas.name: Cold Blade: The Movie
metas.description: Teenage boy Zain, who can transform into the superhero Cold Blade with the yell of a single word, has to fight his greatest battle yet against his arch nemesis Hot Shield.

metas.name: Ballpoint
metas.description: A short film where a normal ballpoint witnesses its owner, a middle schooler who's known to be smart and diligent, get carried away in life.

metas.name: Remission
metas.description: In the empty corridors of her abandoned Catholic school, a woman must confront the grief of a first love lost too soon, face the truth she has long avoided, and finally learn to forgive herself.

metas.name: The Art of the Duel
metas.description: A brief history of the practice of pistol duelling.

metas.name: Halcyon Days
metas.description: A troubled actor returns home to visit his ailing mother, only to discover his life has inexplicably turned into a sitcom.

metas.name: It’s Always sunny in CRC
metas.description: A 7 minute college project based on the tv show “It’s Always Sunny in Philadelphia”. can watch on youtube (pdubs28).

metas.name: Relevé
metas.description: In ballet, the term Relevé refers to the rising up of the body sur les demi-pointes (balls of feet) or sur les pointes (all the way raised en pointe/tips of toes) where the supporting legs are kept completely straight. The physical action of the rise broken down linguistically approaches re/lever- a sort of secondary coming or awakening of self in “re-rising” that we see as often facilitated by the use of art where all else feels lost or broken. An ode to our collective attachment to dance as well as art as it manifestes itself in various forms, Relevé depicts a surreal parallel of how art not only heals us through escapism, but is also the tangible thread that liberates us as we piece ourselves together again.

metas.name: Wrong Room, Right Woman
metas.description: Emma, late for a job interview, rushes into the wrong office and finds herself in a conversation she didn’t expect to have. Embarrassed by the misunderstanding, she tries to put the awkward encounter behind her — but life has other plans.  A low-key romantic drama about chance, timing, and how the wrong door can sometimes lead to exactly the right place.

metas.name: Arthouse Epiphany
metas.description: A young student works alongside his mentor figure and fellow team to steal a mesmerizing dove painting.

metas.name: Whisky Flake
metas.description: The trafficking of a fabled humanoid bird by seedy blokes through rivers, jungles and dark corners of society

metas.name: Stop Bath
metas.description: A reclusive photographer develops an obsession with a girl he meets over spring break, while an entity awakened through his photography develops an obsession with him.

metas.name: Perimeter
metas.description: Bound by the routine of his porch, Elias scans the tree line for a mysterious figure he's certain is closing in. As the nightly conversations with a lifelong friend grow more intense, his watchfulness turns into a desperate struggle to protect the only sanctuary he has left. A gripping exploration of isolation, where the greatest threat isn't the stranger in the yard, but the truth waiting in the silence.

metas.name: Jenny Tian - Supreme Mother
metas.description: In 'Supreme Mother', Jenny Tian unpacks leaving Australia, her time in the United Kingdom, and her journey to America — all under the watchful eye of her mother. Jenny's frozen her eggs, re-downloaded Hinge, and is ready for an adventure. Join her as she shares her stories of phone snatching, cultural oddities and finding herself.

metas.name: While I'm Away
metas.description: "While I'm Away" is a first-year student animated short.  This short is about the sense of not fully belonging to one place, and missing the other one when you are away. The guilt of moving abroad in the first place. Being the first generation to do this in your family. The constant self-reassurance that you aren’t doing anything wrong but still having no idea how to navigate all this. Re-birth. Alienation. Growth. Guilt. Renewal. Envy.

metas.name: LKDP Agituoja
metas.description: Lithuanian Christian Democrats, A. Stulginskis and L. Bistras, invite you to come and express your voice on May 13 at 6 p.m.!

metas.name: INERTIA
metas.description: A woman has an abortion right before her baby shower and tries to hide it from her husband.

metas.name: Never Fold: The 2025 Las Vegas Aces
metas.description: When everyone counted us out, the Aces continued to believe in themselves. From the lows of a 14-14 start and 53-point loss to the highs of 17 consecutive wins and finishing 4-0 in the Finals, now see a closer look at the journey of the Las Vegas Aces' third WNBA title in four years.

When her dancer friend Margot asks Iris to help her learn skills at Iris’s old gym, she reluctantly agrees, but old emotions begin to resurface.

metas.name: The Last Walk
metas.description: Two friends spend their last night in college together recounting memories and discussing what happens next.

metas.name: When The Sun Fell For The Moon
metas.description: Fred, in mourning, relives chronological memories of his life with his partner Kate.

metas.name: Open All Hours: Inside Out
metas.description: Retrospective celebrating the shop sitcom, including a new short scene starring David Jason. Also features Diane Morgan, Johnny Vegas, Tim Healy and Charlotte Barker.

metas.name: Take Me To Church
metas.description: Three failed criminals try to pull off their biggest robbery to date, the local church. But with no luck, nor skills, on their side, will they be able to pull off the ultimate feat?

metas.name: The Sky and the Snake
metas.description: A exercise in rhythm, color, and sound created by Nico Listi. Sound. Color. Digital.

metas.name: The Box
metas.description: Three friends find a mysterious box and debate whether or not to open it and the consequences that may come from its contents.

metas.name: ROACH!
metas.description: Married Couple Arthur and Tori are preparing for a house visit as part of their adoption application, but chaos ensues when Arthur sees their chances threatened by an unwelcome guest - a creepy, crawly COCKROACH!

metas.name: Romeo’s Got Leather
metas.description: Romeo’s Got Leather is a black comedy that follows Julia, a down on her luck fashion obsessed woman, who wants a leather jacket. But by the time she goes to buy it after receiving her paycheck, she finds it has been bought by someone else. This leads her to seek revenge against that who is responsible.

metas.name: The Dating App Nightmare
metas.description: Single mom Kate signs up for a dating app with her daughter Sarah, turning it into a fun bonding moment. But the fun ends fast when Sarah goes missing after a date with someone she met on the app. With little help, Kate launches her own search.

metas.name: Green Unpleasant Land
metas.description: It's a place for overgrown children, where frowns burgeon in soil that used to smile.

metas.name: Foreigean of the Irish Woods
metas.description: Foréigean of Irish Wood explores corporal punishment in 1970s Ireland through the recollections of six subjects. These subjects are made up of three students during the 70’s, one with a hearing loss, a parent, and a student who became a teacher when corporal punishment was outlawed in Ireland.

metas.name: SCF – The Premiere: Seafood Boil
metas.description: Two Serial Killers fall in love and have to become english teachers.

metas.name: The Waiting Room
metas.description: After twenty-two-year-old Drew visits Clearwater Psychiatric Services alone for the first time, the waiting room that he finds himself trapped inside slowly transforms into the madness he experiences within his own mind, and becomes a reflection of his own mental health.

metas.name: SALLE D’ATTENTE
metas.description: 5 strangers wake up in a worn-down meeting room with no memory of how they got there and not all of them are getting out.

metas.name: Ego Death
metas.description: An anxious college freshmen off an ungodly amount of magic mushrooms must sober up in only a few minutes while his equally inebriated friends try every goofy trick they can to help him.

metas.name: Lucky
metas.description: When a down-on-her-luck bartender has a run-in with her abusive ex-boyfriend, their violent encounter may just be the start of her luck turning around.

metas.name: Echoes of You
metas.description: As Sara goes through her closet, she finds a box filled with memories from her and her ex, Anthony. As she looks through the box, she begins to reminisce and relive these memories.

metas.name: Solemate
metas.description: When his date is late to their Picnic, a hopeless romantic does anything he can to fill the time and make their afternoon perfect.

metas.name: Bridlescreech
metas.description: In order to save humankind, two best friends must take matters into their own hands by performing a series of 'monster warding tasks' one of them read about online.

metas.name: Agitation
metas.description: Ellie spends a day in the darkroom, with all the trials and tribulations that come with it.

metas.name: SEEP
metas.description: A mysterious hole in Ashley's ceiling leads to a night of misfortune.

metas.name: Love is Awful
metas.description: A story testing the limits of love.

metas.name: Poor Little Rich Girl
metas.description: A documentary film crew follows indie darling "Edie" as she moves into her new apartment.

metas.name: I'M GOING TO BE LATE
metas.description: Jane thought she found love instead, she found herself.

metas.name: Tooth
metas.description: After a young woman loses a tooth and leaves it under her pillow, two rival tooth fairies secretly clash over the prize in her bedroom.

metas.name: Keep Off Rocks
metas.description: Paul goes to the families dormant vacation home to reconcile with the memories of the lost.

metas.name: The Interrogation
metas.description: An investigator slowly loses control of an interrogation while the suspect starts treating it as a therapy session.

metas.name: Perfect
metas.description: An aspiring model makes a deal for perfection, only to discover that beauty must be fed.

metas.name: Only Passion
metas.description: An 80's dancer breaks out of her shell on the dance floor making her dream a reality while practicing for her big performance.

metas.name: The Doctrine.
metas.description: Soon after getting cast as the lead of a surrealist production, Abhimanyu gets suspended in his last semester of university: throwing his career prospects, personal relationships and senseless film into jeopardy.

metas.name: Andromeda
metas.description: After her mothers funeral, Janie is visited by a teenage version of her mother, Alison, that same night.

metas.name: beautiful!
metas.description: A young woman attends a support group to reflect on her relationship with her late husband, Angel, and begin the healing process by exploring love and memory — seen through the eyes of her obsolete video camera.

metas.name: Waking Up From a Nap on a Long Day of Doing Nothing
metas.description: With the guidance of his best friend and mystical grandfather, a young painter – anxiously awaiting his first gallery show – embarks on a surreal skateboard odyssey through Portland to discover the true value of his art.

metas.name: Knotless
metas.description: When a Ghanaian-American woman relocates to Ghana in search of community and belonging, a friend’s wedding seems like the perfect opportunity to build connection, until a series of unsettling encounters forces her to confront the country’s unspoken beliefs and practices.

metas.name: Heartbreaks & Ocean Waves
metas.description: Heartbreaks & Ocean Waves is an experimental short film that follows a young woman in the aftermath of emotional loss as she journeys toward rediscovery. Through the symbolic interplay of hair plaiting, dance, and spiritual reflection, the film explores the tension and harmony between the head, heart, and spirit. With a distinctive three-frame visual style and sound design inspired by ocean tides, the film invites viewers into an intimate, sensory meditation on healing, womanhood, and becoming.

metas.name: Departing
metas.description: Three individuals enter a temple to summon the Yoruba Orishas through ritual, music, and dance. As colonial influence reshapes spiritual practice, these traditions begin to shift. Over time, the rituals are altered and Westernized, losing their original form. What once connected them to the divine begins to fade.

metas.name: Tasty Morsels
metas.description: A short film that poetically explores the sterile landscape of music consumption in the streaming era.

metas.name: Whispers in The Shadows
metas.description: After billionaire Annie Mercer was found dead in her apartment, it's up to hotshot rookie Henry Campbell to figure out who killed her within 24 hours. His suspects? A gardener, An ex-employee, A lawyer, and the victim's sister.

metas.name: Iron Maiden: Burning Passion
metas.description: IRON MAIDEN: BURNING AMBITION explores how Iron Maiden has helped shape a cultural movement, challenging conventional views of rock music and heavy metal’s broader impact on society and culture. Featuring interviews with the band and contributors such as Javier Bardem, Lars Ulrich, and Chuck D, this electrifying film offers an intimate look at their uncompromising vision and unwavering connection with their global army of fans.

metas.name: The Epic of Enkidu
metas.description: When the catastrophic King Gilgamesh meets the grass-fed Enkidu, things don't go according to the clay tablets.

metas.name: Iron Maiden: Burning Ambition
metas.description: With unprecedented access to the official archives and intimate recollections from the band, both current and past,  Iron Maiden: Burning Ambition invites fans to experience one of the most iconic journeys in music history.  Spanning five decades, this electrifying documentary charts the band’s rise from the pubs of East London to the world’s biggest stadiums. Featuring exclusive interviews with band members and contributors such as Javier Bardem, Lars Ulrich and Chuck D, as well as all-new animated sequences of the band's legendary mascot, Eddie, the film offers a rare and intimate look at Iron Maiden’s uncompromising vision and unwavering connection with their truly global army of fans.

metas.name: The Aperture
metas.description: Fragments

metas.name: Muskox
metas.description: Menace ventures deep into the heart of the Arctic-one of the planet's most extreme environments-to capture the timeless struggle of the musk oxen, rugged and majestic survivors of the Ice Age. Filmed over several years, the documentary follows the herd through the brutal rhythm of the seasons, revealing a world of endurance, fragility, and adaptation. Narrated by acclaimed British actress Daisy Head (The Gray House, Shadow and Bone, The Sandman), the film combines breathtaking imagery and an evocative score by Christian Heschl to explore the resilience of life at the top of the world. Directed by Chris Schmid, Menace is both a tribute and a warning-a cinematic reflection on strength, legacy, and the unseen forces shaping our planet's most remote wild places.

metas.name: voces transcendentes
metas.description: A micro-short documentary portrait about Transcend, an all-trans and non-binary choir

metas.name: Surviving Reality - Beyond The TV Dream
metas.description: Surviving Reality: Beyond the TV Dream reveals the untold struggles of fame through 2005 Big Brother winner Anthony Hutton. From sudden riches to battles with addiction and mental health, it charts his fall and inspiring rise again. With contributions from Pete Bennett, Jonny Regan, and directed by multi award-winning film director, Paul Suggitt, this is a raw, powerful look at fame's true cost.

metas.name: Memoria
metas.description: Memoria follows the story of Richard Howlett, an older man who lives in his secluded forest, separated from the rest of the bustling world. His lonely home is filled with the sounds of nature, the strong river currents, the leaves rustling in the wind, the birds singing in the morning, but the home has a vast emptiness despite the loud ambience. We see Richard reminisce on his old home, the way things were, how they used to be, as he takes his first steps in learning how to remember and respect the past, while learning how to embrace the future.

metas.name: Filial
metas.description: A daughter washes her aging father's back, conflicted on whether to continue caring for him.

metas.name: Birdcage
metas.description: A runaway bride makes one last effort to return to her past life.

metas.name: Lost Expectation
metas.description: "An abstract experimental film inspired by remembering a feeling of expectation that a new relationship would bloom into love." —Bruce Wood

metas.name: The Oceanarium
metas.description: A child gets lost exploring the wonders of the aquarium, and must find their way back to their mother with the help of the ocean animals.

metas.name: Die Mauer
metas.description: A video essay on the physical scars left in the city of Berlin in 2024.

metas.name: Possessive Intelligence
metas.description: While developing a villain for a new hit game, Charlie accidentally creates an Intelligent and Dangerous AI

metas.name: Barred From Entry
metas.description: Jamie, rejected from grad school at Juilliard, decides to open up a bar in his dorm room with his roommate, Wes.

metas.name: Pamanang Pamangan
metas.description: From home kitchens to bustling streets, Pamanang Pamangan explores the cooks who preserve Pampanga’s legendary flavors.

metas.name: Bente-Siyete
metas.description: A woman finds herself in purgatory. On her last day before sailing to Heaven, she questions the idea of love in a painless place.

metas.name: Oblivion: A Pigeon's Journey on the Birth of a Nation
metas.description: After Khemtid, a pigeon from the late 19th-Century Bangkok consumed a contaminated waste near Sanam Luang—a site shaped by overlapping histories of state power, ritual practice, and public life—time ceases to age him. For the next hundred years, Khemtid wanders the city beneath the shifting skies of Siam, bearing silent witness to the nation’s restless metamorphosis.

metas.name: The Backup Friend
metas.description: 2 tardy friends are in desperate need of money for Ubers, so when a wannabe gangster challenges them to a 3v3 basketball game, they have to find a third guy.

metas.name: Maya

metas.name: DollMail
metas.description: A paper doll moves through a house piecing together an image of her human through scattered belongings. Envelopes, dirty clothes, correspondence addressed to someone else. She pictures life: singing, touching, eating. Experiences outside her reach. She tries on choices like clothes, imitating a life she can touch but never inhabit.

metas.name: I'm still in the supermarket

metas.name: Skin of the City
metas.description: Following the female street art scene of London, Skin of the City is an unveiling of how a stereotypically masculine activity, such as graffiti and street art, is seen through the eyes of female artists.

metas.name: Firstborn

metas.name: The Chrysalis

metas.name: Heirloom

metas.name: Poetic Justice: The Art of Healing
metas.description: Poetic Justice: The Art of Healing is a documentary about the transformative power of creativity, voice, and human connection. Through poetry, art, and storytelling, the film explores how expression can help individuals process pain, reclaim their narratives, and move toward healing. At its heart, Poetic Justice is a powerful reminder that when people are given the space to be seen and heard, art can become more than expression. It can become a pathway to justice, resilience, and hope.

metas.name: My Body Feels with Me
metas.description: My Body Feels with Me is a fragmented crip contemplation that emerged from two months of workshops with six women in Hyderabad, India. Together they explored how childhood violence lives in the body: across caste, class, gender, and disability. Rejecting trauma as spectacle or damage, the film transforms personal memory into a collective visual archive. Shot on a mobile phone, shaped by crip time, it asks how cinema might witness pain with care.

metas.name: Tears of the Mountain

The film draws on the late Lithuanian anthropologist and archaeologist Marija Gimbutas’s research into Neolithic matrilineal, animist societies—a source of inspiration for artists, academics, and environmentalists associated with second-wave feminism.

metas.name: The Newspaper Gremlin of the Creek

Dorsey, who wrote one of gospel’s early hits while coping with his grief over the death of his wife and child. It explores the roots of gospel from southern spirituals during slavery, through gospel’s early years.

The "recipes" for these menus were created by activist students from the open-source community. Visionary Digital Minister Audrey Tang is spreading the concept internationally. At the heart of the film, however, are the creative cooks of the LGBTQI+ community and the emerging environmental movement.

metas.name: The Original Thought
metas.description: The Original Thought is a short film about two students, Vig and Logan, who are trying to make a film for a competition based on the theme Old vs. New.  Vig wants the movie to be good, but instead of trusting his own ideas, he keeps asking A.I. what to do. He uses it to choose locations, plan scenes, and make the film feel meaningful. Logan gets frustrated because the movie looks clean, but it does not feel real.  As they move through different locations, Vig starts to understand the problem. The A.I. gave him a plan, but it did not know why the locations mattered. He realizes that a good movie needs more than smart answers. It needs human thought, purpose, and meaning.  By the end, Vig turns away from the phone and chooses to rewrite the film himself. He realizes he can create something more honest than A.I. because the idea has to come from him.  The film shows that new tools like A.I. can help, but they cannot replace original human thinking.

It is the only place in Europe where a large number of whale sharks are sighted and in addition their migration is shrouded in mystery, no one knows where they come from, where they are going … and why they appear surrounded by thousands of tunas.  It also accompanies the scientific expeditions that for 11 years have tried to unveil the secrets of these giants and to know if their recent presence is linked to global warming and rising water temperatures around the Azores.

metas.description: Nigel foolishly goes out thinking he's going to get laid. He unfortunately ends up doing something way worse.

metas.name: The Auntie Sewing Squad Resistance Playbook
metas.description: A feature documentary about the Auntie Sewing Squad, a grassroots collective founded by performance artist Kristina Wong in March 2020 during the COVID-19 pandemic. As PPE shortages spread across the U.S., hundreds of volunteers—mostly BIPOC women, along with Uncles and non-binary members—turned their homes into sewing hubs producing cloth masks for vulnerable communities and essential workers. The group quickly grew from a few dozen activists into a nationwide network of more than 800 volunteers. Beyond providing masks, the collective used mutual aid to support historically marginalized communities and openly discuss feminism, anti-racism, allyship, and resistance to systemic inequality.

metas.name: SELF+TAPE
metas.description: Three actors audition for the same career-defining lead role in a major British romcom, all from the discomfort of their own homes.

metas.name: Slots of Life
metas.description: After life dealt her a bad hand, Carol spends her days in the last place she can find happiness: the video slots of her small-town pub. There's nothing more life can do for her, but that doesn't mean she can't do anything for herself.

metas.name: This is Not a Showcase
metas.description: This is Not a Showcase centers on the courtyard of the Union Center for the Arts, the home of Tuesday Night Cafe, the longest running grassroots Asian American run art series in the country. Contrasting meditations and reflections from the filmmaker and TNC’s staff with footage from the show’s 25th season, This is Not a Showcase takes us on a journey through time and space as we search for the meaning of community, home and belonging in Los Angeles.

metas.name: Hitler's Big Fear: The Trial Against Degenerate Art
metas.description: In 1937, the Nazi regime launched its war on modernity, branding artists like Picasso, Chagall, Van Gogh, and Matisse as “degenerate”. Their works were banned, destroyed, or mocked in grotesque exhibitions, while Aryan ideals were glorified in state-sponsored shows. Framed by a major new exhibition at the Musée Picasso in Paris, the documentary revisits this ideological assault through rare footage, suppressed artworks, and the voices of curators and survivors. It broadens its scope to music, literature, and architecture, exposing how the Reich targeted all forms of dissenting expression. A timely meditation on repression, resistance, and the enduring fight for creative freedom.

metas.name: What It Takes
metas.description: When Skylar’s brother, struggling with addiction, abruptly shows back up in her life, her peace becomes threatened. Trying to protect the life she built for Max becomes increasingly difficult as Chase’s dangerous ties pull them back into his inescapable chaos. Skylar’s past now forces her to make an impossible decision without blurring the lines of love and safety.

metas.name: Ocker Couture
metas.description: A Fashion Designer and his Photographer embark on a trek into the vast Australian Outback to shoot their latest high-brow clothing campaign.

metas.name: Change Of Plans
metas.description: Jenny does the same thing every day: have a shower, make some coffee, walk to the park, sit down at her usual bench, and drink half her coffee. This has worked out for her for years but when a mysterious gentleman keeps beating her and interrupting her schedule she decides to make it her mission to beat him to the bench . Its easier said than done.

metas.name: Kidnapped in Her Own Home: The Martha Carelli Story
metas.description: Follows Martha Carelli whose life is shattered when an escaped convict takes her hostage and forces her to drive his getaway car. She must outwit her increasingly volatile captor to survive.

metas.name: Illustrated Legacies: Graveyard of the Pacific
metas.description: In his first feature-length documentary, Tanner Zurkoski gathers stories from knowledge-keepers, Indigenous researchers and historians to document early encounters between explorers and the Nuu-chah-nulth nations.

metas.name: Manhunt
metas.description: Max is a young and very successful property developer who leads a perfect life but after meeting a property investor named Ernesto, certain events occur that make Max question who he is actually working for.

metas.name: Mysterious Bird
metas.description: Follows Grammy-winning guitarist Gabriela Quintero as she creates her debut solo album, charting a path beyond her global success with Rodrigo y Gabriela.

metas.name: Anxiety & Me
metas.description: When her humanized version of Anxiety invites her crush over behind her back, an introverted college student decides to trap her true emotions inside, causing chaos inside and outside her mind.

metas.name: Fletcher Street
metas.description: The joy and sense of freedom of North Philadelphia at risk youth as they ride horses majestically through the streets of their neighbourhood is as affirming as the trust, discipline and emotional resilience they build through their close bonds with the horses.

metas.name: TISM's Death To Art Live at Sidney Myer Music Bowl
metas.description: TISM performing at the Sidney Myer Music Bowl in Melbourne as part of the Death to Art tour, 9 November 2024.

metas.name: A Dish Best Served Hot
metas.description: A bullied everyman becomes that which he hates the most when his bully colleagues ruin his one special day.

metas.name: Shadow of Hope
metas.description: Far from home, a young Burmese man struggles to escape the weight of a brutal and unforgiving military coup, threatening both his nation’s freedom and its very survival. Now, in Australia and unable to return home, he’s doing everything he can to stay connected to his people.

metas.name: The Beast of Riber Castle
metas.description: Join aspiring Youtubers, John and 'Cameraman', as they investigate the local legend of 'The Beast of Riber Castle'... have the townsfolk of Matlock seen it?  Do they believe in its hypnotic powers?  And what's that coming over the hill, is it a... zombie?

metas.name: I Am With You Now
metas.description: In the aftermath of a devastating car accident, Alex Vandergraaf must cling to his memory in order to break free from his self-destructive behavior and accept the uncertain beauty of life.

metas.name: Reunion
metas.description: Three old friends reunite for a weekend of camping, drinking and reminiscing on old memories. Tensions rise and friendships are tested as old conflicts start to resurface.

metas.name: Made With Love
metas.description: Inside a top-secret government facility, Agent Boro, an intense and serious veteran, along with his partner Agent Maltrax, the dimwitted newbie, question and interrogate Talon Penndle, a disgruntled and laid-back coffee barista who wants to go home after his eight-hour shift. Talon is under fire, however, because he is rumored to have overheard a huge government secret from one of the other agents during their coffee break, which could mean mass panic if it were to get out to the masses.

metas.name: Proper Ladies
metas.description: Four very different schoolgirls are thrown together in detention. As they plan their escape, the situation spirals out of control.

metas.name: Tuesdays With Eloise
metas.description: When 17 year-old Eloise DuPont breaks up with Maxwell Finch, Maxwell spends numerous tuesdays trying to win her back.

metas.name: Sunday's Daughters
metas.description: In a rigid religious cult, two women in a secret relationship must navigate growing suspicion and control as their bond threatens th

metas.name: Rick Broadwater: P.I.
metas.description: Fresh-faced Private Eye Rick Broadwater takes on a new case but finds himself embroiled in the criminal element and book clubs!

metas.name: Hawick Pictorial 1966
metas.description: The 1966 Pictorial features footage of Teviotdale Harriers at Hawick Mair; the general election (candidates: Ian McIntyre (Conservatives), Colin Lindsay (Labour) and David Steel (Lib Dem)); Gerry Marsden and the Pacemakers at Hawick Town Hall with Carol and the Citizens; the Flying Scotsman at the railway station; Joogly Bridge old and new; the new road being constructed at Wilton Hill; old prefabs and new housing at Silverbuthall; St Mary’s Loch sailing club; a Landrover rally at Dodburn; the Common Riding (Cornet Carswell Imrie); the Army at Volunteer Park; Barnardo’s Pete at Balcary; the British Legion Flower Show; Demolition of Dickson Street; Hawick Theatre Group’s presentation of This Happy Breed; Christmas tree at Tower Knowe; a fancy dress party at the Town Hall; a snowy Christmas Day.

metas.name: Building A Murderer
metas.description: A woman has been disassembled. A man is behind bars. But was he born a killer, or MADE one?

metas.name: The Little Town That Could
metas.description: The Little Town That Could explores the story of how the tiny town of Goodwood, Ontario became the backdrop for Schitt’s Creek, one of the most beloved TV shows in Canadian television history.  Through interviews with residents, shop owners, and members of the production team, this short documentary captures how Goodwood has balanced the excitement and disruption of sudden fame. From tourists crowding the “Rose Apothecary” to businesses navigating unexpected attention, it’s a story of what is gained - and quietly lost - when a peaceful community becomes a stage for pop culture and nostalgia.

metas.name: Hyped UP Bunnies
metas.description: Three exotic dancers, Mercedes, Jaguar, and Alexis accidentally witness a violent gun showdown. Now, they're not just dancing for dollars, they're running for their lives. Leaving their old world in the dust, the trio hijacks a ride-share and ends up taking an unlikely hostage: Mark, a clean-cut youth pastor who just wanted to make a little extra cash. He's about to get a front-row seat to the wildest ride of his life. Hot on their heels is Ricky Roulette, a charming but ruthless hunter-for-hire working for the infamous underworld queen pin Kat Kitty. With each stop, the girls blur the line between survival and seduction, pulling jobs, dodging bullets, and leaving chaos in their glitter-dusted wake.

metas.name: Leaks in the Lines
metas.description: Leaks in the Lines is a hybrid film combining laser etching, phytograms, and 8mm footage of gardens to explore the tension between organic growth and imposed order. Reimagining the logic of Jacques Boyceau de la Baraudière’s authoritative 1638 garden design manual, Traité du jardinage, a new shifting visual system is created.

metas.name: I Bleed Maple Syrup
metas.description: A girl and her mother try to understand her strange blood disease.

metas.name: Kings of Kubb
metas.description: KINGS OF KUBB follows four elite competitors, each willing to risk everything for a shot at the U.S. National Kubb Championship, held in the Kubb Capital of North America (Eau Claire, WI). As the stakes rise on the pitch, real-world pressures beyond it reveal a powerful story of legacy, rivalry, and the fragile line between friendship and ambition. What does it cost to be the best?  And how high a price will one pay to be crowned the King of Kubb?

metas.name: The Narrow Land
metas.description: Jaiden van Bork examines both the mythology and reality of Cape Cod, Massachusetts, seeking to unravel the difficult questions that face the coastal community today as it confronts a barrage of overtourism and a subsequent housing crisis that has left locals scrambling to keep their feet planted in the sand. Weaving a personal chronicle of childhood on Cape Cod with the voices of local artists, fishermen, and hospitality workers, the film channels the eerie realities of small town America, posing new questions about identity and memory.

metas.name: Heat in the Barrio
metas.description: Maribel and Jorge’s walk to school is no easy feat, as a zoot-suit-wearing Pachuco is hot on their trail, leaving the children to question the future of their community in the climate he creates.

metas.name: The picture in the house
metas.description: On a storm-lashed rural road in 2006, a stranded traveler seeks shelter in an isolated house, only to discover that its soft-spoken owner preserves more than family history. And may not intend to let the past end.

metas.name: Fahim Anwar: Intrusive Thoughts
metas.description: Ya know, ya go on tour with some jokes for a while but then eventually ya gotta hang the painting and move on. This is that. INTRUSIVE THOUGHTS is my 4th standup special. I'd be flattered if you checked the other ones out too.

metas.name: Cash is King
metas.description: A pair of angry mobsters teach a lesson to a man who bought a pizza using his card.

metas.name: A Small Service
metas.description: A beautiful older woman sits by her sister’s hospice bed. When her sister makes a desperate request, she embarks on a late-night journey, in an unfamiliar neighbourhood, to fulfill it. An encounter with a handsome stranger brings surprising returns, and an unexpected ending.

metas.name: One Stone
metas.description: Dustin, a lunkheaded college student, curates an evening of letdowns and unmade promises all while battling himself and his people-pleasing behaviors.

metas.name: The Time Traveller’s Guide to Hamilton Gardens
metas.description: How did a city rubbish dump transform into a collection of gardens that is now a major visitor attraction?  The story of how Hamilton Gardens became a unique museum of humanity, showcasing gardens from ancient Egypt to the surreal future, is told on screen.

metas.name: Almost There
metas.description: When a long-awaited family celebration puts everything on the table, a guarded woman must confront her fear of disappointing those she loves-and stop hiding who she is.

metas.name: Detective Dean
metas.description: 19 years after the murder of his wife, Detective Dean must reconcile with his past in order to stop the re-emergence of a familiar threat.

metas.name: The Thrill
metas.description: Follows the night of a woman unsure of what is reality.

metas.name: Message from President Trump (Archived) March 10th, 2032. Uncut 720p version.
metas.description: Our President has some words of wisdom to drop on our little asses.

metas.name: Chasing Sub 2
metas.description: A shared dream. A common belief.  Chasing Sub 2 is the journey towards realizing the impossible: running the world's first sub-two-hour marathon. A decade-long pursuit sparked by Haile Gebrselassie at the 2008 Berlin Marathon, which became a reality at the 2026 London Marathon.  Kenyan marathoner, Sabastian Sawe, has won all four of the marathons he has competed in. Adding to his extensive list of accolades is the historic 1:59:30 finish, powered by the latest Adizero innovation: the Adizero Adios Pro Evo 3. The fastest and lightest Adizero super-shoe ever made, weighing less than 100 grams.  Humanity just got faster.

metas.name: Vote Gavin Lyle
metas.description: Gavin Lyle, a proud flag-waving and full English breakfast-eating Brit, seeks to help his country overcome its deep-rooted problems, problems he blames squarely on immigration.

metas.name: Dick Up My Sleeve
metas.description: Detective Dick Pounder investigates a group of missing boys, uncovering a  shadowy conspiracy of magic and misdirection.

metas.name: Rolling
metas.description: Daniel invites his friends over for their last campaign of D&D before they all respectevely go away for college, so everything must be perfect so that they can have their last fun moment before they leave.

metas.name: Vindication: Search and Rescue
metas.description: Two investigations collide, pulling Gary Travis's private investigation team into a web of digital deception and unexpected government attention.

metas.name: The First Shot
metas.description: A student director struggles to shoot the opening scene of her film.

metas.name: The Escape Plan
metas.description: While suffering through an abusive relationship with her boyfriend, Lena teams up with a co-worker to plan a way out.

metas.name: Change of Pace
metas.description: Change of Pace follows Jack, a young professional trapped in a monotonous daily routine where each morning unfolds in the exact same way, slowly draining his energy and sense of purpose. As the repetition takes its toll, his movements become dull and mechanical, reflecting the emotional weight of his lifestyle. Over time, however, small moments of awareness begin to surface, leading him to make subtle changes in his routine. These shifts gradually bring back a sense of intention and energy, hinting at a deeper transformation as Jack begins to realize he has the power to break free from the cycle that once defined his life.

metas.name: Cleaning Hour
metas.description: On a quiet day in a small Irish secondary school, one janitor decides that enough is finally enough.

metas.name: Human Doll
metas.description: A doctor and his two female patients prepare for the approach of a deadly fog that will end life and turn them into petrified dolls.

metas.name: The Ram
metas.description: A man is given a loyalty test from God involving his neglected daughter.

metas.name: The Thing, The Woods, And I
metas.description: The Thing, The Woods, And I is a comedy where a group of filmmaking students attempt to make a movie, but face errors, mistakes, and more due to the strong oddball personalities of those both behind and in front of the camera.
