metas.name: You Confuse Me
metas.description: A try-hard academic and an aloof jock are assigned to work together in college, and bump heads due to assumptions about one another, until one of them realizes that their assumptions about one another aren’t as true as they first thought.

metas.name: The Shadow of the Sun
metas.description: A father attempts to repair his relationship with his estranged son, but his criminal past catches up and threatens to tear them apart.

metas.name: The Return
metas.description: Rejected for not speaking Samoan, Lupesina confronts trauma and identity, discovers her death, reclaims tattooing, and returns home through ancestral power and self-recognition.

metas.name: Screaming yellow
metas.description: Adam is informed that he is dead and experiences his life in fractured pieces.

metas.name: Sunrise
metas.description: A woman desperate to get out of her current situation and to move on with her life stages the closure she knows she will never get in reality.

metas.name: Mudville
metas.description: Ray Patterson, a 47 year old unemployed dad, spends his days hitting baseballs at the community park in a desperate attempt to make it back onto the Atlanta Apaches, a major league baseball team he was signed to when he was younger. His struggles with drinking, which got him booted from the team in his early 20s, are still a daily problem. Ray is plagued with dreams of what he believes are Native American ghosts and supernatural forces that are attempting to bury him and his dreams in the dirt. When a metaphysical event threatens Ray's existence, his family watches hopelessly, while his wife, Holly, finds comfort in suburban witchery and the cosmic answers that the Tarot provides.

metas.name: Convenient Work: Episode II-Clown Therapy
metas.description: As Rick sends Matt to sell some more jewels, he finds himself becoming a sort of therapist for a depressed Officer Jones.

metas.name: Caronte
metas.description: The River Douro, in Porto, is the area of the Portuguese maritime territory where most suicides by precipitation occur. Gastão dedicates his life to rescuing these bodies, not trying to save them, instead giving them back to their families so they can have a closure.

metas.name: Dr. Bomb
metas.description: When an evil doctor plans to annihilate every library on the planet, 4 unlikely heroes are put together to stop him.

metas.name: Between Breath & Silence
metas.description: As his father's health rapidly declines, Tom returns home to face a family he has learned to keep at arm's length. Over the course of a single day, quiet moments, half heard conversations, and unspoken truths surface as Tom, his family, and the palliative care team navigate the fragile space between hope and acceptance. Struggling to communicate what matters most, Tom must confront the weight of what he has never said, and what time may no longer allow him to say. Set against the intimate backdrop of a working class family in Stoke-on-Trent, Between Breath and Silence explores love, loss, and the complexities of communication when words fall short.

metas.name: Black Dove
metas.description: When a man leading a double life is murdered during a secret affair, a troubled detective investigating the case must navigate lies, jealousy, and betrayal to uncover the woman who framed the perfect crime.

metas.name: At the Stage When
metas.description: A newly married couple living in a Chinese megalopolis navigates the tricky waters of the traditional expectations that quietly surface in their most intimate exchanges.

metas.name: The Delivery Line
metas.description: In all corners of the world, on the front lines of war, amidst climate catastrophes and on perilous migratory journeys, women are still giving birth. As fearless midwives risk everything to help mothers in dangerous circumstances, the gravity of their extraordinary and lifesaving work comes into sharp focus.

metas.name: Memories of a Turtle
metas.description: Young, narcissistic writer Noah falls head over heels for Carrie, an exuberant singer/songwriter. Proof of concept for a feature length film.

metas.name: Where Clouds Once Formed
metas.description: This film traces Arizona’s desert as it is reshaped into a hub for data centres and semiconductor manufacturing. Moving through altered waterways, the film exposes tensions between technoutopian visions and drought-stricken ecologies. Guided by offscreen voices and Tohono O’odham poet Ofelia Zepeda’s ‘Cloud Song’, ancestral knowledge counters the rise of industrial ‘cloud’ infrastructures.

metas.name: Deja Vu
metas.description: After discovering being trapped in a time loop, Carl has three more chances to make things right to break the loop or be blinked out of existence forever.

metas.name: The Story of Everything
metas.description: The Story of Everything is a cinematic exploration of the cosmos that reveals the hidden hand behind our universe. From the precise laws that govern the stars to the intricate patterns found in every living cell, the film traces evidence of intentional design throughout nature. Whether examining distant star-forming clouds or the spiral structure of DNA, we discover a consistent signature woven into the fabric of existence.

metas.name: Call Me When You Can: A Father's Day Story
metas.description: Work obsessed entrepreneur Roy Walker must rebuild his fractured relationship when his estranged daughter arrives at his secluded beach condo one Father's Day, forcing them both to confront past mistakes and rediscover what truly matters.

metas.name: COYOTE
metas.description: A late-night snack between two friends rapidly spirals into a high-risk heist, transforming their casual camaraderie into a tense partnership in crime.

metas.name: The Lovebirds
metas.description: Plot unknown

metas.name: The Choreography of a Friendship
metas.description: Plot unknown.

metas.name: Solutus
metas.description: A struggling private investigator reluctantly takes on a missing-person case for a wealthy young client, only to find himself drawn into a conspiracy far more terrifying than he ever imagined.

metas.name: The Candy World Movie
metas.description: In the magical Candy World, a powerful Fountain of Sweetness begins to corrupt after losing its friend and decides to destroy the world to create a new one. As chaos spreads across the candy land, a kind jelly named Baddy discovers the truth and tries to stop it. Instead of fighting, Baddy attempts to heal the Fountain’s pain and save Candy World before everything is erased.

metas.name: Harrison Prime
metas.description: After taking drastic measures to allow enough time and energy for all of his obligations, Harrison struggles to feel whole.

metas.name: Grown
metas.description: Best friends since middle school, Shawna, Sabrina, and Frankie are ready to celebrate senior year with their first real night out. But when their plan unravels in the chaos of New York City, buried secrets surface, and one revelation threatens to shatter their friendship for good.

metas.name: Riverkeeper
metas.description: Veteran riverkeeper, Dr. Jackie Echols, protects the environment and majority Black communities throughout the South River watershed in metro Atlanta. When the city begins construction on the largest police training facility in America (Cop City), she joins the growing resistance movement, revealing the hidden connection between corporate development, unchecked pollution, and environmental racism persistent throughout the region.

metas.name: Mga Bag-ong Anito
metas.description: In a city drowning in campaign posters and noise, a madman believes the coming election will bring the end of the world. He sees signs everywhere from rituals, strange dancers, and the blind excitement of the crowd. As people cheer for their leaders, he tries to warn them. No one listens. The election ends. Nothing changes. The poor stay poor. Was he wrong, orr was he the only one who saw the truth?

metas.name: Alien in the Heartland
metas.description: Amidst growing fears of an alien invasion with shapeshifting capabilities, a paranoid widower imprisons two sisters seeking refuge, convinced one is an extraterrestrial.

metas.name: Off the Air
metas.description: Two estranged sisters reunite to sell their late father’s radio station, but the past won’t let them  leave quietly.

metas.name: What We Carry
metas.description: After multiple miscarriages, a woman’s desperate wish for motherhood is granted—but in a way she never expected.

metas.name: Wolfram
metas.description: 1930s Australia, the colonial frontier: two swaggering outlaws roll into a mining town and unleash a wave of cruelty, leading three kids to break free from their white masters and set off across the 'sweet country' of central Australia in search of a safe home.

metas.name: AFTER ME
metas.description: A student who had a hobby - drawing, but one day he became disillusioned with it. Routine is all he has now, but then he meets his old acquaintance Boris, with whom he had some incident in the past. After a while he remembers that drawing was quite enjoyable.

metas.name: Your Good Name and Your Family
metas.description: Your Good Name and Your Family follows the true, awe-inspiring life story of George Kushner Jr as he navigates the challenges of life and the United States Army during World War II.

metas.name: What to Expect When You’re Expecting
metas.description: A catholic school student gets pregnant and her lies to cover it up spiral out of control.

metas.name: thank you i guess
metas.description: After a viral TikTok disaster ruins his career, Forrest desperately seeks redemption by scoring a suspicious indie film found on Craigslist. What follows is a dreamy story about a lonely boy, a cool girl, and the impossible feeling of wanting someone who never even noticed you.

metas.name: The Oyster
metas.description: A young woman spends some time at the beach. She finds a pearl, a fisherman, and a ghost.

metas.name: Fish Eye
metas.description: ​"Fish Eye" is a poignant psychological drama with surrealist undertones that explores the depths of grief, memory, and the paralyzing dread of mortality. The film follows Yahya, a young man trapped in a feedback loop of anxiety, living with his dementia-ridden mother. Bound by bizarre daily rituals and a haunting past, Yahya is forced to step into the terrifying expanse of the real world when his mother abruptly vanishes. Guided only by her recorded voice, he must confront the ghosts of his childhood to finally break the cycle of his stagnation

metas.name: The Package
metas.description: Frederick goes to have a drink at a bar when Wayne, who is seated next to him, leaves a package behind. Frederick, full of curiosity,  wants to find out the content inside the package.

metas.name: Water Cooler
metas.description: The Trump administration has turned immigration courts into deportation traps. As ICE agents wait to arrest their targets outside of courtrooms, their banal conversations clash with the severity of their actions. ​ This documentary short — filmed in New York's Federal Plaza from November 2025 through January 2026 — captures the virulent callousness of ICE agents detaining migrants who are trying to stay in the country legally.

metas.name: Chudpocalypse
metas.description: All is swell in Milan’s humble abode. The pants people are dancing, da Kirk, Stephen and Epstein are having a blast. When all of a sudden a foe appears… Who will survive, and what will be left of them?

metas.name: Pabulum
metas.description: Giselle must navigate through an endless liminal space in which she's physically and figuratively trapped.

metas.name: Still Form
metas.description: A model is being sculpted. Experiments in time and space.

metas.name: Bros vs. Job
metas.description: 'Job' decides to break the rules of a history assignment to expose a hidden truth, even if it means turning against his teammates who care only about their grades. Under intense pressure, he must prove that the 'truth' is worth more than a test score—before every bond they share is broken

metas.name: qwertyflick56
metas.description: 20 years since the beginning of the Qwertyflick series, the process of recreating his youthful humor begins to take a toll on its creator.

metas.name: St. Augustine's School For Redeemable Boys
metas.description: It's finals week at St. Augustine’s School for Redeemable Boys. Edward must do what he can to not fall behind academically.

metas.name: Stars and Stripes
metas.description: How many dawns, chill from his rippling rest /  The seagull’s wings shall dip and pivot him /  Shedding white rings of tumult, building high /  Over the chained bay waters Liberty—

metas.name: THRIFT
metas.description: Two amateur thieves break into a thrift store hoping to score big, but they instead come across a donated bag full of sinister secrets.

metas.name: Dogs and Dust
metas.description: As Edirne's city dump is cleared to make way for a new prison, the film observes the final days of the dogs who call it home.

metas.name: Peaches and Cream
metas.description: A man who’s dealing with loneliness and identity issues is taken hostage by two masked figures who attempt to brainwash him.

metas.name: Fault
metas.description: A college tennis star's life spirals out of control.

metas.name: Irish Goodbye
metas.description: KNEECAP ft. KAE TEMPEST - IRISH GOODBYE

metas.name: Twin Snakes
metas.description: Like two snakes chasing each other’s tails, time wriggles forward and backwards in Lev Kalman and Whitney Horn’s surrealist satire. In 2001, a pair of young investigators wander a mansion that is haunted by both its eastern relics and their western collector. Meanwhile, in the present day, they are watched by The Therapists, two Lululemon-clad researchers following metaphysical wellness rituals. A mysterious lo-fi kaleidoscope, with cameos by Condoleezza Rice, Shah Jahan, and Brendan Fraser.

metas.name: Archura Leaves the City Forever
metas.description: A lost forest spirit named Archura explores New York and tries to find a home while confronting an urban landscape that is rapidly taken over by luxury developments.

metas.name: A Bundle of Silences
metas.description: A Bundle of Silences is an experimental documentary that circles around the 1983 Águila Blanca heist, when the Puerto Rican pro-independence revolutionary group Los Macheteros expropriated $7 million from a Wells Fargo depot in Hartford, Connecticut. At its center are two figures who remain out of reach: Víctor Gerena, the Puerto Rican employee who carried out the robbery and vanished beyond the FBI’s grasp, and his mother, Gloria Gerena, a community organizer, social worker and advocate for bilingual education who passed away in 2022.

metas.name: SPIRIT
metas.description: A detective trys to uncover the secrets behind a mysterious death in a park, What he finds shocks him to his core

metas.name: IDIOTS
metas.description: An argument erupts between two hitmen after a refusal to admit to murder.

metas.name: Four Words for Memory
metas.description: A diary film: Montage mirroring disorganized recollections of seasons, places, and people, unified through movement. Created by Nico Listi. Silent. Color. Digital.

metas.name: PUTTHINATOR
metas.description: Willy P is a good guy with a good life. Too bad for him the PUTTHINATOR has him in his sights.

metas.name: CENSUS
metas.description: All citizens must provide complete and truthful information upon request. Legal guardians are responsible for submitting binding testimony regarding the conduct, associations, and ideological alignment of minors under their care. This information will be used to assess compliance with national regulations. Citizens are required to cooperate fully to ensure the continued security and order of the United States of America.

metas.name: Hollow
metas.description: A boy’s ordinary conversation in a park spirals into a haunting journey through love, trauma, and guilt as the ghost of his past resurfaces.

metas.name: Oblivious
metas.description: Part of a friend group falls into drugs, and they must pick their moves wisely, on how to tell the rest. Whilst a young girl starts to pick up on their activity, the very Pusher they promised full vigilance too becomes a threat, seeking to destroy the Oblivious crew.

metas.name: New Years Day | .556
metas.description: Travis Helders invites Ella Verneuil Capulet for a trip to the supermarket.

metas.name: Thoughts and Feelings. Full Game Walkthrough!
metas.description: A brand new video game from the same people who brought you depression in the 4th grade.

metas.name: Frontal Lobectomy
metas.description: A man gets his empathy surgically removed, in order to pursue a corporate career.

metas.name: Ethereal Torments
metas.description: In order to find balance between physical attractions, an obedient man stands before two deities.

metas.name: Made of Meat
metas.description: An ordinary man experiences the mental consequences that come with watching gore videos.

metas.name: The Customer Comes First
metas.description: A down on his luck salesman takes a job working in an adult bookstore with his slacker stepbrother.

metas.name: Under Exposed
metas.description: Follows the life of Lucy Parks, a college photographer that is desperate to find a way to expand her clientele. Her financial trauma, and desperation to take risks, ultimately change everything.

metas.name: Flowers Only Bloom in Winter
metas.description: When lost musician is hit with frightening news he must make his way through a psychological dreamscape where he must confront his deepest fears.

metas.name: Fractured
metas.description: On the night of his messy breakup, a drunk and heartbroken brother reconnects with his estranged sister, who becomes the comfort he didn't know he needed.

metas.name: Warak Areesh
metas.description: A cautious woman, hindered by a language barrier, struggles to connect with her grandmother but discovers a bond through food and tradition.

metas.name: Shelf Life
metas.description: After her breakup turns into a homicide, a strung-out young woman named Rookie escapes to a rundown motel with her accomplice Vee. There, they enlist the help of a mutual friend, Logan, an over-worked nurse, to help them in their escape plan. But convincing someone to help you get away with murder isn't as easy as it sounds. Tensions boil between the three best friends in their cramped motel room until Rookie finally gives in to her reality and tells Logan the truth of why she had to end her relationship with a hammer; her heart has stopped beating.

metas.name: The Bridge
metas.description: Owners, players, managers come and go, but the fans are forever.  The Bridge follows the fans of one of the world's most storied football clubs, Chelsea FC.

metas.name: I Don't Speak Italian
metas.description: After hastily moving to Rome for a job interview, a Duolingo-reliant woman must grapple with a hard truth when realizes she can't understand a word of Italian.

metas.name: Flat White
metas.description: Jealousy is best served with a Flat White

metas.name: Night Shift
metas.description: When two best friends are left in charge of an ice cream shop during the night shift, a young man threatens to rob the store, forcing the two women to neutralize the threat and maintain their relationship.
When recently paroled Ali gets a knock on his door, he enters a heated debate between his past and his future--he contemplates a decision that threatens to throw away all that he has worked for.

metas.name: A Peek
metas.description: When a curious teenager catches a glimpse through the open window of his mystifying new crush, he finds that his peeping has more consequences than he could’ve ever imagined.

metas.name: A Flower Falling Back Into the Earth
metas.description: This film emerged from footage originally captured for a feature documentary on enforced disappearances among Sri Lanka’s Tamil population—specifically, an interview with a mother whose son vanished in the war’s final stages.

metas.name: təm kʷaθ nan Namesake
metas.description: When the Tla'amin Nation requests a name change for the city of Powell River, B.C.—named for Israel Wood Powell, a key figure in the creation of the Indian residential school system—it ignites a heated debate about whose history is told and respected.

metas.name: Saving Ava
metas.description: A road trip comedy where six teenagers set out on a cross-country journey through the Midwest to find their missing friend. As the miles pass, old tensions from the turbulent transition between high school and college resurface. Somewhere in between growing up and settling down, a backdrop of summer crickets, endless blue skies, and open roads, they confront their memories and missteps that shaped their drifting friendships.

metas.name: Saigon Story: Two Shootings in the Forest Kingdom
metas.description: Which is more final, the gun or the camera? Armed with a powerful visual style, Oscar®-nominated filmmaker Kim Nguyen reveals the elusive connection between two families and one iconic photo: Saigon Execution. Part history, part mystery, Saigon Story confronts the family secrets left in the wake of the Vietnam War, exposing the resilience of survivors and the blurred legacy of wartime memory.

metas.name: A Life Reimagined: The George Masa Story
metas.description: In 1915 a young, charismatic Japanese man with a mysterious past entered into the Appalachian culture of Asheville, North Carolina, is suspicioned a spy, targeted by the Klan, but perseveres with a passion for photography and the mountains he adopts, bringing to life Great Smoky Mountains National Park & the Appalachian Trail.

metas.name: Lucio's Last Wave
metas.description: Author Stephen Thrower talks about how Lucio Fulci's film "Voices from Beyond" got made.

metas.name: EMPIRIC
metas.description: A series of poems; a reflection on life.

metas.name: Zvezda Padalica
metas.description: Documentary that briefly follows the story of the class IV-9 of Highschool of Electrical Engineering "Nikola Tesla" in Belgrade

metas.name: Vith
metas.description: Hari, recounts his past with a newfound friend and rediscovers his love for life.

metas.name: Go Dodo!
metas.description: A girl has an unexpected encounter with her favourite mascot at an amusement park.

metas.name: WIND DOWN.
metas.description: A college-going student goes through immense trauma, anxiety and fatigue and is trying to take a break. He begins a narration with him walking in places he finds his peace of mind in.

metas.name: Desire Paths
metas.description: A clown explores the urban and natural environments of a city.

metas.name: Brothers Broken
metas.description: Two brothers from the hit '60s rock band PEOPLE! had their careers and relationship torn apart by Scientology. Through a journey of healing, they reunite decades later to face their shared trauma to break free from the grip of indoctrination and rebuild their fractured family anew. With a blend of music nostalgia and cult manipulation, it sheds light on the enduring power of resilience.

metas.name: Back To The Lab
metas.description: Animated short, created using Pro create and Cinema 4D R14 and After Effects.

metas.name: What Happened to Lukas Hayes
metas.description: A police investigation separates a tight-nit friend group as they slowly see their lives fall apart and at the heart of that lies a question, what happened to their friend?

metas.name: Jonathan: The Tricycle Heist
metas.description: A store robbery that escalated into a police chase on tricycles.

metas.name: Franc Gardien
metas.description: A troubled man talks with his therapist about his loneliness and tells him about his encounter with his newest friend.

metas.name: THANK YOU FOR YOUR CO-OPERATION
metas.description: After the fall of Paris, Lionel and Nana return to Saigon as climate refugees with colonial habits. Trapped inside a private karaoke room purchased in the name of protection, Nana is forced to confront the fruit of a marriage system built on patriarchal shame—and awaken her way out.

metas.name: What It Takes
metas.description: Two different stories set on opposite coasts share more in common than meets the eye. The shared arc of their lives reveals the devastation that substance use disorder leaves in its wake, the power of a little grace, and how love can light the path to redemption.

metas.name: Shubham Pujari: Chhoti Soch
metas.description: Shubham Pujari's first standup comedy special, where I talk about my first ever relationship and the cultural shock that I faced when I moved to Delhi.

metas.name: No Phone Friday
metas.description: Events force best friends Mark and Lucas to have a day without using their phones, meaning no contact with Mark’s heavily pregnant wife Claire. But when Claire’s waters break, she cannot contact Mark and is rushed to hospital.  Meanwhile Mark falls at home, suffering a back injury. With phone service restored, they reconcile in hospital as two becomes three.

metas.name: Shrinkage: The Making of Innerspace
metas.description: A brand new hour-long documentary featuring newly filmed interviews on the making of the 1985 film, Innerspace.

metas.name: Get Him Back!
metas.description: After discovering a girl crying in the bathroom, a group of girls unite to plan revenge on her ex.

metas.name: A Writer's Block
metas.description: Struggling writer Sam works to overcome his self-doubt and write his next great work of art with the help of his roommate Clarisse and old mentor Mr. Lynch.

metas.name: Lacuna
metas.description: A man finds himself with an unknown neurological ailment.

metas.name: 'til we meet again
metas.description: a grumpy cook with a not so flavourful life meets a cat that bothers her every now and then.

metas.name: Have A Word: The Kilimanjaro Special
metas.description: The boys are in Tanzania, and Adam, Carl and Finn take on the biggest challenge of their lives: Mount Kilimanjaro - the tallest point in Africa. Dan and Harry, in the other hand, didn’t fancy it and have some other plans to soak in the culture…

metas.name: The Afterbirth
metas.description: An emotionally damaged father must deal with the Afterbirth.

metas.name: Maria Meets Charlie
metas.description: After the catastrophic events prior, when Maria finds Charlie in a park unscathed, she does something completely unheard of.

metas.name: Ice-Pocalypse
metas.description: A new moon caught in Earth's gravitational pull results in an Ice Age. Scientists and the military must destroy the second moon before it's too late.

metas.name: The Last Page
metas.description: A screenwriter divorces himself from the world to focus on his latest work.

metas.name: hey, nothing: One More Song
metas.description: In spring of 2025, a band called hey, nothing played a bunch of shows all around North America. During that time, a camera man by the name of Jake video recorded their mornings, afternoons, evenings, & late nights. After a year in the cutting room, thoroughly deleting countless hours of incriminating footage, they are finally ready to share their journey.

metas.name: Something's Askew in Zonine Valley!
metas.description: In 1957, Natasha Pritchard remotely monitors an alien-infested New Mexico town to get herself off of Death Row.

metas.name: Aonair
metas.description: A quiet state of being alone that feels calm and freeing.  This was a Uni project based around the theme of 'Individualism.'

metas.name: Echo Chamber
metas.description: Through a haze of ego, creative stagnation and a sneaking suspicion that his housemates might hate him, a young man tries to paint his own self-portrait. How do you think it'll turn out?

metas.name: Temporal Slice: Galactic Love
metas.description: Various alien races show and talk about how they experience and show love.

metas.name: Grey Box Test
metas.description: A man wakes up in a waiting room and is suddenly thrust into a series of tests, which he must figure out how to pass in order to escape.

metas.name: Out Of The Shell
metas.description: Upon a visit to her grandparent's house, Winnie discovers that their tortoise, Billy, has gone missing. She sets out on a journey to get Billy back, embodying her inner detective and meeting plenty of bizarre characters along the way.

metas.name: Come What May
metas.description: Come What May tells the full story of Ralphie May through the comics who stood beside him, the friends who knew him best, and the people who watched him burn bright at the center of comedy.

metas.name: Poterant etiam.
metas.description: A girl who is going to die anyway lets herself become mutually infatuated with the brightest boy- letting love and danger twist and slip into what was broken, and what might still be.

metas.name: headache!
metas.description: A man loses his marbles after an unfortunate altercation with a lamppost.

metas.name: The Road to Old Florida
metas.description: This film examines stewardship across four of Florida’s 47 National Historic Landmarks: Marjorie Kinnan Rawlings Historic State Park in Cross Creek, Bok Tower Gardens in Lake Wales, Fort Barrancas in Pensacola, and the Norman Film Studios in Jacksonville.  Each site operates under a different stewardship model and represents a distinct chapter in Florida’s cultural heritage. Together, they pose a central question in the field of historic preservation: what does it take to protect the places that define us, and what happens when that work goes unfinished?

metas.name: Don't Stop Smiling
metas.description: A circus clown grapples with burnout as his clowning partner attempts to help him.

metas.name: The Counselor
metas.description: A young, inexperienced, counselor tries to prevent a grief-stricken student from carrying out an act of violence after her best friend is shot to death.

metas.name: Run!
metas.description: Biru (9), a young boy, runs away from home after witnessing a violent argument between his parents triggered by financial strain. However, the path he takes transforms into a strange, surreal labyrinth. During his flight, Biru encounters "object-human" figures that represent the stages of his mother's grief.

metas.name: Unscripted Love
metas.description: After yet another disastrous date, a hopeless romantic tries to find love by reenacting famous movie  moments only to discover that the best love stories aren’t scripted.

metas.name: Cook Don't Clean
metas.description: The overdose of an acquaintance sends up-and-coming gangster Jimmy Ricci on a quest for vengeance.

metas.name: From the Beyond: High Strangeness in the Bennington Triangle
metas.description: Deep in the forests of Vermont, the Bennington Triangle has become a hotspot for the unexplainable-UFO sightings, Bigfoot encounters, eerie light anomalies, and a string of mysterious disappearances that defy logic. This chilling documentary blends dramatic, stylized recreations with gripping eyewitness interviews to unravel the dark and perplexing history of this enigmatic region. Could there be a connection between these strange phenomena, or is the Bennington Triangle simply a magnet for the unknown? Through expert analysis, firsthand accounts, and immersive storytelling, The Bennington Triangle dares to explore the truth hidden within the shadows of New England's most haunted wilderness.

metas.name: Feeling
metas.description: After the death of his son, a grieving father seeks out new technology that promises to rid him of his emotional pain.

metas.name: Systema
metas.description: Narrowly escaping a heist on Renn Cybernetics, Millie, a determined hacker, is the sole carrier of information exposing their shadowy and illegal activities. She crosses paths with David, a naive cop, forcing him to reckon with the broken and corrupt system he claims to love.

metas.name: Through The Vent
metas.description: In a corporate prison where workers repay debts through forced labor, a young pollen worker nearing freedom risks everything when his dying new cellmate offers at redemption and escape.

metas.name: That Half Barbaric Twang
metas.description: What do you get when you cross two of Australia’s most recognised television actors with a musical wizard? A troubadour trio of conscientious ‘vagabonds’, 160 years between them, who want to bring their ‘bad ass gospel’ country music to the most remote and marginalised people in Australia.  Through their larrikin humour and story telling, they are creating a new wave of excitement in Australia’s fringes, leaving behind smiles and some good ole feeling. Oh and quite a few hangovers. Along the way they meet some quintessential Australian characters, a window into the sunburnt country with its oddballs and strange country folk on the fringes of society.

metas.name: HIM+
metas.description: Chris is a young Black man whose life takes a drastic turn when he learns he is HIV positive. Struggling with fear, stigma, and uncertainty, Chris is forced to confront himself and the world around him in a new way. Through the support of his faith, friends, and mentor, he begins to discover strength and resilience he didn’t know he had.

metas.name: I Know Who My God Is
metas.description: A documentary that explores the role of faith within the LGBTQ+ community, delving into how belief, spirituality, and identity intersect in deeply personal and often complicated ways. For centuries, mainstream religious institutions have positioned themselves in opposition to LGBTQ+ lives, shaping a narrative of exclusion, judgment, and silence. To say that the treatment of LGBTQ+ individuals by many orthodox traditions has been “unkind” is to understate the pain, rejection, and loss countless people have endured in the name of faith.

metas.name: Cladosporium Coke Dial
metas.description: A psychedelic, polychromatic journey into the celestial and surreal.

metas.name: Searching for Drug Peace
metas.description: Amidst a deadly overdose crisis in Vancouver, a daring activist funds a non-profit drug testing centre by operating the illicit Coca Leaf Café and Medicinal Mushroom Dispensary, risking everything to provide life-saving harm reduction and advocate for drug reform.

metas.name: Concrete Turned to Sand
metas.description: Life in Cortes Island, B.C. as local oyster farmers ply their trade amidst a rapidly changing environment.

metas.name: After Me, The Flood
metas.description: Emerging from the forest, a group of nomadic merchants march to the bank of the river they must traverse. Carrying their cargo on their backs, they place their lives in the hands of the wind, as they cross the unpredictable water.

metas.name: ROLLING
metas.description: A young couple confront their landlord over rent, only to find themselves in over their heads when unexpected events spiral out of control.

metas.name: I Got A Bullet with Your Name on It!
metas.description: The very first mafia movie by James Balsamo

metas.name: Is God Is
metas.description: Two sisters embark on an epic quest for revenge, confronting a charged family history that pushes them to extraordinary lengths.

metas.name: Mortal Kombat II
metas.description: The fan favorite champions—now joined by Johnny Cage himself—are pitted against one another in the ultimate, no-holds barred, gory battle to defeat the dark rule of Shao Kahn that threatens the very existence of the Earthrealm and its defenders.

metas.name: Breathing Room
metas.description: In the heart of California’s Central Valley—the region that feeds the nation—a team of Mexican doctors fill gaps in the American healthcare system. Through patient after patient, they the impact of environmental hazards and inhumane immigration policies on their young patients and themselves.

metas.name: Too Close To Home - The Case Of Leroy Jones
metas.description: Prepare to plunge into a powerful and deeply personal true crime story with Too Close To Home The Leroy Jones Case. This gripping documentary follows filmmaker Meosha Bean as she reopens the shocking murder of her own grandfather Leroy Jones a case long shrouded in mystery and silence. What unfolds is more than a cold case investigation it is a journey through family truth and justice as Bean confronts buried secrets reexamines overlooked evidence and challenges the very system meant to protect her loved ones. The official trailer sets a haunting emotional tone that draws you into a narrative that is truly too close to home where the past and present collide in the pursuit of answers that refuse to stay hidden.

metas.name: PEN PALS
metas.description: Two star-crossed cat pens fall in love... and, well, you know the rest.

metas.name: Gaslit: The Truth About CO2 Gas Chambers in the UK
metas.description: A look at practices in the UK chicken and pig farming industry.

metas.name: Gun Barrel Grey
metas.description: A man posing as a courier gains access to an illegal gambling game with a fake delivery. Wielding a gun hidden inside a small teddy bear.

metas.name: Cayendo
metas.description: Exploring the roles we perform to protect ourselves, short dance film Cayendo observes the complexities of group dynamics, with human connection as a bridge between risk and repair. The film centers the group as both a mirror and a judge, and the interplay of giving the illusion of strength against the fear of being truly seen.

metas.name: MISCAST26
metas.description: A one-night-only musical spectacular featuring Broadway’s hottest stars performing songs from roles in which they would not traditionally be cast—and the results are thrilling!

metas.name: A Heart to Heart
metas.description: An aloof cardiologist and a spirited artist accidentally get their folders swapped at a bus stop and both deal with the unexpectedly positive repercussions of having each other's stuff.

metas.name: Criminal Audit
metas.description: Checked up detective Marshal Clein tries to reason with multiple suspects who were involved in a recent bank robbery.

metas.name: Noon
metas.description: A Tenet-inspired fan film

metas.name: yes
metas.description: The Devil in a Sundress is a sharp, seductive thriller about the most dangerous lie, the one that looks like love. Because evil doesn't announce itself with horns and fire. It shows up soft-spoken, sun-kissed, and completely convincing.

metas.name: Cherry on the Cake
metas.description: Embark on the Kamak ship, bound for Greenland and its pristine cliffs, following our favorite Belgians: Sean Villanueva O’Driscoll, Nicolas Favresse, Jean-Louis Wertz, and their newest Swedish recruit  Aleksej Jaruta. After 2 weeks of sailing between storms and icebergs, the quartet sets up their base camp at the foot of the Mythic Cirque, a unique spot surrounded by rocky towers rising from the sea. Their goal: establish dream lines on these untouched summits, armed with their musical instruments. An ode to adventure and friendship!

metas.name: You Jump, I Jump
metas.description: Margot navigates high school with her tightly wound best friend Lyla, but her growing connection with Tate threatens to upend everything. Over one reckless night of dares and confessions, her attempts to keep the peace unravel, forcing the group to face truths they can’t ignore.

metas.name: Why I Fly
metas.description: With a nod to E.T. and Peter Pan, JB Chandelier offers an intimate and moving film, a true visual ode to freedom. Renowned for his impressive proximity flights, the paraglider reveals, through a highly poetic style, the sensations he experiences while flying. But above all, he reflects on the wounds that have shaped his life choices. An invitation to listen to our inner voice, the one that pushes us to achieve our dreams and live our lives to the fullest!

metas.name: Tell Your Face
metas.description: Haunted by her late mother's praise of her smooth skin, Chikana hits 30 and concocts an absurd way to stop her wrinkles in their tracks.

metas.name: Re-Contextualised Atmosphere
metas.description: An experimental short film created for Year 12 VCE Media, exploring how different editing styles can accentuate vastly different atmospheres, even when using the same footage.

metas.name: Silver City
metas.description: Residents of Silver City are instructed to stay indoors due to what the authorities call “environmental irregularities”, but when a young woman’s cat escapes out the door, she wanders the city in search of him, and discovers what else is out there.  Made with frame-by-frame mixed media animation and handmade cardboard miniature buildings.

metas.name: Frescoes
metas.description: When returning to a childhood home, traditions reveal themselves like a cyclical nightmare.

metas.name: Graveyard Rose
metas.description: A slightly off-putting girl who spends her days in the cemetery enters a relationship with a soccer player after realizing there not so different.

metas.name: Eloise's Decision
metas.description: After being threatened with a gun by Maria, Eloise has to choose between her and Charlie once and for all...

metas.name: I Can't Write
metas.description: A man struggles to write.

metas.name: Cupid's Intern
metas.description: A love struck young mans life changes dramatically when he hires Cupid to help with a new love, but  when Cupid's intern, Agape shows up instead, the easy assignment turns to a struggle for love..

metas.name: The How and Why of Killing Your Boyfriend
metas.description: Reserved college student Twyla is goaded by her eccentric professor into killing her infidelitous boyfriend.

metas.name: Bless You
metas.description: A young man's love life is disrupted by his unwelcome ability to teleport every time that he sneezes.

metas.name: Four Minute Warning
metas.description: When a nuclear bomb threatens to end Jesse's life, he chooses to do what he does best when faced with threats: nothing.

metas.name: Blade Coal: Mystery of the Missing Mailman
metas.description: Blade Coal is the world’s best detective, ninja, super spy, and secret agent. He can infiltrate any organization, solve any crime, and has saved the word more times than he can count. Whether it’s uncovering government secrets or rescuing princesses, he gets the job done. The downside however, there’s rarely a global threat that calls for Blade Coal. In the downtime, his life can get agonizingly boring. However, breaking through this boredom is a conspiracy so evil and nefarious, it might call the world’s best action hero back to action…

metas.name: Roommate Required
metas.description: Two roommates navigate conflicts and an unexpected twist.

metas.name: All Roads Lead to Kyusi
metas.description: A group of friends nearing graduation decides to spend their final days of Senior High School on a road trip, where it all began. Along the way, they face unexpected experiences and realizations that lead them to confront the truths about themselves and their friendship.

metas.name: This Mime Thing isn’t a phase, Mom
metas.description: A student with a passion for miming falls in love with a classmate who is not all she seems.

metas.name: A Peel’s Court
metas.description: Two lawyers plead their cases in a trial that is not what it seems to be.

metas.name: Our Favourite Things
metas.description: A short reflective documentary on sustainability and the effect we have on the beautiful animals around us.

metas.name: Melting in the Streets the Legacy of Street Trash
metas.description: A look at the making of and legacy the ultimate B movie melt film had on the indie film industry. Includes several interview with crew, film critics and academics.

metas.name: Figaro Up, Figaro Down
metas.description: Tim Blevins trained at Juilliard, enthralling opera fans with his baritone before losing it all to addiction and landing on the streets of San Francisco. But then he pulled off a stunning comeback.

metas.name: The How We Look Project
metas.description: The How We Look Project is a collection of three short narrative films about dwarf culture and identity, created and performed by Little People (LPs). Each film centers one act of image-making, from renaissance portraiture, to sideshow photography, to medical imaging. APPOINTMENT: three LPs named Avery visit a doctor who is more fascinated with his own medical technology than the patients before him. CARNIVAL: Jessica and her “ Midget troupe” pose for a 1924 souvenir postcard. But this moment of commodification also offers Jessica rare hope to reach her disappeared lover and the outside world. COURT: While Fabio, a Court Dwarf in 1572 Italy endures the uncomfortable act of being painted, he wonders if this image can be a means of communicating with future dwarfs.

metas.name: This Above All: The Theatrical Life of Antoni Cimolino
metas.description: As his final season approaches, the longest serving Artistic Director of the iconic Stratford Festival, Antoni Cimolino, prepares for his exit while reflecting on the 40 years he's devoted to the theatrical repertory company.

metas.name: Myspace
metas.description: What is the legacy of Myspace? Pulling at the heartstrings of millennials and curious newcomers alike, this nostalgic portrait traces how this pioneering social networking platform shaped the digital world we now inhabit, from online fame to social media overload.

metas.name: Only the Dead Know Brooklyn
metas.description: An adaptation of Thomas Wolfe's timeless 1935 short story where a man tries to direct a drunk to his train

metas.name: The Visionary
metas.description: An idiosyncratic pizza delivery guy begins receiving visions of murders in his city, and resolves to stop the killer before they can strike again.

metas.name: The Queen Swing
metas.description: The Queen Swing follows climbers Laura Pineau and Kate Kelleghan as they chase history on Yosemite’s granite walls, attempting to become the first women to complete the legendary Triple Crown: linking El Capitan, Half Dome, and Mount Watkins in a single 24-hour push. But this isn’t just a story about summits and speed records. It’s about what happens between two people when the only thing keeping you alive is the person on the other end of the rope. Through extreme conditions and risky terrain, the film reveals how trust gets built in increments through shared confidence, quiet encouragement, and the kind of vulnerability that only emerges when you’re too exhausted to pretend. The Crown is the goal, but the partnership is the heart of the climb.

metas.name: Live At The Void
metas.description: Live At The Void captures the DIY nature of the local music scene, with full sets filmed at a Mount Roskill flat during a 21st birthday bash. Featuring Neither Do I, Park Flyers, CCTV, and 花溪 Flowerstream, this concert film is a modern snapshot of the Tāmaki Makaurau/Auckland City indie scene. It blends performance with on-screen commentary from film-makers Corey Fuimaono and Liam Hansen.

metas.name: Kenny Loggins: Conviction of the Heart
metas.description: Everybody cut footloose! From chart-topping anthems to movie soundtracks, multi-award-winning singer songwriter Kenny Loggins reflects on a career that defined a generation, tracing his life on and off stage across decades of reinvention.

metas.name: Hungry
metas.description: A man feeds a dragon as its appetite grows.

metas.name: Spaced Out
metas.description: In the far reaches of space, a desperate defense of a single colony rests in the hands of ONE ship... the U.S.S. DeWALTER...

metas.name: Hazama
metas.description: A young woman in Japan returns to her homeland in the remote woods of Sweden after a traumatic event. There, a life-threatening winter accident puts her in hazama — the Japanese concept of the in-between space — forcing her to confront the ultimate choice between life and death.

metas.name: Don't Letter Go!
metas.description: A girl's breakup letter to her girlfriend gets stolen, the ensuing chase leads her to realize her true feelings.

metas.name: DAYLIGHT
metas.description: Alone at home during a seemingly ordinary morning, a young man is haunted by a mysterious doppelgänger ghost, proving that terror does not need darkness to exist.

metas.name: Shelf Life
metas.description: At Sturnley’s Supamart, a faded family grocery store, awkward checkout clerk Nora dreams of singing the store jingle. But when a customer mistakes small talk for life-changing wisdom, Nora is thrust into the spotlight as the store’s new mascot. Overnight, she is elevated from trainee to the face of the Sturnley empire, caught between her power-hungry father, her jealous brother, and the zealous locals. As Nora’s influence spirals into absurdity, she must decide whether to stick to the script or use her own voice.

metas.name: How To Move
metas.description: How To Move is an Australian drama short film that deals with concepts of individualism, community, class, expression, and change. The story follows a man named Jesse over the course of a day as he struggles with the plan to leave his hometown that night.

metas.name: Running Wild: Return to the River
metas.description: Pacific salmon swim upstream on their homeward journey, bearing witness to the interconnected web of life linking land and sea.

metas.name: When We Walk
metas.description: Take a ground-level view of 2024's Hīkoi mō Te Tiriti, one of the largest movements of people in Aotearoa’s recent history; reflecting on identity, unity, and the enduring significance of Te Tiriti o Waitangi for Māori today.

metas.name: Camping After Fort Dark
metas.description: group of teenagars goes camping and finds a body not long after they go viral and regain sucession

metas.name: Mr Crowe
metas.description: When the Evil Plubberman threatens to defecate all over Aura City, one crow must rise up to defeat him.

metas.name: Under My Skin
metas.description: Two girls fall in love, with conflicting views on their relationship, they tear themselves apart over it.

metas.name: ENCORE
metas.description: A story about the most powerful thing in the world: love.

metas.name: Dreams in Translation
metas.description: When a grieving Nigerian immigrant's emotional collapse is misread as misconduct, a single workplace incident sets off a descent, drawing her closer to memories of abuse, betrayal, and a silence that refuses to stay buried.

metas.name: Anklets
metas.description: A young man struggling with his identity finds his true self through a celestial Nymph

metas.name: Oh God!
metas.description: When a young Catholic girl, Grace, develops a crush on her friend, Faith, she must decide if it’s better to confess or conceal.

metas.name: Cycling Alaska
metas.description: "wanna go to Alaska?" - "ok" That's how this whole adventure started.  Where it got us, is a totally different story.  Rain, Camping on the side of the road or under the pipeline, walking trough the tundra, cycling for days and days with no other people then each other, eating pasta with sardines for 2 months, going trough rollercoasters of emotions, and sharing those with a person you barely know, that was Alaska for us.

metas.name: Small Town Girl
metas.description: In a small Midwestern town in 1973, the disappearance of a 14-year-old girl unravels buried secrets. An unexpected twist shocks the community years later.

metas.name: A Decade in the Grey
metas.description: A Decade in the Grey chronicles ten years of Grey Box Collective's bold, multidisciplinary artistry, highlighting their Trauma-Informed Creative Practices and the transformative power of creating during messy, ambiguous, uncertain, and overwhelming times.

metas.name: Our Comiket's History: 50 Years of Love
metas.description: First held in 1975, Comiket has long shaped Japan's creative culture from manga and anime to games and cosplay. The committee, exhibitors, volunteers, fans, and cosplayers share their devotion to it.

metas.name: Jack Tucker: Comedy Standup Hour
metas.description: Jack Tucker Comedy Standup Hour is the world’s FIRST comedy special featuring New York comedian Jack Tucker.

metas.name: Kz The Movie Director's Cut
metas.description: a Movie About Friends Like Brothers

metas.name: Mystery Wrestling #25
metas.description: Mystery Wrestling #25 also known as Mystery Wrestling Three Year Anniversary took place on April, 26, 2026 at Centre Aydelu in Gatineau, QC

metas.name: Perfect Victim
metas.description: At a casting where she's told to "just be herself", a girl faces endless demands to change until she loses herself completely.

metas.name: My Mother's Belly
metas.description: A young woman attempts to cook a family recipe by memory. This means remembering a difficult revelation with her mother.

metas.name: The Great Heist of Starkville Derby
metas.description: At the 2026 Starkville Derby, Parker and Jacob devise a plan to make it big.

metas.name: Princes of Claiborne
metas.description: Two brothers try to raise money with a lemonade stand.

metas.name: Fallen From Grace
metas.description: When Sara gets assigned as a guardian angel to a lonely human girl named Evelynn, she begins to notice a similar loneliness from when she has worked in Heaven for the past eternity

metas.name: McGhee Mysteries
metas.description: Sonya struggles to find her voice for her writing when a strange turn of events puts her face to face with her fictional muse.

metas.name: I'll Come Home
metas.description: An 18 year old George is forced to decide if love is worth risking the draft in the midst of the Second World War. Should he commit to the woman he loves or preserve his safety?

metas.name: Rounds
metas.description: Andrew is an RA who spends most of his nights alone. Tonight is no different, until he witnesses one of his residents doing something he’s not supposed to.

metas.name: The Journey of Weather-Exposed Bones
metas.description: Gilsenan’s latest work is a non-narrative film, inspired by a new translation of the seminal Japanese poet Matsuo Bashō by the Irish translator, poet and scholar Andrew Fitzsimons.  It is – in equal parts – a journey through contemporary Japan, a cinematic act of psycho-geography, a meditation on the devastating impact of climate change and a profound reflection on the meaning of ‘home’ in today’s uneasy global world.

metas.name: Keep The Change
metas.description: June's struggle to pay rent causes a strain on her relationships.

metas.name: You'll Always Be Mine
metas.description: Caleb and Eve plan their future.

metas.name: The Moonlight Murders
metas.description: An investigative reporter gets an exclusive interview with a key witness to the latest in a series of serial killings. Little does she know, her new interview suspect harbors a dangerous obsession.

metas.name: Carving Lines
metas.description: Carving Lines is a visual diary of a printmaker depicting a popular ski touring zone through her art medium of print making.

metas.name: Happy Today
metas.description: An album-length concert film by Charlie Weinmann, capturing the August 2025 Lodge Room performance that became Jeff Parker's new ETA IVtet album "Happy Today". Weinmann’s noirish capture offers a rare opportunity to see the elusive ETA IVtet in action.

metas.name: An Evening with Nicole Scherzinger: Live at Royal Albert Hall
metas.description: Step into an unforgettable night at London’s legendary Royal Albert Hall with Tony-Award Winner Nicole Scherzinger. In this spectacular experience, Nicole takes center stage for a dazzling, career-defining performance that showcases her full artistic range. From the elegance of Sunset Blvd. to the energy of The Pussycat Dolls greatest hits, this event captures every moment of her electrifying live show. With breathtaking vocals, dramatic staging, and unforgettable moments, Nicole transforms this historic venue into a global stage. This is Nicole Scherzinger like you’ve never seen her before.  A Veeps Studio Production in association with Crashburn. Directed by Ryan Mackfall.

metas.name: Addicted to It
metas.description: Dace attempts the impossible: a peaceful walk without his phone. But his device, Phoney Bunny, springs to life and chases him like a clingy ex. As he recruits fellow screen junkies, one question remains: can you live without your phone?

metas.name: Ichi-Bons A Go-Go
metas.description: Ichi-Bons a Go-Go is a documentary about Toronto Garage Rockabillies The Ichi-Bons and their Japanese tours. It is the first time since Covid that Hideki (Bass) and Mamoru (Guitar/Vocals) have been back to their home country of Japan. We hear of the significance of the tour and the influence it had on all 3 members of the band. A Rock n Roll story about returning home.

metas.name: farewell, the metal workers (ghosts▼↑hell’s gate)
metas.description: A restless spirit in an abandoned building is disturbed.

metas.name: Crossroads!
metas.description: When you’ve waited your whole life to start your life, where do you actually begin? After graduating college, Jensen finds himself paralyzed before the void of the future, waiting for the next step.

metas.name: High Street Hangover
metas.description: After a night out drinking, Marnie wakes up with the worst hangover and someone knocking at her door. It's her ex, Leeza, who thinks she needs some help. Marnie tries to cure her hangover with food, more drinking, and smoking weed. The people around her try to help, but Marnie needs to help herself first.

metas.name: Let's Kiss and Find Out
metas.description: Prom becomes an unexpected night to remember when two unlikely friends kiss to find out if they're gay.

metas.name: Latin Lover
metas.description: In 1968, a smooth-talking hustler, Paul Ferguson, details the fateful night he and his younger brother murdered closeted silent film star, Ramon Novarro.

metas.name: Game Over
metas.description: When Cleo and Jade’s date turns sour, they’re left questioning; ‘is the problem the male gaze or the way they’ve been conditioned to react?’ Game Over looks at how it feels to be a lesbian couple constantly sexualised and threatened by men.

metas.name: Red Delicious
metas.description: Tune in to this week's episode of "Red Delicious" to learn how to bake a tasty treat... with a sinister surprise!

metas.name: Action Monster Big Movie
metas.description: Following a decline in the amount of monster movies created, Meng Qi, a director who is obsessed with the monster movie genre, becomes unsure about his persistence—he never expected that one day an actual monster would appear in front of him! In order to fulfill his dream, Meng Qi decides to cooperate with the demon girl Liya and help her shoot a demon themed movie. However, as the shooting progresses, Meng Qi discovers that things in the other world are closely related to him...  (Source: Bilibili, translated)

metas.name: How I Felt When I Lost You
metas.description: After ending a relationship, Maeve’s faces the emotional aftermath of it to start to heal

metas.name: In Tyee Country
metas.description: A century-old fishing club on Canada's west coast faces an existential crisis as salmon populations dwindle and members wrestle with their legacy, realizing that their biggest catches might be a thing of the past.

metas.name: Code of Misconduct
metas.description: An investigative journalist’s duty to follow the facts leads to the trial of five Canadian professional hockey players charged with sexual assault, unravelling our national pastime and questioning the institutions that hold the sport accountable.

metas.name: Meeting Your Maker
metas.description: A feel-good movie about a puppet that kills himself.  Meeting Your Maker is a darkly whimsical and deeply emotional short film that follows Otis, a beloved puppet on a long-running children’s show, as he faces an existential crisis just before the series’ milestone 300th episode.  Set against the vibrant chaos of a TV studio and the surreal backdrop of a puppeteer’s inner world, the story explores themes of identity, burnout, and the creative struggle, blurring the line between performer and creator in (hopefully) poignant and unexpectedly funny ways.

metas.name: Horny For Justice IV
metas.description: They say never meet your heroes, how about never meet your friends heroes! An action hero from an old movie takes vengeance on punk teens.

metas.name: 500 Seconds to Tell You
metas.description: Before a global catastrophe ends life on Earth a young man struggles to tell his best friend how he feels about her.

metas.name: Last Night in Sorrento
metas.description: Jack and Olivia marry and move from London to Sorrento, Italy, the couple’s new life begins to unravel as tensions lead to addictions and temptations. Family secrets are revealed, and the couple must accept that their lives will never be the same.

metas.name: Hard Redemption
metas.description: Korean American teenager Bryan wants out of his ruthless gang, the Goblins, setting the stage for gang retribution. On his first day of GED summer school for at-risk students, Bryan meets his new teacher, a tough ex-con and ex-gang member, a middle-aged man on a positive new course in life.

metas.name: Blood Behind Us
metas.description: Casey Hatfield is a former Army Ranger who joins a motorcycle gang, causing a spiral into a life of crime and addiction. Breaking away from the grips of the brutal gang, he attempts to bring down the entire organization

metas.name: Forever Young
metas.description: Mockumentary about a man who has made a wish with a genie to be forever young.

metas.name: Yo (Love Is a Rebellious Bird)
metas.description: After losing her friend Yo, Anna builds a detailed 1/3-scale version of her friend's house. It is just big enough for Anna to squeeze into, and inside lives a puppet of Yo. When the pair first met, Yo was 73 and Anna 24.

metas.name: Are We Breaking Up?
metas.description: Shandaeya & Nic watch a reenacted performance of their last big fight as a couple.

metas.name: Break a Leg
metas.description: On the opening night of the play in which Léa plays the lead role, a rape complaint was filed against her director. Twenty minutes before curtain time, the theater management decides to proceed with the performance. It’s up to Léa to decide whether or not she will go on stage.

metas.name: One Year Anniversary
metas.description: A young boy tries to focus on his homework as his loud Filipino family gathers to commemorate the one year death anniversary of his father.

metas.name: Holdo’s Most Wanted
metas.description: A live reading of the script for STAR WARS: EPISODE 8 - THE LAST JEDI featuring many of your favorite actors from stage and screen.

metas.name: HER
metas.description: A two-faced woman who kills abusive men targets a rapist, but when she uncovers his secret, the hunter becomes the hunted. The film ultimately questions whether vigilante justice is born from cruelty or from a system that has failed its victims.

metas.name: Life is (a) Short
metas.description: On the ten-year anniversary of her dad's death, Frankie reflects on the absurdity of content creation. She would rather end her life than make a short film about death. But is she serious? A twisted look at why we make art through the lens of grief.

metas.name: The Dripton Files: More Mummy, More Problems
metas.description: A look at the career of the Mexican journalist Jaime Maussan.

metas.name: Remedy
metas.description: Roc, a restless college student, has trouble falling asleep. After a few failed sleep-inducing methods, he discovers one that includes buying a pillow from an unknown website. After his purchase, he feels satisfied with his new sleep cycle until he becomes self-reliant on the pillow, creating a harmful addiction.

metas.name: A Cowboy Named Jazz
metas.description: A coming-of-age drama about a farmboy gaining the courage to tell his Papa about his secret passion: music.

metas.name: Fender Bender
metas.description: While arguing about moving in together, Gabe and Julia are rear-ended by Gabe's therapist, turning an accident into an impromptu therapy session.

metas.name: Look Out!
metas.description: When the criminal in the neighborhood watch sign escapes, a community is thrown into panic. Only through the power of local paranoia and super-funding the police force can any sense of white upper middle-class normalcy be restored. But can this mad criminal be stopped before he spray-paints the property value off every single family home? LOOK OUT!

metas.name: Analgesia-X
metas.description: A young man, after consuming a mysterious drug designed to suppress emotional pain and discomfort, begins to lose his grip on reality, descending into hallucinations and psychological torment as the line between truth and delusion disappears.

metas.name: DAWNLAND
metas.description: An apathetic museum archivist is tasked with returning a mythical artifact back to its resting place, deep in the forest.

metas.name: Finding Light: Salt Lake City Two-Spirit Stories
metas.description: A stop-motion documentary about Two-Spirit people's gender experiences with magical-realism visuals.

metas.name: Fred. - A Zaglo Short
metas.description: Jimmie the Thingie lives in a world of forgotten ideas. One day on a stroll he runs into a particularly hangry puppet named Fred.

metas.name: Make Heaven Crowded
metas.description: You realize, once again, that your life is structured around horrible, false fantasies. That what you most deeply believe are things that can't be reasonable, good, or productive. (They can be beautiful, though the beauty is insipid.) And so you construct a film essay. (https://www.emaf.de/en/index/  Access: 27.04.2026)

metas.name: Bygones
metas.description: Two friends reunite, but things are no longer same.

metas.name: Invocation
metas.description: Fearing she won't survive the trip, a Latter-day Saint makes a deal with a benevolent stranger to help her reach Salt Lake.

metas.name: Season's Feedings
metas.description: At Christmastime, two warring vampires decide to settle their longstanding feud. College student Lydia is caught in the middle of their fight, and must rely on a mysterious paranormal expert to make it through the night.

metas.name: Michael the Band the Derby the Movie
metas.description: parker and jacob devise a plan to play at the starkville weiner derby

metas.name: Alden & Elijah
metas.description: Two brothers, Alden and Elijah have one final weekend together before Alden moves away for work. When a snowstorm hits town, the two are trapped inside forced to reconnect.

metas.name: OFFICE JOB
metas.description: This mixed-media comedy animation follows Rodger, a young man heading into what should be a routine job interview. When a scheduling mistake made by his original interviewer throws everything off, the fumbling receptionist, Iris, scrambles to rearrange things. Unfortunately, Rodger ends up with Joei, a well-meaning but utterly clueless intern turning the already stressful situation into a chaotic and unpredictable experience.

metas.name: Ad Nauseam
metas.description: Hijinks ensue at Titus & Rhonicus College during the last student government meeting of the semester.

metas.name: Behind Closed Doors
metas.description: A murder suspect on the run forces his way into Morgan's home and holds her family captive. She does everything she can to keep them safe, but it seems his arrival at her door may not have been so random after all.

metas.name: Pentatonic Scales
metas.description: P-Town Productions tackles nostalgia and the absurd in their culminating project.

metas.name: The Parking Spot
metas.description: A man’s life unravels after a parking spot is stolen from him.

metas.name: BatFreak Part II: Throbin for Justice
metas.description: With the Woker and their criminal minions on the rise, the dashing duo BatFreak and Throbin must find a way to keep the city streets safe- and they're gonna need some help!

metas.name: Short Films About Grief
metas.description: A series of vignette style short films that cover grief in many different ways.

metas.name: Something Old, Something New
metas.description: An ex-couple find themselves being pushed together by their friends at a wedding.

metas.name: billykid
metas.description: A photojournalist joins her childhood friend on a doomed heist for a Magic 8 Ball in their hometown of Hillsborough, North Carolina.

metas.name: Fingered!
metas.description: Disgruntled detective Janet Wolfe must interrogate her own wife Hannah Foxx over the murders of Janet's ex-wives. Things heat up as the couple's baggage begins to unravel while Janet attempts to get to the bottom of the case, even if that means destroying her marriage.

metas.name: Navigators of the Shadow Ring
metas.description: During the international conflicts of the 1950s, a modest crop dusting pilot searches for his heroic brother after he vanished at the hands of a masked villain obsessed with bringing the world's superpowers to their knees.

metas.name: Dose
metas.description: When Christopher is suddenly unable to pay for his medication, he is forced to learn to survive without control.

metas.name: Ridgeview
metas.description: A young woman struggling with her relationships meets an old friend in her childhood treehouse.

metas.name: The Lonely Crowd
metas.description: Peter and Ashley's online date escalates into a heated battle of the sexes. When Ashley storms out, Peter finds her being harassed and intervenes, unwittingly getting involved with corrupt cops, kidnapping, and stolen money.

metas.name: The Audition
metas.description: During a self tape audition, a young man performs the version of himself he thinks the camera wants until small off screen moments reveal who he really is.

metas.name: One Friday Night
metas.description: Studious teen Emma is left home alone for the first time in a while, when she unexpectedly gets an invite to her first party, she embarks on a whirlwind of adventures meeting new people.

metas.name: As I Am
metas.description: A 60-year-old Iranian man travels to a quiet coastal town in Massachusetts and comes face to face with a former comrade—revealing a love they were never able to live.

metas.name: Armani and the Birth of Italian Fashion
metas.description: In his first—and final—on-screen interview, Giorgio Armani reflects on a life that reshaped global fashion. Armani and the Birth of Italian Fashion traces the rise of Italy’s style empires through the legendary families who defined an era, from Armani and Versace to Gucci, Valentino, Prada, and beyond. Set within Milan’s most exclusive fashion sanctuaries, the film explores creative rivalries, personal stories, and the enduring romance between Hollywood and Italian design. Featuring rare insights from fashion icons, actors, and cultural tastemakers, this star-studded documentary is an intimate portrait of ambition, elegance, and the making of modern luxury.

metas.name: Bright Beautiful World: The Infectious Joy of Pat McCurdy
metas.description: Over more than 50 years and 12,000 performances in Milwaukee and beyond, Pat McCurdy has cultivated a fiercely loyal fan base and a reputation for spreading infectious joy. He may not be a household name, but to those who know him, Pat is unforgettable. BRIGHT BEAUTIFUL WORLD is an uplifting portrait of an artist who found success on his own terms—and of the deep, decades-long love affair between a musician and the fans who keep showing up.

metas.name: My Body Goes to Work
metas.description: A birth worker by day and a dancer in a strip club by night, Nevaeh navigates two very different worlds, in both of which bodies are judged and celebrated. As she reclaims the beauty and agency of her body while defying societal labels and expectations, she generously invites us to rethink our assumptions about sex, labour and healing.

metas.name: Aerobic Corridor
metas.description: Determined to complete the most extreme level of North America's oldest and longest cross-country ski event, three women traverse an unexpectedly serene and peaceful winter landscape on their two-day journey of exhilarating glides and challenging terrain, showcasing the impressive stamina and resolve required to reach the finish line.

metas.name: It Goes That Quick
metas.description: The word “personal” doesn’t begin to describe the profound intimacy of this unconventional family portrait, constructed with delicacy and humor by married filmmakers Ashley Connor and Joe Stankus. Neither can that description reveal the artful and intelligent self-awareness of their approach: It Goes That Quick is neither confessional nor exposé but rather something singular and rich—a timeless mosaic of American life, filmed over the course of eight years within one extended Northeastern network of aunts and uncles, parents and grandparents, adults and newborns in which everyone plays a dramatic role that’s no less constructed for being real. By the end of this fleet, loving feature, you feel like a member of the family.

metas.name: The Birth of Trap Music
metas.description: An exploration of how the architects who created the genre captivated the entire world, forever influenced the way music was made, and became a movement that gave the forgotten voices a platform to be heard.

metas.name: Gimme Truth
metas.description: False flags. Forbidden archeology. Chemtrails. Nefarious extraterrestrials. Fake pandemics. Through the intertwined stories of truth-seekers, influencers, and ex-believers, the film explores what draws people into the gravitational pull of conspiracy culture, and what happens when your truth becomes your identity.

metas.name: Ashes of Reverie
metas.description: After the unexpected death of his girlfriend, Ash seeks comfort through an AI replica of her.

metas.name: What is dyslexia?
metas.description: Before you read anything from searching the internet, discover the extraordinary potential of your dyslexic mind.

metas.name: People That Invented God
metas.description: A guilty Christian, a prideful agnostic, and a hopeful Atheist meet to craft a figure of Christ on the cross. Events are recalled from a recent party unpacking their reasons for apprehension around each other. It's condemn or be condemned in an evening of bible study diorama building.

metas.name: White Nine
metas.description: White Nine is both a historical account of the independent living movement in Massachusetts and a compelling story of resilience, the power of collective action, and the enduring quest for equality, independence, and freedom for all. Fifty years ago, Joe, Christos, and Charlie, formed a profound bond as teens when their lives were forever changed by paralyzing spinal cord injuries-essentially a death sentence at that time. Their intertwined stories form the backbone of a larger narrative: the arduous fight for independence and civil rights for people with disabilities. Today, with enforcement weakening and legal challenges mounting, the ADA's promise of equality faces serious threats. As a country, we must actively defend these vital civil rights now to ensure people with disabilities are not pushed back into the margins. White Nine serves as a reminder of the battles fought, the progress achieved, and the critical work that still lies ahead.

metas.name: Mantis
metas.description: A grieving widow in denial takes a job using experimental tech that taps into residual brain activity after death.

metas.name: I'll Be Seeing You
metas.description: When a work errand derails Amy's weekend plans with her grandma, they embark on a road trip with one sentimental detour but need the help of a charming activities director.

metas.name: Surplus to Requirements
metas.description: A young research graduate survives a shuttle crash on a remote space station run by an experimental AI. With the crew missing, the AI keeps her occupied with routine maintenance, psychological tests, and endless games of chess. Slowly she realises the system is not evaluating her, but learning her and that she is about to be declared surplus to requirements…

metas.name: Confessions of a Modern Incel
metas.description: A young man begins to form negative views on women and relationships after several failed dating experiences.

metas.name: Brain Rot
metas.description: Benji needs his phone to fall asleep.

metas.name: Love Apptually
metas.description: Tired of swiping without results? Follow one journalist’s quest to unpack the dating app algorithms shaping modern romance as she reveals how, in an already lonely world, technology, bias and profit are increasingly influencing who we meet and why.

metas.name: Occupational Hazard: The First Coral Reefers
metas.description: Journey through the 1970s and early ’80s with the original members of Jimmy Buffett's Coral Reefer Band as they recount their contributions to iconic albums, life on tour, and the lasting impact they had in shaping a unique and enduring genre of music.

metas.name: Scenes From Suffolk
metas.description: Three stories of failure over the course of a single night.

metas.name: You Just Had to Be There
metas.description: A look at the community surrounding Nintendo's New York store in the month leading up to the launch of the Nintendo Switch in 2017.

metas.name: Squids
metas.description: After losing their beloved mentor days before the big national Scooter Race, the inexperienced Norah and her two best friends seek out the guidance of a reclusive idol to take down a wealthy, rival crew.

metas.name: ROOM TONE: The Sound of 'The Room'
metas.description: The production sound mixer and boom operator on Tommy Wiseau's "The Room" trade war stories from their time in the trenches alongside the man, the myth, the legend.

metas.name: Fanatic
metas.description: What happens when a hero blindly pursues his goal, consumed by brutal rivalry? This is a ruthless play on fantasy conventions, where an existential crisis of masculinity proves more dangerous than dungeon monsters. A story of people so deeply attached to their roles that they fail to notice the coming end of the world.

metas.name: No Safe Shift: Unravelling discrimination among nurses in Canada
metas.description: Through the voices of nurse leaders and a labour lawyer, No Safe Shift traces how systemic racism shapes everyday realities within the nursing profession in Canada. What emerges is a system where safety is not equally shared.

metas.name: My Little Sunrise
metas.description: After leaving the Rohwer Japanese internment camp, a Japanese father and his young daughter hide in rural Arkansas, where survival depends on every choice that could lead to their freedom... or capture.

metas.name: The One Man Band 369 Days in Antarctica
metas.description: The documentary by Oliver Tree detailing his trip to Antarctica to record for his fourth an final studio album, Love You Madly, Hate You Badly

metas.name: Fukushima Nuclear Accident: The Secret Containment Mission
metas.description: March 2011: The worst-case scenario for the Fukushima Daiichi nuclear accident involved the evacuation of all of eastern Japan, but a secret plan to contain the crisis was being prepared.

metas.name: Axel
metas.description: An experimental film that poses a world without helium. The narrative follows a man who is searching for work and attempts to get hired by a balloon company.

metas.name: Out of Order
metas.description: After prom, two friends break into a forgotten arcade searching for one last thrill before they graduate, but a mysterious game traps them in a nightmare where the only way out of the arcade is to keep playing.

metas.name: Suckers
metas.description: An insecure college freshman sees a Halloween party as his chance to reinvent himself and finally break into the popular crowd. The only problem is: his roommate, who invited him, was just bitten by a vampire, and now he must keep the night from spiraling out of control.
