metas.description: A comedic dance film exploration of our evolution, and the human struggle to connect with each other in an increasingly digital landscape, and as we grow increasingly more addicted to our phones and devices.

metas.name: body landscapes
metas.description: Self-portraits of the artist’s emotional states to process the experience of going through breast cancer during the pandemic.

metas.name: the window kind of opens by itself
metas.description: The window kind of opens by Itself takes place at the intergenerational, embodied intersection of four important experimental dance artists. It explores radical expressions of self within duet form to reveal intimate and epic portals of connection, divergence, and aliveness.

metas.name: Dancing with Moloch
metas.description: This performance mixes B movies, ecstatic dancers, animations, live and recorded poetry, personal elegies, remembrances including an auto-eulogy, zombies, Allen Ginsberg, John Denver, Black Sabbath, Charles Manson, Wheel of Fortune, Buddy Rich, Jelly Roll Morton, Max Fleischer, Donald O’Finn, Feedbuck, Akio Mokuno, Donald Miller, Emmalee Sutton, to name but a few. 99’s multimedia Danse Macabre is joyous, funny, terrifying, thoughtful and playful.

metas.name: Murder at the Merriweather
metas.description: When her best friend falls to her death at the luxury resort where they both work, Sophie fights to learn the truth of what happened. But in this world of haves and have-nots, everyone hides a secret.

metas.name: BE HAPPIER
metas.description: Shot on Super 8 at a framerate equivalent to the beats of a hummingbird’s wing, the artist documents a buoyant open-air conversation with her 103-year-old grandmother in a garden.

metas.name: Dreams Travel Wondrous Wires
metas.description: Imagine a dream-centric world. A world more focused on inner than outer. A world where reality begins in dreams. The writer Jane Roberts dreamt of such a world. In the 1970s-80s, she published a series of best-selling books collectively known as the “Seth Material”. Drawn from these texts, and filmed in the house where she lived and wrote, this is a nocturnal meditation, an oneiric exercise, a dream seed, a primer for the movie your mind will make when you go to sleep tonight.

metas.name: Semaphore to the Sea
metas.description: The artist uses semaphore—a maritime-based communication system that uses handheld flags to convey information at a distance—to transmit a message to the sea. Created at the end of an artist residency at the Sou’wester in Seaview, WA.

metas.name: Remembering Tornado Season
metas.description: A visual poem reflecting on Missouri’s tornado season and the destruction left in its wake.

metas.name: Gaseous Beings
metas.description: This triptych plays on polysemy and repetition to simultaneously address the encounters that unsettle us, impact us, and change us, as well as the chemical exchanges that take place in a polluted environment.

metas.name: The Disastro Theorem
metas.description: Stay-at-home mad scientist Dr. Disastro and his loyal lab assistant Igor try to hatch a scheme to take over the world before the end of the week. Can they be stopped?

metas.name: Cities of Ghosts and Angels
metas.description: In Los Angeles and Tokyo, the film invites people to live out unfulfilled desires as strangers from their city embody those they long for. The film explores loneliness and emotional life in late-capitalist cities, all while celebrating the transformative power of imagination.

metas.name: Clunk Burger
metas.description: Crude comics, bad drawings, and absurd poetry come to life as an animated, adult picture book.

metas.name: Never Seen
metas.description: Two friends enter an abandoned house looking for vintage tech and discover something inside that has been waiting for them.

metas.name: Edinburgh '25
metas.description: I went to Edinburgh last summer and, in retrospect, realised it was the happiest I was all year. So I went back to Edinburgh at New Year's and attempted to reconstruct the experience through film.

metas.name: Finger Guns
metas.description: A privileged office worker rebels when his freedom to use the "finger gun" gesture is threatened in this comedic satire.

metas.name: How It Is
metas.description: This play is adapted from the last full-length novel by Samuel Beckett, also one of his most obscure works.Set in a boundless wilderness, the story follows an unnamed narrator crawling forward. On his journey, he encounters another wanderer named Pim, and an absurd yet tense relationship gradually develops between the two.In the end, Pim chooses to flee, leaving the narrator alone once again.

metas.name: Exploring Our Place
metas.description: Exploring Our Place is filmed and narrated by a group of children from Northwood Primary School in Thamesmead.

metas.name: Square
metas.description: Women’s struggle unfolds against London as both container and witness.

metas.name: Stories from Co-op Pepys
metas.description: A conversation with Daniel, a member of Co-o Pepys Arts Project which was established by residents of the Pepys estate in 1981. He talks about his memories and experiences of living on the estate for more than two decades, accompanied by footage of the Arts Project workspaces.

metas.name: The Dreamers
metas.description: Drawing on concepts of radical imaginings and action: the film weaves together the idea of personal and societal transformation. We arrive to meet a woman on the precipice of change.

metas.name: Three Sheets to the Wind or Why I Haven’t Done The Washing Up Today
metas.description: A personal, experimental response to the history of the wages for housework movement.

metas.name: Pending
metas.description: Drawing parallels between the deindustrialisation of the 1980s and the precarious labour conditions of the 2020s, the film follows Harlem, a former takeaway owner whose visa status places his life in suspension.

metas.name: Warm Beer
metas.description: Fired before noon and in desperate need of a beer, Dee takes to the streets of Philadelphia, only to find the city has other plans. Ex-lovers, unsettling strangers, and a cascade of small disasters turn a simple errand into a personal reckoning.

metas.name: Coming Home
metas.description: New movie by Daniel Golding, J. Mitchell Johnson.

metas.name: Welcome Poets
metas.description: A poetically structured documentary that follows 2023-24 Wisconsin Poet Laureate, Nicholas Gulig, as he returns to his home state of Wisconsin after nearly two decades away, following five years teaching in Thailand, joins UW-Whitewater as a poetry professor, and moves to Fort Atkinson. Feeling estranged from the state, and in a divided political climate, Gulig finds a steadying presence in the region's ties to lauded 20th century Wisconsin poet Lorine Niedecker.

metas.name: Intoxicated Rain
metas.description: Moving from the big city back to the small Midwestern town he grew up in, a young bi-racial man comes to grips with his cultural identity as he faces off with members of his emotionally suffering family along with mysterious figures from the past and present.

metas.name: Due
metas.description: A young man struggles to make it across the city to meet his friends for a night out. When every option falls through, the journey forces him to confront what he’s really chasing.

metas.name: Red Ink and Resin
metas.description: A short, experimental meditation on addiction, suicide, and existential angst. Poetry is performed while footage grows increasingly distorted. Segment from Fringe Hippo's anthology film "Elegy Apokalypto".

metas.name: fields beneath towers
metas.description: Born from 1970s community action to resist planned Docklands development, Mudchute Park and Farm has been preserved as one of the UK's largest urban farms and a vital community space - but today its future is uncertain.

metas.name: The Cry of the Eider
metas.description: Once the proud symbol of the Baltic Sea, the Common Eider is now disappearing at an alarming rate. The Cry of the Eider follows a group of dedicated people fighting to save this iconic sea bird from the brink of collapse. Through breathtaking footage and powerful yet intimate human stories, the film uncovers the deeper forces driving the Eider’s decline — from environmental change to human impact — and asks what this tragedy reveals about the state of the Baltic Sea itself. This is not just the story of one species. The Eider’s fate mirrors the uncertain future of an entire ecosystem. As nature is reshaped by powerful global forces, can individual action still make a difference?

metas.name: Magilligan
metas.description: Between the all-too-familiar prison walls and his mother's house, Ryan grapples with himself, eventually finding an escape with the sheep in the verdant fields of Northern Ireland.

metas.name: From Lassen, With Love
metas.description: In Northern California’s Lassen National Forest, wildlife biologist Alyssa enters ground zero of the 2021 Dixie Fire—one of the largest and most severe wildfires in state history. She returns to a place she calls home, in search of a species she knew. Pacific marten; an elusive and feisty forest carnivore deeply tied to environmental change.

metas.name: Why We Love Dolphins
metas.description: The personal story of one man’s relationship with dolphins; a relationship that has evolved over the last 20 years that Ken O’Sullivan has been a natural history film-maker, through countless hours he has spent in their presence, and in their world. It is also a broader examination of the human cultural relationship with dolphins. Few creatures stir our emotions and imagination in the way that dolphins do, and in the same way Ken’s relationship with them has become more nuanced and complex over the years, the film explores the shifting pubic attitudes towards them. We are no longer comfortable to keep these highly intelligent social animals confined in aquaria, or romanticise and simplify their complex lives, but where has our perception of dolphins settled and are we getting closer to understanding the true nature of these creatures? This film has been a true passion project for Ken, I hope you will find it beautiful, thought provoking and enlightening.

metas.name: Sky Speak
metas.description: Sky Speak was created during an Open Air Arts residency at Travelers’ Rest State Park in Lolo, Montana. Using stop-motion animation and an accompanying soundtrack written and recorded in my home studio, the work explores a familiar narrative of habitat destruction caused by humans, followed by nature’s rebirth and regeneration after human absence.

metas.name: The Horses of Cumberland Island
metas.description: Cumberland Island is one of the largest and most ecologically diverse barrier islands in the United States. Once owned by prominent American family, the Carnegies, much of the island came under the National Park Service in 1972, while some heirs retained lifetime rights to remain. Today, more than 60,000 people visit the island each year. Tourism sustains the nearby town of St. Mary’s, and the island’s feral horses have become a defining symbol of its history and appeal. But the presence of more than 140 non-native horses within a fragile ecosystem has sparked an ongoing debate about ecological balance, animal welfare, and preservation. In 2023, a federal court acknowledged the horses’ suffering and environmental impact, but declined to require intervention. The Horses of Cumberland Island is an observational documentary examining the tension between history, tourism, and ecology in a place where what we cherish and what the land can sustain are not always aligned.

metas.name: No Kidding
metas.description: In No Kidding, a quaint and picturesque Welsh town is divided by an uncommon issue: they have a goat problem. Wild Kashmiri goats stray increasingly far from their home to encounter a quirky cast of characters from the obstinate mayoress to an artist with a goat muse. We follow on their journey, unravelling their place within this slightly absurd village ecology.

metas.name: Black Water
metas.description: Black Water is a poignant exploration of survival and resilience deep in the remote forest of the Congo Basin. This short film delves into the lives of a local community around Lake Mai Ndombe (Lake of ‘Black Water’) in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. This once bountiful body of water now teeters on the brink of collapse. Over the years, the lake’s vibrant fish population has dwindled, threatening the livelihoods of those who have relied on its resources for generations.

metas.name: Snail Hunters
metas.description: A team of evolutionary biologists from the University of Idaho travels to the Galápagos Islands to solve the Earth's biodiversity crisis. The twist? They aren't studying the iconic tortoises or blue footed boobies on this storied archipelago—they are Snail Hunters, studying a more unlikely subject in the crucible of evolution. By understanding the unique traits that make snails a champion of coexistence, the multi-disciplinary scientists hope to unlock a brighter future for humanity and the planet.

metas.name: Between Moon Tides
metas.description: In a ribbon of saltmarsh in coastal New England, an intergenerational group of citizen scientists is trying to save the Saltmarsh Sparrow from extinction, one nest at a time.

metas.name: Risky Routes
metas.description: Every year, thousands of toads make the arduous journey back to the waters of their birth to reproduce. They have to overcome numerous dangers along the way - from dangerous roads to other obstacles that turn their journey into a fight for survival.

metas.name: Heritage and Harvest: Quinault Razor Clams
metas.description: After fighting for decades for recognition of their treaty fishing rights, the Quinault Indian Nation—located on the Olympic Peninsula in Washington—now exclusively manages the northern razor clam harvest on their reservation and co-manages the harvest with the state within their treaty area. This fishery is rated green for environmental sustainability by Monterey Bay Aquarium’s Seafood Watch program thanks to a strong management plan rooted in both traditional knowledge and modern science. This highly effective blend of management systems includes regular population assessments and strong policies to prevent overharvest.

metas.name: Speaking Eep!
metas.description: SPEAKING EEP! follows a team of women scientists working to conserve one of North America’s most climate-sensitive species: the American pika. Using a combination of cutting-edge AI technology and traditional research techniques, population biologist Dr. Chris Ray and PhD student Rachel Billings hope to decode the iconic “eeps” of pika language and determine how communication between subspecies might help separate populations of pikas come together to adapt in the face of a warming climate.

metas.name: The Leap Beneath
metas.description: Narrated by Coyote Peterson, this film dives into the hidden world beneath the forest floor. Follow a springtail’s clumsy quest for food through a bustling ecosystem where mites, beetles, and other tiny creatures keep the forest alive.

metas.name: Summer Lost
metas.description: A man attempts to keep his terminal illness a secret while attending a wedding, but an unexpected romance reshapes his future as well as his past.

metas.name: WWE WrestleMania 42 Sunday - Post-show
metas.description: WWE Superstars and analysts break down the results from WrestleMania, including highlights and reactions.

metas.name: 52 Blue
metas.description: Isolated by his father, Ashish escapes home aged 23 with his mother's unwavering support to meet his idol, Messi, in the 2022 world cup in Qatar. Starting a journey that leads him to discover himself and the world for the first time.

metas.name: Shattered Silence: Imitation of a Perfect Life
metas.description: Pastor Edmond Henry's appears to have the perfect life. But when a mysterious murder shatters the calm, his darkest secret is exposed, unleashing a chain of events that unintentionally destroy his family and everything he fought to protect.

metas.name: Partly Parted Party
metas.description: It’s been four weeks since Jake and his ex broke up when Jake’s best friend, Roddy, invites him to attend a party. However, upon realizing that his ex is in attendance at the party, Jake refuses to enter, settling for spending the night on the porch. In an effort to salvage the night and fulfill his promises, Jake sparks many interactions with party goers either looking for a smoke break, some fresh air, or even some private time.

metas.name: For the Love of Laurie
metas.description: In a bid to express his feelings to his long-time crush, an unpolished Glaswegian tradesman opts to try his hand at spoken word poetry.

metas.name: Vengeance of The Darkside killer
metas.description: Vengeance of The Darkside Killer is a chilling audio thriller that dives deep into the origins of a cursed force born from darkness and rage. As the past resurfaces, a relentless presence begins to close in, blurring the line between justice and vengeance. With every step, the truth becomes more dangerous—and escape may no longer be possible.

metas.name: Snow Colored Ashes
metas.description: In the aftermath of a catastrophic attack, a father receives an audio message from his wife that he needs to find their young daughter before it’s too late.

metas.name: Gwangju Dialogue
metas.description: 𝘼𝙨 𝙩𝙝𝙚 𝙩𝙞𝙙𝙚 𝙤𝙛 𝙢𝙖𝙧𝙩𝙞𝙖𝙡 𝙡𝙖𝙬 𝙧𝙚𝙘𝙚𝙙𝙚𝙙, 𝙂𝙬𝙖𝙣𝙜𝙟𝙪 — 𝙩𝙝𝙖𝙩 𝙘𝙞𝙩𝙖𝙙𝙚𝙡 𝙤𝙛 𝙙𝙚𝙢𝙤𝙘𝙧𝙖𝙘𝙮 — 𝙛𝙚𝙡𝙡 𝙗𝙖𝙘𝙠 𝙞𝙣𝙩𝙤 𝙨𝙩𝙞𝙡𝙡𝙣𝙚𝙨𝙨. 𝙈𝙚𝙢𝙤𝙧𝙞𝙚𝙨 𝙤𝙛 𝟭𝟵𝟴𝟬 𝙖𝙣𝙙 𝟮𝟬𝟮𝟰 𝙝𝙖𝙙 𝙖𝙡𝙧𝙚𝙖𝙙𝙮 𝙨𝙚𝙩𝙩𝙡𝙚𝙙 𝙞𝙣𝙩𝙤 𝙚𝙫𝙚𝙧𝙮𝙙𝙖𝙮 𝙡𝙞𝙛𝙚 𝙡𝙞𝙠𝙚 𝙨𝙚𝙙𝙞𝙢𝙚𝙣𝙩𝙨 𝙤𝙛 𝙩𝙞𝙢𝙚.

metas.name: Connected
metas.description: After her parents divorce Cat and her mother Margaret move into their family's farmhouse, Cat befriends Elise who lives in another time period. Their friendship gives Cat the very thing she lost. Connection.

metas.name: YN the Movie
metas.description: After attending a party, Lionel finds himself narrowly surviving a deadly shooting. As he grieves, he is pulled into a dark world of vengeance, forcing him to choose between redemption and revenge.

metas.name: Tissue Technology
metas.description: The appearance of a Kleenex-box in Heise’s work signals that the scene is about to become emotional. When the character gives in and reaches for a tissue, we know we are witnessing an emotional breakdown or breakthrough. The tissues offer assistance in wiping away tears, snot and other bodily fluids – and are, paradoxically, entirely devoid of use or purpose without the very emotions they seek to remedy.

metas.name: Strube Getting Noodles
metas.description: Owen Robert Strube walks down North Chauncey Avenue, desiring a bowl of noodles.

metas.name: Bellybutton Love
metas.description: A couple struggles to express their true feelings for each other, meanwhile their bellybuttons know the truth.

metas.name: The Long Goodbye
metas.description: The film traces how bodies of water, from their sweeping currents to soft tides, have shaped us, enabling transatlantic migration and continuing to impact communities in east London and beyond. The work explores the creation of new identities and artistic forms by the immigrants who have relocated across oceans, both voluntarily and by force.

metas.name: Cost of Living
metas.description: The story comes to an end as Luke Pint struggles with the next steps after the shocking events of Vested Interest...

metas.name: Me & My Big Mug
metas.description: A 23 year old corporate door sales employee navigates her day before getting lost inside of her childhood rug.

metas.name: Charismanol
metas.description: When a loyal office worker’s manufactured happiness is destroyed, he must escape the system that controls his life.

metas.name: Bogo: Winter '26
metas.description: In edition #5 of Bogo, the gang books a live radio show, a mad scientist hatches his most evil scheme yet, and a mysterious vigilante roams the streets after dark.

metas.name: Helen Frankenthaler: Let the Picture Lead You
Black British Music at the BBC: Volume 1
metas.description: Trevor Nelson presents a compilation of performances by British-born black artists from the BBC archives. Featured acts include Stormzy, Emeli Sandé, Olivia Dean, Hot Chocolate, Billy Ocean and many more.

metas.name: The Garden State
metas.description: A customer uncovers the criminal truth of "Big Al's Auto Repair and Pizza", a gnome-run store in New Jersey.

metas.name: Can This Wait
metas.description: Robert Wright is a distinguished member of the Big Business, Incorporated family. He has the wife. He has the mustache. AND, much to his chagrin, he has his coworker Bob; a ponytailed menace who will soon put everything in jeopardy for him...

metas.name: Primate 'Til Dusk
metas.description: A witch curses a lone gorilla; now he must find a way to reverse it before he is turned into a man forever.

metas.name: Portrait of the Father at 71
metas.description: A film that boldly ventures into realms of intimacy that cinema rarely addresses so directly. Its creator, Dr. Diego Semerene – a non-binary Brazilian filmmaker and scholar of queer media at the University of Amsterdam – made a film essay twenty years ago as a deeply personal conversation with his father about growing up, sexuality and the search for masculinity. Their father had never seen this until now, watching it for the first time as a 71-year-old man. The film returns to that material, confronting the past with the present through an extraordinarily honest dialogue between father and child. It is a story about a queer childhood in Brazil, about the emotional tension between the desire for acceptance and personal identity, and about how memory and family intertwine with our deepest longings. Hypnotic, demanding and remarkably brave cinema that invites a conversation about the boundaries of intimacy.

metas.name: Rozz Williams: Romeo’s Distress
metas.description: Documentary film about the controversial artist, poet, and musician Rozz Williams, founder of the band Christian Death, who passed away at the young age of 34, leaving a legacy behind, now to be discovered for the first time for a new generation.

metas.name: Common Denominator
metas.description: Common Denominator is a series exploring the intersection of art, music, and mental health. The pilot episode features Tony Award-winner Gavin Creel and spotlights Noah Kahan, the Grammy-nominated, chart-topping artist behind "Stick Season".

metas.name: Nowhere Left
metas.description: Maede receives a phone call, and the world has ended.

metas.name: JCW Strangle-Mania: Viva Las Violence 2026
metas.description: The "Wicked Clowns" are taking over the Strip for a night of pure, unadulterated violence. Juggalo Championship Wrestling presents Strangle-Mania: Viva Las Violence. Streaming Live and Exclisive on TrillerTV+, this event brings the legendary spirit of the Gathering to Las Vegas for a high-stakes, high-impact spectacle.

metas.name: In Our Hands
metas.description: A moving painting that attempts to highlight the various ways humans are harming whale populations.

metas.name: Cycles
metas.description: A millworker stuck in the same daily routine takes on the highs and lows of starting a new hobby after encountering a mythical cyclist riding past his jobsite.

metas.name: Significant Lessons
metas.description: As an adolescent teen attends his last day of high school before graduation, he begins to have mixed overwhelming emotions about concluding this chapter of his life.

metas.name: The Swirl of the Shine Pierced
metas.description: A swirling punk rock invocation for revolution.

metas.name: the Night Sky Trilogy
metas.description: Three short films about the beauty and mystery of the night sky.

metas.name: Fragment 21: The Birds and The Beasts
metas.description: Another installment of Toney Merritt’s Fragment series, The Birds and The Beasts is a hypnotizing meditation on nature and sounds that combines timelapse footage of a bird feeder with the trail camera footage of a mountain lion shot in real time. Set to a self-composed piece drawn from Merritt’s sound library, The Birds and The Beasts’ unique rhythm and two-part structure captures what it means to live in the wilderness through juxtaposing the power and majesty of the cougar with the spirit and freedom of the birds. A fragment of the seemingly mundane reality, the birds and the mountain lion turn into something far more meaningful: a reflection on multispecies relations and our peaceful co-existence with animals.

metas.name: Objectionable Fruit
metas.description: Objectionable Fruit is an experimental documentary examining the Ginkgo tree—a living fossil celebrated for its resilience and unique capacity to change sexes, defying human- imposed binaries. Using the Ginkgo as a metaphor for fluidity and endurance, the film weaves together themes of gender identity, ecological interconnectedness, and the nuanced complexities of trans existence.

metas.name: A Vernacular of the Numinous
metas.description: Juxtaposing spacious moving images of the everyday with a voiced reflection on the busy life and everyday mystical moments, A Vernacular of the Numinous is a poetic meditation on the extraordinary ordinary. A contemplative film inspired by an invitation to participate in Unpoetry at Seattle's Frye Art Museum in response to Hugh Hayden: American Vernacular, Freeman's A Vernacular of the Numinous is the latest addition to Cinema Divina--their offering of short films made through and for contemplative practice.

metas.name: Fragments of a Journal in Hell
metas.description: A narrated found footage collage film bringing together fragments of writing by the French Surrealist poet, essayist and philosopher, Antonin Artaud. Fragments of a Journal in Hell both looks at and exemplifies a self under siege, undergoing extreme psycho-physical states. At the same time, the film celebrates a improbably joyful artistic practice struggling to still create personal metaphors during a wartime of the self and the world.

metas.name: GENESIS
metas.description: In the secluded mountains of the Shōwa era, a young girl accidentally creates a man by mixing discarded everyday objects with fragments of abstract memories.

metas.name: That’s My Heart Right There
metas.description: Poet Willie Perdomo performs his iconic poem “That’s My Heart Right There” against the backdrop of New York City’s East River.

metas.name: Reach
metas.description: At the crossroads of intimacy, trails of invisible energy imprint as two wanderers maneuver throughout the landscape, leaving hints of mirrored action yet inverted perspective. Through the shifting shape, current, and conduit of water, Reach follows the journey of two people in search of the other.

metas.name: Everyone Wants A Tight Pussy
metas.description: A poet’s experience living with chronic vaginal pain.

metas.name: My 50 Minute Breath-Hold Speedrun Challenge
metas.description: Going to humiliating and dangerous lengths to be seen.

metas.name: All ways.
metas.description: You could not have tried any harder.

metas.name: When You Left Me
metas.description: Inspired by the trans-Atlantic slave trade and other large-scale traumatic events, this project uses the love-lost trope to examine how collective trauma impacts our connection to the land.

metas.name: Light Ghazal
metas.description: Hala Alyan performs her poem “Light Ghazal” to her reflection on a street in New York City.

metas.name: Gabardine
metas.description: A Black poet haunted by the sound of fingers snapping seeks therapy to address the source of his hallucinations.

metas.name: A Night with Monkey Gino
metas.description: Bedtime is more about fun and less about sleep for a monkey who wants to play. But when his show curtain opens at sunrise, will he shine or snooze?

metas.name: Uncle Roly (Tio Roly)
metas.description: Two young cousins are tasked with the simple chore of picking up their estranged uncle from the hospital and dropping him off at their grandmother's house, all of which turns into a full day's affair, culminating in a treasure-hunt in the Florida Everglades where new family perspectives are discovered.

metas.name: it’s nice and calm here for sure. there’s so much i wish i could’ve done, but now all i can do is this :(
metas.description: Two children find each other under strange circumstances.

metas.name: What if We Kept it Between Us?
metas.description: Drawing from archival footage of ballroom, voguing, juke, footwerk, dancehall and dance practices across the African and Black Queer diaspora, and using music from electronic duo Drexciya, What if We Kept it Between Us? works towards re-centring genres of Black music that have been appropriated. Pushing against extraction and offering gatekeeping as a way to protect and preserve Black music and dance ethnographies.

metas.name: Crude Oil and Cowboys, a prairie boy link up
metas.description: In this film we follow three prairie boys as they finish a day of work and get ready to go out for the evening. The film highlights the playful nature of young Black men and demonstrates the cultural blending that exists between traditional western culture and African iconographies.

metas.name: Maansiksikaitsitapiitsinikssin (Working Title)
metas.description: This film is the result of conversations between Blackfoot artists, youth and Elders and the Southern Alberta Art Gallery to stand as a visualization of the Gallery's Blackfoot name, Maansiksikaitsitapiitsinikssin, the new making of images, related to the telling of Blackfoot peoples' stories.

metas.name: Rhinoceros
metas.description: In a future where nature exists only in dreams and cinema, a woman takes mind-altering pills to experience a lost world.

metas.name: The Burden
metas.description: A stranded astronaut struggling for survival on a mysterious desert planet, driven by longing, searches for a way back home.

metas.name: Helezon Akiskan
metas.description: A woman and a child living in ancient times, separated from their tribe, are looking for water. After the woman faints, the boy begins to search alone.

metas.name: I Used To Be A Very Good Person
metas.description: Salvation is subjective. Ideological entrapment can be disguised as choice. Indulge in the world or suffer anyway, without freedom. Why not eat the apple?

metas.name: Paying Respects
metas.description: This short depicts using the Chinese ritual of burning joss paper to reflect of questions of death and diaspora.

metas.name: Yolkless Press
metas.description: Risograph originated in Japan during the 1980s, and a new movement of artists are redefining this printing technique, including Yolkless Press based in Calgary, Alberta. This short documentary highlights their artist-driven projects centered around the Asian diaspora experience, and how they provide a much needed platform for underrepresented voices.

metas.name: My Giant Within Me
metas.description: A would-be life-coach pushes forward his multimedia corporation while avoiding all of his responsibilities.

metas.name: LAYLA
metas.description: Adam is in the midst of a breakup with his girlfriend Layla when his phone dies and car breaks down. Now he must run to her to plea for a second chance.

metas.name: First Out
metas.description: A hustling sports agent will stop at nothing to get two Cuban brothers to defect to the United States for a chance to play in the major leagues.

metas.name: The Christmas Miracle
metas.description: On Christmas Eve, a boy named Caleb sacrifices everything he has to get a present for his little sister, Stella. When his plan falls apart, a magical surprise changes their night forever.

metas.name: TERRORISM the TERRORISM land TERRORISM of TERRORISM common TERRORISM disgrace
metas.description: In May 2025, artist filmmaker Saeed Taji Farouky collaboratively devised scenarios and filmed with people arrested and tried for pro-Palestinian activism. Together they built sets and performed idealised re-enactments of their police interviews and trials, re-enactments in which they said what they weren’t allowed to say in their real interviews and trials. In July 2025, the group with which some of those participants took action was banned as a terrorist organisation and an unprecedented crackdown on the language of Palestinian liberation began.

metas.name: Murder in the Dark
metas.description: A blind waitress at a dining-in-the-dark restaurant becomes the sole witness to a murder, making her the next target of a killer determined to eliminate the only person who could identify him.

metas.name: Spin!
metas.description: A love story, horror film, or perhaps a comedy, Spin! explores the extremes of consciousness arising from unmediated contact and intimacy with our manufactured ecology. Shot entirely in the first person, the film abandons the strictures of plot to focus instead on the lightness and gravity of a subject’s fleeting relationships with plumbing fixtures, clocks, spectators, vending machines, rabbits, dustbins, directional signs, guards, hand dryers, and with the two cities of dreams—Los Angeles and New York—which feature not merely as backdrops, but as main characters in their own right. Sustained throughout by Welch's Apple Juice, our bandaged entity is someone you’ll find disconcertingly familiar if you manage to spin around to look at yourself.

metas.name: Cowboy in the Rye
metas.description: Caspian, an adolescent boy, grapples with his feelings of loneliness and inadequacy as he navigates Central London at night alone.

metas.name: Little Doors
metas.description: In a quietly apocalyptic world a lonely woman discovers a small wooden door on the side of her body and must decide whether or not to open it.

metas.name: The Pack: Wolves of the Sierra Valley
metas.description: Students from Sierra Continuation High School’s Forestry and Natural Resources CTE program have produced a compelling 17-minute documentary exploring the recolonization of wolves in California. Focusing specifically on the Tahoe-Truckee and Sierra Valley regions, the film examines the complex intersection of wildlife conservation, the ranching industry, and local community impact.

metas.name: Time and Tide
metas.description: In a remote Chinese town, an authoritarian father forces his wife and daughter to take care of him after he suffers a stroke. Vee Shi, his son, explores filial duty and the legacy of patriarchy, questioning who must pay the emotional and financial price for an absent and violent father.

metas.name: The Case Against Space
metas.description: Shortly before Christmas 1973, the crew of Skylab, NASA’s first space station, went on strike.

metas.name: Sawyer Avenue, Sunday Afternoon
metas.description: October 12, 2025: masked and unidentified agents from US Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) seize a man without a warrant on a residential street in Chicago. After the Oscar-nominated Incident (VdR 2023), Bill Morrison uses footage from phones and body cameras to dissect and reconstruct a neighbourhood’s struggle against impunity within a brutal administration.
A short documentary style film following a musician turning 18

metas.name: GCW: Effy's Big Gay Brunch 11
metas.description: Effy’s Big Gay Brunch 11 came to Las Vegas on April 18, 2026, as Game Changer Wrestling (GCW) delivered its signature mix of wild action, bold personalities, and inclusive energy in a high-energy showcase of top independent talent at Horseshoe Las Vegas.

metas.name: Saint Libby
metas.description: When her uptight nun aunt threatens to ruin her fun summer day, 16-year-old Libby will do whatever it takes to get her out of the church and into the car.

metas.name: GCW: Joey Janela's Spring Break: The Immortal Clusterfuck
metas.description: Joey Janela's Spring Break: The Immortal Clusterfuck 2026 was a professional wrestling event promoted by Game Changer Wrestling (GCW) that took place on April 18, 2026, in Las Vegas, Nevada, USA. Part of the annual Spring Break series during WrestleMania weekend, the show featured Joey Janela’s signature Immortal Clusterfuck match, a chaotic battle royal-style spectacle bringing together wrestlers and personalities from multiple eras, along with a mix of high-profile independent matches and surprise appearances.

metas.name: Neon Reef
metas.description: Neon Reef dives into the interconnection between vibrant queer community and homegrown ocean activism. Amid the swaying palms and electric neon nightlife of Miami’s South Beach are unlikely underwater heroes: married couple Patrick Breshike and David Grieser. They strap on scuba gear, schmooze politicians, and marshal a diverse coalition of queer coral scientists, women divers, and a Guinness World Record-breaking mermaid in an urgent battle to save a coral reef from poachers, climate change, and ignorance. This is a sexy, sun-drenched, and sometimes surreal road map to pivoting community toward advocacy in America’s riviera: Miami Beach.

metas.name: Snakes and Surf Breaks
metas.description: Snakes and Surf Breaks follows a daring and amateur team’s 3 month expedition across the Indonesian archipelago in search of a Cobra.

metas.name: One Last Order
metas.description: A cherished drive-thru worker receives the day's proceeds as her going-away gift when the community queues up to bid her farewell on her last day in Gainesville.

metas.name: In God's Hands
metas.description: As a wave of religion-based legislation sweeps through the U.S. public school system, a Central Florida school district debates whether to allow chaplains to volunteer in its schools.

metas.name: Same Water
metas.description: Drawing from institutional and personal archives, this film revisits a colored-only riverside recreation space that existed alongside the celebrated white-only Silver Springs water park, exposing the layered histories of segregation and unequal access to nature and leisure in Jim Crow America.

metas.name: Chasing the Passage of Time
metas.description: A crew of 25 moves the largest Richard Serra sculpture in the world across the entire State of Florida.

metas.name: Screw Lucy
metas.description: As corruption grows in 1980s Florida, a beloved and charismatic local sheriff hides dark secrets that involve the mob, drugs, and trafficking of local children. Faced with nonstop harassment and death threats, a local homemaker-turned-journalist, Lucy Morgan, uncovers the truth—and in doing so becomes one of the first women to ever win the Pulitzer Prize for investigative journalism.

metas.name: Beetle Summer
metas.description: A young girl, Rika, who lives in the countryside of Japan, is raising a rhino beetle for beetle fights in order to gain friends. But before then, she needs to train and nurture it.

metas.name: I Think I'm An Angel ii
metas.description: A city symphony evolves through layers of isolation.  The first part of ANGEL PROJECT.

metas.name: To Be
metas.description: Jack Adler is a dreamer. He feels that soulless poetry recitation is an injustice to the meaning between the lines, and he hungers for connection with others who cherish the truth of storytelling as much as he does. When Jack stumbles upon an artistic safe haven, he learns he may not be so alone after all.

metas.name: To Philly with Love
metas.description: A teacher and an archivist decode Revolutionary War-era love letters, taking them on a thrilling journey through Philadelphia where they uncover history-and discover a love story of their own.

metas.name: #indie
metas.description: Two friends enter a local filmmaking competition to try and settle their debts.

metas.name: Caribou Nation
metas.description: Tłı̨chǫ researchers and Innu youth protect caribou, seeking solutions to climate and habitat crises in traditional ecological knowledge.

metas.name: Intertidal
metas.description: Pioneering Asian and Native Hawaiian marine scientists grapple with questions of belonging as they confront the long history of exploitation in coral reef research. Their work questions who holds authority in science—and what is lost when indigenous perspectives are dismissed. Grounded in the Hawaiian concept of kuleana — a sacred reciprocal responsibility between people and place — they are building new research models that prioritize the needs of local communities.

metas.name: In the Path of Giants
metas.description: In Southern Bangladesh, hungry wild elephants trapped by the world’s largest refugee camp are rampaging over the land of local farmers. The result is a tense three-way stand-off between the refugees, local Bengalis and indigenous farmers, worsening already strained ethnic tensions. In 2017 Bangladesh opened its arms to nearly a million Rohingya who fled a violent regime of ethnic cleansing in Myanmar. But the camp built to house them unknowingly blocked the last migratory corridor for the local elephant population. With no easy escape, a Rohingya refugee, an indigenous farmer, a Bengali forest ranger and the shrinking population of wild elephants find themselves trapped in an impossible fight for land, freedom and a place to call home.

metas.name: Underground Sound
metas.description: For a DJ, keeping up with the latest trends is par for the course, but DJ Brian d’Souza, is forging his own path. Under his stage name, Auntie Flo, he learned to create innovative soundscapes from the subtle vibrations of living plants and mushrooms His musical exploration highlights the living ecosystem that exists all around us, urging us to see nature as living collaborator in the symphony of existence. Beyond the stage, his music promotes mental healing and environmental conservation, encouraging listeners to engage with nature in a new way. By collaborating with the natural world, Brian reshapes how we interact with the environment, giving Mother Earth a voice in the symphony of life and inviting us to listen to what’s hidden in plain sight.

metas.name: Heart of a Lion
metas.description: Heart of a Lion follows cougar biologist Mark Elbroch into the parallel worlds of two mountain lion mothers: F61, who revealed their hidden social lives, and Yoko, struggling to raise her young on the edge of human encroachment. From the rugged wilderness of Wyoming’s Tetons to the misty forests of Washington’s Olympic Peninsula, this intimate and immersive journey reveals one of North America’s most misunderstood predators—asking us to see them with admiration instead of fear.

metas.name: Dinosaur Fish
metas.description: The Lake Sturgeon has existed virtually unchanged for more than 130 million years. It survived a meteor impact and outlived the dinosaurs but we’ve found out it couldn’t survive in the face of human development. With only 1% remaining in the Great Lakes, conservationists in Lake Huron’s Saginaw Bay are working to bring this iconic species back from the brink of extinction.

metas.name: No Brainer
metas.description: Two friends decide to do something drastic to avoid going into work.

metas.name: Men in Towels
metas.description: When a hot-headed man is sent to a luxury spa to confront his fatal stress disorder, he’s forced to share his recovery with a cheeky, laid-back patient whose relentless humor might either save his life - or drive him over the edge.

metas.name: Wild Tamil Nadu
metas.description: Wild Tamil Nadu is a spectacular new natural history film that reveals the extraordinary biodiversity of Tamil Nadu- a land where rainforests, reefs, and deserts meet in one of the most unique ecological landscapes on Earth.

metas.name: Deep Ocean: Kingdom of the Coelacanth
metas.description: David Attenborough looks into the ocean's depths to discuss the coelacanth, a primeval fish hidden for 400 million years. Its mysterious movements reveal vital clues about life's journey from sea to land, as well as secrets of evolution and survival.

metas.name: Krypto Saves the Day!: Coastal Catastrophe
metas.description: A fun day at the beach goes sideways when some sneaky foes get between Krypto and his hot dog.

metas.name: In Lieu of Flowers
metas.description: In the wake of Megan's sudden passing, her best friends Frances and Taylor work together to honor her wishes to remove any contraband items from her bedroom in efforts to preserve her image to her mourning parents. Confronted by conflicting perceptions of Megan and approaches to grief, Frances and Taylor wrestle with the question: Will they remain friends without her?

metas.name: By the Roots
metas.description: Madison Young, a queer gallerist and sexual revolutionary, returns to Southern Ohio to confront her past, conservative family, and emotional landmines with her partner James.

metas.name: WWE WrestleMania 42 Saturday - Post-Show
metas.description: WWE Superstars and analysts break down the results from WrestleMania, including highlights and reactions.

metas.name: Find Your Why
metas.description: A freshman recruit on the Liberty Men's Volleyball Team fights to make the starting roster as an outside hitter in the live-streamed arena games. But he must beat out the senior douche on the team for the position.

metas.name: Scrutiny of Friendship
metas.description: During the peak of summer, two best friends go on a walk through the countryside, but beneath the serene landscape lies a simmering tension, as one of them harbors a secret that will change everything.

metas.name: Frogtown
metas.description: A slice-of-life exploration of the weird and wonderful residents of a small town in North Florida and what they believe in.

metas.name: Lone Rider
metas.description: After stealing his dad's old '89 Mustang, a lonely millennial drifts through midnight summer drives, fleeting reunions, fractured friendships, old regrets, and the pull of roads that keep leading him back to the life he's trying to outrun.

metas.name: G.O.D.Tech
metas.description: An adventure thriller about a group of friends trying to escape a government based world religion who treats them as terrorists.ech

metas.name: SLOOT
metas.description: A typical Dutch ditch: Rarely worthy of a second glance. But those who look closer discover a rich ecosystem, teeming with life and intricate connections. Beneath the surface of a Dutch waterway lies a hidden world. In this short nature film, we follow the lives of fish, insects, and birds across the changing seasons, from winter’s stillness to summer’s abundance. SLOOT is a tribute to biodiversity in a man-made landscape.

metas.name: Uktena Returns
metas.description: The origin story of the Native American myth of Uktena, the Horned Serpent. UKTENA had been contained in the cave but mankind's greed and destruction of Mother Earth, allowed the beast to escape the confines of the cave and begin to go on a rampage once again. A major conflict with the local armed forces erupts and UKTENA is unstoppable. A Native American woman, the descendent of the shaman that cast the original spell, uses a sacred totem to reverse the spell and turn UKTENA back into the human he once was.

metas.name: Cold Ones
metas.description: A hardworking woman has an argument with her drunk and unemployed husband.

metas.name: Reflektion
metas.description: Group project year one

metas.name: I'm Never Showing My Face Again
metas.description: The first episode of *Indie Movie Sound Track*, Forrest Nolan's serialized indie coming-of-age web series. When an unexpected encounter involving Justin Bieber throws his world off balance, Forrest finds himself at the beginning of a strange and increasingly surreal journey. Blending original music, comedy and fiction, the story unfolds one episode at a time.

metas.name: Graham Kay: Pete & Me
metas.description: ‘Pete & Me’ is a deeply funny, unexpectedly moving comedy special from Graham Kay that blends sharp stand-up with heartfelt storytelling about life alongside his older brother Pete, who has profound autism. With his signature dry wit, Graham unpacks family chaos, childhood resentment, adulthood, loneliness, guilt, and the strange, tender rituals that define their bond. The result is a rare special that is as honest as it is hilarious—an intimate, offbeat portrait of brotherhood, responsibility, and the kind of love that doesn’t always look conventional, but lasts a lifetime.

metas.name: Time Trials: A Dragstrip Requiem
metas.description: A teenage drag racing sensation quits competition but stares down fate and returns in pursuit of a championship.

metas.name: B. Reel
metas.description: A young woman discovers a mysterious VHS tape.

metas.name: My Twenty-Third Winter
metas.description: a young woman finds the sublime in the mundane during a grey winter

metas.name: Group Project
metas.description: Five friends work together to complete a short film for one of their classes. Well, they’re not really friends by the end of it...

metas.name: Close Quarters
metas.description: Roomates Ellie and Eric swear to their friends that they are just friends. But as Ellie grapples with the challenges of finishing her thesis, Eric makes a grand gesture that changes everything.

metas.name: Memories of You
metas.description: A grieving widower visits the place most meaningful to their relationship when a spiritual experience helps them to move on.

metas.name: Gigalow
metas.description: Left with debt and tasked with raising his sister, a young man climbs the underground dance scene only to find success comes at a high cost.

metas.name: Take One, Leave One
metas.description: Julie, a grieving daughter, moves to a new city with her  mother, Catherine. Julie, trying to move forward, but also  still struggling with grief, shuts out new people and  possibilities. Instead, she spends her days taking and  leaving books at a mini library near her house, throwing  herself into reading, an activity for which she and her father  had shared a love.

metas.name: Suit and Jacket
metas.description: When a man sees himself unhappy with society’s pressure to follow ordinary careers, he reflects on what he really wants from his life. Seeing his closest friend’s achievement and growth, he decides to pursue his passion and dance to the rhythm of his dreams.

metas.name: STATIC
metas.description: After a bar fight leaves them stranded, a hot-headed frontman, a golden-boy guitarist, an enigmatic bassist, a blissed-out drummer, and their eccentric pianist rush across town to make it to their gig that may or may not matter. Their bickering, banter, and bravado expose how fragile and electric youth really is: for this band, the journey is the show.

metas.name: Pretty Boy Crossover
metas.description: A new technological advancement allows attractive people to cross over to digital dimension as entertainment.

metas.name: Eyes Like Diamonds
metas.description: Passionate conservationist Neil Waters embarks on a decade-long search through Tasmania’s wilderness to prove the Tasmanian Tiger still exists. Once celebrated but now ridiculed, his quest becomes a moving story of belief, science, redemption, and the ethics of extinction.

metas.name: Caryatid (Martin 'The Ghost')
metas.description: Pfeiffer's video presents an excerpt of a boxing match of Frank Lamar Martin from which the attacking opponent has been digitally removed. The title references the caryatids of antiquity-female figures used as architectural columns-and prompts reflection on how (male) heroism is made possible by the labor and support of others. By isolating the boxer receiving the punches, the work underscores the brutality of impact and puts a spotlight on the opponent whose existence enables triumph.
When an unexpected road rage incident puts his son in critical condition, an enraged father spirals down a dark path of emotional turmoil and vengeance.

metas.name: A Gorilla Story: Told by David Attenborough
metas.description: Veteran naturalist Sir David Attenborough tells the story of a remarkable group of gorillas, from his first encounter in the '70s to the present day.

metas.name: Mother Mary
metas.description: Long-buried wounds rise to the surface when iconic pop star Mother Mary reunites with her estranged best friend and former costume designer Sam Anselm on the eve of her comeback performance.

metas.name: Brothers Under Fire
metas.description: Captain Jordan Wright's squadron on leave for a wedding in Mexico encounters a murderous cartel. As Jordan tries to lead survivors to safety, war erupts between his squad and the cartel, forcing him into a battle to save his men.

metas.name: Haim
metas.description: Haunted by nightmares of her miserable future, Rima Haim, grappling with an unexpected pregnancy, becomes hostage to her own mind in a surreal dreamscape as she tries to overcome her anxiety and the pressures of impending motherhood.

metas.name: I Hate PragerU
metas.description: An ambitious young journalist sets out to expose conservative media company PragerU as a hateful propaganda machine—and as a fake university. But, as his investigation unfolds, the people and the ideas he encounters force him to question the one thing he never expected to doubt: his own worldview.

metas.name: Eidolon
metas.description: A man hears the voice of his wife while navigating Manhattan in a crazed stupor.

metas.name: O—————K
metas.description: The title draws on Nietzsche’s comment on modernity as an experience of radical relativization in the cosmos: 'Since Copernicus man has been rolling from the centre toward X.' I became less interested in 'X' representing nothing or negativity, and so I made it crooked, with the letter 'K.' Which brought to mind 'being OK' as a state and a goal: we are familiar with oblivion (X), we read about it every day. How to get to 'OK' is a more challenging and interesting problem. There are five em dashes between O and K — a state of abeyance, like living while holding your breath. — Vijay Masharani

metas.name: The Convenience
metas.description: A short experimental film that follows the desperation of needing to go to the toilet.

metas.name: Race to Class
metas.description: When two friends decide to bet 10$ on a race to see who can make it to class first things get out of hand real quick

metas.name: A Dance Away
metas.description: Following a devastating injury, a young dancer enters a mysterious realm where three enigmatic dancers force her to confront the fears keeping her from the stage.

metas.name: Bells Larsen: Blurring Time (the documentary)
metas.description: The Montreal-based indie-folk songwriter brings 'Blurring Time' to the screen with a short documentary tracing the making of his tender 2025 Polaris Music Prize-longlisted album.  Built from recordings captured before and after his transition, the film is a quiet, intimate portrait of process, change, and self.

metas.name: Nosebleed
metas.description: After waking up from a botched nose job, Carly, furious at the boyfriend who abandoned her, slowly begins to recognize the power of the male gaze, ultimately discovering that true transformation comes from choosing herself.

metas.name: Manchild
metas.description: When the crazed psycho breaks into Maria's house, her and Eloise call the only person they know can deal with him...

metas.name: Clojure: The Documentary
metas.description: This is the story of how one programmer's obsession with simplicity quietly reshaped how the software world thinks about time, immutability, and what it means to write code that lasts. From a sabbatical pet-project to the backbone of one of the world's largest fintechs and a global community that treats their language like a philosophy. This is the story of Clojure.

metas.name: UNCHILD — We’re Ready for What’s Next
metas.description: ​A short documentary following HIGH UP’s new K-Pop girl group, UNCHILD

metas.name: The Grandfather Puzzle
metas.description: Searching for a connection with her mysterious, austere grandfather, Ora DeKornfeld travels to his childhood home in Hungary, where she is swept up in nothing short of a fairytale. The childhood home turns out to be a castle on a 6,000-acre estate. Her grandfather was a baron, and their family was central to the economic and cultural lifeblood of the local community. Suddenly, Ora finds herself ushered through town, meeting curious locals at every corner who greet her with warm hospitality. A question emerges: why would her family leave all this behind? The town, like her grandfather, holds its painful history at arm’s length. Moving between fable and reckoning, whimsy and grief, this deeply personal film explores an identity shaped equally by what was lost and buried and what was lovingly preserved.

metas.name: Kanan Gill : What Is This? (also Original)
metas.description: I recorded this video a week after filming the special, just because it was the last show of the tour. It's quite different in feeling and form compared to the version of the special (confusingly listed as 'What is This? - Original' on this channel). While filming a special I focus on precision and performance, that is doing the show exactly as written and capturing the show as I first conceived it. Live shows on the other hand are also informed by their context —where is this, what time is it, how are you feeling, how am I feeling, is the room too cold, was traffic awful, did someone leave to go to the loo?, etc. This show captures a little more of the regular live experience of performing a stand up show. It's looser, and more tied to the show that day instead of the special-special which aims to capture the show out of time. I hope this isn't confusing. I'm quite confused writing it.

metas.name: IMvisible
metas.description: Two newcomer women in New Brunswick — Rahel and Camilia — both impacted by different forms of gender-based violence from different family members, navigate life, healing, and resistance.

metas.name: SUPLEXX - NECROSIS | FUCK LIFE
metas.description: Band Suplexx and their singer are within Bioskop Zvezda, hijinx and insanity ensue.A two part mini film promoting tracks Necrosis and Fuck Life.

metas.name: Through My Board
metas.description: Growing up in the underbelly of Burnside Skatepark, Paul Johnson is a product of his environment. As a deaf skater, he's learned to navigate the challenges that come with communicating amongst mostly hearing friends. With a new generation of skaters in need of role models, the default culture that once enabled the vices of Burnside's skate community is now in transition. Through My Board tells the story of Paul and the park's OGs as they reckon with aging, addiction, and the often-uncomfortable process of personal evolution.

metas.name: CMLL at Palms Slam Fest 2026
metas.description: Pearl Concert Theater at Palms Casino Resort transforms into a portal to Arena México. As a marquee event of Slam Fest week, Consejo Mundial de Lucha Libre (CMLL) presents a card where international legacies collide and championships are on the line.

metas.name: Norm.
metas.description: A little short film Aron Fromm made about Norm.

metas.name: Hybrid | PWU: Midnight Xpress
metas.description: The neon lights of the Las Vegas Strip meet the grit of the independent scene for a midnight spectacle like no other. Hybrid Wrestling and Pro Wrestling Unplugged (PWU) join forces to kick off "The Collective" with Midnight Xpress.

metas.name: LIVE matches from WWE World: April 16, 2026
metas.description: A broadcast from WWE(World Wrestling Entertainment) of the Live Matches from WWE World

metas.name: Born to Dance
metas.description: Nathalie, a young dancer, trapped in a black-and-white world of discipline, battles perfectionism and self-rejection during a solo rehearsal. When she finally breaks free and embraces the full force of her identity, the world isn't ready.

metas.name: PROGRESS Chapter 193: PROGRESS Las Vegas II
metas.description: The "Best of British" returns to the world's most famous desert oasis as PROGRESS Wrestling presents Chapter 193: PROGRESS Las Vegas II. With guest host So Cal Val leading the festivities and the legendary D'Lo Brown joining Joe Dombrowski on the headset, this is PROGRESS like you've never seen it before.

metas.name: Between death and
metas.description: Between death and is a portrait of a funeral parlor in the heart of Baltimore City on the precipice of its own transition. The liminal states embedded in life, death, and grief are studied in this film. 108 West North Avenue was built in 1878 along Boundary Avenue as it was known then — just beyond the northern border of the city. It served the community as a funeral parlor from 1914 to 2021.

metas.name: Snowfall
metas.description: A 12'53" single shot film, part documentary and part performance. An ecstatic, funky, and amusing homage to all the great snow scenes in mainstream movies that we grew up loving. (Camera by Kirill Mikhanovsky; Music by Evan Maruszewski).

metas.name: Montana
metas.description: Montana is a short experimental narrative that explores the relationship between two girls. Using found footage and other recordings, a story is told in which puberty, longing, and curiosity are intertwined. Datamoshing is used to create the effect on film, and conserves the memory of the narrative in a fluid, transitory way, as if looking into the brain of someone telling the story. Montana asks its viewers to remember what it was like to be small.

metas.name: Chironomies: Barbara Hannigan
metas.description: Chironomies is an ongoing series of videos that reveal the aesthetics of music conductors' gestures. The recordings of the musical works used are edited to retain only the relevant parts. The bodies, stripped of the superfluous and multiplied, leave traces that create patterns specific to each conductor. The result is visual and musical recompositions that navigate between figuration and abstraction.

metas.name: HOG: Las Vegas Culture Clash 2026
metas.description: Watch House of Glory: Culture Clash live on TrillerTV and experience the high-octane ‘Lucha-Resu' style that has made HOG a global phenomenon. Featuring top wrestling stars, elite technical matchups, and world-class high-flyers, this event delivers a must-see main event and championship action. Streaming live from the Palms Casino Resort in Las Vegas, Culture Clash brings together iconic talent and the most prestigious titles in professional wrestling.

metas.name: Unoriginal AF
metas.description: What if our dreams are not the product of our subconscious but are the residue of media we have yet to consume.

metas.name: Resistor
metas.description: Statements made by presidents of the United States of America on glitched repeat, projected onto my face or hand as I work to make the video. And in opposition, portraits of artists in my creative family and community, who are unraveling and restructuring reality as you read this.

metas.name: Diary Entry – July 2024
metas.description: Time rushes past from waking to sleep — a blur of motion shaped by the city’s rush. But when rain interrupts, time begins to melt, and the world displays its shimmering hues. Somewhere in the drift, I remember: I owe a visit to my parents. And yet, here I am - a quiet duck, savoring the sunlight.

metas.name: Palimpsest 2: محل تيب /Bethlehem
metas.description: A series of 1 reel diary films made up of improvised superimpositions. The mundane and the absurd aspects of contemporary life that overwrite one another: a genocide on our phones, a skeleton just outside the window, road trips through the midwest, an eagle and a serpent. Captured in camera without editing on 8mm and blown up to 16mm.

metas.name: Untitled 1 (Zuzax)
metas.description: The source material for this found footage piece was discovered half buried next to a crumbling shack in the Sandia Mountains. Instead of cleaning the film to properly restore its natural image content, the film was intentionally documented in its unearthed state of disintegration. In the spirit of films like Bill Morrison’s Decasia, this willful preservation of the film’s neglected condition exposes and celebrates the aging process of the physical media itself.

metas.name: RUN BABY RUN
metas.description: RUN BABY RUN was inspired by a news headline, Sorry, AI won’t “fix” climate change (MIT Technology Review). According to The World Economic Forum, AI tools predict weather, track icebergs, recycle waste and find plastic in the ocean, however, on its own, AI is powerless to solve climate change––regulation is required for that. An encouraging arena where AI has made quiet progress, is education. Climate change video games can teach children about climate change in subtle ways––no lectures or preaching required. However, the most popular games, ones played mostly by adults, focus on building new cities that have a low carbon footprint, or take place on another planet after earth is no longer habitable. I can only surmise that it’s not entertaining to try and fix the problems we currently face. Has the race already been won?

metas.name: Western Brook Pond
metas.description: A boat trip through Western Brook Pond, an ancient fjord in the Long Range Mountains in Newfoundland, carved out over millions of years by tectonic activity and glaciers. Western Brook Pond was shot on video and 16 mm film which was hand processed with apples and coloured with turmeric and walnuts.

metas.name: South Carolina: As if the Grief Were Not Enough
metas.description: A Case of Criminalizing Pregnancy Loss: A public service announcement about the prosecution of a South Carolina woman who was cruelly arrested after her miscarriage for improperly disposing of fetal remains even though there are no legally established guidelines for that. This is the third in a series of spots about the criminalization of pregnancy loss in the United States, a side effect of the overturning of Roe v. Wade in the Dobbs decision of 2023, and a strategy of anti-abortion forces to normalize the idea of “fetal personhood.”

metas.name: I found some old footage of a tree
metas.description: I found some old footage of a tree is a new film that envisions a Mother Nature- like character, personified as an experimental filmmaker. The film is not intended to be read as her finished work, but rather a snapshot of the creative process—like a journal entry, a vignette of ideas, or a mind map as she contemplates how to capture the changing planet. In this piece, the materiality of film becomes a metaphor for time, impermanence, and the ephemeral nature of the physical world. A sense of anxiety and urgency shapes the work, leaving us uncertain whether we are witnessing the past, the present, or a message from the future.

metas.name: summer school
metas.description: Along the banks of the Salaca River in rural Latvia, a haven emerges where analog film wizards and aspiring apprentices unite. At this pop-up school, the art of filmmaking intertwines with botany, folklore, and magic, weaving a tapestry of creativity and tradition.

metas.name: Bravado
metas.description: In this meta-thriller film within a film, a submissive writer strives to perfect her latest script under the shadow of a manipulative director, crafting a violent mafia story set in the UK's gritty crime world that evolves with every note.

metas.name: He Hath Risen
metas.description: As two con men scam a church, they attempt to capitalize on the pastor’s death by faking his resurrection, only for their scheme to spiral into chaos.

metas.name: Todd Hardy
metas.description: Documentary on musician Todd Hardy, detailing some of his early music days, as well as working with Baz Luhrmann.

metas.name: Kineticritical
metas.description: An experimental short film shot and directed by Nanine. A little peek into his industrial surroundings and focuses mostly on his independent filmmaking abilities

metas.name: A Day to Kill
metas.description: Due to a layover a woman finds herself in an unremarkable, deserted city. While walking aimlessly, she meets a lady who delivers newspapers no one reads, and a man who is looking for his cat.

metas.name: The Revenge of the 2 Twinks in 1 War
metas.description: After the climax of the second World War, Tzakas finds himself lost once again in the heat of battle in Stalingrad. With tensions rising between the two parties a new German sergeant has become a real threat. With sgt. Smitheropoulos and a new ally by his side, Tzakas needs to bring peace back to the world.

metas.name: Untitled
metas.description: A woman walks aimlessly around Melbourne.

metas.name: Rituals of a Grieving Body
metas.description: A reflective portrait of a woman navigating life in New York City, this film traces her evolving relationship with loneliness in the digital age. It examines how our collective pursuit for connection through technology has become an inescapable loop, one where the systems we’ve built increasingly mirror our own contradictions. Through the interplay of natural v.s. technological patterns, the story explores the cyclical nature of self-destruction. At its heart, it is a meditation on complicity and control: how individuals knowingly return to the very technologies that harm them, and how humanity, in turn, condemns the machine for reflecting what we ourselves have created.

metas.name: The Veins of Ghollos
metas.description: For many decades, the evil witch Zolga has lured the people of Dheckmire to become food for the slumbering god Ghollos. But now one man crosses her labyrinth once again with the hopes of rescuing his younger brother. Will Kasten find Auric or will he became the next warrior to meet his end in the cruel god's pits?

metas.name: The End
metas.description: Two cops chase a killer who creates art out of his victims.

metas.name: Excalipurr
metas.description: The brave and noble Arthur has discovered the hiding place of the fabled Excalibur. Little does he know that the "Lady" of the Lake is actually a mischievous cat who does not like people touching her favorite toy.

metas.name: Convenient Work: Episode I-Vinny The Clown
metas.description: A jewel thief finds refuge from an officer in the form of a jobless man with a clown costume.

metas.name: Facing the Future: South Florida vs. Climate Change
metas.description: Densely developed, low-lying South Florida is one of the most vulnerable regions to sea-level rise and climate change in the U.S. and the world. South Florida sits on the front lines of sea-level rise and climate change—and this WLRN original production offers a compelling look at how local communities are responding. Filmed throughout the 2024 hurricane season, it highlights innovative projects and grassroots efforts across the region, from infrastructure improvements to environmental education and citizen science. Following climate leaders and advocates over the course of a year, the film captures both the urgency of these challenges and the resilience of those working toward solutions. It culminates at a regional summit in Key West, where participants reflect on progress and the path ahead.

metas.name: Cuba After Castro
metas.description: In the first and only American interview with President Miguel Díaz-Canel, Cuba After Castro explores the island’s revolutionary history and turbulent present, while revealing a portrait of the man tasked with steering its future.

metas.name: KARMA
metas.description: Three friends reunite after three years. They decide to challenge their fate through an absurd plan. Following a series of rash decisions, their journey turns into a comical mix of drama and absurdity. Each character faces inevitable consequences, discovering that fate cannot be manipulated without confronting the law of karma.

metas.name: Konquering with the Klobmartians
metas.description: Intergalactic Botox Bimbos fight over a bloodthirsty well endowed alien studlord.

metas.name: Ueck
metas.description: Milwaukee legend, Bob Uecker, the former Major League baseball player, Hall of Fame sportscaster, comedian, and actor has seen it all and made us laugh along the way. Though UECK passed away in January 2025, this documentary from Milwaukee-based filmmakers Michael T. Vollmann and Steve Farr persists as a testament to his legacy, giving audiences intimate access to his life, work, family, and friends, amplifying his humor and heart for future generations.

metas.name: Jerry West: The Logo
metas.description: He built dynasties, broke barriers, and became the silhouette that defines the game. But beneath Jerry West's legendary NBA legacy was a man haunted by perfection and pain. Through rare interviews with family and basketball icons, uncover the complex truth behind The Logo.

metas.name: WrestleCon: Mark Hitchcock Memorial Supershow 2026
metas.description: Mark Hitchcock Memorial SuperShow 2026 was an annual supershow promoted by WrestleCon that took place on April 16, 2026, at Horseshoe Las Vegas in Las Vegas, Nevada, USA. Named in honor of wrestling photographer and historian Mark Hitchcock for his contributions to documenting and preserving professional wrestling history, the event serves as WrestleCon’s flagship independent supershow during WrestleMania weekend. The show was headlined by JetSpeed (Kevin Knight & Mike Bailey) and Michael Oku vs. The Demand (Bishop Kaun, Ricochet & Toa Liona) in a six-man tag team match.

metas.name: In the Dream I Forget
metas.description: A reunion between brothers descends into a confrontation shaped by memory, guilt, and violence.

metas.name: Walter Lietha - Drum sing i grad drum
metas.description: The Grisons singer Walter Lietha was one of the biggest names in the Swiss music scene in the 1970s, becoming the voice of a generation with his poetic, sometimes socially critical songs. But at the beginning of the 1980s, this voice largely fell silent in the public sphere. In August 2025, the 75-year-old Grisons bard was honored with a concert at the "Alpentöne" music festival, featuring, among others, Corin Curschellas, Sophie Hunger, Stephan Eicher, Michael von der Heide, and the Narrenschiffband. What has become of Walter Lietha, his utopian visions, his songs?

metas.name: Old Bag
metas.description: Do Bags Feel?

metas.name: A man made of diamonds.
metas.description: "Diamond Made Man" spans epochs and galaxies, marking a cinematic milestone as potentially the first Hollywood production to feature an epic confrontation between prehistoric dinosaurs and advanced robotics.c31a9d Key scenes include intense battles in modern city streets where Dr. Sreehari, inside a colossal golden robot, clashes with a life-sized T-Rex using groundbreaking practical effects, animatronics, and motion capture technology.The story delves into ancient times around 4700 BC, where humanity's early struggles intertwine with futuristic elements, such as discovering billions in gold aboard a ship in the sea or confronting demonic forces reminiscent of mythological.

metas.name: Arnie & Barney
metas.description: A platoon of ants set out to save their community in the midst of a severe drought, but the hilariously inept Arnie and Barney – who are not cut out for heroics – decide to tackle the problem themselves. Their bumbling efforts lead them to uncover a shady water racket and team up with a secretive superhero mosquito. In a series of comical mishaps, they inadvertently save the meadow and become the most unlikely heroes of all.

metas.name: easy on the turns
metas.description: Jay and Matt move everything out of "Stu's" garage. A road trip of memory ensues.

metas.name: The Pickers
metas.description: We want cheap fruit and veg, all year. No problem. The Pickers deliver, but they are paying the price for us: Exploited migrants harvest our oranges, strawberries, olives, blueberries and other fruit and vegetables in Greece, Spain, Italy or Portugal.

metas.name: Eternal Return
metas.description: Cass has come to a personal point of emotional invulnerability, until she meets Virgil, a cartographer. Along with his partner Malcolm, they attempt to travel back in time to awaken Cass to love again.

metas.name: Kill Code
metas.description: North America has been divided into four main quadrants. A power-hungry corporation has taken over the conventional prison system and made criminals the new law enforcers.  The owner of that corporation, nanoscientist Eion Prescott, created a nano-virus called Onyx. Which is distributed through deadly watches to criminals. First, infecting them. Then, forcing them into eliminating each other for freedom. Who can topple the corporation's entire system from within?

metas.name: Yuki Johnson - Detroit's Vigilante
metas.description: In racially divided Detroit, Yuki Johnson, a biracial teenager, transforms into the Detroit Vigilante after his father, a police officer, is targeted by a menacing gang.

metas.name: Phantasm & Elizabeth Kenny @ The Journey of Instruments
metas.description: A direct descendant of the oud, the European lute takes centre stage in this concert by Elizabeth Kenny & Phantasm. With its ‘The Journey of Instruments’ series, the Salle Pierre Boulez in Berlin offers a fascinating musical journey tracing the history of the oud, one of the oldest stringed instruments.

metas.name: Return to the Moon
metas.description: A half-century after American astronauts walked on the Moon, NASA and its international partners are taking the dream of Apollo a giant step further. In the coming years, the Artemis missions – named after Apollo's twin sister in Greek mythology – aim to bring astronauts back to the Moon and establish a lunar space station for scientific and commercial exploration. Follow the four members of the Artemis II crew as they embark on a perilous 10-day journey to orbit the Moon, venturing beyond Earth orbit for the first time since Apollo and farther into the Solar System than any humans have gone before. And get an inside look at the preparations needed to overcome the extreme engineering challenges of human-crewed spaceflight, all the way from launch to splashdown.

metas.name: Curious Friend
metas.description: A hedgehog meets a child who has lost a loved one.

metas.name: Inside the Dream: Audemars Piguet
metas.description: A secretive and codified world, Haute Horlogerie rarely invites cameras behind the scenes. For the first time, Audemars Piguet opens its doors, unveiling the creation of a unique timepiece. In the heart of the Vallée de Joux, designers, artisans, watchmakers and engineers come together to push the limits of their craft and bring an exceptional watch to life.

metas.name: Don't Make Me Bless You
metas.description: Don't Make Me Bless You is a gripping urban drama about Raine, a salon owner who falls for Dre, a charming ex-con rebuilding his life after prison. a dangerous cycle of control and violence, forcing Raine to confront the truth about love.

metas.name: Orange Peel
metas.description: While walking through a market, a girl’s eye is caught by an orange. However, her whole world unravels when she loses it.

metas.name: Providence
metas.description: Erica Schreiner short.

metas.name: Brad Wenzel: Desperate Times
metas.description: Full stand up special from comedy's own, Brad Wenzel.  Brad Wenzel is a product of the Detroit Comedy scene, spent a 7 year stint in Los Angeles, and over the last 15 years has toured the country performing in 38 states. Wenzel has made 3 stand-up appearances on CONAN and more recently performed on Netflix is a Joke Radio and Don't Tell Comedy. His 2017 debut comedy album Sweet Nothings was released on Jack White’s rock label, Third Man Records and can be heard on SiriusXM.
