metas.description: In a chance encounter over a bag of Adderall,  two neurodivergent women form an unlikely romantic bond which questions if love is real for people like them.

metas.name: Million Dollar Tiger
metas.description: After a Kung Fu master spots them in a TV commercial, two reckless car salesmen are sent on a dangerous mission to rescue a stolen tiger from a powerful villain and deliver it to a sacred temple in China.

metas.name: Mary Contrary
metas.description: Welcome to haunted walks! Where Alastair Duncan takes you on a tour of some of the most haunted spaces in England. This episode he tells the tragic story of Mary Contrary, as he walks through the woods where she met her grisly fate...

metas.name: Eddie Cochran: Don't Forget Me
metas.description: Despite his brief 21 years, Cochran’s musical legacy resonates across generations and genres, influencing icons from David Bowie to The Sex Pistols. His timeless hits like “C’mon Everybody” and “Summertime Blues” continue to shape the soundtracks of countless lives. This landmark documentary explores Cochran’s journey from country roots to rock & roll pioneer, showcasing his profound impact on music history, including his influence on legends ranging from The Beatles to Rod Stewart to Yungblud.

metas.name: If I Can't Have You
metas.description: Lust evolves into obsession when a married man embarks on an affair with a seductive and enigmatic woman who soon realizes he'll never leave his wife.

metas.name: Steakout!
metas.description: Sean's going to a steak dinner. Patrick's going to a stakeout. Unfortunately they're both in the same car.

metas.name: Chasing Glory
metas.description: Nigel Hayes-Davis is chasing more than just a title: he's seeking balance amid the constant pressure of high-performance sports. In the demanding EuroLeague, where every game can define a career, mental exhaustion becomes just as critical as physical fatigue. Throughout the 2024-2025 season with Fenerbahçe Beko, Hayes-Davis faces self-doubt, external expectations, and the invisible burden of leadership. Anxiety, the need to stay focused, and the fear of failure are part of his daily life, forcing him to also work on his emotional strength: mental discipline, resilience, and self-control.

metas.name: I'll Always Be There
metas.description: As a man watches his husband’s mind fade, their shadows come to life to reenact cherished memories and spark a final moment of recognition.

metas.name: Journeys
metas.description: A deep dive into the rapidly expanding world of Psilocybin Psychedelic Therapy. How it's being used in large (Heroic) and microdose form for PTSD, depression, end-of-life care, as well as the science, ethics and structure of the practice.

metas.name: A Score in Absence
metas.description: At seventeen, Ukrainian pianist Khrystyna has already fled war twice: first from Crimea, and then from Irpin as Russia’s invasion advanced. With her brother still in Ukraine under martial law, she turns to music to find agency in exile.

metas.name: After/Still
metas.description: Inspired by The Bell Jar, after / still follows two friends at a crossroads, capturing the quiet tension of choosing one life among many, where unfulfilled possibilities linger, yet connection and continuity endure beyond distance and change.

metas.name: RMH15: Back To Me
metas.description: After a summer away, Felix returns to campus with a new mindset, new friends and the same ex boyfriend. After running into each other at a party Montgomery and Felix have to decide if this is love or a thing of the past.

metas.name: Yellow
metas.description: ‘Yellow’ is a project by Filippo Cinotti Shot entirely with: Canon C500MKII Nikkor AI-S lenses Evaluated in Davinci Resolve 20 Extra tools: LensNode

metas.name: Clownspiracy
metas.description: A small town high school misfit investigates the appearance of creepy clowns before an upcoming election, discovering the clowns are more than they appear.

metas.name: You, Me & Tuscany
metas.description: When a woman crashes at an empty Italian villa, posing as the owner's fiancée, she discovers an unexpected romance that could transform her life.

metas.name: Sound Asleep
metas.description: When an insomniac reaches breaking point, he goes to war with every sound in his home - no matter the cost.  Deen Peels needs sleep, but the world just won't shut up. The ticks, clicks and drips are driving him insane, and the shagging through the walls is just too much. Over one relentless night, he's determined to take back control, even if it kills him. Silence isn't golden; it's war.

metas.name: Maddie's Secret
metas.description: Maddie is a plucky dishwasher who leaps to viral superstardom at a trendy food content creation company. While her life seems picturesque — complete with an adoring husband, ride-or-die best friend and a cupboard full of woman-owned ethically-sourced chili crisp to boot — mounting professional pressures threaten to reawaken a hidden secret from her troubled past.

metas.name: La Serenissima
metas.description: La Serenissima drifts through the mythic and material layers of Venice, tracing a lineage of women who refused to remain ornamental in a city built on spectacle. Against the shifting tides and mirrored surfaces of the lagoon, the film evokes figures such as Veronica Franco, the Renaissance poet and courtesan who wielded language as power; Luisa Casati, the avant-garde muse who turned her own life into a living artwork; and Peggy Guggenheim, the modern patron who transformed Venice into a sanctuary for radical art.

metas.name: It's Not That Deep
metas.description: A young director and an actor start arguing about what film is during a shooting of the director’s debut film for a festival. Their argument takes them all over their neighborhood and slowly distorts both of their perceptions of reality.

metas.name: Dunvegan
metas.description: Story about creation as told by the Dunne-za people of northern Alberta. Richard Reeves' animation excerpt, which was originally commissioned as part of "Dunvegan: Where the Trails Cross".

metas.name: Voice Messages From My Mom
metas.description: Inspired by Chantal Akerman’s News From Home, this intimate short film follows a Nigerian student in the Netherlands as she receives a series of WhatsApp voice messages from her mother. While we hear the mother’s voice, we see the daughter moving through her routines in Maastricht. As the voice messages accumulate, they reveal the emotional complexities between a mother and daughter living in different worlds. The contrast between the voice and the visuals reveal the unspoken tension between them: love expressed through control, sacrifice that becomes expectation, and the loneliness that can grow between two people who are always in contact but no longer fully connected.The film explores what it means to be loved by someone who doesn’t entirely understand you, and the emotional burden that can come with that love.

metas.name: Kaupungin synty
metas.description: How did Turku become Finland’s oldest city? An eager reporter sets out to find out why and on what grounds the city of Turku will celebrate its 800th anniversary in 2029.

metas.name: DIVINE BURDEN
metas.description: After a young man confesses to taking the lives of his parents in the name of the lord to bring them to god faster, a priest wrestles with the weight of this sin while the killer plans his next attack.

metas.name: Misophonia
metas.description: When Martin is fired and subsequently forced to move in with his sister following a Misophonia outburst at work, he sets out on a comically disgruntled mission to identify ways he might manage his Misophonia and get his life back on track.

metas.name: Don't Be Weird
metas.description: A casual evening gathering between friends quickly spirals into an awkward ordeal when unexpected personal revelations clash with unfolding global chaos. As tensions rise and social boundaries blur, the group must navigate a series of bizarre interruptions that challenge their attempts to maintain a normal vibe.

metas.name: DRAGON BALL Z: BUU, GOD OF DESTRUCTION
metas.description: Majin Buu is back… and this time, he has the power of a God of Destruction.  When a terrifying cosmic disturbance shakes the universe and Beerus suddenly disappears, Goku realizes the nightmare is real: Majin Buu has returned, stronger and more dangerous than ever. As entire worlds begin to go silent, Earth becomes the next target, forcing Goku, Vegeta, Gohan, and Piccolo into a desperate battle against a power that should never exist.  Dragon Ball Z: Buu, God of Destruction is a live-action fan film inspired by classic DBZ, built around god-level stakes, brutal fights, emotional character moments, and a terrifying “What if Buu Absorbed Beerus” premise: what happens when Buu evolves beyond anything the Z Fighters have faced before?

metas.name: Question Mark
metas.description: A man finds a mysterious box on the train, and wants to return it.

metas.name: Formal Crutch
metas.description: A broken ankle won’t stop Maddie’s sorority sisters from making sure she shines at their 80s-themed semi-formal.

metas.name: The Resurrection of Christ
metas.description: The story of Jesus Christ has been portrayed countless times throughout the history of cinema, from the chaste and embryonic staging of the silent film era to the frenetic dynamism of the digital age at the beginning of the 21st century. Death and rebirth are present in a perpetual cycle in which the sacred myth is transformed into the product of a spiritual franchise.

metas.name: DON'T PLAY DUM
metas.description: Cody, a house sitter, is happily playing video games with his friend Spencer. Then Johnny Carmichael shows up.

metas.name: Trees, exist
metas.description: A man sets out on a journey to discover his true self, only to encounter an unexpected companion who guides him toward the answers he’s looking for.

metas.name: England, Meet England: Red Roses Story
metas.description: A documentary looking at the England women's rugby union team's unbeaten 2025 World Cup championship run. It offers behind-the-scenes access to their training, personal journeys and ultimate victory, following a campaign aiming to boost awareness of the team

metas.name: Reborn
metas.description: A Cement-Man seeks revenge on his archnemesis: Yo-Yo girl.

metas.name: The Chase
metas.description: Sometimes you run. Sometimes you chase.

metas.name: Canard
metas.description: A woman who claims to be a survivor of a ritual sacrifice recounts the night of the crime to a jaded detective, who must determine whether she is truly the sole survivor, or the only witness left for a reason.

metas.name: Strings: A Documentary
metas.description: A documentary about the Yo Yo Killer

metas.name: A Trash Life
metas.description: A man tries to track down the Trash Man

metas.name: Blister
metas.description: Trapped alone in a haunted room, a paranormal researcher’s experiment goes horrifically wrong.

metas.name: Out
metas.description: What would a queer world imagined look like? I bet it would be colourful.

metas.name: Watching Mr. Pearson
metas.description: When a once famous actor can no longer decipher the past from the present, two devoted caretakers discover that imagination and performance may be the only way to help him reconnect with the world that's left him behind.

metas.name: Goblin Sighting
metas.description: A fear-obsessed freelance cameraman investigates an urban legend involving a mysterious goblin recluse that has taken refuge inside of an abandoned observatory.

metas.name: GATE CRASHERS
metas.description: Hoping to impress a date with borrowed luxury, an insecure bachelor invites a date to a backyard pool he's secretly "pool-sitting", only to trigger a humiliating chain reaction that exposes how far he'll go to fake belonging.

metas.name: Pastor's: Our Garage Could Be Your Life
metas.description: Amidst a drought of independently run spaces and DIY venues in the seacoast area, Colin Grady and Nate Pastor put their heads together.  Pastor’s, the small ME-based DIY venue would come back, stronger than ever. Despite the hurdles and roadblocks that were thrown their way, the space thrived: people were starving for spaces like this. With each show the turnout grew, breathing life into the garage, and stoking a fire in the minds of the Pastor’s crew. How big could the shows get?  Many more hours were spent lovingly assembling this piece weaving in and out of maximalist edits of performances from many of the artists who touched down on that spot of concrete in Berwick, ME, all captured through lo-fi voice memos and the lenses of obsolete cameras, and transferred to Hi8 and MiniDV tapes. Why the old cameras? Because this is something that could happen anywhere and at anytime. This is the story of a garage full of life - and how you could be a part of it.

metas.name: All I can do is wait
metas.description: A filmmaker uncovers the letters her grandmother received from her Czechoslovak lover, who was imprisoned in a detention camp after the Spanish Civil War.

metas.name: Septum
metas.description: On the day after Halloween, a college film student encounters a stranger and plays a game of rock-paper-scissors. Then they transform into multiple personas while pondering their own personal experiences and relationships.

metas.name: Sacrifice
metas.description: At an elite fundraising gala, celebrities and socialites find themselves in danger when armed activists storm the venue in pursuit of a legendary relic that could unlock supernatural powers.

metas.name: Becoming Elephant: The Orphans of Reteti
metas.description: Becoming Elephant: The Orphans of Reteti is set in the wild north of Kenya, where a groundbreaking blueprint in conservation is under way. This touching documentary follows the remarkable journey of orphaned elephants at Reteti Elephant Sanctuary, the first community-owned and -operated elephant sanctuary in Africa. These young elephants, rescued after losing their mothers to accidents, drought, or human-wildlife violence, are raised by Samburu men and women who care for them as their own. They nurture these young elephants with patience, care, and deep ancestral knowledge to get them back on their feet and ready for life in the wild. From tiny calves taking their first bottles from their human carers, to adolescents preparing for release, this film captures the elephants’ intimate moments of struggle, healing, and transformation. It also shows how local community members are creating a unique, thoughtful new model of conservation from the ground up.

metas.name: Valediction
metas.description: A teenage overachiever battles her classmates for the title of valedictorian.

metas.name: Honor Rollers
metas.description: A corrupt student government is exposed as an underground crime ring.

metas.name: Restless Sleeper
metas.description: Restless Sleeper is about an alien who can’t sleep at night. She stays up playing video games until she hears a noise outside her window. She jumps out of her window, leaving the safety of her home behind.

metas.name: Fragmented
metas.description: Following a traumatic accident, Miguel is left in a fractured psychological state where memory, perception, and imagination begin to overlap. As fragmented recollections surface-anchored by emotionally significant moments with a close friend-he struggles to distinguish between what is real and what is constructed by his mind. Seeking clarity, he attempts to organize these experiences into a coherent internal narrative, treating them as disjointed pieces of a larger unresolved whole.

metas.name: Holt II
metas.description: A man stumbles into a remote winter cabin seeking refuge. Days pass in isolation until a stranger from his past appears. With unfinished business between them, the two men are forced to confront what was left unresolved.

metas.name: StationBreaks
metas.description: Shot rather surreptitiously in train stations in NYC, Philadelphia, and Baltimore. All sound was recorded on location. Shot almost entirely with an IPhone.

metas.name: Firecracker
metas.description: Jaeron, whose birthday is the Fourth of July, celebrates every year watching the fireworks with his family. However, on his 12th birthday, a serious thunderstorm upsets familiar plans. Jaeron holds out hope, but doubt creeps in, and he begins to question whether his family still cares about him now that he’s older — intensifying what will become his most defining birthday yet.

metas.name: MUDRAT - SOCIAL COHESION LIVE!
metas.description: SOCIAL COHESION LIVE! brings live experience of a MUDRAT show into the home, capturing MUDRAT’s sold-out hometown performance at The Northcote Social Club during the SOCIAL COHESION Tour in September 2025.

metas.name: Tragic Villain
metas.description: After the devastating loss of their infant daughter, Maria and Avery Brooks struggle to survive the quiet devastation that grief leaves behind. Once vibrant and full of life, Maria retreats into silence, while Avery-desperate to fix what feels irreparably broken-searches for any solution that might restore the woman he loves. As outside help enters their home, fragile emotions begin to shift in unexpected ways. What starts as an attempt to heal slowly exposes buried loneliness, unmet needs, and dangerous vulnerabilities. Love becomes complicated.

metas.name: Late Bloomer
metas.description: 30-year-old Harper Muller has always been a Late Bloomer, so when cervical cancer turns her life plans upside-down, she recruits her two best friends to sleep with her so she can lose her virginity. It’s a weird ask; believe her, she knows! But hey, what are friends for?

metas.name: Homebodies
metas.description: In a near future where it literally costs money to leave the house, a burnt-out woman risks fraud when she pays her live-in boyfriend's 'exit toll' to get some alone time.

metas.name: Call Collecting
metas.description: Built from real voicemails left by strangers, Call Collecting is a hauntingly beautiful visual poem. By pairing intimate audio with evocative vertical cinematography, this piece explores the invisible threads that connect us all in a digital age.

metas.name: Rob
metas.description: Two colleagues are unexpectedly sent to a local mall by their boss with one goal- steal the cash from a successful retailer. However, their different work styles clash, and with the clock ticking, tensions rise, putting the job and their futures in jeopardy...

metas.name: Renee Groux: "We're Not Friends"
metas.description: "We're Not Friends" is the debut comedy special and album from Canadian stand-up comedian Renee Groux. Her debut special has her celebrating and shaking her fist at the ups and downs of parenting and marriage. Seen at the Guelph Comedy Festival, Don't Tell Comedy, Fever Dream Comedy and the Edinburgh Fringe Festival, Renee's comedy is smart, upbeat and raunchy as she takes you through her first years of parenting her toddler while trying to stay cool/relevant/feminist/sane!

metas.name: Art Cinema for Tots: Journeys
metas.description: Born out of a commitment to the idea that it’s never too early to introduce kids to the pleasures of movies made outside of the commercial mainstream—and the suspicion that young audiences are often more open-minded and curious than their elders when it comes to such matters—Metrograph presents the latest iteration of Art Cinema for Tots, a celebration of handcrafted, kid-friendly films that reconcile the smart and the silly. In this edition, join us for Journeys, a suite of enchanting, adventurous shorts, including Charlie Chaplin’s early silent family outing gone awry, A Day’s Pleasure, and Hermína Týrlová’s lively stop-motion animation The Little Train, about a cheeky little coal train who gets tired of working and attempts to set off to see the world!

metas.name: The World's Tallest Man: The Next Chapter
metas.description: Fifteen years after becoming a global phenomenon, The World's Tallest Man: The Next Chapter follows Sultan Kösen as he faces the true cost of life as the world's tallest man -- exploring whether fame and love delivered the future he dreamed of.

metas.name: A day trip to Bath with my talking stage
metas.description: A handsome man takes a peaceful day trip to the city of Bath with his talking stage (now girlfriend)

metas.name: Bushes' Big Business
metas.description: Nearing the final debate for the US presidential election, candidate Donald Bushes discovers the ability to reset the day. Bushes tests the structure of reality while manipulating the day to gain more popularity for the election, leading to serious consequences.

metas.name: Eclipse
metas.description: Eclipse is the first ever film to show a total solar eclipse in realtime without a filter—an achievement only possible on film.

metas.name: When The Sun Shines At Night
metas.description: During a chaotic Halloween night, two lonely strangers drift out of suffocating relationships, and toward each other, after a tarot reading hints that fate might show up when the sun shines at night.

metas.name: Bound By Me
metas.description: While the gang fantasizes about money and girls, Melvin searches for identity in the one and only thing he cares about: chess boxing.

metas.name: Train To Knowhere
metas.description: A man has the same dream every night.

metas.name: The Salinas Decoder
metas.description: It is August 8th, 1969 and a teacher from North Salinas High School, along with his wife solve one of the ciphers sent to San Francisco Chronicles by the Zodiac Killer, not realizing they turned him into a legend.

metas.name: Martyr!
metas.description: Based on the first few pages of the book with the same title, this short film brings us into the life of a Cyrus, a queer Iranian-American dealing with depression and addiction who becomes obsessed with the idea of martyrdom.

metas.name: Hands Up Who'd Like a Hug?
metas.description: An oddball young millionaire who can't make friends, sobers up a homeless drunk in an effort to make him his first friend.

metas.name: The School of Rocky
metas.description: A short film about a Rocky Horror Picture Show shadow cast and the Queer community built around it.

metas.name: Myrna's Deal with the Dead
metas.description: In the seventh installment of this telenovela-style comedy series, Myrna is desperately searching for Baby Oscur, the missing heir to the family fortune—stolen by her arch-nemesis, Kittay. Out of options and at her wits’ end, Myrna seeks help from her longtime friend Dixie Longate, a psychic whose séances offer a hilariously unconventional path to the truth. A wild journey to Texas sets off a chain of unexpected revelations as Myrna uncovers not only the mystery of Baby Oscur’s whereabouts, but surprising truths about herself. Secrets unravel, loyalties shift, and—as always in Myrna’s chaotic world—another unfortunate soul ends up dead

metas.name: You Used To Be Around
metas.description: When Rumi unexpectedly sees her ex-boyfriend, Nate, an unresolved confrontation spirals into a chilling revelation, forcing her to confront a truth far more terrifying than heartbreak.

metas.name: Story Drive: Voices Unveiled
metas.description: Story Drive: Voices Unveiled is a hybrid-documentary that showcases real-life anonymous LGBTQIA+ voicemails and adapts them into a cinematic experience contrasting personal, raw, and at times emotional testimonies with otherworldly, whimsical, and experimental animation.

metas.name: Or Forever Hold Your Peace
metas.description: Evelyn, a down-on-her-luck Maid of Honour already on thin ice with the wedding party, must go to extreme lengths to save the Big Day after learning of the Best Man's plan to sabotage the ceremony and profess his love for the bride.

metas.name: Ping
metas.description: Ping sits on his rooftop, looking out into the sea of cold light which emits a plumy glow. This darkness makes Ping’s heart still and mind blank. This existential pigeon digesting in quietness, longs to fly to greater heights, especially after an unforgettable dream.

metas.name: MUSIK
metas.description: Frances Barber stars as Billie Trix — icon, radical, existentialist, and complete disaster — in this bold and hilarious one-woman odyssey through the 20th and 21st centuries. From post-war Berlin to the New York art scene, from folk duos to disco comebacks, Billie Trix has done it all — often naked, usually high, and always on her own terms. Drawing on her warped memories, lost loves, and chaotic career, Billie delivers a savage, surreal monologue that collides memoir, stand-up, and cabaret. Blending monologue with original songs by The Pet Shop Boys, MUSIK is a genre- defying exploration of fame, failure, and fierce individuality — wrapped in sequins and spiked with satire. At once riotous and poignant, this cult show returns as a filmed stage event that cements Billie Trix’s place in the pantheon of outsider icons. As she says herself: "I am music. Ich bin Musik. Without me, there is nothing."

metas.name: Fragment of sometime, somewhere
metas.description: A young man and woman say goodbye to one another in an abstract representation of an apartment entrance. He is leaving. They struggle to separate. They exchange a piece of paper, which hints at their past together, as a farewell gift.

metas.name: The Adventures Of Tony & Raj
metas.description: Two amateur detectives, Tony and Raj, take on their biggest case yet when they come face-to-face with their arch-nemesis, Tex Shotter. Despite being in over their heads, they must work together to stop him and save the world.

metas.name: First Feature
metas.description: Intrepid student filmmaker Thomas Reilly-King (affectionately known as TRK) will do anything to complete his first feature film, aptly titled ENDURING DESTINY. Searching for fame in a production spanning several years, the unflappable writer/director/actor calls in every favor and spends every last dime to realize his vision and bring his hero's story to the big screen.

metas.name: Knotted
metas.description: A young woman returns to her hometown after failing to land a job post-graduation, only to be thrown into a serving job at her past acquaintance's wedding.

metas.name: Our Last Time
metas.description: After a college student returns to China and his grandparents, he begins exploring the idea of death in an introspective journey to understand what it means to exist.

metas.name: An Evening Song (for Three Voices)
metas.description: 1939, in the Midwest: an impeded author, her pulp-writer husband and their pious maid. A spellbinding plunge into their intertwined thoughts, memories and visions.

metas.description: A short montage of nautical life in Hull, Massachusetts.

metas.name: Casual Link.
metas.description: Meet Thomas, a young man who's got his life pretty much sorted out, he's got a stable job, a loving girlfriend and he's even passed his driving test! However, something is missing in his life, his ex-best friend, who he hasn't spoken to since the end of his GCSEs. On a random Saturday morning spent with his girlfriend, Thomas gets a call from a familiar friend, asking him to go on a day out...

metas.name: Andrew Ivimey - Let’s Go
metas.description: Laugh out loud with Andrew Ivimey in his full stand-up comedy special LET’S GO — a hilarious, high-energy, and brutally honest performance packed with sharp observations, relatable storytelling, and nonstop laughs.

metas.name: A Date with Shirley
metas.description: Dir. Ken Jacobs. 2025, 48 mins. U.S. Digital. This colorful and cubist record of a Chinatown haircut is the final long-form work by the great avant-garde filmmaker Ken Jacobs, who died last October. As with his first film, Orchard Street (1955), made 70 years earlier, A Date with Shirley is a slice of New York City life that transforms urban energy into cinematic spectacle. Three cameras capture the action, one operated by Ken as he is having his Einstein-ian locks shorn, and the others by his children, Aza and Nisi. A loving and poignant family scene, the film is also a dazzling work of art—and a tribute to a fine barber whose phone number is offered in the credits

metas.name: Redacted - The Untold Story of Bun Bun
metas.description: The Untold Story of Bun Bun is a found footage short film, pieced together from a recovered tape that was never meant to be seen

metas.name: People's Emergency Briefing
metas.description: Last November, ten of the UK’s leading experts briefed an invited audience of over 1,200 politicians and leaders from business, culture, faith, sport and the media. The briefing set out the implications of climate and nature breakdown for health, food systems, national security and the economy.  The People's Emergency Briefing presents the national implications of climate and nature breakdown - along with credible, positive responses - in a single, accessible account. A new film featuring Chris Packham, leading scientists, a former general and Jennifer Saunders - all being far too frank about where things are heading and what can be done about it.

metas.name: Eden Sher: I Was On A Sitcom
metas.description: Riotous and deeply personal, Eden Sher’s debut comedy special is a show about finding out who you are when your TV show ends and your "real life" begins. Because when you've played a character on TV for a decade, what exactly does it mean to "be yourself?” Living at the intersection of stand-up, storytelling and theatrical chaos, this solo show offers a rare intimate glimpse inside a popular sitcom actor’s real, raw life. Sher dives headfirst into the identity crisis that followed nine years of playing the same character—and what happens when a nurse recognizes you while in the middle of your emergency C-section.  Whether you're a die-hard Middle fan or have no idea who Eden Sher is (she will explain), I Was On A Sitcom is a wild, hilarious, and oddly moving ride through fame, identity, and a harrowing surprise twin pregnancy.

metas.name: Ray O'Leary Laughter? I Hardly Know Her!
metas.description: Ray O’Leary pulled a man from a wrecked car and as the man lay dying, he used his last ounce of strength to ask Ray to tell his children that he loved them. And Ray will get round to it but first he has to do this comedy show.

metas.name: An Apple a Day (Keeps the Doctor Away)
metas.description: A Doctor prescribes patients struggling with dietary issues fast food, and is confronted by his ultimate enemy.

metas.name: Chicken Feet
metas.description: Michelle and Ben have a big announcement. Lynn and Chris? Front row seats. What was meant to be a celebratory dim sum lunch quickly gives way to an unbearably cringeworthy ten minutes that nobody at the table asked for. Sharp, uncomfortable, and darkly humorous, "Chicken Feet" deconstructs the entitlement and desperate search for validation that simmer beneath the surface of modern social dynamics - making it all a little hard to swallow.

metas.name: Pushing Boulder: A Mark-umentary
metas.description: Pushing Boulder: A comedy doc that follows Mark Normand from NYC to Dallas for a weekend of 10 shows in an attempt to refine jokes and rework punchlines or as he says "turn every B into and A" for his Netflix taping in Boulder, CO two weeks later. We watch the green room hangs and the riffing process on the road all the way up to crafting a bit in-between tapings; Only to find himself back in NYC again back at zero.  Keep pushing that rock Mark.

metas.name: Ding, Dong, Die!
metas.description: Ally Clement is throwing an intimate Halloween party for her closest friends. But before the festivities can really begin, a stranger drops by with a Halloween treat of her own.

metas.name: LEENA 23:39
metas.description: LEENA 22:39  a lit awesome film. 4/7/26  Directed by Leena Çorbaji

metas.name: The Deal: Trump Bukele & The Gangs of El Salvador
metas.description: Three months after President Donald Trump returned to office in 2025 and began his major immigration crackdown, he held a White House sit-down with a popular Latin American leader who had once called himself the world's coolest dictator.  As the documentary explores, Bukele opened the doors of the notorious Salvadoran prison known as CECOT to planeloads of mostly Venezuelan U.S. deportees that the Trump administration had swept up and accused of being gang members. Later reporting would reveal that most of the men had no criminal convictions in the U.S. or proven gang affiliations.

metas.name: Untold: Chess Mates
metas.description: Magnus Carlsen, widely regarded as the greatest chess player of all time, is challenged by Hans Niemann, a rising star who capitalizes on the meteoric growth of online chess. Niemann’s ascension culminated in an epic, controversy-shrouded victory over Carlsen at the 2022 Sinquefield Cup, which eventually led to allegations and revelations of cheating. Determined to clear his name, Niemann fights his way back to the top of the chess world, setting the stage for a high-stakes rematch with Carlsen in 2024.

metas.name: Before It’s Too Late
metas.description: “Before It’s Too Late” is a short film about teenagers facing bullying, heartbreak, and the pressures of growing up. Peter, a sensitive and struggling teen, and Lara, his friend, navigate the challenges of friendship, relationships, and personal hardships. Through moments of despair and hope, the story highlights the importance of support, understanding, and faith in Jesus Christ during life’s toughest moments.

metas.name: Precious
metas.description: When an insurance clerk discovers a mysterious shop where priceless antiques can be purchased in exchange for years of his life, he’s forced to contemplate the true value of his youth.

metas.name: This Is Birmingham
metas.description: When Birmingham crime boss Al Kaleo is jailed for murder, his estranged son AK steps up to prove himself. But as he rises, a ruthless Turkish gang from London floods the city with a deadly new drug, igniting a brutal turf war. With chaos on the streets, AK faces a fight not just for control-but for the soul of the city and everything he stands for.

metas.name: Sports Heaven: The Birth of ESPN

As clues begin to unfold, the agent must uncover the truth behind a hidden operation before time runs out. In a world of secrets and deception, trusting the wrong person could change everything.

metas.name: Outcome

metas.description: Crowd work special by Trevor Wallace

metas.name: Memories and Miseries
metas.description: Memories and Miseries follows the introspective journey of a soul who is caught between divinity and the complications of human emotion. Lying by the riverside, the soul revisits scattered periods of its life: one as a writer exploring the human condition and another as a priest scarred by war. Through abstract visuals and fragmented narratives, the film explores the interwoven threads of memory, fate and the eternal struggles between transcendence and suffering. Each life, a moment in the soul’s quest for meaning, leaves behind traces of joy, pain and redemption. Memories and Miseries offers a meditative experience that captures the duality of existence- the profound connection between spirituality and deeply misunderstood human memory and identity.

metas.name: The Everest Dream

metas.name: How Lonyo Shaped UK Garage

metas.description: On Easter day Nez, Tam, and Ren, receive a mysterious package containing a strange rock from Champ Island after a failed mission abroad. As they joke and debate what to do with it, hints emerge that something may be alive inside.

metas.name: Finding Harry: The Craft Behind the Magic
metas.description: Featuring interviews from members of the casting, production design, costume design, and creature effects teams, follow the behind-the-scenes journey of bringing the Harry Potter books to the small screen. Find out how the new Golden Trio were found, and celebrate the commitment to detail of the artists, craftspeople, and technicians who have come together to bring the wizarding world to life.

metas.name: Bach: Passion Oratorio - Il Gardellino Ensemble
metas.description: As the leader of the Il Gardellino ensemble, harpsichordist Alexander Grychtolik performs and conducts Bach’s “Passion Oratorio,” a project that had been abandoned by the cantor. Based on the libretto written by the poet Picander, the musician conducted extensive research to reconstruct the score, parts of which were later incorporated into the “St. Matthew Passion.”

metas.name: Like Father, Like Kyle
metas.description: Kyle's estranged father pays him a visit.

metas.name: Lucy Schulman
metas.description: After a crushing breakup, Lucy moves back in with her eccentric single dad and dives into bad dates, false starts, and growing pains.

metas.name: The Edge of Existence
metas.description: Electronics lecturer, Cam Cameron, attempts to survive on the UK's most remote island, Rockall, for a record 50 days to prove his strength to himself and inspire his family.

metas.name: Friends: In Another Dimension
metas.description: A teen falls through a portal to a foreign dimension, which she discovers is under the control of a dangerous and immature king. An unfortunate series of events motivates her to plan a revolution.

metas.name: Bait and Twitch
metas.description: Sisters Dani and Bertie are at odds about helping their Aunt Cole prepare for a big event, the first Annual Gala for the Generic Tourette Organization, which broke fund-raising records due to an unfortunate PR fiasco.

metas.name: A Escolha De Ficar
metas.description: The Choice To Stay

metas.name: Persepolis : Before It Burned
metas.description: Persepolis—located in modern-day Iran —or Parsa, as the Persians called it , and step into its grand halls exactly as they were around 450 BC, right before its spectacular downfall. It’s not just about looking at buildings; we explore the massive artificial platform , the Gate of All Nations guarded by colossal stone bulls , and the magnificent Apadana audience hall at their absolute peak. We contrast that vibrant reality—where twenty-three different nations gathered during the Nowruz spring festival to share feasts and exchange tribute —with the scorched, silent ruins that remain today.

metas.name: Consumption
metas.description: A young person encounters a strange evil on their walk home.

metas.name: Zombie Land Saga LIVE - Yumeginga Festival
metas.description: Zombie Land Saga LIVE - Yumeginga Festival was Franchouchou's first concert in five years, which took place in April 2026. It lasted two days at the Pia Arena MM in Yokohama. It was related to the movie Zombie Land Saga: Yumeginga Paradise.

metas.name: Clay Bird
metas.description: A girl overcomes the shame of her heritage after her potter grandfather passes away.

metas.name: The Adventures of Jester Jill
metas.description: A short Vincent Alexander wrote, directed and animated about a court jester running riot all over a kingdom.

metas.name: I Have A Name
metas.description: I HAVE A NAME is a powerful, true-story-inspired drama that follows Gary and Lily as a simple act of compassion—taking in a young foster child—pulls them into a complex system that forever changes their lives. As they navigate the harsh realities of foster care, including abuse, separation, and trauma, the film offers a raw, honest look at a broken system while calling for awareness, compassion, and change.

metas.name: Look
metas.description: To look or not to look? That is the question an autistic woman faces when her difficulty making eye contact causes difficulties at her retail job.

metas.name: The Ticket
metas.description: When a small-time neighborhood dealer learns his lottery ticket is a winner, he and his best friend must battle friends, enemies, and pure chaos on the way to claim the prize.

metas.name: The masked ones
metas.description: A documentary experiment exploring what people are willing to do for money and a better life and how things can go completely off the rails

metas.name: Escaping Esau - The Ladder to Heaven
metas.description: Felix, the son of the Roman commander on the prison island of Patmos, is struggling to find meaning in life. Felix comes to John the Apostle for advice, and through the story of Esau and Jacob, John explains what is happening inside Felix. John points to the solution for Felix —and for anyone else who is longing for meaning and fellowship with our Creator. However, John’s solution is not easy to accept, and Felix has to go through inner struggles.

metas.name: So called "Short Film"
metas.description: A conflicted writer and an ambitious director navigate ego, control, and creative compromise.  Written, Directed & Edited by Ram Agnivesh  Cinematography by Chandan  CAST  Adi  Ram  Shamitha  Praveen  Pranathi  A Rififi boys short film

metas.name: On Dying of Dementia in a Capitalist System
metas.description: After a violent episode on Memorial Day, Jim was placed in memory care. 11 weeks later he died. This short film, made in partnership with Chilean animators Sebastián Bisbal and Natalie Johns, explores the contradiction between for-profit institutions and the deep humanity of care workers and residents. The piece ends in healing as the truth of observation changes understanding.

metas.name: Bill Bailey: Thoughtifier
metas.description: From polar bear raves to AI sea shanties and the collapse of the teaspoon industry, Bill Bailey leads a magical, musical mystery tour of the human mind in his 2025 stand-up show at Edinburgh Playhouse.

metas.name: Dead Wife Montage
metas.description: Robin is a painter, and Alex has a knack for video archiving their life together. With Alex filming Robin constantly, their shared joke about being a "dead movie wife montage" soon turns devastating when Alex must grieve Robin's passing with only her digital memories. Her only guide through this is one of Robin's talking paintings.

metas.name: Rise of the Dead: Grandmageddon
metas.description: A young woman uses necromancy to resurrect her grandmother so she can finally come out to her - but accidentally raises an entire army of zombie grandmas instead.

metas.name: Orange You Glad?
metas.description: The Food Police investigate a crime at Bates College.

metas.name: GCW: Maniac 2026
metas.description: GCW Maniac 2026 was a professional wrestling event promoted by Game Changer Wrestling (GCW), held on April 4, 2026 at The Ukrainian Culture Center, Los Angeles, CA,

metas.name: Alter - Nation
metas.description: When Donald Trump and Secret Service Agent 1 messed with time, they made a horrific dystopian reality, an alternate nation. In this reality, A curious man named Winston turns to John F. Kennedy for answers.

metas.name: Bahay-bahayan
metas.description: An OFW mom comes home to start anew with her cold and distant daughter. But to fix the present, they must face their old wounds together.

metas.name: Theatre of Magic
metas.description: Enter Brisbane’s Theatre of Magic at Rydges Hotel and discover an evening where elegance meets illusion. Recently crowned a 2025 TripAdvisor “Travellers’ Choice” Award winner and ranked among the top 10% of experiences worldwide, this hidden theatre features world-class magicians, a spellbinding selection of food and drink, and award winning sleight-of-hand artists. Don’t miss out—get your tickets today for Brisbane’s Theatre of Magic!

metas.name: Goonman
metas.description: After a particularly long game of Goon of Fortune, four friends make a wish upon a shooting star. The weekend that follows is beyond their wildest dreams, but have they bitten off more than they can chew?

metas.name: A$AP Rocky Songline
metas.description: A$AP Rocky brings hits from his latest album Don't Be Dumb alongside memorable classics and an in depth look at his creative process for an exclusive Amazon Music Songline.

metas.name: Sky and Sea
metas.description: In the process of preparing to move, Claira finds an old journal of hers telling a story of doomed love, causing her to reflect on her failed relationship and her feelings in the face of change.

metas.name: Deer
metas.description: Two childhood best friends fake a pre-wedding photoshoot in the city during their last night together in Cebu City, Philippines.

metas.name: Late Nights
metas.description: Late Night Mizzou, a club founded by freshmen Cam Koffel, aimed to revolutionize student journalism and comedy with weekly late-night shows filled with live and pre-recorded sketches, mimicking the professional shows they grew up idolizing. Now, entering its fourth year, Cam and his club members are confronted with the harsh reality that their club has barely captured the attention of their fellow students, let alone the national audience they envisioned. With graduation looming, Cam is in a desperate race against time to save their creation from oblivion amid waning student support, a changing industry and discrepancies within the club.

metas.name: WWE NXT Countdown To Stand & Deliver 2026
metas.description: A major 10-Person Mixed Tag Team Match will take place on the NXT Stand & Deliver Countdown Show. Women’s Speed Champion Wren Sinclair, Hank & Tank, Shiloh Hill and Eli Knight will team against TNA Knockouts Champion Arianna Grace, Channing “Stacks” Lorenzo, Lexis King, Uriah Connors and Charlie Dempsey. Birth Right have not been shy when it comes to sharing their feelings about their peers, and now the makeshift team of Superstars will aim to silence them once and for all. Which dream team will walk out of St. Louis with the victory?

metas.name: If in Winter
metas.description: On the streets of New York City’s Diamond District in the near future; Two best friends depend on each other to survive the winter, knowing that alone they wouldn’t last, and together might not be enough.

metas.name: NXT Stand & Deliver 2026
metas.description: Stand & Deliver 2026 was a professional wrestling event produced by World Wrestling Entertainment (WWE) for its NXT brand, held on April 4, 2026, at The Factory at The District in St. Louis, Missouri, marking the first edition to take place outside of WrestleMania week and NXT’s first standalone event to stream on YouTube in the United States. It was headlined by Joe Hendry (c) vs. Ethan Page vs. Ricky Saints vs. Tony D’Angelo in a Fatal Four Way match for the NXT Championship.

metas.name: Rescued by Faith: The Connie and Larry Van Oosten Story
metas.description: Connie and Larry Van Oosten are jolted awake by a masked gunman standing at the foot of their bed. Abducted from their home and locked inside a hidden bunker, the couple must endure days of torment.

metas.name: A Season to Blossom
metas.description: An aspiring writer takes over her late grandmother's bookstore and finds love.

metas.name: The Strawberry
metas.description: After a terminal diagnosis, Herb Kaplan seeks peace with his broken family and the joy he long overlooked. As old wounds heal and new bonds form, he learns to cherish the sweetness in front of him and say goodbye on his own terms.

metas.name: Hell Hath No Fury
metas.description: When Aidan, an agnostic psychiatrist, is turned away from his grieving wife by a mysterious temptress, he discovers their story may be eons in the making.

metas.name: Angels
metas.description: Paul Taylor, a middle-aged man, is devastated after losing something that meant the world to him. He decides to give up everything and to go and teach at a reform school for young teens in the hope he would come to understand the criminal mind of a child.

metas.name: It's All Vanity
metas.description: The earnest efforts of an event organizer are stifled by the selfish aims of her lead dancers in the hours leading up to a once-in-a-lifetime charity performance.

metas.name: Ensemble: The Documentary
metas.description: The Documentary follows a group of drama school students through the intensity, chaos, and intimacy of training as actors. Beneath rehearsals, performances, and long studio days lies a world rarely seen from the outside — one built on pressure, ambition, friendship, and vulnerability. Through candid behind-the-scenes footage and unexpected revelations, the film captures the blurred line between performance and reality, exposing the emotional highs and quiet fractures hidden within the ensemble.

metas.name: The Return of Arinzo
metas.description: A rising actor returning home with his fiancée to support his father's presidential campaign. Their return sparks a dangerous, 17-year-old scandal tied to a political figure, forcing buried secrets, betrayal, and the truth behind Arinzo's death into the open.

metas.name: Wat is Suriname
metas.description: Esther Figueroa composes a four-part work from 31 Surinamese films that focuses primarily on mining and the physical destruction of workers’ bodies; she reinforces this critique with activist song lyrics.

metas.name: Excerpts from a Plantocracy
metas.description: The Netherlands officially abolished slavery across its colonies on 1 July 1863. Yet in Sumatra’s plantation belt, Dutch authorities created a legal structure that granted plantation owners sweeping control over racialized migrant workers. Through the Coolie Ordinance and Penal Sanction, labourers could be imprisoned, fined, or subjected to corporal punishment. Planters relied on debt, coercion, and deception to recruit workers, while private police forces hunted down runaways and crushed resistance. European overseers were discouraged from bringing European women to the colonies, making Javanese women central to the domestic, reproductive, and sexual labour sustaining plantation life. This hidden structure of dependence remained largely absent from official colonial imagery. Combining archival propaganda footage, fragments of correspondence, and contemporary images, this two-channel installation reflects on the enduring violence and silences of Dutch colonialism.

metas.name: LOVER LOVE

A window is flung open and the gray wall of an apartment block dissolves into a turbulent, overcast sky, against which a smoky being is enveloped by a six-winged seraphim—an angel of the highest order.  This collaboratively scripted film moves between physical and virtual space: between performances in a motel room, a junkyard, and city streets amid surrounding nature, we can see desert plants blooming anthropomorphic appendages and souls escaping inhuman oppression to take transhuman flight.

metas.name: Sumatra, Jawa, Kalimantan (Gazes from the Colony)
metas.description: Amateur films occupy a peculiar space in the colonial film archive. They belong to the private drawers of personal history and family memory, yet they also provide a valuable record of how social conditions were shaped by class divisions and racial hierarchies. Amateur films reveal how deeply colonial power infiltrated every aspect of daily life. Sumatra, Jawa, Kalimantan (Gazes from the Colony) consists of amateur footage recorded on three islands during Dutch rule. Each island's distinctive imagery reveals a difterent facet of how colonialism operated. In Java, domestic and leisure activities are foregrounded, while in Sumatra and Kalimantan imagery is dominated by plantations and resource extraction. As visitors approach the screens, their bodies create shadows interrupting the film projection and inviting the audience to reflect on their own relationship to these images.

metas.name: Becoming Opaque
metas.description: Becoming Opaque exposes a shared visual language between former Dutch and Portuguese colonialists to create racial and gender stereotypes. Stitching together old propaganda films, ethnographic records, and home movies, Paula Albuquerque traces a lineage from earlier racial pseudoscience to Al-powered surveillance technologies. By programming a glitch, aspects of the image are deliberately obscured to protect the privacy of the subjects, who were filmed without their permission. The chairs in the exhibition space echo those of the footage showing an early twentieth century phrenologist* conducting studies in Sierra Leone, seen in her work.

But when Chioma's phone lights up with a message from the man she's been "talking to," something shifts. What begins as playful banter slowly turns into something more fragile. Beneath the laughter and kitchen chaos, Femi must confront feelings he has carefully buried, while Chioma wrestles with the safety of their friendship versus the possibility of something deeper. As the pancakes cook and tension rises, a single impulsive moment forces them to ask the question they've both been avoiding: are they just friends, or have they been pretending all along? In a story set entirely within the intimacy of a kitchen, Let's Make Pancakes explores vulnerability, timing, and the quiet risks required to choose love over comfort.

Featuring a Caucasian pitchman introducing the phrase “How Chee” and a group of amateur young actors repeating it, the ad became infamous. Some laughed. Others cringed. Many called it the worst commercial ever made.  Thirty years later, it still resurfaces—at one point even going viral in China.  How Chee! explores the unlikely origins of the ad, the friendship between an immigrant restaurant owner and the professor who tried to help save his business, and the now-adult actors who became locally famous long before going viral was a thing.

metas.name: The Cereal Aisle Effect
metas.description: On Thanksgiving Eve, a looming hurricane strands four strangers inside a small-town grocery market. As the storm stalls and tensions rise, secrets are unearthed, unexpected bonds form, and redemption emerges in the unlikeliest of aisles. A contained dramedy about connection, empathy, and the fragile humanity we find when forced to stop and face each other.

metas.name: Mastalghia
metas.description: A trans woman nonverbally processes the parts of her womanhood that seem to never stop being difficult (save for the glorious moments when they temporarily do.)

metas.name: Masked
metas.description: Masked exposes the often overlooked mental health battles of those on the Autism Spectrum. Chloe Cavelle shares her journey of learning to function in a world not built for her.

metas.name: Prelude to a Shakespearean Tragedy
metas.description: An actor and an actress discuss love and life while on set for a film adaptation of Shakespeare's "Measure for Measure", then tragedy strikes.

metas.name: Headstones
metas.description: A small-town funeral musician and aspiring writer, Lena Rosewell 'borrows' life stories of those whose funerals she attends, re-writing & publishing them as her own. When an enigmatic funeral crasher begins to take an interest in her, she must confront her own morality, and decide whether her lack of inspiration on the prairies is worth the weight of her creative choices.

metas.name: The Gamers: Dorkness Falls
metas.description: The Gamers: Dorkness Falls concludes the storyline that began with Dorkness Rising and continued through Hands of Fate. At the end of the last film, The Shadow—the nemesis of the players since the original Gamers —pulled the players into the game world itself.  What have the gamers been up to since then? Who is The Shadow*, and what are his plans? How have they managed to survive without powers or class levels? And will they ever find their way home? The answers, and so many familiar faces, will be found in Dorkness Falls.  * (The Shadow? The Shadow! The Shadow...)

metas.name: Resurrection
metas.description: In the wake of a traumatic incident at a funeral, an aging widow is faced with a bizarre, impossible choice.

metas.name: Selegna sol
metas.description: After several years of absence, Gibran returns to Los Angeles with the goal of saving up to purchase land in Tecate, the village where he was born in Mexico. As he organizes his departure, he rediscovers the emotional and historical ties that bind him to the United States.

metas.name: The Price I Pay For Hurting God's Favourite
metas.description: Fate intervenes when ex-lovers Alee and Chan unexpectedly reunite at a friend's out-of-town wedding. Their chance encounter rekindles a spark, but the truth threatens to unravel their connection.

metas.name: The Super Mario Galaxy Movie
metas.description: Having thwarted Bowser's previous plot to marry Princess Peach, Mario and Luigi now face a fresh threat in Bowser Jr., who is determined to liberate his father from captivity and restore the family legacy. Alongside companions new and old, the brothers travel across the stars to stop the young heir's crusade.

metas.name: We're Looking For People Who Do Huge Numbers On Social Media
metas.description: Beth Stelling delivers a candid stand-up performance, reflecting on life in Los Angeles, personal health journeys, and the nuances of modern relationships. From navigating the world of egg freezing to sharing humorous encounters on the dating scene, Stelling offers a sharp and relatable perspective on the complexities of adulthood.

metas.name: Why Inventing Color TV Was So Difficult
metas.description: Did you know that color TV existed decades before it became mainstream? In this video, we explore the incredible story behind how television evolved from blurry black-and-white to vibrant color broadcasts, and why it took nearly 50 years to make the switch. Watch to the end to learn about the innovations, challenges, and clever tricks that made it possible to transmit color without replacing millions of existing TVs.

metas.name: Doctor OmniPotent - The Second Awakening
metas.description: A retired hero has been sulking in his house for days on end. He reminisces about the past, terrified to return to his old self. Will he go back to healing the world?

metas.name: Quiet Pages
metas.description: In today's world, we can easily become distracted by worldly things. It's important to remember to take a break, even daily, to read, or go outside, or both.

metas.name: Sonia Wieder-Atherton: Or  @ Philharmonie de Paris
metas.description: Juggling light and shadow, the Franco-American cellist Sonia Wieder-Atherton alternately reinterprets François Couperin’s *Leçons de Ténèbres* and Vivaldi’s sun-drenched compositions in a performance of rare elegance.

metas.name: Due Diligence
metas.description: Every night, he tells the world what’s wrong with it. Eventually, it starts to change him.  Due Diligence is a psychological indie short film about ambition, identity, and the quiet pressure to choose a life before you’re ready.  After delivering another routine news segment, a young broadcaster finds himself caught between stability and creative freedom. As conversations blur and perspectives collide, he’s forced to confront a question he’s been avoiding:  Is he building a life or drifting into one?  Exploring themes of burnout, societal expectation, and the fear of falling behind, Due Diligence captures the internal conflict of a generation trying to balance security with meaning.

metas.name: The Shower
metas.description: A boy witnesses a shower game turn into a violating act.

metas.name: SYDNEY HIMH JOSEPH VANOYE CUT
metas.description: A short film shot in Sydney, showcasing four pieces of music from an earlier version of Kevin Abstract's 'Honey In My Hair'.

metas.name: TOUCH TANK
metas.description: Two girls who couldn't be more different share a cigarette at a party.

metas.name: Memory Shop
metas.description: Film is a man who runs a photography shop he inherited from his father, who has passed away. In the midst of a struggling economy, he decides that he wants to sell the shop. While searching through old belongings, he comes across an old medium format film camera.

metas.name: you are dead.
metas.description: sit and enjoy the sunrise.

metas.name: The Goldfish
metas.description: A social media influencer loses everything after a viral crash-out, revealing the true cost of fame.

metas.name: Megan Gailey: Live From My Driveway
metas.description: When comedian Megan Gailey set out to film her first hour long special the goal was to make it special! To Megan that meant shooting in her own driveway in front of fans, her husband and toddler. And being 8 months pregnant.

metas.name: Rotting
metas.description: A short film about my struggle with anxiety, especially with  my 20th birthday coming up. It is my goodbye to the teenage years, that I always dreamed of, but never been able to experience. And the hope of a better adulthood.

metas.name: Sang-eo
metas.description: A traveling Korean surfer, named Sang-eo, comes into conflict with a racist local, who challenges him to a surf competition in shark infested waters.

metas.name: So Long, Farewell
metas.description: As Gus prepares to leave his hometown for good, he befriends Trevor, the man living in his childhood home.

metas.name: Negative Space
metas.description: A perfectionist attempts to make contact with the keeper of "the perfect idea" in a surreal pursuit to complete her project.

metas.name: Sam Wants Her Sweater Back
metas.description: Three queer friends launch a half-witted heist to steal back a sweater from one of their exes. But recovering from heartbreak isn't quite the slick-lit, neon-noir adventure one of them imagines.

metas.name: Morning Star
metas.description: 16mm film by Jordan James Kaye

metas.name: Aaron Chen: Funny Garden
metas.description: Aussie comic Aaron Chen riffs on the absurdities of life in the U.S., from New York City sidewalk riddles to unexpected news sources, with deadpan wit.

metas.name: SHED
metas.description: A short film exploring how social media affects us.

metas.name: Collision Course
metas.description: Charlotte finds herself caught up in the affairs that her late brother left behind. With the help of her brother’s best friend, Finn, the duo must outrun a pair of hitmen before their grief consumes them.

metas.name: The Tragic case of Mrs. Didalphidae
metas.description: Charles is dead... but what's going to happen to his widow? Poor Jane?

metas.name: The Shape of Girl to Come
metas.description: Charli tries to explain her philosophy on her art's gaze and its potential for fighting fascism, but wonders whether it's anywhere near enough.

metas.name: Learning the Ropes
metas.description: Repton Boxing Club is recognised as one of the most famous amateur boxing clubs in the world. Through its candid portrait of Tony Burns, the club’s legendary former head coach of 60 years, captured before his death in 2021, Learning the Ropes presents a singular account of his impact upon the institution’s boxers past and present. It also explores the role of the amateur boxing club as a means of understanding social and community life and, on a wider level, the human condition.

metas.name: Exmare
metas.description: A student finds himself stuck reliving the same exam day, using fragments of memory to change his fate.
On the night of April 7th, Jonatan, also known as Yung Lean falls into psychosis

metas.name: Blue
metas.description: Arturo, a broke college student becomes interested in a $50,000 painting titled "Blue".

metas.name: Crossword Clues
metas.description: A new spy shows up to headquarters for her first day of work full of enthusiasm, but a meeting with her new boss leaves her questioning how ready she is to be a spy. Live streaming the day and her co-workers also seems to make it worse for her.

metas.name: Untold: The Death & Life of Lamar Odom
metas.description: This documentary traces the life of Lamar Odom, from his rise to NBA fame and marriage to Khloé Kardashian to his near-fatal overdose in a Nevada brothel.

metas.name: Less Travelled
metas.description: Retired Firefighter Kevin Boyd and Fire Chief Dax Huba set off on a 1200km journey from the edge of Alaska to the most southern point of Western Canada by WaveRunner escaping civilization to rediscover themselves.

metas.name: Our Place
metas.description: As grief overtakes him, Michael drifts through memories and shifting realities, searching for what he has lost.

metas.name: Welcome Inn
metas.description: Amanda works in a cafe in the 1980's when strange customers start appearing.

metas.name: Land Shark
metas.description: An unconventional fish out of water story following an aspiring screenwriter trying to make it in Hollywood. Things take a dark turn after his magnum opus is denied a big shot executive.

metas.name: Bill's Boys
metas.description: Two brothers find themselves on the brink of conflict after an impulsive shooting and now have to hide a body from the police and their gang boss.

metas.name: Outer Sector
metas.description: A lone explorer traveling through a solar system divided by conflict. After an early confrontation damages their ship, the explorer is forced to continue the journey while stranded and vulnerable.

metas.name: The Gospel According To...
metas.description: A group of friends seen through four perspectives.

metas.name: Exit Strategy
metas.description: A tired office worker ponders the best way to quit his job.

metas.name: Saving Grace
metas.description: In a small southern town, Grace Williams, a local teenager, goes missing.Reverend Elijah Harper attempts to comfort the people of his town giving a reassuring sermon on how to deal with grief and uncertainty, but his dual nature begins to unfold through a flashback revealing his disturbing secret.

metas.name: We Go Again
metas.description: Marie and Amy's long-term relationship, living in an isolated cottage, is fraying with both struggling to deal with the realities of being neurodivergent. With Marie chasing long-held dreams, Amy is close to giving up on hers.

metas.name: Zaire: A Film Noir-Inspired Story
metas.description: Filmed during DC's 2025 military occupation, Zaire explores the quarantine distance that united two souls who longed for human comfort beyond closed doors.

metas.name: BOBO BLUES
metas.description: The story of the living archive of black history that comes alive in the beauty supply store.

metas.name: Shalom Aburu previews upcoming fashion show
Stretch Time
metas.description: When you feel you don't have enough time and you want more of it, but can you just stretch time?

metas.name: How to Deal with Tantrums
metas.description: A gentleman desperately tries to become famous before the world ends.

metas.name: Hunting the Silver Killer
metas.description: Closer to the truth? In this gripping documentary, a forensic scientist and pathologist reinvestigate two murder-suicides from 90s that may in fact have been double murders.

metas.name: Last Night Was A Movie
metas.description: In the last 24 hours before Lucy moves away, her and her two best friends, Eva and Tess, must navigate everything they should and shouldn't have said to one another. They must do this all while either disastrously drunk, and/or tragically hungover.

metas.name: Sulidae
metas.description: The bird family Sulidae comprises the gannets and boobies. Collectively called sulids, they are medium-large coastal seabirds that plunge-dive for fish and similar prey.

metas.name: GET OFF!
metas.description: Winnie is a 21-year-old hypersexual girl who suddenly cannot reach a climax. She sets out on an adventure to find the supposed albularyo who will cure her reflection.

metas.name: Dunsinane
metas.description: A man lost in the woods.

metas.name: On 'E'
metas.description: A young mother struggles to keep her head above water as she navigates motherhood, her neurodivergent toddler, and the gritty Atlanta nightclub where she works. All on a quarter tank of gas.

metas.name: ¡¡ LULLABY !!
metas.description: A woman visits a man and teaches him that BABY can be anything he wants.

metas.name: Dean is Dead
metas.description: The various department heads of Northeast State Community College arrive to meet with "Dean the Dean" for an emergency meeting at one in the morning only to find him dead. They must now take on detective roles to solve Dean's murder while unraveling a larger mystery.

metas.name: Henry David Thoreau
metas.description: Henry David Thoreau helped define modern environmentalism and nonviolent resistance, yet his life has been obscured by myth. The author of Walden and Civil Disobedience, he was brilliant but flawed, idealistic but opinionated. A writer, scientist and activist, his words resonate urgently with today’s challenges as humanity looks for ways to live in harmony with nature—and each other.

metas.name: Next Door
metas.description: In a pristine suburb, three couples unravel as abuse, infidelity, drugs, and a missing son resurface.

metas.name: Yard One
metas.description: Yard One shows fragments of people navigating the city of Brussels through dreams, family and community. It's a tribute to its rich electronic music scene and a glimpse of how the sound system functions in today's world. It's a voice for the people. A stand. A vision. A mission.

metas.name: Checkmate
metas.description: When a dramatic college student, Jo, spirals over her childhood best friend’s new relationship, she ropes her quiet, dependable friend into a series of increasingly desperate sabotage schemes—only to realize too late that the girl helping her has been carefully making moves to win her heart instead.

metas.name: /ty
metas.description: A headless skeleton goes fishing.

metas.name: Greetings From Samson
metas.description: Samson, a young and ambitious proofreader at a greeting card company, follows his dream of becoming a greeting card writer and learns that sometimes the hardest part is just showing up. Also, he’s a hot dog!

metas.name: Emma Holland: Don't Touch My Trinkets
metas.description: It’s set in my own personal art gallery and I get to show you all my treasures and wares.  If anyone brings a fountain pen in with them I swear to GOD I will lose it, if the ink gets on any of my knick-knacks and compromises their integrity I will go crazy.

metas.name: Greg Larsen: Where's My Fucken Money?
metas.description: Greg Larsen's new feature length comedy special from Humdinger Studios. Come with him as he discovers where his fucken money is!

metas.name: The Silver Pure Garden
metas.description: The process of change explored through the trembling of the Super 8 format and the audio brutalism of Bradley Cartmell’s soundscape.

metas.name: Through the Window
metas.description: a sports movie

metas.name: The Discourse
metas.description: Character one finds something and character two can't find out otherwise there will be serious ramifications

metas.name: Robot Girls
metas.description: When a robot girl companion fails to listen to its developer, the developer uses an advanced model to train the robot girl. But when the training turns deadly, the developer finds himself in trouble.

metas.name: Ram Raiders
metas.description: Two young spring breakers break in to a man's home in hopes to steal his car.

metas.name: Rory McIlroy: The Masters Wait
metas.description: Through years of heartbreak and resilience, Rory McIlroy's pursuit of the Green Jacket at the Masters becomes a reckoning with legacy and the final step toward completing golf's rarest achievement, the career Grand Slam.

metas.name: Alchemy
metas.description: A girl discovers she has a unique sexual chemistry which creates a mysterious substance that takes over her life and everyone else in the city.

metas.name: Life of Kai
metas.description: A documentary-style short film that follows the real-life story of Kai, a young trans boy in the United Kingdom, over roughly a decade as he grows up and discovers who he is. The film chronicles his coming-of-age journey against the backdrop of changing social and legal attitudes toward trans rights in the UK. It explores the complexities of identity, acceptance, and belonging, showing how Kai navigates personal challenges, relationships with family, and his pursuit of happiness while confronting societal barriers and questions about what it means to live authentically.

metas.name: The Artist Who Disappeared
metas.description: When artist Sergei Ivanov moves with his partner Tezman Chan to the remote Scottish island of Papa Westray, they start an International Arts Festival, bringing an eclectic mix of artists, performers and musicians to the island from as far afield as Japan and USA. With the festival entering its seventh year they invite their friend and filmmaker David Kew to make a documentary about their extraordinary life on the island. But when Sergei suddenly disappears without trace on Papa Westray three months into filming, the filmmaker is forced to embark on a profound journey of discovery and contemplation. As the filmmaker interviews those left behind each in their own way trying to make sense of Sergei's vanishing, the film gravitates towards Iszman as she attempts to come to terms with her grief by creating an elegiac and moving tribute to Sergei on the island.

metas.name: sometimes, i do my skincare in the dark
metas.description: In a vanity, a woman performs her bizarre nightly skincare routine, unraveling into a haunting reflection of pain, pressure, and the relentless pursuit of beauty and perfection.

metas.name: Syncing Sinking
metas.description: A secluded session between a therapist and an at-risk client.

metas.name: Winter After Winter
metas.description: Returning home to Toronto after years away, Nell runs into Jackie, an old friend. As they spend the day together, a buried past rises to the surface, leaving them reckoning with their shared history.

metas.name: The Wire Game
metas.description: Wounded and left for dead, a British soldier embarks on a daring escape from a booby-trapped German dugout.

metas.name: Unwinding
metas.description: When the son of a Senator goes missing, private investigator Gaven Mori is hired by the family to piece together and solve the mystery.

metas.name: ROB
metas.description: ROB, a young LA native, moves to Portland for school, only to drop out almost immediately and settle into a comfortable routine of doing absolutely nothing. What follows is a mostly self-inflicted journey through failure, small awakenings, and the long road to becoming a barely functional adult.

metas.name: Not As Planned
metas.description: When two rookie hitmen stuff up on the job, they must make their choices.

metas.name: The Gull
metas.description: A seagull makes his home by the river and will do all he needs to protect it

metas.name: Hidden Umbrella
metas.description: A race against time between two agents to secure the blueprint for a nuclear weapon.

metas.name: Overqualified
metas.description: A young man undergoes bizarre tasks to land a job in the CIA.

metas.name: Freedom At Stake
metas.description: Activists in Texas fight back against Prop A, a measure targeting those who help others seek abortions across state lines. As legal risks grow, so does their determination to protect access and bodily autonomy.

metas.name: Cayetana, everyone's Duchess
metas.description: This documentary chronicles the lavish life of the Duchess of Alba, Cayetana Fitz-James Stuart, one of 20th-century Spain's best-known aristocrats.

metas.name: Toons by Steve
metas.description: A few afternoons in the life of a Boston cartoonist.

metas.name: Beautiful Fish
metas.description: This film is not art... it is something much.. much... much... More.

metas.name: Chris D'Elia: The 'B Side' Special
metas.description: A previously unreleased stand-up hour from the tour after "Grow or Die" is released as a raw, uncut “B-side” special.

metas.name: Daddy's Girl
metas.description: After her parents’ separation, Gretchen sets out in search of her absent father. Overwhelmed by the need to communicate with those closest to her, she plunges into the unknown. The directorial debut of actress, writer, and musician Robens is a collage of portraits: encounters, people, places, and voices that Gretchen encounters on her journey—a poetic exploration of origins, loss, and quiet becoming.

metas.name: The Truly Masterful Mind of Todd Viller
metas.description: Todd Viller is a creative boy in a world full of doubt and pessimism.

metas.name: Disney+ Insider World of Frozen
metas.description: Let's build a snowman! See World of Frozen at Disneyland Paris with the directors of "Frozen 3"!

metas.name: The Seed
metas.description: A wannabe rapper must protect his new pot plant from his intrusive flatmate, even if the plant keeps whispering to him about world domination.

metas.name: Sweet Boy
metas.description: In the quiet suburbs of the Bay Area, a troubled 15-year-old boy is caught in a crossfire as domestic tensions escalate at home.

metas.name: Exhibition Gala | ISU World Championships | Prague 2026
metas.description: Medalists and stars perform at the Exhibition of Champions at the ISU World Championships in Prague 2026

metas.name: Los Juanos: La Leyenda Del Ooze
metas.description: A mysterious man, a brawl at a Limonada stand, and one missed call. Three different tunes all connected through a mysterious ooze flooding the city of San Antonio, Texas.

metas.name: The White Wolf
metas.description: After vowing to limit himself to six Modelos every Saturday night, Waylon Stone has another life‑changing cinematic experience which makes him reconsider the promise he made to himself.

metas.name: Dashcamera Obscura
metas.description: A man desperate to capture a traffic accident on his new dashcam accidentally unleashes a car crash day in his personal life.

metas.name: The Line She Carries
metas.description: The Line She Carries follows Inuk filmmaker and Indigenous Geographic co-founder Crystal Martin at a turning point, the end of her childbearing years. In Oolootie’s home, she receives her traditional Tunniit, reclaiming Inuit womanhood, identity, and survival. Each line becomes an act of resistance, healing, and intergenerational strength.

metas.name: Wayside
metas.description: A young man diligently prepares for a marriage proposal when old feelings start to resurface.

metas.name: Finding Shelter
metas.description: Hana, alongside her father and their loyal dog Ronaldo, embarks on a perilous journey to escape conflict, navigating treacherous landscapes and the depths of human resilience in search of a place to call home.

metas.name: Polar
metas.description: Zoe, in the wake of an untimely death in the family, is feeling shortchanged by life; the world looks a bit more sad and a bit more grey. On her way home from school on the final day of Summer term, the world does its best to convince her that it's anything but.

metas.name: Viamonte
metas.description: A Northern Irish businessman gets stuck in the middle of the Portuguese countryside while on a business trip.

metas.name: THE MOVING MIRACLE
metas.description: Constructed completely from archival sources, ‘THE MOVING MIRACLE’ considers the vast documentation of humanity in the digital age and ask the question of whether the image our archives leave behind will have us be remembered kindly. What is the point of the camera as a miracle machine if all it seems to do is witness atrocities?

metas.name: Hostages
metas.description: A film about wielding a movie camera at the end of the world.

metas.name: Wings
metas.description: Tyltyl, a shy girl with a torn wing. One day she meets a girl in the same situation, Mytyl.

metas.name: Seasons for you
metas.description: A sweet little human child descends from the sky into the seasons, which had been living a monotonous existence. Which season will welcome him?

metas.name: A Tiny Memory
