metas.description: The only memory Young-i has of her late grandfather is a small childhood mishap involving red bean ice cream. At his funeral, she remembers him in silence, overcome with grief, and eats that ice cream—which she only began to appreciate after his death.

metas.name: After Our Moments
metas.description: The guard accompanies the wolf to Little Red Riding Hood, but leaves without giving her the farewell letter. Back home, memories of Little Red Riding Hood fill the village, intensifying his loneliness and sense of regret.

metas.name: HIGH-SPEED-LEAP
metas.description: The main character wants to reach the stars in the sky on his snowboard. He keeps jumping, hoping to get there one day.

metas.name: Home
metas.description: Freelance writer Yeon-hee is waiting at home for her lover, Myung-soo, to get off work. The longer he stays at the office, the more anxious Yeon-hee becomes.

metas.name: I Go Deep
metas.description: Eun-hee saves a mysterious girl, Seo-hae, who claims to have come from the sea, just as she is about to jump into the icy waters to die. Seo-hae wants to return to the sea, but Eun-hee completely ignores her.

metas.name: Meet Again
metas.description: On her fourteenth birthday, the troubled Han-byul runs away from home and stumbles upon a bizarre midnight festival, where a girl leading monsters awakens a familiar memory within her.

metas.name: The Way Things Seem to Be
metas.description: An in-depth look at documentarian Rob Nilsson.

metas.name: Los Ríos
metas.description: A determined Honduran mother and her three daughters are swept into the currents of the contentious migrant caravan as it pushes relentlessly toward safety, opportunity, and the United States.

metas.name: Sunspark
metas.description: In a post-human wasteland, a robot scavenger unexpectedly finds the broken body of another robot while looking for spare parts. After failing to fully revive her, he must decide how much of himself he’s willing to give in order to bring her back to life.

metas.name: happiness
metas.description: Katia lives in Berlin since 2022, she is fleeing a war. As she reflects on the deep wounds that a war can leave, she tells Yann how important and inevitable it is to try to be happy.

metas.name: My Friend the Couch
metas.description: Ethan takes his broken couch on a roadtrip for one last goodbye.

metas.name: Moving On
metas.description: An exploration of childhood comfort items and the psychological and emotional significance they hold.

metas.name: Demain me tue
metas.description: A disillusioned young man enjoys the beauty of the last minutes before Tomorrow.

metas.name: Picture Perfect Sister-in-Law
metas.description: Three years after escaping a notorious child abductor known as the 'Carousel Kiler', former investigative journalist Parker Bennington has rebuilt her life as a university lecturer near her brother's family. But when disturbing symbols from the past—carousel music boxes—start appearing, and her sister-in-law begins acting strangely, Parker suspects someone is targeting her again.

metas.name: Mordros
metas.description: Two best friends and open-water swimmers take on one final challenge.

metas.name: First Dates
metas.description: In a café, a young woman, Eva, and a middle aged man, Wanja, engage in a heartfelt conversation about love, family, and the complexities of relationships while waiting for their dates. A revelation leads to an unexpected turn and a surprising realisation.

metas.name: Escalofrío
metas.description: A violent bank heist was only the beginning. The detonation of explosives for a new well caused a collapse in a century-old abandoned mine, awakening a hidden nightmare.

metas.name: Illumination
metas.description: A young artist sheds light on his passions, pursuits, and the conflicting voices beneath them all.

metas.name: Come Home, Bunga
metas.description: When her grades start slipping, Bunga, who’s carrying heavy trauma from home, begins getting called out by the school.

metas.name: Maple Leaf Pro Wrestling: Uprising 2026
metas.description: The Mega Event weekend continues with MLP: Uprising 2026, streaming live on TrillerTV as Maple Leaf Pro Wrestling delivers another night of high-impact international competition.  Uprising is headlined by the dominant powerhouse duo The Good Brothers — Karl Anderson & Doc Gallows, fresh off their shocking return to Japan via Pro Wrestling NOAH. The former multi-time tag team champions challenge all comers in a marquee main event that promises chaos and global intrigue.  Across the card, expect elite performers from AEW, NJPW, NOAH, DDT, CMLL, and international partners — creating a rare cross-promotional showcase rarely seen in modern wrestling.

metas.name: White Belt
metas.description: On the eve of her first major Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu tournament, former supermodel Monika "Jac" Jagaciak—once the face of global fashion—reveals her extraordinary transformation as she trades runways for grappling mats, confronting her past and reclaiming her life through the discipline of combat sport.

metas.name: We need to speak about living room
metas.description: Shot at the Labre House in Utrecht, the film brings together a cast of participants to enact experiences and conflicts of shared living within a community housing context, as well as the external pressures that threaten such forms of collective life. The work is interwoven with archival material from histories of collective housing and contemporary housing struggles, and is presented within architectural installations that follow the historic structures of both Casco’s building and Kunsthuis Syb.

metas.name: Count
metas.description: A man entertains briefly the idea that suffering can't be counted, that two who suffer are not more than one who suffers.  Adapted from the book: "Visit to Hades: Auschwitz and Breslau" (1966) by Günther Anders.

metas.name: Richard Wagner: Lohengrin @ Baden-Baden Easter Festival 2026
metas.description: Wagner’s sixth opera, “Lohengrin,” tells the medieval legend of the Knight of the Swan: the knight Lohengrin is sent to protect Duchess Elsa of Brabant, who has been unjustly accused of murder. Johannes Erath directs the production, and Joana Mallwitz conducts the orchestra. Piotr Beczała plays the title role. Rachel Willis-Sørensen plays Elsa of Brabant.

metas.name: Hiding Places
metas.description: Women pretend to be rocks. Military operations masquerade as art education. One woman deserts to pursue a more radical act of unselfing.

metas.name: Big Night of Musicals 2026 by the National Lottery
metas.description: Jason Manford hosts the annual showcase of musical theatre from the AO Arena in Manchester. Featuring a preview of forthcoming new West End productions of Miss Saigon and Jesus Christ Superstar, with Sam Ryder making his debut as Jesus. Featuring Alexandra Burke performing numbers from I'm Every Woman: The Chaka Khan Musical, hits from The Producers, Wicked, The Lion King, Oliver!, Sunny Afternoon and Paddington The Musical, and a performance from Annie featuring La Voix.

metas.name: Strand 45
metas.description: A young woman with a painful past discovers her DNA holds the cure to cancer, instantly making her the most valuable secret on earth. As powerful interests close in, and her past haunts her, she must choose between her own safety and well-being, or risking everything to share her secret with the world.

metas.name: Dinner for Loners
metas.description: Scared about his friends moving on without him, a newly single man recruits his dysfunctional Indian family to throw a reunion dinner in a desperate attempt to reconnect.

metas.name: Echoes
metas.description: In a quirky, heartfelt journey sparked by accidental edibles, three generations of women rediscover the love, happiness, and shared identity they hold as a family.

metas.name: Beck - Live at Pinkpop 1997
metas.description: Beck's performance at the end of the PinkPop Festival in Landgraaf, Netherlands on May 19, 1997.

metas.name: Each Solitary Moment
metas.description: It's a serendipitous encounter - two Chinese high school girls track a certain adult woman living in New York City, eavesdropping on conversations between her and her former friend in the mundane of everyday life, attempting to understand the meaning of growing up.

metas.name: Another Murder Mystery
metas.description: A parody of a parody of a murder mystery dinner. Not even the killer knows what's going on anymore.

metas.name: Gumshoe
metas.description: Short film about a detective trying to catch a (would-be serial?) killer

metas.name: A Conversation at the End of a Party
metas.description: Two exes find closure during their first conversation since their breakup.

metas.name: Good Behaviour
metas.description: A surreal psychological drama about a tormented prisoner who undergoes an talking therapy to reframe the memories of his crime. Starring Antonio Aakeel (Slow Horses, Sherlock & Daughter), Paul McGann (Withnail & I, Doctor Who) and Stephen Walters (This City Is Ours, Outlander).

metas.name: A Conversation at the End of the World
metas.description: An argument between two sisters is interrupted by the end of the world.

metas.name: Madonna
metas.description: This project relies on the fluctuation between home movies and avant-garde aesthetics. Using symbols from numerous iconographic paintings of The Madonna and Child as well as reenactment of miscellaneous film stills, this piece encapsulates the topic of performances of femininity, psychoanalytic thought and interest in mimetic identification theory. Playing with the tension of stillness, the piece also relies on the respiratory nature within lighting, values, and color saturation. Shot on VHS-C.

metas.name: Catching One's Breath
metas.description: Displeasure in the colors. Discord in the hums and waves. The visual and material planes are not a sanctuary: indeed, they are a spotlight. What is sacrificed for our security and the comfort of a pleasing image? Images/Optical sound printed on clear leader.

metas.name: Do Not Watch
metas.description: After an argument with his wife Courtney, Nick reluctantly starts digitizing his family’s old home videos, only to uncover something that was never meant to be seen.

metas.name: Gracie Buckshot and The Kiddo
metas.description: A modern spaghetti western of epic proportions.

metas.name: Alchemist in the City
metas.description: My window shews the travelling clouds,  Leaves spent, new seasons, alter'd sky

metas.name: Prank
metas.description: A young teen, Olivia receives a phone call, in which she's told a boy likes her. She finds out that the person that called her was lying. Olivia goes to the extreme to prank her back.

metas.name: Fred again.. & Thomas Bangalter: Live at Alexandra Palace in London (USB002)
metas.description: Fred again.. & Thomas Bangalter live at Alexandra Palace in London on February 27, 2026.

metas.name: When Soccer Came to America: Goals, Glamour and the Beautiful Game
metas.description: The film examines the North America Soccer League’s (NASL) explosive growth during the 1970’s and 80’s with some of the greatest footballers in history - including Pelé, George Best, and Johan Cruyff - bringing unprecedented attention to the game.  Through rare archive footage and intimate interviews, the documentary explores how the NASL became a cultural phenomenon, blending sport, celebrity, and ambition in a uniquely American experiment to popularize the world’s game.

metas.name: Takanashi Kiara / Ninomae Ina’nis 1st Concert “Drawn to Dawn” Day 2
metas.description: Day 2 of Takanashi Kiara and Ninomae Ina’nis first concert, held on March 28th, 2026 at The Wiltern in Los Angeles and streamed online via Streaming+ and SPWN.

metas.name: Shake 'Em Down
metas.description: A troubled man finds guidance in his burnout friend, a plastic knife, and James Dean.

metas.name: Winter
metas.description: Short film stitched together using unrelated clips from Dec 2025 and Jan 2026.

metas.name: Last Man's Land
metas.description: Last Man’s Land follows Isiah, a hardened survivor navigating a post-apocalyptic America two years after the world’s collapse. When a ruthless survivalist steals a cache of desperately needed medical supplies meant for a group of sick children, Isiah sets out across a dangerous, lawless landscape to track them down and bring the supplies back—no matter the cost.

metas.name: A Tale of Ira Abbott
metas.description: Alma arrives in rural Nova Scotia for work and forms a fragile bond with Connor, a man devoted to his ailing father and seeking his approval. As Alma quietly yearns for Connor's love, their tentative affair unfolds in cycles of intimacy and distance, mirroring the rugged landscape and shaped by longing, desire, and Alma's search for self.

metas.name: V.I.N.C.E. (Voice Intelligent Narrative Creation Engine)
metas.description: V.I.N.C.E. (Voice Intelligent Narrative Creation Engine) is a semi-nonfictional short film about an AI program that takes complete creative control of an ad agency's ill-fated audio session.

metas.name: Behind the Curtain at Black Carpet III
metas.description: Taking a peak behind the curtain at the Black Carpet III event at Shea's Theater we meet some of the special individuals that make the show happen as they get ready to take the stage

metas.name: Chernobyl: 48 Hours To Escape
metas.description: Witnesses, survivors and front-line heroes recall the first days of the Chernobyl disaster of April 1986. Featuring rare archive footage of the world's worst ever nuclear accident.

metas.name: Johann Sebastian Bach: St. John Passion, BWV 245 The NDR Vocal Ensemble and Concerto Köln
metas.description: Johann Sebastian Bach’s *St. John Passion* recounts the trial and death of Jesus through striking musical scenes. The Evangelist guides the narrative, which unfolds through arias, chorales, choral sections, and solo passages. Sequences of great dramatic intensity alternate with calm, meditative passages, highlighting the full complexity of these events.

metas.name: GOOD-MAN
metas.description: Set in suburban America, Henry Goodman fights to liberate his own mind and overcome his father’s small-town ideas of being a good man.

metas.name: Cho Sung-woo in Concert
metas.description: On March 28, 2026, at the Cinema La Compagnia in Florence, his music will come to life in concert thanks to a collaboration with the Florence Pops Orchestra: a musical journey spanning over twenty years of his career, featuring iconic film scores and melodies that have moved audiences around the world.

metas.name: Monsters Down Under
metas.description: "Monsters Down Under" is the third film of Dinosauria Volume 2, and the eighth of my Dinosauria Animated Series overall. The film explores the bizarre and alien world of Early Cretaceous Australia.

metas.name: Dream Synth™
metas.description: Dream Synth™ is a speculative meta-documentary. In a near future humans trade their dreams for access to energy and an expansive virtual reality. But when machines begin to dream, humanity must acknowledge what they’ve given up: dreams were more than random neural firings, they were the essence of consciousness.

metas.name: tempus fugit
metas.description: Can we keep something as it was, or are we clinging to what must inevitably vanish, despite our efforts to preserve it? "tempus fugit" wrestles with this question, through the exploration of vacant spaces: the filmmaker's family home — vacant after her grandmother's recent passing, a cryonics facility where the dead are frozen for possible revival, and in a composting bin, where worms decompose organic matter. Playing with horror, not as a genre, but as a method, the film contemplates the tensions, and possible harmonies, between rot and preservation.

metas.name: brain_rot_vol1.mp4
metas.description: In frantic bursts of digitally-degraded symbols and distorted sounds, this short film explores the absurdity of our attention span by turning classic films into deep-fried hieroglyphic emojis.

metas.name: Algorithmic Nudes Grapple with Entropy
metas.description: A thermodynamic melody amidst the machine and the heartbeat, days spent in shadow as shadow, with the streets empty at dusk, and the blue glow of endless day upon us.

metas.name: Panic in Nowhere
metas.description: Drifting through videoclips online easily leaves you distracted, lost, and back on square one. Imagine, you found a series of clips organized by a sense of inchoate feeling of eclipse of time and end of the world, evoking a shared sense of fate.

The Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) have been instructed by the Trump administration to pause or retract any periodical or journal article that references specific LGBT topics, with agency staff allegedly being provided a list of words that must be removed from all publications.

metas.name: Ode (An Acknowledgement of Sea Country)
metas.description: Ode is a cameraless animation made from handmade macroalgae celluloid. Developed with CSIRO and marine scientists, it uses contact printing, botanicollage, and seaweed bio-sonification to explore post-petrochemical cinema. Lasting 365 seconds, the film offers an ocean-responsive meditation on deep time, material intelligence, and more-than-human collaboration.

metas.name: Soul Kitchen
metas.description: Music video for the electrifying beat track Soul Kitchen by Japanese audio/visual artist Legendary Beast. This work, which pursues a unique rhythmic expression through the multiplication of sound rhythm and visual rhythm, was created with a small drawing size of 75 mm in width.

metas.name: So Many Different Things
metas.description: A collection of things drawn sequentially in a mini sketchbook, hoping they animate. Each drawing is smaller than a centimeter.

metas.name: 35 Days
metas.description: 35 Days is an experimental, stop motion animation about what happens when a coalition of strangers answers the call to locate a missing cat during the pandemic lockdown of 2020.

metas.name: do you see light as i see it?
metas.description: do you see light as i see it? is an exploration of light through the lens of astigmatism, revealing a beautiful perspective of ordinary encounters. As light bends and shifts, the narrative encourages the audience to look inward—challenging them to reconstruct their perceptions of beauty in a more authentic way.

metas.name: TALES OF LAKE DIAN
metas.description: The village of Haiyan near Lake Dian (Yunnan, China), has its feet in the water but can no longer dip its hands in it, it is polluted and must remain at rest for 10 years. The village no longer has fishermen, but stories and tales permeate its mud brick walls.

metas.name: Color Separation
metas.description: Color Separation is about my father David Nerwen who was an artist and graphic designer. He made hand stitched abstract wool designs on canvas and worked in the printing industry. This video weaves together found and shot footage to reflect on his creative work, physical and cognitive decline and the sadness of losing a parent.

metas.name: Flower Keester Cops
metas.description: The Phenakistoscope is an animation toy. A Flower Keester Cop is just like that, but with flower power.

metas.name: See You, Soon
metas.description: A young man sits in a diner with his older brother discussing life, as he waits for someone to show up.

metas.name: Blessings in Disguise
metas.description: Katie, a driven New York fashion designer with only three weeks to develop a collection that could launch her brand to national prominence. Katie reconnects with Luke, her first love and now a gifted furniture designer and woodworker whose designs are rooted in craftmanship, patience, and purpose. As their lives intertwine once more, the two discover that inspiration is not found in deadlines or demand - but in the timeless values of home, heritage, and hope.

metas.name: Puddle
metas.description: Mac wakes up on a hot day to find that his AC broken, and his hungry cat has undergone a strange transformation.

metas.name: A Royal Setting
metas.description: Ruby, a world-renowned gemologist, is hired by Prince Luca to restore the crown jewels and design his crown, challenging tradition and complicating his relationship with his mother, the queen.

metas.name: Under The Covers
metas.description: When a man is taken advantage of in a vulnerable state by his close friend, he must figure out how to cope with the violation he experienced.

metas.name: Routine
metas.description: A repetitive day of a teenager who has dreams that represents a more peaceful and fulfilling life that they’d like to have.

metas.name: Willow World
metas.description: A filmmaker revisits her childhood, interweaving 16mm  vignettes and her old child services documents, uncovering the truth she couldn't voice as a child.

metas.name: Scrape
metas.description: A short film about Sierra Cosmidis-Grove’s experience entering skateparks as a beginner skater and finding community.

metas.name: The Man in the Window
metas.description: A grieving widow grows suspicious of her mysterious new neighbor after local crimes occur. Despite her friend's support, the community dismisses her concerns, leaving her to uncover the unsettling truth alone.

metas.name: Anything For A Dream
metas.description: Stuck in a decollate life and a dead marriage a father goes to any lengths to continue to dream a life for his daughter and himself

metas.name: For Séamus
metas.description: Set in rural Ireland, For Séamus explores the silent struggles between fathers and sons, revealing a story of reconciliation, legacy, and love left unspoken.

metas.name: Littermates
metas.description: Amidst the chaos of a mysterious war, two victims of an attack take refuge at a cottage in the English countryside, where an enigmatic caretaker insists they cannot leave.

metas.name: Talismans
metas.description: Short artist documentary about London-based mixed-media artist and jewellery maker Klara Fokicheva, exploring her creative process of working with found materials and the influence mud-larking has on her work.

metas.name: Audition
metas.description: A young pianist performs an original piece for an audition.

metas.name: Mould
metas.description: Stevie, a disconnected twenty-something struggles with increasing dissociation as her body unexpectedly begins to reshape itself into clay.

metas.name: Breakout
metas.description: Your average chummy classic sitcom with a laugh track...or is it?

metas.name: The Artist Must Grow Ever More Selfish
metas.description: A tender documentary portrait from director Susan Sandler, drawn from Ned Rorem's Paris Diary. The film offers a candid, intimate and dream like visit with the young composer in 1950s Paris, narrated in his own words. Through diary excerpts and music, it reveals a dashing, self-searching artist moving through a vibrant cultural world of writers, composers, and taste makers whose paths crossed with his. Both personal and provocative, the film captures Rorem's fearless honesty, his unguarded reflections on love and ambition, and the formative experiences that shaped his artistic voice.

metas.name: Voicemail
metas.description: The central protagonist of Voicemail is the phone. A conversation happens between voicemail audio from the artist’s late mother and a transcription of his silent responses in the subtitles. The dialogue centers around missed calls, unanswered texts, busy schedules and the concerns of a loving parent.

metas.name: Out of Frame
metas.description: A tortured actress reflects on her career in two perspectives - struggling and famous. However, the lines between the two states blur and leaves her questioning the nature of the industry she once adored.

metas.name: Parasomnia
metas.description: A private investigator returns to his hometown to uncover the whereabouts of his lost cousin.

metas.name: Transient Witness
metas.description: Transient Witness unfolds through the eyes of three protagonists: Christina, the manager of an art collection; Maurizio, an art mover; and Präsens, the collector's dog.

metas.name: grentperez - Backflips In A Restaurant (Live In Sydney)
metas.description: grentperez brings his debut album, Backflips in a Restaurant, to life with a concert in Sydney.

metas.name: They Can Be All Yours: The Making of The Complete Package
metas.description: Benjamin Clarke's behind-the-scenes documentary on the making of The Complete Package.

metas.name: Like Daughter, Like Son
metas.description: Two siblings navigate the newfound grief of losing their father, together in difference.

metas.name: Telephone
metas.description: Don't bother calling these ladies, they're out to party

metas.name: Out of This World
metas.description: An alien crashes on Earth and finds himself attending high school facing the wrath of human bullies.

metas.name: Ten Til Midnight
metas.description: In this film accompanying Snoop Dogg's 2026 album, twin brothers Rus Little and Do Wrong must navigate the aftermath of a bank heist gone wrong.

metas.name: I Will Be A Fish For One Day
metas.description: A fish has an identity crisis within the glass of an aquarium.

metas.name: The Truth About Space
metas.description: A young man is released from prison and has to face up to the lie that his estranged daughter has been led to believe - that he was in space.

metas.name: Hat's Psychic Services
metas.description: A psychic therapist goes inside his client's head to fight her inner demons with a sword.

metas.name: My Ripple Effect
metas.description: “My Ripple Effect” follows a recently divorced dad (Dean Cain) who encounters a mysterious man named Raphael (Kevin Sorbo) at an abandoned church, and discovers his life has far more meaning than he ever imagined. Together with his best friend (Eddie McClintock), he embarks on a journey that reveals how ordinary people and everyday moments can create long‑lasting, generational impact.  This isn’t just a movie about characters on a screen. It’s a story about all of us – parents, students, pastors and neighbors – who wonder if our small efforts really make a difference, and what God can do with one obedient “yes.” By the end of this story, viewers will question not just ‘What if?’ but, ‘What if God uses this moment to change my world?’”

metas.name: The Tokyo Sessions [documentary]
metas.description: The Tokyo Sessions takes you inside the heart of creation as jazz musician Benjamin Herman shapes his latest album. Captured through the lens of his twin brother, filmmaker Jonathan Herman, the documentary follows Benjamin and his band from first ideas to final takes. Filmed partly in Tokyo’s legendary Studio Dede, the story highlights unique collaborations with Japanese artists including Otomo Yoshihide, Tomoaki Baba and Akihito Obama. The documentary is an intimate portrait of music in motion—where inspiration, improvisation, and cultural exchange converge.

metas.name: CHAI
metas.description: With his mother sick, tea shop failing, and father only concerned with prayer, what limits will Ajmer break to protect his loved ones?

metas.name: Imagined Love
metas.description: A lonely man who is desperate for love comes back from a date on the town where we soon find out not everything is as it seems.

metas.name: Waves
metas.description: Nothing is ever really lost, it just changes form.

metas.name: Punk Rockula The Curse of UGLOR
metas.description: 1980's El Paso punk rock band, Uglor, trailblaze their way through the local and national music scene only to have their luck unravel as they maneuver their way through drug-addiction, tragedy, and loss.

metas.name: The Sound of Leaves
metas.description: When everything in his life comes crashing down, Casey retreats to the woods, the only place he can find peace. When the problems he escaped from start coming back to haunt him, he must come to a realization on whether or not he made the right decisions.

metas.name: Hate You to the Moon and Back
metas.description: Two students forced to work on a school project together discuss higher powers, the concept of control, coffee, and discover something deep within in the meantime.

metas.name: Hey, You There
metas.description: 26-year-old Jackie holds the threads of hope for her relationship with childhood best friend Claire. Jackie is stuck in a cycle of their past traumas and what to do about their relationship. Through different time periods of their lives, Jackie reflects on her friendship with Claire, from its past to its future.

metas.name: Evi
metas.description: A famous singer loses everything when her label drops her without pay. With help from her best friend and manager, she struggles to rebuild her career and find herself again.

metas.name: UNFAIR
metas.description: A man in his late 20s sets out to take revenge on someone he believes has wronged him. As his pursuit unfolds, the lines between rage fueled vengeance and the truth start to blur.

metas.name: Takanashi Kiara / Ninomae Ina’nis 1st Concert “Drawn to Dawn” Day 1
metas.description: Day 1 of Takanashi Kiara and Ninomae Ina’nis first concert, held on March 27th, 2026 at The Wiltern in Los Angeles and streamed online via Streaming+ and SPWN.

metas.name: Blue Note
metas.description: A poised woman, a quiet suburban home, and a night filled with spinning records and subtle unease.

metas.name: Regurgitations
metas.description: A handheld smartphone experiment

metas.name: Stella Maris
metas.description: Bobbi, a robot trained to build houses, enters the "real" world to fulfill his mission -- but when reality begins to glitch, he's forced to question everything he was taught as a long-buried dream resurfaces.

metas.name: What We Carry
metas.description: The crew of Phoenix Fire Department Station 42 and their stories.

metas.name: Marble Tissues
metas.description: Robin wanders a landscape shaped by their own desires, caught between the person they've always been and the person they're terrified to become.

metas.name: Collage
metas.description: Jules knows something is wrong.

metas.name: Smooth Criminal
metas.description: A tired detective and a desperate commissioner work together to incriminate a stubborn suspect.

metas.name: Dance Fever
metas.description: A film about dancing, friendship, and the bizarre nature of driving in a car. Available to watch here:

metas.name: No Body But Tody
metas.description: For 11 years, Maricar waited for her fiancé, Tody who mysteriously disappeared, until one day, he came back as a mannequin.

metas.name: Rockabye
metas.description: Suspecting her father didn't take his own life, a grieving woman's hunt for the truth turns treacherous when his friends start dying one by one.

metas.name: Grahanam 2.0
metas.description: Roy and Tina enjoy a picture-perfect life together-until it begins to unravel into an unsettling loop of twists and deception. As the boundaries of their reality shift, the ultimate truth proves to be more chilling than they ever imagined.

metas.name: Silkscreen
metas.description: A struggling shirt printer reconnects with his aging father, the former owner of their now-fading family business, as they confront the changes time has brought to their craft and relationship.

metas.name: Jason Thurston's Acting MasterClass with Jason Thurston
metas.description: Professional actor Jason Thurston brings his award-winning* PAM (Professional Acting MasterClass) to the masses in the car park of the National Theatre. Lessons will be taught. Grievances will be aired. You will be changed. Jason will make sure of it.  *Third place in 'Best Extracurricular Activities at The University of Sussex 2017-2019'.

metas.name: Hill Boy
metas.description: When a pessimistic recluse meets a carefree spirit at group therapy, he realizes that healing can look ridiculous after he learns of an unconventional (and slightly chaotic) way of letting his emotions loose.

metas.name: I Will Go On Missing You Till Then
metas.description: I Will Go On Missing You Till Then is an experimental documentary taking words from a young woman's love letters, from Ireland to America, written in 1960 exploring what remains across a cavern of time and momentous change on both sides of the Irish border

metas.name: Always & Forever
metas.description: Before Jack moves away from her for a year, he creates a visual love letter expressing his feelings for his lover, Jimena.

metas.name: Killer in the Ring
metas.description: Cruiserweight champion Mike Miller faces the consequences of the tragic accident that caused him to step away from boxing.

metas.name: Falling Star
metas.description: In the lead up to the finale of a prestigous dance competition, a promising dancer is driven by external expectations to enhance her body at any cost, leading to a climatic crash-out on stage.

metas.name: Please Hold On
metas.description: Tension begins to grow between four roommates as they confront problems within their living dynamic

metas.name: The Boy by the Pool
metas.description: A woman's sun-soaked vacation takes a sinister turn when she meets a picture-perfect couple whose son bears a striking resemblance to a young boy who disappeared two years earlier.

metas.name: Mutt Cat
metas.description: Milo has been home from university for six months since the passing of his best friend. A missing cat poster in his neighbourhood sparks a fixation after learning that it belongs to a dying old man; to him, a shot at redemption from the survivor’s guilt he has been experiencing. By coincidence, his search pulls him into the orbit of Daisy, an old friend tied to his past.

metas.name: Ryan's House: The 5th Year Disney Show
metas.description: The gang visits the happiest place on Earth to celebrate the 5th anniversary of Ryan's House.

metas.name: 9 Cities 9 Days Mini Documentary
metas.description: Megan Moroney releases a new mini documentary about her Cloud 9 “9 cities, 9 days tour” around America

metas.name: Sweet Dreams
metas.description: Sweet Dreams is an animation film exploring psychological states of transformation.

metas.name: The Invisible Hippo of Grief: An Adoption Story
metas.description: The Invisible Hippo of Grief: An Adoption Story investigates the Canadian Baby Adoption Mandate Era (1945-1985) when over 400,000 newborns were adoption to new families. History reveals the babies were taken—most first mothers were not given informed consent, and were often subject to neglect, abuse, and dangerous medical procedures.

metas.name: On the Inside We are Color
metas.description: In Santa María Tlahuitoltepec, Oaxaca, the women's organization Poj Kaa maintains a community herbarium. Foraging for plants is a way to share knowledge with grandmothers, midwives, healers and shamans. In Teotitlán del Valle the Ruiz family makes their own journey in search of colors, which they find inside plants and insects that are used to dye the wool with which they weave rugs. Both practices involve exploring the territory, recognizing it, naming it and relating to everything in it.

metas.name: Leave Without a
metas.description: An experimental short made in response to Linda Jankowska's score exploring liminal stages of life and death

metas.name: Devotional Signals~
metas.description: Devotional Signals ~ is an audio-visual alchemic process that explores the materiality of the signal as it shifts through historical forms into contemporary graphics. The leap motion was used to create a twelve complex oscillator spatial mixer with x & z, y generates an envelope (one per hand), invisible planes left and right of the performer trigger drums that can be grabbed mid air morphing the audio-visual material.

metas.name: WIND GAP
metas.description: Ming unexpectedly becomes pregnant in a dull relationship, and her life seems to have come to a sudden halt. She embarks on a journey to the China-Vietnam border alone, encountering gods and ghosts.

metas.name: co.loss..deus:
metas.description: "Advent of the monolithic computer era. Just as swiftly came its downfall." co.loss..deus: explores the limits of digital image denoising using NVIDIA's OptiX denoising algorithm, creating raw materials that are simultaneously blurry and sharp. A poignant analogy for digital degradation reminiscent of vaporwave, video game cutscenes and plunderphonics.

metas.name: Goodbye, Snoball
metas.description: During the COVID-19 pandemic, Washington, D.C., swings from a ghost town to a protest epicenter. Sergei Kostin, a local activist moves between these extremes daily. His days are split between the roaring chaos of street demonstrations and the tender moments with his aging dog, Snoball. Against the backdrop of a divisive election that brings thousands to the heart of America's capital, Sergei faces a more intimate challenge - the painful preparation to say goodbye to his beloved dog.

metas.name: Refuge
metas.description: Four estranged friends reunite on a fishing trip, but a missing child and a desperate father's accusation turn reunion into a deadly reckoning

metas.name: Missing Pages
metas.description: When a detective follows the trail of a missing girl to a state senator, he finds himself trapped inside the senator’s house with five strangers — just as the senator's body is discovered. As the night unravels, false faces and buried sins come to light, and bodies begin to fall as he hunts for the truth.

metas.name: Soldiers
metas.description: In a time of political turmoil, a striking factory worker struggles to find sexual satisfaction. As unrest turns to violence, his desire takes him down an unexpected path.

metas.name: Starlight
metas.description: Two estranged siblings set out to return a star to the night sky.

metas.name: Go With The Ghost
metas.description: Carson is haunted by every mistake she's ever made, by the addictions she harbors, by the person she became, and now by a supernatural being beyond comprehension. A being who is only after one thing: her. Even if she escapes him, how can she escape herself? Can you escape your fate? Or is it over from the second you commit your first sin?

metas.name: She Left me...Again
metas.description: A stranded Captain Spaulding tries to hitchhike to his friends birthday party, but the first car he hails is driven by his Ex-wife.

metas.name: VISCERAL IMAGES
metas.description: When Freya unwittingly hosts a group of radical activists on the eve of a stunt she begins to suspect they have designs on her vulnerable younger sister.

metas.name: TNA Sacrifice 2026
metas.description: Sacrifice 2026 was a professional wrestling event produced by Total Nonstop Action Wrestling (TNA) that took place on March 27, 2026, at the Alario Center in New Orleans, Louisiana, USA, and was headlined by Mike Santana (c) vs. Steve Maclin for the TNA World Title.

metas.name: He's Stuck In There
metas.description: When Corey gets cold feet about meeting his girlfriend's parents, he decides to hide inside of his water bottle. Corey must then confront his fear of father figures in order to escape.

metas.name: Is Gang Stalking Real
metas.description: A raw, unflinching look at a friendship haunted by meth-fueled paranoia, and fragile moments of clarity behind bars.

metas.name: Bad Night on Campus
metas.description: College applications are right around the corner, and high school students Kyle, Evan, Kris, and Martin's grades aren't looking too good. Naturally, the decision is made to hack into the gradebook and change their grades. But none of them could've anticipated what happens next...

metas.name: Control
metas.description: Five strangers attempt to regain control over their lives- with varying results.

metas.name: Synthesized
metas.description: Martyn is a man out of time who loves his wife Valkyrie, computers and synthesizers, which he plays in pubs and clubs to unappreciative audiences. But when Val does him wrong and Martyn's life starts to fall apart he retreats into his music, hoping to calm his inner turmoil.  But music can summon the dark as well as soothe the soul, and it's not long before Martyn is hitting more than just the keys on his synthesizer keyboard.

metas.name: Color Theories by Julio Torres. A Guide to Seeing the World
metas.description: Julio Torres takes the stage in NYC and invites the audience to see the people, places, and things around us through his kaleidoscopic lens. Blending stand-up, an interactive set, and live drawings, Julio explores the inherent traits, personalities, and emotions of particular colors.

metas.name: Michael Cruz Kayne: Sorry For Your Loss
metas.description: Michael Cruz Kayne reflects on his son's death and society's relationship with grief.

metas.name: Something Divine
metas.description: Ray Cappo lead singer of the straightedge hardcore band Youth of Today at the height of their growing popularity, leaves the band and goes to India. Ray becomes the monk Raghunath. What follows is the confluence of two worlds coming together. Hardcore punk and spirituality. Something Divine is a pilgrimage through the holy cites of India and concert halls in America. The film highlights the connection between people of very different backgrounds coming together through self-discovery, spirituality, music, the desire to grow and transform themselves personally.

metas.name: BlankBox
metas.description: In a future where an AI called BlankBox has erased all pain from human life, a teenage boy journeys to find something that no longer exists: love.

metas.name: Revelations of Divine Love
metas.description: Between pandemics, people’s revolts and male institutions, this period film cheekily combines fantastic psychedelia and handmade sets. Inspired by the life story of Julian of Norwich, a 14th-century mystic and the first woman to write a book in English.

metas.name: The Traveler
metas.description: An extensive cinematic essay on displacement and the terror of nostalgia.

metas.name: Empire of Lies
metas.description: When a mysterious young woman comes to interview a paranoid man living in rural isolation, he is forced to confront his part in his daughter's murder.

metas.name: How To Make A Friend
metas.description: Moo mourns her deceased friend, so Yuu decides to create a new companion for her. Their adventure fails, but they discover they have built a new friendship during the journey.

metas.name: Your Love
metas.description: Lake loves her Kodachrome, almost to the point where she doesn't trust anyone but it. But Michelle comes along and changes everything.

metas.name: A Collection of Short Skits
metas.description: A group of teenagers find themselves stuck in a constantly changing collection of short skits. Can they get over their differences and make it out?

metas.name: UNCONVENTIONAL
metas.description: A story about powerlifting's divide of deadlifts.

metas.name: Money Game
metas.description: Two young men are thrown into a world of money. How did they make it?

metas.name: Room of the Absolute
metas.description: Amid three years of relentless destruction to her homeland, Ukrainian painter Alla Hurenko (professionally known as "Pazza Pennello") offers a new diaristic perspective on daily life under war, where her canvas becomes a powerful act of resistance, a testament to perseverance, and a quiet rebellion against those determined to erase her world and identity.

metas.name: The Photographer
metas.description: In a quiet suburban town, a man slowly comes  to the realization that he is being stalked.

metas.name: A Symphony of Disappearing Sounds for the Great Salt Lake
metas.description: The short film composition, created together with UK-based music producer Koreless, combined over 150 field recordings of local animals who depend on the health of the Great Salt Lake, including hundreds of species of birds, amphibians, insects, and mammals. Drawn from existing archives as well as new recordings made for the project, the nature sounds have been mixed and translated into a musical composition that differs greatly from how the sounds would be encountered in the wild. The non-human voices are amplified and arranged into rhythmic beats to appeal to the human audience, so that they might perceive the lake in a new light and recognize its vulnerability. The film was projected as part of an art installation in downtown Salt Lake City, Utah, in March and April, 2026.

metas.name: The Last Soufflé
metas.description: The film chronicles the final days of Off Vine, a beloved vine-covered Craftsman bungalow restaurant that became an iconic piece of Hollywood history.

metas.name: The Things We Lose on Our Way to the Sky
metas.description: A reinterpretation of memory through the main motif of the color blue, grappling with both cultural and personal dissonance.

metas.name: Sunny Oaks
metas.description: A son visits his elderly mother in a care home, where he is confronted with an unthinkable dilemma.

metas.name: Cake by the Ocean
metas.description: First of many music video films: Harmony, Phoebe and Caitlin want some Cake by the Ocean

metas.name: Rally
metas.description: A short film about two friends playing ping pong shown at the Locust Valley Film Festival  By Leone Bartolani

metas.name: Noche Tras Noche
metas.description: The 'Movida Madrileña' movement told by Carabanchel neighboors.

metas.name: Hall Pass Enforcement
metas.description: The HPE isn't ICE, yes sure they have an integrated system with the DHS, but like it's completely different! This satire was made for an AP Language and Composition class. The prompt was to satirize something currently important in society today. The amazing group you are watching, wrote the script in under a day, and then shot it, thirty minutes a day, for two weeks. Special thanks to Layla Booker and Lucas Selesnick as this was not their projects and they helped out our crew. I hope you enjoy this student film, consider subscribing so we can all go to college, much love.

metas.name: Rot Log
metas.description: Travis Zariwny plays a man who isolates himself inside a shared living space after noticing subtle signs of environmental decay — softening wood, spreading moisture, structural instability. Determined to approach the anomaly scientifically, he begins recording daily “rot logs,” documenting what he believes is a creeping biological intrusion.

metas.name: Beauty and the Atheist
metas.description: A successful atheist podcaster crosses paths with a devout Christian. Both share a love for science, but are unable to see eye to eye on matters of the heart. This intellectual film will interest both believer and non-believer alike.

metas.name: Come Sunrise
metas.description: Joshua, a retired vampire hunter comes home to discover some things from the past can come back to bite you.

metas.name: Hi
metas.description: A woman reaches out across the digital void. What she hides behind her words is far more dangerous than what she reveals.

metas.name: Letter from Graz
metas.description: A letter-film.

metas.name: Welcome to Sinagovci
metas.description: Time moves at its own slow rhythm in the village of Sinagovci. When the mayor, an avid racing driver, donates a rusty old bus, a fragile dream of romantic journeys begins to take shape. Poets, a painter, a tractor driver, a fortune teller, and a handful of free spirits long for places which lead elsewhere. Some are waiting for Godot; others for a hot meal or a measure of dignity. Blending raw poetry, humour, and melancholy, Welcome to Sinagovci is a documentary portrait of a community where reality and fantasy intertwine, and where meaning is found in the simple, dreamlike act of being.

metas.name: Science Non-Fiction
metas.description: Tom has a simple assignment for school: to write a science fiction story. But none of his ideas are clicking, so he goes outside for a walk, and before he can say "time travel," he has a science-fiction adventure of his own.

metas.name: Leviticus
metas.description: This is what is written...  but this is what exists...  so why are we taught to question it?

metas.name: Pas de Deux
metas.description: A young dancer, once a star, struggles internally after joining a new ballet company where her teacher hardly notices her. Desperate to rise again, she immerses herself in online tutorials from a profound ballerina-turned-influencer, and slowly reshapes herself and her technique in the influencer's image. As her ability strengthens, her obsession deepens. She auditions for the influencer's prestigious company and leaves feeling triumphant, only to overhear a conversation that shatters the idealized version of her idol and her newfound sense of self.

metas.name: Berwick Bro's
metas.description: Two Cowboy's who used to be friends rekindle together for a final showdown of honor and friendship

metas.name: Mounds Above the Earth
metas.description: Mounds Above the Earth contemplates ecological cycles, perception, and environmental transformation, anchored in the rare emergence of two periodical cicada broods surfacing simultaneously for the first time in more than two centuries. The film follows the flicker of red—through the cicadas’ developing eyes, a blood moon, and an ancient fable.

metas.name: One Shot
metas.description: After a hunting accident in the remote woods, two amateur hunters scramble to confront the weight of what just happened, isolation and panic begin to consume them and distort their sense of control and reality.

metas.name: Pour Light on Everything
metas.description: An experiment of light, brought to life.

metas.name: Self-Submission Blues
metas.description: A lonely actor spends his time making self-tapes.

metas.name: Gorillaz - Journey to The Mountain
metas.description: Documentary short covering the making of Gorillaz' ninth studio album, The Mountain.

metas.name: The Life of a Chair
metas.description: no musik, no dialog just a chair and the nature

metas.name: doomscrolling
metas.description: a young woman drifts through her days in a constant scroll, trapped in an endless loop of short-form content. moving from app to app, she mistakes distraction for rest, losing touch with the world around her. when her phone dies, she is forced into silence. reality begins to unfold — vivid and alive — and she finally notices the rhythm of the world she had been ignoring.  a quiet reflection on digital addiction and the beauty of being present.

metas.name: The 15 Year Project
metas.description: The stupider spiritual sucessor to Boyhood: a feature length documentary charting the dramatic rise of a friend group that was initially expected not to last once we got to college, filmed over the course of 15 years.  Filmed by Will Hopson from ages 13 to 27, with select footage courtesy of Jonathan Stritch & Sayed Gilani  Edited by Will Hopson  Starring Will Hopson, Jonathan Stritch, & Sayed Gilani  Featuring music by Drake, Macklemore, David Bowie, Linkin Park, & Ludwig van Beethoven

metas.name: For the Love of Money
metas.description: Brian and Joe, life long friends, have a crisis in their friendship after Brian comes into some money.

metas.name: Thus Spoke the Wind
metas.description: An exiled knight discovers a befallen blade that holds magic, and divine curse.

metas.name: Dead Man's Hand
metas.description: A late night poker game between a cowboy and a professional gambler, alone in a saloon. Things turn deadly as one of them is not what they seem.

metas.name: En Plein Air
metas.description: A struggling painter sets out on a do-or-die journey to paint the Mojave. With 72 hours to capture a perfect desert landscape, she finds herself disrupted by the hostile environment and a bizarre monolith that won't seem to go away.

metas.name: The Midnight Hour
metas.description: The Midnight Hour is about a grieving woman, whose hopes for marriage is re-ignited when the ghost of her dead fiance appears.

metas.name: Sorry, It's a Girl
metas.description: When a woman discovers she is pregnant with a baby girl, family and societal pressures force her to consider an abortion.

metas.name: Lucky
metas.description: When Lucky moves from India to Scandinavia on a student visa, it's a lifelong dream come true. But in Copenhagen Lucky's dream collides with a harsh reality in which people line up to take advantage of his situation, while he has to work day and night to keep his visa. What started out as a golden opportunity increasingly feels like a trap, as Lucky begins to fathom the ramifications of going abroad.

metas.name: Mystery Wrestling #23
metas.description: Mystery Wrestling #23 took place March 26 on Twitch.TV

metas.name: Threads
metas.description: In a non-linear portrait of youth, the lives of several teenagers dealing with heartbreak, loneliness, and identity gradually intertwine, revealing how the smallest moments can change the direction of a life. As their seemingly separate lives begin to intersect, the film explores how small moments and connections shape the emotional reality of teenage life.

metas.name: Refugee Stories
metas.description: Travel to Kakuma Refugee Camp in northwestern Kenya, one the world's biggest refugee camps and home to nearly 300,000 people. In an investigation into the realities of long-term displacement, the film follows five refugees representing different income levels within the camp: from Rose, among the poorest households, to Maker, one of the better-off residents.  Each protagonist shares their story in their own words, offering intimate portraits of work, family life, ambition, and survival. By focusing on representative lives, Refugee Stories challenges dominant media narratives that depict refugees only in extreme situations, revealing the quiet inequalities that shape daily existence and determine what people can eat, learn, hope for, and plan.

metas.name: In The Meantime
metas.description: A stressed film student waiting for his exam results shares an unexpected conversation with an older woman on a park bench that helps him see his future with a little more kindness.

metas.name: Al Buio
metas.description: Academic short film from Chiara and Nicolò Caggiano, which depicts depression as a long sleep.

metas.name: Bluey at the Cinema: Playdates with Friends
metas.description: A compilation of eight episodes from across the show’s three series, united around themes of play, friendship and family.

metas.name: Shareholders
metas.description: They have very serious business to attend to.

metas.name: Collapse
metas.description: When the power goes out and all exits mysteriously seal shut, shoppers and employees find themselves trapped inside a Puerto Rico shopping mall with no communication to the outside world. As uncertainty turns to desperation, what begins as confusion rapidly descends into chaos. With limited food supplies and no answers, strangers must choose between cooperation and survival at any cost. In the darkness, civilized society collapses in mere hours, revealing the fragile line between order and anarchy. A post-apocalyptic thriller that unfolds entirely within the claustrophobic confines of a mall, where the real horror isn't what's outside—it's what emerges from within.

metas.name: Green Time
metas.description: A short drama film.

metas.name: Really Happy Someday
metas.description: A rising musical theatre star struggles with his changing voice during his gender transition. With the help of a singing coach, he learns to trust himself, reclaim his career, and reconnect with the people he loves.

metas.name: Investigator
metas.description: Amidst the foggy evergreen forests of Washington State's Olympic Peninsula, private investigator Leigh Hearon explores the criminal underbelly of a small town that has been transformed by the loss of manufacturing jobs and the invasion of meth and opiates. Recently employed by a local public defender on a case of attempted matricide, INVESTIGATOR delves into Hearon's personal motivations and her place in the criminal justice system as she reaches the latter part of her thirty-year career.

metas.name: Casino!
metas.description: In this docu-fiction short, a group of community theater actors create a casino through a sense-memory workshop and explore the workshop’s effect on their own histories, imaginations, and performances.

metas.name: No More Mister Nice Guy
metas.description: After a post-coital conversation rattles his self-image, a painfully nice boyfriend embarks on a late-night mission to reinvent himself

metas.name: Sisyphus
metas.description: A man is trapped in a psychological time loop, forced to relive the same moment again and again. With every repetition, his grip on reality weakens, turning survival into a battle against his own mind.

metas.name: The Fort
metas.description: In a world destroyed by war, pandemics, and disaster, a small group of survivors finds refuge inside a rebuilt stronghold known as The Fort. As darkness rises and deception spreads, the community must stand together in faith and courage to defend their last haven and fight for truth, hope, and the future of mankind.

metas.name: Cats from the Crow’s Nest: The Bottle
metas.description: An animated pilot featuring three feline swashbucklers and the silly hijinks that ensue.

metas.name: 40th Melbourne International Comedy Festival Gala
metas.description: Denise Scott hosts the Melbourne Comedy Festival Gala featuring a stellar lineup including Claire Hooper, Josh Thomas, Urzila Carlson, Sammy J, Matt Okine, Sashi Perera, Takashi Wakasugi, Ray O'Leary, Nath Valvo and more.

metas.name: UNBROKEN: The Untold Story of Shen Yun
metas.description: “UNBROKEN: The Untold Story of Shen Yun” follows the world-renowned classical Chinese dance company Shen Yun Performing Arts as it rises to global acclaim while facing intimidation and threats of violence. Through the eyes of two brothers and their fellow performers, the film traces an unlikely journey—from ordinary American childhoods to the world’s most prestigious stages—where rigorous artistic training and spiritual conviction shape both their craft and their character.  As Shen Yun tours internationally, the company becomes the target of escalating smear campaigns, threats, and alleged interference linked to the Chinese Communist Party. Blending personal storytelling with investigative reporting, “UNBROKEN” reveals what happens when art, faith, and freedom collide with totalitarianism power—and how resilience, community, and cultural revival endure in the face of intimidation.

metas.name: War of the Worlds
metas.description: Rhys narrates the abridged story of 2025 hit film War of the Worlds

metas.name: RAW
metas.description: Experimental short film

metas.name: A Room Without Corners
metas.description: A man discovers a USB drive containing footage of his own life—before it happens.

metas.name: My Husband the Child Soldier
metas.description: In Cambodia, former Khmer Rouge child soldier Aki Ra and his wife Hout help communities reclaim their land by undertaking the potentially lethal task of clearing unexploded landmines left over from years of war. Along the way they adopt unwanted kids whose childhoods and limbs have been destroyed by landmines, and open a war museum that soon becomes world famous. Aki Ra fights to break free of shadows cast by his role in the genocidal Khmer Rouge regime, and rebuild his shattered family. But in a country grappling to come to terms with its history, the past always has a way of catching up.

metas.name: Memories of the Beginning
metas.description: Memories of the Beginning tells the story of survival and unlikely friendship between two 13-year-old prison guards at one of Cambodia’s earliest killing fields. Filmed 50 years later at the former prison site, it traces a hard-won journey of compassion and freedom.

metas.name: Sukundimi Walks Before Me
metas.description: When an enormous mine threatens the Sepik River, Papua New Guinean activist Manu Peni and his people launch an urgent mission to protect the waterway, by recognising the river’s own Right to Life.

metas.name: March 25th, 2015
metas.description: “March 25th, 2015” (Directed by Alexandra LoCascio & Rebecca Rutledge) follows a group of middle school girls on the day Zayn Malik left One Direction. The die-hard Directioners must  survive a spiral into emotional chaos, an unexpected soul-searching journey for any semblance of an answer, and… an algebra quiz that's due tomorrow.

metas.name: EARTH ISN'T FUNNY
metas.description: when a local subway talk show host interviews a homeless man, he's sucked down a paranoid rabbit hole of aliens, salvia, and stand up comedy

metas.name: NANOcell
metas.description: After an experimental research study goes wrong, Maggie Miller must battle a race against time and a government conspiracy to prevent a technological nightmare from taking over her body.

metas.name: Fractured Acts
metas.description: In the intense world of theater, Jason's simmering jealousy, fueled by a script change and real-life betrayal, culminates in a tragic on-stage confrontation that blurs the lines between reality and fiction.

metas.name: Breaking Glass: The Pat Summitt Story
metas.description: Chronicles the life of the legendary Tennessee Lady Vols basketball coach.

metas.name: Top
metas.description: Finally at the hospital for his long awaited gender affirming top surgery, Matt Levit, with lively girlfriend Leisha Meyer by his side, navigates the bureaucracy of the top surgery process. But once Matt is thrown deep into surgery day, he suddenly finds his present intertwining with his past self, Kimberly. Plunging through past and present, Matt is dropped into confronting his relationship with his chest and sudden loss of his mother, Nancy.

metas.name: Learning to Love Your Demon in 8 Stages
metas.description: The self encounters the inner demon for the first time, and takes the audience on a journey from terror to acceptance in a silent film about the perils of self discovery.

metas.name: NO MORE THAN ANYONE ELSE
metas.description: Blending candid interviews, experimental moments, and reflective narration, this 55-minute personal doc explores what it means to grow up when the people who love you also struggle to accept who you are. Through screen-recorded calls with friends, street interviews, and distant footage of everyday life, I examine my upbringing as a queer non-binary trans person—where love, expectation, and shame often coexisted—among a sea of other stories about adolescence. Anchored by a conversation with a close friend and fellow artist, the film sits in the tension between care and rejection, asking if anyone is even really special—or maybe all of us are.

metas.name: Jake Webley In: The Mysterious Case of the Pacific Robbery
metas.description: Jake is a guy who likes reading books, maybe a little too much. Caught up in his imagination, he drags his best friend along on solving a mystery in a very noir way.

metas.name: Portraits
metas.description: Portraits is an intimate window into the life of Hung, a sketch artist in the middle of a bustling night market of Da Nang, Vietnam. With 2 charcoal pencils and masterful skills, Hung captures the essence of his subjects in minutes. In a world increasingly obsessed with the speed and precision of Artificial Intelligence, Hung offers a quiet, profound meditation on what it means to create.

metas.name: A Fleeting Fugue
metas.description: A songwriter desperately tries to hold on to a new melody as they navigate through the sounds of the big city

metas.name: Rabbit's Foot
metas.description: After a robbery, two brothers and a girlfriend drift into the countryside - where the air turns cold and hidden desires push brotherhood toward collapse.

metas.name: The Last of the Lookouts
metas.description: One of British Columbia’s last remaining fire lookouts, 72-year-old Bart Vanderlinde, scans horizons and distills life lessons during what may be his final fire season in the watchtower.

metas.name: My Body Is a Lens I Can Look Through With My Mind
metas.description: My Body Is a Lens I Can Look Through With My Mind starts at the 2024 solar eclipse and uses planetary movements and geological records as jumping-off points to explore memory, meaning-making and subjectivity.

metas.name: Bon Jovi Forever: A Tony Robbins Special
metas.description: World-renowned motivational speaker and author Tony Robbins sits down with superstar, Jon Bon Jovi. Enjoy this intimate conversation between friends with exclusive performances from Bon Jovi.

metas.name: Transforming the Beautiful Game: The Clyde Best Story
metas.description: Biography of the iconic groundbreaking athlete Clyde Best, the Black football superstar in the modern TV Era in England and legend of the North America Soccer League.

metas.name: Breaking Through the Fear
metas.description: After a traumatic assault, a gay man battles crippling anxiety and fear of the outside world, anchored by the quiet, unwavering love of his partner, who becomes his strength when his own falters.

metas.name: Kiloran Bay
metas.description: Kiloran Bay is written and directed by Michael Bruce: A musical short film starring Alan Cumming and Jack Wolfe. After decades away, a gay man returns home to Scotland to attend a traditional wedding and faces a past he spent a lifetime avoiding.

metas.name: Bring Me the Horizon: L.I.V.E. in São Paulo
metas.description: BRIT-winning and Grammy-nominated band Bring Me The Horizon's biggest headline show to date. Shot at São Paulo’s Allianz Parque Stadium, performed in front of a sold-out crowd of 50,000, the film expands the visual universe of POST HUMAN by blending cinematic visuals, fan-submitted videos and showcasing characters such as E.V.E, Selene & M8. It delivers an immersive experience that rivals that electric night in Brazil. The performance spans the full evolution of BMTH’s discography, from Sempiternal and That’s the Spirit to amo and the POST HUMAN albums. L.I.V.E. in São Paulo brings the viewer in, and never lets them go.

metas.name: A Man of Potential: Visions of Paul Wendkos, the Godard of Gidget
metas.description: Paul Wendkos was a bit of an auteurist fetish object in the early 1960's, when his career in theatrical features reached its pinnacle. He made his mark with such genre outings as The Burglar (1957) and Face of a Fugitive (1959), as well as with the hit Gidget (1959) and his acclaimed indictment of evangelicalism Angel Baby (1961). Many of the finest critics and film writers wrote of his style admiringly, even as studio contracts regularly saddled him with empty commercial vehicles. Quentin Tarantino even credited him as the director of the faux action saga The 14 Fists of McCluskey in his Once Upon a Time...in Hollywood. What is there to Paul Wendkos when we look at him and his work today?

metas.name: Washed Up
metas.description: Morwenna is scraping by, searching for artistic inspiration, battling heartbreak and trying to fend off tourists seeking to buy her grandfather’s house. When she meets the nomadic Inga, her life is transformed. But how can a girl and a selkie make a relationship work? Drawing inspiration from romcoms and folklore, Washed Up is a guaranteed crowd-pleaser.

metas.name: Inside the Mind of Oscar Geppetto
metas.description: A window inside the mind of Oscar Geppetto, one of the most puzzling enigmas in music history.

metas.name: The Second Door
metas.description: A woman who is a mother figure of an 8-year old boy, struggles with a moral predicament when he meets her 19 years later, as the lines between the present reality and the possible future begin to blur.

metas.name: spilled milk
metas.description: When faced with the haunting memories of her complicated relationship with Mark, Kate is forced to decipher if what she believes happened between them is reality.

metas.name: Every Time I See A Yellow Car
metas.description: Olly, a man haunted by a childhood tragedy and a recent assault, and his older brother Liam, who desperately attempts to protect Olly, find themselves in a spiral of revenge and chaos. Whilst their seemingly clashing personalities should make them anything but friends, the pair both aim to break a cycle of trauma, but in contradictory ways.

metas.name: Molly
metas.description: A chance encounter at a launderette sparks a meaningful connection between Vinnie and Ryan. As closeness blurs into desire, they are forced to confront what love demands before it fractures everything they have built.

metas.name: Mihnea
metas.description: A coming-of-age story about the only son of a tight-knit Romanian-Canadian family struggling with his mental health and the expectations of his authoritarian father in his final year of University.

metas.name: Fresh Meat Mom
metas.description: A young mom must find a way to maneuver around her husband’s vasectomy when she learns the private school she’s been pressured into joining has a 2 kid minimum.

metas.name: HARD / SOFT / STICKY WET: A Joyous Death
metas.description: A queer and trans found family create a death ritual that weaves together the inextricable experiences of grief and eros, community and country.

metas.name: Colors Don't Cry
metas.description: The film is a conversation between a young man, not naive, but seemingly lost and a wise master. It starts with the young man's question, "What does a warrior do at night?". "Nothing. He sleeps", answers the master. The profound simplicity of this answer probes the young man to bring out more of his dilemmas and angst as the master holds his hand, not to guide, but to challenge his despair.

metas.name: Bad Date
metas.description: A bad date.

metas.name: SUSPECTS
metas.description: A group of teens go through the night of a birthday party to figure out who killed their friend.

metas.name: Musicians
metas.description: Two street musicians fight to out-play each other.

metas.name: Killers of the Flower Moon: A Historic Collaboration
metas.description: New documentary featuring Scorsese, actors Leonardo DiCaprio and Lily Gladstone, author David Grann, Osage Nation Principal Chief Geoffrey Standing Bear, Osage cultural consultant John Williams, editor Thelma Schoonmaker, and other members of the cast and crew

metas.name: WahZhaZhe: A Song for the Osage
metas.description: Documentary illuminating the film’s final shot, featuring Scorsese, Chief Standing Bear, and six members of the Osage Nation

metas.name: WhatsApp Obsession: The Murder of Stephanie Hansen
metas.description: Obsession, control and betrayal. This powerful true-crime documentary tells the story of Stephanie Hansen, a young woman who was murdered at the hands of her fixated flatmate.

metas.name: Sala
metas.description: A young woman lost everything in Nazi slave labor camps but never surrendered her empathy, compassion, and willingness to love.  A portrait of lifelong and ever-changing resilience.

metas.name: The Legend of Legendarius
metas.description: Legendarius tries to find a way back to his son Junior after meeting an untimely end.

metas.name: First Haunt
metas.description: Claire, a young woman afraid to move on, enters purgatory after being brutally murdered, only to find the unexpected business world of haunting where she's assigned to haunt Will - a struggling writer who just found the inspiration for his new murder mystery novel.

metas.name: Year of the Horse
metas.description: Luhvers make it out the gc

metas.name: Stardust
metas.description: Autumn is haunted by vivid dreams of a man, Jo. As Autumn’s waking life becomes a blur, she faces hard truths about her reality.

metas.name: Power: The Downfall of Huw Edwards
metas.description: Docudrama following the downfall of BBC Presenter Huw Edwards.

metas.name: The Kinderhook Creature: In the Shadow of Sasquatch
metas.description: Kinderhook is a quiet, picturesque community found in Columbia County, New York, typified by bubbling streams, thick forests and generational homes. But Kinderhook is much more than a small, rural town. In the 1980s an author and radio broadcaster named Bruce Hallenbeck and his family were beset by continual encounters with a strange, upright creature. The sightings became an international phenomenon, and even stranger, were but one of many odd events chronicled by Hallenbeck and others.

metas.name: She Had Some Work Done
metas.description: In this subversive short, Nancy Andrews plays with form to examine ways of conforming to standard norms of beauty. In the process, she redefines the purpose behind the saying, "to have work done".

metas.name: That Bolex Thing
metas.description: The Bolex is a Swiss-made film camera that played a pivotal role in the development of avant-garde filmmaking. The aesthetic look produced by the Bolex is equally unique and significant. The 16mm images display a textured and grainy quality. The resulting visuals are synonymous with the visionary and poetic aesthetic of artist inspired filmmaking.

metas.name: Abstraction Belongs to Us
metas.description: Queer Palestinians in London and Paris navigate the intersections between their national identity and sexuality.

metas.name: The Catalyst
metas.description: A university student seizes control of time when he is endowed with a divine golden necklace -- 'the Catalyst' -- which grants him the ability to restart the day, only to learn that limitless productivity comes at a dangerous cost.

metas.name: How Was Your Day?
metas.description: Ben’s days are a mess of minor catastrophes that only seem to get worse. But none of it matters, because he lives with roommates who never let him get a word in. As the interruptions pile up, the question becomes less dramatic and more ridiculous: will Ben ever get to talk about his day?

metas.name: Jeff Ross: Take a Banana for the Ride
metas.description: Making his Broadway debut, legendary comic Jeff Ross turns the spotlight on himself in a one-man show that is as heartfelt as it is hilarious.

metas.name: Finding the Zone
metas.description: This timeless coming-of-age story is about a teenage boy who dreams of becoming a professional baseball player. From his humble beginnings, raised on a farm, the hero's journey transports the audience through his trials and tribulations, propelling him into an inner world where he discovers who he truly is and claims victory over his most notorious enemy.

metas.name: JUGGERNAUT
metas.description: In the found-footage film JUGGERNAUT, men from YouTube archives take center stage. They participate in an endless competition for the title of "THE BEST." To achieve this, the film uses documentary footage from the 1950s that extol the virtues of capitalism, as well as a flood of YouTube videos uploaded by men revealing their secrets to getting rich quickly.

metas.name: Kairos The Musical
metas.description: After an ambitious young student discovers how to time travel, they try and explain their findings through song and dance to their skeptical friends.

metas.name: Watermelon.
metas.description: A regular grocery store watermelon seeks a higher ranking in the hierarchy of the universe.

metas.name: Shalom
metas.description: An underground MMA fighter diagnosed with ADHD not only fights his opponents but also faces his battles within. What lies ahead in this black sheep’s journey?

metas.name: EYE CANDY
metas.description: Does an eye for an eye still make the world blind?

metas.name: Happy Place
metas.description: A lonely high school student takes refuge in his mind after being the subject of indirect bullying at school.

metas.name: Where Do Clowns Go
metas.description: Where Do Clowns Go unpacks the incredible lives of five performing artists. This fly-on-the-wall documentary opens a window into their lives; the joys, conflicts and contradictions of living with the characters they create. Five career performers, across four countries, are all united by one thing; the draw of the stage.

metas.name: The Male Gaze: Naughty Boys
metas.description: Bad behavior travels from the bedroom to the classroom to the beach in these six short films from Spain, France, Germany, Australia and Afghanistan that follow wayward boys and men for whom mischief and sexuality go hand in hand.

metas.name: A Fool's Affair
metas.description: A Jester's Royal love affair.

metas.name: Joyce’s Kitchen 2
metas.description: Chef Ryan Joyce cooks a meal with his team

metas.name: Forglemmegei
metas.description: Martin lives alone with his memories, but even they are starting to slip away. His grandchild, Teodor, gives him something to fill the void in his life, and it works — for a while.

metas.name: Japan (2026)
metas.description: Experience Japan in 2026 through this casual documentary.

metas.name: Onde Jaz Orson Welles?
metas.description: To the memory of Orson Welles and all filmmakers inspired by him and to the love that was and is.

metas.name: The [Conserv]atives
metas.description: From summer 2021 through Donald Trump's re-election campaign, four Republican insiders wage an uphill battle to transform their party's stance on climate change from within. A young grassroots organizer, a big-city mayor, an Iowa farmer, and an evangelical pastor — each embedded in different corners of the conservative ecosystem — risk alienation from their own communities as they attempt to reframe climate action as a conservative value.  As extreme weather intensifies and the 2024 election approaches, they confront a political machine built on denial, testing whether personal conviction can overcome tribal loyalty. This is a deeply personal story about the cost of defying your own side and the haunting question that drives them all: will their efforts be enough before time runs out?

metas.name: Hallways
metas.description: A tour through the hallways of a high school , starting in a stairwell and ending in the bathroom. A rumination on teenage love.

metas.name: Kountry Wayne: Nostalgia
metas.description: Nostalgia is full of funny and hilarious moments mixed with the truth. It reminds us of how comedy was back in the day. It gives us that '90s feel-that funny, raw, fun, hard, Def Jam laughter-but at the same time, it holds informational, truthful, and enlightening moments. It's full of laughter, and it's the nostalgia of how you felt back in the day… before AI existed!

metas.name: Revue !!!
metas.description: Artefacts from the golden times of small gauge amateur film take centre stage: Ready-made film transitions from the 1970’s and 80’s, short, colourful patterns and animations for the ambitious hobby film maker to be intercut into their home movies. This project brings these forgotten pieces of film culture back to life and celebrates their opulent aesthetics in a stereoscopic film projection. It pumps, jumps, slides, and distorts the reference points of our languid brains. A trip!

metas.name: GT40: The Road to Spa
metas.description: With exclusive behind-the-scenes access, take a front-row seat to one of the most gruelling classic endurance races in the world as the sport’s most fearless drivers push themselves to the limit for the Spa 6 Hours. On a battleground infamous for its unpredictable weather, dramatic elevation changes, and unforgiving corners, who will defy the odds to cement their place in racing history?

metas.name: Shoulder
metas.description: A man inherits his estranged father’s home and grapples with the rationale; much to the agitation of his close friend.

metas.name: The Nomophobe
metas.description: A teenage girl with nomophobia endeavours to break free from her smartphone addiction to restore the close connection with her mother.

metas.name: The Embalmer
metas.description: “Ang Bangkay” (The Embalmer) tells the story of the Corintho family who owns a funeral business.
