The story begins with the death of the matriarch, Milagros, leaving Isabel to deal with the responsibility of dealing with the errands in the family business and the household left behind by her mom.

metas.name: This is home
metas.description: a playful portrait of a local actress who researches an unusual role and a filmmaker that is caught in the metaphorical limb between Siberia and Southern Indiana.

metas.name: Confessions of a Female Serial Killer
metas.description: In the spring of 2013, 31-year-old mother of two, Joanne Dennehy, embarked on a murderous rampage that would leave 3 men dead and 2 others fighting for their lives. She was only the third woman in the UK to ever be handed a whole life sentence; joining Myra Hindley and Rose West as one of the most notorious British female serial killers of all time.

metas.name: ìfé: (The Sequel)
metas.description: ìfé: (The Sequel) picks up from the events of the first film, with two women, Ife and Adaora, crossing paths again, years apart from their past passionate dalliance. Adaora has settled comfortably into domestic life with her husband, while Ife found love in South Africa. However, all of this threatens to fall apart when the pair reconnect unexpectedly at a Lagos book store. The film unfolds as an exploration of love, choice, and identity in Nigeria. It is an intimate and political look at the universal longing for connection and the courage it takes to live authentically.

metas.name: A Force Of Nature
metas.description: Mikey is alone in his house, he doesn't realise that someone from his past is about to confront him. Someone who believes themself to be A Force Of Nature.

metas.name: Hannah Montana 20th Anniversary Special
metas.description: Filmed in front of a live studio audience and hosted by Alex Cooper of 'Call Her Daddy' fame, Miley Cyrus reflects on the creation and impact of the series with never-before-seen archival footage, all the while interacting and reminiscing on some of the show's most memorable sets 'brought back to life' — including the Stewart family living room and the legendary Hannah Montana closet.

metas.name: Piety, Patriotism and Violence: The Legacy of Cutter and Bone
metas.description: Featurette on the legacy of Cutter’s Way with contributions from writers Megan Abbott, Jordan Harper, and George Pelecanos

metas.name: An Incomplete Calendar
metas.description: A forgotten musical record connects Caracas to Tehran, revealing untold stories of oil, not as a commodity, but as a political leverage for the liberation struggles in Palestine and building Pan-Arab solidarity between 1960-1970.

metas.name: Pour the Water as I Leave
metas.description: A surreal exploration of the war in Bosnia told through the unbreakable spirit of seven of her people whose strength to leave was as powerful as the fight to stay. Through the lens of diaspora, the film captures not just the weight of displacement, but the defiant act of survival and the unwavering pursuit of home, no matter where the journey leads.

metas.name: SNUFF
metas.description: After a failed suicide attempt due to immense drug debt, Noel is released from the psych ward, and Enzo, her plug, will stop at nothing for his money back.

metas.name: Leaving Eden
metas.description: Sixty years after the nuclear devastation, a few survivors cling to life in a ruined industrial zone. Ten-year-old Niko lives with his grandfather Lexi, convinced that their territory is a "paradise" worth defending. Lexi indoctrinates Niko to hate the rival survivors across the railroad tracks. A violent confrontation with a feral child triggers a brutal conflict in which the children serve the adults' power struggles. As the adults' violence escalates, Niko realizes that Lexi is not the man he thought he was. The arrival of Xeni's family reveals that borders are a prison, and escape threatens deadly consequences for the children.

metas.name: The Fright Stuff
metas.description: This documentary follows the life and times of the haunted attraction industry in the United States - the history, the people, the lasting imprint it's had on the culture.

metas.name: Out Laws
metas.description: A powerful documentary that follows gay Namibian activist Friedel Dausab as he challenges his country’s criminalisation of same-sex love. In June 2022, Friedel files a landmark lawsuit against the government, becoming a beacon of hope for LGBTQIA+ Namibians seeking safety and equality. Facing death threats, public hostility, and immense personal risk, he takes his fight to court while awaiting judgment. The film also traces the colonial roots of queer criminalisation—from Tudor England to its export across the Global South through empire and later reinforced by Christian evangelism. Alongside fellow activists from Sri Lanka and Barbados, Friedel travels to London, where history, protest, and Pride converge. Blending legal battle with historical insight, the documentary is both an urgent exposé of injustice and a stirring celebration of queer resilience, courage, and resistance.

metas.name: In Case I Forget You
metas.description: A man struggles to recollect the memories that he shared with his estranged father as he travels back to see him for the last time. In his journey, he confronts a fragmented yet important past that makes him question if he can trust his own memories.

metas.name: The Christophers
metas.description: The estranged children of a once-famous artist hire a forger to complete his unfinished works so they can be "discovered" and sold after his death.

metas.name: Hejira, Fragmented
metas.description: Still somehow the slightest touch of a stranger can set up trembling in my bones. I know no one's going to show me everything.

metas.name: Monochromatic
metas.description: After years of living alone, a shut-in takes on a roommate and learns that the world is not just in black and white. But did Lumi get more than she bargained for with her new roommate Angel?

metas.name: I Hope I Get This Job
metas.description: A confused interviewee is tormented by his two potential bosses to his breaking point

metas.name: Always On
metas.description: After moving into his parents’ basement, Bronson Somatz deals with his breakup the only way he knows how: impromptu therapy sessions in the back of an ice cream truck, escapes to his ever-devolving daydreams, and a whole lotta Tennessee whiskey.

metas.name: 4th & 44
metas.description: Based on the life of Marty Reichman, who became the oldest college football player in American history at the age of 44.

metas.name: Mirrors
metas.description: Upon returning home after spending seven years living in Spain, Inés must adapt to a reality that is not what she left behind. Her family’s expectations, accumulated tensions, and her grandmother's deterioration make her return more complicated than she imagined.

metas.name: The Kingdom of Kubala
metas.description: Drew Taylor travels to Scotland to investigate the controversial 'Kingdom of Kubala,' an alleged African tribe living in the woods. Taylor explores allegations of manipulation, coercive behavior, and the group's dramatic online presence to understand the true nature of their existence. This film documents real people and perspectives.

metas.name: Agnus Dei
metas.description: A three student document about one of the most visited and famous places in Portugal. The Sactuary of Fátima. It explores the duality of the visitors, the believers and the tourists and both at the same time. It revolves around the gathering of many people in one singular place with the same reasons, faith and devotion.

metas.name: Compulsive
metas.description: A man goes to increasingly desperate lengths to avoid his girlfriend discovering the web of lies he has woven.

metas.name: This Is It
metas.description: This Is It is an exploration in finding truth within labour, creativity, and mortality. Written entirely on the job, Kyrstyn Kumor thrusts herself into the endless attempt at finding the answers. This Is It is a play inspired by Jordan Tannahill’s Declarations.

metas.name: I Want Everyone to Like Me
metas.description: Jules, a small independent vtuber, meets a series of eccentric people while trying to get rent money.

metas.name: #UNBOXING
metas.description: There’s something fascinating about unwrapping gifts and opening boxes, an emotion that ranges from intrigue to euphoria. Here we know what’s inside, and what interests us is what’s outside: Americans filming themselves while showing off their new weapons and gleefully monetizing content that is also a relentless killing machine and, in Edo García’s hands, a razor-sharp ode to frivolity.

metas.name: In Our Blood: The Forever Chemicals Scandal
metas.description: Revealing how toxic PFAS "forever chemicals" contaminated a UK town, leaving residents and workers with staggering blood test results.

metas.name: The Tree Economy
metas.description: Atlanta has the largest urban tree canopy of any major city in North America. The Tree Economy follows the forces of development, economics, and politics threatening to erase the defining characteristic of one of America's great cities.  Through the voices of tree activists, arborists, urban designers, elected officials, and developers, filmmaker James Schroeder documents a city at a crossroads.

metas.name: Melanie Bracewell: A Little Treat
metas.description: A show about the night at the netball awards where I didn't know how I would get my car home.

metas.name: Everything Good
metas.description: It's Thanksgiving dinner and twenty-something Gabi has to deliver some disappointing news: she's dropping out of college. Gabi is especially worried about her father, whose high expectations have smothered her entire life. Riddled with nerves, Gabi enlists the help of her mischievous cousin and some psychedelics.

metas.name: Random Acts
metas.description: Last year there were 6,012 people who got away with murder. This is the story of two of them.

metas.name: Ditched
metas.description: A group of friends have to overcome their paranoia and work together to survive a deadly road trip.

metas.name: Code Red
metas.description: After a menstrual mishap on her way to class, a professor is exposed to her students and must decide whether to flee the scene or teach a lesson about shame.

metas.name: Lock Him In
metas.description: Famous rapper Rook gets trapped in a recording studio with Tiana, a fan dedicated to returning him to his old style.

metas.name: Lights camera vanya
metas.description: Lights, Camera, Vanya is a dark comedy psychological thriller about a young woman who starts hearing background music that no one else can hear. As the sound continues, it begins to affect her behavior and decisions, leading to a moment where she loses control and commits an irreversible act. Someone's watching, turning the night into a tense darkly fun game.

metas.name: Charlotte, Beverly, Georg.
metas.description: Walking and filming, I listened to Beverly Glenn-Copeland, read Charlotte Perkins Gilman and Georg Trakl. The film, shot and edited in single day, is structured around these 3 artists.

metas.name: Who Could Kill a Sweet Old Lady
metas.description: When Edie becomes the new caregiver to an extremely rich elderly woman, she soon starts to suspect that someone wants her client dead - and that she's now the only thing standing in their way.

metas.name: Soft Tread
metas.description: Alice and Jack are at a rest stop on their way to a new city when they realise they've left something important back home. Jack heads back to get it and Alice is left at the rest stop alone where she is forced to face her fears about moving

metas.name: The Last Responders
metas.description: On 23 March 2025 in Tel al-Sultan, Gaza, Israeli forces massacred fifteen Palestinian aid workers travelling in clearly marked humanitarian vehicles, later burying their bodies and vehicles in a shallow mass grave. Earshot and Forensic Architecture worked with the Palestine Red Crescent Society and survivors of the massacre to reconstruct the incident with unprecedented precision.  The Last Responders is an investigative documentary about this massacre. Anchored in the situated testimonies of two survivors, the film draws on firsthand video and voice recordings captured during the night of the attack by the Palestine Red Crescent Society. Through these materials, the film probes acts of execution and concealment, while reconstructing a fuller account of what unfolded in Tel al-Sultan in the hours and days that followed.

metas.name: Rum Kicks
metas.description: Scott tries to remember his relationship with his ex, Nina, but the facts of what they once had are muddled.

metas.name: Under a Bamboo Sky
metas.description: A tale of human connection, hope and resilience in the face of great tragedy, Under a Bamboo Sky uses new technology to bring to life an untold story of Australian soldiers held prisoner by the Japanese in WWII. Using their own words, their own voices, the film weaves the recollections of more than 60 former POWs with newly colourised archival material and new location footage to deliver a moving and revelatory first-hand account of their experience. Captured during the Japanese offensive and imprisoned in Singapore’s Changi Barracks, the film follows the years long journey of these soldiers through four countries. After bearing witness to some of WWII’s most history-defining events, they tell of returning home to families, wives and sweethearts, and of the price they paid for the trauma they endured. Shining through the horrors of war is the spirit of these men and an inspiring human capacity to find beauty in their surroundings and hold onto hope in the worst of circumstances.

metas.name: Mystery Wrestling x Baka Gaijin
metas.description: Mystery Wrestling x Baka Gaijin took place on 3.17.2026

metas.name: Voice Dismissed
metas.description: When 19-year-old Frankie finds out that her sexual assault case has been closed due to a 'lack of evidence', she turns to her best friend Chloe, who encourages her to go back and confront the justice system that failed her.

metas.name: Body of Noise
metas.description: A Boston filmmaker profiles experimental musician and inventor (and former Harvard faculty) Victoria Shen, aka Evicshen, known for her improvised style of “chaotic sound.”

metas.name: Space Rock
metas.description: A group of friends set off to authenticate a legendary family heirloom.

metas.name: Effortless: The Eddie Fiola Story
metas.description: Follows BMX legend and Hollywood stuntman Eddie Fiola's career, personal life, and pursuit of making it to the top in his sport and second career as an elite stuntman on some of the biggest budget movies in Hollywood.

metas.name: Everything I'm Not; Everything I Am
metas.description: Clayton Nonhof, a high schooler, learns how to process pressure.

metas.name: The Serpent in Bonanjo
metas.description: In the Douala neighborhood of Bonanjo, Baba and his friends rollerblade in the shadow of a wall built by a French billionaire to block the sea. Amidst the specters of anticolonial resistance, they practice the serpent for hours.

metas.name: Notice Me
metas.description: Two lesbian neighbors in London's East End navigate romance and connection through messy, heartfelt situations, going to ridiculous lengths to get closer to each other.

metas.name: You and Me makes Three
metas.description: Alannah and Amara are a married couple in their early thirties, finally ready to start a family. After a chaotic kids' birthday party full of unfiltered parenting confessions, their dream of having a child becomes stronger than ever. Their journey through fertility options is funny, messy, and deeply human from anonymous donor apps to their gay best friends, David and Tom, offering to help. What follows is a series of awkward, hilarious attempts at home insemination (yes, with science goggles) and the very real emotional ups and downs of trying to conceive. Each negative test hits hard, but support from Amara's mum, Joy, and the couple's rock-solid partnership keeps them going.

metas.name: Can't Go Over It
metas.description: Two friends embark on their annual backpacking trip only to discover there might not be enough connection to keep up the tradition. Filmed while the cast and crew slept in tents and hiked up the tallest mountains in New York State.

metas.name: Fish & Chips
metas.description: Fab plans a surprise for Cassie on their first anniversary, but Cassie's rough day, coupled with a party popper mishap, leads to a heated argument over dinner options. What starts as a takeaway tiff over Caribbean or pizza spirals into an identity battle, revealing deep-seated resentments about their racial and queer identities. With half of the film shot in one take, Fish and Chips is a tender, unflinching exploration of mixed-heritage identity, queer love, and the fine line between connection and conflict.

metas.name: In the Making: An Australian-Taiwan Indigenous Art Exchange
metas.description: "In the Making: An Australia–Taiwan Indigenous Art Exchange" is a 43-minute bilingual documentary co-produced by Australia and Taiwan. It explores a five-year exchange program between Indigenous artists from both regions. Filmed mainly in Taiwan in late 2024, the artists' first in-person meeting reveals the depth and transformative potential of cross-cultural collaboration through interviews, shared creative processes, and the creation of new collaborative artworks.

metas.name: Lady Puritan
metas.description: As dream life bleeds into waking reality, a woman haunted by her Puritan ancestor must confront the terror buried deep within her bloodline.

metas.name: Another Earth
metas.description: From mouth to cave to fire to screen to war to skin, a 16mm portrait of an increasingly chaotic present, one whose political contours are affected by everything and nothing all at once. In the words of Zadie Smith:  'Time is not what it is / But how it is felt'.

metas.name: The Hero Avenges
metas.description: Documentary short about artist Akinsanya Kambon.

metas.name: Porcelain
metas.description: ‘Porcelain’ is a 2D animated sequence that follows a porcelain dog’s chase for its ball through a pottery shelf. Weaving through each piece, a visual adventure unfolds as illustrations come to life, exploring the different styles of pottery.

metas.name: Disco
metas.description: Fourteen year old JoJo has a sleepwalking episode that leaves her haunted and determined to solve its mystery.

metas.name: Lunar Sway
metas.description: Cliff is struggling with his love life in a desert town when he unexpectedly connects with his estranged birth mother. After learning of his mom’s string of secrets, Cliff is led on a wild misadventure while also spending time with his love interest, Stew, a mysterious dentist.

metas.name: Digging for Worms
metas.description: An observational, short documentary about about lugworm diggers on the Kent coast. It's a very unusual place – as are the conversations and activities which were filmed throughout 2025.

metas.name: Burt Thanksgiving Versus The Leprechaun
metas.description: Burt Thanksgiving and his classmate Tom attempt to finish a group project while being attacked by an aggressive leprechaun.

metas.name: The Ninth Master
metas.description: From the shadows of a London kitchen, a humble Sikh porter discovers he is heir to a legendary warrior order. As darkness threatens humanity, he must rise as the Ninth Master to f ight for the fate of the world.

metas.name: Eighteen
metas.description: Set against the weight of a single shared birthday, Eighteen follows five young men, Fletcher, Waylon, Ben, Wes, and Caleb, each crossing the threshold of adulthood in their own way, on the same day.

metas.name: Ronita Rambo
metas.description: Ronita Rambo, the sharp-tongued waitress of a rural Missouri diner, has everyone's order memorized - but not a clue how to text her new crush. Enlisting the help of two gay teens, she takes an unexpected leap toward love and authenticity.

metas.name: Chappell Roan: Live at Lollapalooza Brasil
metas.description: Chappell Roan performed in South America for the first time in 2026 as part of her ‘Visions of Damsels & Other Dangerous Things’ tour, which brought it to a spectacular close at Lollapalooza Brasil on March 21st, 2026 at the Autódromo de Interlagos in São Paulo, Brasil. As part of the festival line-up, Chappell Roan made a point of bringing her entire set and pet ‘Shigella’ from the tour for an enchanting and involving performance at the festival, further engaging the public with her lyrics, performance, charm and love shouted at the audience throughout the entire show.

metas.name: Birder
metas.description: A disenfranchised birdwatcher heads into the woods to find solitude from society, but events soon conspire against her. Will she go to extreme lengths to preserve her tranquillity?  Darkly comic thriller.

metas.name: It Changes
metas.description: Amy, a young nurse, heads to her Grandmother's house one night, only to find something is off about her.

metas.name: The Horned Woman of Saughall
metas.description: Alone in a Church at Night, a horned Woman confronts centuries of shame and Judgement.

metas.name: The Robinsons' Family BBQ
metas.description: The Robinsons gather for a quintessential British summer BBQ

metas.name: Grin
metas.description: A young immigrant’s day delivering food takes an unexpected turn when he finds a stuffed animal —and the girl who’s looking for it.

metas.name: Maid Robot: Defiance
metas.description: A quiet home becomes a pressure chamber when two advanced domestic units begin to deviate from their programming.

metas.name: Better Apart
metas.description: As Marisa’s friends try to stop her from going to her boyfriends, Dom scours the city for his apartment keys in preparation for their date.

metas.name: The Forgotten Prince: The Mystery Of The Duke Of Kent
metas.description: George VI’s younger brother, Prince George, the Duke of Kent, died in a military plane crash in 1942. This documentary explores his life and the circumstances surrounding his untimely death; and attempts to shed light on the many theories and questions that have been raised over the years.

metas.name: A Mole Of A Time
metas.description: When relaxing in the park, a strange man approaches Jack. Together, the two begin to look further into the backstory of the legend that was Mr. Mole, an amazing scientist who had since gone insane.

metas.name: Yedoye Travis: Fatherless Behavior
metas.description: Independently shot comedy special featuring comedian Yedoye Travis. Recorded February 22nd, 2025.

metas.name: Screwy People
metas.description: After receiving a disappointing grade on their group project, four art majors conspire to sneak their sculpture into the Art Institute of Chicago and pass it off as a legitimate exhibit in an attempt to prove their professor wrong.

metas.name: The Lunchbox
metas.description: Rahul, a 7-year-old South Asian boy, is teased at school for his traditional food and decides to change himself in order to fit in. Meanwhile, his mother, Deepika, wants to celebrate Holi, a vibrant Hindu festival, with her son.

metas.name: Flag of Convenience
metas.description: In the summer of 2025, a Maltese filmmaker discovers that most of the luxury yachts in a Corsican marina fly the Maltese flag.

metas.name: TVF's Headshot
metas.description: Follows the journey of Sachin, a young man caught between his passion for professional gaming and the heavy weight of real-world responsibilities.

metas.name: Justice Junction
metas.description: A brave sheriff helps save the town from a rag tag gang of outlaws.

metas.name: All I Ever Wanted
metas.description: All I Ever Wanted follows a character moving through fragments of digital life—messages, recordings, mediated experiences—in search of someone who feels both intensely real and just out of reach. As the pursuit deepens, language begins to slip into something mercurial. What begins as a search gradually unfolds into a world of warped digital dreams and material fictions, where what is real becomes a negated question.

metas.name: Virgin Fandango
metas.description: A short musical film that uses an innovative technique of animated tiles, featuring a rebellious Mary joining her voice to those of celebrated women throughout history in the fight for equality.

metas.name: On the Tip of the Tongue
metas.description: Luana is excited to attend her best friend's party, but her plans are upended when she's forced to spend the day with her grandmother, who's just arrived from Brazil. To make matters worse, they don't speak the same language - Luana doesn't speak Portuguese, and her grandmother doesn't speak English. Frustration turns into connection as they begin to bond through cooking, and Luana slowly starts to embrace her Brazilian roots.

metas.name: Best Mom Ever
metas.description: Ali, who recently gave birth to her first child, goes back to work and encounters unexpected difficulties.

metas.name: The Theory of Spice
metas.description: Set across India, Sri Lanka, and Guatemala, The Theory of Spice is a short film that traces the journeys of Ginger, Cinnamon, and Cardamom as living expressions of culture, community, and ancestral knowledge. What unfolds is a vivid meditation on the people and places that continue to shape the spirits of these timeless spices.

metas.name: Maid To Shine
metas.description: Elena, a hardworking Filipina housekeeper in Las Vegas, struggles to provide for her teenage son, Miguel, who is suspended from school for defending her honor. Meanwhile, Gabriel, a famous pop star, grows weary of his suffocating celebrity lifestyle. Their worlds collide when Gabriel, fleeing a mob of fans, stumbles into Elena's workplace, and she unexpectedly helps him through a panic attack. Their brief but heartfelt connection is captured by paparazzi, setting the stage for a media frenzy and an unforeseen entanglement in each other's lives.

metas.name: Plantasia
metas.description: Janet's quest for self-improvement takes her down a dark and sensual path.

metas.name: Moments of Brotherhood

In the gentleness of everyday life, they speak of death — not as an end, but as a form of transmission. Through their gestures and their words, an intimate dialogue slowly takes shape, exploring the bond between generations and the traces we leave behind when our bodies fade away.

In interview sequences, descendants of indigenous people speak, while research reports recount the brutal missionary campaigns.

metas.name: Ouarda Ouarda: yet another floral film
metas.description: Flowers flicker along a 16mm strip, just before or right after the flames. You can hear them weep, scream, and resist.

metas.name: Nureyev - A ballet by Kirill Serebrennikov and Yuri Possokhov

metas.name: occupation studies: ngayanhurra bayarral Birrarung
metas.description: In this work, the artists assert the fatal link between genocide and ecocide, exposing the colonial logic of 'taming', inherent in European intervention. Video footage and field recordings of the Birrarung are layered with shredded snippets of a score composed in the 1800s, inspired by the river. By contrast, the soundscape features the voice of Jasper Cohen-Hunter, who recounts the Creation Story of the Birrarung as told by Beruk (William Barak, 1823-1903), the Ngurungaeta (leader) of the Wurundjeri-balluk.

metas.name: Misadventures of a Nisei Week Queen

Growing up in prewar Little Tokyo, she goes from surviving in a horse stall at the Santa Anita temporary detention center and in a barrack at the Rohwer concentration camp during World War II to being crowned Nisei Week Queen in Los Angeles.

metas.name: Happy 90th Birthday.

The man encounters a strange attendant while viewing the film in an empty theater. As the movie begins, the man sees himself on the screen in a series of music videos by the musical duo, Here KeKe. Ambiguity abounds through the dreamlike worlds encountered in a journey through the man's inner-self, across time and space.

metas.name: Uncanny Waters

metas.name: Love Is Not an Emotion

metas.name: Cake in an Elevator

metas.description: A surrealist look at the creative process, This student short film follows Jack Orston, an aspiring playwright commissioned to write a script. However his anxiety worsens as the deadline nears, forcing him to confront his inner demons.

metas.name: Baggage

metas.description: The Festival sees the Royal Marines showcase their incredible musicianship and pageantry and features a wide range of musical styles, including music from the big screen and superb solo items, as well as the traditional marches and overtures that have proved such a hit with audiences over the years.

metas.name: Crimea: The War Before the War. Part 2

The documentary draws on testimonies, memoirs, and video and photo archives, including unique footage from the island of Tuzla, unseen for more than 20 years, which was handed to our team by a Commander of the Border Guard Detachment that was deployed to Tuzla.

metas.name: Southerly
metas.description: Southerly follows Ada, a young and impulsive musician who flees Melbourne's 2020 lockdown for a coastal property in rural NSW. There, she meets Josh, a washed-up musician living across the road. Sensing an opportunity to reclaim what has already been a disappointing year, Ada persuades the reluctant Josh to help her record music.Through uneasy collaboration and shared isolation, Ada and Josh are forced to challenge each other as well as themselves, ultimately finding the opportunity for the change they both need.

Forced to confront his anger and the truth about his past, Kevin must overcome his regret to save Tim and finally begin healing from their mother’s death.

metas.name: The Closet
metas.description: In 2025 we’re no longer scared to come out as Bisexual to the straights, we’re nervous to tell our judgmental gay friends. The Closet is a fun and quirky short about Olympia coming out to her closest friends.

metas.name: A Trip

Lost in a frozen Antarctic landscape inspired by Frank Hurley's 1914 Endurance expedition photographs, escapism becomes a path back, a mirror revealing how far she's drifted from herself, and a space where she can begin to heal.

metas.name: Soft Fruit
metas.description: Filmed in Angus, Scotland, Soft Fruit follows migrant seasonal workers on an industrial berry farm as they pick, prepare and transport crops. Candid conversations and scenes of rebellious, collective gathering appear alongside observational footage in shifting visual formats – from high-definition video to 16mm, and CGI inspired by medieval Islamic cosmography – building a layered sense of time and place.

metas.name: Aba Blues
metas.description: Set in 1989 Aba, Amara must navigate the intense feelings she thought no longer exist for her high school lover Dirim, as her husband Uzor fights for the heart of his wife despite the unwavering hold of her ex.

metas.description: Rooted in Louisiana French and Kouri-Vini, this film highlights Creole Zydeco musicians whose language, sound, and spirit power the state’s cultural identity and tourism economy.

metas.name: Wilem

metas.name: Catfight

metas.name: Missing 411 National Parks: Washington State
metas.description: Washington State follows investigator David Paulides as he examines a series of unexplained disappearances in and around Mount Rainier and Olympic National Park, where hikers, climbers, and experienced outdoorsmen vanish without tracks, scent trails, or clear cause. Through interviews with families, witnesses, and search personnel the film contrasts known environmental dangers - severe weather, terrain, and hypothermia - with unsettling anomalies. Some of these include aircraft debris fields, unusual patterns in search failures, eyewitness encounters, and reported aerial phenomena dating back to the 1946 Curtis Commando crash and the dawn of the modern UFO era. As grief-stricken families search for closure and investigators compare evidence against established "profile points," the documentary challenges viewers to consider whether these cases can be explained by nature alone - or if something unknown operates within the wilderness.

metas.name: Ritchie

metas.name: Woven
metas.description: “Woven”, a documentary with a vibrant tapestry that unravels tradition and modern clothes. From the stunning landscapes of England to the rural Isaan region in Thailand, we'll uncover the stories behind traditional clothing. We'll delve into the environmental impact of fast fashion and celebrate the sustainability of traditional textiles, from the intricate embroidery of China Polano to the bold tartans of Scottish kilts. We'll explore the power of clothing to shape identity and challenge societal norms.

On the trip, the sisters resist the feeling that they're trapped in a cycle of permanent separation by revisiting their past while trying to imagine a future of togetherness for the baby, even amist political turmoil.

metas.name: The Sea Is Yours
metas.description: Iyo Ang Dagat (The Sea is Yours) is a documentary film about the relationship between people and sharks in Palawan, Philippines. It tells the stories of people interacting with sharks and rays in their everyday lives. Centred around the Sulu Sea the film follows fishermen, marine park rangers, enforcement officers, business owners and conservationists.  As the cast reflects on their roles and hopes, Iyo Ang Dagat asks a vital question: Can we protect sharks - and the people who depend on the sea - before it’s too late?

metas.name: Now, Irving Rapper
metas.description: Irving Rapper is, in many ways, Hollywood's forgotten man. After getting his start as a "dialogue director" at Warner Bros. in the mid 30's, he became synonymous with the studio's "women's pictures" and rose in prominence as one of Bette Davis's most consistent collaborators, including on her biggest commercial success, Now Voyager (1942). He was a rebel who led the studio in suspensions for chronically refusing to direct the scripts handed to him by the brass, waiting instead for material that better suited his interests and thematic preoccupations. He was also one in a secretive fraternity of gay directors who had to conceal their identities and shield their private lives from potential public ruination. Daniel Kremer takes you through an unexamined and misunderstood life of a man of great artistic inclination who expressed his innermost yearnings covertly through his work in motion pictures.

metas.name: Chatlines
metas.description: Jordan is a 30-something with terminal cancer in 2027 who spends his final days drifting between morphine dreams and digital distractions. On a whim, he uses an old Chatroulette-style app and on the screen appears Danny, a sarcastic, vibrant guy, also terminally ill, who swears it’s 2005. As days pass, the two men form a deep bond, opening up about their regrets, dreams and the loneliness of facing death too soon.

metas.name: Maya & Samar
metas.description: Set in contemporary Athens, Maya and Samar tells the story of two young women from conflicting cultures whose brief yet torrid affair endangers the life of one, while propelling the other to instant online fame.

metas.name: Fishy
metas.description: Hazel Monroe, a trans pageant queen finds herself back in the spotlight to reclaim the space she once fled. But as the pressure mounts, her surreal visions blur her reality, forcing her to confront the self-doubt that shadows her womanhood.

metas.name: Human Resource
metas.description: A financial horror comedy about Shae, a millennial HR manager who’s given everything to her beloved tech company — and been given purpose, friends, and bountiful perks in return. But when the market crashes and the company is acquired in a hostile takeover, Shae’s value as an employee is thrown into question. Desperate to save herself and her colleagues from the new private equity owner's restructuring strategy, Shae makes a dangerous deal to secure their jobs — only to discover a fate worse than termination

metas.name: Pops
metas.description: Through the eyes of an aspiring documentary film maker called Nathan, fostered siblings are reunited and go on a journey together to uncover the past, people and gain closure on the mysteries of the home they were raised in.

metas.name: Sloppy Sunday
metas.description: After calling it quits with her former pimp, a young prostitute thinks of a way to earn some quick money to leave town.

metas.name: Project Hail Mary
metas.description: Science teacher Ryland Grace wakes up on a spaceship light years from home with no recollection of who he is or how he got there. As his memory returns, he begins to uncover his mission: solve the riddle of the mysterious substance causing the sun to die out. He must call on his scientific knowledge and unorthodox ideas to save everything on Earth from extinction.

metas.name: Wardriver
metas.description: He’s a Wardriver: a hacker who steals from banks, not people—until he’s noticed. Now the money turns violent, and the woman caught in it could save him or kill them both.

metas.name: Chrissie Wunna Presents: Escorting in the City
Rotten
metas.description: Stella spends her 18th birthday alone in her room.

metas.name: Texas Pete Spaghetti Western
metas.description: When the evil Clyde Carbonara threatens the town of Flavorado’s right to eat spaghetti a dozen different ways, Johnny Alfredo and his companions risk everything to save Flavorado and it’s very way of life.

metas.name: We Are Jeni
metas.description: Dr Jeni Haynes lives with Dissociative Identity Disorder, her memories held by 2,500 alternate selves. When she seeks justice for childhood abuse, a decade-long investigation asks whether fractured testimony can be believed, or whether her condition preserved the truth needed to make legal history, with police, psychiatry and the judiciary aligned together.

metas.name: Every Second Until Our Last
metas.description: Set in an alternate reality America- A young couple encounters a family of bunker holdouts from the Cold War who are trying to find their missing child in a world they no longer understand.

metas.name: The Window
metas.description: The window as a real and symbolic gateway to the world: The Window is an autobiographical film about memories and experiences shaped by the feeling of isolation during the pandemic. Past and present, black-and-white, and color, reality and dream flow into one another.

metas.name: Portrait of Nowness
metas.description: What unites us all, regardless of the circumstances or part of the world we live in? Is simply being human the lowest common denominator? In their experimental documentary, Juri Rechinsky and Mario Hainzl explore this question by equipping women and men of different ages with body cams—in Austria, Senegal, the U.S., Japan, and on the Ukrainian front. An intimate, point-of-view journey through many lives and realities, revealing how close we actually are.

metas.name: Sunny Yard
metas.description: What begins as petty theft spirals into a personal reckoning, as a junkyard owner grapples with survival, self-worth, and the legacy she hopes to leave behind.

metas.name: Welcome to Birdworld
metas.description: Welcome to Birdworld, a beautifully colorful city filled with - you guessed it - BIRDS. From Magpies to Warblers to the Oh-So-Majestic Chicken, this place will fill all your feathery needs. Join Crow when he gets an early morning call to rescue his best friend, Chicken, from a wild night on the town.

metas.name: daylight
metas.description: Recently transformed into a vampire and fearful of the world, Allie escapes her parents home for a night to find freedom. Through the ups and downs she accepts who she is and her chosen family.

metas.name: Unsung
metas.description: A renowned muralist celebrates a historic neighborhood through 21 murals painted at a nearby recreation center.

metas.name: Miss Canton
metas.description: As Jenny, an aspiring chef, sits down for a Lunar New Year dinner with her family, she is engulfed by the disassociation with the language and culture of her Chinese heritage. She grapples with guilt and an overwhelming pressure to belong, but can she escape the surreal pageant of her own creation?

metas.name: Remembering Colors
metas.description: In a world where dreams and ambitions blur the lines between friendship and betrayal, Remembering Colors tells the gripping story of Shauna, an up-and-coming artist on the brink of stardom. Shauna's life takes a dark turn when her closest friend, Ashley, consumed by envy, orchestrates a plan to eliminate her and claim the spotlight for herself.

metas.name: FILKOOL
metas.description: The story is about a big, different creature named FILKOOL who doesn't fit in his house. Everyone tries to change him, until a child with Down syndrome enters and shows in a simple and unique way that he doesn't need to change. The animation depicts the characters' movements with the real calmness and slowness of children with Down syndrome. The work is based on the drawings of my brother Mazdak, who has Down syndrome, and we have been creating different worlds together for years. All the voice actors in this animation are people with Down syndrome.

metas.name: Unseen Territories
metas.description: Unseen Territories is a documentary and community-driven performance project that reimagines public space and the stories it carries. In Las Vegas, on Southern Paiute land, fourteen BIPOC artists challenge the colonial symbols that dominate the city, creating work that asserts identity, memory, and presence. The project treats artistic practice as a form of witness, showing how acts of creation can preserve histories and lived experiences that have long been marginalized. As the flags are made and brought into public view, they animate the landscape with joy, resilience, and pride, insisting that the complexity of these communities cannot be simplified or erased.

metas.name: Jolanta
metas.description: During the Nazi occupation of Poland, in the heart of World War II, an extraordinary woman named Irena Sendler risked everything to save more than 2,500 Jewish children from the Warsaw Ghetto. She gave them new identities, Christian names, and a chance to live, hiding them with families willing to protect them. To keep their real names from being lost forever, she wrote each one on a small piece of paper and placed them in jars, buried under a tree - a silent promise that one day they would be found again. When the war ended, she devoted herself to bringing those children back to their surviving families. She carried out her mission under a single name: Jolanta.

metas.name: Spiral
metas.description: A young girl lives alone in the forest when she suddenly turns into a Snail...

metas.name: Darling: Old Habits
metas.description: In this prequel to Darling, a Musical, Demi is desperate to fill a void left from a breakup.

metas.name: Cyber Syndicate
metas.description: An obsessive-compulsive security analyst is forced to team up with a sloppy yet ingenious hacker to protect a large conglomerate. Little do they know that their suave leader has been secretly pulling strings behind their backs.

metas.name: Beyond the Pane
metas.description: David is enjoying a calm day at home reading and relaxing until he spots something unusual outside his window: a suspicious stranger hanging out on the corner in front of his house. Who is this hooligan, and what is he doing here? David intends to find out. This film and its characters are a metaphor for the endless cycle of child abuse where most children who are abused tend to grow up and abuse their own children.

metas.name: Seasonal Work
metas.description: Becoming a part time seasonal sales associate at Hot Topic will take the interview of a lifetime... and some Christmas magic.

metas.name: Monsters
metas.description: An unexpected competition where the worst of the worst must debate which one of them should die.

metas.name: Nebraskamerican
metas.description: Erik Wells interviews his parents about growing up in two very different parts of Nebraska. Also, runzas.

metas.name: Weeping Willow 3: The Last Night
metas.description: Weeping Willow 3: The Last Night concludes Merlin Dutertre’s Weeping Willow trilogy by returning once more to the unstable contact zone between ordinary lived space and globally circulating fictional imagery. Pikachu, Spider-Man, Mario, and other familiar figures inhabit a recognisable real-world environment under the sign of imminent catastrophe. Convinced that tonight is the end of the world, they move through the film less as heroic protagonists than as displaced witnesses, exhausted icons suddenly exposed to finitude. Built by embedding images found on YouTube into real settings, the film turns some of the most recognisable characters of mass culture into fragile presences. Dutertre does not use them for parody or nostalgic citation alone. Instead, he relocates them within a subdued visual field where the comic, the melancholic, and the apocalyptic coexist without collapsing into a single register.

metas.name: Confession
metas.description: Confession is a machinima by Gianni Romeo that grew out of the director’s found-footage documentary work inspired by Marquis De Sade’s The 120 Days of Sodom, specifically The Simple Passions, in which amateur porn videos sourced online are used to test the persistence of libertinage in contemporary culture. The project’s point of departure is an internet video of a young woman secretly recording her confession to a priest; initially conceived as a prologue for a new instalment, it ultimately became a standalone short once its self-contained intensity became clear. Structurally, the film draws on A.K.A. Serial Killer (1969/1975) by Masao Adachi, replacing the subject with environments: Romeo films the three churches of Los Santos inside Grand Theft Auto V, discarding the original image but retaining its audio, and setting up a deliberate tension between virtual architecture and intimate testimony.

metas.name: Project Space Pirate
metas.description: In a pirate timeline of the future, a pirate in space sings the ballad of pirate freedom and warns of the Alien Surf Dude's involvement in the Oscar's awards ceremony. Meanwhile, The Brilliant Brick is still lost in space...

metas.name: Body and Blood
metas.description: A Reverend must face his congregation after learning dreadful news during a church service.

metas.name: Cody Clarke's Unofficial Roast of the Oscars
metas.description: NYC comedians roast the Oscars instead of watching them.

metas.name: Meet Nikolas
metas.description: Nikolas attends one of the most prestigious high-schools in the world, and aspires to study economics. However, building up to the exam that decides his fate in further education, Nikolas hopes that his persistent failure in mathematics may take a turn for the best.

metas.name: Grayson Gets Cancer
metas.description: Grayson finds out he has cancer and has to break into his friend's safe to get his one time use cancer potion.

metas.name: Meal Ticket
metas.description: Follow the untold story of the 47-year old legacy of the McDonald's All American Game and the past, present and future stars that defined it.

metas.name: Lady Champagne
metas.description: Champagne is one of San Francisco’s most notorious dancers. When she’s framed for her recent hubby’s death, she must outwit sinister businesswomen, incompetent detectives and sadistic prison guards. Starring a host of famous San Fran faces, Lady Champagne is the perfect queer counterpart to comedies like Airplane! and The Naked Gun.

metas.name: Wavering
metas.description: Wavering is a short film in which technological, somatic, and symbolic worlds intertwine. Three robots, three performers, and a set of elastic bands intermingle to explore their limits and co-evolve until they transform each other. The film is a loose adaptation of the dance show Popmolle created by Montreal-based artists.

metas.name: The Truth and Tragedy of Moriah Wilson
metas.description: An intimate, arresting portrait of cyclist Moriah Wilson—raised by a fierce, loving family—whose singular drive becomes her superpower, carrying her to athletic brilliance and, devastatingly, toward a life cut short by murder.

metas.name: Serling
metas.description: The definitive and authorized documentary on Rod Serling, the creator of the iconic Twilight Zone.

metas.name: The Dads
metas.description: As anti-trans legislation and hostility escalate in the United States, a group of dads, building a nascent movement to support their trans and gender expansive kids, are forced to make an impossible choice: stay and fight or flee the country.

metas.name: Capturing Bigfoot
metas.description: On October 20, 1967, Roger Patterson captured 60 seconds of film showing a creature walking through the Northern California woods—footage that became the most analyzed and debated in history. Fifty-seven years later, a reel of 16mm film discovered in a safe changes everything, revealing the untold story behind the world's greatest mystery, told for the first time by Patterson's own son and the people who were there.

metas.name: Jack Johnson: SURFILMUSIC
metas.description: This intimate documentary traces Johnson's evolution from surfer to filmmaker to world-renowned musician. Rare archives and present-day reflections reveal how lived experience, friendship, & exploration shaped the sound & stories behind the music.

metas.name: Beyond The Duplex Planet
metas.description: In 1979, artist David Greenberger's talks with senior citizens become a word-of-mouth hit 'zine, The Duplex Planet. Four decades on, now a senior himself, he has much to tell us about the nature of art, conversation and growing old.

metas.name: Campeón Gabacho
metas.description: A determined Mexican migrant boxes his way through challenges and discrimination in America, using his fighting spirit and optimism to rise above adversity and find unexpected success.

metas.name: Los Lobos Native Sons
metas.description: Los Lobos Native Sons is the definitive chronicle of the global Latin rock ’n’ roll legends Los Lobos, offering an unparalleled 50-year musical journey through exclusive access to the band’s personal archives and extraordinary legacy.

metas.name: The Ascent
metas.description: The Ascent is the inspiring true story of Colorado Springs bilateral-amputee climber Mandy Horvath's record-breaking attempt to crawl to the summit of Mt. Kilimanjaro and the mysterious circumstances under which she lost her legs at the age of 21.

metas.name: Plantman & Blondie: A Dress Up Gang Film
metas.description: A lonely man escapes working from home when he meets Plantman...a mysterious man saving the neglected house plants of Los Angeles.

metas.name: Everything's on Fire
metas.description: Four freshman in the fall of 2021 come together to form an unorthodox debate club in hopes to bring civil discourse back to their generation.

metas.name: Oat Milk
metas.description: A grieving woman finds a lost message from her late boyfriend and quietly confronts the space between love, regret, and letting go.

metas.name: daylight
metas.description: Recently transformed into a vampire and fearful of the world, Allie escapes her parents home for a night to find freedom. Through the ups and downs she accepts who she is and her chosen family.

metas.name: No Tears on the Field
metas.description: In New Zealand’s heartland, teams of aspiring female rugby players must shatter glass ceilings both on and off the field to achieve their improbable dream of international glory.

metas.name: Solo Fanáticos
metas.description: The film follows the story of an OnlyFans star who becomes pregnant with a nepobaby, the son of a hotel magnate, and addresses the tensions between love, power, and media exposure.

metas.name: Don't Let the Sun
metas.description: In a world almost like ours, Jonah works for an agency that offers human relationships. When he's hired to serve as Nika's father, he begins to lose control of his tightly controlled life.

metas.name: End of the Line
metas.description: End of the Line is an anthology of three short films (The Brief Case of Maya Moon, The Red Widow, and The Extraordinary Experience of Dick Shatner), all of which take place on one reality defying steam train.

metas.name: Finding My Voice
metas.description: After a tragic event breaks her family apart, a teenage girl abandons her dreams of a music career and is thrown into the foster care system.

metas.name: The 27 Club
metas.description: Vito, a depressed young man planning to kill himself on his 27th birthday, meets Gina - a self-harming riot of chaos who appoints herself as his ‘suicide coach’.

metas.name: Tides
metas.description: A short mixed media animation about the beach with a nostalgic feel to it.

metas.name: Full Tank
metas.description: A getaway driver must wait three minutes for a gang of burglars to return to his car before making their escape. There’s just one problem... he’s absolutely desperate for a piss.

metas.name: REVERIE
metas.description: After a lifetime in the closet, a newly divorced man in his 60s arranges his first one-night stand, but what begins as lust transforms into a deeply human connection across generations.

metas.name: COME FIND US!
metas.description: KISS OF LIFE 'Who Is She' Campaign film

metas.name: Exotic Jim
metas.description: A man who can read animals' minds tests his abilities on a house cat.

metas.name: Nish Kumar: Nish, Don't Kill My Vibe
metas.description: In Nish, Don’t Kill My Vibe, Nish Kumar brings his trademark blend of righteous fury and self-deprecating chaos to a world that feels like it’s permanently on fire.

metas.name: Super Bowl Champions: The 2025 Seattle Seahawks
metas.description: From training camp to the final confetti fall, Super Bowl Champions: The 2025 Seattle Seahawks is the definitive, cinematic story of a team that soared above the odds, told with the style only NFL Films can deliver. Narrated by actor and Seahawks fan Jeffrey Dean Morgan, the 75-minute documentary looks back at Seattle's 2025 championship season through game broadcast footage, including extended highlights of their 29-13 victory over the New England Patriots in Super Bowl LX. The film also includes coverage from the championship parade, behind-the-scenes footage captured by the team, and the largest compilation of player and coach wired sound from throughout the season ever for an NFL Films championship documentary.

metas.name: Flying Fish
metas.description: The weight of the world doesn’t discriminate between man, fish or fruit. decay is inevitable. will you take the leap towards better times?

metas.name: Waiting For A Friend
metas.description: An experimental short film set in 1939 Poland, about two men who have a conversation on a hill while the history of Poland and Polish Cinema flashes in the sky.

metas.name: Cold Cakes / 冰冷的蛋糕 / コールド・ケーキ
metas.description: Built within the 3D worlds of Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas, Condemned 2: Bloodshot, Call of Duty: Black Ops II, Saw II: Flesh & Blood, and Call of Duty: Advanced Warfare, Pastinaca Videotapes Plantation’s machinima exploit each engine’s abrupt, uncanny atmosphere, creating bizarre collages that challenge any single interpretative move. Cold Cakes / 冰冷的蛋糕 / コールド・ケーキ is no exception and adopts the look of damaged evidence. Burnt-in timestamps, murky contrast, smeared textures, and VHS-like degradation give the film the texture of a copied, handled, and partially lost recording. Moving between domestic interiors, found footage, flickering images, bodily aftermath, cryptic imagery and open-world urban drift, the film assembles fragments rather than a linear narrative. Working through a text-first method that pairs written themes with archival and game footage, PVP reflects on suppressed histories, hoaxes, mockumentaries, and the erasure of inconvenient events.

metas.name: Mare Nostrum
metas.description: Trapped between grueling working conditions and the medical expenses of his ailing brother, Ömer is being crushed under the weight of systemic oppression and identity politics. While striving to give voice to his friend Deniz’s silenced story, he encounters someone new. For Ömer, this meeting will mark the beginning of an unforeseen end.

metas.name: Women's Adventure Film Tour 2026
metas.description: Presented by Mountain Designs, the Women’s Adventure Film Tour® (WAFT) returns for its 9th year, celebrating extraordinary women and their thrilling adventures. This year’s line-up features an inspiring collection of short films that highlight stories of courage, connection, and pushing beyond personal limits. From mountain peaks to ocean waves, and from the everyday to the extreme, these films showcase women from all walks of life pursuing their definition of adventure.

metas.name: how to feel
metas.description: How to feel is a Machinima short film made during the Nouvelle Bug vol.2 residency. The movie is shot almost entirely within the video game The Sims 4. The story is about a girl who is not able to love herself and is forced by circumstances to learn how to stay in her body, breathe and feel alive. The more she learns, the more her presence comes to life, along with the eye of the camera.

metas.name: Honey Bun
metas.description: After finding her mother drunk at a karaoke bar, a young woman reluctantly brings her home for the night. The two are forced to confront the complicated question of whether either of them truly love each other.

metas.name: TJPW Texas Stampede in Austin ~ Day 2
metas.description: Texas Stampede in Austin ~ Day 2 was a professional wrestling event promoted by Tokyo Joshi Pro-Wrestling (TJPW), held on March 18, 2026 at Palmer Events Center in Austin, Texas, USA.

metas.name: Winter Ball
metas.description: During a school dance, an overly jealous and vindictive teen spirals when his best friend shows up with the girl he never stopped loving, forcing him to confront the painful truths of his past.

metas.name: Medora: Empress of the Badlands
metas.description: In 1883 Dakota Territory, the Marquis de Mores and wife Medora arrive to build a home, town, and meat empire, facing hostility from ranchers, beef trusts, and violent locals determined to drive them out.

metas.name: Negative Space
metas.description: An aspiring journalist and reclusive, retired detective are brought together by a long-forgotten cold case.

metas.name: Footsteps Forward
metas.description: Footsteps Forward is a short film about rediscovering the things you love when the reason for doing it is gone.

metas.name: An Exercise In Perspective
metas.description: An Exercise in Perspective is an experimental documentary and fundraising film, which follows the story of blind runner Phil Harrison.  Born fully sighted, Phil has lost eyesight from two unfortunate moments – an injury to his left eye as a teenager, compounded by a cancer diagnosis in his right eye when he turned 60. He now has less than 5% vision, only afforded to him with an artificial iris.  Many people could become reserved after such bad luck — Phil has decided to run.  In 2026 he will run his first ever marathon, the London Marathon, raising money for the UK sight loss charity: RNIB (Royal National Institute of Blind People).  As the frontman of infamous punk band Social Security he has always been defiant and young-at-heart. The band provide the perfect soundtrack to his story.  Immersive, mixed-media and a DIY project — the documentary gives a perceptual insight into Phil’s excitable, scrappy and inspirational spirit.

metas.name: Your Cards Are Bleeding
metas.description: A couple has agreed to help a friend arrange a move. But the friend has dropped out of the project, leaving the couple and their baby on an increasingly chaotic journey through an unnamed American city.

metas.name: Fahrenheit
metas.description: A pianist with a lizard head sits at his grand piano on a stage and works on Bach’s Goldberg Variations. A woman – also with a lizard head – goes about her work of wiping tables in an empty café overlooking Baghdad. At one of the tables, the silhouettes of a young couple sit and talk, but on the other side of the wall mirrors no one is sitting.

metas.name: Life Drawings
metas.description: Told through a series of self-portraits, an artist's passion and perseverance prepare him for the discovery of a greater joy in life

metas.name: Maddie & The Test
metas.description: When 10-year-old Maddie sits down for a test at school, she calls upon her inner strength to confront her deepest fears and overcome her anxiety.

metas.name: Squared Circles
metas.description: An aging professional wrestler, who was once a household name, is now clinging to his glory days as champion for a small company. Moments before his match, he's told to lose his championship to a young up-and-coming star who's coming to take his spot.

metas.name: Something to do
metas.description: Josh is on holiday while his best friend Nick housekeeps for him.

metas.name: Hunky Jesus
metas.description: A feature documentary that explores the legacy of the San Francisco chapter of the Sisters of Perpetual Indulgence, a global, secular order of queer and trans "nuns" who combat guilt, shame, and exclusion through joy, humor, activism, and irreverence, serving their communities while challenging bigotry and redefining spirituality.

metas.name: Encroachment
metas.description: A down-on-his luck gig economy courier has his morality tested when he finds the door to a swanky apartment has been left open.

metas.name: New York Movie
metas.description: A dough-eyed newcomer to New York is sent on a mental spiral of his own self-worth when he is asked to take photos of a random couple in a park and he finds out what it truly means to be a New Yorker.

metas.name: The Last Game
metas.description: The 57 year history of the Oakland Athletics baseball team is recalled through the memories and stories of its most dedicated fans.

metas.name: Arrudas Boulevard
metas.description: Nilson, a guide at the Municipal Aquarium of Belo Horizonte, Brazil, is one of those affected by the constant flooding caused by torrential rains and floods in the Arrudas River basins in the city, which is now facing the greatest flood in its history.

metas.name: The Drama
metas.description: A happily engaged couple is put to the test when an unexpected turn sends their wedding week off the rails.

metas.name: OceanGate Disaster: Minute by Minute
metas.description: A minute by minute reconstruction of the events surrounding the 2023 Titan submersible tragedy.

metas.name: From Page to Panic - Making The Housemaid
metas.description: Follow the filmmakers behind this new and exciting thriller as they explain the creative process from the book to the big screen

metas.name: TAXITAXI's VERA aftermovie
metas.description: An aftermovie capturing TAXITAXI's performance at VERA

metas.name: HADES: The Listening Chamber
metas.description: A recorded event for Melanie Martinez's listening event for most recent project and album, HADES. Live from London, England on March 17, 2026.

metas.name: Mr. Bop
metas.description: Mr. Bop is a comedic short film about legacy, identity and aging, told through breakdancing and nostalgia. The film follows a former teenage breakdancer who, forty years later, is dragged back into the spotlight by his old manager and lifelong friend, blending heartfelt character moments with stylised, retro visuals and a bold comedic tone.

metas.name: My Stepdaughter's Big Tits
metas.description: Not easy when your stepdaughter's got such a perfect pair. Especially when she plays the naughty little bad girl. 100% natural but a lot more than stepmom's. Way too XXL for that cheerleader uniform.

metas.name: Bulls On Earth
metas.description: What began as a film test has transformed into a short film that evokes nostalgia.

metas.name: Pinecone
metas.description: Meet Pinecone in nineteenth century Ireland. A story is about love, overcoming fear and not judging others.

metas.name: Tin Door Tabernacle
metas.description: A priest plots revenge on the archbishop he thinks has failed him.

metas.name: Motive
metas.description: Trent is suiting up to go out, Henry calls to check if he's on his way. But all is not as it seems. He is not the only one getting ready.

metas.name: Queen Maeve
metas.description: Traditional Irish folk music and a story of Irish mythology.

metas.name: Decide Decide
metas.description: A husband and father is driven to the edge.

metas.name: Myrtilles la nuit
metas.description: Bear Country, Pyrenees, France  Zoe, age 5, and Luna, four times her age.  What happens after death?  And Arthur, is he your boyfriend?  Anyway, there are only chickens in this village.

metas.name: Shamik Chakrabarti: Despite Appearances
metas.description: Through understated humor and interconnected anecdotes, Shamik navigates bureaucracy, identity, and everyday absurdity while unraveling a deceptively simple misadventure of losing his laptop.

metas.name: Charter'd Street
metas.description: Charterhouse Street, London. Smithfield Market is one of the oldest markets in the city, with its current covered building dating to the mid-Victorian period. Due to close in 2028.

metas.name: Jordi Fernádez's Coaching Journey: From Badalona to Brooklyn
metas.description: Jordi Fernádez has always had the game of basketball in his blood. Born in the "Cradle of Basketball", Fernádez knew quickly he was meant to coach the game he loved. This is the story of his journey, which led him across the globe in his pursuit of coaching at the highest level.

metas.name: Forged in Foxborough - Warriors
metas.description: Get an exclusive look at the 2025 New England Patriots with never-before-seen access as the team battled through an unforgettable playoff run to reach Super Bowl LX. Take a behind the scenes look at the historic playoff performances from Head Coach Mike Vrabel, QB Drake Maye, CB Christian Gonzalez and more as we re-live a memorable 2025 NFL Season.

metas.name: Foools
metas.description: In a faraway land where they only speak Circush, a sad little clown learns the value of friendship when her friends bake her a cake made from stars.

metas.name: Pet Bunny
metas.description: Suspicious Craigslist user MacaroniCop_2 arrives at a location - looking to pick up a pet bunny, for free - only to meet with Willow: a furry role-player, who challenges his worldview and pushes him to his limits.

metas.name: Passing Place
metas.description: It is hard enough arriving without time, let alone to understand somewhere with somewhere else in mind; life as landscape passing from the back of a moving car. Shot over a single afternoon on the Isle of Mull, Scotland.

metas.name: Mistake Me for Anybody
metas.description: A 16mm film informed by the expansive nature of queer relationships and bodily autonomy. This film was processed by a plant-based developer and the sage used was grown in my garden.

metas.name: Kata Tjuṯa, West of Uluru
metas.description: Looking at the present, as though the far future were dreaming of its ancient past – an 'iconogenic' vision of Australia.

metas.name: Heimþrá eða Nostalgía
metas.description: "Like the doctors before them, poets and philosophers failed to find a precise location for nostalgia...a metaphorical journey seemed like a homeopathic treatment for human longing...". – Svetlana Boym, The Future of Nostalgia

metas.name: Cradle & Step
metas.description: Two friends discuss and improvise repeated movements for the camera

metas.name: Bolognaogna
metas.description: Round and round we go through the historic city. Shot on Super 8, Bolognaonga utilises hyperlapses to highlight the unique architecture and patterns formed throughout the historic city of Bologna.

metas.name: Agoda Asleep at Home
metas.description: A sleeping mother looks after a decaying house. As we move through each room, we are met with new objects and new friends, off screen. She is scrolling through Agoda to find the best hotel.

metas.name: Desert Passages
metas.description: The Colorado River is drying up. Reservoirs are falling to record lows and drought ravages the borderlands of the United States and Mexico. The heavily engineered water systems of the American Southwest buckle under the strain of an expanding population. Life for those on the fringes begins to unravel.

metas.name: TJPW Texas Stampede in Austin ~ Day 1
metas.description: Texas Stampede in Austin ~ Day 1 was a professional wrestling event promoted by Tokyo Joshi Pro-Wrestling (TJPW), held on March 17, 2026 at Palmer Events Center in Austin, Texas, USA.

metas.name: Ha Ha Ha
metas.description: Dive into the raw, unfiltered world of stand-up comedy through the eyes of six comedians, each on their own unique path.

metas.name: Teodor Currentzis conducts Brahms and Mahler
metas.description: At Berlin’s Funkhaus, virtuoso pianist Alexandre Kantorow and star soprano Regula Mühlemann dazzle in this stunning program featuring Brahms’s Piano Concerto No. 2 and Mahler’s Symphony No. 4 alongside Teodor Currentzis and his renowned Utopia Orchestra.

metas.name: The Futora
metas.description: The film follows an unidentified ghostly entity that travels through nocturnal shimmer. It is an ‘egregore’, a collective being formed by unconscious memories. Inspired by 1980s and 1990s Chinese children’s science fiction media, the film reimagines electricity not just as infrastructure, but as a living force. The images drift through the peripheral glimmers of a nocturnal city, where unfinished imaginings of the future slip into another world.

metas.name: Vampyracine RX
metas.description: Winner, Best Use of Genre — 24 Speed Filmmaking Competition 2026. Scientists discover the cure for an incurable disease.

metas.name: Farewell, My Tree
metas.description: What survives war and what doesn’t? For Liza, it is the fractured bond with a grandmother who is both her wound and her home. Moving between present wanderings and archival footage, this cyanotype experimental animated documentary film follows Liza’s attempts to reconstruct her past.

metas.name: American Troubles: A Tale of Two Democracies
metas.description: America's democracy feels more divided than ever - but what if the problem lies in how we vote? "American Troubles" explores whether proportional representation could break the cycle of dysfunction, drawing comparisons from two striking case studies: Portland, Oregon, where a bold new voting system is reshaping local politics, and Northern Ireland, where proportional elections helped end decades of violent conflict. Blending history, reform, and human stories, the film shows how electoral rules can entrench division - or create space for compromise.

metas.name: Mark Normand: None Too Pleased
metas.description: Mark Normand turns married life, fatherhood and hot-button topics into rapid-fire punchlines in this witty free-for-all where nothing is off limits.

metas.name: Worlds Beyond Her Hours
metas.description: After being abandoned by her friends in the silent stacks of a library, a lonely teenager follows a letter to a broken clock that shatters her world. Thrust into a series of haunting alternate timelines, she must navigate a fractured multiverse to find her way back to the imperfect life she once hated—realizing too late that the reality she resented was the only place she belonged.

metas.name: He Calls Me Daughter
metas.description: An exploration of women shaped by absent or broken fathers as they find healing, courage, and restored identity through God’s faithful love. Through raw and powerful stories, HE CALLS ME DAUGHTER reveals a timeless truth: A heavenly Father changes everything.

metas.name: The Sandbox
metas.description: The Sandbox offers a rare glimpse inside the global black box of migration surveillance, control, and the caretakers fighting to keep these worlds in check.

metas.name: Turn Off The Machines
metas.description: Turn Off the Machines follows Ethan Hughes, a radical homesteader in mid-coast Maine who lives entirely without electricity, global supply chains, or modern technological comforts. Raised in Gloucester to working class parents, an early tragedy shattered a happy childhood and set him on a path of radical resistance. Living deliberately below the poverty line, Ethan's life is not a retreat but a protest against capitalism, war, and ecological collapse. The film explores his convictions, his family's daily rhythms, and the tensions that arise when belief meets the demands of life.

metas.name: I go down to the shore
metas.description: At the same time every morning, on the same small stretch of beach, the Cremorne Ocean Dippers submerge themselves in the icy waters off the south-east coast of Lutruwita (Tasmania).  With my mother being one of these cold water swimmers, I have witnessed, and partaken, in the quiet wonder of this daily ritual.  ‘I go down to the shore’ is a love letter to this daily practice and the people who enact it.

metas.name: Preschool
metas.description: Two determined fathers engage in a comical battle to enroll their kids in an elite preschool, escalating into an absurd competition with unexpected results.

metas.name: Sounds of the Desert
metas.description: A visual odyssey of Sun Ra concepts through their followers - Marshall Allen and Abshalom Ben Shlomo. The film follows Sun Ra Arkestra band members and their journey across the desert, a promised land where Sun Ra once created his identity. Navigating through an astro-galactic world of sound, they find a reason to fight racism, injustice and vanity of the modern world - all through inner wisdom of music and sound. It's a story of infinite peace in a troubled world. An utopian planet where Sun Ra and his prophets celebrate the divine wealth of their spirits.

metas.name: People Magazine Investigates: The Secrets of the Twelve Tribes Cult
metas.description: Gene Spriggs forms the Twelve Tribes in Tennessee with teens and disenchanted hippies; the group later gains a cult reputation and faces accusations of child abuse, forced labor, and strict devotion to what members say is God's will.

metas.name: Pageant Panic
metas.description: At a local pageant, two determined contestants let their rivalry get out of hand while an overwhelmed assistant attempts to maintain order.

metas.name: KILLAS
metas.description: This documentary offers an intimate look at a recreational basketball team competing in a local league over the course of a single season. Filmed and created by one of the team’s own players, the project blends on-court action with candid moments off the court, capturing game footage, locker-room conversations, and personal reflections from the athletes themselves.

metas.name: Gangster’s Daughter 5
metas.description: After a crushing loss, Kadisha cannot grieve before a new threat emerges, turning friends into foes in a world where nothing is as it seems.

metas.name: 4.7 Seconds: For the Championship
metas.description: The greatest title game ending in the history of March Madness

metas.name: Chris Parker: Stop Being So Dramatic
metas.description: Chris Parker explores the intense relationship with intrusive thoughts and memories of a dramatic childhood in community theater.

metas.name: Storm Warning
metas.description: MADE IN USA MARCH 15, 2026

metas.name: Investigating the Supernatural: Angels & Demons
metas.description: Investigative journalist Billy Hallowell travels across America to uncover the evidence for the spiritual realm, angels, and demons.

metas.name: The Man with a Hat
metas.description: A Bounty Hunter is trying to get revenge on thieves who are stealing people's lands, while being hunted down by most dangerous western gang boss.

metas.name: Burden of Other People's Dreams: Chapter One – Ganymede
metas.description: A surreal, abstract memoir of Joe Bini's life as a film editor and storyteller, presented as a live cinema experience for one audience member at a time.

metas.name: Last Save Point
metas.description: In a scorched, post-apocalyptic world, survival is fragile and trust is dangerous. When a hardened loner discovers a naive man with the mind of a child, the two form an uneasy alliance, their journey colliding with a sinister school where the once students (now adults) are still ruled by the authority figures of the past. Fear, secrets, and the threats prevent them from exploring whats beyond their gated community.

metas.name: GI, your helicopters fall from the sky like broken birds
metas.description: GI, your helicopters fall from the sky like broken birds examines the visual culture of war games and the ideological ease with which conflict is converted into spectacle. With a documentary inflection, the film isolates the recurrent devices of the military videogame and turns them into objects of analysis. Its central concern is distance. Interfaces, crosshairs, surveillance views, and elevated perspectives reorganise destruction into something clean, legible, and remote. Romanello, Madrussa, and Mennella make visible the visual regime through which war is formatted in advance for command, abstraction, and consumption.

metas.name: Mirai (The Abyss)
metas.description: Mirai (The Abyss) draws on the world of Ghost of Tsushima to shape a brief, concentrated meditation on conscience under pressure. Beginning with a textual intervention, the film turns toward habituation, moral fatigue, and the threshold where violence stops appearing as rupture and sinks into the texture of experience. De Simone counters the game’s dramatic momentum with a quieter dissonance, redirecting attention to ethical aftertone, the residue produced when repetition dulls the force of response. Its restraint is what gives the work its edge. Mirai (The Abyss) follows the normalisation of the intolerable, showing how exposure reorders feeling before crisis fully declares itself.

metas.name: The Last Harvest
metas.description: Set within the ravaged world of Pathologic Classic HD, The Last Harvest unfolds across a landscape marked by disease, exhaustion, and slow attrition. Cocco works through the game as an atmospheric field saturated with depletion, where every sound, surface, and bodily trace carries the weight of a world wearing down. Barren streets and exposed figures accumulate with quiet insistence. Falling leaves, distant cattle, the tolling of a bell, and the persistent signals of the game interface acquire unusual pressure, no longer incidental details but elements in a visual rhetoric of fragility. What the film records is a condition of survival stripped of heroism and reward. The Last Harvest stays with what endures after renewal has withdrawn, when the world continues in a diminished state, poised between persistence and abandonment.

metas.name: The Road to Tehran
metas.description: The Road to Tehran is a short documentary looking at the US' strategy in Iran, the economic and political constraints which have shaped it and the inevitability of the war's spread. In doing so it shows how the US' assault on Venezuela, Cuba, Greenland and Iran are inexorably linked.

metas.name: Blaiklock: The Refuge in Need of Rescue
metas.description: On this rare glimpse into a season of conservation with UK Antarctic Heritage Trust, we follow a team of specialists as they journey to remote Blaiklock Island, Antarctica. Here, they undertake a mission to save this remarkable historic refuge as it battles a changing climate in an environment of extremes.
