metas.description: A senior member of a notorious crime syndicate battles with the aftermath of a string of poor decisions, resulting with his own mob against him and a ruthless cop hunting him down.

metas.name: Abel Ernest Tembo's Suspect
metas.description: Inspector Joseph Kimball Kobé and his team investigate a mysterious cult of serial killers calling themselves "the lost souls." They are determined to save the world from this threat.

metas.name: Good Boy
metas.description: Tommy, a volatile 19-year-old, revels in drugs, parties and violence. After getting separated from his friends on a drunken bender, he is abducted by a shadowy figure. He wakes to find himself imprisoned in the basement of a remote Yorkshire house, inhabited by a very strange family. But what unfolds is not what he could possibly expect.

metas.name: Peaky Blinders: The Immortal Man
metas.description: After his estranged son gets embroiled in a Nazi plot, self-exiled gangster Tommy Shelby must return to Birmingham to save his family — and his nation.

metas.name: Protector
metas.description: Nikki's life is shattered when her daughter is kidnapped. Thrust into the criminal underworld while hunted by cops and military, she must fight to rescue her child.

metas.name: War Machine
metas.description: On one last grueling mission during Army Ranger training, a combat engineer must lead his unit in a fight against a giant otherworldly killing machine.

metas.name: Mary Oliver: Saved by the Beauty of the World
metas.description: From a lonely childhood to literary fame, her life was shaped by devotion to nature, paying attention, and the long journey toward learning to love and to be loved.  If poetry had a pop icon, Mary Oliver would be it.

metas.name: Mates for Life
metas.description: Two mates embark on a road trip across Tasmania, a journey that becomes a poignant exploration of friendship, depression and regret. As they traverse the island’s rugged landscapes, Paul confronts the emotional fallout of his recent breakup.

metas.name: Gelée
metas.description: A girl brushes her teeth

metas.name: BUNKER
metas.description: Bunker is a commissioned documentary that follows Damián Arabia as he recounts the unexpected odyssey of living under terrorist siege, transforming a personal testimony into an intimate reflection on fear, survival, and the fragile line between ordinary life and historical violence. Through interviews and archival material, the documentary reconstructs a state of confinement where memory becomes both shelter and battlefield, revealing how extreme events reshape not only the lives of those who endure them, but also the way they understand the world afterward.

metas.name: Boxed In
metas.description: Alex, a 33-year-old ex-army veteran struggles with trauma and post-service psychological scars. When a mysterious, dirt-covered box appears at his apartment door containing five unsettling objects—a beer bottle, a Polaroid, a key, a stopped pocket watch, and a missing person poster—Alex is forced to confront fragments of his memory. Each item unravels pieces of a horrific night, revealing loss, guilt, and the dark secrets he’s tried to bury. As he retraces his actions, Alex faces the consequences of that night in an unending cycle, blurring the line between memory, punishment, and purgatory.

metas.name: Undisclosed Location: The Haunted Mountain
metas.description: After their initial investigation into a remote Kentucky mountain property rumored to be home to tragic deaths, a forgotten graveyard, and sightings of a woman in white, the TCC Research Team returns for a deeper, more intensive exploration. What begins as a follow up quickly becomes one of their most powerful and unsettling investigations to date.

metas.name: Atrophy
metas.description: A short video art by Paris Kiropoulos which focuses on architecture. Made for his Screen & Media class at Swinburne University, 2026.

metas.name: Fred's Basement Bijou
metas.description: A former insurance agent in Racine, Wisconsin constructs a complete 1920s movie theater in his basement, creating an extraordinary alternate world.

metas.name: Viridian Wedding
metas.description: A group of people are gathered at a wedding

metas.name: HUNKS vs. The Hurricanes
metas.description: When Tampa was struck by back to back hurricanes, local teams like College Hunks stepped up in a major way. Clearing debris, delivering supplies, and helping rebuild lives. What started with a single call from Mayor Jane Castor became a citywide movement powered by compassion and hustle. This film is more than a disaster response doc, it’s a tribute to the strength of Tampa and the people who refused to back down.

metas.name: The Murders of Seminole Heights
metas.description: In 2017, a series of seemingly random shootings terrorized Tampa’s Seminole Heights neighborhood, leaving four people dead and a community on edge. With few leads and mounting fear, the film examines the investigation and the lasting impact on a neighborhood forever changed.

metas.name: IntelliJ IDEA: The Documentary
metas.description: This is the IDE that changed everything.  This documentary traces the 25-year journey of one of the most beloved tools in software development. Through rare archival footage, intimate interviews, and behind-the-scenes moments, it explores how IntelliJ IDEA challenged the status quo, shaped the Java world, and set the standard for intelligent tooling, all while staying true to its founding vision: helping developers do their best work.  Featuring stories from JetBrains creators, current engineers, and voices from Google, Oracle, and the Spring community.

metas.name: 'I Was Kidnapped'
metas.description: As Dhananjay recounts a funny story from his childhood in Mumbai, he begins to realise how it affected his mum.

metas.name: a news about “someone who is going to be shot in the head on the street”
metas.description: An old analog news broadcast archive containing a threatening message: “I’ll shoot you in the head on the street”

metas.name: Eyeliner
metas.description: Nina and her best friend Lily decide to steal an eyeliner, hoping they’ve finally found their key to womanhood. When they're given wildly different receptions to wearing it, Nina discovers that her journey as a trans girl might not be so easy.

metas.name: HEY!
metas.description: A young man self soothes as best he can after an over-the-phone argument.

metas.name: Just For You-Trilogy
metas.description: Combining Riverbed’s three award-winning 360VR films (All That Remains, Over the Rainbow, and A Simple Silence) into a single experience, the Just for You Trilogy immerses the audience in a surreal meditation on memory, death, and desire.

metas.name: Pitch for Love
metas.description: When Indie books an Airbnb, she has no idea the owner, Keira, is competing for the same dream job. What begins as an awkward encounter soon turns into late-night confessions, as their opposing views on love and connection collide.  By the day of the interview, both women must decide - is love a risk not worth taking, or the only truth worth pitching?

metas.name: Doors of Bresson
metas.description: A video essay by filmmaker Kogonada exploring the use of doors in the 13 feature films of Robert Bresson

metas.name: ESL: More Than a Language
metas.description: Without the lifeline of communication, four immigrant families find life in America full of obstacles. As they persevere, pursuing the simple goal of learning English, they cross paths with Americans eager to help, form lifelong friendships, and discover a new sense of belonging.

metas.name: Srce Sarajeva
metas.description: A blind person is coming to help a struggling man learn how to live

metas.name: Together We Stand, Alone We Fall Apart
metas.description: Two sisters still grieving the loss of their mother clash over a political protest for Palestine.

metas.name: Doctor, Doctor: The Race to Fight Lung Cancer
metas.description: Delays in cancer diagnosis are killing Canadians. Surgeon-scientist Dr. Kazuhiro Yasufuku is fighting this crisis head-on with a groundbreaking device that could cut wait times from weeks to minutes.

metas.name: "The Gang Tries The Big Arch"
metas.description: Caed, Griffin, and Liam try McDonald's new burger, The Big Arch. However, the Shamrock Shakes are sold separately.

metas.name: ALPHA / OMEGA - The Rufige Files
metas.description: The film traces the story, sound and ethos of Rufige Kru through Goldie and Submotive, with appearances from the likes of Marc Mac, Photek, dBridge and Heist.

metas.name: Sting - Sounds Like Art Rijksmuseum Amsterdam
metas.description: World-renowned artist Sting performs in the beautiful surroundings of Amsterdam’s Rijksmuseum amongst paintings by Rembrandt, Vermeer and Judith Leyster, and reflects on the works of the old masters.  The 17-time Grammy Award winning artist performs a unique concert amongst masterpieces in the Gallery of Honour. Playing a rare 17th century guitar, Sting, managed by Martin Kierszenbaum/Cherrytree Music Company, reveals his love for the Old Masters and revels in the power of books and reading, while performing in the museum’s spectacular library.  Accompanied by his longtime guitarist Dominic Miller, Sting reflects on the musical’s origins, shares stories from throughout his career, and performs beloved songs spanning his illustrious catalogue, including classics from his celebrated band, The Police.  For the occasion, Sting plays a unique 17th-century guitar - originally crafted for the court of Louis XIV, the Sun King -  generously loaned to the museum.

metas.name: We Are Your Friends (Forever Unfinished)
metas.description: Recreation of an unfinished 2025 short film made with found footage. For a lost friend.

metas.name: Phase
metas.description: A boy looks back at his past phases to reflect on his new phase comming up

metas.name: Sepahtu Reunion Live in Singapore - Pentas Akhir
metas.description: Sidek wants to marry Mira even though he is unemployed. His father, Kadir, agrees to the marriage because he spoils his son. Kadir later reunites with his former love, Mona, who has returned to the village after her divorce. Their relationship is misunderstood by Mona's ex-husband, Malik. On the engagement day, Malik spreads lies about Kadir. Influenced by her father, Mira rejects Sidek's proposal. Sidek believes his father ruined his relationship, but soon, the truth is revealed.

metas.name: The Promise
metas.description: This short documentary revisits ROC Esports’ historic victory in Call of Duty Challengers 2026, the official global pathway to the professional Call of Duty League operated by Activision.  Through retrospective interviews and cinematic reenactments, the film tells the story of how the roster was built, the promise that defined their mission, and the mindset that led to Saudi Arabia’s first ever title in the Call of Duty Challengers circuit.

metas.name: If You're Lost I'll Come Find You
metas.description: A search for a lost budgie quickly unravels into a chaotic journey through Manchester...

metas.name: Live It Up: The Mental As Anything Story
metas.description: Live It Up is a feature documentary celebrating Mental as Anything, the art-school band whose irreverent humour, visual art and clever pop songs made them one of Australia's most distinctive cultural forces. Following the release of Nips Are Getting Bigger in 1979, the Mentals rose quickly from inner-city Sydney pubs to national fame, becoming masters at capturing Australian suburban life with warmth, wit and playfulness. While success came fast, they never treated it with reverence. Funny, warm and unexpectedly moving, Live It Up explores how Mental as Anything navigated fame, longevity and the pressures of the music industry while holding fast to their humour and creative spirit - revealing why their music continues to resonate today.

metas.name: The Making of a Surgeon
metas.description: Dylan Williams’ compelling new documentary follows a handful of surgeons who carry the healthcare needs of an entire nation on their shoulders. At the center is Faustin Ntirenganya, one of only two reconstructive plastic surgeons in Rwanda, responsible for patients from across the country—fourteen million people. His work involves repairing bomb-damaged faces, burn injuries, and congenital deformities, but also striving to build a sustainable system where more surgeons can take over. The goal is ambitious: to train thirty new surgeons by 2030. An intimate and unsentimental portrait of medicine as practical, political, and moral work.

metas.name: True South
metas.description: Few sporting events hold the cultural weight of the Sydney to Hobart. Every Boxing Day, as the Cricket Test breaks for lunch, millions of Australians turn their attention to the start of the Great Race. For days, the nation follows the fleet into one of the world’s most treacherous bodies of water — Bass Strait — where shifting weather systems can turn elite competition into a fight for survival.

metas.name: Deb is Boss
metas.description: Before becoming a powerhouse music executive who launched Gucci Mane, Nicki Minaj, and French Montana, Deb Antney was a street-smart survivor navigating the dangerous underworlds of Queens, NY and Boston, MA. Balancing romance, ambition, and hustler instincts, she built an underground drug empire while dreaming of something bigger, laying the foundation for her eventual rise to the top of the music industry.

metas.name: Isäni on kuollut – mitä sitten?
metas.description: What remains when the father you chose to forget dies? A shabby apartment, a pile of photos, a plastic bag of papers, and a father-son relationship that broke off more than 30 years ago.

metas.name: How to Clean a House in Ten Easy Steps
metas.description: A mother and daughter create a shared fantasy to explore their intertwined experiences of immigration, labor, and womanhood.

metas.name: Phenomena
metas.description: A psychedelic odyssey into the fabric of the universe, guided by a filmmaker’s immersive practical experiments that transcend into a deeply hypnotic audio-visual experience of awe and human connection to the natural world.

metas.name: Sole
metas.description: An observational portrait of a Korean American cobbler in Nashville, revealing how pride in craft becomes a way of being.

metas.name: Wanderland
metas.description: A Wanderer finds himself in a position which is taken by everyone at some point in their life.

metas.name: Jailbroken
metas.description: A relentless, high-stakes action thriller, set entirely within a single prison cell. On the eve of his release, violent criminal Joe receives a call that shatters his world: his ex-wife and son have been kidnapped, and unless he follows the caller’s demands, they will die. Armed only with a mobile phone, Joe must race against time to save his family and himself. Ruthless prison officers only add to Joe’s woes in a razor-sharp, gripping descent into suspenseful chaos with intense emotional stakes where every second counts and freedom comes at a deadly price.

metas.name: The Man Who Saw Them Arrive
metas.description: In January 1968, the quiet life of Melbourne resident Colin Cameron was shattered following a mysterious encounter on Kew Boulevard. Obsessed with uncovering the truth, Colin documented strange phenomena and shared his experiences with those closest to him as the events grew increasingly intense and dangerous. Told through the eyes of those honouring a promise to share his story, THE MAN WHO SAW THEM ARRIVE recounts Colin’s journey, presents first-hand accounts of Australia’s most famous UFO sightings—including Westall 1966—and provides insights from leading UFO researchers. A haunting exploration of mystery, memory, and unanswered questions hidden in Melbourne’s backstreets.

metas.name: Cedar Lake
metas.description: Determined to prove her brother’s death wasn’t a suicide, Olivia returns to Cedar Lake with her friends, unaware that Xander, her brother’s friend, has discovered his missing necklace, and that someone they once trusted has been watching them all year.

metas.name: Jo in the Water
metas.description: A passionate sea swimmer turned reluctant activist, Jo Bateman takes on one of the UK’s biggest water companies in a David-and-Goliath battle to protect our oceans from devastating sewage pollution. As Jo’s courage helps ignite a growing movement, this film exposes the dire state of our water system and asks: who will stand up for our right to swim in clean natural waters, for the species and communities that rely upon them?

metas.name: School for Defectors
metas.description: In an industrial corner of Busan, South Korea, stands the tiny Jangdaehyun School. It is home to 20 students, all of whom are North Korea defectors. With unprecedented access to a community never seen on film, SCHOOL FOR DEFECTORS gives voice to young people whom the world might otherwise overlook—illuminating not just what they’ve endured, but who they are about to become.

metas.name: Oscar's
metas.description: At a neighborhood bar, a lonely mechanic, named Steven (JM Ward), and an overworked PR professional, named Audra (Lizzie Salata), meet by chance and form an unexpected bond. As their connection deepens, love collides with ambition, forcing them to confront what truly matters. Oscar’s is a tender, grounded story about timing, vulnerability, and the courage it takes to choose love in a world that never slows down.

metas.name: Palliative
metas.description: Low on money and time, free spirited Brian risks anything and anyone to get what he needs by the end of the day.

metas.name: You Had My Smile
metas.description: During the frightful winter months, a Father's heartbreak leads him back out to the malefic sea in an attempt to finally let go of his grief.

metas.name: D*CKS
metas.description: A pair of inept detectives dream of a more thrilling caseload. Then a dead body turns up and they are accused of murder and pulled into a world of mayhem, torture-and laughs.

metas.name: What Comes from Sitting in Silence?
metas.description: From a cramped Mumbai storefront, Khatoon leads Mumbai's first women-led Islamic court. Amidst heated arguments and raw testimony, these female judges settle cases of domestic conflict, reclaiming religious law from male dominance to offer a new path toward grassroots justice.

metas.name: Living Legends of Comedy: Real Talk
metas.description: From the outside it may look like fun and games, but this provocative documentary reveals that stand-up comedy is one of the most grueling and merciless careers paths one can choose. Popular comedian Rayzor hosts this insider's look at the urban comedy circuit, featuring candid interviews with Sheryl Underwood, Donnell Rawlings and other top funnymen and women who tell it like it is. This program also includes selected comedy routines.

metas.name: A Love Letter To Handsome John
metas.description: An intimate portrait of Todd Snider in the last year of his life. What starts as a film about gratitude, and a way to say thank you to John Prine, becomes a rare glimpse of the artist at home in his most quiet moments.

metas.name: CityWalk The Musical
metas.description: Welcome to CityWalk, a place where themed restaurants and retail come alive… for real. A couple goes on an unforgettable journey to the depths of the magical mall in search of adventure, passion, and $22 sugary cocktails. From Bubba Gump to Bucca di Beppo, every new turn is always unexpected.

metas.name: Es pii
metas.description: A voyeuristic experiment.

metas.name: BANANA
metas.description: An epic three-way duel ensues when a mysterious gunman called The Walker holds a gun to another man’s head.

metas.name: No one succeeded
metas.description: It’s a college awareness short movie that shows how important the ethics of the faculty is.

metas.name: My Buddy Bruce
metas.description: Bruce Wensley Lee Joseph, a promising scholar-athlete who had dreams of being both a dentist and an NBA player, is brutally killed by gang members in Cité Soleil, Haiti on December 1st, 2022. A recent high school graduate, at the time of his death, Bruce was on his way to his school, École Chrétienne des Frères Unis, to pick up his last report card.  One of his teammates and closest friends narrates this moving documentary that tells his story, and sheds light on the gang violence currently plaguing Haiti.

metas.name: Disolution
metas.description: A vengeful wife uses black magic to transfer her lover's terminal cancer to her abusive husband.

metas.name: Pendapat Pak Rama tentang internet
metas.description: Mr. Rama Yugiono (78) was interviewed about his views on the internet.

metas.name: RICO pornorico
metas.description: RICO pornorico is a fictional documentary balancing on the edge of mockumentary and improvisation, inspired by Sacha Baron Cohen or the film The Beach Bum. It follows the absurd character of Rico, known for stealing "vinčus" from live broadcasts, around whom the fictional plot develops. Through humor and awkwardness, the film tests the limits of audience tolerance and reveals the humanity and hypocrisy of a character who consciously refuses to submit to consumerism and social expectations.

metas.name: Friends Like These: The Murder of Skylar Neese
metas.description: When 16-year-old Skylar Neese vanishes from her West Virginia home, her family and community are thrown into turmoil.

metas.name: To the throat of Sun
metas.description: A film by Saodat Ismailova

metas.name: Natalie and the Gila Monster
metas.description: NATALIE is a golem witch with “emet” on her forehead. KURT is a Gila Monster lizard in the Somer’s Isles Band. The Lizard Exterminators want to kill KURT. NATALIE’S sister JOANNA is friends with HOUDINI a toothpaste vendor. NATALIE attacks and kills the Lizard Exterminators. KURT is against violence so he removes the “e” from “emet” on NATALIE’S forehead and deactivates her.

metas.name: pigeonhole
metas.description: An insecure actress recovering from a secret nose job on a quiet Spanish island, confronts the harshest critic of all - herself.

metas.name: DEFECTIVE
metas.description: A special agent sent to recapture a traitorous former member discovers they may have been right to leave - and that the organization is now after him.

metas.name: The Case
metas.description: A detective deals with a hangover.

metas.name: Poésie radiophonique
metas.description: A boy and a girl wonders around a cold lac with a radio poem.

metas.name: Disconnect
metas.description: "Disconnect" bears witness to the systematic and large-scale violent repression of recent street protests in Iran. Through voice messages and self-recorded footage from two days of demonstrations, the film captures the shifting emotions of its narrator—grief, anger, shock, fear, and enduring hope.

metas.name: Observing as the World Burns
metas.description: Observing as the World Burns: Poems is an evocative, introspective short film that transforms lines of verse into raw visual poetry—confronting the dual forces of personal introspection and outward chaos. Anchored by cinematic performances, layered voice-over, and an emotive soundscape, the film embodies the tension between witnessing life’s unraveling and finding meaning within it. Rather than dramatizing action, this film immerses the viewer in the experience of attention—the act of watching, contemplating, and articulating what it means to be alive. At the same time, everything feels like it’s burning. It is both a cinematic poem and a visual diary—an invitation to witness, feel, and reflect alongside the narrator.

metas.name: The Revolution Against Death
metas.description: In minimalist villas that already resemble film sets, we meet a community of aging citizens. With the help of technology, they plan to have themselves frozen after death until they can be resurrected. A disturbing visit to an environment where the question arises: Is it still self-deception if everyone else is on board with the idea?

metas.name: Beholders
metas.description: A summer sojourn in France activates an obsession with tourists and everyday spectators. Back in Toronto, perceptive artists and benevolent voyeurs shape each others’ ways of seeing—living, modelling, & documenting in the same breath.

metas.name: Scott & Zelda At Home
metas.description: After a night out drinking, F. Scott Fitzgerald arrives home to find his wife, Zelda, ready for battle in a blow-up fight to define the Jazz Age.

metas.name: Mrs Staker's Manuscript
metas.description: A retired detective is pulled back into work by his old police chief, in search of his late wife’s final manuscript. The Chief suspects the newest crime boss is after it, to take advantage of its mysterious power.

metas.name: El Día Que Me Quieras
metas.description: In a near-future Los Angeles where space travel is becoming common, a young couple faces their last day together after Lisa is selected by NASA for a life-changing mission. Torn between love and ambition, they try to make peace with the distance her choice will create.

metas.name: AURORA: What Happened to the Earth? Live From Mexico City
metas.description: Norwegian alt-pop artist AURORA plays her biggest ever headline performance at Mexico City’s Palacio de los Deportes as part of her What Happened to the Earth? Tour. Filmed live on Dia De Los Muertos (Day of the Dead), the arena is transformed into a space of spellbinding sound and light, and filled with fans in festive dress. AURORA’s ethereal voice is ever-captivating as she sings haunting ballads including 'Dreams' and 'Exist for Love' as well as fan-favourites 'Runaway', 'The Seed' and 'Churchyard'. Known for blending electronic pop with folk and vivid storytelling, AURORA’s performances are always immersive and emotional, and this concert – celebrating nature and the human experience – solidifies her as a beacon of originality and inspiration.

metas.name: Othello
metas.description: Moorish general Othello is manipulated into thinking that his new wife Desdemona has been carrying on an affair with his lieutenant Michael Cassio when in reality it's all part of a scheme orchestrated by bitter ensign Iago. Filmed live at the Theatre Royal Haymarket in London especially for the big screen.

metas.name: Finn
metas.description: Indy and Finn are best friends who escape into the forest to create a fantasy film filled with heroes, monsters, and wooden swords. As they immerse themselves in their imaginary world, the real world quietly encroaches, Finn is moving away, and neither boy knows how to say goodbye.  Their playful filmmaking project becomes a means of clinging to a fleeting connection. Through toy knights, hand-drawn monsters, and whispered arguments, the boys wrestle with the inevitable changes that come with growing up.

metas.name: Humans of USF
metas.description: A look at the lives of the people of the University of South Florida's Tampa campus.

metas.name: The Act of Caring
metas.description: A group of young girls comes together to make a play. They are all young carers.

metas.name: Thunder of Clouds: What Women Can Do
metas.description: The courageous journey of Afghan women activists and refugees as they rebuild their lives in Canada. While facing their own trauma and displacement, these women work tirelessly to support the hundreds of Afghan women arriving every day.

metas.name: Watermelon
metas.description: Nallie is planning a surprise party, but things aren't going as planned...

metas.name: TIMINGS
metas.description: Timings is a snapshot of one quintessential night when seven friends go out for one last hoorah, celebrating a friend making the choice to leave the city behind. In the span of just hours they all learn more about their friendships, their romances, their surroundings and more than anything, themselves. Timings is a journey of self discovery and most of all, the moments that make the New York City experience one like no other

metas.name: The WASPS: Taking Flight
metas.description: Nadine Ramsey was one of 1,102 young women who answered the call to defend lives and liberty during WWII. The film is a profile in courage of the women who selflessly cleared the flight path for today's female combat and commercial aviators yet were not recognized or compensated as members of the armed forces. They came from all walks of life to join the experimental WASP program, a once in a lifetime opportunity to enter what had been an exclusively male bastion.

metas.name: Johnny's Shadow
metas.description: A harrowing short, student, noir film about domestic abuse

metas.name: Motu Patlu Ka Goa Dhammal
metas.description: Okay, so this one’s got all the classic Motu Patlu chaos but with palm trees and beach vibes. Ghasitaram goes missing, turns out he’s been kidnapped by this goofy-looking don named Michael Pinto who looks exactly like him. Cue the identity swap, the fake vacation, and Motu losing his mind because he thinks his best friend ditched him for Goa without him. 😅  Honestly, the part where Motu starts crying about how they used to share everything — even underwear —? That hit harder than I expected. It’s silly, but also kinda sweet. The wild action, food fights, jet skis, invisible cars, and Patlu pretending to be a ghost? Pure cartoon gold.  The bad guys aren’t super scary, but they’re fun to watch get wrecked. And the ending? All of them cruising along the coast, laughing together? Perfect. If you’re a fan, you’ll enjoy it. If you’re not? Still worth a watch if you need a silly, feel-good 30 minutes.

metas.name: BYU Students Don't Park Here

As the owner of the bank is his friend, he goes through confusion and decides whether to stand with honesty or not.

metas.name: Brittle Structures

The Wilis are hell-bent on killing any man who crosses their path in a dance to the death. Wracked with guilt, Albrecht visits Giselle’s grave, where he must face the Wilis – and Giselle’s ghost. It addresses the present and potential use of AI in factory farms and, conversely, in reducing wild animal suffering. It also examines how reducing speciesist attitudes in frontier AI systems can have an impact in the present and the future. Finally, it considers how AI tools could boost our efforts in animal advocacy.

metas.name: Matter of Britain
metas.description: Matter of Britain is an ethnographic fantasy which documents an English country village’s performance of the Holy Grail myth. In that myth, King Arthur’s knights quest for the Holy Grail in order to heal their wasted land.  The performance took place over 12 months from 2023 to 2024 in multiple locations across the parish of Mayfield, East Sussex. Over 300 members of the community took part as questing knights, angelic choirs, guiding anchorites and tempting devils.  The work was supported by an Arts Council England Project Grant, the Lund Trust, High Weald AONB, East Sussex Arts Partnership, the University of Reading and the Museum of English Rural Life.

Left alone with the unanswered ring, his imagination spirals as silence turns into unease, forcing him to confront the weight of a moment he can’t take back. What seemed insignificant becomes a lingering question of what might have happened if he had answered.

In this comedic, character-driven chamber piece, Jocelyn’s attempt to reach out to her isolating step-sister sours when Jane learns she has not been invited to the upcoming family vacation.

metas.name: What About Me?

metas.name: C.R.Y.S.T.A.L.
metas.description: An electric transition. The void left by a vice disguised as false promise to escape, is reclaimed by a new frequency, louder, colder, more transcending: C.R.Y.S.T.A.L. (Cognitive Rupture Yielding Synthetic Trance and Luminality). Through a synesthesia of stroboscopic light and sound pulses that pierce the viewer's consciousness, this short film is a sensorial trance that documents the disintegration of an individual. There's no narrative, only the vibration of a substance that reprograms the body until light is the only thing left within them. A feedback loop where the flash is, at the same time, consumption and the end of being.

metas.name: Castration Movie Documentary i. You Had To Be There

The Da Ge tribe's king committed suicide! * Cai Ba'er fled with a seven-holed sword and rescued a little boy raised by wolves in the mountains. Cai Ba'er named the boy Zu Che. metas.name: The Nikkei of Norwalk
metas.description: Trace 100 years of history from a humble 1925 community center and Japanese school. See how founding Nikkei families celebrated their heritage and built a brighter future for their kids, despite facing discriminatory laws, WWII, hate crimes, and other obstacles.

metas.name: Mission: Inspire - The Challenger Center Story
metas.description: This 30-minute film shares the powerful story behind the DPS Challenger Learning Center, which is one of only 32 Challenger Learning Centers worldwide. Through exclusive interviews with June Scobee Rodgers (founding Chair of Challenger Center and widow of Challenger Space Shuttle Commander Richard “Dick” Scobee), retired astronaut Dottie Metcalf-Lindenburger (STS-131) and Jim Rowley (Professor Emeritus at the University of Dayton and Semi-Finalist for Teacher in Space), the documentary highlights the lasting impact of the Space Shuttle Challenger tragedy and how it inspired a global movement dedicated to sparking students’ interest in Science, technology, engineering, and mathematics.  Mission: Inspire explores how a moment of national heartbreak transformed into a mission of hope — empowering generations of students to dream boldly, explore fearlessly, and reach for the stars.

metas.name: L'art de Vivre

metas.description: Created with Seedance 2.0, Nano Banana 2, Suno AI, and ChatGPT. It took under 48 hours to complete and cost under $100. Made entirely by one person.

metas.name: Frozen People Festival @ Oulu 2026
metas.description: Frozen People is a unique festival of electronic music and northern art on the frozen sea next to the Finnish city of Oulu. As part of Oulu2026 European Capital of Culture, the event brings together international and Finnish DJs Sanna Mun, Paula Koski, Schacke and Winter Games in truly arctic conditions. Welcome to the world’s iciest dancefloor!

metas.name: Anabios
metas.description: Two men move through a hostile landscape, carrying a vessel older than memory. They do not speak. They are followed. Anabios is a modern myth about rebirth, inspired by Mesoamerican cosmology and told through silence, ritual, and pursuit.

metas.name: The Match-Stick Flame 3: Red Mafia
metas.description: Dalton, who's now a bounty hunter, finishes his assignment given by DEA Agent Prasad to take down the remaining Lunada Bay Gang members in Rancho Palos Verdes, CA. Dalton is a Navy Seal veteran with PTSD who is seeking alternative medicine strategies with karate Sensei Darryl Vidal as well as traditional therapy. However, Dalton has to hunt down the Russian mob called Red Mafia to save Agent Prasad who was taken. Dalton reconnects with Chief Higgins, the Match-Stick Mobsters, and Jake in order to rescue Agent Prasad.

metas.name: The Great Gold Scam
metas.description: Tucker Carlson reveals how companies use beloved right-wing voices to sell precious metals at astronomical markups, leaving hardworking Americans betrayed by the very people they trust. The scam has run for decades because those who should expose it are often paid to promote it. That ends now.

metas.name: Something Greater Than You
metas.description: A pair of feuding raccoons, having found shelter from a winter storm, receive an unexpected guest.

metas.name: Night Out at AMPM
metas.description: A group of friends decide their motive, a night out at AMPM - a club well known by Toronto’s Asian community.

metas.name: Catch Cathy
metas.description: Competitive classmates Callie (Lily Friberg) and Connie (Camryn Anderson) race to win a high-stakes game: catch someone named Cathy, bake a cake with them, and prove whose creation is best before the final bell rings. What could possibly go wrong?

metas.name: Into Blue
metas.description: Morgan is acting strangely at home and at school, drinking gallons of water and taking excessively long baths. Soon she realizes the dreams she’s been having of the sea are in fact calling her back home.

metas.name: Anhedonia
metas.description: Anhedonia is a quiet, introspective short film that explores the invisible transition from childhood innocence to the emotional stillness of adulthood. Through fragmented memories of friendship, laughter, and carefree days, the film contrasts the warmth of the past with the cold repetition of the present.  As time moves forward, joy slowly fades into routine, and life becomes a cycle of silent moments and unspoken thoughts. What once felt alive and limitless begins to feel distant, almost unreal.  Without dramatic events or dialogue, Anhedonia reflects on a feeling many experience but rarely name, the subtle loss of pleasure in everyday life. It is a meditation on nostalgia, isolation, and the quiet realization that growing up sometimes means growing apart from the joy we once knew.

metas.name: Vicky Wakes Up
metas.description: Stuck in a dead-end office job, Vicky lives an uninspired existence until she’s confronted by a mystical pop star.

metas.name: The Human, Will : Will’s Will
metas.description: A depressed insurance claims adjuster vows to exercise free will after his pet goldfish Frodo is shot and killed.

metas.name: Cat & Nat
metas.description: Disturbing fortune cookie predictions send a girl and her cat into a surreal spiral.

metas.name: Before Closure
metas.description: While Murph is moving out of her apartment after ending a long-term relationship, she finds a box of her ex-boyfriend’s old things and sorts through them to find closure.

metas.name: A Voice from the Hut
metas.description: A talented 13-year-old village girl dreams of winning a music contest hosted by her idol, but is isolated in a hut by tradition during menstruation. She must find a way to reach her idol with her singing.

metas.name: Little Towns
metas.description: Jack is a hustler chasing big scams with new partners, forced to choose between another con or a better life. Little Towns is about growing up too late, loving at the wrong time, and learning that escape isn't freedom without change.

metas.name: Spa Day
metas.description: Trying to relax at a spa, an anxious guy can’t help but talk too much about himself.

metas.name: 8-Track TeckHead Takes To The Streets
metas.description: 8-Track TeckHead, undead cybernetic DJ and head writer of the CHAINGUN ISLAND ZINE, takes to the streets of Milford to see just how aware people are of his work.

metas.name: Shoebox
metas.description: Two friends facing homelessness resort to sabotage at a rental inspection.

metas.name: Dear Dija
metas.description: Two teenagers find love and quickly discover the chaos that comes with it.

metas.name: If This World Were Mine
metas.description: If This World Were Mine: Poems is an intimate, cinematic short film adaptation of a layered poetic journey—a visual meditation on identity, introspection, and the internal landscapes we navigate as we grow. The film blends voice-over narration, evocative imagery, and reflective monologue to bring the emotional and thematic currents of the poetry to life.

metas.name: Smoke Break
metas.description: A clairvoyant trapped in a city far from home, bums a cigarette & shares knowledge with a video store clerk on a smoke break.

metas.name: The Hand
metas.description: Kid is sleeping soundly but is disturbed by a sudden noise and is haunted by a hand...

metas.name: Body
metas.description: A boy goes to the gym, only to be discouraged and face mental and physical body problems.

metas.name: A Woman's Bestfriend
metas.description: In a world where men have become dogs, one inquisitive pup attempts to go back to his ancestor's roots.

metas.name: Trinity and Kai build a double decker couch
metas.description: BSA students Kai and Trinity take on the challenge of wise sage Julianne to build a double decker couch in order to save Expressions.

metas.name: Sane and Polite
metas.description: Véndetta's first short film, follows the lives of those struggling in the 1920s. These different characters find a connection and teach each other how to embrace their individuality and how to stand strong.

metas.name: Freaking Out.
metas.description: Paul calls everyone in his life after making a huge mistake.

metas.name: Pushed Off a Plane and Survived
metas.description: Jaynie miraculously cheats death after her husband Cole’s betrayal.

metas.name: Dead End Street
metas.description: Community is a group of people who share something in common, be it a place, interests, culture, or even a geographical or virtual environment. So, in the center of São Paulo, amidst the hustle and bustle of one of the busiest cities in the country, some figures stand out when their realities intersect. What are the difficulties and similarities between people who cross paths by chance? The street will tell.

metas.name: Super Fancy Induce Me
metas.description: Documentarian Benjamin Spurlock (nephew of Super Size Me filmmaker Morgan Spurlock) attempts to eat nothing but Fancy Induced Burger for 30 days. Made for Sewerfest X.

metas.name: Giants' Anatomy
metas.description: Envisions a speculative journey for decommissioned North Sea oil platforms through s liminal landscape, combining real-world footage with computer-generated imagery to explore their potential afterlife. At times as absurd as it is strikingly plausible, the film plays with notions of truth and reality while asking us to consider all possible futures.

metas.name: Cop Origin Story
metas.description: In this short film, director Akemongkhon Mongkhonmaung explores themes of police brutality and homoerotic relationships

metas.name: Martha's Notebook: Samuel & Jordan
metas.description: In this intense horror short, witness the desperate actions of Samuel & Jordan along with their friends, Derek and Mia, as they navigate the beginning of an apocalyptic nightmare unlike any other zombie film before. The group finds themselves face-to-face with AI-controlled zombies. This teaser showcases what a full feature film adaptation of the award-winning zombie book series could look like. Through blending gritty realism with emotional depth, and unique zombie thrills that horror fans crave!

metas.name: Green Man - The Story of Type O Negative
metas.description: Peter Steele was a 6'8" gothic icon who appeared to be a real-life vampire, but behind the towering physique and bass-heavy growl was a man battling crippling stage fright, addiction, and profound loss. From the streets of Brooklyn and the "Green Man" days at the Parks Department to the platinum success of Bloody Kisses and October Rust, this documentary explores the dual life of the Type O Negative frontman.  We delve into his early days with Fallout and Carnivore, his controversial brush with the European media, and the personal demons that inspired anthems like "Black No. 1" and "I Don't Wanna Be Me." This is the definitive story of Type O Negative—a band that blended gloom, humor, and heavy metal into a legacy that remains unmatched.

metas.name: Couch In The Kitchen
metas.description: When two old friends (Edith and Tracy) go on their first date, dessert becomes the appetizer. TV-14. Comedy. Stereo.

metas.name: Finding Mama
metas.description: When Harold Holt returns to land after a 60 year hiatus, the aquatic Prime Minister questions why Australian theatres are struggling.

metas.name: The Slightest Touch
metas.description: As she turns forty - an age doctors once said she would never reach - Emma Fogarty, who lives with the rare and extremely painful condition Epidermolysis Bullosa, takes up an offer from longtime friend Colin Farrell; they agree to run the Dublin Marathon together, with Colin pushing Emma's wheelchair for the final four kilometres. Also follow their lives and the enduring friendship that has sustained them through the years.

metas.name: Hold Me Close
metas.description: A recently widowed woman is given the chance to bring her husband back to life, but with the condition that she's not allowed to touch him ever again.

metas.name: Where are the children?
metas.description: A brave young soldier, Trey Simmons, just 31 years old, is putting everything on the line to unveil the dark schemes lurking within the shadowy corners of a secret government agenda — one that involves the horrific realities of child trafficking, abduction, and abuse on a global scale, concealed within underground tunnels, military installations, and secluded private islands. Trey's mission in life is clear: to uncover the truth behind what some might dismiss as mere 'conspiracy theories,' yet he has seen firsthand the dreadful and atrocious acts that have long been hidden from the world. Seeking methods to shield himself, particularly as the sole survivor, he strives to amplify the voices of the unheard and bring clarity to the unresolved.

metas.name: Wreckage
metas.description: A teen flees her controlling mother, only to face abuse in a new relationship, forcing her to choose between escape or freedom.

metas.name: How To Hide It
metas.description: A moment of weakness after a humiliating breakup leads Zahra, a young Muslim woman to play a forbidden lottery ticket. Her chance at escape becomes a spiritual crisis. While her coworker dreams of riches, she’s certain Allah is watching and waiting.

metas.name: Spectacular by Comparison
metas.description: In Park City, Utah a group of independent filmmakers attend a shoestring film festival and experience the oft-regular disillusionment of the low budget film world. However, they enter the orbit of the one man running the show and decide to come back the following year to help and change what was a beautiful disaster the year before.

metas.name: Blood Runs Thick
metas.description: In Medieval England, the King's secret order looks to gain a new member as two brother realise the cost at which it comes.

metas.name: Bad Guys Wear Black
metas.description: Bad Guys Wear Black is a short documentary that challenges metalhead stereotypes by exploring the lives of five prominent Bristolian metal musicians. We follow the surprising personal lives of these performers as they play a metal gig together and take us around their favourite places in the city.

metas.name: Romance at Hope Ranch
metas.description: Hope Morgan sets out to begin a new chapter of her life—fulfilling her childhood dream of running a ranch in the picturesque town of Ruidoso, New Mexico and reviving the beloved Giddy Up Gala.

metas.name: The Hero
metas.description: At the end of the Great War, a soldier burdened with informing a mother of her son's death, faces an impossible decision... Tell her a noble lie, or the horrible truth?

metas.name: Mr. Puzzle
metas.description: After an enchanting first date, Charlotte thinks she is seeing her new love interest at every turn. She is.

metas.name: Derm: The Long Run
metas.description: After completing 35 consecutive Boston Marathons, Derm Holwell reflects on the trials and triumphs of nearly half a century of running.

metas.name: Aladdin
metas.description: A group of friends vacation on a lake front cabin and find Aladdin's ancient lamp which grants 3 terrible wishes.

metas.name: Elimination Chamber: Post-Show
metas.description: WWE Superstars and analysts break down the results from Elimination Chamber 2026, including highlights and reactions.

metas.name: Last Looks
metas.description: At his son’s gallery opening, a reserved father must confront years of emotional distance between them before their last chance at connection slips away.

metas.name: The Mustangs
metas.description: In 2019, the Mandurah Mustangs All Abilities AFL team was born. What began as a dream of inclusion has grown into a powerful movement, proving that football is for everyone. This film celebrates their journey, their triumphs on and off the field, and their 2025 season — showing the world that ability comes in many forms, but passion unites us all

metas.name: No Happy Beginnings
metas.description: Jared has never felt seen on his birthday, and Ted is still healing from a recent breakup. After a lame birthday celebration the previous night, in a misguided attempt to lift their spirits, they follow a shady tip to a “happy ending” massage parlor. Caught between impulse and introspection, they question whether they’re chasing relief or running from reality.

metas.name: March to the Sea
metas.description: An African Slave makes great effort to escape the clutches of the Confederates and make it to the North all by himself.

metas.name: On the Moov: A Journey Towards Accessibility
metas.description: In this documentary, we follow the narrative of this grassroots organization through the lens of it its founder and key contributors, Fabiola Amaya, Aria Welch, and Camden Ross, as they discuss the glaring gaps in meaningful support for disabled students on a college campus.  We would like to specially thank the American Association of People with Disabilities for granting Fabiola Amaya and On the Moov with the Paul G Hearne Emerging Leader Award. Without them, this documentary would have never been made.  Finally, the filmmaker and leaders of On the Moov gladly encourage the sharing of this film. If you are a student with a disability, an advocate, or just a person who liked the video, please help spread the word. It is our shared ambition to have students from other secondary education campuses create their own chapter of OTM or something similar to better support their disabled community. This film is only the first step, but we hope it inspires others.

metas.name: Watched
metas.description: A struggling artist is confronted by a girl with a video camera.

metas.name: Pink Floyd - Delicate Sound Of Thunder [Remastered]
metas.description: The Grammy-nominated 1988 concert, restored, re-edited and remixed from the original films and master tapes. Filmed at the Nassau Coliseum (Long Island, NY) and featuring David Gilmour, Nick Mason and Richard Wright at their incendiary best, this engrossing and uplifting event uses an innovative mix of lighting and staging, balancing the then-new material and classic Pink Floyd songs.

metas.name: Kalandra - Live at Lafayette
metas.description: A live performance by progressive/folk rock band Kalandra recorded at the Lafayette in London on September 21, 2024.

metas.name: 雪掘り
metas.description: A short documentary set in Niigata, Japan.

metas.name: Creature of the Deep
metas.description: While visiting home, a queer college freshman is brought by her parents to meet a reclusive elderly uncle who controls the family's estate.

metas.name: In the House of the Bad Man
metas.description: When Leo, a fresh high-school graduate, invites two girls to a small party, buried insecurities soon emerge among the other boys in attendance. In a series of serious misjudgements, Leo initiates a cruel game on his friend Jim, which has consequences far more serious than any of them could have anticipated.

metas.name: Duality of Man
metas.description: Sean Bailey makes the first ascent of Duality of Man, a 100-foot cave route near Tucson, Ariz., believed to be North America’s first 5.15d.

metas.name: Excalibur, A Pursuit in Process
metas.description: Brooke Raboutou climbs Excalibur, a notoriously steep 5.15c sport route in Italy, and makes history by becoming the first woman to send the grade.

metas.name: Drifer's Escape
metas.description: Connor Herson establishes Drifter’s Escape on the Stawamus Chief in Squamish — the world’s first 5.15a trad route.

metas.name: A Not So Mellow Adventure
metas.description: The film documents a shift from bouldering to high-stakes alpinism, showcasing a "curveball" trip to the Alaska Range.

metas.name: A Mustard Seed
metas.description: A young man questions his faith and relationship after his father refuses treatment that could have saved his mother's life.

metas.name: Trouble in Paradise: Okhotsk Confronts Climate Change
metas.description: Climate change in the Sea of Okhotsk threatens the rich ecosystem of Shiretoko Peninsula. Decreases in sea ice and spawning fish have upset the natural balance and put once common brown bears at risk.

metas.name: Bloody Hu Long Tou
metas.description: On April 12, 1927, Chiang Kai-shek launched the April 12 Counter-Revolutionary Coup in Shanghai, carrying out a brutal massacre of Communist Party members and revolutionary masses, which led to the collapse of the First United Front between the Kuomintang and the Communists. In response, the Communist Party led the Tingpang Uprising, marking the beginning of a large-scale revolutionary movement in eastern Zhejiang. It was soon besieged by the Nationalist provincial defense forces, and Bao Ding led the crowd in a fierce battle against the enemy at Hulongtou.

metas.name: TISAY!
metas.description: On the day she plans to leave Cebu for America, a glamorous and outspoken young woman obsessed with Western beauty ideals sees her dream of reinvention unravel through family pressures, public humiliation, and romantic betrayal—forcing her to choose between fleeing her past or embracing the roots and identity she once tried to erase.

metas.name: TRANSIT
metas.description: Back from a short trip abroad, Ciarán finds himself battling a growing discomfort — one that leads him down a path of torment, faded memories, and an unsettling truth he is unable to remember.

metas.name: The Color of Sound
metas.description: Director Henry Frederick experiments with color and sound to create a new unity between the two elements. The Color of Sound is best seen through the questioning of what distortion and electronic feedback looks like.

metas.name: A Blanket Made of Stone
metas.description: Avoiding troubles at home, Charlotte goes to spend the week at her grandmother's house and quickly finds herself smothered by her love. Desperate to get out from under her, Charlotte offers to help out around the farm. In doing so she discovers an ancient Grogoch, a household spirit from old Irish folklore, living in her grandmother's work shed. Who is he, and where does he come from?

metas.name: One or Two
metas.description: Tobi visits an optometrist convinced she needs new glasses -- everything seems blurry after her recent breakup. During the eye exam, the repeated question "One or Two?" triggers memories of her relationship, which Tobi struggles to see clearly.

metas.name: Where Trees Grow Tall
metas.description: A photographer recounts a dream about wandering through a strange but beautiful forest. Discovering what it means to achieve great art.

metas.name: I Wish He Could Stay
metas.description: When Roberto and Teodor run over a mysterious time-travelling person from 1942’s Germany, they're faced by tons of possibilities. They could kill him, play with him, make a cool TikTok... super fun stuff, if Teo didn't ruin the party by being jewish.

metas.name: HAPPY BIRTHDAY
metas.description: On her 25th birthday, Faith stumbles upon a letter from her 15-year-old self, forcing her to confront the gap between the person she hoped to be and who she has become.

metas.name: Paddy Gallagher vs. Bahadur Karami
metas.description: Conlan Boxing presents a high-octane night of fights in Belfast, as Paddy Gallagher (16-6) faces light heavyweight veteran Bahadur Karami (4-43-4).

metas.name: Nighty Knight
metas.description: A lady bug knight ventures out to find a stinkbug, going on a grueling journey to capture him.

metas.name: Though The Flock Shall Be Cut Off From The Fold
metas.description: Although the fig tree shall not blossom, neither shall fruit be in the vines; the labour of the olive shall fail, and the fields shall yield no meat; the flock shall be cut off from the fold, and there shall be no herd in the stalls.

metas.name: WORLD ENTERPRISES
metas.description: In 1940, on the dry westside of Kauaʻi, the Kekaha Sugar Company began a six-month mail-order film subscription with World Enterprises, an Oʻahu-based distributor—screening films for workers on their Sundays off from harvesting and processing sugarcane. Varied in style, the films shared a common theme: American power taming lands and peoples of the “frontier” through extraction, an encroachment justified by declared ideals of progress. WORLD ENTERPRISES is a collage of radical possibilities sourced entirely from the original 1940 film program. Recontextualized by Banua-Simon, the short compilation enters a dreamlike conversation with both the material realities of the moment of its creation and the present day, culminating in an explicit “cut-up poem” provocation that reflects on community amid political defeat while pointing toward a revolutionary movement just beneath the surface.

metas.name: What's Keeping Us Together
metas.description: Charlotte, a poet suffering from artist’s block, must contend with her roommate Mary’s constant do-goodery when Mary visits Charlotte at her office.

metas.name: Room
metas.description: A 5 hour and 30 minute film consisting of an unchanging view of a bedroom in real time

metas.name: You Any Good?
metas.description: A janitor and a student accidentally get trapped in a closet together.

metas.name: High Heels
metas.description: A girl makes a new friend on the first day of school, but life is not always as it seems.

metas.name: A Strange Man Breaks Into Yet Another Office
metas.description: An Executive of Noteworthy Distinction finds his work very rudely interrupted.

metas.name: Translation
metas.description: A young Gaeilgeoir must learn the art of self-assurance and acceptance upon moving from her remote town to the city.

metas.name: Sinister Secret Ingredient
metas.description: When dentist Mel buys a small-town clinic to start a new life, she meets Ruth, a beloved baker and neighbor with a tragic past. But when Mel’s 12-year-old daughter Abby goes missing, Mel uncovers Ruth’s horrifying secret.

metas.name: Men Who Fish
metas.description: After an uneventful fishing trip, a man uncovers a conspiracy upholding centuries-old gender norms, threatening his worldview and loved ones.

metas.name: First Job 2
metas.description: Luke and Charlie are tasked with taking out another hitman who is wanted for manslaughter.

metas.name: Lay Lefty Down
metas.description: Two women unexpectedly unite through stories of grief and laughter, after their family throws a surprise memorial for a left breast.

metas.name: Red Emanuelle
metas.description: A journalist finds herself caught in a bleak office, haunted by her thoughts and yearning to be free.

metas.name: Bikini Office Girl
metas.description: A corporate auditor must log the actions of a bikini-clad employee. But when she begins breaking her own routine, he becomes convinced she's communicating with him, uncovering a reality where they are both prisoners in a simulation.

metas.name: Pondside Pandemonium
metas.description: A split-second accident sets off a chain of events that traps a desperate man in a situation he can't control and can't escape.

metas.name: Clouds
metas.description: Footage of Clouds.

metas.name: Devil’s Lettuce
metas.description: Two Christian teenagers agree to try marijuana with a local dealer if he promises to follow the teachings of Jesus Christ.

metas.name: How to Sleep Better
metas.description: Denise Van Outen explores the eye-opening reasons why we can't get no sleep; from food and hormones to the sneaky sleep-thief of snoring. How we can stay in the land of Nod?

metas.name: One Hour Girlfriend
metas.description: A reclusive man hires a woman for a one-hour companion visit, treating intimacy as a controlled experiment. As the hour unfolds, emotional barriers erode, forcing him to confront love, time, and loss

metas.name: Fake Friends
metas.description: A jogger is recruited to save a tense birthday dinner on fragile pretenses.

metas.name: A Film By Cool Jake
metas.description: The story of Cool Jake's slow descent into madness, as he explores the weird, wacky, & absurd world around him.

metas.name: Chris Fleming: Live at The Palace
metas.description: From the Cadillac Palace Theatre in Chicago, comedian Chris Fleming bursts onto the screen with a fun and lighthearted blend of skillful storytelling and wild physicality in his first HBO stand-up special. A high-energy performer who seamlessly pivots from one everyday topic to another – from Trader Joe’s to Oreos, NPR, and dog breeds – Fleming bounds across the stage as he shares his unique takes on masculinity, conga lines, and more.

metas.name: Udokumenteret
metas.description: Whilst trying not to get fooled, an agent must put all his skills to the test, to save a school from the hands of a villian.

metas.name: Three Small Words
metas.description: A woman spirals to the edge of sanity after accidentally letting three small words slip out to her new coworker.

metas.name: Grade 10D
metas.description: A day in the life of four students in what is considered the worst class in the history of the school, as they confront unscrupulous teachers, sex, drugs and a math test.

metas.name: La Bohème
metas.description: In present day East End, an aspiring novelist falls in love with a Ukrainian cleaner whilst his best friend attempts to rekindle his romance with a social climbing sex bomb.

metas.name: You're Hired
metas.description: Two job applicants desperately try to make it through the same interview.

metas.name: Half Heard
metas.description: After losing hearing in one ear to a schwannoma, a man regains sound through a cochlear implant, drawing parallels between what he hears again and how he’s always listened.

metas.name: The Right Whale
metas.description: While Southern right whales show signs of recovery, their Northern cousins face mounting threats from ship strikes, entanglement, and industrial noise. Filmed in collaboration with scientists, The Right Whale is both a celebration of resilience and a powerful call to action—revealing the intelligence, grace, and vulnerability of these magnificent creatures, and the urgent need to protect them.

metas.name: Pastoral
metas.description: A pastor struggles to connect with his new rural congregation. When he receives an anonymous note about suicide, he is drawn into the lives of the community, uncovering both its struggles and quiet beauty.

metas.name: Buster Brooks
metas.description: Buster Brooks, a naive farm boy, moves to Hollywood with his rooster to try to make it in the movies. Ultimately, Buster has to make the difficult choice between his family life back home and his Hollywood dreams.

metas.name: No Mercy
metas.description: From the starting point of her admiration for the pioneering Ukrainian filmmaker Kira Muratova (1934-2018), the director poses a question: is cinema made by women really tougher, more violent? Seeking answers, she talks to great contemporary filmmakers like Catherine Breillat, Virginie Despentes, Alice Diop, Céline Sciamma, Ana Lily Amirpour, and Monika Treut, among others. It becomes obvious that the cinema screen is a space for the projection of real social problems and power relations.

metas.name: The Napa Boys
metas.description: Jack Jr, Miles Jr and the whole gang are back for one last wine-soaked journey prompted by the mysterious "Sommelier." Joined this time by Puck, a fan of The Napa Boys comics, the group will learn about love, loss, friendship and viticulture.

metas.name: On the Hunt
metas.description: A former military woman takes on a ruthless criminal underworld in a race against time to find her missing daughter.

metas.name: The Cycle
metas.description: In the near future a new drug outlawed by the government called time that once taken makes you immortal but the catch is every time you die you go back to the same spot you were killed but on the same day you took the drug. We follow Curio a mysterious loner that has to complete a mission no matter how many times he dies.

metas.name: The Spin
metas.description: A struggling record store owner travels down south to Cork with his best friend in a bid to save his shop from closure.

metas.name: All That Glitters
metas.description: After accidentally summoning the ghost of William Shakespeare, an insecure teenager tries to land the role of Romeo in his school play and win over the girl playing Juliet, with the Bard as his guide.

metas.name: Bring the Law
metas.description: A disgraced LA cop is chosen to lead a task force against a local crime syndicate and uncovers a conspiracy of corruption in his own department.

metas.name: Little Wings
metas.description: An old woman trapped in a bitter marriage is pushed to the brink when her paralyzed husband sets out to consume her pet rooster.

metas.name: Operation Taco Gary's
metas.description: Two brothers uncover an alien invasion hidden inside a fast-food chain and must save Earth.

metas.name: K-Pops!
metas.description: A washed-up musician travels to Korea to write for K-pop stars, discovering that his long-lost son is set to front one of the country’s hottest new groups. He then jumps at the opportunity to capitalize on his son’s stardom for his own renaissance, but learns that fatherhood is much more fulfilling and meaningful than stardom.

metas.name: Starbright
metas.description: A young woman becomes the guardian of a fallen star, which she must protect from dangerous forces with the help of a brave stranger.

metas.name: Nova '78
metas.description: Resurrected through UK-led archival restoration NOVA 78' shows never-before-seen footage of the legendary Nova Convention where William Burroughs, Patti Smith, Zappa, Ginsberg and more collided in an explosion of ideas, art and rebellion.

metas.name: Just Our Heart
metas.description: An exploration of the profound journey of grief and how grieving can lead to transformation, through the eyes of five women who work with the theme of grief. Each of them dedicates her life to helping others navigate the turbulent waters of personal and ecological grief using ancient and contemporary rituals.

metas.name: Gunslingin' Grandpa
metas.description: Gunslingin’ Grandpa is a comedic Western short about a boy sharing a wildly exaggerated tale of his grandfather’s days in the "Old West". However, the story keeps rewriting itself onscreen, calling into question the reliability of the narrator.

metas.name: Just A Show
metas.description: Minutes before opening night, egos and sabotage erupt backstage as a lead actress fights to save her role.

metas.name: Wool Man Sheep
metas.description: At the heart of modern Europe lies a silent paradox: while we celebrate sustainability, we destroy more than half of our wool—one of our most ecological materials. Through 14 interviews in 11 countries and following two shepherds over the course of a year, the film reveals a fragile knowledge interwoven into the landscapes and everyday gestures. Wool is not disappearing due to a lack of quality, but rather under the pressure of synthetic fibers, a byproduct of the oil industry, which releases microplastics into our world and our bodies. What is at stake goes beyond the material: a living connection between the land, biodiversity, and traditions that shape a sustainable future.

metas.name: Snowblind
metas.description: Introverted snowboarder Ken meets an unexpected friend on the ski mountain that changes his perspective on the sport.

metas.name: OHOIOrOI Syndrome
metas.description: Sally is in the digital world.  Sally watches, listens and learns.  Sally generates through the digital language.  Sally wonders, is Sally OHOIOrOI?  Maybe Sally is a part of OHOIOrOI.  But this film was made with 0% OHOIOrOI.

metas.name: Kelsey Hamilton - A Very Professional Comedian
metas.description: Finally, Kelsey Hamilton drops her debut stand-up special 'A Very Professional Comedian', though the blooper reel may show otherwise. She has the pearly white smile of a dental ad, but when she speaks, it's pure comedic gold! Get to know Kelsey as she shares stories about dating, marriage, lying at work, dogs with social media and how her mom provides endless material. You'll be hearing this album on SiriusXM Comedy Club and we have a feeling she's about to blow up, so be sure follow Kelsey to see what comes next!

metas.name: The Gay Agenda 38
metas.description: In this anthology of shorts, the phrase “Gay Agenda” is reclaimed from the religious right and transformed into a celebration of gay culture. Sit back and enjoy “Slashr,” “Father of the Bride,” and “Bros Before.”

metas.name: Tamago Stories One
metas.description: The first in a series about mechanisms, economies, and ecologies of production through the confluence of eggs, photography, and the sun.

metas.name: The Man Who Built the Waldorf Astoria
metas.description: The story of a Mayo man exiled to New York following the Irish Civil War.

metas.name: Lightshow
metas.description: An experimental short film focusing on artificial lights.

metas.name: Daydreaming About Love
metas.description: A young 20-year-old, George. Spends most of his time daydreaming about the idea of falling in love until he meets Olivia. Watching a young couple grow together, through the most joyful and unhappy times of being in a relationship.

metas.name: all that is solid melts into air
metas.description: Wallflower Mina wants a promotion at the TV production company she works at, but while navigating a fierce rivalry with colleague Dara, Mina realises she must exploit her friend Evie if she is to stand out from the competition.

metas.name: Wind
metas.description: An elderly man escapes from a care home on a journey into his past.

metas.name: Snowday
metas.description: Build a snowman

metas.name: The Idea of Me
metas.description: When a man meets a lost love again, she's no longer who he knew.

metas.name: shadowPLAY
metas.description: An introvert, obsessed with celluloid film and analog photography, forms an  unlikely friendship with a cynical coworker in a very old-fashioned analog  sort of way.

metas.name: Stronger than the Wave
metas.description: This documentary explores the Michinoku Coastal Trail, a 1,000km trail along Tohoku's coast, reflecting on the region's recovery from the 2011 Tohoku earthquake.

metas.name: Handmade Future
metas.description: HANDMADE FUTURE follows artisans in six countries who preserve heritage, navigate the complex role of middlemen, and advance responsible trade—pushing back against fast, cheap production to quietly restore a frayed world through beauty and human connection. From rug weavers in Morocco’s Atlas Mountains and block printers in India’s Golden Triangle to Appalachian broom makers in Kentucky and recycled-glass blowers in Kenya, the film showcases craftspeople whose work carries generations of skill, culture, and creativity.

metas.name: One Night Out with Alan Cumming
metas.description: Alan Cumming hosts a comedy gala featuring 2SLGBTQIA+ stars performing at the Just For Laughs Montréal festival.

metas.name: The Dunblane Tapes
metas.description: After the 1996 mass shooting at Dunblane, a campaign was launched to ban private handguns in the UK. This remarkable story can now be told with unseen video filmed by a bereaved parent.

metas.name: Centrífuga
metas.description: Maca is leaving in a week to study abroad away from her city, Seville. What she once envisioned as the future is now an imminent reality. Maca's inertia suddenly stops after having to face a host of new fears that will falter the decision that was once firm.

metas.name: A Suburban Drone
metas.description: In a quiet dream, a housewife lives a peaceful life in nature with her cat. She is jolted awake by the harsh drone of her husband mowing the lawn. The relentless chorus of lawn mowers operated by the husbands on her street grows increasingly unbearable.

metas.name: My Art
metas.description: A drummer and a basketball player meet at an unexpected time, creating a unique friendship. While pushing each other to their limits, they demonstrate true passion.

metas.name: If You Are Seeing This I've Slowly Passed
metas.description: A short video essay centered around an improbable pain.

metas.name: Death of a Bartender
metas.description: On yet another boring day at work, the overworked Jay struggles to deal with his passive-aggressive boss and his Scouse co-worker.

metas.name: Strip Buds
metas.description: We find ourselves in a magical stop-motion animated world where a group of female flowers gather in search of fun and entertainment.

metas.name: The Corinthians: We Were the Champions
metas.description: A documentary highlighting the talent and plight of a successful British women’s football team who fought against sexist attitudes to become champions.

metas.name: Chain Of Command
metas.description: A recruit attempts to access data but her officer already knows what is going on

metas.name: KOP-CLUB
metas.description: By day, a kopitiam runs like any ordinary shop, but once night falls, it becomes a hidden base for gang dealings. On his first shift, Arjun, is warned to stay quiet and follow orders, but the night quickly unravels when two gang leaders arrive and tensions flare. As their argument escalates into violence, the worker becomes trapped in the chaos

metas.name: Tgirls Make Music
metas.description: A documentary about trans woman rapper and producer htmljones/ish99ni (Ishaani Ponniah), framed through the visual language of early-2000s television, 2010s internet aesthetics, and contemporary British culture.

metas.name: Saint Agnes
metas.description: Over the course of one night at a women-themed gallery preview, a withdrawn young woman is forced to confront her unresolved trauma when a provocative artwork exposes her best friend, pushing both women to reckon with consent, complicity, and the quiet fractures in their friendship.

metas.name: Palestine Comedy Club
metas.description: Six Palestinian stand-up comedians write and tour a comedy show exploring the unlikely, often dark humour that surrounds the complexity of Palestinian identity. What starts as a blending of comic traditions to encourage honest and open reflections through the shared enjoyment of laughter becomes an existential imperative to survival and sharing common humanity.

metas.name: Masa
metas.description: A profile of Masa Sakano, who relocated from Japan to the Highlands of Scotland in search of mountain adventure.

metas.name: Stone Age Temple Mystery
metas.description: On a remote hillside in modern-day Turkey sits Göbekli Tepe, the oldest temple on Earth. For centuries, archaeologists believed it was a religious center built by nomadic hunter-gatherers before the rise of civilization. But groundbreaking new evidence reveals that a sophisticated community of settled hunter-gatherers, not nomads, lived here year-round for centuries. This startling discovery could be the missing link in humanity's momentous transition from hunting to farming. Follow experts as they use new digs and shattered skulls to piece together a captivating story that could forever change our understanding of the roots of civilization.

metas.name: Ang Tao, Ang Bayan, Ngayon ay Lumalaban
metas.description: An intimate oral history interview with a veteran educator from Bocaue, Bulacan, revealing the psychological tightrope of teaching truth under the shadow of the Marcos Martial Law regime.

metas.name: Paths
metas.description: When life changes and you’re going through a difficult low phase.
