metas.name: Trapped Outside
metas.description: After killing her abusive husband in self-defense, Dana discovers his hidden fortune, only to be stalked by a mysterious figure.

metas.name: The Great Procrastinator
metas.description: A writer struggles to come up with an idea for a script. He keeps getting off-track, and time is relentlessly against him.

metas.name: Elise Christie: No Filter
metas.description: In December 2021, three-time Olympian Elise Christie retired from short track speed skating, broken and unwell. Elise tells her story.

metas.name: Jackie Kashian: Alter-Kashian
metas.description: Jackie Kashian returns with a new hour filled with all the excitement, drama, and hilarity that you've come to expect from one the greatest to ever do it. This hour has it all - Guns! Fly Fishing! Death-defying stunts (driving)! Recorded live to a packed house at The Siren Theater in Portland, OR, Jackie is back and better than ever.

metas.name: Spirit
metas.description: A celebration of home and belonging in South London. This is a film that tows the line between documentary and narrative, and celebrates neighborhood and the rhythms of everyday life in South London. Friends for over a decade, their closeness runs through the piece; rooted in lived relationships, it resists spectacle in favor of quiet intimacy.

metas.name: Jovial Pals with Evil Rabbit
metas.description: The Jovial Pals are shown in a series of shots to the theme of a song by “Evil Rabbit”

metas.name: LS Lowry: The Unheard Tapes
metas.description: The story of the 'matchstick man' painter, one of Britain’s most beloved artists, revealed as never before through intimate and previously unheard hidden recordings. Recorded by a young fan, Angela Barratt, in 1972, the tapes uncover much about Lowry's life story and the changing north he captured in his iconic paintings. The voices in this film are real, lip-synced by actors Ian McKellen and Annabel Smith.

metas.name: On Call
metas.description: Walking film about cycles and the eternal.

metas.name: Roses
metas.description: Slow film about waiting and loving, and the ways they intersect.

metas.name: Paranormal Dependence
metas.description: Unable to become sober, a man consumes a substance that allows him to communicate with dead people.

metas.name: Sol Garden
metas.description: Water, wind, light, and bodies move together, the ground and the sky becoming one with everything in between. Shot in July of 2025 by Nico Listi and Kathir Mack-Dev and scored by the two (Seafaring Vessels).

metas.name: Survivor 50: Epic Party
metas.description: 24 returning players are abandoned on the islands of Fiji for a monumental 50th season, with the chance to win $1 million. The theme of the season, "In the Hands of the Fans," quickly materializes as decisions from the fan vote swiftly and forcefully impact the game. Castaways reflect on how much they have changed since the last time they played the game. Then, an unforeseen injury during the first immunity challenge causes tribemates to rethink their attack strategy in order to support their team member.

metas.name: New Life, Hard Choice
metas.description: James, a remorseful father, fights to rebuild a relationship with the daughter he abandoned nearly a decade ago, racing against time to make amends before the opportunity to repair their fractured bond disappears forever.

metas.name: Creepizoid
metas.description: Conner's girlfriend breaks up with him; he takes it very well.

metas.name: The Only Constant In Life
metas.description: "Wow look at all of that snow." - QV

metas.name: Let Him Go
metas.description: Leo, a young man with a depressing life, suddenly dies. However, a Council of Gods gives him twenty-four hours back on Earth to prove why he deserves to be brought back to life.

metas.name: LOOK WITH EYES ONLY
metas.description: Landscapes change with time; people don't. I try to expose the solipsism of lower Appalachian life in this day and age.

metas.name: I BURNT MY BRAIN FOR YOU
metas.description: A documentary style examination of the artistic process, delving into the creation of a project that takes an immeasurable toll on its creator.

metas.name: No Refunds
metas.description: "No Refunds" is a visceral, tangled descent into the transactional dynamics of intimate encounters, told through the language of bodies, sheets, and reflections, where the purchase of queer sex work is laid bare. As the filmmaker simultaneously takes on the roles of client and audience, the boundaries between documentary and performance fade, unraveling the artifice at the heart of sex work and the act of filmmaking.

metas.name: EMERGENCE: Women in the Storm
metas.description: Following recent natural disasters in British Columbia and the Northwest Territories, female frontline responders, and community leaders demonstrate new ways to live and support one another in a rapidly changing climate.

metas.name: Twenty One Pilots: More Than We Ever Imagined
metas.description: Experience the electrifying concert film capturing Twenty One Pilots at a career-defining moment: their monumental Mexico City headline show, performing in front of 65,000 fans at Estadio GNP Seguros during The Clancy World Tour. Set against the vibrant pulse of one of the world’s most iconic music capitals, the film blends cinematic high-energy performance footage with intimate, behind-the-scenes access, revealing the heart, humor, and humanity of the artists as they prepare for one of the biggest shows of their career.

metas.name: Inside the Kingdom of MBS: Saudi Arabia Between Repression and Transformation
metas.description: Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman, also known as MBS, is the de facto ruler of Saudi Arabia. For almost a decade, he has been radically transforming the country — at a breathtaking pace.

metas.name: Keo - Live at Village Underground
metas.description: Keo - Live from Village Underground, Shoreditch (29/10/2025)

metas.name: Mark Vigeant: The Best Man Show
metas.description: Mark Vigeant examines loneliness, toxic masculinity, and the meaning of love as best man Paul Rose.

metas.name: Hoppers
metas.description: Scientists have discovered how to 'hop' human consciousness into lifelike robotic animals, allowing people to communicate with animals as animals. Animal lover Mabel seizes an opportunity to use the technology, uncovering mysteries within the animal world beyond anything she could have imagined.

metas.name: OLD TECHNOLOGY
metas.description: Official short film for Slayyyter's "Worst Girl in America" album.

metas.name: Living Out Loud
metas.description: In a time when the visibility of LGBTQ+ people in Britain has never been higher, so too has the backlash. Guided by the beloved drag star, Copper Topp, Living Out Loud confronts the rising tide of homophobia and transphobia sweeping the UK, while celebrating the resilience and brilliance of the queer community.

metas.name: Lord, Have Mercy: An Interview With Hisayasu Sato
metas.description: An interview with director Hisayasu Satô about "Kyrie Eleison" (bonus feature on the "The Films of Hisayasu Satô: Volume #3" Bluray set released by Vinegar Syndrome).

metas.name: Eric Dane: Life, Loss & Courage – A Diane Sawyer Special
Anthony Oakes: Sweet Little Oakes Boy
metas.description: Anthony Oakes serves sharp wit with Southern roots and D.C. hustle. Learn how to play "Guess Who Died", what it's like to be gay in church, and how to deal with vegetarians in this hour of polished punchlines and joyful power.

metas.name: Nature, Texture, and Patience - The Films of Yuri Norstein
metas.description: A 21-minute visual essay from film historian Evan Chester exploring the background and style of Yuri Norstein, influences on his work, how his work fits into the history of Russian animation, and more.

metas.name: Pink Moon Dispatch
metas.description: An abstract video collage project about love and fear and the cosmos.

metas.name: Concerto di Pasqua dal Duomo di Orvieto 2026
metas.description: From Orvieto Cathedral, the traditional Easter Concert. The Maggio Musicale Fiorentino Orchestra, conducted by Maestro Daniele Rustioni, performs Wagner’s *Tannhäuser* Overture and Brahms’ Symphony No. 2 in D major, Op. 73.

metas.name: Lip Crush 2
metas.description: It's been two weeks since Tyler and Oliver uploaded their video to YouTube, and the world hasn't stopped spinning since. Those fleeting kisses have become a constant, but now, as they prepare to attend Tyler's mom's wedding, they must confront what their friendship is becoming. As they navigate these blurred lines, they realize that time, like their feelings, can stretch or rush by, depending on how they choose to see it.

metas.name: A Telephone
metas.description: A man becomes transfixed by a hypnotic mobile phone commercial, leading him to uncover a hidden message.

metas.name: Dys-Sympathetic
metas.description: A dejected man living in Los Angeles limps through a prolonged break-up and the distractions in the aftermath. Brian Follmer directs “Dys-Sympathetic,” a satirical featurette poking at casual sex, casual romance, and the emotional deterioration of it all. Tyler waits for his ex-girlfriend, Zoe, at a bar. We listen to his train-of-thought in the form of narration. He thinks about all the fake food he’s recently eaten and considers what he'll say about himself on his new Tinder profile. After hooking up once again, Tyler and Zoe try returning to “no-contact.” As Tyler begins a numbing, sex-induced bender, Zoe comes by his apartment, wanting more and sharing the news that she’s pregnant. Tyler acquires abortion pills, and the two experience it together at his place.

metas.name: No Time To Heal
metas.description: No Time to Heal follows Kyrylo, a Ukrainian soldier released after three years in Russian captivity. He arrives at the Forest Glade rehabilitation center, where soldiers are given just three weeks to stabilize psychologically before returning to the uncertainty of war. Observing therapy sessions, daily routines, and moments of quiet reflection, the film captures the fragile space between trauma and recovery. Through an intimate portrait of one man’s struggle to regain control over his mind and body, the documentary reveals the limits of healing when time, war, and duty leave little room for recovery.

metas.name: Escape 3: An Interview with Hisayasu Sato
metas.description: An interview with Hisayasu Sato about Rafureshia  (bonus feature on the "The Films of Hisayasu Satô: Volume #3" Bluray set released by Vinegar Syndrome).

metas.name: Best Egg Fried Rice Ever
metas.description: A young man and his friend try earnestly to recreate the magic of his grandma's egg fried rice. In other words, to cook the Best Egg Fried Rice Ever.

metas.name: Clown & Out
metas.description: Paco Saavedra is a struggling comedian whose life flips overnight when a livestreamed scuffle with a gangster goes viral. Suddenly, he’s a national hero, a meme, and the internet’s newest obsession. But fame is a double-edged sword. As Paco is thrust into instant stardom, he battles to separate his true identity from the clown persona the world demands — even if it costs him the woman he loves.

metas.name: Dreamscape
metas.description: A boy has his teddy bear stolen and he must find it.

metas.name: Probashe Agomon
metas.description: Documentary is a form of digital media  which speaks about the livelihood of people living in a city and their revelations about it. Durga Puja as a festival is mostly known for being celebrated by Bengali's (a community from eastern India).  Probashe  Agomon as translated directly "Arrival Abroad" is what Bengalis wait for throughout the year for a Glimpse of Maa Durga. This is not just a religious ceremony it is a cultural festival.

metas.name: Horseman Cometh
metas.description: An animated short inspired by a long-abandoned student film draft, resurrected nearly a decade later.  Russ has spent years consumed by the legend of the Horseman — a serial killer who stalks the city behind a grotesque horse mask. What began as curiosity has hardened into obsession, isolating him from the world around him. When Russ finally uncovers a lead that points to the killer’s hidden lair, the line between hunter and hunted begins to blur.  Joined by his loyal friends Isaac and the enigmatic THUNDERBIRD, Russ descends into a confrontation that is as psychological as it is physical. As long-buried fears surface and the truth behind the Horseman comes into focus, Russ must decide whether solving the mystery will bring closure… or complete the very story that has consumed him.

metas.name: Revenge in S&M: An Interview with Hisayasu Sato
metas.description: An interview with Hisayasu Satô about "Turtle Vision" (bonus feature on the "The Films of Hisayasu Satô: Volume #3" Bluray set released by Vinegar Syndrome).

metas.name: The Zero Line: Inside Russia's War
metas.description: BBC exposes the horror unfolding on the Russian side of the war in Ukraine. Soldiers being tortured and even executed at the hands of their brothers in arms.

metas.name: Thanatophobia
metas.description: A young man struggles to get through the day due to his overwhelming fear of death.

metas.name: I had a dream about my land
metas.description: Dedicated to those who left their homeland, and those whose land is bleeding

metas.name: Slaget
metas.description: A guy gets punched and questions what to do and why.

metas.name: A Guide to Pink: An Interview with Yoshiyuki Hayashida
metas.description: An interview with critic Yoshiyuki Hayashida about Hisayasu Satô's films (bonus feature on the "The Films of Hisayasu Satô: Volume #3" Bluray set released by Vinegar Syndrome).

metas.name: 99 rush
metas.description: debut short film

metas.name: Through The Widening Woods
metas.description: Having lived in a chaotic, broken, and unnatural world. One must escape to the widening woods.

metas.name: Walking in Circles: Shinjuku with Hisayasu Sato: Part 3
metas.description: Hisayasu Satô revisits the locations in Shinjuku where he shot "Kyrie Eleison", "Turtle Vision" and "Rafureshia". (bonus feature on the "The Films of Hisayasu Satô: Volume #3" Bluray set released by Vinegar Syndrome).

metas.name: Scenes From The Divide
metas.description: In the lead-up to Zohran Mamdani’s election as mayor of New York City, many of the city’s Jewish population found themselves at odds over the candidate’s positions on Palestine and Israel. By inviting viewers into the homes of New Yorkers on both sides of the campaign, filmmaker Alison reveals a fierce battle among American Jews over identity, history, and responsibility. SCENES FROM THE DIVIDE explores a community in generational upheaval.

metas.name: Being Billy
metas.description: William (Billy) Livesey is a Falklands Veteran with dementia, living in a care home.  A brief connection with new carer Lisa stirs memories in Billy, taking him back to the closing stages of the Falklands War in 1982 and a life changing incident that took place for him, his close friend (and fellow Para) Stu and Argentinian soldier Pablo.  Memories from the past help guide Billy through the fog of dementia and re-connect him to the present.  Some Wars Never End....

metas.name: Gwen Rose: Emotional Cutting
metas.description: Gwen Rose - One of Time Out Magazine's "Comics to Watch in 2025" - delights a packed crowd at The Den Theater for her debut special. From the absurdity of people accepting the Spider-verse but not transitioning, issues with her family in Indiana and her ability to still do a kick flip, Gwen destroys in her adopted hometown of Chicago.

metas.name: The Charlie O'Leary Story
metas.description: Charlie O'Leary, born in Dublin on 1 February 1924, is now 101 years old, and best known for being kitman on the Irish football team which qualified for the European Championships in 1988 and the World Cup in 1990 and 1994.

metas.name: Quand la mer furieuse
metas.description: Short film about the return of water to the Aude region, based on the eponymous music by Emahoy Tsegué-Maryam Guèbrou.

metas.name: Taylor Tomlinson: Prodigal Daughter
metas.description: Taylor Tomlinson takes her fans to church with hilarious confessions about dating in her 30s, her dream assistant and why she refuses to use AI.

metas.name: Displaced
metas.description: A depressed, dysfunctional physicist accidentally sent back in time tries to fix her future by mentoring her troubled 14-year-old self: a whole-ass handful with her own mischievous agenda.

metas.name: She Was Here
metas.description: Heather O’Rourke captured hearts as Carol-Anne in the Poltergeist films, a bright light destined for greatness. Her sudden passing at just 12 years old left the world stunned and searching for answers. She Was Here looks beyond the headlines and rumors to honor the girl behind the role: her life, her spirit, and the legacy she left behind.

metas.name: The Short Life Of Jaxon Blume
metas.description: Two brothers embark on the journey of a lifetime to see the ocean, all while being hunted down by a detective for a murder they may or may not have committed. We don’t know what their intentions are.

metas.name: WUFT at CES 2026: Megabytes and Vegas Nights
metas.description: Join WUFT technology reporter Jacob Sedesse on a whirlwind trip as the world's biggest electronics showcase descends upon the Las Vegas Strip.

metas.name: 100 Years of Marilyn Monroe
metas.description: An exploration of Marilyn Monroe's life, legacy, and lasting impact a century after her birth, revealing the complex woman behind the iconic image.

metas.name: Echoes
metas.description: A traumatized detective leaves a message for his psychiatrist.

metas.name: Shots
metas.description: A-level short film featuring 2 cowboys who fire many shots but soon realise they just can't hit any.

metas.name: Blood Pact
metas.description: Matthew and his lifelong friend Daniel begin the mission that will set them free from their debt forever, but complicated relationships and rising tensions cause an outbreak of violence between the pair of them that destroys any future aspirations they once thought they could have...

metas.name: Gabriella
metas.description: After a near death experience, an incredible little girl named Gabriella is given the miraculous power to heal and act in God's name.

metas.name: Heel Turn
metas.description: You may never have heard of her, but she is an icon in the underground world of wrestling in Sydney, Australia. Fierce, alive, electric: her shows are part acrobatics and part insult comedy. She's never met a battle she can't face. But now, after 8 years of wrestling, things have shifted. As she prepares for the match she reflects on wrestling, sexism, gender and her future in the industry. What does it mean to be a Heel in a world that already villainises your identity?

metas.name: Cold as I.C.E
metas.description: After legal U.S citizen Joey Mexico is shot and arrested by I.C.E, conflicting narratives on the incident spark severe controversy.

metas.name: Breaking the Horse
metas.description: A working-class man finds himself stuck in a system that destroys ambition in place of dehumanising and monotonous work. As his labour devours him, his mind begins to fracture, revealing the psychological cost of a life stripped of purpose.

metas.name: The Traveling Shoes
metas.description: Short Stop Motion film showing converse shoes in different locations

metas.name: Remember the Summit
metas.description: Sir Chris Bonington’s return to Torres del Paine, 62 years after the first ascent of the Central Tower.  At 91 years old, and while living with Alzheimer’s disease, the documentary accompanies Bonington in a profoundly human return: an attemp to reconnect with memories that time has erased, but that the Patagonian landscape still seems to guard. During the filming, Chris once again set foot on the territory of Estancia Cerro Guido, closing a circle between past and present, between the epic of mountainneering and the fragility of memory.

metas.name: The Confederate
metas.description: Spanning thirty years of smoke, mirrors, and regret, a washed-up illusionist clinging to the past must team up with the estranged daughter he treated like a prop to conquer the viral age and pull off the greatest trick of all: redemption.

metas.name: Pete Holmes: Silly Silly Fun Boy
metas.description: Comedian Pete Holmes delivers fresh takes on parenting, marriage and more.

metas.name: Instructions To Cry
metas.description: A man receives a package with items intended to help him navigate his emotions and cry.

metas.name: Chipped
metas.description: In the distant future where AI rules the world, one man must escape the claws of the allegiance to return to the woman he loves.

metas.name: yawning so you don't ask why my eyes are full
metas.description: a man takes a trip home after a visit to his girlfriend

metas.name: Only Fans
metas.description: A Film About 2 fans in complete and utter silence

metas.name: No Exit
metas.description: No Exit follows a young woman trapped in a seemingly ordinary corridor, only to repeatedly return to the same starting point. At first, she searches for a way out with logic and patience, testing doors and marking walls, but nothing leads forward. As time begins to loop and reality subtly shifts - objects move, sounds stretch, and familiar patterns distort - her attempts to escape become increasingly frantic. The corridor feels smaller, the air heavier, and silence grows suffocating. Without dialogue, the film relies on sound, atmosphere, and visual repetition to chart her unraveling. By the end, it's unclear whether the prison is physical, psychological, or both, leaving the audience to imagine the boundaries of her reality - and question if there was ever an exit at all.

metas.name: Spiritual day in Minneapolis
metas.description: In a spiritual, aesthetic and esoteric sense but most importantly in a literal sense this documentary film attempts to follow the footsteps of oil magnate Maximiliano Coraza, adventurer, conjurer, detail-lover and probably the only man capable of tracing a general history of the geomorphology of the wide American continent.

metas.name: Syd
metas.description: As a cricketer, Dave Syd Lawrence was a fearsome fast bowler, who reached the top of the game to become the first British born Black man to play for England. Although his career was cut short by an injury described as one of the worst in sporting history, his achievements off the field have to be seen to be believed.

metas.name: A Story About You

metas.name: The Bulldogs

metas.name: Belonging Syndrome
metas.description: Belonging Syndrome is a short documentary that follows Duang, a second-generation Italian-Thai girl. Duang, during a period of stay in a monastery. Through her inner diary, the film explores a suspended phase of life: the one in which identity it is not yet defined and belonging becomes an open question. The monastery becomes the physical and symbolic place where Duang observes herself. Immersed in a daily life marked by rituals, silences and repeated gestures, the protagonist goes through an experience of deep listening, in which time slows down and perception is refined. Belonging Syndrome talks about hybrid identities, cultural legacies that coexist without completely merging, the difficulty and possibility of inhabiting multiple worlds without having to choose just one. It is an intimate and contemplative story about the search for balance in a fragile and open phase of existence.

metas.name: canım

metas.name: Homecoming: The Tokyo Series

metas.name: Beau Ideal
metas.description: In the stillness of a remote town, a troubled writer intervenes in a neighbor’s abusive household— testing the limits of truth, heroism and his own fractured sense of self.

metas.name: Gays Against Guns
metas.description: Gays Against Guns takes us to the frontlines of the American gun violence epidemic, seen through the eyes of an Irish immigrant, who left Ireland when it was illegal to be gay in search of the ‘Gay American Dream’. But the Pulse nightclub massacre changed everything. It was the worst mass shooting in the U.S. at that time, and the catalyst for the formation of an extraordinary new activist group - Gays Against Guns.  We follow our narrator, the filmmaker, from neon splashed street protests into the corridors of power, as he documents GAG’s actions over a ten year period, from that fateful night in Orlando, through the chaos of today’s unhinged, divided America.  Featuring legendary filmmaker John Waters, this is an inspiring David and Goliath story for our turbulent times -  a testament to resilience, community, and the power of caring for a total stranger.

metas.name: Enough
metas.description: While researching a class assignment, Ashley, a disillusioned college student crosses paths with Erika, a quiet librarian, and is drawn into the decades-old fight for Japanese American redress and the story of a lawyer who must find the courage to testify in  order to help heal a community--and himself.

metas.name: Walking Through The Jungle
metas.description: Join the explorer girl on a journey through the jungle, river, mountains, ocean, arctic and the city of London encountering different animals on the way.  This version of the classic song 'Walking Through the Jungle' follows a girl exploring environments and meeting animals before returning home. Once indoors it is revealed that she is playing with her stuffed animal toys and has been in her garden imagining a trip around the world.

metas.name: Age of Quorum
metas.description: Age of Quorum is a thrilling drama about Issy, a young British Black man, whose NYE celebrations turn terrifying when his friends break out some recreational drugs. He spirals into a paranoid nightmare where he’s confronted, then stalked by a thug intent on violence. The feeling that there is no escape or safe place to weather this storm is exemplified when he believes the friends who abandoned him, turn out to be part of the torture.

metas.name: Swing Swish Sway
metas.description: "Inspired by Rosalie 'Rose' Bamberger (1921-1990), the mixed-race Filipina American paintbrush maker and co-founder of the Daughters of Bilitis (DOB) in 1955. When DOB shifted their focus to becoming the first US lesbian political rights organization, Rose and her partner Rosemary faded from the historical record. What they truly sought was a 'secret society for lesbians' -- a space to dance, drink, and dine without fear of police raids. The film presents Rose's unrealized vision -- a kaleidoscope of women swinging, playing, and dancing, intercut with celluloid fragments of potlucks and paintbrushes ... " (TT) Commissioned for Canyon Cinema's Print Generations project.

metas.name: Operation Matryoshka: Russia's Hidden Front

The aim of these operations is political, social and economic destabilisation, which many experts consider to be preparation for military aggression.

Then, just as the consequences of being a thankless social outcast threaten to completely overwhelm her, her sculpture wins a coveted award. Now Daphne must face a new challenge, one to herself and her art.

metas.name: Murder in Music City

metas.name: Something to Hold

He reminisces about past seasons spent in the wilderness making art and bearing witness to his awe-inspiring subjects. metas.name: One Queer Day In Hackney
metas.description: More than ever LGBTQI+ lives are under pressure and threat from the media and society, queer venues are disappearing, queer her/history is not being recorded. So this was a chance to record the everyday life that we and others don’t see, of what its like to be queer and live in Hackney, how we exist and support each other, the challenges and ways the community comes together, to cover working, creativity, expression, housing, mobility, ageing, support, love, all in one day as a snap shot of life, to show its diversity, and not just the more visible members, but the everyday people and a glimpse into their daily routine.

metas.name: Brailled It

metas.name: To continue knowing (you)

Bleary-eyed and exhausted from their journey, they bicker. As they wait on a train platform to continue homeward, a misunderstanding occurs. Confusion rises and doubts awaken. Where do they go from here?

metas.name: Charlie Is Not a Boy
metas.description: Charlie is Not a Boy is the tale of a hushed soul, bound to a crumbling household in an allegorical America. With a perverted butcher for a father and a mother frozen in a quiet, catatonic spell, Charlie seeks solace in the whimsical world of his eccentric grandmother. As his safe haven unravels, Charlie navigates the hostile worlds of home and the military, caught between his authentic self and the masks he must wear.

Determined to stay in the Corps, she pushes her body to the limit, competing in elite-level endurance sports to prove she’s still fit to serve. Her wife Melissa and their young son Archer watch in awe as Christman fights not just for her career, but to leave behind a legacy of strength. With every grueling challenge, she defies the odds, knowing that even if cancer takes her, the legacy of people she’s touched and love for her family will live on.

metas.name: Saving the Hidden Coral of the Mediterranean
metas.description: The coral in the mediterranean form unique underwater habitats, usually between 30–150m deep. These ecosystems support more than 1,800 species but have been decimated by destructive bottom trawling fishing, which can flatten centuries-old coral structures in minutes. RAZOR’s Russell Beard meets Anastasia Miliou and her team of scientists at the Archipelagos Institute of Marine Conservation. They have been mapping coral to provide the hard scientific evidence needed to secure their long-term protection. Their work has led to the recent creation of a protected no-trawl zone around the Fourni Islands. Over the years the organization has developed into one of the Mediterranean's most respected marine research and conservation institutes, attracting a new generation of scientists tooling up for a future of fighting the colossal challenges facing our seas. Over 26 years, they have hosted over 27,000 young people from 43 countries.

metas.name: Sidney Felsen Decorates an Envelope
metas.description: Sidney Felsen, who passed away in 2024 at age 99, was a true Los Angeles institution. He co-founded Gemini G.E.L. alongside Stanley Grinstein in 1966 and spent decades overseeing, photographing, and befriending some of the greatest postwar American artists of his generation.  Sidney kept a quiet, joyful ritual: decorating the envelopes that carried artists’ royalty checks, using his beloved collection of postage and rubber stamps that filled his iconic office — a room filled with photographs of every artist he had ever worked with.  It was Julie Mehretu who first introduced Tacita to Gemini. Knowing Sidney’s deep affection for Julie, Dean asked him to decorate an envelope for her. The result is this poignant 14-minute film: Sidney, impeccably dressed as always, at his desk, doing what he loved most.

metas.description: Interlude is a heartfelt, dialogue-free short film about Walter, an elderly widower who rediscovers his passion for music. Haunted by memories of his late wife, Walter struggles to play the piano again after years away. With only his loyal dog for company, he battles self-doubt, aging hands, and unfinished melodies as he prepares for a local talent show. Through quiet determination and bittersweet flashbacks, Walter finds the courage to finish his composition and honor his wife’s memory, ultimately reconnecting with his family and himself.

metas.name: The Light Won't Dim
metas.description: From Puerto Rico’s Centro Buen Pastor, where solar panels became a lifeline after Hurricane Maria, to New York City schools and small-town rooftops, the film shows how communities are taking energy into their own hands. Featuring interviews with Senator Bernie Sanders and climate leader Bill McKibben alongside local leaders and experts, the film reveals both the obstacles and the unstoppable momentum of clean energy — a story of resilience, equity, and hope for the future.

metas.name: Hoʻomalu ʻĀina Maui
metas.description: Hoʻomalu ʻĀina Maui follows students from Kīhei Charter School as they partner with Kīpuka Olowalu on wildfire mitigation and native planting along Olowalu Stream. Through interviews with students, their teacher, Kīpuka Olowalu staff, and a PhD candidate collaborating on the project, the film highlights the importance of blending cultural knowledge, scientific research, and hands-on stewardship. This student-made documentary celebrates the power of youth learning and working alongside their community to protect and restore the Olowalu watershed.

metas.name: Project Deer: Bridging Roads & Wildlife
metas.description: At Project Deer, our mission is to make roads safer for both humans and wildlife by using intelligent, accessible technology to detect animals in real-time and prevent collisions. We believe every life matters and we’re committed to creating a future where roads are shared responsibly, ecosystems are respected, and innovation drives positive change.

metas.name: Marine Field Station
metas.description: Nestled in New Jersey ‘s coastal marshes, a fabled research center has quietly tracked the marine life nearby. Now with water levels rising around them, these scientists face a new and unnerving subject to study: themselves.

metas.name: Hawk Watch
metas.description: Endangered raptors. A dedicated crew of citizen scientists. A fragile desert environment. The HAWK WATCH Documentary follows local conservationists as they attempt to establish a legacy: protecting the Swainson’s Hawk migration in Southern California. The “Hawksters” strive for success, but aging, climate change, business development, and even Mother Nature herself produce obstacles that threaten it all.

metas.name: Outside The Frame

metas.name: Montmartre

There, she falls for Toussaint, a tour guide with a penchant for poetry, magic and romance. As they grow closer, culture, art and love intertwine, reconnecting Jo to her long-lost passion for life.

metas.name: Regenerative Ag in the Northern Great Plains
metas.description: In eastern Montana, one family is leading the regenerative agriculture movement with the support of a seemingly unlikely partner, the World Wildlife Fund.  Dig into regenerative ag and see why so many conservation NGOs are backing it.

metas.name: Crime & Parody

metas.name: Regarding Art,
metas.description: See you in a dream. Feathers tucked to your sides. There in a tree, hazel eyes flicker in my direction. See your lights parked outside. Caught up in the race with time. Lights blinking. Feelings pour out into an open sea. Into more of me. Dancing like a dream. I trust, and I know it’s never over. Rain pours again. It’s getting hard to be someone. Hold my bags, even if they won’t understand. Less is plenty, more is many. Isn’t that what Yeat said? Whispered into echoes through hollow paper chambers in my short term memory. If not for you, I’d never blur my vision again. And in the night I’ll remember the day. Whispering a lovely thank you into the darkness.

metas.name: Double Double Trouble

metas.name: A CNN & Variety Town Hall Event: Timothée Chalamet and Matthew McConaughey
metas.description: Filmed before a live audience of students at The University of Texas at Austin's Moody College of Communication, this event brings together two of Hollywood's most dynamic actors, Timothée Chalamet and Matthew McConaughey, for a candid discussion about their craft and creative process. In addition to reflecting on their approaches to performance and the roles that have most influenced their artistic journeys, Chalamet and McConaughey will also take questions from the student audience throughout the program.

metas.name: Stone Biter: Saving the Arctic Sea Forests
metas.description: When an Italian photographer moves to Northern Norway, he carries a dream: to explore the icy Arctic waters and film the iconic wolffish amongst lush kelp forests. But beneath the surface, he finds a stark reality - an ocean floor stripped bare, where the once-thriving sea forests have nearly vanished.

metas.name: Dreaming Of Carhartt
metas.description: Dreaming of Carhartt is a playful and introspective short film that follows Soren, a wide-eyed dreamer whose obsession with a Carhartt jacket pulls him into a dream world where memory, imagination, and reality intertwine. As Soren loses himself in musical sequences and personal identity, the film becomes both a critique and a celebration of brand culture.

metas.name: Little Feat: The Documentary
metas.description: Narrated by Jeff Bridges, Little Feat: The Documentary tells the untold story of one of America’s most influential and under-appreciated bands, featuring never-before-seen footage and stories from iconic fans and friends, including Bonnie Raitt, Linda Ronstadt, Jackson Browne, Elvis Costello, members of the Doobie Brothers, Phish and the Grateful Dead.

metas.name: _____ in Paris
metas.description: We lived a secret life, hidden from your husband--a romance of furtive meetings and a future eternally postponed. We stole a week to be together in France; I still could never film us directly, but in the textures and details of the city, I captured the tragic absences of our affair, infinite in the shadows, impossible in the open. Years later, I found these grainy old videotapes--faded like memory, feelings raw but transformed--and composed a love letter to who we once were, what we could’ve been.

metas.name: Really Love
metas.description: A relationship between love and dreams, a pursuit of legacy. Jean, an architect who built his love through materialistic things meets with Jaa, who tries to find an emotion under materialistic things.

metas.name: Guardians of Yellowstone: The Yellowstone Cougar Project
metas.description: Told across three distinct phases of research, the film chronicles the evolution of the Yellowstone Cougar Project, highlighting the groundbreaking science, tireless fieldwork, and unwavering passion of the biologists who are committed to understanding and protecting these elusive animals. Audiences will also get to meet specific cougars, each with their own unique story of survival, resilience, and connection, set against the stunning backdrop of Yellowstone's majestic landscapes.

metas.name: The Stars Between Us
metas.description: Seven years ago, Kim made a connection with a stranger during an eclipse event. Now a fledgling news reporter, Kim returns to Illinois for this year's eclipse, unaware that their paths may cross again.

metas.name: DEI
metas.description: A bigoted man finds himself in an unlikely body on Día de los Muertos.

metas.name: Corpse Pose
metas.description: An experimental musical following a heartbroken man's nocturnal odyssey.

metas.name: The Hit
metas.description: An assassin botches a hit

metas.name: Between Ourselves
metas.description: Three people search for their ideal selves in a fictional world until those ideal selves come to life.

metas.name: Okay
metas.description: Struggling with the loss of her husband, a widow processes her grief by searching for him amidst the cosmos.

metas.name: The Hail Mary
metas.description: Sister Kathy finds an angry loner in need of redemption and leads him to his atonement by conning him into creating a football team for her Catholic School.

metas.name: Skeleton Girls. A Kidnapped Society
metas.description: A young woman on the run must survive a news cycle frenzy in order to escape a dangerous plot involving a notorious girl gang.

metas.name: Bee Wild
metas.description: Bee Wild is an inspirational, upbeat, and poetic documentary that explores the foundational role that bees play in sustaining humanity, the reasons for their sharp population decline and how we can regenerate bees worldwide so they are once again part of a thriving ecosystem. Because we are losing 1 billion pollinators annually, the film will focus on the urgent nature of both bees and other insects that pollinate our food and emphasize ways that viewers can get involved in restoring, regenerating and nurturing this largely unseen world.

metas.name: The Mental Traveller
metas.description: In the twelve hours leading up to a mysterious death at a gathering of old acquaintances, we move closer to the truth through the eyes of a hamster, a dog, a cat, a wasp, and a parrot.

metas.name: Death Reigns
metas.description: In 2022, radio hosts and music promoters Raven Moonla and Zach Moonshine organized an underground metal music festival in small town Tennessee. In doing so, they became a target for outrage from religious fundamentalists and conservative politicians, as well as a rallying point for those outside of the Bible Belt’s constrictive culture. Death Reigns follows Zach and Raven’s Metal Devastation Festival, its impact, and triumph over the forces that attempted to silence it.

metas.name: The Lightkeeper
metas.description: The Lightkeeper is the story of a lighthouse keeper stuck in a cycle of grief and the three people who change the course of his life: the housekeeper who quietly yearns for him; the beautiful American war widow whose quest for closure ignites something in him; and the hard-line priest, who starts a battle of wills with a man who has nothing to lose.

metas.name: Attack of the Killer Tomatoes: Organic Intelligence
metas.description: "Jurassic Park" meets "Dr. Strangelove". It's a reprise and fifth feature spin of the 1978 Cult Classic "Attack of the Killer Tomatoes," the franchise that went from 80s midnight screenings to help launch the Fox Children's TV Network.

metas.name: One Mile: Chapter Two
metas.description: Former special forces operative Danny is forced back onto a remote island when a violent, secretive community takes revenge by abducting his daughter Alex, launching a relentless hunt against enemies prepared for his every move.

metas.name: Nirvanna the Band the Show the Movie "Home Movies" Featurette
metas.description: Behind-the-scenes featurette included as exclusive bonus content on the physical and home media releases of Nirvanna the Band the Show the Movie.

metas.name: MagNata
metas.description: It is a cold night and there is an electric tension in the air. A box is passed from hand to hand by mafia figures with professional secrecy. They have all been ordered to pass it on to the next courier without opening it, but one of the members is following different orders.

metas.name: The Beast Hunts Back
metas.description: They came to the wilderness to hunt. Something was already hunting them. Every year, the lodge holds a competition whoever brings back the biggest trophy wins. This year, a young hunter steps into the woods determined to prove she can beat the men and bring home the prize. But the land remembers hidden secret that will turn them from hunters to prey.

metas.name: Petty
metas.description: After moving in too soon, a couple realizes they're incompatible. Now they're stuck as roommates in a hilarious war of petty shenanigans.

metas.name: Eighth Rest
metas.description: George had written a song for his wife, Freya, for their first anniversary. However, George is reluctant to share it with her until it's "perfect". When Freya falls ill, George must grapple with his idea of perfectionism and decide whether or not to share his song with her despite it's imperfections.

metas.name: Charli & the Wolf
metas.description: Awarded at the Anima Festival, Charli & the Wolf is a short film that is both accessible, sensitive, and finely crafted. In just a few minutes, Gwenaëlle de Ville blends humor and melancholy to explore a universal theme: the difficulty of embracing one’s emotions.

metas.name: The Last Portal Convergence
metas.description: In a post-apocalyptic world devastated by nuclear war, a lone survivor discovers an unstable energy source capable of powering a temporal portal. After traveling to the past, he confronts an earlier version of himself and attempts to alter the decisions that led to humanity's collapse. As hidden patterns emerge and long-buried secrets are revealed, he realizes that survival depends not on escaping time, but on choosing which future deserves to exist.

metas.name: Out of State Plates
metas.description: A film about the dangers of driving in the south during the Freedom Summer of 1964.

metas.name: Lo que está en el interior de la caña
metas.description: This documentary showcases the importance of sugar mills in Tucumán cinema. It traces the history of filmmaking from Bagazo (2025) back to the beginnings of cinema in the province.

metas.name: Dicks-A-Thon
metas.description: Conceived as a challenge between twin brothers, the Dick’s-A-Thon has grown into Seattle’s premiere marathon event. Participants must run to five different locations of the iconic Dick’s Drive-In and eat something off the menu, like burgers, fries or shakes, at each stop. Dick’s-A-Thon is the origin story of a wacky run that has evolved into a beloved race with 650 participants, a fundraiser and a memorial to one of its mountaineering founders.

metas.name: The Primordial Code III - The Return of the Stars
metas.description: Filmmaker Marijn Poels embarks on a riveting quest to uncover the profound primal code that was once captivated and rewritten by intelligence and power structures.

metas.name: Staatsräson
metas.description: Building on testimony from pro-Palestinian activists in Berlin and featuring demonstration footage from between 2023 and 2025, this animated documentary explores activist culture and the people who have spent the past 2 years clashing with German police. By applying an expressive and colourful brush stroke to the experiences and anecdotes of two people closely involved with the movement, we look into the motivations that have driven them to get involved and their reactions to the repression they have experienced. Staatsraison attempts to shine light on police violence and explore how repression can drive someone ever further into a political movement.

metas.name: schhwwrrrpppp!
metas.description: A hungover hopeless romantic eats batchoy and gets flashes of his previous hook-up with every mouthful.

metas.name: The Barkley Strikes Back: The 2026 Barkley Marathons - The Strongest Field Ever vs The Course
metas.description: The 2026 Barkley Marathons featured one of the deepest and most accomplished fields in race history. With elite ultrarunners like Mathieu Blanchard, John Kelly, Max King, Damian Hall, and Sébastien Raichon all on the start line, many wondered if this would finally be the year the course was conquered again.  Coming off a brutal 2025 edition that produced no finishers and only a single Fun Run from John Kelly, expectations were uncertain. The talent was undeniable. The preparation was meticulous. But would it be enough to beat this version of the Barkley?  In this film, we follow the unfolding drama loop by loop, combining on-the-ground race coverage with historical context and insight from key voices in the Barkley ecosystem, including Lazarus Lake, Keith Dunn, and Carl Laniak.  As the race develops, a deeper reality emerges. At Barkley, fitness alone is never the whole story.

metas.name: The Race
metas.description: A family gathers at the home of their grandfather on his last day. But their motives are rattled when they each discover everyone has a hidden agenda.

metas.name: Lydia
metas.description: TV PILOT SHORT: Trapped in a bureaucratic maze not built to see her, one transgender woman sparks a historic battle against the Irish State in this dramatisation of real events.

metas.name: Ass Magic
metas.description: A day in the life of Jack Grady, magician and fastest loser on America's Got Talent.

metas.name: Sub5
metas.description: A mother’s return to dating triggers a terrifying chain of events when her teenage son’s online prank spirals out of control, turning virtual resentment into real-world terror.

metas.name: Gray Pham's Full Throttle
metas.description: 9 motorcycle racers embark on different journeys, in different championships, in different parts of the world, with one goal: Become the best in the world.

metas.name: Why Vegas Doesn't care if you visit anymore
metas.description: A short documentary exploring how Las Vegas is shifting from mass tourism toward high-spending visitors, examining falling visitor numbers, rising gambling revenues, and the economic forces reshaping the city.

metas.name: Rock Concert: Excretion Part 2
metas.description: The transformation of punk rock musician Aidan Rayburn into a folksinger is captured in a rare online concert, this courtesy of the exciting social media platform, Poof. As fellow musicians and audience members gather to hear Aidan's upcoming songs via the internet, they have no idea the surprise that awaits them. Nor does the man about to play his new music.

metas.name: East River Cross Section
metas.description: Shot between Spring and Summer 2025, divided between Wall St in Manhattan, and Red Hook/Gowanus in Brooklyn.

metas.name: Go Theodore
metas.description: Two internet-famous personalities are engaged in a destructive rivalry.

metas.name: Let Go
metas.description: When ex-best friends Orla and Meghan run into each other as adults, their past reminds us that being disabled is hard but being a teenage girl is harder.

metas.name: Ugly Little Monkeys
metas.description: Ugly Little Monkeys is a compelling documentary that brings to life the remarkable journey of Los Changuitos Feos de Tucson, the pioneering youth mariachi group in the United States. Inspired by Wilfred Arvizu's captivating book, this film delves into the heart of Tucson, Arizona, where the band was formed in the 1960s under the guidance of an unlikely mentor, Father Charles Rourke, an Irish priest with a deep passion for mariachi music.

metas.name: Prestiege Wrestling Roseland XIII
metas.description: The final show ever of Prestiege Wrestling took place on 2.20.2026 Main Evented by Kevin Blackwood vs Icarus

metas.name: Angels of Tokyo Decadence
metas.description: A high-profile escort finds herself in possession of a mysterious orb that haunts her with a mysterious presence as she confronts the meaning of love.

metas.name: Meeting at the Center of the Pit
metas.description: Lauren is excited to see her best-friend. She is observed in the time which precedes this.

metas.name: Dr. Roy Bubbles in: Double Trouble
metas.description: Dr. Roy Bubbles Monkey Scientist (a monkey who is also a scientist) and his assistant, Adam Sandler, have successfully created a cloning device to make more bananas. But an experiment gone wrong has created Dr. Bubbles’s greatest problem yet: a clone of himself. With the government on his tail and a banana republic on the rise, Dr. Bubbles and Adam Sandler must clear their names and stop the clone.

metas.name: Chirp Talker
metas.description: On her city balcony, Audrey delights in the flutter of tiny birds—fluffing their feathers, chattering, and sneaking tangerine bites. Their chirps sound like cheerful hellos and playful spats, inspiring her to invent a bird-language translator that unlocks their secret conversations.

metas.name: Camaramotion's December
metas.description: The musical/short film based off "December (Demo)" by Camaramotion. Alejandro drives around thinking about his lover, how he feels, moments with her and what to do next.

metas.name: Unrequited
metas.description: A hotel maid with a shadowy past falls for her handsome but taken coworker, unwittingly stepping into a dangerous game of desire and betrayal.

metas.name: BODYCOUNT
metas.description: During a quiet moment of closeness, a young couple’s playful banter takes a profound and sobering turn when a simple question about the past redefines the meaning of "counting" one's life experiences.

metas.name: Who Took My Family
metas.description: When devoted wife and mother Courtney’s whole family mysteriously disappears, she embarks on a desperate search, uncovering dark secrets and dangerous threats that force her to test the lengths she’ll go to find them.

metas.name: I Don't Love You Anymore
metas.description: A man is found floating lifeless in a suburban couple’s pool, and nothing about the story adds up. In separate police interrogations, their conflicting accounts twist and fracture, revealing a Rashomon-like web of deceit, buried desire, and long-denied truths. As the night of the shooting replays from shifting perspectives, a tale of love, loyalty, and betrayal slowly surfaces — darker and more disturbing than anyone wants to admit.

metas.name: Undine
metas.description: A young man in 1930s Berlin finds himself torn between his love for a young performer and his desire for wealth and power. Based on the German fairytale of the same name.

metas.name: To Your Grave
metas.description: Cop turned Private Eye, Rick Slader is given one last chance to come clean before his impending execution. Sean O'Russel, Slader's ex-partner in the LAPD, believes in his innocence and will sacrifice anything to save a doomed friend.

metas.name: Living Harriet Tubman
metas.description: A retiring Civil War reenactor stages a provocative final performance amid escalating attempts to obscure the realities of American history.

metas.name: Stalin Boys
metas.description: Four Mexican-American middle school boys in a Texas border town have developed an unusual obsession: Joseph Stalin. When their teacher tells them about the Texas State History Fair, they write a play about the Soviet dictator and his efforts to destroy all who opposed him. With cardboard props and fur hats purchased on the internet, the boys enter the competition as underdogs and leave home for the very first time.

metas.name: Sunbird
metas.description: When the pitcher Argo dares to dream of joining a real team with her best friend Goro, her best friend is determined to make it happen. The two are a battery waiting to take the field—a pitcher on the mound and a catcher behind the plate. In a desperate attempt to make their shared dream come true, the duo is separated by life and death.

metas.name: Restless
metas.description: A calculated serial killer takes one too many risks.

metas.name: Paul’s Portrait
metas.description: Paul has a physical disability: he’s paralyzed from the neck down. He cares about helping others and works on digital accessibility.

metas.name: Pickup
metas.description: Trying to complete a pickup-class assignment, a shy girl slips past her confident rivals and ends up on a rooftop smoking area where she finds a guy about to jump.

metas.name: You, Rock
metas.description: An angry man makes an important discovery while skipping rocks.

metas.name: Keepsake
metas.description: A year after her father’s passing, Saira tries to connect with her mom and brother but struggles as they seem to have moved on without her by starting a Pakistani Drama podcast.

metas.name: Pack
metas.description: A young werewolf tries to befriend a group of werewolf hunters while keeping their identity hidden.

metas.name: Seaweed Snacks
metas.description: A hard-edged dad just wants to survive another birthday party, but when a try-hard super dad won’t take “no” for an answer, things get real awkward…real fast.

metas.name: ANIMIST UNCONSCIOUS
metas.description: When sound, abstraction, and LiDAR imaging awaken Metro Atlanta’s animist unconscious, a displaced landscape is compelled to reckon with its histories of erasure as Black life resurfaces through animist persistence and collective splintering.

metas.name: Auras
metas.description: an experimental self portrait

metas.name: I AM
metas.description: Ijeoma Iloputaife’s filmic poem attesting to autonomy, spiritual expansiveness, spacetime and belief in one’s self reflects on life over the sounds of Fela and the Africa 70 while luxuriating in the aesthetic beauties of nature.

metas.name: unbroken spaces of vision
metas.description: Maono Mzimi is a 30-minute 16mm and digital hybrid performance in which loss is explored through space and motion.

metas.name: Za Mwezi
metas.description: A true happening of some things i remember in ritual or songs of the mind and moon mesmerize in the hypnosis of orbit

metas.name: Becoming Ollie
metas.description: At age nine, a childhood stroke reshapes a family’s world; creating a film together gives two siblings a way to share what had previously been difficult to explain.

metas.name: Murphy’s Ranch
metas.description: A routine pool-cleaning job leads two brothers into a hidden compound where curiosity quickly becomes a threat.

metas.name: Ghost of Home
metas.description: On the day my grandfather’s spirit was to depart and enter his new home, I began searching for the traces he left behind through different visual forms.

metas.name: Panther Pat
metas.description: In 1970, Patricia Palinkas became the first woman to play professional football. Panther Pat traces this high-stakes moment in sports history and the shattering of the gender barrier in America’s game.

metas.name: A Bloody Situation
metas.description: Through radio snippets and salon chatter, teen Nara meets Ms Moodswings, the personified menstruation blood blob. A tapestry of interrupted life, where growing up unfolds amidst implied socio-political chaos.

metas.name: Brain to Meninges
metas.description: After living with holes in my meninges for 10 years, I felt that there was a passage through which memories are passed between my brain and meninges. Through this, my memories flow by my brain like water.

metas.name: Hungry Hollow
metas.description: A girl left for dead gets devoured by forest spirits.

metas.name: The Fan Man
metas.description: A lonely tenant finds a man in his bathroom ceiling fan.

metas.name: Jonathan
metas.description: After years of war, Nyawel, a South Sudanese woman living in Kenya, travels back to her hometown in search of her missing son and mother. On the long bus journey, she meets others with broken ties. As the landscape slips by, so does time, will she find them, or is everything already lost?

metas.name: It Means Hope
metas.description: An encounter between two women—one forced to appear in a confession video, and the other, a member of the video crew.

metas.name: Harajuku, FL
metas.description: Miami, Tokyo, expensive fish eggs, and father–son turmoil… in a blender.

metas.name: Busy Barry
metas.description: A desperate boss finds his day wasted as he "patiently" awaits work due from his employee, Barry. Who just so happens to be busy with other things between the sessions of their less than pleasant calls.

metas.name: Spare Time
metas.description: When a local Ten Pin Bowling Alley in the northern suburbs of Melbourne Australia puts on a Pro Amateur competition with the biggest cash prize in the country, the local league players try their luck.

metas.name: Starlit
metas.description: Just another party of the century as three teenage girls sneak out into the night to meet up with a crew of energy drink bootlegging aliens. The true celebration is in the different forms and paths of young female individuality. They boldly discover what the universe has to offer them not without some tricks of their own.

metas.name: Pretty How Town
metas.description: A surreal drama weaving love, loss, and identity through a fractured small-town dreamscape.

metas.name: Lazarus: The Awakening
metas.description: A vigilante resurrected from death hunts a drug empire in Jackson, clashing with a kingpin, a reporter, and a city consumed by fentanyl. Justice becomes war.

metas.name: BRB
metas.description: 15-year-old Sam embarks on a road trip with her older sister Dylan to meet the boy she fell for in a chatroom.

metas.name: Going Nowhere Fast
metas.description: Three adults living with disabilities navigate an unconventional love triangle in this bittersweet portrait of resilience and connection.

metas.name: Unlimited, Forever and Ever, No Matter What
metas.description: Maggie is a mother, PE teacher, and former athlete living with chronic pain. When an accident happens at school, both her body and her relationship with her daughter begin to crumble. Will she retire on government disability or muscle through it as always?

metas.name: The LeMieurs
metas.description: Fearing regret and desperate to keep hold of their history, the five sons of a small-town Minnesota matriarch must reconcile her getting on in years. Meanwhile, for her three grandsons who own and operate a funeral home, death cannot be run from.

metas.name: Tradwife
metas.description: An actress turned tradwife influencer finally finds her dream audience, but when a troll exposes the cracks in her picture-perfect marriage during a livestream, she stages a high-stakes dinner that might just save her show–or end the act for good.

metas.name: To All The Girls I Never Banged: I'm Sorry
metas.description: A dark secret is exposed when Ed and Nath, two Brits abroad, compete for the same girl while leading a hostel bar crawl in Budapest.

metas.name: Anastacia - #NTK25 Live in Concert
metas.description: #NTK25 –Live in Concert was recorded during Anastacia's acclaimed NOT THAT KIND tour in 2025 – pure power, soul and voice.

metas.name: Oh Whale
metas.description: When news anchor Paul Linnman arrived in Florence OR on November 12th, 1970, he had no idea that the story he was about to tell would forever define his career. Following a small Oregon town, an exploding whale, and the man who made the story famous, Oh Whale is about how we don't get to choose our fate, only what we make of it.

metas.name: Surface Tension
metas.description: A strange young woman struggling with distressing visions visits a psychiatrist in an attempt to reconcile with her past.

metas.name: Veins of Grace
metas.description: An experimental mixed-media animation that blends the Indian classical art of Kathak with a deeply personal narrative of memory, identity, and return. Told through the evocative sounds of ghungroos, harmonium, and traditional bol, the film follows a young woman estranged from her cultural roots, drawn back to the rhythms once passed down by her mother — her first guru.

metas.name: Egg
metas.description: An enigmatic, fluid actor embodies a mythical figure tied to Virgil's egg, blurring reality and fiction as he recreates a film about his own life, an homage to Patroni Griffi's Il Mare. Through encounters, passions, and visions evoking ancient cults and legends, the work becomes a sensual, unsettling tribute to Naples and its magical-literary heritage.

metas.name: Box Boy
metas.description: A boy raised in a rigid, beige society where boxes define every part of his life meets a colorful flower girl who changes the way he views the world. His job, life and family all hang in the balance, but he soon learns there may be more to life outside of the box.

metas.name: Space Cadet
metas.description: A young astronaut and her guardian robot explore grief, loss and love across generations.

metas.name: One Mile: Chapter One
metas.description: After being released from special forces, a father tries to reconnect with his daughter by taking her on a tour of college, but they soon find themselves fighting for more than their lost relationship when a murderous cult pursues them.

metas.name: Midwinter Break
metas.description: Longtime retired couple Stella and Gerry realise that their relationship has reached a crossroads while on holiday in Amsterdam. After so much time and so many memories, long-held promises and deeply concealed wounds threaten to come to light and force them to confront their future.

metas.name: Famous Last Words: Eric Dane
metas.description: In this emotional interview, the late actor and ALS advocate Eric Dane shared his final message for the world — knowing it would not air until his death.

metas.name: I Can Only Imagine 2
metas.description: Following the breakout success of the song 'I Can Only Imagine', MercyMe's Bart Millard is living the dream—sold-out arenas, a devoted fanbase, and a thriving career. But behind the spotlight, Bart's past threatens the family he's built, especially the fragile bond with his son Sam. When hopeful newcomer Tim Timmons joins the band for their biggest tour yet, he unknowingly brings a renewed gratitude to Bart's life through their unlikely friendship. Bart soon discovers that Tim carries hardships—and secrets—of his own, forcing him to face his past and repair his relationships with Sam and his wife Shannon before fame costs him what matters most.

metas.name: EPiC: Elvis Presley in Concert
metas.description: Long-lost footage from Elvis Presley's legendary Las Vegas residency in the 1970s woven together with rare 16mm footage from Elvis on Tour, and 8mm from the Graceland archive, plus recordings of Elvis telling "his side of the story" rediscovered during Baz Luhrmann's research for his 2022 film, Elvis.

metas.name: Sandiwara
metas.description: In a night market, five characters recount their own unique story and represent a facet of Malaysian culture rarely explored.

metas.name: Waterman
metas.description: See the coiling smoke, sheet of ice pilling the brick. Figure I'll take a closer step. There are people inside, walking about. Figure I'll take a closer look. It notices the curiosity and flashes the lights. End the intermission. Figure, I'll watch from here.

metas.name: Sally: A Solo Play
metas.description: This powerful one-woman drama from Sandra Seaton, set at Monticello in the final days before Thomas Jefferson’s death, gives a voice to Sally Hemings. Sabrina Sloan (Hamilton’s Angelica Schuyler) portrays Sally Hemings as well as Jefferson, his daughter Martha and Sally’s brother James. Amid rising family tensions, Sally struggles to ensure Jefferson’s promise to free their children is final.

metas.name: Mr. Benjamin's Birthday
metas.description: A heartbroken health care provider is forever changed when his patient wants to give up on life.

metas.name: Huzn
metas.description: A muted melancholic drama. A women is given tragic news about her family leading to an irreversible decision.

metas.name: Fighting More Than Fire
metas.description: Fighting More Than Fire is a documentary that explores the untold history of Black firefighters in Tulsa, Oklahoma. Through personal stories, first-hand accounts, and following a “day-in-the-life” of these heroes, the film captures the struggles and triumphs of the men who broke barriers in a segregated fire department.

metas.name: The Valley where LOAB Lives
metas.description: LOAB is a creature of generative AI. The product of an anti-prompt, it haunts – as both a glitch and a ghost – the worlds of human-machine-made horror. In The Valley Where LOAB Lives, Georg Tiller takes his film craft by the horns and creates a whole new brand of storytelling: the Promptus. The Promptus openly reveals its origins and the problems inherent within it: “Working with generative models means working within systems that are designed to obscure their own origins.” In this film, he has found an ingenious solution to this problem, linking LOAB’s generated probabilities with the monstrous improbabilities of the film genre. Observing with a winking eye.

metas.name: Mimic
metas.description: The ancient tradition of Mimicry is a dying art. When Maggie, the last remaining Mimic in England has her world turned upside-down by a patient, she begins to find the cracks in her reality start to widen. What would you do if you could have one last conversation with someone you've lost?

metas.name: Tim Hawkins: Fist Bump
metas.description: Tim Hawkins brings his hilarious blend of stand-up comedy and song parodies straight to your home in his brand-new comedy special Fist Bump! Packed with Tim’s latest comedy material and songs, Fist Bump delivers laugh-out-loud entertainment the whole family can enjoy together.

metas.name: The Zabrecky Hour
metas.description: In this comedy magic and variety special, the multi-skilled Zabrecky invites you into his curious and bizarre world with storytelling and beautifully presented magic effects. A spellbinding performance of magic, deadpan comedy and reverie.

metas.name: Thanksgiving Day
metas.description: Follows a bear and his platypus assistant travelling through the galaxy in a spacecraft that looks like a dumpster as they deal with corrupt space-cops, hygiene officials, and an unusual food delivery service.

metas.name: where time slows
metas.description: Seeking quiet, a lone hiker ventures off a winter trail into a place that seems to have been expecting her.

metas.name: Caucasian Blues
metas.description: An Armenian–Azerbaijani–Georgian feature film about love, friendship, identity, and politics in the South Caucasus.

metas.name: Bakkekøbing - Fuld Gas
metas.description: The animated film 'Bakkekøbing - Full Gas' puts the accelerator to the floor in a new, thrilling chapter in Kjell Aukrust's beloved Bakkekøbing universe.  Three unlikely friends attempt to win the legendary “Paris to the Pyramids” rally.  Their inventions have created more problems than they have solved, so the mayor has banned them from staying in their small village of Bakkekøbing.

metas.name: Shazam
metas.description: in the early 2000s, shazam worked by calling a short code. you’d hold your phone near the music, hang up, shazam would match the audio on its servers and send the song details straight to you via sms. magic. always sounded like the brewing grounds for a potential love story. this is it.

metas.name: Mike Vecchione: Live from the Stress Factory
metas.description: Get ready for razor-sharp stand-up from one of the best joke writers in comedy. In his brand-new special, comedian Mike Vecchione delivers nonstop laughs in front of a packed house at the legendary Stress Factory in New Jersey. Mike tackles everything we’re all navigating in America right now: Cracker Barrel and Waffle House culture, the confusing nightmare of health insurance at 50, how to watch American politics, and being married to someone from the Midwest

metas.name: Yachay Terra
metas.description: Mariana and Xevi work the land from opposite ends of the world. Rooted in agroecology, their projects trace a quiet dialogue between territory, nature and family.

metas.name: Collision Theory
metas.description: On her way to the opportunity of a lifetime, an overly careful astrophysicist teacher finds herself stuck on a plane in a turbulent debate with a passionate flat-earther.

metas.name: The Girl that Ramsgate Forgot
metas.description: Ramsgate. A town of mystery, history, and a very large Wetherspoons. But behind the seaside charm lies a tragedy: They’ve completely forgotten I exist. This is a British mockumentary investigating the disappearance of my own reputation. If you’ve ever felt like a local legend that nobody actually knows, or if you just enjoy awkward British comedy (think Cunk on Earth vibes but with less budget), then please watch this. It's for the history books.  Recorded in the style of a BBC documentary." parts of this video were blurred & cut purely for comedy purposes jokes on me not the people in the video.

metas.name: Trailblazers
metas.description: In 1982, inspired by mountain men and legends of the Old West, brothers Troy and Powell “Gil” Gillenwater walked across Arizona. They weren’t chasing fame or following a mapped route because there wasn’t one. They were Trailblazing. What began as a homegrown adventure became a journey that reflected the rugged beauty of the Southwest. Accompanied by two mules, a stray dog, and a handful of topo maps, they faced snowstorms, irate ranchers, mule mishaps, a closed Grand Canyon, and the constant challenge of finding water. Their trek was a rebellion against convenience.  Today the Arizona Trail, a National Scenic Trail, offers that same spirit of discovery, but its roots trace back to Native Peoples, prospectors, outlaws, and two brothers who believed that if no path existed, they would create one.

metas.name: Spotify Presents: Robyn Live from Los Angeles
metas.description: Spotify welcomed Robyn to the stage for her long-awaited return with a live performance film from Los Angeles, featuring hits: “Missing U,” “Dopamine,” “Honey,” “Love is Free,” “Dancing On My Own,” and “With Every Heartbeat.”

metas.name: To Love Another
metas.description: The developing friendship between an outcast and a new girl at school.

metas.name: bradford.mov
metas.description: The GU* Cinematic Universe expands in its first spinoff - new city, new director and new shenanigans.

metas.name: Chores
metas.description: A weathered farmer is asked to offer refuge to a shady visitor. As the situation evolves, each man realizes that the other is not who they think. In the dark of night, intentions are dangerously revealed.

metas.name: Cases
metas.description: Echelon tasks Agent Albatross with a mission to obtain an important case from their rival agency, Obsidian.

metas.name: An Off Day
metas.description: After returning home from yet another rough day, Parker just wants to unwind, but is repeatedly reminded of his shortcomings. Why even bother saving others if he gets nothing but criticism?

metas.name: LIVE SANKARAS IN YOUR AREA
metas.description: What happens when you take childhood friends turned Z-List celebrities, and lock them in a recording studio in the middle of nowhere with nothing but their instruments and insatiable ego's? You get LIVE SANKARAS IN YOUR AREA.

metas.name: Cecil
metas.description: In 2015 a lion in Zimbabwe named Cecil was killed by Walter Palmer, an American dentist, provoking a global outcry. The story of Cecil’s death turns the gaze back on to us and our behaviour. The simplicity of the outrage is a stark contrast to the complexity of the reality.

metas.name: Clarities
metas.description: An ominous chain text spreads across the world as Earth’s first hotel rocketship prepares for launch.

metas.name: I Think About Birds
metas.description: A journey down the algorithmic rabbit hole of online dating coaches takes a personal turn as the filmmaker ponders her own marriage amidst digital appeals to nature. As the computer screen collides with the natural world and everyday life, the film traces a growing preoccupation with the inherent emotional risks of intimacy.

metas.name: In My Life
metas.description: A lover recalls the memories of the beginnings of his relationship.

metas.name: SPEED KILLS
metas.description: When a mysterious car crash leaves her stranded in the middle of nowhere, a wannabe race car driver takes shelter with a traveling theater troupe seeking safety, only to find herself in a twisted romance she couldn’t have imagined.

metas.name: Always Returning
metas.description: A Short Film by Rylee Zapotoschny.  A High School student’s mundane routine replayed through a dream sequence.

metas.name: Diana & Minerva
metas.description: Ancient myth keeps Diana and Minerva apart, until this film brings them together in the unlikely setting of a pink kitchen in an '80s Mexican villa. Reimagined as two contemporary women, they speak through fragmentary voice mails that blur personal pain, natural-world anxieties and the erosion of civility. With its hybrid language of observation, visual collage and dream logic, the film invents a myth inside an intimate, hyper-feminine domestic space charged with quiet, growing tension.

metas.name: The Projectionist
metas.description: In a forgotten theater, a haunted man's past flickers back to life-forcing a final reckoning.

metas.name: The Parting
metas.description: A 9-year-old girl gains control amidst family chaos by striving for her hair's perfect parting and pigtails, becoming self-reliant despite emotional turmoil.

metas.name: Monkey Bar
metas.description: A monkey steps out of a bar to get some air, grappling with the harsh nature of existence.

metas.name: Descendants/ZOMBIES Worlds Collide - Concert Special
metas.description: Celebrating the high-energy music from the iconic Descendants and ZOMBIES franchises, the Descendants/ZOMBIES Worlds Collide Tour thrilled sold-out crowds in over 40 arenas across North America last summer. Now, families and fans of all ages can relive the excitement - singing and dancing along with their favorite stars from the comfort of home.

metas.name: Bellyache
metas.description: A grieving witch escapes to a cabin alone to give birth.

metas.name: Dating Method
metas.description: When Elijah, an aspiring actor, gets feedback that his audition for a romantic role was unconvincing, he impulsively tries to pursue the first person he sees, attempting to “method act” a relationship in hopes to improve his acting skills.

metas.name: R.A. Confidential
metas.description: When 3 Residential Assistants are called to investigate a dorm of potential thieves, a violent altercation reveals the truth.

metas.name: I Want Her for Myself
metas.description: A band that has only experienced hard times writes a hit song which is stolen by a rival record label.

metas.name: The Everglades: A Symphony of Life
metas.description: "The Everglades: A Symphony of Life" reimagines the story of this fragile ecosystem, told not through a traditional narrator but through music, imagery, and the voices of those who live and work there. With sweeping cinematography and stirring music performed by New World Symphony, this documentary is an orchestral meditation on the balance of nature, humanity’s impact, and the hope for renewal.

metas.name: The System Only Dreams in Total Darkness
metas.description: A tour of my bedroom and what's in it.

metas.name: Black Waters: The Sea Empress Disaster
metas.description: The story of the 1996 Sea Empress oil spill off the Pembrokeshire coast, and how communities mobilised to respond to the disaster and protect their coastline.

metas.name: A Banker's Bounty
metas.description: An English banker travels into the crime-infested West in a desperate attempt to finance his son’s life-saving treatment overseas. But in a world ruled by outlaws and greed, survival is never guaranteed.

metas.name: How Not to Die Documentary
metas.description: In celebration of the 10th anniversary of the publication of How Not to Die, a documentary about my life and work.

metas.name: Closer Than We Think: A Year That Changes You
metas.description: A Documentary on the humanitarian organization, Youthlinc.

metas.name: Gym Buddy
metas.description: Recently dumped by his girlfriend, Dylan throws himself into the fitness, making friends with the muscular and charismatic Noah in the process. But is his admiration for Noah's physique more than aesthetic?

metas.name: Deadline
metas.description: A group of hungover film students must race against the clock in order to  finish a university project after a wild party leaves their flat, and their footage, in total  chaos.

metas.name: Bex
metas.description: Bex Clayman, a grad student who has found herself behind on life is in the middle of a huge step into adulthood. A move from Brooklyn to Denver, and a return to school have led to the beginning of a new journey to heal childhood scars left behind by the darkest depths of mental illness.

metas.name: The Cycle
metas.description: A young man realises he is stuck in a simulation and must escape before it’s too late.

metas.name: Roommate
metas.description: When a man sits down to watch a classic monster movie, a greater threat lurks in his own apartment.

metas.name: Dance Floor Tragedy
