metas.description: The film uses dance as its central metaphor, portraying how imperfect relationships maintain rhythm until imbalance can no longer be sustained.

metas.name: Travelling down Love Lane
metas.description: Be as ignorant of what you are going to catch as a fisherman of what is at the end of his fishing rod. We are travelling down the love lane and we will meet again along the way.

metas.name: Puppet Love
metas.description: A tartan paint salesperson. A Bridge Salesperson. A connection nobody expected.  Bowie Gingham is an ordinary bridge salesperson moonlighting as an actor, and Tansy Felton is a tartan paint salesperson who dreams to create more with paint than just sales.  What happens when these two salacious salespeople accidentally pick up the the phone to each other, rekindling a long forgotten romance?  Find out in Puppet Love.  Directed by Hatter Tinpenny, Puppet Love follows Bowie Gingham (Anne Flavie Testelin) and Tansy Felton (Dezharney Beignet) as they navigate the struggles of working, staying true to your passions, and finding love in a world that needs a bit of light. Oh, and they're puppets. That sing.

metas.name: Alan
metas.description: A film about Alan, among other things.

metas.name: Hyodo's Paradise
metas.description: Hyodo lives near Tokyo in a vibrant house filled with hundreds of sex dolls. An unconventional character living amidst the normalcy and conformity of Japan, his life blurs the lines between reality and fantasy. Hyodo’s hedonistic, imaginative world is explored unflinchingly in an affectionate portrait of a deeply complex man.

metas.name: Abracadabra
metas.description: On a school bus ride that feels both endless and fleeting, Agastya wrestles with identity, guilt and unspoken emotions when his best friend chooses to sit elsewhere.

metas.name: Chase Atlantic: Lost in Heaven
metas.description: Chase Atlantic's concert film captures their epic O2 Arena show closing the LOST IN HEAVEN Tour. The Australian trio, plus touring members, showcase years of growth that led to filling major venues and earning billions of streams.

metas.name: Tomato Soup
metas.description: Dodd, a freshly signed baseball player struggling to say goodbye to his hometown, spends his final night trying to reconnect with an old lover.

metas.name: Adonis
metas.description: When Nathan is invited to a poolside stag party, the thought of standing beside his perfectly sculpted friends sends his confidence spiralling. Facing his body insecurities head-on, he must decide whether to take the plunge or hide away. A queer comedy.

metas.name: Wood Street
metas.description: Two unhoused men turned community leaders— John and LaMonté —organize their neighbors in the face of displacement, addiction, and a failing social system.

metas.name: How Not to Die
metas.description: The majority of premature deaths can be prevented through simple changes in diet and lifestyle. In How Not to Die, Dr. Michael Greger examines the fifteen top causes of death in America-heart disease, various cancers, diabetes, high blood pressure, and more. He explains how nutrition and lifestyle can sometimes trump prescription pills and other approaches, freeing us to live healthier lives.

metas.name: More Dead Than Living
metas.description: A bitter, cranky widow is visited by Death, who lets him know that his time is up. He’s ready and happy to die but not without having one last “magic” adventure with his estranged daughter, whom he never got it right with.

metas.name: Hellfire
metas.description: A drifter with a mysterious past arrives in a small town and finds the residents in the grip of a ruthless crime boss and realizes he has to help them.

metas.name: Big Bryce Son
metas.description: After the death of his father and the birth of his son in the same year, Rapper Bryce Savoy finds himself navigating a transformative chapter in his life.

metas.name: Watches of Cinema
metas.description: In this feature-length masterclass, we’re taking you on a journey that is nothing short of cinematic. Hosted by movie and watch expert, Danny Milton, we’re charting not only the most significant, culture-defining watches across movie history, but also what the film giants behind the camera, like Kubrick, Lucas, and Cameron, wore, and some little-known tricks of the trade.

metas.name: CAM GIRL FREIGHT
metas.description: A series of outtakes, location hunting, and tests for a feature film that was never made becomes a page from the film diary of my first winter in the Lagoon. As always, filming is just a pretext to play with the camera and try a series of tricks concentrated in just 100ft of film. Filmed and edited with Kenta and Kae.

metas.name: The Bluff
metas.description: When her tranquil life on a remote island is shattered by the return of her vengeful former captain, a skilled ex-pirate must confront her bloody past and unleash her deadly talents to save her family from a ruthless siege.

metas.name: Butter Tea
metas.description: In a small Tibetan cafe in Queens, a cup of butter tea becomes a bridge between generations.

metas.name: Beyond The Autumn
metas.description: "Beyond the Autumn" «Persian: پس از خزان»  is a poetic meditation on the collapse that humanity calls "the end." Here, autumn is not a season of falling leaves, but a threshold where existence sheds its veil within the shadows. Beyond this descent, perhaps only a light of serenity remains. It whispers that following the world's silence, a subtler form of consciousness may emerge.  "At the farthest edge of the soil, eyes open that no longer belong to the ground."

metas.name: 2000 Light Years From Sanity
metas.description: On a distant forgotten planet, Millennium, we once watched the dream die - Are we still 2000 light years from sanity? The 10th Film in the 'Wade on 8' shot on video, film series.

metas.name: Call Me When You Wake Up
metas.description: A young man wakes up to a message from the girl he likes asking him to call her. What begins as an ordinary moment soon turns into a haunting realization as he confronts a silence he never expected. Call Me When You Wake Up is an intimate exploration of love, absence, and the unseen emotional battles people carry within themselves.

metas.name: Baylin and the Ducks
metas.description: A young divorcee reckons with the sudden end of his marriage through caring for the pet ducks his ex-wife left behind.

metas.name: The Stranger
metas.description: A man is followed by an unsettling stranger as he walks throughout the woodlands taking photos for a woodland photography competition.

metas.name: God's Thoughts
metas.description: A look into Bowdoin College's Mary Frances Searles Building

metas.name: 4th Rope Wrestling: Westside Gunn Day
metas.description: 4th Rope Westside Gunn Day took place on 28.08.2025 and aired on YouTube on 17.2.2026

metas.name: Strange Light
metas.description: Psychedilic autobiographical abstraction.

metas.name: Evan Hull: Big Cool Bug
metas.description: In his debut comedy special, Evan Hull captures a glimpse of his world from the perspective of a "well-adjusted" 28-year-old. Born and raised in Denver, Colorado, and now living in Chicago,he tells tales of erotic dolls, drunk wrestling his own father, and other chaotic anecdotes told from the perspective of a middle child in a far too supportive Jewish family. Filmed at the Laughing Tap in Milwaukee, Wisconsin, Evan has shown that while this may be his first special, it will not be his last.

metas.name: Breakdown
metas.description: A family in crisis take a roadtrip to visit one of their own. Unless they can learn to communicate, the journey threatens to tear them even further apart.

metas.name: Noor
metas.description: Follows Moreen, New Zealand's first female Iraqi police officer, as she recounts her experiences as a refugee, a domestic abuse survivor, and eventually a community leader.

metas.name: Dava
metas.description: During a rare visit from her tradition-minded grandmother, a young Indian girl lets slip that she's left handed. Horrified, her grandmother and aunt set out to change that, and a battle of wills ensues.

metas.name: Faster Than Fear
metas.description: Three motorcyclists share the experiences, anxieties and philosophies which inform their lives on the road.

metas.name: Engari
metas.description: Brothers in smalltown New Zealand make pocket money off of tourists who visit a local cave, said to be the home of a mythical bird-woman. One night, a terrifying encounter leads the boys to drastically change their business model.

metas.name: Supercars - Road to Glory
metas.description: Go inside the pressure cooker of Australia's Supercars Final. Chaos erupts, hearts broken and dreams are realised on the streets of Adelaide.

metas.name: Séjour éclair
metas.description: Two art history students spend a long day with a stolen painting, filling the hours with idle, superfluous conversations. All the while, they avoid confronting the obvious question: did they actually do something wrong?

metas.name: February 13th, 2026
metas.description: A man tries to get home late at night in New York City

metas.name: BYOB
metas.description: Dumped by his ex, Frank decides to enlist the help of a new Build Your Own Bride service to craft his perfect woman.

metas.name: Growing Up Nyima: Between Two Worlds
metas.description: Growing Up Nyima is a documentary film that follows Nyima Tucker, a young woman of Ngarluma, Banjima, and Yamatji heritage, as she moves between the worlds of city and country. Born in the Pilbara and raised in Karratha before relocating to Perth at sixteen, Nyima’s journey captures the tension between modern life and ancestral connection. Across the 1,500 km that separate these landscapes, she grapples with questions of identity, belonging, and the meaning of home.

metas.name: Stray Embers
metas.description: After saving his home from a historic wildfire that destroyed his town, a California man opens his doors to displaced families and neighbors, determined to stay rooted in a place that could burn again. Filmed over five years, it captures the bonds, challenges, and tensions that emerge when dozens of people and their dogs live together in the aftermath of disaster.

metas.name: Au creux des sources
metas.description: Film outtakes No shriek of mine...

metas.name: SILA
metas.description: Set on an island 600 kilometers north of the Arctic Circle, this intimate vérité portrait follows two young Inuit coming of age. Created in close collaboration with a local children’s home and filmed in the Greenlandic language, the story traces identity, tradition, loss, and resilience. Living alongside its protagonists, the film observes a fragile passage between deep cultural roots and an uncertain, rapidly changing world.

metas.name: Remember Mulugeta: Confronting Hate in Portland
metas.description: Portland in the 1980s was a hotbed of racist, skinhead violence, which reached a boiling point in 1988 when three neo-Nazis murdered Ethiopian immigrant Mulugeta Seraw. Was it homegrown hate or did it come from outside?

metas.name: Sommore: Chandelier Fly
metas.description: Get ready for comedic royalty as the Undisputed Queen of Comedy, Sommore, returns to Detroit for her 7th special, performing up close and personal at the Garden Theatre, recorded on June 28th.

metas.name: The Darkest Web
metas.description: For US agent Greg Squire and a dedicated network of specialist undercover investigators around the world, the mission is clear: track and catch serial paedophiles who operate across the dark web with the same sophistication and secrecy as international organised crime syndicates. Increasingly, these offenders are far younger than the stereotypical image of a paedophile - tech-savvy young adults who exploit digital anonymity with alarming ease.

metas.name: Sugarhouse
metas.description: In rural Vermont, aging sugarmakers honor a centuries-old tradition in this powerful meditation on family legacy, loss, and resilience. Through seven distinct portraits, the film forms a rich tapestry of stories about how we spend our time on this earth—and what we leave behind.

metas.name: Give it a Shot
metas.description: In India and the U.S., scientists are developing a new male contraceptive that could revolutionize family planning and transform women’s lives worldwide. The film follows the researchers as they strive to successfully launch a reversible male contraceptive—the first breakthrough since the modern condom was invented 200 years ago.

metas.name: Douglas Gordon by Douglas Gordon
metas.description: An intimate portrait of the Turner Prize-winning artist. As the boundary between reality and performance blurs, the shifting relationship between filmmaker and subject calls into question who is actually making the film.

metas.name: UNWRAPPING
metas.description: What is perfection?

metas.name: Mr. Wonderful
metas.description: Three generations of men—a millennial on the run from a drug dealer; his father, a jaded professor trying to keep his job; and the family patriarch fighting senility—all struggle to find meaning in life.

metas.name: TALENSSS and The Angry Inch
metas.description: We follow TALENSSS, the disgusting diva sweet transvestite from transexual Carcaixent during one of the most difficult stages of her shitty life.

metas.name: Kangaroo Kids
metas.description: A group of kids in a small town in the United States USA save a zoo.

metas.name: I Loved Lucy
metas.description: An unscripted reality competition pits a group of strangers and peers against one another online in an unpredictable game of social politics for the charities of their choice.

metas.name: You Can't Win
metas.description: The true-crime story of legendary outlaw Jack Black, whose 1926 memoir became an unlikely bestseller upon its release and later inspired generations of counter-cultural writing.

metas.name: Boys of Summer
metas.description: Two boys arrive at a remote summer camp in the Vermont woods. Free from screens and societal expectations, they learn to open up, support one another, and redefine what it means to be a boy. "Boys of Summer" is a tender vérité portrait of vulnerability, friendship, and the quiet rebellion of feeling deeply in a world that often tells boys not to.

metas.name: Interview with the Giant
metas.description: A (roughly) 48-hour cartoon about a day in the life of the local giant, Janine.

metas.name: A Life in Art: Through the Eye of Dr. Leslie King Hammond
metas.description: The life and work of Dr. Leslie King Hammond, a renowned art historian, teacher, curator and artist, exposes a side of the art world rarely seen. Through studio visits and museum exhibitions, Dr. Hammond untiringly dedicates her life to assisting artists of color find their way to success through humor, ingenuity and the incredible creativity she and her extended artist family embody. Her insistence on excellence and vision to rise above and transform the struggles she faces becomes contagious.

metas.name: A Cause for Alarm
metas.description: Christopher wrongly suspects his husband Allen and doctor Ryan of an affair and murder plot. After making Allen mail his letter to authorities about it, he threatens Allen and dies. Allen must recover the letter.

metas.name: The Call
metas.description: A drunken man who has lost his catholic faith receives a call.

metas.name: Cat & Calmell - Live From The Hordern Pavillion
metas.description: Cat & Calmell's opening set at the Hordern Pavillion in Sydney. Captured live in front of the crowd.

metas.name: Alienation
metas.description: A couple's strained relationship begins to unravel when they encounter a mysterious alien presence that challenges both their trust in each other and their grasp on reality.

metas.name: The Rise: The Gold Medal Girls of the X Games
metas.description: The journey of four teen phenoms on the road to the 2024 X Games, with the sun-soaked, rebellious world of California skate culture as the backdrop.

metas.name: Almost American
metas.description: For Sam, America has always been home. Yet without a pathway to citizenship, he and over half a million DACA recipients live in limbo, dependent on a temporary status renewed every two years. When his mother is suddenly deported, Sam must confront his own precarious reality through a new lens.

metas.name: Egg Film
metas.description: Short film by Jacob Tobin featuring visuals of an egg getting cooked.

metas.name: The Rise: The Inaugural Season of the PWHL
metas.description: In this documentary, the historic inaugural season of the Professional Women's Hockey League is explored through interviews and footage of the adrenaline-pumping games.

metas.name: Chris Locke: Tiki Madness
metas.description: Chris Locke gets loose and silly in a Tiki bar while his bartender friend Arno serves him cocktails. There’s classic stand up jokes, hilarious improvisational riffs, sound effects, dancing, and classic attention deficit madness for these bonkers times.  Filmed at the Drake Underground in Toronto.

metas.name: lips like blood
metas.description: Two night walkers fall in entombed into each others withering hearts.

metas.name: I Happy, I Lover.
metas.description: A young man named Calvin has died. Wherever he is in the afterlife, it has one rule. He has to observe a random number of moments from the last year of his life. His random number was 10.

metas.name: John 9:25 / 52:9 nhoJ
metas.description: Reworking of Karppanen's "John 9:25": double length, double reverse.

metas.name: Hustle
metas.description: A routine college enrollment turns into a psychological struggle as anxiety and overthinking distort reality, revealing how silent internal battles can feel louder than the world outside.

metas.name: Radio Sky
metas.description: When NASA loses contact with American astronauts in space, a notorious hacker - under house arrest for breaching top-level government agencies - watches the crisis unfold on the news. Acting on instinct, he illegally hacks into the Deep Space Network and gains access to the International Space Station. There, he discovers a single survivor: a first-time female astronaut, held hostage by a Russian billionaire who claims he has discovered alien life and insists NASA stole his proof. Confined to his cluttered bedroom and shackled by ankle monitors, the hacker is thrust into a deadly game. The Russian demands he break into NASA again to recover the evidence - or the girl dies. From his apartment, the hacker must guide her escape, uncover buried secrets, and evade government surveillance... or lose her forever.

metas.name: Dear Mae
metas.description: After their mother’s passing, sisters Noi and Nai are left to run her restaurant. As grief alters their relationship and pressures mount, they must navigate the fragile terrain of family, memory, and tradition.

metas.name: The Trail
metas.description: A troubled man embarks on a brief odyssey through his own mind.

metas.name: Flying Tigers
metas.description: An Alzheimer-plagued mother’s fear of tigers in Assam sparks a multi-location probe into the US army unit supplying Kunming in WWII. A collective quest through history’s butterfly effects, told via found stories and turned hybrid.

metas.name: Tutu
metas.description: Through never-before-seen archival footage and first-hand accounts of those who knew him best, the film traces Archbishop Desmond Tutu’s rise as the voice of the oppressed, guided by faith, hope and an understanding of the power of forgiveness.

metas.name: Confessions
metas.description: When a young woman confesses her lust for a man devoted to the church, her priest’s guidance blurs into provocation when he believes the confession is meant for him.

metas.name: Where We Left Off
metas.description: A survivor and a terminally ill friend take refuge during the apocalypse. When faced with the choice to keep running or finally stop, they must confront their fears, grief and mortality.

metas.name: Quantum Supremacy
metas.description: In a future threatened by rogue robots and an all-powerful AI, Captain Monroe and his crew race to prevent humanity's downfall in Quantum Supremacy.

metas.name: Rocket Fuel 001: If You Try and Fall, I'll Save You
metas.description: The first in a planned trilogy of short films from director Elijah Winfield, Rocket Fuel 001 is a lo-fi, freeform odyssey through the art of connectivity, coping with lost love and an ongoing struggle with sense of self by means of vivid, stark-colored imagery and a soundscape heavily induced with breakbeat instrumentals.

metas.name: At the Sea
metas.description: After a long rehabilitation, Laura returns to her family at their beach holiday home where she has to readjust to the complicated life she left behind. Now she is forced to face the following next chapter of her life without the career that gave her fame, fortune and, most importantly, identity.

metas.name: The Recce
metas.description: Drawing on a location test filmed in Uganda and an email exchange with the scout, this short film captures cinema’s ties to land and its entanglement with colonial imaginaries, binding the fiction of filmmaking with state-building.

metas.name: The Confession Room
metas.description: Invited to a private study on human morality, three patients take part in a therapy session led by the controlled and clinical Dr Hale. Her methods grow increasingly unorthodox as comfort is stripped away and secrets are extracted.

metas.name: An Evening With Bright Eyes and Cursive
metas.description: Go behind the scenes with exclusive interviews and live music, filmed at Higher Ground in Burlington Vermont on April 15, 2025 during Bright Eyes’ Five Dice, All Threes tour.

metas.name: An Alternate Pond
metas.description: A man takes his boat out on a pond. An conversation with a fish becomes a meditation on the lives we didn't live. Surreal imagery blurs the line between waking and dream as the film explores regret, aging, and the search for peace within the only life we have.

metas.name: Business Men
metas.description: Two mysterious and gay business men arrive at a kawaii German’s house to sell him random items until he goes insane.

metas.name: House of Light
metas.description: As the last lighthouse keeper in America approaches retirement, Dr. Sally Snowman reflects on her spiritual and emotional connection to the country’s oldest light station.

metas.name: Philippe Gaulier: The Man Who Waits for Freedom
metas.description: Philippe Gaulier taught theatre for over forty-five years. Students came from all around the world to attend École Philippe Gaulier in France, where they studied theatre and clown. Created in collaboration with Philippe and Michiko, this film is a final gift from a man who spent his life helping his students discover freedom.

metas.name: Factor 50 - Year of The Zebra
metas.description: Music Video for Factor 50's "Year of The Zebra".

metas.name: John and Carolyn: Love, Beauty and Loss
metas.description: Love, ambition and legacy collide under an unrelenting public spotlight throughout John F. Kennedy Jr. and Carolyn Bessette's relationship and tragic deaths in the 1990s.

metas.name: Deep Dive
metas.description: Take an exclusive look behind the scenes of The War Between the Land and the Sea.

metas.name: Paving the Way
metas.description: Set against the sweeping landscapes of the Flathead Indian Reservation, the film highlights skateboarding’s power to build community, foster confidence, and challenge stereotypes. More than a skateboarding film, it becomes a vibrant portrait of young  people who get back up every time they fall.

metas.name: There's Hell in Hello, But More in Goodbye (For Henry Jaglom)
metas.description: Elaine Fuentes recounts their short yet impactful friendship with Henry Jaglom.

metas.name: Love & Madness
metas.description: A chance meeting between the hopeless romantic Henry and aspiring actress Chloe reveals a poignant glimpse into the crossroads of youth, ambition, and the personal struggles that come with pursuing one's dreams.

metas.name: To Catch a Cheater
metas.description: When her teenage daughter dies under mysterious circumstances, a mother's search for truth unravels a chain of lies and betrayal among her closest friends, forcing her to confront evil in her own circle.

metas.name: Big Sky Falling
metas.description: A shocking drug and murder scandal erupts within Montana State University's athletic program. As investigators pursue the case, a cocaine ring run by current and former players comes to light, entangled with weapons, threats, and underground crime. The violence ripples through the MSU community, leaving Bozeman permanently changed.

metas.name: Almost Always
metas.description: 'Almost Always' follows a teenager counting down to finally leaving abroad for university as he spends his last days at home with his lifelong best friend. But his quiet urgency suggests there’s more he isn’t saying, as he hides a truth she won’t understand until it’s too late.

metas.name: The Bear Hunter
metas.description: Following a lifelong hunter deep into the Northern Yukon, the film tracks his pursuit of the animal he reveres most. With a careful eye on the often-overlooked spiritual motivations behind the hunt, and exploring the ethical contradictions, the film challenges viewers to confront the complexities of the hunting instinct in the modern world.

metas.name: Talliyah
metas.description: Capturing the spirit of Indian Relay Racing—a fast, dangerous sport that has rarely made space for women—the film follows one of its top competitors as she leaps bareback from horse to horse, racing at full speed around the track.

metas.name: Love, Ted Bundy
metas.description: As America's most notorious serial killer Ted Bundy awaited execution, he exchanged a series of death row letters with the woman who loved him like a brother - his cousin, Edna Martin.

metas.name: The Board
metas.description: After rumours spread of a puzzle leading to a secret treasure left behind by the president of the  University, two students find themselves seven years deep into untangling this labyrinth of lies  with only one name to guide them... David.

metas.name: Ghosts In York: Truth or Tourist Trap
metas.description: We investigate the paranormal in the historic city of York.

metas.name: Portals
metas.description: a journey through spiritual gateways filmed in the Dine'tah

metas.name: A Circle as the Center of the Whole
metas.description: The city of Delhi is a site of constant excavation, formed by fragments of what is left behind. Archaeology becomes method and metaphor, revealing an absence in the ground around which the city forms.

metas.name: The Moths & the Flame
metas.description: In Pahokee, Florida, the myth of the absent Black father is contradicted every day: housework, children’s birthdays, neighbourhood, care. In vignettes brimming with solidarity, Contento traces out his protagonists’ self-confidence. Calm and attentive.

metas.name: This Suffocating Now
metas.description: At a time when elements of fascisation are becoming ever more apparent, ever more pervasive, artist Vika Kirchenbauer takes a personal look at what is in the air in present-day Germany.

metas.name: The Apocalypse of St. John
metas.description: The Apocalypse of St. John invites viewers on an epic journey through the visions revealed to the Apostle John on Patmos. This cinematic experience brings the Book of Revelation to life through striking visuals, immersive sound, and powerful dramatizations that draw audiences deep into the apocalyptic narrative. Beyond its spectacle, the film offers clear and engaging explanations of each vision, illuminating their theological meaning through the lens of ancient Christian tradition. It presents Revelation not as distant symbolism, but as a living prophecy with profound relevance for our age. Blending drama, documentary insight, and faithful exegesis, the film guides viewers through the mysteries of the End Times and the great spiritual battle at the heart of the prophecy.

metas.name: The Ballad of Judas Priest
metas.description: Witness the 50-year story of Judas Priest. From forging Heavy Metal in the British Steel industry to their rise to Metal Gods.

metas.name: Bitters
metas.description: At the end of a lovely wedding rehearsal, the Maid of Honor gives a speech in a last-ditch attempt to win the love of the bride.

metas.name: How to Make a Killing
metas.description: Disowned at birth by his obscenely wealthy family, blue-collar Becket Redfellow will stop at nothing to reclaim his inheritance, no matter how many relatives stand in his way.

metas.name: Love Sick Rebourne
metas.description: Can Samantha Anderson survive the worst night of her life, or will the weapon of mass destruction she was made to be, take over?

metas.name: Running Late
metas.description: A short and sweet film about a couple running late to their wedding. Made with love! For love!

metas.name: The Chirp of Men
metas.description: A lonely customer service agent seeks fleeting moments of connection through anonymous cruising in a local park. These wordless encounters are choreographed like the courtship dances of birds, providing a stark contrast to his isolated life.

metas.name: Meong!
metas.description: Meong, a stray cat in campus who spends its daily life by playing around and occasionally causing a bit of mischief. One day, Meong meets a college student who is overwhelmed with stress while working on her final thesis. Over time, the interactions between the student and Meong grow deeper. How will the dynamics of this unlikely friendship between a cat and a university student unfold?

metas.name: Dior: Anatomy of an Haute Couture Collection
metas.description: The House of Dior opens its ateliers to us for Jonathan Anderson's first Dior Haute Couture collection! Jonathan Anderson takes you behind the scenes, onto to the runway and into the ateliers to explain his vision, silhouette by silhouette, embroidery by embroidery! Are you ready for his first wedding dress?

metas.name: Just Friends
metas.description: Natalie connects with Isaac after a series of bad dates, but navigating the blurry lines between friendship and romance proves messier than expected.

metas.name: The Oracle
metas.description: Teenage tarot reader Celine has always idolized her mother, Mara - a magically unique woman convinced she possesses real supernatural gifts. But when Mara disappears from their home, Celine’s search for answers pulls her beyond the comfort of her tarot deck into something much darker.

metas.name: The Letter
metas.description: A one-minute short where a piece of news changes the relationship between two best friends forever.

metas.name: Sketti.
metas.description: Two friends video chat to talk, but one refuses to turn his camera on...again

metas.name: Treagens' Black Shadows
metas.description: Treagen Kiers' Black Shadows is a chilling triptych thriller that dissects the fragile morality of the modern world through three visceral chapters wrapped into one provocative film.

metas.name: The Space Between Us
metas.description: A messy house party and a tense cleanup. Three friends struggle to come to terms with a hard hitting truth that weighs on them all.

metas.name: Five Minutes Away
metas.description: A woman walks through town, carrying her bouquet of flowers, her boyfriend is only five minutes away...

metas.name: Incessant
metas.description: Haunted by what she believes is her husband's spirit, a grieving widow embarks on a time-traveling journey through her memories in a desperate attempt to change the past.

metas.name: Kintsugi
metas.description: Carla and Patrick navigate the raw aftermath of their breakup over one evening. This intimate portrayal explores the beauty and flaws of their relationship.

metas.name: Moana Jr: The Ranches Academy School Performance
metas.description: Live Recording of the Ranches Academy School Performance of "Disney’s Moana JR", a musical adaptation of the 2016 Disney animated film, bringing the adventures of Moana and her village of Motunui to life onstage. Moana JR. features all the beloved songs from the film, written by Tony®, GRAMMY, Emmy, and Pulitzer Prize-winning composer Lin-Manuel Miranda, Opetaia Foa’i, and Mark Mancina, including “How Far I’ll Go,” “Shiny,” and “You’re Welcome.”  This thrilling and heartwarming coming-of-age story follows the strong-willed Moana as she sets sail across the Pacific to save her village and discover the truth about her heritage. Moana and the legendary demigod Maui embark on an epic journey of self-discovery and camaraderie as both learn to harness the power that lies within. With empowering messages of bravery and selflessness, Moana JR. is sure to bring out the hero within each of us.

metas.name: KIRAC 29: Whore Dialectics
metas.description: While Ben Lunato awaits his day in court, we embark with him on a journey through the world of whores. We traverse bizarre mental landscapes and arrive in Los Angeles, where we meet our friend, the art dealer Stefan Simchowitz, and, of course, whores. Endlessly many whores.  In Los Angeles, walking through the warehouses that store Stefan Simchowitz’s vast collection of contemporary African art, a promising discovery emerges concerning whores and fetishized Africans. In this film these figures appear to merge into an affirmative horizon, beyond woke ideology and politics, toward a new art, reaching back to reestablish a link with modernist symbolism as represented by Picasso’s Demoiselles d’Avignon.

metas.name: XOXO
metas.description: Love's mirror

metas.name: The Wrong Drink
metas.description: In a dusty saloon somewhere in the American West, a quiet afternoon of poker and whiskey is interrupted when a bounty hunter named Annie Baker walks in searching for answers. She believes someone in the room knows who stole her weapons — and she’s not leaving without a name.  What begins as an uneasy reunion with an old acquaintance quickly spirals into chaos when a drink meant for celebration turns deadly. As suspicion spreads across the saloon, every patron becomes a potential culprit, and the tension rises with every passing second.  With guns drawn and trust evaporating, Annie forces the room into a brutal game of truth, where one wrong move could mean death.

metas.name: Make Up Sex
metas.description: After a year of dating, a young couple explores the boundaries of what Make Up Sex can do for their relationship. Jeremy, not looking for confrontation, agrees to give it a try as they gear up to start that one fight worth making up over.

metas.name: Sambahin Ang Ngalan Mo
metas.description: On the eve of Christmas, two lovers confront faith and forbidden love, deciding whether devotion means obedience or choosing each other.

metas.name: Kino
metas.description: Kino by Marta Szewczyk and Andrea Jarales tells the story of a woman whose daily routine begins to blur as her obsession with a local cinema grows. Visionary hallucinations and fleeting moments of wonder weave through her life, mixing with the monotony of everyday existence. Each scene — from empty streets to the chaos in her apartment — reflects the protagonist’s inner disarray, showing how the line between reality and imagination becomes increasingly thin.

metas.name: Season's Greetings
metas.description: At a Christmas party, a girl seeks closure from her ex, only to get answers she doesn’t want.

metas.name: Bi-Rista
metas.description: Leslie, an awkward queer woman, tries to work up the courage to ask out the cute barista at her local coffee shop.

metas.name: Short Sharp Scares: Valentine
metas.description: Passion and obsession collide this Valentine's Day.

metas.name: I Just Shit My Pants
metas.description: On Valentine's Day, a man shits his pants while proposing to his girlfriend.

metas.name: Tender: Aerin Frankel & Gwyneth Philips
metas.description: "Tender" is a tribute to the care, responsibility, and quiet eccentricity of the goaltending position – exploring a lesser-seen side of some of the fiercest competitors in a brutal sport. Told through the intertwined careers of Team USA goaltenders Aerin Frankel & Gwyneth Philips, this short documentary highlights the talents, habits, and quirks that make both athletes individually elite at their craft, while allowing their distinct personalities to shine through. It also examines the unique bond between goalie partners – a relationship defined by mutual trust and respect, forged over years as both teammates and opponents.

metas.name: Pencil & Doodles
metas.description: On the eve of her departure, a citywide blackout traps two childhood best friends in an apartment, forcing them to face the conversation about love they can no longer avoid.

metas.name: Calabash
metas.description: When two families with distinct traditions, expectations, and unspoken agendas come together for a celebration meant to unite them, anxiety-fueled scenarios quickly spiral.

metas.name: My Hero
metas.description: On their way to Comic-Con, a timid guy in an ill-fitting Spider-Man freezes as two bullies humiliate his girlfriend.

metas.name: The Amazing Bulk: Re-Bulked
metas.description: The greatest mockbuster of all time has been reimagined and reinterpreted by nearly 100 people.

metas.name: Homewreckers
metas.description: With his friends constantly crashing at his house and straining his relationship with his girlfriend, James must choose between his friends and his girlfriend.

metas.name: Sam Darnold's Redemption
metas.description: Sam Darnold's journey from early career setbacks to Super Bowl stardom with the Seattle Seahawks is chronicled. NFL Films follows the player's path through multiple teams, showcasing both struggles and triumphs.

metas.name: For The Love of Film
metas.description: A heartbroken film student is pulled out of his slump by his colleague and rediscovers passion for cinema. When a major movie podcast invites him to join an episode, he sees a chance to finally move forward as he steps into a moment that could change everything.

metas.name: "Bad News"
metas.description: A man is having a Good Day until he receives some Bad News.

metas.name: D RATING
metas.description: After anonymously purchasing a service from his favorite OnlyFans model, a young man must confront his choices when meeting this woman in the real world.

metas.name: Take 37
metas.description: In the sweltering heat of a indie film set, Molly, a dedicated young actress, endures a relentless barrage of misogynistic slights from her domineering director co-stars and ex love interest. As subtle condescension—dismissive comments, unwanted touches, and endless “adjustments” to her performance—escalates,  the grueling shoot drags on take after take. The air grows thicker, bodies slick.  Pushed to her absolute limit, Molly snaps. In a raw, explosive outburst, she unleashes the feral rage she’s bottled up for too long—shattering the facade of polite tolerance that women are expected to maintain. Chaos erupts on set, but in the aftermath, Molly stands unapologetic, reclaiming her power and proving a searing truth: a woman’s fury doesn’t diminish her humanity—it affirms it. This unflinching drama exposes the toxic underbelly of an industry built on silencing women, delivering a cathartic reckoning that lingers long after the credits roll.

metas.name: Bloated
metas.description: Billy, a queer college student and hopeless romantic, gets swept into what seems like a romantic connection with a kind man. From a light and cheesy beginning, Billy gradually confronts the pain of unreciprocated feelings and blurred boundaries. In the end, he learns that love does not have to come from romance to be real — and that, for now, choosing himself is enough.

metas.name: Tinseltown in Time
metas.description: Worried about his grieving partner Amelia, Shane orchestrates a date night, virtually taking her all the way across the world to experience a moment of serenity under the Tinseltown skyline.

metas.name: Party of the Past
metas.description: A man waits for guests who may arrive from another time.

metas.name: Window Service Only
metas.description: A new customer can’t decide if he wants the single or the double.

metas.name: Two Guys and a Time Machine
metas.description: Two roommates find out how to control time what could go wrong? (answer: everything)

metas.name: Ghosted In Love
metas.description: At a Halloween party, a reclusive English major, Will, falls in love with the mysterious Ghost Girl. But before he can get her name, she vanishes. It is up to Will and his best friend Marty to find Ghost Girl before she is lost forever.

metas.name: Cupid
metas.description: Follow Cupid and her new client Neha as they race the clock to find her a date for Valentine's Day. Will she find a perfect match? Or has it been there all along...?

metas.name: The Prodigy
metas.description: Roger Sportsmans comes to Bellingham to escape his crime-riddled past when he stumbles on an underground foosball ring.

metas.name: How to Kill a Mermaid: The Linnea Mills Story
metas.description: A heart-wrenching true-crime documentary exploring the death of 18-year-old Linnea Mills during a 2020 cold-water scuba dive in Montana’s Glacier National Park. Using never-before-seen footage, it reexamines the fatal dive and investigation, offering an intimate portrait of a life cut short.

metas.name: Wild Asia: Life at Extremes
metas.description: Atop the world’s tallest peaks of the Himalayas, get an intimate look at elusive Snow Leopards and Tiger moms in Nepal raising their young. Witness a Tibetan Fox ‘hide-and-seek hunting’ amongst yaks on an ancient plateau, catch glimpses of the secretive red panda in its remote forest stronghold, meet the remarkable long-eared jumping Jerboa in the harsh Gobi Desert, and fly alongside beautiful songbirds feeding on “sapcicles” in northern Japan. In the world’s richest coral seas of the Pacific, discover the cute-yet-deadly Sea Bunny and be immersed in an unbelievable shark feeding frenzy, that’s never been filmed before. Each story reveals the incredible ways in which wildlife has adapted to thrive in these challenging habitats.

metas.name: The Butterfly Lab
metas.description: At Oregon’s only women’s prison, incarcerated women raise an endangered butterfly. In the Lab, eggs are collected and caterpillars are fed by hand, each life stage carefully nurtured.  As metamorphosis nears, the film reflects on captivity, purpose, care, and the natural world.

metas.name: Love Hurts
metas.description: After kidnapping a Valentine’s Day icon, local mob boss Frank Deeno learns the hard way that love hurts like hell.

metas.name: Love Notes
metas.description: A couple diagnoses and dissects their relationship through thoughts and notes.

metas.name: AEW Grand Slam Australia 2026
metas.description: Grand Slam Australia 2026 was a professional wrestling event promoted by All Elite Wrestling (AEW) that took place on February 14, 2026 at Qudos Bank Arena in Sydney, New South Wales, Australia, and was headlined by MJF (c) vs. Brody King for the AEW World Championship.

metas.name: Creation Story: A First Date
metas.description: A middle-aged woman embarks on a first date.

metas.name: Osculum Infame: The Shameful Kiss
metas.description: A Catholic college student wants to join a coven, so she goes to a chapel and performs a ritual in hopes of summoning the devil. Where she can then perform the Osculum Infame and be initiated!

metas.name: The Last Egg
metas.description: After the passing of her last living relative, an astronaut travels across a sterile universe to a hostile planet believed to have a psionic egg with the ability to restore life. However, the closer she gets the more aggressive the egg and the planet become.

metas.name: Kiss Me
metas.description: Desperate for affection, Hazel unravels while grappling with the lack of intimacy and fulfillment in her life.

metas.name: The Dating App Killer: The Monica White Story
metas.description: A divorcee reenters the dating pool by creating an online profile, but when her match displays unsettling behavior and a series of women from the same dating site go missing, she must save herself from becoming the next victim.

metas.name: Practice Makes Perfect
metas.description: When best friends Rory and Lola arrive at Lola's crush's party, they don't expect anything to happen. Let alone for the crush to ask Lola if she wants to 'go somewhere quieter?'. Now panicking in a bathroom, Rory has to comfort Lola while pushing down growing feelings of her own.

metas.name: The Same Frame
metas.description: While writing a screenplay for successful film producer Sally Kimmer, twin brothers Austin and Lee learn of their true sibling rivalry. As tensions rise, Sally finds herself having to prove herself worthy to her pushy boss Mr. Williams.

metas.name: This Desirable Device
metas.description: Exploring the power that comes with language itself, the worth of the device, not the meaning, an artist considers the actual price of emigrating into a “better life”, while working in a restrictive political climate.

metas.name: Enjoy Your Stay
metas.description: To avoid losing custody of her six-year-old daughter in Manila, Luz, an undocumented Filipina cleaner working in a luxury Swiss ski resort, must earn money at any cost – even if it means transgressing her own moral limits.

metas.name: Not a Hero
metas.description: Exiled from city comforts to his ancestral village, Mivan meets his embittered aunt, befriends a horse and joins the local kids on wild adventures, discovering the beauty of life and a courage he never knew he had.

metas.name: Graft Versus Host
metas.description: In this speculative video essay, the filmmaker connects his medical history with the shifts in post-Cold War geopolitics and their impact on contemporary politics.

metas.name: Kontrewers
metas.description: The ghost of a possessed girl, trapped for centuries within a stone, encounters the director’s 102-year-old grandmother. What begins as a haunting becomes a tender dialogue, as archival, staged and documentary footage blur.

metas.name: A Woman's Place Is Everywhere
metas.description: After the sudden death of their mother, identical twin sisters face eviction from the Williamsburg, Brooklyn loft they’ve called home for more than three decades.

metas.name: Because of Cupid
metas.description: Best friends Naomi and Marcus participate in a Valentine's Day mocktail competition but things go awry when Cupid interferes with a love potion that affects Marcus and several of their friends.

metas.name: Bucks Harbor
metas.description: Boys in Downeast Maine are shaped by the brutal winters, their harvesting of the ocean’s bounty and the rigid codes of their fathers. Bucks Harbor explores growing up in a community where a man’s worth is often defined by the strength of his back.

metas.name: Battle For Giant Cake the movies
metas.description: One time there was a family of Phones. Phone was one time playing on the road and found Battery. They became friends and Phone asked his family to accept Battery into the Phones family. Everyone accepted but Battery started becoming more greedy... (No more spoilers)

metas.name: Somewhere Between
metas.description: Kaveen and Liya navigating love, connection, and the moments that shape their relationship. As their bond grows, they discover what lies somewhere between companionship and vulnerability.

metas.name: Just Shy of Love
metas.description: A story of boy meets girl.

metas.name: Cigar Box
metas.description: A high schooler gives his girlfriend a cigar box, but she rejects it. Throughout the years, as their paths cross, he takes each opportunity to ask her why.

metas.name: Back Then
metas.description: Haneul greets his parents and heads to college. While in a taxi to New York, a diminishing past memory is brought up — through one old, crumbled Leche Frita wrapper.

metas.name: Where the Light Fades
metas.description: A Farmer struggling to move on from a past relationship finds comfort in a life draining entity

metas.name: More Than Monogamy
metas.description: Sexuality is complex. Sexuality is diverse. Sexuality is More Than Monogamy.  "The Lifestyle" is a massive umbrella term that encompasses swinging, polyamory, kink...and so much more; this documentary is all about highlighting and explaining why it might be perfect for your relationship and maybe why it won't.  Designed to be both educational and entertaining, let's look at why there can be so much more to a relationship than monogamy.

metas.name: Harry Kane: Against the Odds
metas.description: From a quiet academy hopeful to one of football's most prolific strikers, this documentary traces Harry Kane's determined rise through setbacks, loan spells, and relentless self-belief. Blending personal interviews, unseen training-ground moments, and career-defining matches, it reveals how discipline, mentality, and leadership transformed him from an underestimated youngster into a global sporting icon.

metas.name: Where's Urmila?
metas.description: What begins online doesn’t stay there. Where’s Urmilla? is a reflection on the emotional weight of cyberbullying, especially for queer and trans people, whose visibility often comes with a cost.

metas.name: Singh & Sinha
metas.description: Singh and Sinha are two soulmates sharing a blissful, inseparable bond for a year and a half. Their happiness abruptly shatters when one partner suddenly passes away, leaving the survivor trapped in overwhelming grief. The tragedy deepens when the protagonist discovers the cause of death: complications from AIDS. Shortly after, his own medical tests confirm that he is also HIV positive. Confronted with mortality and isolation, he undergoes a painful emotional journey. The narrative transforms absolute loss into a testament to human strength, showing his struggle to find hope, heal, and rebuild his life despite the illness.

metas.name: Boys of a Feather
metas.description: Tomás is nervously waiting for a job interview in an office lobby, when his childhood best friend Jamal walks in. But... does Jamal recognize Tomás? Tomás must decide whether or not to summon up the courage to seize this happenstance meeting in hopes of rekindling their friendship and maybe something more.

metas.name: Afterwords
metas.description: Lost in a disintegrating marriage, Kate travels to Provincetown to confront a love from her past who might be the key to her finding herself.

metas.name: Because of You
metas.description: Brayden, a young 17 year old boy, faces conflict and self doubt as he navigates the complexities of one's first love. Supported by many, he remains in question and fear until crossing paths with the one who changes everything - Thomas.

metas.name: Old Ned
metas.description: An oral history of the creation, performance, and legacy of the locally beloved guise beast Old Ned, and his role in the revived tradition of May Horns held annually in Penzance, Cornwall.

metas.name: Spooder-Kid Shattered World
metas.description: Full movie version of series.  Its been a few months since Spooder-Kid has defeated the Bubbler. Its winter time. The boys are well adjusted to their new lives. But when a new villain who goes by the name of Octavius creates a dangerous machine to  make infinite energy and finish what the Bubbler started , Spooder-Kid intervenes. Will he save his town from this new unwanted threat?

metas.name: Étienne de Crécy @ L'Ososphère 2026
metas.description: Étienne de Crécy is a pioneering figure of French Touch. Over 30 years, he's released major albums and remixed for Kraftwerk, Air, Moby, and Lil'Louis. His 1997 cult album Super Discount embodied the elegance and boldness of French electronic music. From punk bassist to sound engineer, Crécy has always embraced experimentation across projects and collaborations. A passionate DJ known for intense live performances, he electrified audiences at the 2026 Ososphère event, where Strasbourg train station became a monumental dancefloor. Lights, tension, energy: his set captivated the crowd. Filmed February 13, 2026, at Strasbourg station, France.

metas.name: Olchu Ta
metas.description: A young man moves through a series of rooms, routines, and his past, where voices linger longer than people and small objects seem to carry a memory he can’t fully grasp. As fragments of a childhood game resurface, the line between what is lived and what is remembered begins to blur.

metas.name: COMPLICIT
metas.description: A Young, Alienated teen with an affinity recorded video, goes through his weekly routines with emotional distance and emptiness, but after an encounter with someone, he soon develops a fascination that could turn dangerous.

metas.name: Finding Orson
metas.description: Andrew Callaghan helps find a lost parrot

metas.name: Gangster’s Daughter 4
metas.description: Kadisha Spencer continues to run her father’s brutal empire while matching wits with Detective Steel and meticulously eliminating her enemies.

metas.name: Working in Progress
metas.description: Working in Progress is a quirky, offbeat mockumentary that hilariously captures the bizarre and absurd day-to-day operations of Scorbsackeg, a company with a purpose no one can quite figure out. Founded and run by the delusional and self-obsessed CEO James Brownlee, the company operates out of his sister Janet's home in the small town of Progress, Delaware. Despite its lack of clear direction, James believes the business is destined for greatness. He's so convinced, in fact, that he hires a film crew to capture his "rise to success," planning to sell the documentary alongside his autobiography when he makes it big.

metas.name: Living in the Cemetery
metas.description: A mother haunted by trauma becomes overprotective of her daughter, but when the daughter falls in love, their bond fractures. As buried secrets emerge, both must confront whether forgiveness can heal old wounds before it's too late.

metas.name: Georgia Peach
metas.description: A nurse in recovery from alcoholism must confront her past and her brother's growing demands, risking everything she's worked for to reclaim her life or lose it all to her inner demons.

metas.name: Body Of Nurses
metas.description: A doctor is led into a web of betrayal by his nurses on a fateful night shift at a mysterious hospital.

metas.name: Evaporation
metas.description: Two strangers bond through fleeting moments of smoking, but beneath their connection lie a gut wrenching emptiness they can't escape.

metas.name: Big Scouse
metas.description: Big Scouse follows Terry O’Neill’s journey from Merseyside to Richmond, Virginia and the impact he had on the city's football culture with his legendary pub Penny Lane and what makes it the best football bar in America.

metas.name: Seal: Purpose
metas.description: The Grammy Award-winning British soul icon performs a celebratory concert at The Venetian in Las Vegas three decades after the release of his self-titled album Seal and eponymous follow up Seal II. Joined by longtime producer Trevor Horn, he performs a set highlighted by classic chart-topping anthems Crazy, Future Love Paradise, Killer and Kiss From a Rose, as well as a few surprises. Directed by Keirda Bahruth (Hardcore Devo) and with intimate interviews interspersed throughout, it’s a stunning film that shows this extraordinary artist at the top of his performance game.

metas.name: Feigning Tennis
metas.description: An amateur tennis player must keep up the facade of being a pro to delay her wedding to a man she’s fallen out of love with. If her career takes off, she can excuse herself from the relationship with the promise of bigger and better things, even though it might reveal she was leading him on, but if she fails, she’d rather be in a one-sided marriage than completely alone. How far will she feign tennis success before the truth comes out?

metas.name: Caught Slippin
metas.description: Three couples-Shawn and Chelsea, Mack and Ciara, and Jen and Mike-go on a weekend getaway to Joshua Tree. The trip takes a dark turn when Mack goes missing after the first day. As tensions rise and secrets come to light, the friends must confront their deepest fears and suspicions, unraveling a mystery that threatens to change their lives forever.

metas.name: Out in the Wilderness
metas.description: A group of friends try to set off on a camping trip. After a series of mistakes leaves the group stranded in the woods, they find themselves needing to go to lengths never before imagined in order to get out alive.

metas.name: Sakari Orama conducts Saariaho and Mahler With Verneri Pohjola
metas.description: The Orchestre Philharmonique de Radio France and Finnish conductor Sakari Oramo celebrate the memory of composer Kaija Saariaho with a performance of one of her last works as well as Mahler's Symphony No. 5.

metas.name: Seal – Purpose: Celebrating 30 Years of the Classic Albums Seal and Seal II (2025/2026)
metas.description: The Grammy Award-winning British soul icon performs a celebratory concert at The Venetian in Las Vegas three decades after the release of his self-titled album Seal and eponymous follow-up Seal II. Joined by longtime producer Trevor Horn, he performs a set highlighted by classic chart-topping anthems “Crazy,” “Future Love Paradise,” “Killer,” and “Kiss From a Rose,” as well as a few surprises. Directed by Keirda Bahruth (Hardcore Devo) and with intimate interviews interspersed throughout, it’s a stunning film that shows this extraordinary artist at the top of his performance game.

metas.name: Keep It Going
metas.description: This film, which follows Xavier on his first-ever headlining tour, captures a young rapper at an inflection point in his career: he's the biggest he's ever been and needs to make a decision of where to go next. With a dedicated fanbase keeping up with his every move, Xavier is still working to make his most basic ends meet. "I'm homeless right now. We trying to get a crib right now," he admits at one point during our doc. "We still got a long way to go."

metas.name: HORSEBOTTOM
metas.description: Langely Horsebottom is an aspiring basketball player and showcases his talents on film.

metas.name: Who Killed These Women? (The Tinley Park 5)
metas.description: An examination into the largest unsolved mass shooting in modern day America today. On Feb 2, 2008 a killer executed 5 women inside a Lane Bryant department store in suburban Chicago.

metas.name: Confessions of a Girl
metas.description: She has something to say.....and you better listen.

metas.name: Violent Bastards
metas.description: A disillusioned teenager embraces violence as a means to truly fight for ideologies, drawing his estranged brother into a bloody confrontation that will leave both scarred.

metas.name: Soberman
metas.description: After waking up from his first hangover, Waylon Stone experiences a life‑changing cinematic event that makes him rethink his weekend drinking habits.

metas.name: Starry Eyed
metas.description: 'A struggling actor and burnt-out painter find themselves torn between passion, love, and day jobs over a magical night at the movies.'

metas.name: The Constant Dawn
metas.description: Who are we, when our origins no longer protect us, yet continue to live within us? This short unfolds as a passage without destination, offering neither answers nor salvation. It's not a return to the origin nor a path toward redemption, but a state of permanence: the experience of inhabiting places, memories, and beliefs without ever feeling fully 'at home'.

metas.name: Sips
metas.description: Two teenagers, Tom and Mac, are pulled and chased around Brisbane city as they argue about drugs, kickons and their life ambitions.

metas.name: The Wrong Baby Daddy
metas.description: Lila’s life finally feels complete when she starts a dream job with her close friend Robin, falls into a promising romance with Mark, and discovers she’s pregnant. But everything shifts when Julia, Mark’s ex-wife, reappears the moment she learns about the baby. At first, Julia’s involvement seems harmless, even polite, until she begins showing up uninvited, inserting herself into every corner of Lila’s new life. As Julia’s presence grows more intrusive and her intentions more unsettling, Lila realizes she may be fighting to protect far more than just her future. Soon, what began as a perfect new chapter becomes a tense battle of boundaries, obsession, and survival.

metas.name: Milk, Two Sugars (A Jamie Powell Film)
metas.description: A man struggling with the loss of his wife, is startled by a knock at his front door from  an unusual visitor

metas.name: The Blind Date
metas.description: When a young woman is set up on a blind date in New York City, she realizes quickly her date is her ex-girlfriend and must decide whether to stay or go.

metas.name: For the Love of Strippers
metas.description: An intimate portrait of two L.A. strippers and activists fighting to protect their art, safety, and livelihoods during a critical inflection point for the industry and their own lives.

metas.name: Discipline
metas.description: The film examines girlhood as inherited performance-costumes worn before identity forms. Mona frames femininity as simultaneous nurture and constraint, exploring how intimacy between girls and garments becomes predetermined theatre. Clothing functions as ritual and control, dictating movement before self-knowledge arrives.

metas.name: Red Flags
metas.description: After hundreds of bad dates, a chance meeting brings two people, in the same boat, together.

metas.name: BYU's Resident Cougar
metas.description: A documentary crew follows Ella Gible, a BYU student for 20 years, who refuses to graduate until she finds a husband.

metas.name: Love & New Notes
metas.description: A couple expecting a child makes the drastic decision to attempt a robbery, finding themselves out of their depth with the homeowners they try to steal from.

metas.name: Josh Groban: An Intimate Evening at The Union Chapel
metas.description: Filmed in the intimate and historic setting of London’s Union Chapel, Josh Groban: An Intimate Evening at The Union Chapel captures the acclaimed vocalist at his most personal and powerful. Shot in November 2025, the concert film showcases Groban performing many of his most beloved songs alongside new material, all reimagined within the chapel’s soaring acoustics. The film highlights Groban’s extraordinary voice, emotional range, and deep connection with his audience.

metas.name: Bikini Nurses
metas.description: With the sheriff set to padlock their clinic at dawn, and a wealthy buyer on the prowl, three Bikini Nurses mount one last move: to impress their wealthiest patron with a show so that he'll buy the clinic and save the day.

metas.name: There Is A Woman In The Attic
metas.description: As shown as part of the LEE MILLER curation at Tate Britain with Girls In Film.  There Is A Woman In The Attic is a personal response to seeing the LEE MILLER exhibition at Tate Britain. It is a reflective piece exploring the feeling of inequality about knowing details about an artist or celebrities personal life after viewing their work, yet knowing they don’t and might never know you. In retracing Miller's own footsteps and questioning this power balance and relationship, the film poses an examination into identity and asks how well we can really know a stranger as well as how well do we know ourselves.

metas.name: Autumn Ends
metas.description: Autumn Ends follows Lily, a withdrawn international student trapped in a controlling relationship, whose emotional world shifts when she meets Nadia, a free-spirited student preparing to leave the country. As their connection deepens over a fading autumn, Lily is forced to confront desire, fear, and the quiet cost of choosing safety over truth.

metas.name: God Forgive Me
metas.description: After her father’s death, a queer Greek woman returns home to inherit a crumbling estate — only to find the house itself turning against her as grief and old debts close in.

metas.name: TNA No Surrender 2026
metas.description: No Surrender 2026 was a professional wrestling event produced by Total Nonstop Action Wrestling (TNA) that took place on February 13, 2026 at The Pinnacle in Nashville, Tennessee, USA, and was headlined by Eddie Edwards & Nic Nemeth vs. Leon Slater & Mike Santana in a Tag Team Match.

metas.name: Land Invaders
metas.description: Land Invaders is an 8-bit video game that reimagines the history and legacy of colonialism, letting players symbolically confront intergenerational trauma through arcade-style gameplay.

metas.name: Born of the Yam
metas.description: A techno-mythological ritual of light and sound to an imagined demigod born of a yam. This 16mm expanded cinema performance evokes the spectres of ritualism and mythic idols in our modern times.

metas.name: Crocodile
metas.description: In Nigeria, the young art-collective The Critics, armed with makeshift gear, conjures homemade sci-fi spectacles, chronicling their reality while blasting into wild imagined worlds.

metas.name: My Dog: The Paradox
metas.description: This film is a celebration of the absurd, unconditional love between humans and their pets, equal parts hilarious and heartfelt.

metas.name: Fortnite with Louis Noon
metas.description: Louis Noon, retired gamer, must take on a new challenge: training his disciple to become the greatest fighter in the universe... but their hunger for perfection has a price.

metas.name: Kissing Is the Easy Part
metas.description: Sean's gunning for MIT. Flora's ditching the SAT. A secret deal with her tenured parents sparks a romance that challenges everything they believe in.

metas.name: Real Couples
metas.description: Me and my girl fight a lot, it’s honestly why I’m in therapy. Is every couple like this or are my friends better than me?

metas.name: Compromised
metas.description: Six members of a crew meet up in a secret location to discuss their upcoming heist to retrieve a specific artefact; but their plan goes sideways when they discover that their mission has been leaked, and one of them is the culprit. Time for a nervous poo.

metas.name: What We Dreamed of Then
metas.description: A passionate swim coach and dedicated father navigates the turbulent reality of invisible homelessness when he is forced to live out of his van.

metas.name: The Souffleur
metas.description: Lucius Glantz, a veteran hotel manager in Vienna, fights to save his beloved establishment from a scheming realtor's plan to demolish it, leading to a clash of wills that even affects the hotel's renowned soufflé recipe.

metas.name: Mostly Void, Partially Stars
metas.description: When Sammie Mckenzie's low-stakes boyfriend cheats on her with the girlfriend of Drew Stark - Sammies high school ex - Drew and Sammies lives collide together in one night that will re-contextualize their pasts, presents, and futures.

metas.name: Love on Tap
metas.description: Amber, a headstrong brewery owner, and Samuel, a slick marketing strategist, clash over how to save her failing business. But as they stir up a plan to reinvent the brewery, they unexpectedly ferment their own love story.

metas.name: Mouse
metas.description: Callie and Minnie’s relationship is suddenly upended at the start of the summer before their senior year of high school. Left rudderless without her charismatic best friend, Minnie starts to form a complicated friendship with Callie’s mother.

metas.name: A Prayer for the Dying
metas.description: In 1870 Friendship, Wisconsin, a small town of Scandinavian settlers still suffering the repercussions of the recent Civil War. When faced with a new and even deadlier threat, one man is forced to make a harrowing choice: save his young family or defend the community that gave him a second chance at life and meaning.

metas.name: The Story of Ruby Falls
metas.description: A 5-minute short film that depicts not only the fated discovery of Ruby Falls in 1928, but also the passions of adoration and devotion that drove explorer Leo Lambert onward. Only viewable at Ruby Falls in Chattanooga, Tennessee.

metas.name: Joe's College Road Trip
metas.description: To teach his sheltered grandson about the real world, Madea's foul-mouthed brother Joe takes the college-bound teen on a raucous cross-country road trip.
